words.meaning: 轟動；爆紅的人事物；（身體的）感覺

sentences.en: The young pop sensation will perform at the opening ceremony of the new shopping mall next Saturday.
sentences.zh: 這位爆紅的年輕流行歌手，下週六會在新購物中心的開幕典禮上表演。

sentences.en: The small bakery became an overnight sensation after a famous food blogger posted a video about its cakes.
sentences.zh: 一位知名美食部落客發了蛋糕影片後，這家小麵包店一夜爆紅。

sentences.en: The company's new folding phone caused a sensation at the technology fair in Berlin last month.
sentences.zh: 公司的新款摺疊手機上個月在柏林科技展上引起轟動。

sentences.en: Some patients feel a slight burning sensation in their eyes for a few minutes after using the drops.
sentences.zh: 有些病患用了眼藥水後，眼睛會有幾分鐘輕微的灼熱感。

sentences.en: The music festival organizers hope to invite the Korean dance sensation to headline next year's event.
sentences.zh: 音樂節主辦單位希望邀請這位爆紅的韓國舞蹈明星擔任明年活動的壓軸。

words.note: 語塊：a pop sensation（爆紅的流行歌手）、an overnight sensation（一夜爆紅的人或東西）、cause／create a sensation（引起轟動）、a burning／tingling sensation（灼熱／刺痛的感覺）。sensation 有兩個意思：①轟動、爆紅的人事物 ②（身體上的）感覺。形容詞 sensational（轟動的；極好的）。和 feeling 的差別：sensation 多指身體感官的感覺，feeling 也能指情緒。

words.meaning: 前衛的；大膽有個性的；緊張不安的

sentences.en: The pop sensation is known for her edgy style, bold hairstyles, and unusual music videos.
sentences.zh: 這位爆紅的流行歌手以前衛的風格、大膽的髮型和特別的音樂影片出名。

sentences.en: The fashion brand hired a young designer to give its clothing line a more edgy look.
sentences.zh: 這個時尚品牌請了一位年輕設計師，讓服裝系列看起來更前衛。

sentences.en: Some loyal customers felt the new advertising campaign was too edgy for a family restaurant like ours.
sentences.zh: 有些老顧客覺得新的廣告活動對我們這種家庭餐廳來說太大膽了。

sentences.en: Everyone in the office felt a little edgy while waiting for the results of the company merger.
sentences.zh: 辦公室裡每個人在等公司合併結果時，都有點緊張不安。

sentences.en: The magazine wants to attract younger readers with edgy articles about music, art, and street culture.
sentences.zh: 雜誌想用關於音樂、藝術和街頭文化的前衛文章吸引年輕讀者。

words.note: 語塊：an edgy style／look（前衛、有個性的風格）、too edgy（太大膽、太敢）、feel edgy（覺得緊張、焦躁）。edgy 有兩個意思：①前衛、大膽、敢挑戰規範的（時尚、廣告、音樂常用，通常是稱讚）②緊張不安的（同 nervous）。來自 edge（邊緣）→ 走在邊緣、不走一般路線。和 cutting-edge（最先進的，指科技）不同。

words.meaning: 目前的；現行的；時下流行的

sentences.en: The singer's style feels very current, so many young fans copy her clothes and hairstyles.
sentences.zh: 這位歌手的風格很跟得上潮流，所以很多年輕粉絲模仿她的穿著和髮型。

sentences.en: Please make sure your contact information is current so that our staff can reach you in an emergency.
sentences.zh: 請確認你的聯絡資料是最新的，讓我們員工在緊急時能聯絡到你。

sentences.en: Under current rules, employees must work for six months before they can take paid vacation.
sentences.zh: 依照現行規定，員工必須工作滿六個月才能請帶薪假。

sentences.en: Our current office is too small, so the company plans to move to a larger building next year.
sentences.zh: 我們目前的辦公室太小了，所以公司打算明年搬到更大的大樓。

sentences.en: The magazine hires young writers to keep its articles about fashion and music current and interesting.
sentences.zh: 雜誌聘用年輕作者，讓時尚和音樂的文章保持新潮又有趣。

words.note: 語塊：very current（很新潮、很跟得上流行）、current rules／policy（現行規定／政策）、our current office（我們目前的辦公室）、keep＋東西＋current（保持最新）。current 最常見是「目前的、現在的」，形容風格或東西時是「時下流行的、很新潮的」。副詞 currently（目前）。當名詞是「水流；電流」。拼法很像的 currant 是「醋栗（一種水果乾）」。

sentences.en: The children's book contains a colorful illustration on every page to help young readers follow the story.
sentences.zh: 這本童書每一頁都有彩色插圖，幫助小讀者跟上故事。

sentences.en: The magazine hired a freelance artist to draw the cover illustration for its special holiday issue.
sentences.zh: 雜誌請了一位自由接案的畫家，為假期特刊畫封面插圖。

sentences.en: As an illustration of our growth, the company opened twelve new stores in Asia last year.
sentences.zh: 舉例說明我們的成長：公司去年在亞洲開了十二家新店。

sentences.en: The instruction manual includes a clear illustration showing how to connect the printer to the computer.
sentences.zh: 使用說明書附了一張清楚的圖解，說明怎麼把印表機接到電腦。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim studied illustration at an art school in Seoul before joining our design department.
sentences.zh: 金小姐加入我們設計部之前，在首爾的藝術學校讀插畫。

words.note: 語塊：a cover illustration（封面插圖）、a colorful illustration（彩色插圖）、as an illustration of（舉例說明……）、study illustration（學插畫）。illustration 有兩個意思：①插圖、圖解 ②例子、例證。動詞 illustrate（畫插圖；用例子說明），畫插畫的人叫 illustrator。別跟 illusion（錯覺）、installation（安裝）搞混。

words.meaning: 承諾；保證；（名詞）誓約、承諾

sentences.en: Several major companies pledge to reduce their carbon emissions by half within the next ten years.
sentences.zh: 好幾家大企業承諾在未來十年內把碳排放減半。

sentences.en: The new mayor made a pledge to build more affordable housing for young families in the city.
sentences.zh: 新市長承諾要為市內的年輕家庭蓋更多平價住宅。

sentences.en: Our employees pledge to donate one day of their salary to the children's hospital every December.
sentences.zh: 我們的員工承諾每年十二月捐出一天的薪水給兒童醫院。

sentences.en: The CEO kept his pledge to give every employee a bonus if the company reached its sales target.
sentences.zh: 執行長信守承諾，公司達到業績目標後給每位員工發了獎金。

sentences.en: Customers who sign the online pledge to recycle their old phones will receive a ten percent discount.
sentences.zh: 在網路上簽署承諾回收舊手機的顧客，可以享九折優惠。

words.note: 語塊：pledge to＋動詞（承諾要……）、make a pledge（做出承諾）、keep a pledge（信守承諾）、sign a pledge（簽署承諾書）。pledge 可以當動詞也可以當名詞。和 promise 意思接近，但 pledge 比較正式、公開，常用在企業、政府、捐款。同義詞：commit to、vow。

words.meaning: 引導師；（會議、課程的）主持引導人；促進者

sentences.en: The workshop facilitator asked each participant to share one challenge they face when dealing with difficult customers.
sentences.zh: 工作坊引導師請每位學員分享一個面對難搞客戶時遇到的挑戰。

sentences.en: We hired an experienced facilitator to lead the two-day strategy meeting for our management team.
sentences.zh: 我們請了一位有經驗的引導師，帶領管理團隊為期兩天的策略會議。

sentences.en: A good facilitator makes sure that everyone has a chance to speak and that the discussion stays on topic.
sentences.zh: 好的主持引導者會確保每個人都有機會發言，討論也不會離題。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen will act as the facilitator for next week's training session on time management.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐會擔任下週時間管理培訓課程的引導人。

sentences.en: The facilitator divided the employees into small groups and gave each group a different problem to solve.
sentences.zh: 引導師把員工分成小組，給每組不同的問題去解決。

words.note: 語塊：a workshop facilitator（工作坊引導師）、act as (the) facilitator（擔任引導人）、an experienced facilitator（有經驗的引導師）。facilitator 是帶領討論、讓會議或課程順利進行的人，不一定是老師，重點是引導大家參與。動詞 facilitate（促進、使……容易）。別跟 facility（設施）、faculty（全體教職員）搞混。相近：moderator（主持人，常用在座談、論壇）。

sentences.en: This year's company party will incorporate live music, a magic show, and a short awards ceremony.
sentences.zh: 今年的公司派對會加入現場音樂、魔術表演和簡短的頒獎典禮。

sentences.en: The designers plan to incorporate feedback from customers into the next version of the mobile app.
sentences.zh: 設計師打算把顧客的意見納入下一版手機應用程式。

sentences.en: The new office building will incorporate solar panels on the roof to reduce electricity costs.
sentences.zh: 新的辦公大樓會在屋頂裝太陽能板，以降低電費。

sentences.en: Our chef likes to incorporate local ingredients, such as Taiwanese tea and fresh fruit, into every dessert.
sentences.zh: 我們的主廚喜歡在每道甜點裡加入在地食材，像是台灣茶和新鮮水果。

sentences.en: The training course will incorporate several role-playing exercises to help sales staff practice speaking with clients.
sentences.zh: 培訓課程會加入好幾個角色扮演練習，幫助業務人員練習跟客戶對話。

words.note: 語塊：incorporate A into B（把 A 納入 B）、incorporate feedback／suggestions（採納意見／建議）、incorporate live music（加入現場音樂）。incorporate 是「把某樣東西加進來、變成整體的一部分」。同義詞：include、integrate。它也可以指「成立公司」，所以公司名後面常看到 Inc.（＝Incorporated，股份有限公司）。別跟 cooperate（合作）、corporate（公司的）搞混。

words.meaning: 令人愉快的；討喜的；宜人的

sentences.en: Our guests had a delightful evening at the rooftop restaurant, where they enjoyed live music and a beautiful sunset.
sentences.zh: 我們的客人在屋頂餐廳度過了愉快的夜晚，欣賞現場音樂和美麗的夕陽。

sentences.en: The hotel staff were absolutely delightful and helped us plan every day of our trip to Kyoto.
sentences.zh: 飯店員工非常親切討喜，幫我們規劃了京都之旅的每一天。

sentences.en: Thank you for the delightful gift basket, which arrived just in time for our team's holiday party.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你送的令人開心的禮物籃，剛好趕上我們團隊的節日派對。

sentences.en: Visitors will find the small museum a delightful place to spend a quiet afternoon away from the crowds.
sentences.zh: 參觀者會發現這間小博物館是遠離人潮、度過安靜下午的好地方。

sentences.en: The new café serves delightful homemade cakes, so it has quickly become popular with office workers nearby.
sentences.zh: 新咖啡店供應很美味的手工蛋糕，所以很快就受到附近上班族歡迎。

words.note: 語塊：a delightful evening／day（愉快的夜晚／一天）、absolutely delightful（非常令人愉快、討喜）、a delightful place（令人開心的地方）。delightful 形容「事物或人讓人開心」；delighted 是「人感到開心」：I was delighted.（我很高興）。同義詞：lovely、pleasant、charming。反義詞 dreadful（糟透的）。

words.meaning: （建築物及其土地的）場所；營業處所；店內

sentences.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited anywhere on the premises, including the parking lot and the outdoor seating area.
sentences.zh: 場內任何地方都嚴格禁止吸菸，包括停車場和戶外座位區。

sentences.en: All visitors must sign in at the front desk and wear a badge while they are on the premises.
sentences.zh: 所有訪客都必須在櫃台登記，並在公司範圍內配戴識別證。

sentences.en: Pets are not allowed on the premises, except for service dogs that help guests with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 場內禁止攜帶寵物，但協助身障客人的服務犬除外。

sentences.en: The restaurant has a small bakery on the premises, so all the bread is made fresh every morning.
sentences.zh: 餐廳裡面有一間小烘焙坊，所以所有麵包每天早上都是現做的。

sentences.en: Security cameras will be installed throughout the premises to protect the company's equipment at night.
sentences.zh: 整個場所都會裝上監視器，在晚上保護公司的設備。

words.note: 語塊：on the premises（在場所內；在店內／公司範圍內）、off the premises（在場所外）、throughout the premises（整個場所）、leave the premises（離開場所）。premises 是「建築物連同它的土地、營業場所」，這個意思永遠用複數。單數 premise 是另一個意思「前提、假設」。別跟 promises（承諾）搞混。

words.meaning: 入場；入場費；入學許可；承認

sentences.en: Admission to the art museum is free for children under twelve and senior citizens on weekdays.
sentences.zh: 平日十二歲以下孩童和年長者可以免費進入美術館。

sentences.en: The admission fee for the trade fair includes a printed guide and a free cup of coffee.
sentences.zh: 商展的入場費包含一本印刷導覽手冊和一杯免費咖啡。

sentences.en: Tickets can be purchased at the door, but advance purchase guarantees admission to the popular evening show.
sentences.zh: 票可以在現場買，但提前購票才能保證進場看熱門的晚場表演。

sentences.en: Applicants must submit two letters of recommendation to be considered for admission to the business program.
sentences.zh: 申請者必須繳交兩封推薦信，才會被考慮錄取這個商業課程。

sentences.en: The manager's admission that the delivery schedule was unrealistic helped the team set a more reasonable deadline.
sentences.zh: 經理承認送貨時程不切實際，幫助團隊訂出更合理的截止日期。

words.note: 語塊：admission fee（入場費）、free admission（免費入場）、admission to＋地方／學校（進入……；入學）、guarantee admission（保證入場）。admission 有三個意思：①入場（多益最常考）②入學、錄取 ③承認（an admission of guilt 認罪）。動詞 admit（准許進入；承認）。別跟 permission（許可）、commission（佣金）、submission（提交）搞混，字尾一樣。

sentences.en: For many visitors from Japan, the night market is the most popular tourist attraction in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 對很多日本遊客來說，夜市是台北最受歡迎的觀光景點。

sentences.en: Admission to the water park's newest attraction is eight dollars on top of the regular entrance fee.
sentences.zh: 水上樂園最新設施的入場費是八元，要另外加在一般門票之外。

sentences.en: The giant Ferris wheel has become the main attraction of the riverside park since it opened last summer.
sentences.zh: 巨型摩天輪去年夏天開幕後，就成了河濱公園的主要景點。

sentences.en: Free parking is a major attraction for shoppers who visit the outlet mall on weekends.
sentences.zh: 免費停車對週末來暢貨中心購物的人來說是一大吸引力。

sentences.en: If guests have a free afternoon, the hotel concierge can recommend a local attraction and book tickets for them.
sentences.zh: 如果客人下午有空，飯店禮賓人員可以推薦一個當地景點，並幫他們訂票。

words.note: 語塊：a tourist attraction（觀光景點）、the main attraction（主要景點；最吸引人的地方）、local attractions（當地景點）、a major attraction（一大吸引力）。attraction 有兩個意思：①景點、遊樂設施（遊樂園裡的設施也叫 attraction）②吸引力。動詞 attract（吸引），形容詞 attractive（有吸引力的）。別跟 attention（注意力）、attendance（出席）搞混。

words.meaning: 報名；註冊；登記；報名人數

sentences.en: Enrollment in the company's English training program has doubled since managers started offering it during work hours.
sentences.zh: 經理開始在上班時間開課後，公司英文培訓課程的報名人數增加了一倍。

sentences.en: The deadline for enrollment in the new health insurance plan is the last Friday of this month.
sentences.zh: 新健康保險方案的登記截止日是這個月的最後一個星期五。

sentences.en: Online enrollment for the spring semester will open on January fifth and close two weeks later.
sentences.zh: 春季學期的線上註冊會在一月五日開放，兩週後截止。

sentences.en: Because of low enrollment, the evening photography class was canceled and students received a full refund.
sentences.zh: 因為報名人數太少，晚間攝影課取消了，學生拿到全額退款。

sentences.en: Employees can complete the enrollment form on the HR website or pick up a paper copy at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 員工可以在人資網站填報名表，或到櫃台拿紙本。

words.note: 語塊：enrollment in＋課程／方案（報名、登記參加……）、the deadline for enrollment（報名截止日）、online enrollment（線上報名）、low／high enrollment（報名人數少／多）、an enrollment form（報名表）。動詞 enroll in（報名、註冊）。英式拼法是 enrolment（一個 l）。和 registration 意思接近，enrollment 常用在課程、學校、保險方案。

sentences.en: The newsletter was sent to undisclosed recipients, so no one could see the other customers' email addresses.
sentences.zh: 電子報是寄給不公開的收件人，所以沒有人能看到其他顧客的電子郵件地址。

sentences.en: The tech company was sold to a large investment firm last month for an undisclosed amount.
sentences.zh: 這家科技公司上個月以未公開的金額賣給了一家大型投資公司。

sentences.en: The famous singer is staying at an undisclosed location while she prepares for her world tour.
sentences.zh: 這位知名歌手在準備世界巡迴演出期間，住在一個不公開的地點。

sentences.en: Two employees left the company for undisclosed reasons, and the manager refused to answer any questions about it.
sentences.zh: 兩位員工因為不透露的原因離職，經理拒絕回答任何相關問題。

sentences.en: The contract includes an undisclosed bonus that will be paid if the project is finished ahead of schedule.
sentences.zh: 合約裡有一筆未公開的獎金，如果專案提前完成就會支付。

words.note: 語塊：undisclosed recipients（不公開的收件人，密件副本寄出時會看到）、an undisclosed amount／sum（未公開的金額）、an undisclosed location（不公開的地點）、for undisclosed reasons（因為不透露的原因）。un（不）＋disclose（公開、透露）＋ed。動詞 disclose（揭露），名詞 disclosure（揭露、公開）。

sentences.en: The email was sent to undisclosed recipients, so the list of names did not appear at the top of the message.
sentences.zh: 這封信是寄給不公開的收件人，所以收件人名單沒有出現在信件最上面。

sentences.en: All recipients of the company newsletter can unsubscribe at any time by clicking the link at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 公司電子報的所有收件人，隨時都可以點最下面的連結取消訂閱。

sentences.en: This year's award recipients will be honored at a dinner held at the Grand Hotel next Friday.
sentences.zh: 今年的得獎者會在下週五於圓山飯店舉辦的晚宴上受到表揚。

sentences.en: Scholarship recipients must keep good grades and complete twenty hours of volunteer work each semester.
sentences.zh: 獎學金得主每學期必須保持好成績，並完成二十小時的志工服務。

sentences.en: Please double-check the list of recipients before you send the contract to make sure no one is missing.
sentences.zh: 寄出合約前請再確認一次收件人名單，確保沒有漏掉任何人。

words.note: 語塊：undisclosed recipients（不公開的收件人）、award／scholarship recipients（得獎者／獎學金得主）、the list of recipients（收件人名單）、recipients of＋東西（……的接收者）。單數 recipient；動詞 receive（收到）。反義詞 sender（寄件人）。別跟 receipts（收據）、residents（居民）搞混。

words.meaning: 技工；工匠；（有手藝的）師傅

sentences.en: The construction company is hiring skilled tradespeople, such as electricians, plumbers, and carpenters, for its new projects.
sentences.zh: 建設公司正在招募有技術的技工，像是電工、水電工和木工，參與新的工程。

sentences.en: Many young people are training to become tradespeople because these jobs are stable and pay well.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕人正在受訓成為技工，因為這些工作穩定、薪水也不錯。

sentences.en: Local tradespeople will begin repairing the roof and windows of the community center next Monday.
sentences.zh: 本地的師傅下週一會開始修理社區中心的屋頂和窗戶。

sentences.en: The hardware store offers a special discount card for professional tradespeople who buy materials in large amounts.
sentences.zh: 五金行為大量購買材料的專業技工提供特別折扣卡。

sentences.en: Homeowners should always ask tradespeople for a written estimate before any renovation work in the house begins.
sentences.zh: 屋主在任何裝修工作開始前，都應該請師傅提供書面估價。

words.note: 語塊：skilled tradespeople（有技術的技工）、local tradespeople（本地師傅）、hire tradespeople（請師傅）。tradespeople 是靠手藝技術工作的人，例如 electrician（電工）、plumber（水電工）、carpenter（木工）、welder（焊工）。單數 tradesperson。tradesmen 是舊說法（偏男性），現在常用 tradespeople。別跟 salespeople（業務員）搞混。

sentences.en: Before opening his own furniture shop, Mr. Lin worked as an apprentice to a master carpenter for three years.
sentences.zh: 林先生開自己的家具店之前，跟著一位木工師傅當了三年學徒。

sentences.en: The electrical company hires one new apprentice every spring and pays him or her while learning on the job.
sentences.zh: 電力公司每年春天招一名新學徒，在學徒邊做邊學的期間付薪水。

sentences.en: Each apprentice is assigned a senior worker who teaches basic safety rules and the correct use of tools.
sentences.zh: 每位學徒都會分配一位資深員工，教他基本安全規定和正確使用工具。

sentences.en: After finishing the two-year program, an apprentice can take an exam to become a licensed plumber.
sentences.zh: 完成兩年的課程後，學徒可以參加考試，成為有執照的水電工。

sentences.en: The bakery is looking for a young apprentice who is willing to start work at five o'clock every morning.
sentences.zh: 麵包店正在找一位願意每天早上五點開始工作的年輕學徒。

words.note: 語塊：work as an apprentice（當學徒）、an apprentice to＋師傅（某師傅的學徒）、a young／new apprentice（年輕／新進學徒）。名詞 apprenticeship（學徒期、學徒制度）：complete an apprenticeship（完成學徒訓練）。相對的是 master（師傅）或 senior worker（資深員工）。相近：trainee（受訓人員）、intern（實習生，常指學生）。

sentences.en: Our new smartphone is expected to outperform its competitors in battery life and camera quality.
sentences.zh: 我們的新手機預計在電池續航和相機畫質上會勝過競爭對手。

sentences.en: In recent years, small online shops often outperform large department stores during the holiday shopping season.
sentences.zh: 近年來在假期購物季，小型網路商店常常表現得比大型百貨公司好。

sentences.en: The manager praised the sales team for helping the Taichung branch outperform all the other branches this year.
sentences.zh: 經理稱讚業務團隊，讓台中分公司今年的表現超越其他所有分公司。

sentences.en: Analysts believe the company's shares will continue to outperform the market over the next few months.
sentences.zh: 分析師認為這家公司的股票在接下來幾個月會繼續跑贏大盤。

sentences.en: New employees who receive proper training usually outperform those who are left to learn on their own.
sentences.zh: 有接受適當訓練的新員工，表現通常比讓他們自己摸索的人好。

words.note: 語塊：outperform competitors／rivals（勝過競爭對手）、outperform the market（表現超越大盤）、outperform expectations（表現超出預期）。out（超過）＋perform（表現）＝表現得比……好。後面直接接被比較的對象，不用加 than。同義詞：beat、do better than、surpass。相似字：outnumber（數量上超過）、outlast（比……持久）。

sentences.en: Please indicate your seating preference on the online form when you register for the company's annual dinner next month.
sentences.zh: 報名下個月的公司年度晚宴時，請在線上表單註明你的座位偏好。

sentences.en: According to our latest survey, many customers have a strong preference for products that use eco-friendly packaging.
sentences.zh: 根據我們最新的調查，很多顧客非常偏好使用環保包裝的產品。

sentences.en: The hotel staff asked each guest about their room preference, such as a high floor or a quiet area.
sentences.zh: 飯店員工詢問每位客人對房間的偏好，例如高樓層或安靜的區域。

sentences.en: Applicants who speak both English and Japanese will be given preference for the customer service position.
sentences.zh: 會說英文和日文的應徵者，在客服職位上會被優先考慮。

sentences.en: Our survey shows that younger employees have a clear preference for flexible working hours over a higher salary.
sentences.zh: 我們的調查顯示，年輕員工明顯比較偏好彈性工時，而不是更高的薪水。

words.note: 語塊：have a preference for（偏好……）、a strong／clear preference（強烈／明顯的偏好）、seating／room preference（座位／房間偏好）、be given preference（被優先考慮）。動詞 prefer A to B（比較喜歡 A 勝過 B）。形容詞 preferred（偏好的；優先的），例如 preferred qualifications（加分條件）。別跟 reference（參考；推薦人）搞混。

sentences.en: If you are not at home, the delivery driver will leave the parcel with the building's security guard.
sentences.zh: 如果你不在家，送貨員會把包裹交給大樓警衛。

sentences.en: Customers can track their parcel online by entering the order number on our shipping website.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在我們的物流網站輸入訂單編號，在線上追蹤包裹。

sentences.en: Please make sure the parcel is wrapped securely before you send it to our overseas office.
sentences.zh: 把包裹寄到我們海外辦公室之前，請確認包得很牢固。

sentences.en: The receptionist signed for a large parcel that arrived for the marketing department this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上櫃台人員幫行銷部簽收了一個大包裹。

sentences.en: The new parcel delivery service promises to deliver all orders within twenty-four hours in major cities.
sentences.zh: 新的包裹配送服務保證在主要城市二十四小時內送達所有訂單。

words.note: 語塊：deliver a parcel（送包裹）、track a parcel（追蹤包裹）、sign for a parcel（簽收包裹）、parcel delivery service（包裹配送服務）。parcel 是英式常用說法，美式比較常說 package，意思一樣。另外 a parcel of land 是「一塊土地」。別跟 particle（微粒）搞混。

words.meaning: 有瑕疵的；故障的；錯誤的

sentences.en: Investigators believe that faulty wiring in the kitchen caused the small fire at the restaurant last night.
sentences.zh: 調查人員認為，餐廳昨晚的小火災是廚房線路故障引起的。

sentences.en: Customers who receive a faulty product can return it within thirty days for a full refund.
sentences.zh: 收到有瑕疵產品的顧客，可以在三十天內退貨並全額退款。

sentences.en: The printer kept jamming because of a faulty part, so the technician replaced it this morning.
sentences.zh: 印表機一直卡紙是因為有個零件壞了，所以技術人員今天早上把它換掉。

sentences.en: The company recalled ten thousand electric heaters last month after discovering that some of them had faulty switches.
sentences.zh: 公司上個月發現部分電暖器的開關有問題後，召回了一萬台。

sentences.en: The report was rejected by the board because it was based on faulty data from an old survey.
sentences.zh: 這份報告被董事會退回，因為它根據的是舊調查的錯誤資料。

words.note: 語塊：faulty wiring（線路故障）、a faulty product／part（有瑕疵的產品／零件）、faulty data（錯誤的資料）。faulty 是「有毛病、有缺陷、運作不正常的」，來自 fault（缺點；過錯）。同義詞：defective（有缺陷的，比較正式）、broken（壞掉的）。和 false（錯誤的、假的）不同：faulty 強調東西「有毛病」。

words.meaning: 提出（問題、理由）；引用（cite 的過去式／過去分詞）

sentences.en: In your email, you cited an issue with the coffee machine's grinder that prevents it from working properly.
sentences.zh: 你在電子郵件中提到咖啡機的研磨器有問題，導致它無法正常運作。

sentences.en: Many employees cited long working hours as the main reason for leaving the company last year.
sentences.zh: 很多員工提到工時太長是他們去年離職的主要原因。

sentences.en: The manager cited rising fuel costs when she explained why delivery fees would increase next month.
sentences.zh: 經理在解釋下個月運費為什麼會調漲時，提到了燃料成本上升。

sentences.en: The final report cited several recent studies showing that short breaks during the day improve employee productivity.
sentences.zh: 最終報告引用了好幾份近期研究，顯示白天短暫休息能提升員工的工作效率。

sentences.en: Customers who cancelled their subscriptions this year most often cited high prices and slow customer service as reasons.
sentences.zh: 今年取消訂閱的顧客，最常提到的原因是價格太高和客服太慢。

words.note: 語塊：cite an issue／a problem（提出某個問題）、cite＋原因＋as the reason（提到……是原因）、cite a study（引用研究）。cite 是「（正式地）提到、舉出、引用」，常用在客訴回覆、報告。名詞 citation（引用；（法院的）傳票、罰單）。發音和 sight（看見）、site（地點）一樣，要靠拼法分辨。

sentences.en: You cited an issue with the coffee machine's grinder that prevents you from making fine grounds.
sentences.zh: 你提到咖啡機的磨豆器有問題，讓你無法磨出細的咖啡粉。

sentences.en: Our café uses a professional coffee grinder so that every cup tastes fresh and strong.
sentences.zh: 我們咖啡店使用專業的磨豆機，讓每一杯都喝起來新鮮又濃郁。

sentences.en: If the grinder makes a loud noise, please turn off the machine and contact our customer service team.
sentences.zh: 如果研磨器發出很大的聲音，請關掉機器並聯絡我們的客服團隊。

sentences.en: The warranty covers repairs to the grinder and the water tank for two years after purchase.
sentences.zh: 保固涵蓋購買後兩年內研磨器和水箱的維修。

sentences.en: The kitchen staff clean the meat grinder carefully at the end of every shift to keep it safe to use.
sentences.zh: 廚房員工每班結束時都會仔細清潔絞肉機，確保使用安全。

words.note: 語塊：a coffee grinder（磨豆機）、an issue with the grinder（研磨器有問題）、a meat grinder（絞肉機）。動詞 grind（磨碎），三態 grind–ground–ground。grind 也有口語意思「辛苦重複的工作」：the daily grind（每天單調辛苦的工作）。

sentences.en: The coffee machine cannot make fine grounds because there is a problem with its grinder.
sentences.zh: 咖啡機磨不出細的咖啡粉，因為它的研磨器有問題。

sentences.en: Please empty the coffee grounds from the machine at the end of each day to keep it clean.
sentences.zh: 每天結束時請把機器裡的咖啡渣倒掉，保持清潔。

sentences.en: Used coffee grounds can be collected and given to local farmers to use in their gardens.
sentences.zh: 用過的咖啡渣可以收集起來送給當地農民，用在他們的園子裡。

sentences.en: Visitors are not allowed to smoke anywhere on the hotel grounds, including the garden and parking area.
sentences.zh: 訪客不可以在飯店範圍內任何地方吸菸，包括花園和停車區。

sentences.en: The employee was dismissed on the grounds that he had repeatedly shared confidential information with competitors.
sentences.zh: 這名員工被解雇的理由是他多次把機密資訊洩漏給競爭對手。

words.note: 語塊：coffee grounds（咖啡粉、咖啡渣）、fine／coarse grounds（細／粗的咖啡粉）、on the hotel／school grounds（在飯店／學校範圍內）、on the grounds that＋句子（以……為理由）。grounds 有三個意思：①咖啡渣、咖啡粉 ②（建築物周圍的）場地、範圍 ③理由、根據。和 premises（營業場所）意思接近，但 grounds 偏指建築物外面的土地、庭院。

sentences.en: Please unplug the power cord before you clean the coffee machine or replace any of its parts.
sentences.zh: 清潔咖啡機或更換任何零件之前，請先拔掉電源線。

sentences.en: The heater stopped working because the power cord was damaged when someone moved the desk.
sentences.zh: 電暖器不能用了，因為有人搬桌子時壓壞了電源線。

sentences.en: For safety reasons, do not run an extension cord under carpets or across busy hallways.
sentences.zh: 為了安全，不要把延長線放在地毯下面或橫跨人來人往的走廊。

sentences.en: The new vacuum cleaner has a long cord, so you can clean the whole room without changing outlets.
sentences.zh: 新的吸塵器電線很長，所以不用換插座就能把整個房間吸乾淨。

sentences.en: Each laptop comes with a charging cord and a two-year warranty that covers most repairs.
sentences.zh: 每台筆電都附一條充電線，還有涵蓋大部分維修的兩年保固。

words.note: 語塊：a power cord（電源線）、an extension cord（延長線）、a charging cord（充電線）、unplug the cord（拔掉電線）。cord 是比較粗的線或繩子；cable 通常指傳輸用的線（網路線、電視線），口語上兩個常混用。cordless 是「無線的」：a cordless vacuum（無線吸塵器）。發音和 chord（和弦）一樣。

words.meaning: 加盟；加盟店；特許經營權

sentences.en: Our company plans to open a new local franchise in Taichung next year to reach more customers.
sentences.zh: 我們公司打算明年在台中開一間新的在地加盟店，接觸更多客戶。

sentences.en: Before you buy a franchise, you should carefully review the contract and understand all the monthly fees involved.
sentences.zh: 在你買下一間加盟店之前，應該仔細看過合約，了解每個月要付的各種費用。

sentences.en: The franchise owner decided to renovate the store after noticing a steady drop in weekend customer traffic.
sentences.zh: 這位加盟店老闆注意到週末來客數持續下滑後，決定重新裝潢店面。

sentences.en: New owners must pay an initial franchise fee before opening their doors to the public.
sentences.zh: 新的加盟主在對外營業前，必須先支付一筆加盟金。

sentences.en: The franchise has grown rapidly since it started offering online ordering and delivery services nationwide.
sentences.zh: 自從開始提供全國線上訂購和外送服務後，這個加盟品牌就快速成長。

words.note: 語塊：buy a franchise（買下一間加盟店）、franchise owner（加盟店老闆／加盟主）、franchise fee（加盟金）。franchise（名詞）＝加盟這個品牌／生意本身；franchisee（名詞）＝加盟主這個「人」。容易搞混：franchise 是制度或店面，franchisee 是簽約經營的那個人。

words.meaning: 保護區；儲備；（動詞）預訂、保留

sentences.en: Visitors to the Blue Mountain Animal Reserve can see deer, eagles, and wild horses in their natural habitat.
sentences.zh: 到藍山動物保護區的遊客，可以看到鹿、老鷹和野馬在牠們的自然棲地生活。

sentences.en: The company organized a volunteer day at the nature reserve to help plant trees along the river.
sentences.zh: 公司在自然保護區辦了一天志工活動，幫忙沿著河岸種樹。

sentences.en: Hunting and fishing are strictly prohibited anywhere inside the wildlife reserve to protect endangered species.
sentences.zh: 為了保護瀕危物種，野生動物保護區內任何地方都嚴格禁止打獵和釣魚。

sentences.en: The government plans to expand the forest reserve by two thousand hectares over the next five years.
sentences.zh: 政府打算在未來五年把森林保護區擴大兩千公頃。

sentences.en: Guided tours of the reserve leave from the visitor center every morning at nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 保護區的導覽行程每天早上九點從遊客中心出發。

words.note: 語塊：a nature reserve（自然保護區）、a wildlife／animal reserve（野生動物保護區）、a forest reserve（森林保護區）。reserve 當名詞是「保護區」，也可以是「儲備」：cash reserves（現金儲備）。當動詞是「預訂；保留」：reserve a table（訂位）、All rights reserved（版權所有）。名詞 reservation（預訂）。同義：preserve（保護區）、sanctuary（庇護所）。

sentences.en: The hotel is located in a beautiful colonial building that was built more than a hundred years ago.
sentences.zh: 這間飯店位在一棟一百多年前蓋的美麗殖民時期建築裡。

sentences.en: Tourists can join a walking tour of the old town to learn about its colonial history.
sentences.zh: 遊客可以參加老城區的步行導覽，了解它的殖民歷史。

sentences.en: Many restaurants in the area serve dishes that mix local flavors with recipes from the colonial period.
sentences.zh: 這一帶很多餐廳的菜色，融合了當地口味和殖民時期的食譜。

sentences.en: The city government spent three years and millions of dollars restoring the colonial architecture along the waterfront.
sentences.zh: 市政府花了三年和數百萬元，修復濱水區一帶的殖民時期建築。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibition shows furniture and clothing from the colonial era in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽展出東南亞殖民時代的家具和服飾。

words.note: 語塊：a colonial building（殖民時期建築）、colonial architecture（殖民風格建築）、colonial history（殖民歷史）、the colonial period／era（殖民時期）。colonial 是「殖民的、殖民時期的」，來自 colony（殖民地）。台灣常見的例子：淡水紅毛城、台南安平古堡附近的老建築。別跟 colossal（巨大的）搞混。

words.meaning: 古董的；古老而珍貴的；（名詞）古董

sentences.en: The hotel lobby is decorated with antique furniture that the owner collected from Europe over many years.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳擺著老闆多年來從歐洲收集的古董家具。

sentences.en: Visitors can find old maps, coins, and clocks at the antique shop near the colonial church.
sentences.zh: 遊客可以在殖民時期教堂附近的古董店找到舊地圖、錢幣和時鐘。

sentences.en: An antique dealer offered to buy the old wooden desk for much more than the family expected.
sentences.zh: 一位古董商出價要買那張老木桌，價錢比那家人預期的高很多。

sentences.en: The museum will hold a special exhibition of antique jewelry from the nineteenth century next spring.
sentences.zh: 博物館明年春天會舉辦十九世紀古董珠寶特展。

sentences.en: Please handle the antique vase carefully, because it is very fragile and cannot be replaced.
sentences.zh: 請小心拿那個古董花瓶，因為它非常易碎，而且無法取代。

words.note: 語塊：antique furniture（古董家具）、an antique shop／store（古董店）、an antique dealer（古董商）。antique 通常指一百年左右以上、有收藏價值的老東西；也可以當名詞：collect antiques（收藏古董）。和 ancient（古代的，指幾千年前）、vintage（復古的、有年代感的，常用在衣服、紅酒、二手貨）不同。

sentences.en: After the museum tour, visitors are welcome to stroll through the adjacent gardens and enjoy the flowers.
sentences.zh: 參觀完博物館後，歡迎遊客到旁邊的花園散步、欣賞花朵。

sentences.en: Many office workers stroll along the river during their lunch break when the weather is nice.
sentences.zh: 天氣好的時候，很多上班族會在午休時沿著河邊散步。

sentences.en: Guests can stroll around the night market after dinner, since it is only five minutes from the hotel.
sentences.zh: 客人晚餐後可以去夜市逛逛，因為離飯店只有五分鐘。

sentences.en: Our tour group plans to stroll through the old town tomorrow morning before the crowds of tourists arrive.
sentences.zh: 我們旅行團打算明天早上在大批觀光客到之前，去老城區散步。

sentences.en: The new walking path allows residents to stroll safely from the train station to the park.
sentences.zh: 新的步道讓居民可以安全地從火車站散步到公園。

words.note: 語塊：stroll through the gardens（在花園裡散步）、stroll along the river／beach（沿著河邊／海邊散步）、stroll around＋地方（在……四處逛逛）、take a stroll（去散散步，名詞用法）。stroll 是「慢慢地、悠閒地走」，比 walk 更放鬆。相近：wander（漫無目的地走）、hike（健行）。別跟 scroll（滑手機、捲動）搞混。

sentences.en: After the museum tour, visitors are welcome to relax and stroll through the adjacent gardens until closing time.
sentences.zh: 參觀完博物館後，歡迎遊客到旁邊的花園放鬆散步，直到閉館。

sentences.en: The conference will take place in the hotel ballroom, and lunch will be served in the adjacent room.
sentences.zh: 會議會在飯店宴會廳舉行，午餐則在隔壁的房間供應。

sentences.en: Our new office is adjacent to the train station, so commuting will be much easier for most employees.
sentences.zh: 我們的新辦公室就在火車站旁邊，所以對大部分員工來說通勤會方便很多。

sentences.en: The company bought the adjacent building last year because it needed to expand its warehouse space quickly.
sentences.zh: 公司去年買下隔壁的大樓，因為需要快速擴大倉庫空間。

sentences.en: Guests staying in adjacent rooms can request a connecting door when they book their stay online.
sentences.zh: 住在相鄰房間的客人，線上訂房時可以要求有連通門。

words.note: 語塊：the adjacent gardens／room／building（旁邊的花園／房間／大樓）、be adjacent to（緊鄰……、在……旁邊）。adjacent 是「緊鄰的、就在旁邊的」，比 nearby（附近的）更近，通常是貼著或只隔一點點。同義：next to、neighboring。別跟 adequate（足夠的）搞混。

words.meaning: 容納；配合、通融；提供住宿

sentences.en: The new conference hall can accommodate up to five hundred guests, making it ideal for large business events.
sentences.zh: 新的會議廳最多可以容納五百位來賓，非常適合大型商務活動。

sentences.en: The hotel staff did their best to accommodate our request for a quiet room on a high floor.
sentences.zh: 飯店員工盡力滿足我們想要高樓層安靜房間的要求。

sentences.en: Our restaurant is happy to accommodate guests with food allergies if they tell us in advance.
sentences.zh: 如果客人事先告知，我們餐廳很樂意配合有食物過敏的客人。

sentences.en: The company changed its work schedule to accommodate employees who need to pick up their children from school.
sentences.zh: 公司調整了工作時間，配合需要接小孩放學的員工。

sentences.en: The airline could not accommodate all the passengers on the next flight, so some had to wait until the morning.
sentences.zh: 航空公司沒辦法讓所有乘客都搭下一班飛機，所以有些人得等到早上。

words.note: 語塊：accommodate up to＋人數（最多容納……人）、accommodate a request（配合、滿足要求）、accommodate guests／employees（配合客人／員工的需要）。accommodate 有兩個意思：①容納（房間、場地裝得下多少人）②配合、通融（滿足別人的需要）。名詞 accommodation（住宿；配合），訂房網站常看到。拼法注意：兩個 c、兩個 m。別跟 accompany（陪同）、accumulate（累積）搞混。

words.meaning: （食物）精緻的、高級的；（名詞）美食家

sentences.en: The hotel's rooftop restaurant offers a gourmet dinner menu prepared by a famous French chef.
sentences.zh: 飯店的屋頂餐廳提供由知名法國主廚準備的精緻晚餐菜單。

sentences.en: The new supermarket has a gourmet food section that sells imported cheese, olive oil, and chocolate.
sentences.zh: 新超市有一區高級食品，販售進口起司、橄欖油和巧克力。

sentences.en: For the holiday party, the company ordered gourmet sandwiches and desserts from a local bakery.
sentences.zh: 公司為節日派對向本地一家烘焙坊訂了精緻的三明治和甜點。

sentences.en: Several gourmet food trucks will park near the stadium during the music festival this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這週末音樂節期間，好幾台美食餐車會停在體育館附近。

sentences.en: The cooking class teaches beginners how to make simple gourmet meals at home in under thirty minutes.
sentences.zh: 這堂烹飪課教初學者在三十分鐘內在家做出簡單的精緻料理。

words.note: 語塊：a gourmet dinner／meal（精緻的晚餐／料理）、gourmet food（高級食品、美食）、a gourmet restaurant（高級餐廳）、gourmet coffee（精品咖啡）。gourmet 是法文來的字，t 不發音，念 [ˋgʊrme]。當形容詞是「精緻高級的（食物）」，當名詞是「美食家」。和 culinary（烹飪的）不同：culinary 指「料理這件事」，gourmet 指「高級的食物」。

words.meaning: 辦理；處理（手續、訂單等）；（名詞）過程、流程

sentences.en: After you create an account on our website, you can then process a rental directly without calling the office.
sentences.zh: 在我們網站建立帳號後，你就可以直接辦理租借，不用打電話到辦公室。

sentences.en: Our customer service team usually needs three to five business days to process a refund.
sentences.zh: 我們的客服團隊通常需要三到五個工作天來辦理退款。

sentences.en: The warehouse hired ten extra workers to process the large number of online orders during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 倉庫多請了十位員工，處理假期期間大量的網路訂單。

sentences.en: The bank will process your loan application and contact you by email within one week.
sentences.zh: 銀行會審理你的貸款申請，並在一週內用電子郵件聯絡你。

sentences.en: Please wait while the system tries to process your payment, and do not close this page.
sentences.zh: 系統正在處理你的付款，請稍候，不要關閉這個頁面。

words.note: 語塊：process a rental（辦理租借）、process a refund／payment（辦理退款／付款）、process an order（處理訂單）、process an application（審理申請）。process 當動詞是「照流程辦理、處理（手續）」，比 do 或 handle 更有「跑流程」的感覺；當名詞是「過程、流程」：the application process（申請流程）。別跟 proceed（繼續進行）搞混：proceed to the gate（前往登機口）。

words.meaning: 使用權；進入；（動詞）進入、登入

sentences.en: Family members enjoy free parking and discounted meals, not to mention access to our large indoor playground.
sentences.zh: 家庭會員享有免費停車和餐點折扣，更不用說還能使用我們的大型室內遊樂場。

sentences.en: All hotel guests have access to the fitness center and swimming pool from six in the morning until ten at night.
sentences.zh: 所有房客從早上六點到晚上十點都可以使用健身中心和游泳池。

sentences.en: New employees will receive a card that gives them access to the office building on weekends.
sentences.zh: 新員工會拿到一張卡，週末也能進入辦公大樓。

sentences.en: Members can get free access to hundreds of online business courses through our learning website.
sentences.zh: 會員可以透過我們的學習網站，免費使用數百堂線上商業課程。

sentences.en: For security reasons, only the IT manager has access to the customer database from outside the office.
sentences.zh: 為了安全，只有資訊部經理能從辦公室外存取客戶資料庫。

words.note: 語塊：have access to（可以使用、可以進入）、free access to（免費使用）、give someone access to（讓某人可以使用）、access＋系統／帳號（當動詞，登入、進入）。access 當名詞後面要接 to：access to the gym；當動詞後面直接接東西，不加 to：access your account。和 use 的差別：access 強調「有權利、有辦法進去或使用」。形容詞 accessible（可進入的）。別跟 excess（過量）、assess（評估）搞混。

sentences.en: The company introduced a cute bear as its new mascot to attract more young customers to its stores.
sentences.zh: 公司推出一隻可愛的熊當新吉祥物，吸引更多年輕顧客到店裡。

sentences.en: Children lined up to take photos with the team mascot before the baseball game started.
sentences.zh: 棒球比賽開始前，小朋友排隊和球隊吉祥物拍照。

sentences.en: The city held a design contest to choose an official mascot for next year's international food festival.
sentences.zh: 市政府舉辦設計比賽，為明年的國際美食節選出官方吉祥物。

sentences.en: Our marketing team plans to print the mascot on shopping bags, cups, and other small gifts.
sentences.zh: 我們行銷團隊打算把吉祥物印在購物袋、杯子和其他小禮物上。

sentences.en: Kumamon, the famous mascot of a Japanese city, has helped bring millions of tourists to the region.
sentences.zh: 日本某城市的知名吉祥物熊本熊，幫這個地區帶來了數百萬名觀光客。

words.note: 語塊：a team mascot（球隊吉祥物）、an official mascot（官方吉祥物）、a company／brand mascot（公司／品牌吉祥物）。mascot 是代表球隊、公司、活動或城市，並帶來好運、吸引注意的角色，常常有人穿著布偶裝出現。台灣例子：各縣市的吉祥物、運動賽事的吉祥物。

words.meaning: 一陣；一段時間（不好的事發作）；（比賽）一回合

sentences.en: The outdoor concert was delayed for an hour because of a sudden bout of heavy rain in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 因為下午突然一陣大雨，戶外音樂會延後了一小時。

sentences.en: Another bout of heavy rain is expected this weekend, so the city has warned residents near the river.
sentences.zh: 預計這週末還會有一波大雨，所以市政府已經警告河邊的居民。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen missed three days of work last week after a bad bout of the flu.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐上週得了一場嚴重的流感，請了三天假。

sentences.en: After a short bout of hot weather in March, temperatures dropped again in early April.
sentences.zh: 三月短暫熱了一陣子之後，四月初氣溫又下降了。

sentences.en: The factory suffered another bout of power outages, which delayed the shipment of several orders.
sentences.zh: 工廠又遭遇一波停電，延誤了好幾筆訂單的出貨。

words.note: 語塊：a bout of heavy rain（一陣大雨）、a bout of the flu（一場流感）、a short bout of（短暫的一陣……）、another bout of（又一波……）。bout 是「一陣子、一段時間」，通常指不好的事情發作一段時間，像天氣、生病、問題。也可以指拳擊、摔角的「一回合比賽」。同義：spell（一段時間）、episode（發作）。發音 [baʊt]，跟 about 的後半一樣。

sentences.en: The amount of precipitation this month was twice as high as usual, causing floods in several low-lying areas.
sentences.zh: 這個月的降雨量是平常的兩倍，造成好幾個低窪地區淹水。

sentences.en: Weather forecasters expect heavy precipitation in the mountains, so drivers should be careful on the roads.
sentences.zh: 氣象預報員預估山區會有大量降雨，所以駕駛在路上要小心。

sentences.en: Annual precipitation in this region is very low, so farmers depend on water from the nearby river.
sentences.zh: 這個地區的年降雨量很少，所以農民依賴附近河流的水。

sentences.en: The outdoor event will continue as planned unless there is more than a seventy percent chance of precipitation.
sentences.zh: 除非降雨機率超過七成，否則戶外活動會照原定計畫進行。

sentences.en: Scientists are studying how changes in precipitation will affect rice production over the next twenty years.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在研究降水的變化會怎樣影響未來二十年的稻米產量。

words.note: 語塊：the amount of precipitation（降水量）、heavy precipitation（大量降雨／降雪）、annual precipitation（年降水量）、a chance of precipitation（降雨機率）。precipitation 是「降水」，包含雨、雪、冰雹，比 rain 更正式，常出現在氣象報告。別跟 participation（參加）、preparation（準備）、prescription（處方）搞混，字尾都一樣。

sentences.en: More than two thousand residents signed a petition asking the city to build a new park near the station.
sentences.zh: 超過兩千位居民連署請願，要求市政府在車站附近蓋一座新公園。

sentences.en: Last month, the employees started an online petition to ask management for more flexible working hours.
sentences.zh: 上個月，員工發起線上連署，要求管理層給更有彈性的工作時間。

sentences.en: The neighborhood group will submit the petition to the mayor's office at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 社區團體會在月底把請願書交給市長辦公室。

sentences.en: Local shop owners launched a petition against the plan to close the main street to cars on weekends.
sentences.zh: 本地店家發起連署，反對週末禁止汽車進入主要街道的計畫。

sentences.en: Over five hundred customers signed the petition to bring back the restaurant's popular breakfast menu.
sentences.zh: 超過五百位顧客連署，希望餐廳恢復受歡迎的早餐菜單。

words.note: 語塊：sign a petition（連署請願書）、start／launch a petition（發起連署）、submit a petition to（向……遞交請願書）、an online petition（線上連署）、a petition against＋東西（反對……的連署）。petition 是很多人簽名，正式要求政府或公司做某件事的文件。也可以當動詞：petition the government（向政府請願）。別跟 position（職位）、partition（隔板）搞混。

words.meaning: （建築）綜合區、園區；社區；（形容詞）複雜的

sentences.en: The developer plans to build a large residential complex with three hundred apartments, a gym, and a swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 建商打算蓋一個大型住宅社區，有三百戶公寓、健身房和游泳池。

sentences.en: Our company moved its headquarters to a new office complex near the airport last spring.
sentences.zh: 我們公司去年春天把總部搬到機場附近一個新的辦公園區。

sentences.en: The sports complex includes two basketball courts, a running track, and an indoor ice rink.
sentences.zh: 這個運動中心包括兩座籃球場、一條跑道和一座室內溜冰場。

sentences.en: Residents of the apartment complex can use the shared laundry room and parking lot for free.
sentences.zh: 這個公寓社區的住戶可以免費使用共用洗衣間和停車場。

sentences.en: A new shopping complex with more than one hundred stores will open downtown next year.
sentences.zh: 一個有一百多家店的新購物中心明年會在市中心開幕。

words.note: 語塊：a residential complex（住宅社區、住宅群）、an apartment complex（公寓社區）、an office complex（辦公園區）、a sports／shopping complex（運動中心／購物中心）。complex 當名詞是「由好幾棟建築或設施組成的一整區」。當形容詞是「複雜的」（a complex problem 複雜的問題），意思完全不同。名詞 complexity（複雜性）。

sentences.en: Residents signed a petition asking the city to repair the potholes on the road outside the residential complex.
sentences.zh: 居民連署請市政府修補住宅社區外面道路上的坑洞。

sentences.en: After weeks of heavy rain, many potholes appeared on the highway and caused damage to several cars.
sentences.zh: 下了幾個星期的大雨後，高速公路上出現了很多坑洞，弄壞了好幾台車。

sentences.en: City workers will fill the potholes on Main Street next Monday, so drivers should expect some delays.
sentences.zh: 市府人員下週一會填補中山路上的坑洞，所以駕駛要預期會有些延誤。

sentences.en: Several delivery drivers have complained that the deep potholes near the warehouse are damaging their tires.
sentences.zh: 好幾位送貨司機抱怨倉庫附近很深的坑洞把他們的輪胎弄壞了。

sentences.en: Drivers can report dangerous potholes through the city's mobile app, and repairs usually begin within a week.
sentences.zh: 駕駛可以透過市政府的手機 App 回報危險的坑洞，通常一週內就會開始修補。

words.note: 語塊：repair／fill potholes（修補坑洞）、report potholes（回報坑洞）、a road full of potholes（坑坑洞洞的路）。pothole 是馬路上因為下雨、車子壓過而形成的坑洞。pot（鍋子）＋hole（洞）＝像鍋子一樣凹下去的洞。單數 pothole。

sentences.en: The young director's first movie received critical acclaim and won three awards at the film festival.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕導演的第一部電影獲得影評一致好評，並在影展上拿下三個獎。

sentences.en: The small family restaurant has won international acclaim for its creative dishes made with local ingredients.
sentences.zh: 這家小家庭餐廳用在地食材做出富有創意的料理，贏得國際讚譽。

sentences.en: Her book about small business management was met with wide acclaim from readers and experts.
sentences.zh: 她那本關於小企業管理的書受到讀者和專家的廣泛好評。

sentences.en: The young architect gained acclaim for designing energy-efficient office buildings that still look modern and beautiful.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕建築師因為設計出節能又現代美觀的辦公大樓而備受讚譽。

sentences.en: Despite the public acclaim, the band decided to take a long break after their world tour ended.
sentences.zh: 儘管受到大眾讚揚，樂團在世界巡演結束後還是決定長期休息。

words.note: 語塊：critical acclaim（影評、專家的一致好評）、win／gain acclaim（贏得讚譽）、international acclaim（國際讚譽）、be met with wide acclaim（廣受好評）。acclaim 是「（公開的）讚揚、好評」，比 praise 更正式、程度更強。形容詞 acclaimed（廣受好評的）：an acclaimed author（備受讚譽的作家）。別跟 exclaim（大叫、驚呼）、claim（聲稱）搞混。

words.meaning: 慢性的；長期的；長期存在的

sentences.en: The new clinic specializes in helping older patients who suffer from a chronic ailment such as diabetes.
sentences.zh: 新診所專門幫助患有糖尿病等慢性病的年長病患。

sentences.en: Many office workers develop chronic back pain from sitting at their desks for long hours every day.
sentences.zh: 很多上班族因為每天長時間坐在桌前，得了慢性背痛。

sentences.en: The city has suffered from a chronic shortage of affordable housing for more than ten years.
sentences.zh: 這座城市長期缺乏平價住宅，已經超過十年了。

sentences.en: The factory's chronic delays in shipping have caused several important customers to look for other suppliers.
sentences.zh: 工廠長期出貨延誤，讓好幾個重要客戶開始找其他供應商。

sentences.en: The company's new insurance plan covers regular checkups and medicine for employees with chronic illnesses.
sentences.zh: 公司新的保險方案涵蓋有慢性病的員工的定期檢查和藥物。

words.note: 語塊：a chronic ailment／illness／disease（慢性病）、chronic pain（慢性疼痛）、a chronic shortage of（長期缺乏……）、chronic delays／problems（長期延誤／問題）。chronic 是「長期、一直存在、好不了」，反義詞 acute（急性的、突然很嚴重的）。也可以用在問題上，不只是生病。

sentences.en: The new clinic specializes in helping older patients who suffer from a chronic ailment such as diabetes.
sentences.zh: 新診所專門幫助患有糖尿病等慢性病的年長病患。

sentences.en: For a common ailment like a cold or a headache, a pharmacist can usually give advice without a doctor's visit.
sentences.zh: 像感冒或頭痛這種常見小病，藥師通常就能提供建議，不用看醫生。

sentences.en: The company's health program offers free massages to any employee who suffers from a back or neck ailment.
sentences.zh: 公司的健康計畫為有背部或頸部毛病的員工提供免費按摩。

sentences.en: In many Asian countries, people drink traditional herbal tea to treat a minor ailment such as a sore throat.
sentences.zh: 在很多亞洲國家，人們會喝傳統草本茶來治療喉嚨痛之類的小毛病。

sentences.en: The nurse asked each visitor about any ailment they had before allowing them to enter the patient's room.
sentences.zh: 護理師讓訪客進入病房前，先詢問每個人有沒有任何身體不適。

words.note: 語塊：a chronic ailment（慢性病）、common／minor ailments（常見小病／小毛病）、suffer from an ailment（患有……病痛）。ailment 通常指不太嚴重但讓人不舒服的病痛。比較：disease（疾病，通常比較嚴重）、illness（生病，一般說法）、condition（病況、慢性狀況，比較委婉）。

words.meaning: 分發；配（藥）；（機器）提供、吐出

sentences.en: At our hospital, only licensed pharmacists are allowed to dispense prescription medicine to patients and their families.
sentences.zh: 在我們醫院，只有持有執照的藥師可以發放處方藥給病患和家屬。

sentences.en: The new vending machine in the lobby can dispense hot and cold drinks as well as healthy snacks.
sentences.zh: 大廳的新販賣機可以提供冷熱飲料和健康零食。

sentences.en: Our customer service staff are trained to dispense helpful advice to customers who have problems with their orders.
sentences.zh: 我們的客服人員受過訓練，能給訂單有問題的顧客提供有用的建議。

sentences.en: The machine at the parking lot entrance will dispense a ticket when you press the green button.
sentences.zh: 按下綠色按鈕時，停車場入口的機器就會吐出一張票。

sentences.en: The charity plans to dispense free meals to elderly residents in the neighborhood every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 慈善機構打算每週日發送免費餐點給社區的年長居民。

words.note: 語塊：dispense medicine（配藥、發藥）、dispense drinks／cash（提供飲料／吐出現金）、dispense advice（給予建議）、dispense with（省去、不需要……）。dispense 是「分發、提供（給需要的人）」，常用在藥局和機器。相關名詞：dispenser（給皂機、飲水機等自動出物的機器），例如 a soap dispenser（給皂機）、a water dispenser（飲水機）。別跟 dispose of（丟棄）、disperse（驅散）搞混。

sentences.en: The pharmacist recommended a cream that can quickly relieve pain and swelling in the knees.
sentences.zh: 藥師推薦一種乳膏，可以很快舒緩膝蓋的疼痛和腫脹。

sentences.en: Taking a short walk during lunch can help office workers relieve stress and feel more focused in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 午餐時散步一下，可以幫上班族紓解壓力，下午更專心。

sentences.en: The city plans to build a new bridge to relieve traffic congestion near the train station.
sentences.zh: 市政府打算蓋一座新橋，紓解火車站附近的交通壅塞。

sentences.en: Two new staff members were hired to relieve the pressure on the busy customer service team.
sentences.zh: 公司請了兩位新員工，減輕忙碌的客服團隊的壓力。

sentences.en: Many patients use this medicine to relieve the symptoms of a chronic ailment such as arthritis.
sentences.zh: 很多病患用這種藥來舒緩關節炎之類慢性病的症狀。

words.note: 語塊：relieve pain（舒緩疼痛）、relieve stress（紓解壓力）、relieve traffic congestion（紓解交通壅塞）、relieve the pressure on（減輕……的壓力）。relieve 是「減輕、舒緩（不舒服或壓力）」。形容詞 relieved（鬆了一口氣的）：I was relieved to hear the news.；名詞 relief（解脫；救濟）。別跟 relive（重新經歷）搞混。

sentences.en: The new marketing director is keen to expand our presence in Southeast Asian markets by the end of next year.
sentences.zh: 新的行銷總監很想在明年底前擴大我們在東南亞市場的版圖。

sentences.en: Several board members have shown a keen interest in the proposed merger with the regional logistics firm.
sentences.zh: 幾位董事對與那家區域物流公司的合併提案表現出濃厚的興趣。

sentences.en: Ms. Patel is keen on attending the trade fair in Frankfurt so that she can meet potential suppliers in person.
sentences.zh: Patel 小姐很想參加法蘭克福的商展，好親自認識潛在的供應商。

sentences.en: Our recruiters are looking for applicants with a keen eye for detail and strong written communication skills.
sentences.zh: 我們的招募人員在找對細節很敏銳、書面溝通能力又強的應徵者。

sentences.en: Because the staff were keen to learn the new accounting software, the training session was fully booked within a day.
sentences.zh: 因為員工都很想學新的會計軟體，訓練課程一天之內就額滿了。

words.note: 語塊：be keen to（很想做）、be keen on（熱衷於）、keen interest（濃厚興趣）。keen 和 eager 都表示「渴望」，keen 還可以表示「敏銳的」（a keen eye for detail）。

sentences.en: The bakery decided to hire a bookkeeper because the owner no longer had enough time to track daily expenses.
sentences.zh: 那家麵包店決定僱用一位記帳員，因為老闆已經沒有足夠時間記每天的開銷。

sentences.en: Before joining our finance team, Mr. Lin worked as a bookkeeper for a small construction company in Taichung.
sentences.zh: 林先生加入我們財務團隊之前，在台中一家小營造公司擔任記帳員。

sentences.en: Our part-time bookkeeper updates the expense records every Friday afternoon before the office closes for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們的兼職記帳員每週五下午、辦公室週末關門前更新支出紀錄。

sentences.en: Many small businesses hire a bookkeeper to make sure that all invoices and receipts are recorded accurately.
sentences.zh: 很多小公司會僱用記帳員，確保所有發票和收據都記錄正確。

sentences.en: Applicants who wish to work as a bookkeeper at our firm must be familiar with basic accounting software.
sentences.zh: 想在我們公司擔任記帳員的應徵者，必須熟悉基本的會計軟體。

words.note: 語塊：hire a bookkeeper（僱用記帳員）、work as a bookkeeper（擔任記帳員）。bookkeeper 負責日常記帳；accountant（會計師）層級較高，負責報表分析與稅務。

sentences.en: We would like to apologize to all viewers who experienced difficulties streaming the live broadcast last night.
sentences.zh: 我們要向昨晚收看直播時遇到困難的所有觀眾致歉。

sentences.en: Due to unexpected technical difficulties, the online registration system will be unavailable until noon on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 由於意外的技術問題，線上報名系統到週二中午前都無法使用。

sentences.en: The company faced serious financial difficulties after it lost its largest client at the beginning of last year.
sentences.zh: 那家公司去年初失去最大客戶後，面臨嚴重的財務困難。

sentences.en: If you experience difficulties logging in to your account, please contact the IT help desk at extension 204.
sentences.zh: 如果你登入帳號時遇到困難，請撥分機 204 聯絡資訊服務台。

sentences.en: The airline offered free meal vouchers to passengers because of technical difficulties with the aircraft's engine.
sentences.zh: 因為飛機引擎出現技術問題，航空公司提供乘客免費餐券。

words.note: 語塊：experience difficulties（遇到困難）、technical difficulties（技術問題）、financial difficulties（財務困難）。difficulty 當「困難」時常用複數 difficulties；have difficulty (in) doing 則用單數，表示「做某事有困難」。

sentences.en: Forecasters warn that the heavy snowfall could cause a delay of several hours for all outbound flights tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 氣象人員警告，大雪明天可能造成所有出境航班延誤好幾個小時。

sentences.en: We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this schedule change may cause our valued customers and partners.
sentences.zh: 對於這次時程變更可能為我們重要的顧客和夥伴帶來的任何不便，我們深感抱歉。

sentences.en: Improper storage of these chemicals can cause damage to the sensitive equipment in the laboratory.
sentences.zh: 這些化學品存放不當，可能對實驗室裡精密的設備造成損害。

sentences.en: The power outage will not cause a delay in shipping because the warehouse has its own backup generator.
sentences.zh: 停電不會造成出貨延誤，因為倉庫有自己的備用發電機。

sentences.en: Road construction on Main Street is expected to cause inconvenience for many commuters throughout this week.
sentences.zh: Main 街的道路施工預計這整週會為許多通勤族帶來不便。

words.note: 語塊：cause a delay（造成延誤）、cause damage（造成損害）、cause inconvenience（造成不便）。cause 後面常接壞結果；result in 意思相近：The storm resulted in delays。

sentences.en: The severe thunderstorm caused a blackout that shut down the factory for most of Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 強烈雷雨造成停電，工廠週四下午大半時間都停工。

sentences.en: During last week's citywide blackout, the hospital relied entirely on its emergency generators to keep operating.
sentences.zh: 上週全市停電期間，醫院完全靠緊急發電機維持運作。

sentences.en: All employees should save their files regularly in case a blackout occurs in the middle of the workday.
sentences.zh: 所有員工都應該定期存檔，以防上班時間中途停電。

sentences.en: The utility company promised to prevent another power blackout by upgrading its old equipment before summer.
sentences.zh: 電力公司承諾會在夏天前升級舊設備，避免再次停電。

sentences.en: A brief power failure at the data center caused a blackout of our company website for about twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 資料中心短暫的電力故障，讓我們公司網站中斷大約二十分鐘。

words.note: 語塊：cause a blackout（造成停電）、a citywide blackout（全市停電）、a power blackout（停電）。blackout 指大範圍停電；power outage 意思相同，比較正式。

sentences.en: Please remember to unplug the coffee machine before you leave the break room on Friday evening.
sentences.zh: 週五晚上離開茶水間前，請記得拔掉咖啡機的插頭。

sentences.en: For safety reasons, technicians must always unplug the device before they open its plastic cover.
sentences.zh: 為了安全，技師打開塑膠外殼前一定要先拔掉裝置的插頭。

sentences.en: If the printer stops responding, unplug the cord for thirty seconds and then turn the machine back on.
sentences.zh: 如果印表機沒有反應，把電線拔掉三十秒，再把機器重新打開。

sentences.en: The instruction manual reminds users to unplug the space heater whenever it is not being used.
sentences.zh: 使用說明書提醒使用者，電暖器不用時都要拔掉插頭。

sentences.en: Staff were asked to unplug the device in each meeting room to reduce electricity costs over the long holiday.
sentences.zh: 員工被要求在連假期間拔掉每間會議室設備的插頭，以減少電費。

words.note: 語塊：unplug the device（拔掉裝置插頭）、unplug the cord（拔掉電線）。unplug 是「拔插頭」；turn off 只是「關掉」，插頭還插著。

sentences.en: The new parking policy for employees and visitors will take effect on the first day of next month.
sentences.zh: 員工和訪客的新停車規定將在下個月一號生效。

sentences.en: Rising fuel prices have had a significant effect on our overall shipping costs during this quarter.
sentences.zh: 油價上漲對我們這一季的整體運輸成本有很大的影響。

sentences.en: The holiday discount program will remain in effect until the end of January for all registered members.
sentences.zh: 節慶折扣方案對所有註冊會員都會持續實施到一月底。

sentences.en: Researchers at the institute are studying the effect of flexible working hours on employee productivity.
sentences.zh: 研究所的研究人員正在研究彈性工時對員工生產力的影響。

sentences.en: Managers expect the revised training schedule to have a positive effect on customer satisfaction ratings.
sentences.zh: 經理們預期修改後的訓練時程會對顧客滿意度評分有正面影響。

words.note: 語塊：have an effect on（對……有影響）、take effect（生效）、in effect（實施中）。effect 是名詞「影響」；affect 是動詞「影響」。take effect 指法規、政策開始生效。

sentences.en: All affected customers will receive a full refund to their credit cards within five business days.
sentences.zh: 所有受影響的顧客都會在五個工作天內收到退回信用卡的全額退款。

sentences.en: Flights to the affected area have been suspended until the tropical storm passes later this week.
sentences.zh: 飛往受影響地區的航班暫停，直到熱帶風暴這週稍晚過去。

sentences.en: Employees in the affected departments will be notified about the system upgrade by email this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 受影響部門的員工今天下午會收到系統升級的電子郵件通知。

sentences.en: Only shipments from the northern warehouse were affected by the delays in deliveries last week.
sentences.zh: 上週的出貨延誤只影響到北區倉庫的貨物。

sentences.en: The airline is offering hotel vouchers to affected passengers whose flights were canceled overnight because of the storm.
sentences.zh: 航空公司提供飯店住宿券給航班在夜間被取消的受影響乘客。

words.note: 語塊：affected area（受影響地區）、affected customers（受影響的顧客）、be affected by（受……影響）。affected 是「受影響的」；effective（有效的）長得像但意思不同。

sentences.en: Many longtime customers have a deep affection for the bakery's original location on Fifth Avenue downtown.
sentences.zh: 很多老顧客對那家麵包店在市中心第五大道的原始店面有深厚的感情。

sentences.en: The retiring manager will always be remembered with affection by everyone in the accounting department.
sentences.zh: 會計部的每個人都會一直深情地懷念那位退休的經理。

sentences.en: Our founder had a special affection for handmade furniture, which inspired the company's first product line.
sentences.zh: 我們的創辦人特別喜愛手工家具，這啟發了公司的第一個產品系列。

sentences.en: The staff spoke with affection about the old office building before the move to the new headquarters.
sentences.zh: 搬到新總部之前，員工們深情地談起那棟舊辦公大樓。

sentences.en: Visitors often develop an affection for the small seaside town after attending its annual summer music festival.
sentences.zh: 遊客參加過那座海邊小鎮的年度夏季音樂節後，常常會喜歡上它。

words.note: 語塊：have an affection for（喜愛……）、deep affection（深厚的感情）、with affection（深情地）。affection 是「喜愛、感情」；affectation（做作）拼法很像，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: The university plans to expand its athletics program by building a new indoor stadium near the main campus.
sentences.zh: 那所大學計畫在主校區附近蓋一座新室內體育館來擴大體育計畫。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant was hired last spring to manage the athletics department's budget and travel schedules.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐去年春天受聘管理體育部門的預算和行程安排。

sentences.en: Several local companies donated sports equipment this year to support the high school's athletics program.
sentences.zh: 幾家當地企業今年捐贈運動器材，支持那所高中的體育計畫。

sentences.en: Our sportswear brand proudly sponsors several regional athletics competitions for young runners in the city every summer.
sentences.zh: 我們的運動服品牌每年夏天都很自豪地贊助好幾場給年輕跑者的地區田徑比賽。

sentences.en: The new director of the athletics department will meet with all of the coaches on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 體育部門的新主任週一上午會和所有教練開會。

words.note: 語塊：athletics program（體育計畫）、athletics department（體育部門）。athletics 在美式英文指「各種體育運動」，英式英文多指「田徑」；athlete 是「運動員」。

sentences.en: We chose this courier company because it provides fast and reliable service at a very reasonable price.
sentences.zh: 我們選這家快遞公司，因為它以很合理的價格提供快速可靠的服務。

sentences.en: The figures in the market report were based on data from a reliable source in the electronics industry.
sentences.zh: 市場報告裡的數字來自電子業一個可靠的來源。

sentences.en: After many years of working together, Brenton Foods has become our most reliable supplier of fresh produce.
sentences.zh: 合作多年後，Brenton 食品已成為我們最可靠的新鮮蔬果供應商。

sentences.en: Business travelers expect reliable internet access and a quiet workspace when they stay at our hotel.
sentences.zh: 商務旅客住我們飯店時，會期待有穩定可靠的網路和安靜的工作空間。

sentences.en: The engineering team is currently looking for a reliable supplier of high-quality steel parts in Asia.
sentences.zh: 工程團隊目前正在亞洲尋找能提供高品質鋼製零件的可靠供應商。

words.note: 語塊：reliable source（可靠來源）、reliable service（可靠的服務）、reliable supplier（可靠的供應商）。reliable 是「可靠的」；reliant（依賴的）常用 be reliant on，意思不同。

sentences.en: The company reported only a marginal increase in sales during the third quarter despite heavy advertising.
sentences.zh: 儘管大量打廣告，公司第三季的銷售只有些微增加。

sentences.en: Upgrading the old servers produced a marginal improvement in speed, so the IT team recommended replacing them entirely.
sentences.zh: 升級舊伺服器只讓速度小幅改善，所以資訊團隊建議全部汰換。

sentences.en: Because of rising material costs, the furniture maker now earns only a marginal profit on each dining table.
sentences.zh: 因為材料成本上漲，那家家具廠現在每張餐桌只賺到微薄的利潤。

sentences.en: Analysts expect a marginal increase in interest rates that should have little effect on consumer spending.
sentences.zh: 分析師預期利率會些微上升，對消費支出應該影響不大。

sentences.en: The survey showed a marginal improvement in employee satisfaction after the cafeteria was renovated last spring.
sentences.zh: 調查顯示，員工餐廳去年春天整修後，員工滿意度小幅改善。

words.note: 語塊：marginal increase（些微增加）、marginal improvement（小幅改善）、marginal profit（微薄利潤）。marginal 指「很小的、不重要的」；minimal（極少的）意思接近，但 marginal 常用來說變化幅度。

sentences.en: The smartphone manufacturer plans to release a new product line at the technology fair next month.
sentences.zh: 那家手機製造商計畫下個月在科技展推出新的產品線。

sentences.en: The mayor's office will release a statement about the new transportation budget later this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 市長辦公室今天下午稍晚會針對新的交通預算發表聲明。

sentences.en: The band is expected to release an album next spring after finishing its world tour in December.
sentences.zh: 那個樂團預計十二月結束世界巡演後，明年春天發行專輯。

sentences.en: We cannot release any customer information to outside parties without written permission from the client.
sentences.zh: 沒有客戶的書面同意，我們不能把任何顧客資料提供給外部單位。

sentences.en: The publisher decided to release the novel in both print and digital formats on the same day.
sentences.zh: 出版社決定在同一天以紙本和電子兩種形式發行那本小說。

words.note: 語塊：release a new product（推出新產品）、release a statement（發表聲明）、release an album（發行專輯）。release 常指「公開發布」；launch 多用於「推出新產品或活動」，兩者常可互換。

sentences.en: Our three-day tour package includes a guided visit to a historic site just outside the old city walls.
sentences.zh: 我們的三天行程套裝包含參觀舊城牆外一處古蹟的導覽。

sentences.en: The city council approved additional funding to preserve the historic site near the central train station.
sentences.zh: 市議會核准追加經費，保存中央火車站附近的那處古蹟。

sentences.en: Because the factory is located next to a historic site, any construction plans require special approval.
sentences.zh: 因為工廠就在古蹟旁邊，任何施工計畫都需要特別核准。

sentences.en: Volunteers are needed to help clean the historic site before the anniversary celebration in October.
sentences.zh: 十月週年慶典前，需要志工幫忙清理那處古蹟。

sentences.en: Tourists who visit the historic site are asked not to touch the ancient stone carvings on the walls.
sentences.zh: 參觀古蹟的遊客被要求不要觸摸牆上古老的石雕。

words.note: 語塊：visit a historic site（參觀古蹟）、preserve a historic site（保存古蹟）。historic 是「有歷史意義的」；historical 是「歷史上的、跟歷史有關的」（historical records 歷史紀錄）。

sentences.en: Residents with even-numbered addresses may water their gardens only on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays this summer.
sentences.zh: 門牌是偶數的居民，只能在週二、週四、週六替花園澆水。

sentences.en: The elevators on the east side of the building stop only at even-numbered floors during peak hours.
sentences.zh: 大樓東側的電梯在尖峰時段只停偶數樓層。

sentences.en: Workshops for new employees are held on even-numbered days throughout the month of September at the main office.
sentences.zh: 新進員工的研習在整個九月的偶數日舉行。

sentences.en: Passengers seated in even-numbered rows will board the aircraft after those seated in odd-numbered rows.
sentences.zh: 坐在偶數排的乘客會在奇數排的乘客之後登機。

sentences.en: Parking in the north lot is restricted to vehicles with even-numbered license plates on Mondays.
sentences.zh: 每週一，北側停車場只限偶數車牌的車輛停放。

words.note: 語塊：even-numbered days（偶數日）、even-numbered floors（偶數樓層）。even-numbered 是「偶數的」；odd-numbered 是「奇數的」。

sentences.en: The research team will conduct an experiment to test the durability of the new plastic packaging.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊會進行一項實驗，測試新塑膠包裝的耐用度。

sentences.en: Before launching the campaign nationwide, the marketing department carried out an experiment in two cities.
sentences.zh: 在全國推出廣告活動之前，行銷部先在兩個城市做了實驗。

sentences.en: The results of the experiment suggest that customers prefer shorter product descriptions on our website.
sentences.zh: 實驗結果顯示，顧客比較喜歡我們網站上較短的產品說明。

sentences.en: Scientists at the laboratory must record every step when they conduct an experiment with hazardous materials.
sentences.zh: 實驗室的科學家用危險物質做實驗時，必須記錄每一個步驟。

sentences.en: The four-day workweek began as a small experiment but has now been adopted by the entire company.
sentences.zh: 每週上班四天一開始只是個小實驗，現在已經被全公司採用了。

words.note: 語塊：conduct an experiment（進行實驗）、carry out an experiment（做實驗）。experiment 是「實驗」；experience（經驗）拼法相近，意思不同。

sentences.en: Customer service representatives are available by phone or email during normal business hours, Monday through Friday.
sentences.zh: 客服人員在週一到週五的正常營業時間可以電話聯絡。

sentences.en: Train service is expected to return to normal by Wednesday after the damaged tracks are repaired.
sentences.zh: 受損的軌道修好後，火車服務預計週三恢復正常。

sentences.en: The factory resumed normal operations only two days after the fire in the storage room was put out.
sentences.zh: 儲藏室的火撲滅後才兩天，工廠就恢復了正常運作。

sentences.en: It is normal for new employees to feel a little nervous during their first week at the company.
sentences.zh: 新員工在公司的第一週有點緊張是很正常的。

sentences.en: Shipping may take longer than normal during the holiday season, so please place your orders early.
sentences.zh: 節慶期間寄送可能比平常久，所以請提早下訂。

words.note: 語塊：normal business hours（正常營業時間）、return to normal（恢復正常）、normal operations（正常運作）。normal 是「正常的」；ordinary（普通的）偏「平凡」，normal 偏「符合常態」。

sentences.en: The opening of the new branch has been postponed until an undetermined date because of permit issues.
sentences.zh: 新分店的開幕因為許可證問題，延到日期未定。

sentences.en: The cause of the power failure at the plant remains undetermined, and engineers are still investigating.
sentences.zh: 工廠停電的原因仍未確定，工程師還在調查。

sentences.en: The exact number of positions available at the new call center is still undetermined at this time.
sentences.zh: 新客服中心到底有幾個職缺，目前還沒確定。

sentences.en: Several speakers have confirmed their attendance, but the location of the annual conference remains undetermined.
sentences.zh: 幾位講者已確認出席，但研討會的地點仍未確定。

sentences.en: The concert will be rescheduled for an undetermined date once the stadium repairs are complete.
sentences.zh: 等體育場修繕完成，演唱會會改到一個還沒確定的日期。

words.note: 語塊：at an undetermined date（日期未定）、remain undetermined（仍未確定）。undetermined 指「還沒決定」；undecided 偏指「人還沒做決定」，undetermined 多用在事情。

sentences.en: The hotel restaurant is renowned for its seafood dishes, which are prepared with locally caught fish.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店餐廳以海鮮料理聞名，用的都是當地捕撈的魚。

sentences.en: Our consulting firm is renowned for helping small businesses grow quickly in highly competitive local markets.
sentences.zh: 我們的顧問公司以幫助小企業在競爭激烈的市場中快速成長而聞名。

sentences.en: The region has long been renowned for its high-quality tea, which is exported to many countries.
sentences.zh: 那個地區長久以來就以高品質的茶葉聞名，外銷到許多國家。

sentences.en: The guest speaker is an architect who is renowned for designing beautiful and energy-efficient office buildings.
sentences.zh: 這位演講嘉賓是一位以設計節能辦公大樓聞名的建築師。

sentences.en: The small town is renowned for its annual jazz festival, which attracts thousands of visitors every summer.
sentences.zh: 那個小鎮以每年的爵士音樂節聞名，每年夏天吸引數千名遊客。

words.note: 語塊：be renowned for（以……聞名）、internationally renowned（國際知名）。be renowned for 和 be famous for、be known for 意思相同，renowned 比較正式；別和 renewed（更新的）搞混。

sentences.en: The architecture firm won an award for its innovative design of the new public library downtown.
sentences.zh: 那家建築事務所因市中心新公共圖書館的創新設計而獲獎。

sentences.en: Our team is looking for an innovative approach to reduce packaging waste without raising costs.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊在找一個創新的做法，在不增加成本的情況下減少包裝廢棄物。

sentences.en: The startup offers an innovative solution that helps restaurants manage their inventory through a mobile app.
sentences.zh: 那家新創公司提供一個創新的解決方案，用手機 App 幫餐廳管理庫存。

sentences.en: Employees who suggest innovative ideas for improving efficiency will be recognized at the annual meeting.
sentences.zh: 提出創新點子改善效率的員工，會在年度大會上受到表揚。

sentences.en: Investors were impressed by the innovative design of the electric bicycle presented at the trade show.
sentences.zh: 投資人對商展上展示的那款電動自行車的創新設計印象深刻。

words.note: 語塊：innovative design（創新的設計）、innovative approach（創新的做法）、innovative solution（創新的解決方案）。innovative 是「創新的」；innocent（無辜的）長得像，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: We need someone who can translate the user manual into Spanish before the product launch in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我們需要有人在墨西哥的產品發表前，把使用手冊翻譯成西班牙文。

sentences.en: The agency will translate all of the contracts from Japanese so that our legal team can review them.
sentences.zh: 翻譯社會把所有合約從日文翻過來，讓我們的法務團隊審閱。

sentences.en: Managers hope the new training program will translate into higher sales over the next few months.
sentences.zh: 經理們希望新的訓練計畫在接下來幾個月能轉化成更高的銷售額。

sentences.en: Please ask the marketing department to translate the brochure before it is sent to our clients overseas.
sentences.zh: 請行銷部在小冊子寄給海外客戶之前先把它翻譯好。

sentences.en: It can be difficult to translate certain expressions into English without losing their original meaning.
sentences.zh: 有些說法很難翻成英文又不失去原本的意思。

words.note: 語塊：translate into（翻譯成；轉化成）、translate from（從……翻譯）。translate 是「筆譯、把文字翻成另一種語言」；interpret 是「口譯」或「解讀」。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim was asked to interpret for the visiting delegation during the factory tour on Thursday.
sentences.zh: Kim 小姐被請去在週四參觀工廠時替來訪的代表團口譯。

sentences.en: Our analysts will interpret the data from the customer survey and present their findings next week.
sentences.zh: 我們的分析師會解讀顧客調查的資料，下週報告他們的發現。

sentences.en: It is important to interpret the results of the study carefully before making any major decisions.
sentences.zh: 在做任何重大決定之前，仔細解讀研究結果是很重要的。

sentences.en: The company hired a professional to interpret for the Korean investors at the shareholders' meeting.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位專業人員在股東大會上替韓國投資人口譯。

sentences.en: Staff members sometimes interpret the dress code differently, so the human resources department issued clearer guidelines.
sentences.zh: 員工有時候對服裝規定的理解不一樣，所以人資部發布了更清楚的規範。

words.note: 語塊：interpret for（替……口譯）、interpret the data（解讀資料）、interpret the results（解讀結果）。interpret 偏「口譯」或「解讀意思」；translate 偏「筆譯」。

sentences.en: The video conference ended abruptly when the internet connection in the main office suddenly failed.
sentences.zh: 總公司的網路斷線時，視訊會議突然結束了。

sentences.en: The production line stopped abruptly after a sensor detected a problem with one of the machines.
sentences.zh: 感應器偵測到其中一台機器有問題後，生產線突然停了下來。

sentences.en: Weather conditions can change abruptly in the mountains, so hikers should always bring extra clothing.
sentences.zh: 山區的天氣可能突然改變，所以登山客應該多帶衣服。

sentences.en: The manager abruptly canceled the afternoon meeting without giving any reason to the team or the clients.
sentences.zh: 經理突然取消下午的會議，沒有給團隊任何理由。

sentences.en: Sales of the product stopped abruptly after a competitor released a cheaper model with similar features.
sentences.zh: 競爭對手推出功能相似又比較便宜的機型後，這個產品的銷售突然停滯。

words.note: 語塊：end abruptly（突然結束）、stop abruptly（突然停止）、change abruptly（突然改變）。abruptly 和 suddenly 都是「突然」，abruptly 還帶有「令人措手不及、不禮貌」的感覺。

sentences.en: We are very appreciative of your patience while our technicians repaired the elevator this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我們的技師修理電梯時，非常感謝您的耐心。

sentences.en: The pianist performed for an appreciative audience at the new community center on Saturday evening.
sentences.zh: 那位鋼琴家週六晚上在社區中心為一群懂得欣賞的觀眾演出。

sentences.en: The board of directors is appreciative of the hard work that all employees put in this year.
sentences.zh: 董事會很感謝所有員工今年付出的努力。

sentences.en: Customers were appreciative of the free shuttle service that the hotel offered to the airport.
sentences.zh: 顧客很感謝飯店提供的免費機場接駁服務。

sentences.en: The speaker thanked the appreciative audience for their thoughtful questions at the end of the seminar.
sentences.zh: 講者在研討會結束時感謝懂得欣賞的聽眾提出了很有想法的問題。

words.note: 語塊：be appreciative of（感謝……）、appreciative audience（懂得欣賞的觀眾）。appreciative 用來形容人「心懷感激」；appreciable（可觀的、明顯的）長得像，意思不同。

sentences.en: The renovation of the lobby was completed on time and within budget, which pleased the building owners.
sentences.zh: 大廳翻修準時完成而且沒超出預算，讓大樓業主很滿意。

sentences.en: The marketing campaign went over budget because the company decided to add several television commercials.
sentences.zh: 行銷活動超出預算，因為公司決定加幾支電視廣告。

sentences.en: The finance committee will approve the budget for next year's training programs at Friday's meeting.
sentences.zh: 財務委員會將在週五的會議上核准明年訓練計畫的預算。

sentences.en: Department heads must submit their budget proposals to the accounting office by the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 部門主管必須在月底前把預算提案交給會計室。

sentences.en: We were able to stay within budget by choosing a smaller venue for the annual awards dinner.
sentences.zh: 我們選了比較小的場地辦年度頒獎晚宴，所以能控制在預算內。

words.note: 語塊：within budget（在預算內）、over budget（超出預算）、budget for（……的預算）。budget 是「預算」；budge（移動、讓步）少一個字母，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: All applicants must submit a proposal describing their research plans by the fifteenth of March.
sentences.zh: 所有申請人都必須在三月十五日前提交一份描述研究計畫的提案。

sentences.en: The city council voted to approve the proposal for a new bicycle lane along the river.
sentences.zh: 市議會投票核准沿著河邊新建自行車道的提案。

sentences.en: The board decided to reject the proposal because the estimated costs were far higher than expected.
sentences.zh: 董事會決定否決那份提案，因為估計的成本比預期高出許多。

sentences.en: Mr. Hassan will present his proposal for reorganizing the sales department at the next staff meeting.
sentences.zh: Hassan 先生會在下次員工會議上報告他重組業務部的提案。

sentences.en: After reviewing the budget carefully, the directors agreed to approve the proposal with minor changes.
sentences.zh: 仔細審閱預算後，董事們同意在小幅修改後核准那份提案。

words.note: 語塊：submit a proposal（提交提案）、approve a proposal（核准提案）、reject a proposal（否決提案）。proposal 是名詞「提案」；propose 是動詞「提議」；purpose（目的）拼法相近，別搞混。

sentences.en: The company spent a large portion of its budget on new office equipment such as printers and scanners.
sentences.zh: 公司把很大一部分預算花在印表機和掃描器等新的辦公設備上。

sentences.en: Technicians will install equipment in the new laboratory over the weekend so it can open on Monday.
sentences.zh: 技師週末會在新實驗室安裝設備，讓它週一可以啟用。

sentences.en: Every piece of equipment in the gym is inspected once a month to ensure that it is safe to use.
sentences.zh: 健身房裡的每一件器材每個月都會檢查一次，確保使用安全。

sentences.en: Employees must return all borrowed camera equipment to the media room by five o'clock on Friday.
sentences.zh: 員工必須在週五五點前，把借用的所有相機器材歸還到媒體室。

sentences.en: The hospital received a donation that will be used to purchase modern medical equipment for its clinics.
sentences.zh: 醫院收到一筆捐款，將用來為診所購買現代化的醫療設備。

words.note: 語塊：office equipment（辦公設備）、install equipment（安裝設備）、a piece of equipment（一件設備）。equipment 是不可數名詞，不能加 s；要說「一件」用 a piece of equipment。

sentences.en: Quite a few customers have asked whether the store will be open on the national holiday.
sentences.zh: 相當多顧客問過店家在國定假日會不會營業。

sentences.en: The new office is quite spacious compared to the small room we used to share downtown.
sentences.zh: 跟我們以前在市中心共用的小房間比起來，新辦公室相當寬敞。

sentences.en: The report is not quite finished, so Ms. Lopez will send it to the clients tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 報告還沒完全完成，所以 Lopez 小姐明天早上才會寄給客戶。

sentences.en: Our team spent quite a lot of time preparing for the presentation, and the clients were impressed.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊花了相當多時間準備簡報，客戶印象很深刻。

sentences.en: The training session was quite helpful for new employees who had never used the software before.
sentences.zh: 這次訓練課程對以前沒用過這套軟體的新員工相當有幫助。

words.note: 語塊：quite a few（相當多）、quite a lot（相當多）、not quite（不完全）。quite 是「相當」；quiet（安靜的）和 quit（放棄）拼法很像，要小心。

sentences.en: Our restaurant offers a wide choice of vegetarian dishes in addition to the regular menu.
sentences.zh: 除了一般菜單之外，我們餐廳還提供多樣的素食料理選擇。

sentences.en: Customers who cannot make a choice between the two models can test both in our showroom.
sentences.zh: 在兩種機型之間做不了選擇的顧客，可以在我們的展示間兩種都試試看。

sentences.en: The hotel near the convention center was our first choice, but it was already fully booked.
sentences.zh: 會展中心附近那家飯店是我們的首選，但已經客滿了。

sentences.en: Please make a choice from the three lunch options and inform the event coordinator by Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 請從三種午餐選項中做選擇，並在週三前通知活動負責人。

sentences.en: The university bookstore provides a wide choice of textbooks, stationery, and computer accessories for students.
sentences.zh: 大學書店提供多樣的教科書、文具和電腦配件可以選。

words.note: 語塊：make a choice（做選擇）、a wide choice of（多樣的選擇）、first choice（首選）。choice 是名詞；choose 是動詞「選擇」。

sentences.en: Guests who wish to dine at the rooftop restaurant should make a reservation at least two days in advance.
sentences.zh: 想在頂樓餐廳用餐的客人，至少要提前兩天訂位。

sentences.en: Please call the front desk to confirm your reservation before you arrive at the hotel tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚抵達飯店前，請打電話到櫃台確認您的預約。

sentences.en: If you need to cancel a reservation, you must do so twenty-four hours before your scheduled appointment.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要取消預約，必須在預定時間的二十四小時前取消。

sentences.en: Ms. Romero made a reservation for twelve people at the Italian restaurant across from our office.
sentences.zh: Romero 小姐在我們辦公室對面的義大利餐廳訂了十二個人的位子。

sentences.en: The travel agency will confirm your reservation by email once the payment has been received.
sentences.zh: 收到付款後，旅行社會用電子郵件確認您的預約。

words.note: 語塊：make a reservation（預約；訂位）、confirm a reservation（確認預約）、cancel a reservation（取消預約）。reservation 是「訂位、預約」；reserve 是動詞；conservation（保育）長得像，意思不同。

sentences.en: Every guest at the resort stays in a spacious room with a private balcony overlooking the ocean.
sentences.zh: 度假村的每位客人都住在有私人陽台、可以看到海景的寬敞房間。

sentences.en: After the merger, the company moved into a spacious office on the twentieth floor of the tower.
sentences.zh: 合併之後，公司搬進大樓二十樓一間寬敞的辦公室。

sentences.en: The minivan has a spacious interior that can comfortably seat seven adults and their luggage.
sentences.zh: 那台休旅車內部空間寬敞，可以舒服地坐七個大人和他們的行李。

sentences.en: The conference hall is spacious enough to hold more than five hundred participants at once.
sentences.zh: 會議廳夠寬敞，一次可以容納五百多位與會者。

sentences.en: Employees enjoy eating lunch in the spacious cafeteria, which was renovated at the beginning of the year.
sentences.zh: 員工很喜歡在今年初整修過的寬敞員工餐廳吃午餐。

words.note: 語塊：spacious room（寬敞的房間）、spacious office（寬敞的辦公室）、spacious interior（寬敞的內部空間）。spacious 是「空間大」；specious（似是而非的）只差一個字母，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: The fitness center offers a twelve-week program designed to help members lose weight safely and keep it off.
sentences.zh: 健身中心提供一個為期十二週的課程，幫助會員安全地減重。

sentences.en: Many employees who try to lose weight have joined the walking club that meets every lunch break.
sentences.zh: 很多想減重的員工加入了每天午休時間聚會的健走社。

sentences.en: Our nutrition app helps users lose weight by tracking their meals and suggesting healthy recipes.
sentences.zh: 我們的營養 App 透過記錄餐點和推薦健康食譜來幫助使用者減重。

sentences.en: The doctor advised Mr. Brooks to lose weight and exercise more often to reduce his blood pressure.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議 Brooks 先生減重並多運動，好降低血壓。

sentences.en: Customers who want to lose weight can book a free consultation with one of our personal trainers.
sentences.zh: 想減重的顧客可以和我們的私人教練預約一次免費諮詢。

words.note: 語塊：help sb lose weight（幫助某人減重）、try to lose weight（試著減重）。lose weight 是「減重」，相反是 gain weight（增重）；lose 別寫成 loose（鬆的）。

sentences.en: The gym's new class provides a full-body workout in just thirty minutes during the lunch hour.
sentences.zh: 健身房的新課程在午餐時間只要三十分鐘就能做完全身運動。

sentences.en: Ms. Ortega starts every morning with a daily workout before she drives to the office.
sentences.zh: Ortega 小姐每天早上開車上班前都會先做運動。

sentences.en: Our trainers can design a workout routine that suits your schedule and your fitness goals.
sentences.zh: 我們的教練可以設計符合你的時間和健身目標的運動計畫。

sentences.en: Members can book a workout session with a personal trainer through the fitness center's mobile app.
sentences.zh: 會員可以透過健身中心的 App 預約一堂私人教練課。

sentences.en: Doctors recommend a short daily workout for office workers who spend most of the day sitting.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議整天大部分時間都坐著的上班族每天做一點運動。

words.note: 語塊：a daily workout（每天的運動）、a full-body workout（全身運動）、workout routine（健身習慣）。workout 是名詞「一次運動」；work out 兩個字是動詞片語「運動；解決」。

sentences.en: The company signed a contract with a well-known brand of sportswear to sponsor the marathon.
sentences.zh: 公司和一個知名運動服品牌簽約，贊助這場馬拉松。

sentences.en: The keynote speech will be given by a well-known author who writes about leadership and management.
sentences.zh: 主題演講將由一位寫領導與管理的知名作家主講。

sentences.en: The café is well-known for its homemade pastries, so it is usually crowded on weekend mornings.
sentences.zh: 那家咖啡廳以自製的糕點出名，所以週末早上通常很擠。

sentences.en: Several well-known chefs will demonstrate their recipes at the outdoor food festival in the park next Saturday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下週六下午的美食節，會有幾位知名主廚示範他們的食譜。

sentences.en: The architect who designed the museum is well-known for using natural light in her buildings.
sentences.zh: 設計這座博物館的建築師以在建築裡運用自然光而聞名。

words.note: 語塊：well-known brand（知名品牌）、well-known for（以……出名）。well-known 和 famous 意思接近；well-known 放在名詞前要加連字號。

sentences.en: The CEO will deliver a speech about the company's future plans at the opening of the conference.
sentences.zh: 執行長會在研討會開幕時發表一場關於公司未來計畫的演講。

sentences.en: We guarantee that we will deliver every order on time, or the shipping fee will be refunded.
sentences.zh: 我們保證每筆訂單都會準時送達，否則退還運費。

sentences.en: The new sales manager is expected to deliver results within her first six months at the company.
sentences.zh: 新的業務經理預計在到職前六個月內交出成果。

sentences.en: The furniture store can deliver your sofa on Saturday morning if you place the order today.
sentences.zh: 如果你今天下訂，家具店可以在週六早上把沙發送到。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen was chosen to deliver a speech on behalf of all the employees at the retirement party.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐被選為代表全體員工在退休派對上致詞。

words.note: 語塊：deliver a speech（發表演講）、deliver on time（準時送達）、deliver results（交出成果）。deliver 除了「送貨」，也常用在 deliver a speech / presentation（發表演講、簡報）。

sentences.en: The new washing machine is designed to reduce vibration and noise during the spin cycle.
sentences.zh: 新的洗衣機設計成在脫水時能減少震動和噪音。

sentences.en: Passengers reported a strong vibration in the cabin shortly after the aircraft took off from Seoul.
sentences.zh: 乘客反映飛機從首爾起飛後不久，機艙出現強烈震動。

sentences.en: Heavy trucks on the highway can cause vibration that damages the windows of nearby houses.
sentences.zh: 高速公路上的大卡車可能造成震動，損壞附近房屋的窗戶。

sentences.en: Engineers installed rubber pads under the machines to reduce vibration on the busy factory floor.
sentences.zh: 工程師在機器下面裝了橡膠墊，減少工廠地板的震動。

sentences.en: If you notice any unusual vibration in the equipment, turn it off and contact the maintenance team.
sentences.zh: 如果你發現設備有任何異常震動，請關掉它並聯絡維修團隊。

words.note: 語塊：reduce vibration（減少震動）、strong vibration（強烈震動）、cause vibration（造成震動）。vibration 是名詞「震動」，動詞是 vibrate；variation（變化）拼法相近，意思不同。

sentences.en: The company has opened a small medical clinic on the first floor for employees who feel unwell.
sentences.zh: 公司在一樓開了一間小診所，給身體不舒服的員工使用。

sentences.en: Patients should arrive at the dental clinic fifteen minutes early to fill out the necessary forms.
