sentences.en: The rise in online orders is suggestive of a trend toward shopping from home rather than visiting stores.
sentences.zh: 網路訂單增加，顯示大家越來越傾向在家購物而不是逛實體店。

sentences.en: The name of the new perfume is suggestive of fresh flowers and early spring mornings.
sentences.zh: 那款新香水的名字讓人聯想到鮮花和初春的早晨。

sentences.en: Some critics felt that the advertisement was too suggestive for a product aimed at young children.
sentences.zh: 有些評論者覺得那支廣告對於針對幼童的產品來說太有暗示性了。

sentences.en: The drop in sales last month may be suggestive of a larger problem with the company's pricing strategy.
sentences.zh: 上個月的銷售下滑可能暗示公司的定價策略有更大的問題。

words.note: 語塊：be suggestive of（讓人聯想到）、suggestive of a trend（顯示某種趨勢）。suggestive of 是「讓人想到、暗示」；也可以指「有性暗示的」，用在商務時要小心。

sentences.en: Guests who wish to file a complaint should speak with the hotel manager at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 想提出投訴的房客請到櫃台找飯店經理。

sentences.en: The restaurant received a complaint about the noise from its outdoor seating area late at night.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳接到投訴，說深夜戶外座位區太吵。

sentences.en: Every customer complaint is recorded in our system and answered by our staff within two business days.
sentences.zh: 每一則顧客投訴都會記錄在我們的系統裡，並在兩個工作天內回覆。

sentences.en: After receiving a complaint from a tenant, the landlord sent a plumber to fix the leaking pipe.
sentences.zh: 接到房客的投訴後，房東派了水電工去修漏水的水管。

sentences.en: The airline has improved its baggage service in order to reduce the number of complaint calls it receives.
sentences.zh: 航空公司改善了行李服務，以減少接到的投訴電話數量。

words.note: 語塊：file a complaint（提出投訴）、receive a complaint（接到投訴）、customer complaint（顧客投訴）。complaint 是名詞；complain 是動詞（complain about）；compliment（讚美）長得像，意思相反。

sentences.en: The bakery now opens at six in the morning in response to requests from commuters.
sentences.zh: 因應通勤族的要求，那家麵包店現在早上六點就開門。

sentences.en: In response to demand from customers, the store has extended its opening hours on weekends.
sentences.zh: 因應顧客的需求，那家店延長了週末的營業時間。

sentences.en: The software company released an update in response to feedback from users about the slow loading time.
sentences.zh: 那家軟體公司因應使用者對讀取速度慢的意見，推出了更新。

sentences.en: The city added more buses to the airport route in response to the growing number of travelers.
sentences.zh: 市政府因應旅客人數增加，在機場路線上加開了公車。

sentences.en: In response to feedback from employees, the company will offer more flexible working hours next year.
sentences.zh: 回應員工的意見，公司明年將提供更有彈性的工作時間。

words.note: 語塊：in response to requests（回應要求）、in response to demand（因應需求）、in response to feedback（回應意見）。in response to + 名詞，表示「為了回應……」；as a response to 意思相同。

sentences.en: The company will cover the cost of your hotel and meals during the three-day training program in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 公司會負擔你在首爾三天訓練期間的飯店和餐費。

sentences.en: Customers can upgrade to a larger room at no extra cost if they book before the end of this week.
sentences.zh: 顧客如果在這週結束前訂房，可以免費升等到較大的房間。

sentences.en: The total cost of the renovation was much higher than the original estimate provided by the contractor.
sentences.zh: 翻修的總費用比承包商原本的估價高出許多。

sentences.en: Switching to electronic invoices will help us reduce paper waste and lower the cost of mailing.
sentences.zh: 改用電子發票可以幫我們減少紙張浪費，並降低郵寄的成本。

sentences.en: Members of the gym can attend yoga classes at no extra cost on weekday mornings.
sentences.zh: 健身房會員平日早上可以免費參加瑜伽課。

words.note: 語塊：reduce costs（降低成本）、cover the cost of（負擔……的費用）、at no extra cost（不額外收費）。cost 是「花費的金額」；price 是「標價」；fee 是「服務費」。

sentences.en: The new medicine cannot be sold until it receives regulatory approval from the national health department.
sentences.zh: 新藥要等到獲得國家衛生部門的核准才能販售。

sentences.en: The regulatory agency will inspect the factory next month to make sure it meets environmental standards.
sentences.zh: 監管機構下個月會檢查工廠，確保它符合環保標準。

sentences.en: All of our products are tested carefully to make sure that they meet every regulatory requirement in Europe.
sentences.zh: 我們所有的產品都經過仔細測試，確保符合歐洲的每一項法規要求。

sentences.en: The bank hired additional lawyers to help it deal with the regulatory changes announced last year.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行增聘律師，協助處理去年宣布的法規變更。

sentences.en: Waiting for regulatory approval delayed the opening of the new airline by almost six months.
sentences.zh: 等待主管機關核准讓那家新航空公司的開航延後將近六個月。

words.note: 語塊：regulatory approval（主管機關核准）、regulatory agency（監管機構）、regulatory requirements（法規要求）。regulatory 是形容詞，regulation 是「法規」；regular（規律的）長得像，意思不同。

sentences.en: The supplier refused to accept the client's unreasonable demands for a fifty percent discount on the entire order.
sentences.zh: 供應商拒絕接受客戶要求打五折的無理要求。

sentences.en: Many tourists complained about the unreasonable price of taxis from the airport to the city center.
sentences.zh: 很多觀光客抱怨從機場到市中心的計程車價格不合理。

sentences.en: It is unreasonable to expect new employees to learn the entire system in only one day.
sentences.zh: 期待新員工一天之內學會整個系統是不合理的。

sentences.en: The manager apologized to the team for setting an unreasonable deadline for the marketing report.
sentences.zh: 經理為了替行銷報告訂下不合理的截止日向團隊道歉。

sentences.en: The tenants felt that the landlord's request for an extra deposit was unreasonable and contacted a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 房客覺得房東要求多付押金不合理，於是聯絡了律師。

words.note: 語塊：unreasonable demands（無理的要求）、unreasonable price（不合理的價格）、it is unreasonable to（……是不合理的）。unreasonable 是「不合理、過分」；unacceptable（無法接受的）意思接近但重點不同。

sentences.en: The city hopes to reduce the amount of garbage that is sent to a landfill by encouraging recycling.
sentences.zh: 市政府希望藉由鼓勵回收，減少送到垃圾掩埋場的垃圾量。

sentences.en: Residents are worried about the smell from the landfill site that was built near their neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 居民擔心蓋在他們社區附近的垃圾掩埋場會有臭味。

sentences.en: Our company uses recycled packaging to help reduce landfill waste and protect the local environment.
sentences.zh: 我們公司使用回收包裝，幫助減少掩埋垃圾並保護環境。

sentences.en: Most of the old furniture from the hotel was donated to charities instead of being sent to a landfill.
sentences.zh: 飯店大部分的舊家具都捐給了慈善團體，而不是送到垃圾掩埋場。

sentences.en: The government plans to close the landfill site within ten years and replace it with a public park.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫在十年內關閉那座垃圾掩埋場，改建成公園。

words.note: 語塊：send to a landfill（送到垃圾掩埋場）、landfill site（掩埋場）、reduce landfill waste（減少掩埋垃圾）。landfill 是「垃圾掩埋場」；recycling（回收）是減少 landfill 的方法；landmark（地標）長得像。

sentences.en: It is particularly important to back up your files before the system upgrade this weekend.
sentences.zh: 在這個週末系統升級之前備份檔案特別重要。

sentences.en: The training video was particularly useful for employees who had never used the new software before.
sentences.zh: 訓練影片對從沒用過新軟體的員工特別有用。

sentences.en: Sales of cold drinks were particularly strong in July, when temperatures across the country reached record highs.
sentences.zh: 冷飲在七月的銷售特別好，那時氣溫創下新高。

sentences.en: The new restaurant is not particularly expensive, but its portions are quite small for the price.
sentences.zh: 新餐廳不怎麼貴，但以價格來說份量蠻小的。

sentences.en: Customers were particularly impressed by the friendly staff and fast service at the new branch.
sentences.zh: 顧客對新分店親切的員工和快速的服務印象特別深刻。

words.note: 語塊：particularly important（特別重要）、particularly useful（特別有用）、not particularly（不怎麼）。particularly 和 especially 意思接近，都是「特別、尤其」。

sentences.en: Social media has a strong influence on the products that young people decide to buy.
sentences.zh: 社群媒體對年輕人決定買什麼產品有很大的影響。

sentences.en: The weather can have an influence on the number of visitors who come to the outdoor market.
sentences.zh: 天氣會影響來逛戶外市集的人數。

sentences.en: The architect's designs were created under the influence of the traditional Japanese buildings that he studied as a student.
sentences.zh: 那位建築師的設計是受到他學生時期研究的日本傳統建築影響而創作的。

sentences.en: Customer reviews have a strong influence on whether people choose to stay at a particular hotel.
sentences.zh: 顧客評論對人們是否選擇住某家飯店有很大的影響。

sentences.en: Ms. Rossi has had a great influence on the success of our company since she became director.
sentences.zh: Rossi 小姐自從當上總監以來，對公司的成功有很大的影響。

words.note: 語塊：have an influence on（對……有影響）、under the influence of（受……影響）、a strong influence（強大的影響）。influence 可以當名詞或動詞；effect 偏「造成的結果」，influence 偏「影響的力量」。

sentences.en: All the members of the design team deserve credit for finishing the project two weeks ahead of schedule.
sentences.zh: 設計團隊的所有成員都值得讚揚，因為他們提前兩週完成了專案。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee has worked very hard this year, and many colleagues believe that she and her assistant deserve a promotion.
sentences.zh: 李小姐今年非常努力，很多同事認為她和她的助理都應該升職。

sentences.en: Problems with employee safety at the warehouse deserve attention from every manager in the company.
sentences.zh: 倉庫的員工安全問題值得公司每位經理注意。

sentences.en: Volunteers who give up their weekends to help the local community deserve our sincere thanks and support.
sentences.zh: 放棄週末時間幫助社區的志工值得我們真誠的感謝。

sentences.en: The judges decided that both designers deserve credit for the creative ideas in the winning proposal.
sentences.zh: 評審決定，兩位設計師都值得因得獎提案中的創意而受到讚揚。

words.note: 語塊：deserve credit（值得讚揚）、deserve attention（值得注意）、deserve a promotion（應該升職）。deserve 是「理應得到」；reserve（預訂）和 preserve（保存）長得像，意思不同。

sentences.en: Due to an oversight, your name was not included on the list of guests for the dinner.
sentences.zh: 由於我們的疏忽，你的名字沒有被列在晚宴的賓客名單上。

sentences.en: The error in the invoice was caused by an oversight in our accounting department last month.
sentences.zh: 發票上的錯誤是上個月我們會計部的疏忽造成的。

sentences.en: A new committee was created to provide oversight of all spending on the construction project.
sentences.zh: 公司成立新的委員會，監督這個工程的所有支出。

sentences.en: We apologize for the oversight and will send the missing items to you by express mail today.
sentences.zh: 我們為這次疏忽道歉，今天會用快遞把缺少的品項寄給您。

sentences.en: The government is responsible for the oversight of food safety in restaurants, schools, and supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 政府負責監督餐廳和超市的食品安全。

words.note: 語塊：due to an oversight（由於疏忽）、an oversight in（……的疏忽）、oversight of（對……的監督）。oversight 有兩個意思：「疏忽、漏看」和「監督」；oversee 是動詞「監督」。

sentences.en: Mr. Gomez will give a presentation about the new marketing strategy at Tuesday's staff meeting.
sentences.zh: Gomez 先生會在週二的員工會議上做新行銷策略的簡報。

sentences.en: Each team must make a presentation to the judges that lasts no longer than ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 每一組都必須向評審做一場不超過十分鐘的簡報。

sentences.en: Ms. Huang practiced her sales presentation several times before meeting with the potential clients from Japan.
sentences.zh: 黃小姐在和潛在客戶見面之前把銷售簡報練習了好幾次。

sentences.en: The slides for the presentation should be sent to the event organizer by Friday at noon.
sentences.zh: 簡報投影片應該在週五中午前寄給活動主辦人。

sentences.en: After the presentation, the audience asked many questions about the cost of the new system.
sentences.zh: 簡報結束後，聽眾針對新系統的成本問了很多問題。

words.note: 語塊：give a presentation（做簡報）、make a presentation（做簡報）、sales presentation（銷售簡報）。presentation 是「簡報、發表」；present 是動詞「報告」；presence（出席）長得像。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a special menu designed especially for guests who follow a vegetarian diet.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供一份專門為吃素客人設計的特別菜單。

sentences.en: Traffic near the stadium can be very heavy, especially when there is a concert or a baseball game.
sentences.zh: 體育場附近的交通可能非常擁擠，尤其是有演唱會或棒球比賽的時候。

sentences.en: It is especially important to arrive early on the first day of the conference to pick up your badge.
sentences.zh: 研討會第一天提早到場領取識別證特別重要。

sentences.en: The new park is popular with families, especially on weekends when the weather is warm and sunny.
sentences.zh: 新公園很受家庭歡迎，尤其是天氣溫暖晴朗的週末。

sentences.en: This course was created especially for managers who want to improve their leadership and communication skills.
sentences.zh: 這門課是特別為想提升領導技巧的經理們設計的。

words.note: 語塊：especially for（特別為了）、especially when（尤其是當……的時候）、especially important（特別重要）。especially 和 particularly 意思相同；specially 偏「專門為了某目的」（specially designed）。

words.meaning: 有教育意義的；有啟發性的

sentences.en: The workshop on customer service was highly instructive for the new staff at our downtown branch.
sentences.zh: 客服工作坊對我們市中心分店的新員工來說很有啟發性。

sentences.en: The failure of the product launch provides an instructive example of what happens when research is skipped.
sentences.zh: 那次產品上市失敗，提供了一個跳過市場研究會發生什麼事的教育性例子。

sentences.en: Many employees found the speaker's talk about time management to be highly instructive and practical.
sentences.zh: 很多員工覺得講者關於時間管理的演講很有啟發性又實用。

sentences.en: Reading the reports from previous projects can be instructive for managers who are planning similar work.
sentences.zh: 閱讀以前專案的報告，對正在規劃類似工作的經理很有幫助。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibit is both entertaining and instructive for children who are interested in science.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽對喜歡科學的孩子來說既有趣又有教育意義。

words.note: 語塊：highly instructive（很有啟發性的）、an instructive example（有教育意義的例子）。instructive 是「讓人學到東西的」；informative（資訊豐富的）意思接近；instructor 是「講師」。

sentences.en: The highly successful marketing campaign helped the company double its online sales in just six months.
sentences.zh: 那次非常成功的行銷活動幫公司在短短六個月內讓網路銷售加倍。

sentences.en: The successful candidate will be responsible for managing a team of ten customer service representatives.
sentences.zh: 錄取者將負責管理一個十人的客服團隊。

sentences.en: The company was successful in reducing its energy use by installing solar panels on all of its buildings.
sentences.zh: 公司在所有建築物裝了太陽能板，成功減少了用電量。

sentences.en: The successful candidate must be able to travel overseas several times a year for business meetings.
sentences.zh: 錄取者必須能夠一年出國好幾次參加商務會議。

sentences.en: After a highly successful first year, the restaurant opened a second location near the university.
sentences.zh: 在非常成功的第一年之後，那家餐廳在大學附近開了第二家分店。

words.note: 語塊：highly successful（非常成功的）、successful candidate（錄取者）、be successful in（在……方面成功）。successful 是「成功的」；successive（連續的）長得像，意思不同；success 是名詞。

sentences.en: The hotel offers comfortable rooms at a reasonable price, so it is popular with business travelers.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店以合理的價格提供舒適的房間，所以很受商務旅客歡迎。

sentences.en: The manager agreed to the employees' reasonable request for more flexible working hours in the summer.
sentences.zh: 經理同意員工希望夏天工時更有彈性的合理要求。

sentences.en: Our company provides high-quality printing services at a reasonable cost for small and medium-sized businesses.
sentences.zh: 我們公司以合理的成本為中小企業提供高品質的印刷服務。

sentences.en: It is reasonable to expect that sales will increase during the holiday season, as they do every year.
sentences.zh: 預期節慶期間銷售會增加是合理的，每年都是這樣。

sentences.en: Customers can rent bicycles at a reasonable price from the shop located next to the train station.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在火車站旁的店以合理的價格租腳踏車。

words.note: 語塊：reasonable price（合理的價格）、reasonable request（合理的要求）、at a reasonable cost（以合理的成本）。reasonable 是「合理、不貴」；affordable 偏「負擔得起」。

sentences.en: Moving the factory closer to the port was a sensible decision that has greatly reduced shipping costs.
sentences.zh: 把工廠搬到離港口更近是一個明智的決定，大大降低了運費。

sentences.en: Comfortable shoes are a sensible choice for visitors who plan to walk around the old town all day.
sentences.zh: 對打算整天在老城區走動的遊客來說，舒適的鞋子是明智的選擇。

sentences.en: It is sensible to compare prices from several suppliers before signing a long-term contract for office supplies.
sentences.zh: 簽長期合約之前，比較好幾家供應商的價格是明智的。

sentences.en: The committee made a sensible decision to postpone the outdoor event because of the storm warning.
sentences.zh: 委員會因為暴風雨警報決定延期戶外活動，是個明智的決定。

sentences.en: Leasing a car instead of buying one may be a sensible choice for companies that need vehicles only temporarily.
sentences.zh: 對只是暫時需要車子的公司來說，租車而不是買車可能是明智的選擇。

words.note: 語塊：a sensible decision（明智的決定）、a sensible choice（明智的選擇）、it is sensible to（……是明智的）。sensible 是「明智、有道理的」；sensitive 是「敏感的」，兩個字很容易搞混。

sentences.en: The trainer reminded new employees about the importance of punctuality when meeting with clients and partners.
sentences.zh: 訓練講師提醒新員工和客戶見面時守時的重要性。

sentences.en: The railway company is known for punctuality, and most of its trains arrive within one minute of schedule.
sentences.zh: 那家鐵路公司以準時聞名，大部分列車都在預定時間一分鐘內抵達。

sentences.en: Punctuality is one of the qualities that our managers value most when they evaluate employee performance.
sentences.zh: 守時是我們經理評估員工績效時最重視的特質之一。

sentences.en: The hotel received high ratings for the punctuality of its airport shuttle service throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店的機場接駁服務因為整年都很準時而獲得高評價。

sentences.en: Many companies in Japan place great importance on punctuality, so arriving late to a meeting is considered rude.
sentences.zh: 日本很多公司非常重視守時，所以開會遲到會被認為很沒禮貌。

words.note: 語塊：importance of punctuality（守時的重要性）、be known for punctuality（以準時聞名）。punctuality 是名詞「守時」；形容詞是 punctual（準時的）；punctuation（標點）長得像。

sentences.en: The gym has lowered its membership fee for students and senior citizens starting next month.
sentences.zh: 健身房從下個月起調降學生和年長者的會費。

sentences.en: Please remember to renew your membership online or at the front desk before it expires on the thirty-first of December.
sentences.zh: 請記得在十二月三十一日到期前續會員。

sentences.en: An annual membership at the museum includes free admission and discounts at the gift shop.
sentences.zh: 博物館的年費會員包含免費入場和禮品店折扣。

sentences.en: Customers who renew their membership online will receive a free tote bag with the store's logo.
sentences.zh: 在網路上續會員的顧客可以拿到一個印有商店標誌的免費托特包。

sentences.en: The membership fee for the business association is paid once a year and covers all networking events.
sentences.zh: 商業協會的會費一年繳一次，涵蓋所有交流活動。

words.note: 語塊：membership fee（會費）、renew a membership（續會員）、annual membership（年費會員）。membership 是「會員資格」；member 是「會員（人）」。

sentences.en: Our main competitor recently lowered its prices, so we need to find new ways to attract customers.
sentences.zh: 我們的主要競爭對手最近降價了，所以我們需要找新的方法吸引顧客。

sentences.en: The company released its new tablet one month before its main competitor launched a similar product.
sentences.zh: 公司在主要競爭對手推出類似產品前一個月發表了新平板。

sentences.en: To stay ahead of every competitor, we invest heavily in research and the development of new technology.
sentences.zh: 為了領先每一個競爭對手，我們在研究和新科技開發上投入大量資金。

sentences.en: The small bakery became a strong competitor to the large supermarket chains in the area.
sentences.zh: 那家小麵包店成了這一帶大型連鎖超市的強勁競爭對手。

sentences.en: Analysts believe that the merger will make the firm a much stronger competitor in the Asian market.
sentences.zh: 分析師認為這次合併會讓公司在亞洲市場成為更強大的競爭對手。

words.note: 語塊：main competitor（主要競爭對手）、compete with（和……競爭）、stay ahead of competitors（領先競爭對手）。competitor 是「競爭對手（人或公司）」；competition 是「競爭；比賽」；competent 是「能幹的」。

sentences.en: Engineers suspect that a faulty cable caused the power outage at the data center last night.
sentences.zh: 工程師懷疑是一條有問題的電纜造成昨晚資料中心停電。

sentences.en: If you suspect a problem with your account, please change your password and contact the bank immediately.
sentences.zh: 如果你懷疑帳戶有問題，請更改密碼並立刻聯絡銀行。

sentences.en: Many analysts suspect that the company will announce a merger at its annual meeting next month.
sentences.zh: 很多分析師猜想公司會在下個月的年度大會上宣布合併。

sentences.en: We suspect that the shipment was delayed at customs because some important documents were missing.
sentences.zh: 我們猜想貨物在海關被耽擱，是因為缺了一些文件。

sentences.en: The manager began to suspect a problem when the monthly sales figures suddenly dropped by thirty percent.
sentences.zh: 每月業績突然下滑三成時，經理開始懷疑有問題。

words.note: 語塊：suspect that（猜想……）、suspect a problem（懷疑有問題）。suspect 是「懷疑某事是真的」（傾向相信）；doubt 是「懷疑某事不是真的」（傾向不信）。

sentences.en: The company received a summons to appear in court regarding a dispute with one of its former suppliers.
sentences.zh: 公司收到傳票，要為和一家前供應商的糾紛出庭。

sentences.en: The court will issue a summons to the building owner if the safety problems are not fixed within a month.
sentences.zh: 如果一個月內沒有修好安全問題，法院會對大樓業主發出傳票。

sentences.en: Mr. Hall was surprised to receive a summons for jury duty during the busiest week of the year.
sentences.zh: Hall 先生很意外在一年中最忙的那一週收到擔任陪審員的傳票。

sentences.en: Anyone who receives a summons should contact a lawyer as soon as possible to discuss their options.
sentences.zh: 任何收到傳票的人都應該盡快聯絡律師討論該怎麼做。

sentences.en: The judge decided to issue a summons to the manager after he failed to respond to several letters.
sentences.zh: 經理沒有回應好幾封信之後，法官決定對他發出傳票。

words.note: 語塊：receive a summons（收到傳票）、issue a summons（發出傳票）。summons 是單數名詞（結尾的 s 不是複數），複數是 summonses；動詞 summon 是「召喚、召集」。

sentences.en: Using bright colors on your website can help your products stand out from those of your competitors.
sentences.zh: 網站使用鮮豔的顏色可以幫助你的產品在競爭對手之中脫穎而出。

sentences.en: Ms. Ito's creative ideas made her stand out among the twenty candidates who applied for the design job.
sentences.zh: 伊藤小姐的創意讓她在應徵設計工作的二十位候選人中顯得突出。

sentences.en: A well-written cover letter can help your application stand out when hundreds of people apply.
sentences.zh: 當有數百人應徵時，一封寫得好的求職信可以讓你的申請脫穎而出。

sentences.en: The new packaging is designed to stand out from other brands on crowded supermarket shelves.
sentences.zh: 新包裝是設計來讓產品在擁擠的超市貨架上從其他品牌中脫穎而出。

sentences.en: One thing that will stand out to visitors is the large glass ceiling above the main hall of the museum.
sentences.zh: 博物館大廳上方的巨大玻璃天花板是會讓參觀者印象深刻的一點。

words.note: 語塊：stand out from（從……中脫穎而出）、stand out among（在……之中顯得突出）。stand out 是「特別顯眼」；outstanding 是形容詞「傑出的」。

sentences.en: Could you break down the cost of the project so that we can see how much each part will be?
sentences.zh: 你可以把專案的費用細分，讓我們看看每個部分要多少錢嗎？

sentences.en: The delivery van tends to break down in cold weather, so we plan to replace it next year.
sentences.zh: 那台送貨車天冷時常常故障，所以我們打算明年換掉。

sentences.en: If talks break down again, the two companies may have to settle the dispute in court.
sentences.zh: 如果談判再次破裂，兩家公司可能得上法院解決糾紛。

sentences.en: The report will break down the cost of operating each store by rent, salaries, and utilities.
sentences.zh: 報告會把每家門市的營運成本按租金、薪水和水電細分。

sentences.en: Please call our hotline immediately if your machine should break down during the warranty period.
sentences.zh: 如果你的機器在保固期間故障，請立刻打我們的專線。

words.note: 語塊：break down the cost（把費用細分）、talks break down（談判破裂）。break down 可以指機器「故障」、談判「破裂」，也可以指把資料「細分」；breakdown 是名詞。

sentences.en: The company had to shut down the factory for a week to repair the damage caused by the flood.
sentences.zh: 公司因為要修復水災造成的損壞，只好關閉工廠一週。

sentences.en: The IT team will shut down the system at midnight on Friday in order to install the new software.
sentences.zh: 資訊團隊會在週五午夜關閉系統，安裝新軟體。

sentences.en: The museum will temporarily shut down its east wing while workers replace the old air conditioning system.
sentences.zh: 工人更換舊空調系統期間，博物館會暫時關閉東翼。

sentences.en: Please save your work and shut down your computer before you leave the office this evening.
sentences.zh: 今晚離開辦公室前，請存好檔案並關掉電腦。

sentences.en: Officials decided to shut down the highway for several hours after a truck accident blocked all lanes.
sentences.zh: 一起卡車事故擋住所有車道後，官員決定封閉公路好幾個小時。

words.note: 語塊：shut down the factory（關閉工廠）、shut down the system（關閉系統）、temporarily shut down（暫時關閉）。shut down 是「關閉、停止運作」；close down 也可以表示「歇業」。

sentences.en: A recruiter from the bank will visit the university next week to talk with students about job openings.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行的一位招募人員下週會到大學和學生談職缺。

sentences.en: If you are interested in working overseas, you can contact a recruiter who specializes in international positions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有興趣到海外工作，可以聯絡一位專門做國際職缺的招募人員。

sentences.en: The job recruiter called Ms. Moreno to schedule a second interview with the marketing director.
sentences.zh: 招募人員打電話給 Moreno 小姐，安排她和行銷總監進行第二次面試。

sentences.en: Our company hired an experienced recruiter to help us find qualified engineers for the new project.
sentences.zh: 我們公司聘請了一位有經驗的招募人員，幫我們找新專案需要的合格工程師。

sentences.en: Every recruiter at the job fair was looking for candidates with strong computer and language skills.
sentences.zh: 就業博覽會上的每一位招募人員都在找電腦能力強的應徵者。

words.note: 語塊：job recruiter（招募人員）、contact a recruiter（聯絡招募人員）。recruiter 是「招募人員」；recruit 是動詞「招募」或名詞「新進人員」。

sentences.en: Customers can redeem a coupon for a free coffee at any of our locations until the end of March.
sentences.zh: 顧客在三月底前可以在我們任何一家分店用優惠券換一杯免費咖啡。

sentences.en: Members can redeem points for hotel stays, flights, and gift cards through our mobile app.
sentences.zh: 會員可以透過我們的 App 用點數兌換飯店住宿、機票和禮物卡。

sentences.en: Gift certificates cannot be redeemed for cash, but you can redeem them for any item in the store.
sentences.zh: 禮券不能換現金，但可以在店內兌換任何商品。

sentences.en: To redeem your voucher, simply show the barcode to the cashier when you pay for your meal.
sentences.zh: 要使用你的抵用券，結帳時只要把條碼給收銀員看就好。

sentences.en: Passengers who redeem points for a flight must book their tickets at least two weeks in advance.
sentences.zh: 用點數兌換機票的乘客，必須至少提前兩週訂票。

words.note: 語塊：redeem a coupon（使用優惠券）、redeem points（兌換點數）、redeem for（兌換成）。redeem 是「用點數、優惠券換東西」；名詞是 redemption。

sentences.en: The redemption of points for free flights is not available during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 節慶旺季期間不能用點數兌換免費機票。

sentences.en: The redemption period for the gift vouchers ends on the last day of the year, so please use them soon.
sentences.zh: 禮券的兌換期限在年底最後一天結束，所以請盡快使用。

sentences.en: Customers can check the redemption status of their rewards by logging in to their online account.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以登入線上帳戶查詢獎勵的兌換狀態。

sentences.en: The store changed its policy so that the redemption of coupons is limited to one per customer.
sentences.zh: 店家修改了規定，每位顧客只能兌換一張優惠券。

sentences.en: Please contact customer service if you have any problems with the redemption of points on our website.
sentences.zh: 如果你在我們網站上兌換點數有任何問題，請聯絡客服。

words.note: 語塊：redemption of points（點數兌換）、redemption period（兌換期限）。redemption 是名詞，動詞是 redeem；常見於「點數、優惠券的兌換」。

sentences.en: Small businesses with fewer than ten employees are exempt from the new reporting requirements announced last month.
sentences.zh: 員工少於十人的小企業不受新的申報規定約束。

sentences.en: Donations to the children's hospital are tax-exempt, so donors can deduct them from their income.
sentences.zh: 捐給兒童醫院的錢是免稅的，捐款人可以從收入中扣除。

sentences.en: Senior managers are exempt from the training sessions because they have already completed the course.
sentences.zh: 高階經理不用參加訓練課程，因為他們已經上過了。

sentences.en: Certain medical supplies are exempt from import taxes under the new trade agreement signed this year.
sentences.zh: 根據新的貿易協定，某些醫療用品免繳進口稅。

sentences.en: Visitors from member countries are exempt from visa requirements for stays of up to ninety days.
sentences.zh: 來自會員國的訪客停留九十天以內免簽證。

words.note: 語塊：be exempt from（免除……）、tax-exempt（免稅的）。be exempt from 是「不用做／不用付」；exemption 是名詞「豁免」。

words.meaning: 苦苦掙扎的；經營困難的

sentences.en: The new CEO was hired to help the struggling company return to profit within two years.
sentences.zh: 新執行長受聘幫助這家經營困難的公司在兩年內轉虧為盈。

sentences.en: Many small shops are struggling to pay their rent because the number of tourists has decreased.
sentences.zh: 因為觀光客減少，很多小店都很難付出房租。

sentences.en: The government introduced new programs to support the struggling economy after several large factory closures.
sentences.zh: 工廠關閉後，政府推出新計畫支持不景氣的經濟。

sentences.en: The struggling restaurant decided to change its menu and lower its prices to attract more customers.
sentences.zh: 那家經營困難的餐廳決定更換菜單並降價，吸引更多顧客。

sentences.en: Volunteers offer free tutoring to struggling students at the local community center every Tuesday evening.
sentences.zh: 志工每週二晚上在社區中心為課業吃力的學生提供免費輔導。

words.note: 語塊：struggling company（經營困難的公司）、struggling economy（不景氣的經濟）、struggling to（努力想要……）。struggling 是「努力掙扎、處境困難」；struggle 是動詞或名詞「奮鬥」。

sentences.en: Employees have the option of working from home two days a week if their manager approves.
sentences.zh: 如果經理同意，員工可以選擇一週在家工作兩天。

sentences.en: Our online store now offers a new payment option that allows customers to pay with their mobile phones.
sentences.zh: 我們的網路商店現在提供一種新的付款方式，讓顧客可以用手機付款。

sentences.en: After comparing several suppliers, the team decided that the local company was the best option.
sentences.zh: 比較了幾家供應商後，團隊認為當地那家公司是最好的選擇。

sentences.en: Passengers have the option of upgrading to business class for an additional fee at the check-in counter.
sentences.zh: 乘客可以在報到櫃台付額外費用選擇升等商務艙。

sentences.en: Taking the train is the best option for travelers who want to avoid heavy traffic during rush hour.
sentences.zh: 對想避開尖峰時段塞車的旅客來說，搭火車是最好的選擇。

words.note: 語塊：have the option of（可以選擇……）、payment option（付款方式）、the best option（最好的選擇）。option 是「可以選的選項」；optional 是形容詞「可選擇的、非必要的」。

sentences.en: The two companies will meet next Monday to discuss the details of the new partnership agreement.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司下週一會見面討論新合作協議的細節。

sentences.en: Please discuss your vacation plans with your supervisor before you book any flights or hotels.
sentences.zh: 訂任何機票或飯店之前，請先和你的主管討論休假計畫。

sentences.en: The board members agreed to discuss the matter further at their next meeting in December.
sentences.zh: 董事們同意在十二月的下次會議上進一步討論這件事。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin would like to discuss the budget with the finance team before the proposal is submitted.
sentences.zh: 林小姐想在提案送出前和財務團隊討論預算。

sentences.en: We have scheduled a call for Thursday afternoon to discuss the details of your order.
sentences.zh: 我們安排了週四下午的電話，討論您訂單的細節。

words.note: 語塊：discuss the details（討論細節）、discuss with（和……討論）、discuss the matter（討論這件事）。discuss 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，不加 about（discuss the plan，不是 discuss about the plan）。

sentences.en: Organizing an international conference in only three months was a challenging task for the small team.
sentences.zh: 在短短三個月內籌辦國際研討會，對這個小團隊來說是一項艱鉅的任務。

sentences.en: Despite a challenging year, the company managed to increase its profits by five percent compared to last year.
sentences.zh: 儘管經歷了艱難的一年，公司仍設法讓獲利增加百分之五。

sentences.en: We are looking for candidates who enjoy working in a challenging environment with tight deadlines.
sentences.zh: 我們在找喜歡在截止期限緊、有挑戰性的環境中工作的應徵者。

sentences.en: Learning to use the new accounting software was challenging at first, but most employees now find it easy.
sentences.zh: 一開始學用新的會計軟體很有挑戰性，但現在大部分員工都覺得很容易。

sentences.en: The hiking trail is quite challenging, so visitors should bring plenty of water and wear proper shoes.
sentences.zh: 那條步道相當有挑戰性，所以遊客應該帶足夠的水並穿合適的鞋子。

words.note: 語塊：challenging task（艱鉅的任務）、challenging environment（有挑戰性的環境）、challenging year（艱難的一年）。challenging 是「有挑戰性但值得做」；difficult 只是「困難」。challenged 是「有障礙的；受到挑戰的」。

sentences.en: Employees who miss work without a legitimate reason may receive a written warning from human resources.
sentences.zh: 沒有正當理由缺勤的員工可能會收到人資部的書面警告。

sentences.en: Before signing the contract, we checked that the supplier was a legitimate business with a valid license.
sentences.zh: 簽約之前，我們確認了供應商是有有效執照的合法商家。

sentences.en: Residents raised a legitimate concern about the increase in traffic that the new mall would bring.
sentences.zh: 居民提出合理的擔憂，認為新購物中心會帶來更多車流。

sentences.en: Customers should only download the software from our official website to make sure it is legitimate.
sentences.zh: 顧客應該只從我們的官方網站下載軟體，確保它是正版的。

sentences.en: The manager agreed that the team had a legitimate reason for asking to extend the project deadline.
sentences.zh: 經理同意團隊要求延長專案期限是有正當理由的。

words.note: 語塊：legitimate business（合法的生意）、legitimate reason（正當理由）、legitimate concern（合理的擔憂）。legitimate 是「合法、正當的」；legal 只強調「合法」，legitimate 還帶「合理、站得住腳」。

sentences.en: Rising fuel prices continue to cut into profits for airlines and shipping companies around the world.
sentences.zh: 油價上漲持續侵蝕全世界航空公司和航運公司的利潤。

sentences.en: Long meetings can cut into the time that employees need to complete their daily tasks.
sentences.zh: 冗長的會議會佔用員工完成日常工作所需的時間。

sentences.en: The new competitor's low prices are beginning to cut into our share of the market for office furniture.
sentences.zh: 新競爭對手的低價開始侵蝕我們在辦公家具市場的佔有率。

sentences.en: Higher rent will cut into profits for many small restaurants in the downtown area next year.
sentences.zh: 明年房租上漲會侵蝕市中心許多小餐廳的利潤。

sentences.en: Frequent business trips started to cut into his time with his family, so he asked for a different role.
sentences.zh: 頻繁出差開始佔用他陪家人的時間，所以他要求換一個職位。

words.note: 語塊：cut into profits（侵蝕利潤）、cut into one's time（佔用時間）。cut into 是「吃掉、減少一部分」；cut down on 是「減少（使用量）」。

sentences.en: A senior executive from the head office will visit our branch next week to review its performance.
sentences.zh: 總公司的一位高階主管下週會來我們分行檢視績效。

sentences.en: The chief executive announced that the company will open twenty new stores in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 執行長宣布公司將在東南亞開設二十家新店。

sentences.en: Mr. Kaplan was hired as a sales executive responsible for clients in the Middle East and Africa.
sentences.zh: Kaplan 先生被聘為業務主管，負責中東和非洲的客戶。

sentences.en: Every executive in the company is expected to attend the annual planning meeting in January.
sentences.zh: 公司每位主管都必須參加一月的年度規劃會議。

sentences.en: The newspaper interviewed a senior executive about the bank's plans to reduce its number of branches.
sentences.zh: 報紙訪問了一位高階主管，談銀行減少分行數量的計畫。

words.note: 語塊：senior executive（高階主管）、chief executive（執行長）、sales executive（業務主管）。executive 當名詞是「主管」；當形容詞是「行政的、高級的」（executive suite 行政套房）。

sentences.en: Many experts regard the new smartphone as the best product the company has ever released.
sentences.zh: 很多專家把這支新手機視為公司推出過最好的產品。

sentences.en: Most employees regard Ms. Fischer as a fair and supportive manager who listens to their ideas.
sentences.zh: 大部分員工都認為 Fischer 小姐是一位公平、支持部屬又願意聽想法的經理。

sentences.en: The company does not regard working from home as a reward but as a normal part of the job.
sentences.zh: 公司並不把在家工作當作獎勵，而是當作工作的正常一部分。

sentences.en: Investors regard the tourism industry as one of the most promising areas for growth in the region.
sentences.zh: 投資人把觀光業視為該地區最有成長潛力的產業之一。

sentences.en: Customers regard our after-sales service as the main reason they continue to buy our products.
sentences.zh: 顧客把我們的售後服務視為他們持續購買我們產品的主要原因。

words.note: 語塊：regard as（把……視為）、be highly regarded（受到高度評價）。regard A as B 是「把 A 視為 B」；名詞 regard 有「關心、問候」：with regard to（關於）。

sentences.en: The band spent three months in a recording studio in London working on their new album.
sentences.zh: 那個樂團在倫敦的一間錄音室待了三個月製作新專輯。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz opened her own design studio after working for a large advertising agency for ten years.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐在大型廣告公司工作十年後，開了自己的設計工作室。

sentences.en: The studio apartment is small but comfortable, and it is only a short walk from the subway station.
sentences.zh: 那間套房雖小但很舒適，離捷運站只要走一小段路。

sentences.en: The television interview will be recorded at the television studio downtown on Wednesday afternoon at two.
sentences.zh: 電視訪問將在週三下午於市中心的攝影棚錄製。

sentences.en: The yoga studio offers morning classes for office workers who want to exercise before work.
sentences.zh: 那間瑜伽教室為想在上班前運動的上班族開設晨間課程。

words.note: 語塊：recording studio（錄音室）、design studio（設計工作室）、studio apartment（套房）。studio 可以指「工作室、攝影棚」，在租屋時指「套房」（客廳臥室合一）。

sentences.en: The movie studio plans to release a sequel to its popular animated film next summer.
sentences.zh: 那家電影公司計畫明年夏天推出熱門動畫電影的續集。

sentences.en: Readers have been waiting for three years for a sequel to the best-selling mystery novel.
sentences.zh: 讀者等那本暢銷推理小說的續集已經等了三年。

sentences.en: The sequel was even more successful than the original film and broke several box office records.
sentences.zh: 續集比原本的電影更成功，打破了好幾項票房紀錄。

sentences.en: The game company will release a sequel that includes many new characters and greatly improved graphics.
sentences.zh: 那家遊戲公司將推出一款有新角色和更好畫面的續集。

sentences.en: The author announced at the book fair that she is currently writing a sequel to her first novel.
sentences.zh: 那位作家在書展上宣布她正在寫第一本小說的續集。

words.note: 語塊：a sequel to（……的續集）、release a sequel（推出續集）。sequel 是電影、書的「續集」；prequel 是「前傳」；sequence 是「順序」。

sentences.en: Increasing sales by forty percent in a single year is a remarkable achievement for such a small company.
sentences.zh: 一家這麼小的公司在一年內讓銷售增加四成，是非凡的成就。

sentences.en: The new employees have made remarkable progress since they started the training program in September.
sentences.zh: 新員工從九月開始參加訓練計畫以來有了顯著的進步。

sentences.en: The restaurant has enjoyed remarkable success since a famous food critic wrote about it last year.
sentences.zh: 自從一位知名美食評論家去年寫了那家餐廳後，它就獲得驚人的成功。

sentences.en: The view from the top floor of the hotel is truly remarkable, especially at sunset.
sentences.zh: 從飯店頂樓看出去的景色真的很棒，尤其是夕陽西下的時候。

sentences.en: The research team made remarkable progress in developing a battery that charges in only ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊在開發只要十分鐘就能充飽的電池上有了顯著的進步。

words.note: 語塊：remarkable achievement（非凡的成就）、remarkable progress（顯著的進步）、remarkable success（驚人的成功）。remarkable 是「值得注意、了不起的」；remark 是「評論」，兩者意思不同。

sentences.en: Many guests choose our mountain resort because they want some peace and quiet away from the city.
sentences.zh: 很多客人選擇我們的山中度假村，因為他們想遠離城市，享受安靜。

sentences.en: Our extended warranty gives customers peace of mind when they buy expensive electronic products such as laptops.
sentences.zh: 我們的延長保固讓顧客在購買昂貴的電子產品時更安心。

sentences.en: The library has quiet study rooms where students can work in peace without being disturbed.
sentences.zh: 圖書館有安靜的自習室，學生可以在那裡不受打擾地專心讀書。

sentences.en: Installing security cameras gave the shop owner peace of mind while she was away on vacation.
sentences.zh: 裝了監視器讓店主去度假時也很安心。

sentences.en: The hotel's garden offers guests a place to enjoy peace and quiet after a busy day of meetings.
sentences.zh: 飯店的花園讓客人在忙碌開會的一天之後，有個享受安靜的地方。

words.note: 語塊：peace and quiet（安靜）、peace of mind（安心）、in peace（安靜地）。peace 是「和平、平靜」；piece（一片）發音一樣，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: Investing in new technology always involves some inherent risk, so we must plan every step carefully.
sentences.zh: 投資新科技總是有一些固有的風險，所以我們必須仔細規劃。

sentences.en: Delays are inherent in large construction projects, especially when the weather in the region is unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 大型工程本來就會有延誤，尤其是天氣難以預測的時候。

sentences.en: The consultant explained the inherent risk of expanding into a market where we have no experience.
sentences.zh: 顧問說明了進入我們沒有經驗的市場本身固有的風險。

sentences.en: Some noise is inherent in working at an open office, so headphones are provided for all employees.
sentences.zh: 在開放式辦公室工作本來就會有些噪音，所以公司提供耳機給所有員工。

sentences.en: Every business plan contains some inherent risk, but careful market research can help reduce it significantly.
sentences.zh: 每份商業計畫都有一些固有的風險，但仔細的研究能幫助降低風險。

words.note: 語塊：inherent risk（固有的風險）、be inherent in（是……本身固有的）。inherent 是「本來就有、與生俱來的」；inherit 是動詞「繼承」，意思不同。

sentences.en: The program provides free office space and advice to any young entrepreneur with a promising idea.
sentences.zh: 這個計畫為任何有好點子的年輕創業家提供免費辦公空間和建議。

sentences.en: Mr. Adeyemi is a successful entrepreneur who started three technology companies before the age of forty.
sentences.zh: Adeyemi 先生是一位成功的企業家，四十歲前就創辦了三家科技公司。

sentences.en: Ms. Park left her job at the bank to become an entrepreneur and open a chain of coffee shops.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐辭去銀行的工作，成為創業家，開了一系列咖啡店。

sentences.en: The speaker at the conference is a young entrepreneur who sells handmade wooden furniture online.
sentences.zh: 研討會的講者是一位在網路上賣手工家具的年輕創業家。

sentences.en: The magazine named her the most successful entrepreneur of the year for her work in renewable energy.
sentences.zh: 雜誌因為她在再生能源方面的成就，把她選為年度最成功的企業家。

words.note: 語塊：young entrepreneur（年輕創業家）、successful entrepreneur（成功的企業家）、become an entrepreneur（成為創業家）。entrepreneur 是「創業的人」；enterprise 是「企業」；entrepreneurial 是形容詞。

sentences.en: The new factory is expected to support job creation in a region where many people are unemployed.
sentences.zh: 新工廠預計會在許多人失業的地區帶動就業機會。

sentences.en: The board approved the creation of a new department that will focus on online sales.
sentences.zh: 董事會核准成立一個專注於網路銷售的新部門。

sentences.en: The chef's latest creation, a chocolate cake with sea salt, has become the restaurant's most popular dessert.
sentences.zh: 主廚最新的作品，海鹽巧克力蛋糕，已經成為餐廳最受歡迎的甜點。

sentences.en: Government programs that encourage job creation often include special tax benefits for small and medium-sized businesses.
sentences.zh: 鼓勵創造就業的政府計畫通常包括給小企業的稅務優惠。

sentences.en: Ms. Tran was responsible for the creation of the company's first online training program for new staff.
sentences.zh: Tran 小姐負責建立公司第一套給新員工的線上訓練課程。

words.note: 語塊：job creation（創造就業）、the creation of（……的創立）。creation 是「創造（的行為或成果）」；creativity 是「創造力」；create 是動詞。

sentences.en: Many companies stopped hiring new staff during the economic downturn that began two years ago.
sentences.zh: 兩年前開始的經濟衰退期間，很多公司停止招聘新人。

sentences.en: The travel agency reported a downturn in bookings after several major airlines raised their ticket prices in May.
sentences.zh: 航空公司調漲票價後，旅行社回報訂位量下滑。

sentences.en: Despite the economic downturn, the restaurant chain opened five new locations across the country last year.
sentences.zh: 儘管經濟衰退，那家連鎖餐廳去年還是開了五家新分店。

sentences.en: A downturn in the housing market has caused furniture sales to decline throughout the region.
sentences.zh: 房市下滑導致整個地區的家具銷售下降。

sentences.en: The company prepared for a possible downturn by reducing its debts and saving more cash.
sentences.zh: 公司藉由減少負債和存更多現金，為可能的景氣下滑做準備。

words.note: 語塊：economic downturn（經濟衰退）、a downturn in（……的下滑）。downturn 是「景氣下滑」；recession 是「經濟衰退」，程度通常更嚴重。

sentences.en: Our new laptops are competitively priced and come with a free three-year warranty and technical support.
sentences.zh: 我們的新筆電價格具競爭力，還附免費三年保固。

sentences.en: To survive in the market, small shops must be able to price their products competitively against those of large chains.
sentences.zh: 為了在市場上生存，小店必須能為產品訂出有競爭力的價格。

sentences.en: The hotel's rooms are competitively priced compared to other hotels of the same size in the city center.
sentences.zh: 跟市中心其他飯店比起來，這家飯店的房價很有競爭力。

sentences.en: The company has grown quickly because it offers high-quality services that are competitively priced for small businesses.
sentences.zh: 公司成長得很快，因為它提供價格有競爭力的高品質服務。

sentences.en: All of the furniture in our catalog is competitively priced, and delivery is free for orders over $500.
sentences.zh: 我們目錄中的所有家具價格都很有競爭力，訂單滿五百美元免運費。

words.note: 語塊：competitively priced（價格具競爭力）、compete competitively（有競爭力地競爭）。competitively priced 是常見說法，表示「價格很有競爭力（不貴）」；competitive 是形容詞。

sentences.en: The sales team worked extra hours in December to achieve its goal for the year.
sentences.zh: 業務團隊十二月加班，為了達成年度目標。

sentences.en: The company was able to achieve success in the Asian market by working with local partners.
sentences.zh: 公司藉由和當地夥伴合作，在亞洲市場獲得成功。

sentences.en: Our consultants help businesses achieve results by improving the way they train and manage their employees.
sentences.zh: 我們的顧問藉由改善企業管理員工的方式，幫助它們取得成果。

sentences.en: To achieve a goal like this, every department must cooperate closely and share information regularly.
sentences.zh: 要達成這樣的目標，每個部門都必須合作並定期分享資訊。

sentences.en: The new software helped the factory achieve results that were better than expected in its first year.
sentences.zh: 新軟體幫助工廠第一年就取得比預期更好的成果。

words.note: 語塊：achieve a goal（達成目標）、achieve success（獲得成功）、achieve results（取得成果）。achieve 是「努力後達成」；reach 意思接近但較口語；名詞 achievement 是「成就」。

sentences.en: The new restaurant received a favorable review in the city's most popular food magazine last month.
sentences.zh: 新餐廳在城裡最受歡迎的美食雜誌上獲得好評。

sentences.en: Weather conditions are favorable for the outdoor concert, so the event will take place as planned.
sentences.zh: 天氣條件對戶外音樂會有利，所以活動會照計畫舉行。

sentences.en: The proposal received a favorable response from the board, and work will begin next month.
sentences.zh: 提案獲得董事會的正面回應，工作將在下個月開始。

sentences.en: Low interest rates have created favorable conditions for people who want to buy their first home.
sentences.zh: 低利率為想買第一間房子的人創造了有利的條件。

sentences.en: The company offers favorable terms to customers who agree to sign a two-year service contract.
sentences.zh: 公司提供優惠條件給同意簽兩年服務合約的顧客。

words.note: 語塊：favorable conditions（有利的條件）、favorable review（好評）、favorable response（正面回應）。favorable 是「有利、正面的」；favorite 是「最喜歡的」，意思不同。

sentences.en: The outcome of the negotiations will be announced at a press conference on Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 談判的結果將在週五早上的記者會上宣布。

sentences.en: Both companies were pleased with the positive outcome of the meeting and agreed to work together.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司對會議的正面結果都很滿意，並同意合作。

sentences.en: The final outcome of the project depends on whether we receive the necessary funding by June.
sentences.zh: 專案的最後結果取決於我們能否在六月前拿到必要的經費。

sentences.en: Managers are waiting to learn the outcome of the customer survey before making any changes to the menu.
sentences.zh: 經理們在等顧客調查的結果出來，再決定菜單要不要改。

sentences.en: We expect a positive outcome from the new training program, as employees have responded well so far.
sentences.zh: 我們預期新訓練計畫會有正面的成果，因為員工到目前為止反應很好。

words.note: 語塊：the outcome of（……的結果）、a positive outcome（正面的結果）、the final outcome（最後結果）。outcome 是「最後的結果」；income 是「收入」，長得像但意思不同。

sentences.en: The company tries to create a friendly work environment where employees feel comfortable sharing ideas.
sentences.zh: 公司努力營造友善的工作環境，讓員工能自在地分享想法。

sentences.en: Customers are encouraged to bring their own bags to protect the environment and reduce plastic waste.
sentences.zh: 鼓勵顧客自備購物袋，保護環境並減少塑膠垃圾。

sentences.en: The current business environment is very competitive, so we must find new ways to attract customers.
sentences.zh: 目前的商業環境競爭非常激烈，所以我們必須找新的方法吸引顧客。

sentences.en: Our new packaging is made from recycled paper as part of our effort to protect the environment.
sentences.zh: 我們的新包裝用回收紙製成，這是我們保護環境努力的一部分。

sentences.en: A quiet work environment is important for employees who need to concentrate on detailed tasks.
sentences.zh: 對需要專注於細節工作的員工來說，安靜的工作環境很重要。

words.note: 語塊：work environment（工作環境）、protect the environment（保護環境）、business environment（商業環境）。environment 可以指「周遭環境」或「自然環境」；environmental 是形容詞。

sentences.en: The firm has built a solid reputation for providing excellent legal advice to small businesses.
sentences.zh: 那家事務所為小企業提供優質法律建議，建立了穩固的名聲。

sentences.en: We are looking for a project manager with solid experience in the construction industry in Asia.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位在營造業有紮實經驗的專案經理。

sentences.en: All of the tables in our showroom are made of solid wood from sustainable forests.
sentences.zh: 我們展示間的所有桌子都是用永續林場的實木做的。

sentences.en: The company reported solid growth in sales during the first half of the year, mainly in Europe.
sentences.zh: 公司上半年的銷售有穩健的成長。

sentences.en: Applicants with solid experience in customer service will be given priority for the position in our Taipei office.
sentences.zh: 在客服方面有紮實經驗的應徵者將優先考慮。

words.note: 語塊：solid reputation（穩固的名聲）、solid experience（紮實的經驗）、solid wood（實木）。solid 可以指「堅固、可靠」，也可以指「實心的」（solid wood 實木）。

sentences.en: Employees who arrive after nine o'clock often have trouble finding a parking spot near the office.
sentences.zh: 九點以後才到的員工常常很難在辦公室附近找到停車位。

sentences.en: The old lighthouse has become a popular tourist spot since it was renovated last year.
sentences.zh: 那座舊燈塔去年整修後已經成為熱門的觀光景點。

sentences.en: The manager offered the job to Ms. Varga on the spot because she was clearly the best candidate.
sentences.zh: 經理當場就錄取 Varga 小姐，因為她明顯是最好的候選人。

sentences.en: The café is a great spot for business meetings because it is quiet and has free internet access.
sentences.zh: 那家咖啡廳是商務會面的好地點，因為很安靜又有免費網路。

sentences.en: Visitors can reserve a parking spot online before they arrive at the stadium for the concert.
sentences.zh: 訪客可以在前往體育場看演唱會之前先在網路上預約停車位。

words.note: 語塊：parking spot（停車位）、tourist spot（觀光景點）、on the spot（當場）。spot 是「地點」；當動詞是「發現、認出」（spot a mistake 發現錯誤）。

sentences.en: The farmers received a government subsidy to help them buy new equipment after the flood.
sentences.zh: 水災之後，農民獲得政府補助幫他們購買新設備。

sentences.en: Companies that hire young workers can receive a subsidy of up to five thousand dollars per employee.
sentences.zh: 聘用年輕員工的公司每位員工最多可以獲得五千美元的補助。

sentences.en: The company provides a housing subsidy for employees who move to the city for work.
sentences.zh: 公司為了工作搬到這座城市的員工提供住房補貼。

sentences.en: Without a government subsidy, the small theater would not be able to continue operating for another year.
sentences.zh: 沒有政府補助，那間小劇場就無法繼續營運。

sentences.en: The new program offers a subsidy to families who install solar panels on their homes.
sentences.zh: 新計畫為在家裡安裝太陽能板的家庭提供補助。

words.note: 語塊：government subsidy（政府補助）、receive a subsidy（獲得補助）、housing subsidy（住房補貼）。subsidy 是「政府或公司給的補助」；複數 subsidies；subsidiary 是「子公司」。

sentences.en: The city has a very high population density, so most residents live in small apartments near the center.
sentences.zh: 這座城市的人口密度很高，所以大部分居民住在市中心附近的小公寓裡。

sentences.en: Areas with high density of housing often need more public transportation and green spaces for residents.
sentences.zh: 住宅高密度的地區通常需要更多大眾運輸和綠地給居民使用。

sentences.en: The report compares the population density of five major cities in Asia over the past twenty years.
sentences.zh: 報告比較了過去二十年亞洲五個大城市的人口密度。

sentences.en: Planners must consider population density when deciding where to build new schools, parks, and hospitals.
sentences.zh: 規劃人員決定新學校和醫院要蓋在哪裡時，必須考慮人口密度。

sentences.en: The new foam material has a high density, which makes the mattress firm and long-lasting for customers.
sentences.zh: 新的泡棉材料密度高，讓床墊對顧客來說又紮實又耐用。

words.note: 語塊：population density（人口密度）、high density（高密度）。density 是「密度」；dense 是形容詞「密集的」；destiny（命運）長得像。

sentences.en: As a precaution, all flights to the island were canceled until the storm had moved away from the coast.
sentences.zh: 作為預防，所有飛往那座島的航班都取消了，直到暴風雨離開海岸。

sentences.en: Workers must follow every safety precaution listed in the manual when they operate heavy machines.
sentences.zh: 工人操作重型機械時，必須遵守手冊上列出的每一項安全預防措施。

sentences.en: As a precaution, please save a copy of your files on an external drive before the system upgrade.
sentences.zh: 作為預防，系統升級前請把你的檔案存一份到外接硬碟。

sentences.en: The hotel added extra security guards in the lobby as a precaution during the international conference.
sentences.zh: 國際研討會期間，飯店作為預防措施在大廳增派了保全。

sentences.en: Wearing gloves is a simple safety precaution that can protect laboratory staff from dangerous chemicals.
sentences.zh: 戴手套是一個簡單的安全預防措施，可以保護實驗室人員不受危險化學品傷害。

words.note: 語塊：take precautions（採取預防措施）、as a precaution（作為預防）、safety precaution（安全預防措施）。precaution 是「事先的防範」；caution 是「小心、警告」。常用 take precautions（複數）。

sentences.en: The director is convinced that the new product will become our best-selling item by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 主任確信這項新產品到年底會成為我們最暢銷的商品。

sentences.en: After seeing the test results, the investors were fully convinced of the value of the new technology.
sentences.zh: 看過測試結果後，投資人完全相信這項新技術的價值。

sentences.en: Ms. Ward was convinced that moving the store to a busier street would attract more customers.
sentences.zh: Ward 小姐確信把店搬到比較熱鬧的街上會吸引更多顧客。

sentences.en: The board was not convinced that the proposal could be completed within the planned budget and schedule.
sentences.zh: 董事會不相信那份提案能在規劃的預算和時程內完成。

sentences.en: Many economists are convinced of the need to invest more in public transportation and clean energy.
sentences.zh: 很多經濟學家確信有必要在大眾運輸和潔淨能源上投入更多資金。

words.note: 語塊：be convinced that（確信……）、be convinced of（確信……）、fully convinced（完全相信）。convinced 是「確信的（人的感受）」；convincing 是「有說服力的（事物）」。

sentences.en: The city council approved the plan to build a new bicycle path along the river last Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 市議會上週二核准了沿著河邊興建新自行車道的計畫。

sentences.en: Residents are invited to share their opinions at the next council meeting, which will be held at city hall.
sentences.zh: 歡迎居民在下一次議會會議上分享意見，會議將在市政廳舉行。

sentences.en: A council member visited the neighborhood to listen to complaints about noise from the construction site.
sentences.zh: 一位議員到社區聽取居民對工地噪音的抱怨。

sentences.en: The proposal to raise parking fees will be discussed by the city council at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 調漲停車費的提案將在月底由市議會討論。

sentences.en: The arts council provides funding to local theaters and music groups that perform in public schools.
sentences.zh: 藝術委員會為到公立學校演出的地方劇團和音樂團體提供經費。

words.note: 語塊：city council（市議會）、council meeting（議會會議）、council member（議員）。council 是「議會、委員會」；counsel 是「建議；律師」，發音一樣但意思不同。

sentences.en: The company plans to make an investment of five million dollars in new equipment for its factories.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫投資五百萬美元替工廠購買新設備。

sentences.en: Before buying the software, managers wanted to know the expected return on investment over three years.
sentences.zh: 購買軟體前，經理們想知道三年內預期的投資報酬。

sentences.en: The government lowered taxes in order to attract more foreign investment in the technology sector.
sentences.zh: 政府調降稅率，以吸引更多外國投資進入科技業。

sentences.en: Training employees is a long-term investment that helps companies keep their best and most experienced workers.
sentences.zh: 訓練員工是一項長期投資，能幫助公司留住最好的員工。

sentences.en: Buying energy-efficient machines was a smart investment that has greatly reduced our monthly electricity bills.
sentences.zh: 買節能機器是一項聰明的投資，大大降低了我們的電費。

words.note: 語塊：make an investment（投資）、return on investment（投資報酬）、foreign investment（外國投資）。investment 是名詞；invest 是動詞（invest in）；investigation（調查）長得像。

sentences.en: Technicians are working hard to restore power to the neighborhoods that were affected by the storm.
sentences.zh: 技師們正在努力為受暴風雨影響的社區恢復供電。

sentences.en: The internet provider expects to restore service to all customers by tomorrow morning at the latest.
sentences.zh: 網路業者預計最晚明天早上會恢復所有用戶的服務。

sentences.en: The city hired experts to restore the old theater, which was built more than one hundred years ago.
sentences.zh: 市政府聘請專家修復那座一百多年前建造的老劇院。

sentences.en: If you accidentally delete a file, the IT department can restore it from the backup server.
sentences.zh: 如果你不小心刪掉檔案，資訊部可以從備份伺服器把它還原。

sentences.en: The new manager hopes to restore customer confidence after the problems with last year's product.
sentences.zh: 新經理希望在去年產品出問題之後，恢復顧客的信心。

words.note: 語塊：restore power（恢復供電）、restore service（恢復服務）、restore a building（修復建築）。restore 是「讓東西回到原本的狀態」；store 是「儲存」；restore 也用在電腦「還原」檔案。

sentences.en: The update was delayed because of an incompatibility between the new software and older computers.
sentences.zh: 更新延後了，因為新軟體和舊電腦之間不相容。

sentences.en: Several users reported problems caused by software incompatibility after they installed the latest version of the program.
sentences.zh: 好幾位使用者回報安裝最新版本後，因軟體不相容而出現問題。

sentences.en: The engineers solved the incompatibility between the two systems by writing a small connecting program.
sentences.zh: 工程師寫了一個小的連接程式，解決了兩個系統之間的不相容問題。

sentences.en: Customers should check for any incompatibility with their devices before purchasing the new wireless charger online.
sentences.zh: 顧客在購買新充電器之前，應該確認和自己的裝置是否有不相容的問題。

sentences.en: The merger was canceled because of an incompatibility between the management styles of the two companies.
sentences.zh: 合併被取消了，因為兩家公司的管理風格不相合。

words.note: 語塊：software incompatibility（軟體不相容）、incompatibility between（……之間的不相容）。incompatibility 是名詞；形容詞 incompatible（不相容的）常用 be incompatible with。

sentences.en: The manager spoke with a sense of urgency about the need to finish the report before the deadline.
sentences.zh: 經理帶著緊迫感談到必須在截止日前完成報告。

sentences.en: Repairing the broken air conditioner in the server room should be treated as a matter of urgency.
sentences.zh: 修理機房壞掉的冷氣應該被當作緊急事項處理。

sentences.en: The government acted with urgency to provide food and water to the families affected by the flood.
sentences.zh: 政府緊急行動，為受水災影響的家庭提供食物和水。

sentences.en: There was a sense of urgency in the office as the team prepared for the visit from the important client.
sentences.zh: 團隊為重要客戶來訪做準備時，辦公室裡瀰漫著緊迫感。

sentences.en: The safety problem was reported as a matter of urgency, and the factory stopped production immediately.
sentences.zh: 安全問題被當作緊急事項通報，工廠立刻停止生產。

words.note: 語塊：a sense of urgency（緊迫感）、a matter of urgency（緊急事項）、with urgency（緊急地）。urgency 是名詞；urgent 是形容詞「緊急的」；agency（代理機構）長得像。

sentences.en: The company headquarters will move from Taipei to Singapore at the beginning of next year.
sentences.zh: 公司總部明年初將從台北遷到新加坡。

sentences.en: Visitors to the headquarters must sign in at the security desk and wear a visitor badge at all times.
sentences.zh: 到總部的訪客必須在保全櫃台登記，並隨時配戴訪客識別證。

sentences.en: The firm opened its regional headquarters in Tokyo to manage its growing business in East Asia.
sentences.zh: 那家公司在東京設立區域總部，管理在東亞日益成長的業務。

sentences.en: All department managers will travel to the headquarters in Chicago for the annual planning meeting.
sentences.zh: 所有部門經理都會到芝加哥的總部參加年度規劃會議。

sentences.en: After the merger, the two companies decided to move headquarters to a new building near the airport.
sentences.zh: 合併之後，兩家公司決定把總部搬到機場附近的一棟新大樓。

words.note: 語塊：company headquarters（公司總部）、move headquarters（遷移總部）、regional headquarters（區域總部）。headquarters 結尾有 s，但可以當單數或複數用；常縮寫成 HQ。

sentences.en: The research team used statistical analysis to find out which factors affect customer satisfaction the most.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊用統計分析找出哪些因素最影響顧客滿意度。

sentences.en: The government publishes statistical data about employment, wages, and prices in each region every three months.
sentences.zh: 政府每三個月公布一次就業和薪資的統計資料。

sentences.en: Ms. Ng has a strong background in statistical analysis, which makes her ideal for the research position.
sentences.zh: 吳小姐在統計分析方面有紮實的背景，非常適合這個研究職位。

sentences.en: The report includes statistical data showing that online sales have grown by twenty percent each year.
sentences.zh: 報告包含統計資料，顯示網路銷售每年成長百分之二十。

sentences.en: Our analysts will provide a statistical analysis of the survey results at the meeting next Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我們的分析師會在下週四的會議上提供調查結果的統計分析。

words.note: 語塊：statistical analysis（統計分析）、statistical data（統計資料）。statistical 是形容詞；statistics 是「統計數字；統計學」；statistician 是「統計學家」。

sentences.en: Please contact human resources if you have any questions about your vacation days or health insurance.
sentences.zh: 如果你對休假天數或健康保險有任何問題，請聯絡人資部。

sentences.en: The human resources department is responsible for hiring new staff and organizing training programs for every department.
sentences.zh: 人資部負責招募新員工和安排訓練課程。

sentences.en: All new employees must submit their bank account details to human resources before their first payday.
sentences.zh: 所有新員工必須在第一次發薪日前，把銀行帳戶資料交給人資部。

sentences.en: Ms. Reyes has worked in the human resources department for eight years and now leads a team of six.
sentences.zh: Reyes 小姐在人資部工作了八年，現在帶領一個六人團隊。

sentences.en: Employees who wish to change their working hours should first contact human resources for the proper form.
sentences.zh: 想更改工作時間的員工，應該先聯絡人資部索取正確的表格。

words.note: 語塊：human resources department（人資部）、contact human resources（聯絡人資）。human resources 常縮寫為 HR，指公司的「人資部門」；personnel 是比較舊的說法。

sentences.en: The company's annual revenue grew by fifteen percent last year thanks to strong sales in Asia.
sentences.zh: 多虧亞洲的銷售強勁，公司去年的年營收成長了百分之十五。

sentences.en: Advertising has become the main source of revenue for the free mobile game and its developers.
sentences.zh: 廣告已經成為那款免費手機遊戲和開發者的主要收入來源。

sentences.en: The new parking garage is expected to generate revenue of about two million dollars each year for the city.
sentences.zh: 新停車場預計每年替市政府創造大約兩百萬美元的營收。

sentences.en: Tourism is an important source of revenue for small towns located along the eastern coast.
sentences.zh: 觀光是東海岸小鎮的重要收入來源。

sentences.en: The finance team will present a report comparing this year's annual revenue with that of the past five years.
sentences.zh: 財務團隊會報告今年和過去五年年營收的比較。

words.note: 語塊：generate revenue（創造營收）、annual revenue（年營收）、a source of revenue（收入來源）。revenue 是公司的「營收」；profit 是扣掉成本後的「利潤」。

sentences.en: The company will set aside money each month to pay for the renovation of its offices next year.
sentences.zh: 公司每個月會存一筆錢，支付明年辦公室的翻修費用。

sentences.en: Managers should set aside time every week to meet with each member of their team individually.
sentences.zh: 經理應該每週撥出時間和每位組員個別面談。

sentences.en: The restaurant will set aside several tables for guests who have made reservations for the holiday dinner.
sentences.zh: 餐廳會保留幾張桌子給預訂節慶晚餐的客人。

sentences.en: The building manager agreed to set aside ten parking spaces near the entrance for visitors with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 大樓管理員同意在入口附近保留十個停車位給身障訪客。

sentences.en: It is wise to set aside money for emergencies in case your income suddenly decreases.
sentences.zh: 存一筆緊急預備金是明智的，以防收入突然減少。

words.note: 語塊：set aside money（存一筆錢）、set aside time（撥出時間）、set aside for（為……保留）。set aside 是「特別留起來給某用途」；put aside 意思相同。

sentences.en: Please contact the front desk immediately if you notice anything unusual in your hotel room.
sentences.zh: 如果你發現飯店房間有任何異常，請立刻聯絡櫃台。

sentences.en: The new dress code is effective immediately and applies to all employees who meet with customers.
sentences.zh: 新的服裝規定立即生效，適用於所有會和顧客見面的員工。

sentences.en: A short reception will be held in the lobby immediately after the award ceremony on Friday evening.
sentences.zh: 週五晚上頒獎典禮結束後，緊接著會在大廳舉行簡短的酒會。

sentences.en: The airline immediately offered hotel rooms to passengers whose flights were canceled because of the snow.
sentences.zh: 航空公司立刻為因下雪而航班取消的乘客提供飯店房間。

sentences.en: If you lose your company badge, please report it to the security office immediately so that it can be deactivated.
sentences.zh: 如果你遺失公司識別證，請立刻向保全室報告，讓它可以被停用。

words.note: 語塊：immediately after（緊接在……之後）、effective immediately（立即生效）、contact immediately（立刻聯絡）。immediately 和 right away、at once 意思相同；immediate 是形容詞。

sentences.en: The client continues to insist on meeting with the director in person before signing the contract.
sentences.zh: 客戶一直堅持在簽約前要親自和總監見面。

sentences.en: Our new manager will insist that every report be checked by two people before it is sent to any client.
sentences.zh: 我們的新經理會堅持每份報告在寄給任何客戶之前都要由兩個人檢查。

sentences.en: Many customers insist on paying with cash, so the store will continue to accept it at every register.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客堅持用現金付款，所以那家店的每個收銀台都會繼續收現金。

sentences.en: The doctors insist that patients rest for at least one week after the surgery before returning to work.
sentences.zh: 醫生堅持病人在手術後至少休息一週才能回去上班。

sentences.en: The chef will insist on using only fresh, local vegetables in every dish on the new menu.
sentences.zh: 主廚會堅持新菜單上的每道菜都只用新鮮的在地蔬菜。

words.note: 語塊：insist on（堅持……）、insist that（堅持……）。insist on + 名詞或動名詞；insist that 後面的子句常用原形動詞（insist that he come）。

sentences.en: The company will hold a series of meetings next week to discuss the new organizational structure.
sentences.zh: 公司下週會舉行一系列會議，討論新的組織架構。

sentences.en: The museum is hosting a series of events to celebrate its fiftieth anniversary this autumn.
sentences.zh: 博物館今年秋天舉辦一系列活動，慶祝五十週年。

sentences.en: After a series of delays, the new subway line finally opened to the public last Saturday.
sentences.zh: 經過一連串的延誤之後，新捷運線終於在上週六開放給民眾搭乘。

sentences.en: Ms. Allen will give a series of lectures on leadership at the business school this semester.
sentences.zh: Allen 小姐這學期會在商學院開一系列關於領導的講座。

sentences.en: The library offers a series of free workshops for residents who want to improve their computer skills.
sentences.zh: 圖書館為想提升電腦能力的居民開設一系列免費工作坊。

words.note: 語塊：a series of meetings（一系列會議）、a series of events（一系列活動）、a series of workshops（一系列工作坊）。a series of 後面接複數名詞，但當主詞時動詞通常用單數；series 單複數同形。

sentences.en: The new energy drink is aimed at a younger demographic, especially university students and young workers.
sentences.zh: 新的能量飲料瞄準較年輕的族群，尤其是大學生和年輕上班族。

sentences.en: Our target demographic for the online course is working professionals between the ages of thirty and forty-five.
sentences.zh: 我們線上課程的目標族群是三十到四十五歲的上班族。

sentences.en: The magazine changed its design in order to attract a younger demographic of readers who prefer short articles.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌改了設計，以吸引較年輕的讀者族群。

sentences.en: Marketing experts studied which demographic was most likely to buy the new luxury cars produced in Germany.
sentences.zh: 行銷專家研究了哪一個族群最可能購買那款豪華汽車。

sentences.en: Before opening the café, the owners researched the target demographic of the surrounding neighborhood very carefully.
sentences.zh: 開咖啡廳之前，老闆們研究了周邊社區的目標族群。

words.note: 語塊：target demographic（目標族群）、a younger demographic（較年輕的族群）。demographic 當名詞是「某一族群（如年齡層）」；demographics 是「人口統計資料」；democratic（民主的）長得像。

sentences.en: The company spent a massive amount of money on advertising before the launch of its new smartphone.
sentences.zh: 公司在新手機上市前花了大量的錢做廣告。

sentences.en: There has been a massive increase in the number of people who shop online during the past five years.
sentences.zh: 過去五年來，網路購物的人數大幅增加。

sentences.en: The music festival was a massive success, attracting more than fifty thousand visitors over three days.
sentences.zh: 那場音樂節非常成功，三天內吸引了五萬多名遊客。

sentences.en: Workers needed several days to remove the massive amount of snow that fell on the airport last week.
sentences.zh: 工人花了好幾天清除上週降在機場的大量積雪。

sentences.en: The new shopping center is massive, with more than three hundred stores and a large movie theater.
sentences.zh: 新的購物中心非常大，有三百多家店和一間大型電影院。

words.note: 語塊：massive amount（大量的）、massive increase（大幅增加）、massive success（巨大成功）。massive 是「非常大」；huge、enormous 意思接近。

sentences.en: Because of intense competition from online stores, many small bookshops have closed in recent years.
sentences.zh: 因為網路商店的激烈競爭，近年來很多小書店都關門了。

sentences.en: Workers on the construction site were told to take frequent breaks because of the intense heat.
sentences.zh: 因為酷熱，工地的工人被告知要經常休息。

sentences.en: The sales team has been under intense pressure to meet its targets before the end of the quarter.
sentences.zh: 業務團隊一直承受著在季末前達成目標的極大壓力。

sentences.en: The smartphone market faces intense competition, so companies must keep their prices low and quality high.
sentences.zh: 手機市場競爭激烈，所以公司必須維持低價。

sentences.en: After weeks of intense negotiations, the two companies finally agreed on the terms of the merger.
sentences.zh: 經過幾週激烈的談判，兩家公司終於就合併條件達成共識。

words.note: 語塊：intense competition（激烈的競爭）、intense heat（酷熱）、intense pressure（極大的壓力）。intense 是「強烈、激烈」；intensive 是「密集的」（intensive training 密集訓練）。

sentences.en: The other board members concur with the chairperson's decision to open a new office in Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 其他董事都同意董事長在越南開設新辦公室的決定。

sentences.en: Most experts concur that the new law will help reduce air pollution in the city within five years.
sentences.zh: 大部分專家都同意，新法律會在五年內幫助減少城市的空氣污染。

sentences.en: I concur with your suggestion that we postpone the product launch until all the tests are complete.
sentences.zh: 我同意你的建議，把產品上市延到所有測試完成之後。

sentences.en: The two reports concur that customer satisfaction has improved since the new system was introduced.
sentences.zh: 兩份報告一致認為，自從導入新系統以來，顧客滿意度提高了。

sentences.en: If the committee members concur, the proposal will be sent to the director for final approval next week.
sentences.zh: 如果委員們都同意，提案下週會送交總監做最後核准。

words.note: 語塊：concur with（同意……）、concur that（同意……）。concur 比 agree 正式，常用在會議、報告中；occur（發生）只差一個字母。

sentences.en: Many employees take an English lesson every Tuesday evening at the language school near the office.
sentences.zh: 很多員工每週二晚上在辦公室附近的語言學校上英文課。

sentences.en: The company learned a lesson from last year's delays and now orders all materials two months in advance.
sentences.zh: 公司從去年的延誤中學到教訓，現在提前兩個月訂購所有材料。

sentences.en: Losing the important client was a valuable lesson about the need to respond to emails quickly.
sentences.zh: 失去那位重要客戶是一個寶貴的教訓，讓我們知道回信要快。

sentences.en: The manager hopes the team will learn a lesson from this mistake and check their work more carefully.
sentences.zh: 經理希望團隊能從這次錯誤中學到教訓，更仔細地檢查工作。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a free cooking lesson to guests who stay for more than three nights during the summer.
sentences.zh: 飯店為夏天住三晚以上的客人提供一堂免費烹飪課。

words.note: 語塊：take lessons（上課）、learn a lesson（學到教訓）、a valuable lesson（寶貴的教訓）。lesson 是「一堂課」或「教訓」；lessen（減少）發音一樣，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: Our main goal is to satisfy customers by providing fast delivery and friendly, helpful service.
sentences.zh: 我們的主要目標是提供快速的配送和親切的服務，讓顧客滿意。

sentences.en: The factory added a night shift in order to satisfy the demand for its popular electric fans.
sentences.zh: 工廠加開夜班，以滿足熱門電風扇的需求。

sentences.en: All applicants must satisfy the requirements listed in the job description before they can be interviewed.
sentences.zh: 所有應徵者都必須符合職缺說明中列出的要求，才能參加面試。

sentences.en: The restaurant changed its menu several times in order to satisfy customers with different tastes.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳為了讓不同口味的顧客滿意，換了好幾次菜單。

sentences.en: It will be difficult to satisfy the demand for new apartments unless the city allows taller buildings.
sentences.zh: 除非市政府允許蓋更高的建築，否則很難滿足新公寓的需求。

words.note: 語塊：satisfy customers（讓顧客滿意）、satisfy the demand（滿足需求）、satisfy the requirements（符合要求）。satisfy 是動詞；satisfied 是「感到滿意的（人）」，satisfying 是「令人滿意的（事物）」。

sentences.en: The movie is based on a true story about a small company that became one of the biggest in the world.
sentences.zh: 那部電影改編自一個小公司變成世界最大公司之一的真實故事。

sentences.en: Based on the results of the survey, we will add more vegetarian dishes to the cafeteria menu.
sentences.zh: 根據調查結果，我們會在員工餐廳的菜單上增加更多素食料理。

sentences.en: Bonuses are based on each employee's performance and the overall profits of the company each year.
sentences.zh: 獎金根據每位員工的表現和公司的整體獲利來決定。

sentences.en: The price of the tour is based on a group of at least ten people sharing a bus and a guide.
sentences.zh: 行程的價格是以至少十個人共用一輛巴士和一位導遊來計算的。

sentences.en: The decision to close the branch was based on several years of declining sales and rising costs.
sentences.zh: 關閉分店的決定是根據好幾年的銷售下滑和成本上升。

words.note: 語塊：be based on（根據……）、based on the results（根據結果）。be based on 是「根據」；be based in 是「總部設在……」，介系詞不同意思就不同。

sentences.en: Engineers warned that the old bridge could collapse suddenly if heavy trucks continued to use it.
sentences.zh: 工程師警告，如果重型卡車繼續使用那座舊橋，它可能會突然倒塌。

sentences.en: Without new investment, the struggling airline may collapse before the end of the year, experts say.
sentences.zh: 沒有新的投資，那家經營困難的航空公司可能會在年底前倒閉。

sentences.en: The company was about to collapse when a large technology firm offered to buy it last spring.
sentences.zh: 去年春天一家大型科技公司提議收購時，那家公司已經快要倒閉了。

sentences.en: Experts fear that housing prices could collapse if interest rates rise too quickly this year.
sentences.zh: 專家擔心，如果今年利率上升太快，房價可能會崩盤。

sentences.en: The roof of the old warehouse could collapse under the weight of the snow, so workers were sent home early.
sentences.zh: 舊倉庫的屋頂可能會被積雪壓垮，所以工人被提早送回家。

words.note: 語塊：collapse suddenly（突然倒塌）、be about to collapse（快要倒閉）。collapse 可以指建築「倒塌」，也可以指公司、市場「崩潰」；collapsible 是「可折疊的」。

sentences.en: Hundreds of people waited in line outside the store to buy the new smartphone on the first day.
sentences.zh: 第一天有數百人在店外排隊買新手機。

sentences.en: The festival attracts hundreds of thousands of visitors to the city and its beaches every summer.
sentences.zh: 那個節慶每年夏天吸引數十萬遊客到這座城市。

sentences.en: The company receives hundreds of applications every year for its popular summer internship program in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 公司每年都收到數百份熱門暑期實習計畫的申請。

sentences.en: Hundreds of people attended the free concert in the park despite the light rain on Saturday evening.
sentences.zh: 儘管週六晚上下著小雨，仍有數百人參加公園的免費音樂會。

sentences.en: The new factory will create hundreds of jobs for residents of the small town and nearby villages.
sentences.zh: 新工廠將為小鎮和附近村莊的居民創造數百個工作機會。

words.note: 語塊：hundreds of people（數百人）、hundreds of thousands of（數十萬）。hundreds of 後面接複數名詞，表示不確定的「好幾百」；確定數字時用 three hundred（不加 s）。

sentences.en: Customers who cancel their reservation less than one day in advance will incur a fee of fifty dollars.
sentences.zh: 提前不到一天取消預約的顧客，會被收取五十美元的手續費。

sentences.en: Employees who incur expenses during business trips should keep all of their receipts for reimbursement.
sentences.zh: 出差期間產生開支的員工，應該保留所有收據以便報銷。

sentences.en: The company will incur costs of about one million dollars to move its headquarters to the new building.
sentences.zh: 公司把總部搬到新大樓會產生大約一百萬美元的費用。

sentences.en: To avoid having to incur late fees, please pay your bill before the fifteenth of each month.
sentences.zh: 為了避免產生滯納金，請在每個月十五日前繳費。

sentences.en: Changing the design at this stage would incur costs that are not included in our current budget.
sentences.zh: 在這個階段改設計會產生目前預算沒有包含的費用。

words.note: 語塊：incur costs（產生費用）、incur a fee（產生手續費）、incur expenses（產生開支）。incur 常用在「產生費用、損失」；occur（發生）和 concur（同意）長得像。

sentences.en: The car factory recently added robots to its assembly line in order to increase production.
sentences.zh: 那家汽車工廠最近在裝配線上加入機器人，以提高產量。

sentences.en: Our bookshelves are designed for easy assembly and can be put together in about twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 我們的書架設計成容易組裝，大約二十分鐘就能裝好。

sentences.en: Please read the assembly instructions carefully before you begin putting the new desk together at home.
sentences.zh: 開始組裝書桌之前，請仔細閱讀組裝說明。

sentences.en: Workers on the assembly line take a fifteen-minute break every two hours to rest and stretch.
sentences.zh: 裝配線上的工人每兩小時休息十五分鐘，休息和伸展一下。

sentences.en: The furniture store charges a small fee for assembly if customers prefer not to do it themselves.
sentences.zh: 如果顧客不想自己組裝，家具店會收一筆小額的組裝費。

words.note: 語塊：assembly line（裝配線）、easy assembly（容易組裝）、assembly instructions（組裝說明）。assembly 可以是「組裝」，也可以是「集會、議會」；assemble 是動詞「組裝；集合」。

sentences.en: The supermarket has expanded its section of organic food because more customers are asking for it.
sentences.zh: 超市擴大了有機食品區，因為越來越多顧客要求。

sentences.en: Organic farming does not use chemical fertilizers, so it is often better for the soil and local rivers.
sentences.zh: 有機農業不使用化學肥料，所以通常對土壤和當地河川比較好。

sentences.en: The restaurant buys organic produce from small farms located within fifty kilometers of the city.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳向城市五十公里內的小農場購買有機農產品。

sentences.en: Prices for organic food are usually higher because it takes more time and effort to grow.
sentences.zh: 有機食品的價格通常比較高，因為種植需要更多時間和心力。

sentences.en: The cafeteria now serves organic vegetables and fruit grown on a farm owned by the company.
sentences.zh: 員工餐廳現在提供公司自己農場種的有機蔬菜和水果。

words.note: 語塊：organic food（有機食品）、organic farming（有機農業）、organic produce（有機農產品）。organic 是「有機的、沒用化學農藥的」；organized（有組織的）長得像。

sentences.en: Many farmers are reducing their use of chemical fertilizer in order to protect the quality of the soil.
sentences.zh: 很多農民減少使用化學肥料，以保護土壤品質。

sentences.en: The garden center sells a natural fertilizer made from recycled food waste collected from local restaurants.
sentences.zh: 園藝中心販售一種用當地餐廳回收廚餘製成的天然肥料。

sentences.en: Farmers should apply fertilizer in the early spring, before the new plants begin to grow.
sentences.zh: 農民應該在早春、新植物開始生長之前施肥。

sentences.en: The company developed a new fertilizer that helps crops grow faster without harming the environment.
sentences.zh: 那家公司開發出一種新肥料，能幫助農作物長得更快又不傷害環境。

sentences.en: Using too much chemical fertilizer can pollute nearby rivers and lakes, so farmers must follow strict rules.
sentences.zh: 使用太多化學肥料可能污染附近的河川和湖泊，所以農民必須遵守嚴格的規定。

words.note: 語塊：chemical fertilizer（化學肥料）、natural fertilizer（天然肥料）、apply fertilizer（施肥）。fertilizer 是「肥料」；fertile 是形容詞「肥沃的」；fertility 是「肥沃；生育力」。

sentences.en: Spare parts for this model are readily available at most hardware stores in the country.
sentences.zh: 這個型號的備用零件在國內大部分五金行都隨時買得到。

sentences.en: The supplier readily agreed to lower its prices when we offered to sign a three-year contract.
sentences.zh: 我們提議簽三年合約時，供應商爽快地答應降價。

sentences.en: Information about our products is readily available on our website and in our printed catalog.
sentences.zh: 我們產品的資訊在網站和紙本目錄上都可以輕易取得。

sentences.en: Ms. Ford readily agreed to lead the training session when her manager asked for a volunteer.
sentences.zh: 經理找自願者時，Ford 小姐爽快地答應帶領訓練課程。

sentences.en: Fresh vegetables are readily available at the farmers' market, which is open every Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 每週六早上開放的農夫市集隨時都有新鮮蔬菜。

words.note: 語塊：readily available（隨時可取得）、readily agree（爽快答應）。readily 有「很容易取得」和「欣然、爽快」兩個意思；ready 是形容詞「準備好的」。

sentences.en: These cleaning tablets dissolve in water within a few minutes and leave no chemicals behind.
sentences.zh: 這些清潔錠幾分鐘內就會溶於水，不會留下化學物質。

sentences.en: The two founders decided to dissolve the partnership after they disagreed about the future of the business.
sentences.zh: 兩位創辦人對公司的未來意見不合後，決定拆夥。

sentences.en: The board voted to dissolve the company and sell all of its remaining equipment to pay its debts.
sentences.zh: 董事會投票決定解散公司，並把剩下的設備全部賣掉償還債務。

sentences.en: Our new fertilizer is designed to dissolve in water quickly so that plants can absorb the nutrients easily.
sentences.zh: 我們的新肥料設計成能快速溶於水，讓植物容易吸收養分。

sentences.en: The committee will dissolve once the new building is finished and the final report has been submitted.
sentences.zh: 新大樓完工、最終報告提交之後，委員會就會解散。

words.note: 語塊：dissolve in water（溶於水）、dissolve a company（解散公司）、dissolve a partnership（拆夥）。dissolve 可以指東西「溶解」，也可以指組織「解散」；solve 是「解決」。

sentences.en: The region is famous for its rich soil, which allows farmers to grow vegetables all year round.
sentences.zh: 那個地區以肥沃的土壤聞名，讓農民一整年都能種蔬菜。

sentences.en: Scientists are testing the soil quality on the farm to find out why the crops are growing so slowly.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在檢測農場的土壤品質，找出農作物為什麼長得這麼慢。

sentences.en: Planting trees along the river can help prevent soil erosion during the long rainy season in the summer.
sentences.zh: 沿著河邊種樹可以幫助防止雨季時的土壤流失。

sentences.en: Before building the factory, engineers must check whether the soil is strong enough to support it.
sentences.zh: 蓋工廠之前，工程師必須確認土壤夠不夠堅固能支撐它。

sentences.en: Organic farming methods are designed to protect soil quality and keep the land healthy for many years.
sentences.zh: 有機耕作方法的目的是保護土壤品質，讓土地多年保持健康。

words.note: 語塊：rich soil（肥沃的土壤）、soil quality（土壤品質）、soil erosion（土壤流失）。soil 是「土壤」；toil（辛苦工作）和 spoil（寵壞；腐壞）長得像。

sentences.en: These towels are made from a special cotton that can absorb water much faster than ordinary towels.
sentences.zh: 這些毛巾是用特殊棉料做的，吸水速度比一般毛巾快很多。

sentences.en: The company decided to absorb the cost of shipping instead of raising prices for its customers.
sentences.zh: 公司決定自行吸收運費，而不是向顧客漲價。

sentences.en: New employees often need several weeks to absorb all the information presented during the training.
sentences.zh: 新員工通常需要好幾週才能吸收訓練期間教的所有資訊。

sentences.en: The thick carpets in the conference room absorb sound, so it is very quiet during meetings.
sentences.zh: 會議室的厚地毯會吸收聲音，所以開會時非常安靜。

sentences.en: Small suppliers cannot always absorb the cost of rising fuel prices, so they must charge more.
sentences.zh: 小供應商不一定能吸收油價上漲的成本，所以必須收更多錢。

words.note: 語塊：absorb water（吸水）、absorb the cost（吸收成本）、absorb information（吸收資訊）。absorb 可以指「吸收液體、資訊」，商業上也指公司「自行吸收（成本）」。

sentences.en: Poor sleep can negatively affect the concentration and performance of employees at work the next day.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不足會負面影響員工工作時的專注力和表現。

sentences.en: The long strike at the port is expected to negatively impact the delivery of goods across the country.
sentences.zh: 港口的長期罷工預計會對全國的貨物運送造成不利衝擊。

sentences.en: Customers responded negatively to the new design of the website, so the company returned to the old one.
sentences.zh: 顧客對網站的新設計反應負面，所以公司改回了舊版。

sentences.en: Rising interest rates could negatively affect sales of cars, homes, and other expensive products in the coming months.
sentences.zh: 利率上升可能會對汽車、房屋和其他昂貴產品的銷售造成負面影響。

sentences.en: The heavy rain did not negatively impact the number of visitors who attended the indoor exhibition.
sentences.zh: 大雨並沒有對參觀室內展覽的人數造成不利影響。

words.note: 語塊：negatively affect（負面影響）、negatively impact（不利地衝擊）、respond negatively（負面回應）。negatively 是副詞，常放在 affect、impact 前面；positively 是相反詞。

sentences.en: Vitamin C is an essential nutrient that helps the body fight infections and recover from illness.
sentences.zh: 維他命 C 是一種必需營養素，能幫助身體對抗感染、從疾病中復原。

sentences.en: The new breakfast cereal contains every essential nutrient that growing children need to start each morning.
sentences.zh: 新的早餐穀片含有成長中孩子每天早上需要的所有必需營養素。

sentences.en: Plants absorb water and each nutrient they need through their roots, which spread deep into the soil.
sentences.zh: 植物透過深入土壤的根部吸收水分和所需的每一種養分。

sentences.en: The nutrition label lists the amount of every important nutrient contained in a single serving.
sentences.zh: 營養標示列出每一份所含的每種重要營養素的量。

sentences.en: Doctors say that calcium is a key nutrient for strong bones, especially for women over the age of fifty.
sentences.zh: 醫生說鈣是讓骨骼強健的關鍵營養素，尤其是對五十歲以上的女性。

words.note: 語塊：essential nutrient（必需營養素）、key nutrient（關鍵營養素）。nutrient 是「營養素」（可數）；nutrition 是「營養（學）」；nutritious 是形容詞「營養的」。

sentences.en: The dry weather this summer has damaged the rice crop in several parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天的乾旱天氣損害了國內好幾個地區的稻作。

sentences.en: Farmers in the valley expect a good crop of apples this year because of the mild spring.
sentences.zh: 因為春天氣候溫和，山谷裡的農民預期今年蘋果會有好收成。
