sentences.en: The new fertilizer helped increase the crop yield on the test farm by nearly twenty percent.
sentences.zh: 新肥料讓試驗農場的作物產量增加了將近兩成。

sentences.en: Coffee is the most important crop for the region, and most families depend on it for their income.
sentences.zh: 咖啡是那個地區最重要的農作物，大部分家庭都靠它維生。

sentences.en: Scientists are developing a new type of crop that can grow well even when there is very little rain.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在開發一種即使雨量很少也能長得很好的新作物。

words.note: 語塊：grow crops（種植作物）、a good crop（好收成）、crop yield（作物產量）。crop 是「農作物」；harvest 是「收成（的動作或時期）」。

sentences.en: Our products are now available at every major retailer in the country, including department stores.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品現在在國內每一家大型零售商都買得到，包括百貨公司。

sentences.en: The online retailer offers free delivery on all orders placed on our website before noon on weekdays.
sentences.zh: 那家網路零售商對平日中午前下的所有訂單都提供免運費。

sentences.en: Fashion House is the largest retailer of children's clothing in the region, with over fifty stores.
sentences.zh: Fashion House 是那個地區最大的童裝零售商，有五十多家門市。

sentences.en: The manufacturer sells its goods to the retailer, who then sells them to customers at a higher price.
sentences.zh: 製造商把商品賣給零售商，零售商再以較高的價格賣給顧客。

sentences.en: Several retailers have signed contracts with us, and one major retailer plans to open a special section for our brand.
sentences.zh: 好幾家零售商已經和我們簽約，其中一家大型零售商打算為我們的品牌開設專區。

words.note: 語塊：major retailer（大型零售商）、online retailer（網路零售商）、retailer of（……的零售商）。retailer 是「零售商（賣給一般消費者）」；wholesaler 是「批發商」；retail 是「零售」。

sentences.en: The consultant will suggest that we reduce the number of products in our catalog to lower costs.
sentences.zh: 顧問會建議我們減少目錄中的產品數量，以降低成本。

sentences.en: We strongly suggest booking your hotel room early because the city is very busy during the festival.
sentences.zh: 我們強烈建議提早訂房，因為慶典期間城市非常熱鬧。

sentences.en: The results of the survey suggest that customers want longer opening hours on weekends and holidays.
sentences.zh: 調查結果顯示顧客希望週末營業時間更長。

sentences.en: Could you suggest a good restaurant near the office where we can take our clients for lunch?
sentences.zh: 你可以推薦辦公室附近一家可以帶客戶去吃午餐的好餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: The doctor may suggest taking a short walk after lunch to improve your blood circulation.
sentences.zh: 醫生可能會建議午餐後散個步，促進血液循環。

words.note: 語塊：suggest that（建議……）、suggest doing（建議做……）、strongly suggest（強烈建議）。suggest 後面接 doing 或 that 子句，不接 to do；that 子句常用原形動詞（suggest that he leave）。

sentences.en: Students must pay the tuition fee for the first semester before the end of August.
sentences.zh: 學生必須在八月底前繳交第一學期的學費。

sentences.en: The company will cover the tuition fee for employees who take evening courses related to their work.
sentences.zh: 公司會替上和工作相關的夜間課程的員工支付學費。

sentences.en: Many parents are worried about the tuition fee increase announced by the university last week.
sentences.zh: 很多家長擔心大學上週宣布的學費調漲。

sentences.en: The scholarship pays the full tuition fee as well as the cost of textbooks for one year.
sentences.zh: 這份獎學金支付全額學費以及一年的課本費用。

sentences.en: If you pay the tuition fee in one payment, you will receive a five percent discount from the school.
sentences.zh: 如果你一次繳清學費，學校會給你百分之五的折扣。

words.note: 語塊：pay the tuition fee（繳學費）、tuition fee increase（學費調漲）。tuition fee 也常寫作 tuition 或 tuition fees；scholarship（獎學金）可以用來支付學費。

sentences.en: Many small restaurants struggle to find enough staff during the busy summer tourist season each year.
sentences.zh: 很多小餐廳在忙碌的夏季旅遊旺季都很難找到足夠的人手。

sentences.en: New employees sometimes struggle with the company's complicated software during their first few weeks on the job.
sentences.zh: 新員工在頭幾週有時候會被公司複雜的軟體搞得很辛苦。

sentences.en: Some customers struggle to understand the instructions, so we will rewrite them in simpler language.
sentences.zh: 有些顧客很難看懂說明，所以我們會用更簡單的文字重寫。

sentences.en: Factories in the region struggle with high energy costs and a shortage of skilled workers.
sentences.zh: 那個地區的工廠為高昂的能源成本和技術工人短缺所苦。

sentences.en: Without more funding, the museum will struggle to keep its doors open for another year.
sentences.zh: 如果沒有更多經費，博物館將很難再撐一年。

words.note: 語塊：struggle to（努力想要……）、struggle with（為……所苦）。struggle to do 是「很努力但很辛苦地做」；struggling 是形容詞「經營困難的」。

sentences.en: Students who need financial aid should submit their applications to the university before the end of May.
sentences.zh: 需要財務援助的學生應該在五月底前向大學提出申請。

sentences.en: All security guards in the building are trained to provide first aid in case of an emergency.
sentences.zh: 大樓裡所有的保全都受過訓練，可以在緊急狀況時提供急救。

sentences.en: Charts and pictures are a useful visual aid when you are giving a presentation to a large audience.
sentences.zh: 對一大群聽眾做簡報時，圖表和圖片是很有用的視覺輔助工具。

sentences.en: The government sent food and medical aid to the towns that were damaged by the earthquake.
sentences.zh: 政府送食物和醫療援助到被地震損壞的城鎮。

sentences.en: A first aid kit is kept in the break room on every floor of our office building.
sentences.zh: 我們辦公大樓每一層的茶水間都放有急救箱。

words.note: 語塊：financial aid（財務援助）、first aid（急救）、visual aid（視覺輔助工具）。aid 比 help 正式；aide（助理）多一個 e，指「人」。

sentences.en: The car company decided to recall thousands of vehicles because of a problem with the brakes.
sentences.zh: 那家汽車公司決定召回數千輛車，因為煞車有問題。

sentences.en: I recall that the meeting was moved to Thursday, but please check the schedule to be sure.
sentences.zh: 我記得會議改到週四了，但請查一下行程表確認。

sentences.en: The toy manufacturer will recall a product that could be dangerous for children under three years old.
sentences.zh: 那家玩具廠會召回一款可能對三歲以下兒童有危險的產品。

sentences.en: Ms. Bauer could not recall the name of the client, so she checked the notes from their last meeting.
sentences.zh: Bauer 小姐想不起那位客戶的名字，所以查看了上次開會的筆記。

sentences.en: Customers who purchased the heater should stop using it immediately, as the company plans to recall the product next week.
sentences.zh: 購買那款電暖器的顧客應立刻停止使用，因為公司打算下週召回這項產品。

words.note: 語塊：recall a product（召回產品）、recall that（記得……）。recall 在商業上常指「召回有問題的產品」；也可以表示「想起」（= remember）。

sentences.en: Please report any problems that occur with the new software to the IT department as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 新軟體發生任何問題，請盡快回報給資訊部。

sentences.en: It did not occur to the manager that the team might need more time to complete the project.
sentences.zh: 經理沒想到團隊可能需要更多時間完成專案。

sentences.en: Delays often occur during the holiday season, so we recommend ordering gifts at least two weeks early.
sentences.zh: 節慶期間常常發生延誤，所以我們建議至少提前兩週訂禮物。

sentences.en: Most accidents in the warehouse occur when workers do not follow the safety instructions carefully.
sentences.zh: 倉庫的大部分意外都發生在工人沒有仔細遵守安全說明的時候。

sentences.en: If an error should occur during the payment process, your card will not be charged.
sentences.zh: 如果付款過程中發生錯誤，你的卡不會被扣款。

words.note: 語塊：occur to sb（某人突然想到）、problems occur（問題發生）。occur 比 happen 正式；occur to sb 是「某人想到」。名詞 occurrence 是「事件、發生」。

sentences.en: When planning the event, please take into consideration the number of guests who may need parking.
sentences.zh: 規劃活動時，請把可能需要停車的客人數量列入考慮。

sentences.en: The committee will take into consideration both the cost and the quality of each proposal before choosing one.
sentences.zh: 委員會在選擇之前，會把每份提案的成本和品質都列入考慮。

sentences.en: We will take into consideration your years of experience when we decide on your starting salary.
sentences.zh: 決定你的起薪時，我們會把你多年的經驗列入考慮。

sentences.en: Designers must take into consideration the needs of elderly users when creating the new mobile app.
sentences.zh: 設計師在製作新 App 時，必須把年長使用者的需求列入考慮。

sentences.en: The bank will take into consideration your income and your credit history before approving the loan.
sentences.zh: 銀行核准貸款前，會把你的收入和信用紀錄列入考慮。

words.note: 語塊：take sth into consideration（考慮某事）。take sth into consideration 和 take sth into account 意思相同，都是「把……列入考慮」。

sentences.en: Please call my secretary to schedule a meeting, as I will be traveling for most of next week.
sentences.zh: 請打電話給我的秘書安排會議，因為我下週大部分時間都在出差。

sentences.en: The executive secretary is responsible for managing the director's calendar and organizing business trips for the whole team.
sentences.zh: 執行秘書負責管理總監的行程並安排出差。

sentences.en: Mr. Ibrahim hired a personal secretary to help him answer emails and prepare documents for meetings.
sentences.zh: Ibrahim 先生聘了一位私人秘書，幫他回信和準備開會的文件。

sentences.en: The secretary of the association will send the minutes of the meeting to all members by Friday.
sentences.zh: 協會的秘書會在週五前把會議記錄寄給所有會員。

sentences.en: Ms. Cho worked as an executive secretary for five years before she was promoted to office manager.
sentences.zh: Cho 小姐擔任執行秘書五年後被升為辦公室經理。

words.note: 語塊：executive secretary（執行秘書）、personal secretary（私人秘書）。secretary 在公司指「秘書」，在美國政府指「部長」（Secretary of State 國務卿）。現在也常用 administrative assistant。

sentences.en: The head chef at the hotel restaurant changes the menu every season to use fresh local ingredients.
sentences.zh: 飯店餐廳的主廚每季更換菜單，使用新鮮的在地食材。

sentences.en: The bakery hired a talented pastry chef who trained for several years at a famous school in Paris.
sentences.zh: 那家麵包店請了一位在巴黎知名學校受訓好幾年的優秀糕點師傅。

sentences.en: An award-winning chef will give a cooking demonstration at the food festival this Saturday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 一位得獎主廚將在這週六下午的美食節做烹飪示範。

sentences.en: Guests can watch the chef prepare their meals in the open kitchen in the center of the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 客人可以在餐廳中央的開放式廚房看主廚準備他們的餐點。

sentences.en: The restaurant is looking for an experienced head chef who can manage a kitchen staff of twelve people.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳在找一位能管理十二名廚房員工的資深主廚。

words.note: 語塊：head chef（主廚）、pastry chef（糕點師傅）、award-winning chef（得獎主廚）。chef 是「專業廚師」，尤其是餐廳的主廚；cook 是一般「做飯的人」。

sentences.en: The food festival gives visitors a taste of traditional dishes from more than twenty different countries.
sentences.zh: 美食節讓遊客嚐到二十多個國家的傳統料理。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a wide range of activities to suit every taste, from hiking to cooking classes.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供各種活動，從健行到烹飪課，適合各種喜好。

sentences.en: The designer clearly has good taste, as every room in the new office looks modern and elegant.
sentences.zh: 那位設計師顯然很有品味，新辦公室的每個房間看起來都既現代又優雅。

sentences.en: Customers said that the new sauce has a strong taste of garlic and lemon, which they enjoyed very much.
sentences.zh: 顧客說新醬料有濃濃的大蒜和檸檬味，他們很喜歡。

sentences.en: Our menu includes dishes to suit every taste, including several options for children and vegetarians.
sentences.zh: 我們的菜單有適合各種喜好的料理，包括好幾道兒童和素食的選擇。

words.note: 語塊：a taste of（……的味道）、have good taste（有品味）、suit every taste（適合各種喜好）。taste 可以是「味道」，也可以是「品味、喜好」；tasty 是「好吃的」；tasteful 是「有品味的」。

sentences.en: Employees continue to push for more flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
sentences.zh: 員工持續爭取更有彈性的工時和在家工作的選擇。

sentences.en: We may need to push back the launch date because some of the parts have not arrived yet.
sentences.zh: 我們可能需要把上市日期往後延，因為有些零件還沒到。

sentences.en: The store manager asked the staff to push sales of the new coffee machines during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 店長要員工在節慶期間推銷新咖啡機。

sentences.en: The city council will push for a new law to reduce the number of cars in the downtown area.
sentences.zh: 市議會將爭取一項減少市中心車輛數量的新法律。

sentences.en: The meeting with the clients had to be pushed back, so we will push back the deadline for the report too.
sentences.zh: 和客戶的會議必須延後，所以我們也會把報告的截止日往後延。

words.note: 語塊：push for（極力爭取）、push back（延後）、push sales（推銷）。push back 在商業上常表示「把時間往後延」；push for 是「爭取」。

sentences.en: The company uses a secure online system to store data about its customers and their orders.
sentences.zh: 公司用一個安全的線上系統儲存顧客和訂單的資料。

sentences.en: Please store all cleaning products in the locked cabinet in the storage room on the first floor.
sentences.zh: 請把所有清潔用品存放在一樓儲藏室上鎖的櫃子裡。

sentences.en: Fresh fish should be stored in the refrigerator, and you should store it for no more than two days.
sentences.zh: 新鮮的魚應該放在冰箱裡，而且存放不要超過兩天。

sentences.en: Customers can store their luggage at the front desk after they check out of the hotel.
sentences.zh: 客人退房後可以把行李寄放在櫃台。

sentences.en: The warehouse has enough space to store more than ten thousand boxes of products at one time.
sentences.zh: 倉庫有足夠的空間一次存放一萬多箱產品。

words.note: 語塊：store data（儲存資料）、store in（存放在）、be stored safely（被安全存放）。store 當動詞是「儲存」，當名詞是「商店」；storage 是名詞「儲存（空間）」。

sentences.en: The company operates more than two hundred stores throughout the country, mostly in large cities.
sentences.zh: 公司在全國各地經營兩百多家門市，大部分在大城市。

sentences.en: Heavy rain is expected throughout the country this weekend, so outdoor events may be canceled.
sentences.zh: 預計這個週末全國各地都會下大雨，所以戶外活動可能會取消。

sentences.en: Our products are sold in supermarkets throughout the country and in several other countries overseas.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品在全國各地的超市和海外好幾個國家都有販售。

sentences.en: The bank plans to close twenty branches throughout the country as more customers use online banking.
sentences.zh: 隨著越來越多顧客使用網路銀行，那家銀行計畫關閉全國各地的二十家分行。

sentences.en: Schools throughout the country will celebrate the national holiday with special events and musical performances.
sentences.zh: 全國各地的學校會用特別活動和表演來慶祝國定假日。

words.note: 語塊：throughout the country（全國各地）、stores throughout the country（全國各地的門市）。throughout 是「遍及」；across the country、nationwide 意思相同。

sentences.en: The number of people who work from home has increased significantly over the past three years.
sentences.zh: 在家工作的人數在過去三年大幅增加。

sentences.en: The museum hopes to increase the number of visitors by offering free admission on Sunday mornings.
sentences.zh: 博物館希望藉由週日早上免費入場來增加參觀人數。

sentences.en: The hotel limits the number of guests who can use the swimming pool at the same time.
sentences.zh: 飯店限制同時使用游泳池的客人人數。

sentences.en: The number of complaints about late deliveries dropped sharply after we hired a new shipping company.
sentences.zh: 我們換了新的貨運公司後，延遲送達的投訴數量大幅下降。

sentences.en: The company plans to increase the number of employees in its research department by twenty percent.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫把研究部門的員工人數增加兩成。

words.note: 語塊：the number of + 複數名詞（……的數量）、increase the number of（增加……的數量）。the number of 當主詞時動詞用單數（The number of visitors is…）；a number of 是「一些」，動詞用複數。

sentences.en: Please download the latest version of the software before attending the training session on Monday.
sentences.zh: 週一參加訓練課程前，請先下載最新版本的軟體。

sentences.en: The publisher will release an updated version of the guidebook that includes new restaurants and hotels.
sentences.zh: 出版社會推出更新版的旅遊指南，收錄新的餐廳和飯店。

sentences.en: Ms. Ochoa sent the final version of the contract to the client for signature yesterday afternoon.
sentences.zh: Ochoa 小姐昨天下午把合約定稿寄給客戶簽名。

sentences.en: The new version of the app allows users to pay their bills and check their balance in one place.
sentences.zh: 新版的 App 讓使用者可以在同一個地方繳帳單和查餘額。

sentences.en: Customers who purchased the old model can upgrade to the latest version at a discounted price.
sentences.zh: 購買舊型號的顧客可以用優惠價升級到最新版本。

words.note: 語塊：the latest version（最新版本）、an updated version（更新版）、the final version（定稿）。version 是「版本」；vision（視野；願景）和 virgin 長得像，意思不同。

sentences.en: Reporters who have questions about the merger should contact the public relations department directly by email or phone.
sentences.zh: 對合併有疑問的記者應直接聯絡公關部。

sentences.en: The public relations department will prepare a press release about the opening of the new factory.
sentences.zh: 公關部會準備一份關於新工廠開幕的新聞稿。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant joined the public relations department after working as a journalist for several years.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐當了好幾年記者後加入了公關部。

sentences.en: All interviews with the media must be approved by the public relations department in advance.
sentences.zh: 所有媒體採訪都必須事先經過公關部核准。

sentences.en: The public relations department organized a charity event to improve the company's image in the community.
sentences.zh: 公關部籌辦了一場慈善活動，提升公司在社區的形象。

words.note: 語塊：contact the public relations department（聯絡公關部）、the public relations department will（公關部將會……）、approved by the public relations department（經公關部核准）。public relations 常縮寫為 PR，負責公司對外的形象和媒體關係；human resources（人資）負責內部員工。

sentences.en: The store has a reputation for selling quality goods at prices that most families can afford.
sentences.zh: 那家店以販售大多數家庭負擔得起的優質商品出名。

sentences.en: Customers are willing to pay more for quality goods that will last for many years.
sentences.zh: 顧客願意為能用很多年的優質商品付更多錢。

sentences.en: Our online market connects local farmers and artists who produce quality goods with buyers around the world.
sentences.zh: 我們的網路市集把生產優質商品的在地農民和藝術家與世界各地的買家連結起來。

sentences.en: The company's success is based on offering quality goods at low prices and providing excellent service.
sentences.zh: 公司的成功建立在以低價提供優質商品和優秀的服務上。

sentences.en: The department store sells quality goods from famous brands as well as products made by local designers.
sentences.zh: 那家百貨公司販售知名品牌的優質商品，也賣在地設計師做的產品。

words.note: 語塊：sell quality goods（販售優質商品）、quality goods at low prices（價格實惠的優質商品）。quality 放在名詞前可以當形容詞「優質的」（quality service 優質服務）。

sentences.en: The professor's lecture compared individualism in Western cultures with the importance of group values in Asian cultures.
sentences.zh: 教授的講座比較了西方文化中的個人主義和亞洲文化中的團體價值觀。

sentences.en: Some companies value individualism and encourage employees to develop and share their own creative ideas.
sentences.zh: 有些公司重視個人主義，鼓勵員工發展自己的創意。

sentences.en: The book explains how individualism has influenced the way people shop and spend their money.
sentences.zh: 那本書說明個人主義如何影響人們購物和花錢的方式。

sentences.en: Advertisers often use the idea of individualism to sell products that help people express their personality.
sentences.zh: 廣告商常利用個人主義的概念，銷售能幫人表現個性的產品。

sentences.en: Critics argue that too much individualism can make teamwork and communication in the office more difficult.
sentences.zh: 批評者認為，太強的個人主義會讓辦公室的團隊合作更困難。

words.note: 語塊：value individualism（重視個人主義）、individualism in（……中的個人主義）、too much individualism（過強的個人主義）。individualism 是「重視個人自由與獨立的想法」；collectivism（集體主義）是相反的概念；individuality 是「個性、特色」。

sentences.en: The economics course examines how modern capitalism developed in Europe during the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
sentences.zh: 那門經濟學課程探討現代資本主義在十九世紀的歐洲如何發展。

sentences.en: The documentary discusses the effects of global capitalism on small farmers and workers in developing countries.
sentences.zh: 那部紀錄片探討全球資本主義對開發中國家小農的影響。

sentences.en: Many economists believe that capitalism encourages innovation because businesses must constantly compete with one another for customers.
sentences.zh: 很多經濟學家認為資本主義會鼓勵創新，因為企業必須爭取顧客。

sentences.en: The author's new book offers a critical view of modern capitalism and its impact on the environment.
sentences.zh: 那位作者的新書對現代資本主義和它對環境的衝擊提出批判的觀點。

sentences.en: Students in the seminar debated whether global capitalism has reduced or increased poverty around the world.
sentences.zh: 研討課的學生辯論全球資本主義是減少還是增加了世界各地的貧窮。

words.note: 語塊：global capitalism（全球資本主義）、modern capitalism（現代資本主義）。capitalism 是「資本主義」；capital 是「資本；首都」；capitalist 是「資本家」。

sentences.en: Please read the eligibility requirements carefully before you apply for the university's new scholarship program.
sentences.zh: 申請獎學金計畫之前，請仔細閱讀資格條件。

sentences.en: Customers can check eligibility for the discount by entering their membership number on our website.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在我們網站上輸入會員編號確認是否有資格享有折扣。

sentences.en: Employees must work for at least one year to meet the eligibility requirements for the bonus.
sentences.zh: 員工必須至少工作一年，才符合獲得獎金的資格條件。

sentences.en: The human resources department will review each applicant's eligibility for the new management training program.
sentences.zh: 人資部會審核每位申請人參加訓練計畫的資格。

sentences.en: If you are unsure about your eligibility, please contact our office by phone before you submit your application.
sentences.zh: 如果你不確定自己的資格，請在申請前聯絡我們辦公室確認。

words.note: 語塊：eligibility requirements（資格條件）、check eligibility（確認資格）、eligibility for（……的資格）。eligibility 是名詞；形容詞 eligible 常用 be eligible for（有資格獲得）。

sentences.en: The proposed plan to build a new airport has received strong support from local business owners.
sentences.zh: 興建新機場的提議計畫獲得當地商家的強烈支持。

sentences.en: Employees will have a chance to comment on the proposed changes to the vacation policy next week.
sentences.zh: 員工下週有機會對休假規定的擬議變更發表意見。

sentences.en: The city council will vote on the proposed budget for next year at its meeting on Thursday evening.
sentences.zh: 市議會將在週四晚上的會議上對明年的預算草案進行投票。

sentences.en: Several residents spoke against the proposed shopping center because of concerns about traffic and noise.
sentences.zh: 好幾位居民因為擔心交通和噪音，發言反對擬議中的購物中心。

sentences.en: The proposed changes to the website will make it easier for customers to find the products they need.
sentences.zh: 網站的擬議變更會讓顧客更容易找到需要的產品。

words.note: 語塊：proposed plan（提議的計畫）、proposed changes（擬議的變更）、proposed budget（預算草案）。proposed 是「被提議、還沒決定的」；proposal 是名詞「提案」。

sentences.en: Each employee has an individual workstation with a desk, a computer, and an adjustable chair.
sentences.zh: 每位員工都有一個配有桌子、電腦和可調式椅子的個人工作區。

sentences.en: Please clean your workstation before you leave on Friday, as the carpets will be replaced over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 週五離開前請整理你的辦公座位，因為週末要換地毯。

sentences.en: The new office layout gives every workstation more natural light and a view of the garden.
sentences.zh: 新的辦公室配置讓每個工作座位都有更多自然光，也看得到花園。

sentences.en: Technicians will visit each workstation on Tuesday to install the new security software on every computer.
sentences.zh: 技師週二會到每個辦公座位安裝新的資安軟體。

sentences.en: Employees are not allowed to eat at their workstation, so please use the break room for meals.
sentences.zh: 員工不可以在座位上吃東西，所以用餐請到茶水間。

words.note: 語塊：individual workstation（個人工作區）、clean your workstation（整理辦公座位）、each workstation（每個辦公座位）。workstation 是「一個人的辦公位置（含桌子、電腦）」；workshop 是「工作坊；工廠」。

sentences.en: The training program teaches staff how to handle every customer interaction in a polite and helpful way.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫教員工如何以禮貌又有幫助的方式處理每一次和顧客的互動。

sentences.en: Many people prefer face-to-face interaction when they are discussing important business decisions with partners or clients.
sentences.zh: 很多人在討論重要的商業決策時比較喜歡面對面交流。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibit encourages interaction with the displays, so children can touch and play with them.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽鼓勵和展品互動，所以孩子可以觸摸、玩這些展品。

sentences.en: Working from home has reduced face-to-face interaction between employees who work in different departments of the company.
sentences.zh: 在家工作減少了不同部門員工之間的面對面交流。

sentences.en: Our software records every customer interaction so that staff can see past questions and complaints.
sentences.zh: 我們的軟體記錄每一次和顧客的互動，讓員工可以看到過去的問題和投訴。

words.note: 語塊：customer interaction（與顧客的互動）、face-to-face interaction（面對面交流）、interaction with（與……的互動）。interaction 是名詞；interact 是動詞（interact with）；interactive 是形容詞「互動式的」。

sentences.en: If we stick to the plan, the new store should be ready to open by the end of October.
sentences.zh: 如果我們照計畫進行，新店應該在十月底前就能開幕。

sentences.en: The project manager reminded everyone to stick to the budget because there is no extra money available.
sentences.zh: 專案經理提醒大家要守住預算，因為沒有額外的錢了。

sentences.en: It is important to stick to the schedule so that the construction can be finished before winter.
sentences.zh: 按照時程進行很重要，這樣工程才能在冬天前完工。

sentences.en: The company decided to stick to its original design even though some customers asked for changes.
sentences.zh: 儘管有些顧客要求修改，公司還是決定堅持原本的設計。

sentences.en: Speakers at the conference are asked to stick to the time limit of twenty minutes per presentation.
sentences.zh: 研討會的講者被要求遵守每場簡報二十分鐘的時間限制。

words.note: 語塊：stick to the plan（照計畫進行）、stick to the budget（守住預算）、stick to the schedule（按照時程）。stick to 是「不改變、堅守」；adhere to 意思接近但比較正式。

sentences.en: The company is taking a new approach to marketing by focusing on social media instead of television.
sentences.zh: 公司在行銷上採取新做法，把重點放在社群媒體而不是電視。

sentences.en: Our approach to customer service is simple: listen carefully and solve problems as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 我們的客服做法很簡單：仔細聆聽，並且盡快解決問題。

sentences.en: The manager decided to take a different approach after the first plan failed to increase sales.
sentences.zh: 第一個計畫沒能提升業績後，經理決定採取不同的做法。

sentences.en: The consultant recommended a new approach to training that combines online lessons with practice in the office.
sentences.zh: 顧問推薦一種新的訓練方法，結合線上課程和辦公室實作。

sentences.en: Many schools are adopting a more practical approach to teaching science, with more experiments in class.
sentences.zh: 很多學校採用更實際的科學教學方法，在課堂上做更多實驗。

words.note: 語塊：a new approach（新做法）、approach to（……的方法）、take an approach（採取做法）。approach 當名詞是「方法」，後面接 to + 名詞或動名詞（approach to solving problems）；當動詞是「接近」。

sentences.en: Hospitals in the city prepared extra beds during the flu epidemic that began in early winter.
sentences.zh: 初冬開始的流感疫情期間，城裡的醫院準備了額外的病床。

sentences.en: The government launched a campaign to stop the epidemic from spreading to other parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 政府發起一項行動，阻止流行病擴散到國內其他地區。

sentences.en: Some experts describe the rise in office workers with back pain as an epidemic of poor posture.
sentences.zh: 有些專家把背痛上班族增加的現象形容為姿勢不良的蔓延。

sentences.en: Schools were closed for two weeks during the flu epidemic to protect students and teachers.
sentences.zh: 流感疫情期間學校停課兩週，以保護學生和老師。

sentences.en: Doctors warn that obesity has become an epidemic in many countries where people rarely exercise.
sentences.zh: 醫生警告，在很多人很少運動的國家，肥胖已經成為一種流行病。

words.note: 語塊：flu epidemic（流感疫情）、an epidemic of（……的蔓延）。epidemic 是「地區性流行病」；pandemic 是「全球大流行」；endemic 是「地方性的（長期存在）」。

sentences.en: This pain medicine can be bought over the counter at any pharmacy without a prescription from a doctor.
sentences.zh: 這種止痛藥不需要醫生處方，在任何藥局都可以直接買到。

sentences.en: Many cold medicines are sold over the counter, but you should still read the instructions carefully.
sentences.zh: 很多感冒藥不需處方就能買到，但你還是應該仔細閱讀說明。

sentences.en: The pharmacist explained which allergy tablets are available over the counter and which require a prescription.
sentences.zh: 藥師說明了哪些過敏藥不需處方就能買、哪些需要處方。

sentences.en: Some medicines that were once sold over the counter now require a doctor's approval because of safety concerns.
sentences.zh: 有些以前不需處方就能買的藥，因為安全考量現在需要醫生核准。

sentences.en: Customers can buy vitamins over the counter at our store or order them online for home delivery.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在我們店裡直接買維他命，或在網路上訂購宅配到府。

words.note: 語塊：over-the-counter medicine（成藥）、buy over the counter（不需處方即可購買）。over the counter（OTC）指藥局直接買得到的藥；prescription medicine 是「處方藥」。

sentences.en: Patients should tell the doctor about any medication they are currently taking before the surgery.
sentences.zh: 病人在手術前應該告訴醫生目前正在服用的任何藥物。

sentences.en: The doctor decided to prescribe medication for the patient's high blood pressure after the checkup.
sentences.zh: 健康檢查後，醫生決定開藥治療那位病人的高血壓。

sentences.en: Please take medication only as directed and contact the clinic if you notice any side effects.
sentences.zh: 請只依照指示服藥，如果發現任何副作用請聯絡診所。

sentences.en: The pharmacy can deliver medication to elderly customers who are unable to visit the store in person.
sentences.zh: 藥局可以把藥送給無法親自到店的年長顧客。

sentences.en: Some employees need to take medication during work hours, so a private room is available for them.
sentences.zh: 有些員工需要在上班時間服藥，所以公司為他們準備了一間私人房間。

words.note: 語塊：take medication（服藥）、prescribe medication（開藥）、medication for（治療……的藥）。medication 和 medicine 都是「藥」；medication 比較正式，常指「正在服用的藥」；meditation（冥想）只差一個字母。

sentences.en: The growing middle class in Southeast Asia has created a large market for cars and electronics.
sentences.zh: 東南亞日益成長的中產階級為汽車和電子產品創造了龐大的市場。

sentences.en: The new housing project is designed for the middle class, with apartments that most families can afford.
sentences.zh: 新的住宅計畫是為中產階級設計的，公寓價格大多數家庭都負擔得起。

sentences.en: Economists say that the middle class is spending more money on travel and education than before.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家說，中產階級花在旅遊和教育上的錢比以前更多。

sentences.en: The government introduced tax benefits to support the middle class during the long economic downturn.
sentences.zh: 政府在經濟衰退期間推出稅務優惠來支持中產階級。

sentences.en: Luxury brands are now targeting the growing middle class in China and India with more affordable products.
sentences.zh: 精品品牌現在用比較平價的產品瞄準中國和印度日益成長的中產階級。

words.note: 語塊：the growing middle class（日益成長的中產階級）、middle-class families（中產家庭）。middle class 是名詞；放在名詞前當形容詞時要加連字號：middle-class families。

sentences.en: Ms. Hassan works for a multinational company with offices and factories in more than thirty countries.
sentences.zh: Hassan 小姐在一家在三十多個國家設有辦公室的跨國公司工作。

sentences.en: The multinational corporation plans to build its regional headquarters in Singapore at the beginning of next year.
sentences.zh: 那家跨國企業計畫明年在新加坡設立區域總部。

sentences.en: Working for a multinational company gives employees the chance to travel and work with people from many cultures.
sentences.zh: 在跨國公司工作讓員工有機會出差，和來自許多文化的人共事。

sentences.en: The government hopes that lower taxes will persuade at least one multinational company to build a factory in the region.
sentences.zh: 政府希望較低的稅率能說服至少一家跨國公司到這個地區設廠。

sentences.en: The multinational team includes engineers from Japan, Germany, and Brazil who communicate with each other in English.
sentences.zh: 那個跨國團隊有來自日本、德國和巴西的工程師，他們用英文溝通。

words.note: 語塊：multinational company（跨國公司）、multinational corporation（跨國企業）。multinational 也可以當名詞，直接指「跨國公司」；international 是「國際的」。

sentences.en: Every room on the top floor of the hotel has a beautiful view of the mountains and the lake.
sentences.zh: 飯店頂樓的每間房間都能看到美麗的山景和湖景。

sentences.en: It is important to consider the customer's point of view when designing a new product.
sentences.zh: 設計新產品時，考慮顧客的觀點很重要。

sentences.en: In my view, we should spend more of our budget on training rather than on advertising.
sentences.zh: 依我看，我們應該把更多預算花在訓練而不是廣告上。

sentences.en: The restaurant on the twentieth floor offers a stunning view of the city, especially at night.
sentences.zh: 二十樓的餐廳可以看到城市的絕美景色，尤其是晚上。

sentences.en: Guests who book a room with a view of the harbor must pay an extra twenty dollars per night.
sentences.zh: 預訂港景房的客人每晚要多付二十美元。

words.note: 語塊：a view of（……的景色）、point of view（觀點）、in my view（依我看）。view 可以是「景色」，也可以是「看法」；review 是「評論、審查」。

sentences.en: Many small bookshops may disappear from the city center as more people buy books online.
sentences.zh: 隨著越來越多人在網路上買書，很多小書店可能會從市中心消失。

sentences.en: Traditional crafts could slowly disappear if young people are not encouraged to learn them at school.
sentences.zh: 如果不鼓勵年輕人學習，傳統工藝可能會慢慢消失。

sentences.en: The problem with the screen did not disappear after the update, so the technician replaced the part.
sentences.zh: 更新後螢幕的問題沒有消失，所以技師換掉了零件。

sentences.en: The company hopes that the long lines at the counter will disappear once the new online system is introduced.
sentences.zh: 公司希望新的線上系統啟用後，櫃台前的長龍就會消失。

sentences.en: Experts warn that some fish species could disappear from the lake because of pollution from factories.
sentences.zh: 專家警告，因為工廠的污染，有些魚類可能會從湖裡消失。

words.note: 語塊：disappear from（從……消失）、slowly disappear（慢慢消失）。disappear 是「消失」；appear 是「出現」；disappoint（使失望）長得像。

sentences.en: The government plans to build a power plant that will provide electricity to more than one million homes.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫興建一座能為一百多萬戶供電的發電廠。

sentences.en: The new solar power plant in the desert is the largest of its kind in the country.
sentences.zh: 沙漠裡的新太陽能發電廠是國內同類型中最大的。

sentences.en: Residents held a meeting to discuss their concerns about the nuclear power plant near the coast.
sentences.zh: 居民開會討論他們對海岸附近那座核電廠的擔憂。

sentences.en: Engineers at the power plant work in shifts to make sure the machines run safely day and night.
sentences.zh: 發電廠的工程師輪班工作，確保機器日夜都安全運轉。

sentences.en: The company won a contract to build a solar power plant that will reduce the city's use of coal.
sentences.zh: 那家公司拿到興建一座太陽能發電廠的合約，可以減少城市的燃煤使用。

words.note: 語塊：nuclear power plant（核電廠）、solar power plant（太陽能發電廠）、build a power plant（興建發電廠）。plant 在這裡是「工廠」；power plant 也可以叫 power station。

sentences.en: The water level in the reservoir has dropped because there has been very little rain this year.
sentences.zh: 因為今年雨很少，水庫的水位下降了。

sentences.en: The city plans to build a new water reservoir to meet the needs of its growing population.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫興建一座新水庫，滿足日益增加的人口需求。

sentences.en: Visitors can walk or ride bicycles along the path that goes around the reservoir on weekends.
sentences.zh: 週末遊客可以沿著環繞水庫的步道散步或騎腳踏車。

sentences.en: The university is a reservoir of talent that local technology companies rely on when hiring engineers.
sentences.zh: 那所大學是當地科技公司招聘工程師時所依賴的人才庫。

sentences.en: Swimming is not allowed in the water reservoir because it supplies drinking water to the entire region.
sentences.zh: 水庫禁止游泳，因為它供應整個地區的飲用水。

words.note: 語塊：water reservoir（水庫）、reservoir of（……的儲備）。reservoir 是「水庫」，也可以比喻「大量的儲備」（a reservoir of talent 人才庫）。

sentences.en: The new stadium has started to take shape, and the outside walls are almost finished.
sentences.zh: 新體育場已經開始成形，外牆幾乎完工了。

sentences.en: Plans for the company's expansion into Europe will begin to take shape after the meeting with investors.
sentences.zh: 和投資人開會後，公司進軍歐洲的計畫將開始具體化。

sentences.en: As the design of the website begins to take shape, the team will ask customers for their opinions.
sentences.zh: 網站設計開始成形時，團隊會徵詢顧客的意見。

sentences.en: It may take several months for the ideas discussed at the workshop to take shape as real projects.
sentences.zh: 工作坊中討論的點子可能要幾個月才會成形為真正的專案。

sentences.en: The new shopping district will take shape over the next three years as more stores and restaurants open.
sentences.zh: 隨著更多商店和餐廳開幕，新的購物區將在未來三年內逐漸成形。

words.note: 語塊：begin to take shape（開始成形）、take shape as（成形為……）、take shape over（在……期間逐漸成形）。take shape 是「慢慢變得具體、成形」；take place 是「發生、舉行」，別搞混。

sentences.en: Applicants for the scholarship must have a grade point average of at least 3.5 out of 4.0.
sentences.zh: 獎學金申請人的平均成績必須至少達到 4.0 中的 3.5。

sentences.en: The company prefers to hire graduates with a high grade point average and some work experience.
sentences.zh: 公司偏好聘用平均成績高、又有些工作經驗的畢業生。

sentences.en: Students who fall below the minimum grade point average will not be allowed to join the exchange program.
sentences.zh: 低於最低平均成績的學生不能參加交換計畫。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin included her grade point average on her résumé because it was one of the highest in her class.
sentences.zh: 林小姐在履歷上寫了她的平均成績，因為那是班上最高的之一。

sentences.en: Some employers care more about practical skills than about a student's grade point average at university.
sentences.zh: 有些雇主比較在意實務技能，而不是學生的平均成績。

words.note: 語塊：a high grade point average（高 GPA）、minimum grade point average（最低平均成績）。grade point average 常縮寫為 GPA，是美國學校計算成績的方式。

sentences.en: The company will cover food and lodging for all employees who attend the conference in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 公司會負擔所有參加東京研討會員工的食宿。

sentences.en: The farm offers simple lodging for volunteers who help with the harvest during the autumn.
sentences.zh: 那座農場為秋天幫忙收成的志工提供簡單的住宿。

sentences.en: Please keep your receipts so that the company can reimburse your lodging expenses after the trip.
sentences.zh: 請保留收據，讓公司在出差後補助你的住宿費。

sentences.en: The tour price includes lodging at four-star hotels, breakfast every day, and transportation between cities.
sentences.zh: 行程價格包含四星級飯店的住宿、每天早餐和城市間的交通。

sentences.en: The town has limited lodging, so visitors to the festival should book their rooms several months ahead.
sentences.zh: 那個小鎮住宿有限，所以要參加慶典的遊客應該提前幾個月訂房。

words.note: 語塊：food and lodging（食宿）、provide lodging（提供住宿）、lodging expenses（住宿費）、limited lodging（住宿有限）。lodging 是「住宿」，常用在出差、旅遊；accommodation 意思相同。

sentences.en: Customers trust our brand because we have provided reliable products for more than fifty years.
sentences.zh: 顧客信任我們的品牌，因為我們五十多年來一直提供可靠的產品。

sentences.en: The manager will trust you with the important client account if you do well on this project.
sentences.zh: 如果你這個專案做得好，經理會把那個重要客戶交給你負責。

sentences.en: We trust that you will find our services useful and look forward to working with you.
sentences.zh: 我們相信您會覺得我們的服務很有用，期待和您合作。

sentences.en: It takes time for new employees to trust their colleagues and feel comfortable sharing ideas.
sentences.zh: 新員工需要時間才能信任同事，並自在地分享想法。

sentences.en: Many people trust online reviews more than advertisements when they choose a restaurant or hotel.
sentences.zh: 很多人在選餐廳或飯店時，比較相信網路評論而不是廣告。

words.note: 語塊：trust sb with sth（把某事託付給某人）、trust that（相信……）。trust 是「信任某人或某事」；believe 偏「相信某說法是真的」。名詞 trust 是「信任」。

sentences.en: The hotel needs to recruit staff quickly because the busy summer season begins in only one month.
sentences.zh: 飯店需要快速招募員工，因為忙碌的夏季再一個月就開始了。

sentences.en: The charity plans to recruit volunteers from local schools to help clean the beach in September.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善團體計畫從當地學校招募志工，九月時幫忙清理海灘。

sentences.en: Technology companies actively recruit graduates from the top engineering schools in the country every spring.
sentences.zh: 科技公司積極招募國內頂尖工程學院的畢業生。

sentences.en: It has become more difficult to recruit staff with the right skills for our factory in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 要為我們鄉下的工廠招募具備合適技能的員工變得更困難了。

sentences.en: The team will recruit two new designers to help with the growing number of projects this year.
sentences.zh: 團隊會招募兩名新設計師，協助處理今年越來越多的專案。

words.note: 語塊：recruit staff（招募員工）、recruit volunteers（招募志工）、actively recruit（積極招募）。recruit 是動詞「招募」，也可以當名詞「新人」；recruiter 是「招募人員」。

sentences.en: Please list the items you need for the event and send them to the office manager by Friday.
sentences.zh: 請列出活動需要的物品，並在週五前寄給辦公室經理。

sentences.en: The menu will list every ingredient used in each dish so that customers with allergies can choose safely.
sentences.zh: 菜單會列出每道菜使用的所有食材，讓過敏的顧客可以安心選擇。

sentences.en: The new catalog will list the items in order of price, from the cheapest to the most expensive.
sentences.zh: 新目錄會依價格順序列出商品，從最便宜到最貴。

sentences.en: The report will list the main reasons why customers stopped using our service last year.
sentences.zh: 報告會列出顧客去年停止使用我們服務的主要原因。

sentences.en: Applicants should list their previous jobs in order, starting with the most recent position they held.
sentences.zh: 應徵者應該依序列出以前的工作，從最近的職位開始。

words.note: 語塊：list the items（列出品項）、be listed on（被列在……上）、list in order（依序列出）。list 當動詞是「列出」；當名詞是「清單」。listing 是「列表；上市」。

sentences.en: All new employees must read and sign the company's code of conduct during their first week.
sentences.zh: 所有新員工都必須在第一週閱讀並簽署公司的行為準則。

sentences.en: Staff who violate the code of conduct may receive a warning or lose their jobs.
sentences.zh: 違反行為準則的員工可能會被警告或丟掉工作。

sentences.en: Everyone at the conference is expected to follow the code of conduct and treat other attendees with respect.
sentences.zh: 研討會上的每個人都應該遵守行為準則，尊重其他與會者。

sentences.en: The code of conduct explains how employees should behave when they meet with clients and suppliers.
sentences.zh: 行為準則說明員工和客戶及供應商見面時應該怎麼做。

sentences.en: The company updated its code of conduct to include new rules about the use of social media.
sentences.zh: 公司更新了行為準則，加入關於使用社群媒體的新規定。

words.note: 語塊：follow the code of conduct（遵守行為準則）、violate the code of conduct（違反行為準則）、the company's code of conduct（公司的行為準則）。code of conduct 是公司或組織的「行為守則」；dress code 是「服裝規定」。

sentences.en: All employees must adhere to the rules regarding safety equipment while they are in the factory.
sentences.zh: 所有員工在工廠內都必須遵守安全裝備的相關規定。

sentences.en: Restaurants must strictly adhere to the guidelines for food storage set by the health department.
sentences.zh: 餐廳必須嚴格遵守衛生局制定的食物保存準則。

sentences.en: Contractors who do not adhere to the guidelines may not be hired for future projects.
sentences.zh: 不遵守準則的承包商以後的專案可能不會被聘用。

sentences.en: The company expects its suppliers to adhere to the same environmental standards that it follows.
sentences.zh: 公司期待供應商遵守和公司相同的環保標準。

sentences.en: Pilots must strictly adhere to the procedures in the manual, especially during takeoff and landing.
sentences.zh: 飛行員必須嚴格遵守手冊上的程序，尤其是在起飛和降落時。

words.note: 語塊：adhere to the rules（遵守規則）、adhere to the guidelines（遵守準則）、strictly adhere to（嚴格遵守）。adhere to 比 follow、stick to 正式；名詞是 adherence。

sentences.en: The store hired several temporary workers to help with the busy holiday shopping season in December.
sentences.zh: 那家店聘了好幾名臨時工協助節慶購物季。

sentences.en: Ms. Rossi accepted a temporary position at the bank while she was looking for a full-time job.
sentences.zh: Rossi 小姐在找全職工作期間接受了銀行的一個臨時職位。

sentences.en: The museum announced the temporary closure of its west wing while the old roof is being repaired.
sentences.zh: 博物館宣布舊屋頂修繕期間，西翼將暫時關閉。

sentences.en: The office will move to a temporary location downtown until the renovation is finished in March.
sentences.zh: 辦公室會暫時搬到市中心的地點，直到三月翻修完成。

sentences.en: A temporary bridge was built so that cars could cross the river while the main bridge was closed.
sentences.zh: 為了讓車子在主橋封閉期間能過河，搭建了一座臨時橋。

words.note: 語塊：temporary position（臨時職位）、temporary closure（暫時關閉）、temporary worker（臨時工）。temporary 是「暫時的」；permanent 是「永久的」；contemporary（當代的）長得像。

sentences.en: The new software will help us streamline the process of ordering supplies for all of our stores.
sentences.zh: 新軟體會幫助我們簡化所有門市訂購用品的流程。

sentences.en: The company plans to streamline operations by combining the sales and marketing departments next year.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫明年合併業務部和行銷部來精簡營運。

sentences.en: To streamline the process of hiring, applicants can now upload their documents directly to our website.
sentences.zh: 為了簡化招聘流程，應徵者現在可以直接把文件上傳到我們網站。

sentences.en: The consultant recommended several ways to streamline operations at the warehouse and reduce delays in shipping.
sentences.zh: 顧問建議了幾種精簡倉庫營運、減少延誤的方法。

sentences.en: The bank hopes to streamline the loan application so that customers receive an answer within one day.
sentences.zh: 銀行希望簡化貸款申請流程，讓顧客在一天內得到答覆。

words.note: 語塊：streamline the process（簡化流程）、streamline operations（精簡營運）。streamline 是「讓流程更簡單、更有效率」；simplify 意思接近。

sentences.en: Our new website is much easier to navigate, so customers can find products in just a few clicks.
sentences.zh: 我們的新網站更容易瀏覽，顧客點幾下就能找到產品。

sentences.en: Visitors can use the free app to navigate through the large museum and find each exhibit quickly.
sentences.zh: 訪客可以用免費 App 在大型博物館中導覽，快速找到每個展品。

sentences.en: The training session will teach new employees how to navigate the company's online system for booking meeting rooms.
sentences.zh: 訓練課程會教新員工如何操作公司的線上系統。

sentences.en: Small businesses often hire accountants to help them navigate the complicated tax rules each year.
sentences.zh: 小公司常常聘請會計師幫他們應付每年複雜的稅務規定。

sentences.en: The map in the lobby helps guests navigate through the hotel, which has three separate buildings.
sentences.zh: 大廳的地圖幫助客人在有三棟獨立建築的飯店裡找路。

words.note: 語塊：navigate the website（瀏覽網站）、navigate through（穿過……）、easy to navigate（容易使用）。navigate 原本是「導航」，也用在「操作網站」或「應付困難」；navigation 是名詞。

sentences.en: The coffee chain will raise prices by ten percent next month because of the rising cost of coffee beans.
sentences.zh: 因為咖啡豆成本上升，那家咖啡連鎖店下個月將漲價一成。

sentences.en: The charity event helped raise money for several children's hospitals in the region last year.
sentences.zh: 那場慈善活動幫該地區的兒童醫院募到了錢。

sentences.en: If you would like to raise a question during the meeting, please wait until the presentation is finished.
sentences.zh: 如果你想在會議中提出問題，請等簡報結束後再提。

sentences.en: The school plans to raise funds to build a new library by holding a concert in the spring.
sentences.zh: 學校計畫在春天舉辦音樂會，為興建新圖書館籌募經費。

sentences.en: Several employees decided to raise a question about the new vacation policy at the staff meeting.
sentences.zh: 幾位員工決定在員工會議上對新的休假規定提出問題。

words.note: 語塊：raise prices（漲價）、raise money（募款）、raise a question（提出問題）。raise 是及物動詞「把……提高」；rise 是不及物動詞「（自己）上升」。

sentences.en: The storm damaged several roads, and as a result, many employees could not get to work on time.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨損壞了幾條道路，因此很多員工無法準時上班。

sentences.en: As a result of the new marketing campaign, online sales increased by thirty percent in two months.
sentences.zh: 由於新的行銷活動，網路銷售在兩個月內增加了三成。

sentences.en: The result of the customer survey will be shared with all department managers next week.
sentences.zh: 顧客調查的結果會在下週分享給所有部門經理。

sentences.en: The delay was the result of a problem with the computer system at the shipping company.
sentences.zh: 延誤是貨運公司電腦系統出問題的結果。

sentences.en: Our profits fell last quarter as a result of higher material costs and lower demand.
sentences.zh: 由於材料成本上升和需求下降，我們上一季的獲利下滑。

words.note: 語塊：as a result（因此）、as a result of（由於……）、the result of（……的結果）。as a result 放句首表示「因此」；result in 是動詞片語「導致」。

sentences.en: Employees are not allowed to use their personal phones for long periods while they are at work.
sentences.zh: 員工在工作中不可以長時間使用私人手機。

sentences.en: Please check your work schedule for next month, which has been posted on the bulletin board.
sentences.zh: 請查看下個月的工作時程表，已經貼在公告欄上了。

sentences.en: The painting in the hotel lobby is a work of art by a famous local artist from the nineteenth century.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳的那幅畫是一位十九世紀當地知名藝術家的作品。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim has a lot of work to finish before the end of the quarter, so she will stay late this week.
sentences.zh: 金小姐在季末前有很多工作要完成，所以這週會留得比較晚。

sentences.en: Changes to your work schedule must be approved by your supervisor at least one week in advance.
sentences.zh: 工作時程的更改必須至少提前一週經主管核准。

words.note: 語塊：at work（在工作中）、work schedule（工作時程）、a work of art（藝術作品）。work 當「工作」時是不可數名詞（a lot of work）；當「作品」時可數（works of art）。job 是可數的「一份工作」。

sentences.en: Customers can place an order online or by phone, and most items will be delivered within two days.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在網路上或打電話下訂單，大部分商品兩天內送達。

sentences.en: The elevator on the east side of the building is out of order, so please use the stairs today.
sentences.zh: 大樓東側的電梯故障了，所以今天請走樓梯。

sentences.en: In order to reduce waste, the cafeteria no longer provides plastic forks, spoons, or cups to employees.
sentences.zh: 為了減少浪費，員工餐廳不再提供塑膠叉子和湯匙。

sentences.en: If you place an order of more than one hundred dollars, shipping will be free of charge.
sentences.zh: 如果你下單超過一百美元，就免運費。

sentences.en: The documents should be arranged in order of date, with the most recent ones on top.
sentences.zh: 文件應該按日期順序排列，最新的放在最上面。

words.note: 語塊：place an order（下訂單）、in order to（為了）、out of order（故障）。order 可以指「訂單」、「順序」或「命令」；out of order 是「故障」；in order to 是「為了」。

sentences.en: The manager clearly explained the new procedures so that everyone on the team understood what to do.
sentences.zh: 經理清楚說明了新程序，讓每個人都知道該怎麼做。

sentences.en: All emergency exits in the building are clearly marked with green signs above the doors.
sentences.zh: 大樓所有的緊急出口都在門上方用綠色標誌清楚標示。

sentences.en: The contract should clearly state the price, the delivery date, and the terms of payment.
sentences.zh: 合約應明確寫出價格、交貨日期和付款條件。

sentences.en: The new product was clearly a success, as it sold out within the first week of its launch.
sentences.zh: 新產品顯然很成功，上市第一週就賣光了。

sentences.en: Please write your name and address clearly on the form so that we can send you the package.
sentences.zh: 請在表格上清楚寫下你的姓名和地址，讓我們可以把包裹寄給你。

words.note: 語塊：clearly explain（清楚說明）、clearly marked（標示清楚）、clearly state（明確表示）。clearly 可以是「清楚地」，也可以表示「顯然」；clarity 是名詞「清晰」。

sentences.en: The courier will deliver a package to your office between ten and twelve o'clock tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 快遞明天早上十點到十二點之間會送一個包裹到你的辦公室。

sentences.en: The travel agency is offering a vacation package that includes flights, hotels, and meals for one price.
sentences.zh: 旅行社推出一個度假套裝行程，一個價格就包含機票、飯店和餐點。

sentences.en: The company's benefits package includes health insurance, paid vacation, and a generous retirement plan for all staff.
sentences.zh: 公司的福利方案包括健康保險、帶薪休假和退休金計畫。

sentences.en: If you are not at home, the driver will leave the package with a neighbor or at the post office.
sentences.zh: 如果你不在家，司機會把包裹交給鄰居或留在郵局。

sentences.en: Our hotel offers a special package for couples that includes dinner and a spa treatment.
sentences.zh: 我們飯店提供情侶專屬套裝方案，包含晚餐和一次水療。

words.note: 語塊：deliver a package（遞送包裹）、vacation package（度假套裝行程）、benefits package（福利方案）。package 可以是「包裹」，也可以是「套裝方案」；packaging 是「包裝（材料）」。

sentences.en: The new machines will hasten the process of packaging and shipping our products to customers.
sentences.zh: 新機器會加速我們包裝和寄送產品給顧客的流程。

sentences.en: The manager praised the team's work but hastened to add that there was still a lot to do, so we must hasten our efforts.
sentences.zh: 經理稱讚了團隊的工作，但趕緊補充說還有很多事要做，所以我們必須加快腳步。

sentences.en: Hiring more staff could hasten the completion of the project, but it would also increase costs.
sentences.zh: 增聘人手可以加快專案完成，但也會增加成本。

sentences.en: The government hopes the new law will hasten the development of clean energy across the country.
sentences.zh: 政府希望新法律能加速全國潔淨能源的發展。

sentences.en: To hasten the process, please send all of the required documents by email rather than by mail.
sentences.zh: 為了加快流程，請用電子郵件而不是郵寄方式傳送所有必要文件。

words.note: 語塊：hasten the process（加速流程）、hasten to add（趕緊補充）。hasten 比 speed up、hurry 正式；haste 是名詞「匆忙」。

sentences.en: The two companies will sign a contract next week to work together on the new shopping center.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司下週會簽約，合作興建新的購物中心。

sentences.en: The cleaning company hopes to renew its contract with the hospital for another three years.
sentences.zh: 那家清潔公司希望和醫院再續約三年。

sentences.en: Please read the terms of the contract carefully before you sign it and return it to our office.
sentences.zh: 簽名並寄回我們辦公室之前，請仔細閱讀合約條款。

sentences.en: The supplier broke the contract by delivering the parts two months later than the agreed date.
sentences.zh: 供應商比約定日期晚兩個月交付零件，違反了合約。

sentences.en: Ms. Ortiz was offered a one-year contract with the option to renew it if her performance is good.
sentences.zh: Ortiz 小姐獲得一份一年的合約，如果表現好可以選擇續約。

words.note: 語塊：sign a contract（簽約）、renew a contract（續約）、terms of the contract（合約條款）。contract 當名詞重音在前（CON-tract）是「合約」；當動詞重音在後（con-TRACT）是「收縮；感染」。

sentences.en: The position offers an annual salary of sixty thousand dollars plus a bonus based on performance.
sentences.zh: 這個職位提供六萬美元的年薪，外加依績效計算的獎金。

sentences.en: The starting salary for new engineers at the company is higher than the average in the industry.
sentences.zh: 公司新進工程師的起薪比業界平均還高。

sentences.en: All employees will receive a salary increase of three percent at the beginning of next year.
sentences.zh: 所有員工明年初都會加薪百分之三。

sentences.en: Ms. Bell negotiated a higher starting salary because she had several years of experience abroad.
sentences.zh: Bell 小姐因為有好幾年的海外經驗，談到了比較高的起薪。

sentences.en: Your salary will be paid into your bank account on the twenty-fifth day of each month.
sentences.zh: 你的薪水會在每個月二十五日匯入你的銀行帳戶。

words.note: 語塊：annual salary（年薪）、starting salary（起薪）、salary increase（加薪）。salary 是固定的「月薪、年薪」；wage 多指按時計算的「工資」。

sentences.en: The company offers a competitive benefits package that includes health insurance and free gym membership.
sentences.zh: 公司提供具競爭力的福利方案，包括健康保險和免費健身房會員。

sentences.en: Many applicants were attracted by the comprehensive benefits package, which includes four weeks of paid vacation.
sentences.zh: 很多應徵者被完善的福利方案吸引，其中包括四週的帶薪休假。

sentences.en: Details about the benefits package will be explained by the human resources manager during orientation.
sentences.zh: 福利方案的細節會由人資經理在新人說明會上解釋。

sentences.en: A competitive benefits package helps companies attract and keep talented employees for a long time.
sentences.zh: 具競爭力的福利方案能幫助公司長期留住有才能的員工。

sentences.en: The new benefits package also provides financial support for employees who want to continue their education.
sentences.zh: 新的福利方案也為想繼續進修的員工提供經費補助。

words.note: 語塊：competitive benefits package（具競爭力的福利）、comprehensive benefits package（完善的福利方案）。benefits package 指薪水以外的「整套福利」，例如保險、休假、退休金。

sentences.en: The instructions for the new machine are somewhat difficult to understand, so we will provide training.
sentences.zh: 新機器的說明有點難懂，所以我們會提供訓練。

sentences.en: Prices at the new supermarket are somewhat higher than those at the store across the street.
sentences.zh: 新超市的價格比對街那家店稍微高一點。

sentences.en: Sales were somewhat lower than expected in the first quarter, but they improved in April.
sentences.zh: 第一季的銷售比預期稍微低一點，但四月就改善了。

sentences.en: The hotel rooms are somewhat small, but they are clean, quiet, and close to the train station.
sentences.zh: 飯店房間有點小，但很乾淨、安靜，而且離火車站很近。

sentences.en: The weather was somewhat cooler than usual, so fewer people visited the beach last weekend.
sentences.zh: 天氣比平常稍微涼一點，所以上週末去海灘的人比較少。

words.note: 語塊：somewhat difficult（有點困難）、somewhat higher（稍微高一點）、somewhat lower（稍微低一點）。somewhat 比 a little、slightly 正式，用來修飾形容詞或副詞。

sentences.en: Many people consider the new museum one of the most beautiful buildings in the city.
sentences.zh: 很多人認為新博物館是城裡最美的建築之一。

sentences.en: The company will consider opening a second factory if demand continues to grow next year.
sentences.zh: 如果明年需求持續成長，公司會考慮開設第二座工廠。

sentences.en: We consider customer satisfaction as the most important measure of our success as a company.
sentences.zh: 我們把顧客滿意度視為衡量我們成功最重要的指標。

sentences.en: Please consider all of the options carefully before you make a final decision about the contract.
sentences.zh: 在對合約做最後決定之前，請仔細考慮所有選項。

sentences.en: Ms. Torres would consider moving to the Seoul office if the company offered her a management position.
sentences.zh: 如果公司提供管理職，Torres 小姐會考慮調到首爾辦公室。

words.note: 語塊：consider sth as（把某事視為……）、consider opening（考慮開設）、consider moving（考慮搬到）、consider all of the options（考慮所有選項）。consider 後面接動名詞（consider moving），不接 to do；consideration 是名詞。

sentences.en: Wearing a helmet can prevent serious injuries while you are working on the construction site.
sentences.zh: 在工地工作時戴安全帽可以預防嚴重受傷。

sentences.en: Regular maintenance will prevent the machines from breaking down during the busy holiday season in December.
sentences.zh: 定期維修會防止機器在旺季時故障。

sentences.en: The new software is designed to prevent hackers from stealing customer information stored on our servers.
sentences.zh: 新軟體的設計是為了防止駭客竊取顧客資料。

sentences.en: To prevent accidents, all employees must complete safety training before they use the heavy equipment.
sentences.zh: 為了預防意外，所有員工都必須完成安全訓練才能使用設備。

sentences.en: Covering the furniture with plastic sheets will prevent damage while the walls are being painted.
sentences.zh: 牆壁油漆時，用塑膠布蓋住家具可以防止損壞。

words.note: 語塊：prevent sth from（防止某物……）、prevent accidents（預防意外）、prevent damage（防止損害）。prevent A from doing 是「阻止 A 做某事」；protect 是「保護」。

sentences.en: The internship gave Ms. Chen valuable experience in marketing, sales, and customer service at a large firm.
sentences.zh: 實習讓陳小姐在行銷和客服方面得到寶貴的經驗。

sentences.en: The survey provided valuable information about what customers want from our new product and its price.
sentences.zh: 調查提供了關於顧客想從新產品得到什麼的寶貴資訊。

sentences.en: Experienced employees are a valuable asset to any company, so we try hard to keep them.
sentences.zh: 有經驗的員工是任何公司的寶貴資產，所以我們很努力留住他們。

sentences.en: Please keep your valuable items in the safe in your hotel room while you are out.
sentences.zh: 外出時，請把貴重物品放在飯店房間的保險箱裡。

sentences.en: Working abroad for two years was valuable experience that helped him get his current job.
sentences.zh: 在國外工作兩年是寶貴的經驗，幫助他得到現在的工作。

words.note: 語塊：valuable experience（寶貴的經驗）、valuable information（有價值的資訊）、valuable asset（寶貴的資產）。valuable 是「很有價值」；invaluable 是「非常寶貴、無價的」（不是沒價值）；valueless 才是「沒價值」。

words.meaning: 佔用（時間、空間）；開始從事

sentences.en: The old filing cabinets take up too much space, so we plan to store our documents online.
sentences.zh: 舊的檔案櫃太佔空間，所以我們打算把文件存在網路上。

sentences.en: Long meetings take up time that employees could use to complete more important tasks each day.
sentences.zh: 冗長的會議佔用了員工可以用來完成更重要工作的時間。

sentences.en: Many employees decided to take up yoga after the company opened a small fitness room.
sentences.zh: 公司開了一間小健身房後，很多員工決定開始練瑜伽。

sentences.en: The new printer is small enough that it will not take up much space on your desk.
sentences.zh: 新印表機夠小，不會佔用你桌上太多空間。

sentences.en: Mr. Diaz plans to take up painting as a hobby after he retires from the bank next year.
sentences.zh: Diaz 先生打算明年從銀行退休後，開始把畫畫當成嗜好。

words.note: 語塊：take up space（佔空間）、take up time（佔時間）、take up a hobby（開始一項嗜好）。take up 可以是「佔用」，也可以是「開始學、開始從事」；take over 是「接管」。

sentences.en: Please send me the list of guests for the upcoming event by the end of this week.
sentences.zh: 請在這週結束前把即將舉行活動的賓客名單寄給我。

sentences.en: The agenda for the upcoming meeting will be emailed to all participants on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 即將召開會議的議程會在週一早上寄給所有與會者。

sentences.en: Stores are hiring extra staff to prepare for the upcoming holiday season, which is always very busy.
sentences.zh: 商店正在增聘人手，準備即將到來的節慶季。

sentences.en: The director will announce the dates of the upcoming training sessions at the next staff meeting.
sentences.zh: 主任會在下次員工會議上宣布即將舉行的訓練課程日期。

sentences.en: Tickets for the upcoming concert sold out within an hour of going on sale online.
sentences.zh: 即將舉行的演唱會門票在網路開賣一小時內就賣光了。

words.note: 語塊：upcoming event（即將舉行的活動）、upcoming meeting（即將召開的會議）、upcoming season（即將到來的季節）。upcoming 是「即將發生的」；forthcoming 意思接近，比較正式。

sentences.en: The department store is hiring a part-time sales associate to work on weekends and holidays.
sentences.zh: 百貨公司正在招聘一名週末和假日上班的兼職店員。

sentences.en: An experienced sales associate can help customers choose the right size and style of shoes.
sentences.zh: 資深銷售員可以幫顧客挑選合適尺寸和款式的鞋子。

sentences.en: Each sales associate receives a small bonus for every customer who signs up for a store credit card.
sentences.zh: 每位店員每讓一位顧客辦店內信用卡，就能拿到一小筆獎金。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz started as a part-time sales associate and became the store manager five years later.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐從兼職店員做起，五年後成為店長。

sentences.en: Please ask a sales associate if you need help finding a product or checking the price.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要幫忙找商品或查價格，請詢問店員。

words.note: 語塊：part-time sales associate（兼職店員）、experienced sales associate（資深銷售員）。sales associate 是「店員、銷售人員」的正式說法；salesperson、sales clerk 意思相同。

sentences.en: The company hired a new manager to improve customer relations after receiving many complaints last year.
sentences.zh: 公司接到很多投訴後，聘請了一位新經理來改善顧客關係。

sentences.en: Please contact the customer relations department if you have any questions about your order or delivery.
sentences.zh: 如果你對訂單有任何問題，請聯絡客戶關係部。

sentences.en: Good customer relations are important for small businesses that depend on regular customers for most of their sales.
sentences.zh: 良好的顧客關係對依賴常客的小商家來說很重要。

sentences.en: The training program focuses on communication skills that help staff improve customer relations in every store.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫著重於幫助員工改善顧客關係的溝通技巧。

sentences.en: Ms. Park has worked in the customer relations department for ten years and knows many of our clients.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐在客戶關係部工作了十年，認識我們很多客戶。

words.note: 語塊：improve customer relations（改善顧客關係）、customer relations department（客戶關係部）。customer relations 是公司和顧客之間的關係管理；customer service 是「客服」，兩者常一起出現。

sentences.en: We truly appreciate your patience while our team works to solve the problem with your account.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊處理您帳戶的問題期間，真心感謝您的耐心。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a truly unique experience, with rooms built inside the trees of an old forest.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店提供真正獨特的體驗，房間就蓋在古老森林的樹上。

sentences.en: The new product is truly different from anything else on the market, which is why it sells so well.
sentences.zh: 這款新產品和市場上其他產品真的很不一樣，所以賣得這麼好。

sentences.en: Our staff truly appreciate the support that customers have shown during the renovation of the store.
sentences.zh: 我們的員工真心感謝顧客在店面整修期間給予的支持。

sentences.en: The view from the mountain top is truly unique, especially in the early morning when the sun rises.
sentences.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色真的很獨特，尤其是太陽升起的清晨。

words.note: 語塊：truly appreciate（真心感謝）、truly unique（真正獨特的）、Yours truly（敬上）。truly 是 true 的副詞，注意沒有 e；Yours truly 是書信結尾用語。

sentences.en: Customers can withdraw money from any of our machines without paying an extra fee at any time.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在我們任何一台機器提款，不用付額外手續費。

sentences.en: The company decided to withdraw from the project after the costs became much higher than expected.
sentences.zh: 成本變得比預期高很多之後，公司決定退出這個專案。

sentences.en: The client may withdraw the offer if we cannot agree on the price by the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 如果我們在週末前無法談妥價格，客戶可能會撤回提議。

sentences.en: Several runners had to withdraw from the race because of the extremely hot weather on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 好幾位跑者因為週日天氣極度炎熱而退出比賽。

sentences.en: You will need your bank card and your password to withdraw money at the airport machine.
sentences.zh: 在機場的機器提款需要你的金融卡和密碼。

words.note: 語塊：withdraw money（提款）、withdraw from（退出……）、withdraw an offer（撤回提議）。withdraw 可以是「提領（錢）」或「撤回、退出」；名詞是 withdrawal。

sentences.en: All full-time employees receive fifteen days of paid vacation each year, as well as national holidays.
sentences.zh: 所有全職員工每年都有十五天帶薪休假，加上國定假日。

sentences.en: New parents at the company can take up to six months of paid leave after their baby is born.
sentences.zh: 公司的新手爸媽在寶寶出生後最多可以請六個月的有薪假。

sentences.en: A paid membership gives users access to all of the videos on our website without any advertisements.
sentences.zh: 付費會員可以觀看我們網站上所有的影片，沒有任何廣告。

sentences.en: Employees who need paid leave for medical reasons should submit a note from their doctor.
sentences.zh: 因醫療原因需要請有薪假的員工，應該提交醫生證明。

sentences.en: The company increased paid vacation for staff who have worked there for more than five years.
sentences.zh: 公司為工作超過五年的員工增加了帶薪休假天數。

words.note: 語塊：paid vacation（帶薪休假）、paid leave（有薪假）、paid membership（付費會員）。paid 是「有薪的；已付款的」；unpaid 是「無薪的；未付的」。

sentences.en: Mr. Evans has worked in broadcasting for twenty years, first in radio and later in television.
sentences.zh: Evans 先生在廣播電視業工作了二十年，先是廣播，後來是電視。

sentences.en: The broadcasting company paid a large amount of money for the rights to show the football games.
sentences.zh: 那家廣播公司付了一大筆錢買足球比賽的轉播權。

sentences.en: The network bought the broadcasting rights to the international tennis tournament for the next five years.
sentences.zh: 那家電視網買下了這個錦標賽未來五年的轉播權。

sentences.en: Students in the broadcasting program learn how to produce news reports and interview guests in a real studio.
sentences.zh: 廣播學程的學生學習如何製作新聞報導和訪問來賓。

sentences.en: The government plans to update the rules for broadcasting companies to include online video services.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫更新廣播公司的規定，把線上影音服務也納入。

words.note: 語塊：broadcasting company（廣播公司）、broadcasting rights（轉播權）。broadcasting 是「廣播、電視播送（產業）」；broadcast 是動詞或「節目」。

sentences.en: The increase in online orders is a sign of the growing popularity of our new product line.
sentences.zh: 網路訂單增加是我們新產品線越來越受歡迎的跡象。

sentences.en: Please follow the warning sign and do not enter the area while the floor is being cleaned.
sentences.zh: 請遵守警告標誌，地板清潔期間不要進入該區域。

sentences.en: The store owner will put up a sign in the window to tell customers about the summer sale.
sentences.zh: 店主會在櫥窗掛上招牌，告訴顧客夏季特賣的消息。

sentences.en: Rising house prices may be a sign of a strong economy, but they also make it hard to buy a home.
sentences.zh: 房價上漲可能是經濟強勁的跡象，但也讓人很難買房子。

sentences.en: Drivers should slow down when they see the warning sign near the entrance of the elementary school.
sentences.zh: 駕駛看到學校入口附近的警告標誌時應該減速。

words.note: 語塊：a sign of（……的跡象）、warning sign（警告標誌）、put up a sign（掛上招牌）。sign 可以是「標誌、招牌」，也可以是「跡象」；當動詞是「簽名」；signature 是「簽名（名詞）」。

sentences.en: The bank wants to simplify the process of opening an account so that it can be done in ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 銀行想簡化開戶流程，讓它十分鐘就能完成。

sentences.en: The government plans to simplify the tax form to make it easier for small business owners.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫簡化報稅表，讓小企業老闆更容易填寫。

sentences.en: We need to simplify the instructions because many customers say they find them confusing and too long.
sentences.zh: 我們需要簡化說明，因為很多顧客覺得很難懂。

sentences.en: The new software will simplify the process of tracking orders from the warehouse to the customer.
sentences.zh: 新軟體會簡化從倉庫到顧客之間追蹤訂單的流程。

sentences.en: To simplify the form, the hospital removed several questions that were not really necessary for new patients.
sentences.zh: 為了簡化表格，醫院刪掉了幾個其實不必要的問題。

words.note: 語塊：simplify the process（簡化流程）、simplify the form（簡化表格）。simplify 是「變簡單」；streamline 偏「讓流程更有效率」。名詞是 simplification。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a fast internet connection in every room as well as in the lobby and restaurant.
sentences.zh: 飯店每間房間、大廳和餐廳都提供高速網路連線。

sentences.en: The police would like to speak with anyone who has information in connection with the robbery.
sentences.zh: 警方想和任何有搶案相關資訊的人談談。

sentences.en: Passengers who need to make a connection in Tokyo should go directly to the transfer desk.
sentences.zh: 需要在東京轉機的乘客應該直接前往轉機櫃台。

sentences.en: If your internet connection is slow, please restart the router or call our technical support team.
sentences.zh: 如果你的網路連線很慢，請重新啟動路由器或打給我們的技術支援團隊。

sentences.en: We are writing in connection with the order you placed last week, which has been delayed.
sentences.zh: 我們來信是關於您上週下的訂單，它延遲了。

words.note: 語塊：internet connection（網路連線）、in connection with（關於）、make a connection（轉機）。connection 可以指「連線」、「關係」，或旅行時的「轉機、轉車」。

sentences.en: The restaurant changes its menu every month in order to please customers who visit often.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳每個月更換菜單，好讓常來的顧客滿意。

sentences.en: Some clients are hard to please, so it is important to listen carefully to what they want.
sentences.zh: 有些客戶很難取悅，所以仔細聆聽他們的需求很重要。

sentences.en: The new design of the store is sure to please shoppers who prefer a modern and simple style.
sentences.zh: 新的店面設計一定會讓喜歡現代簡約風格的顧客滿意。

sentences.en: It is impossible to please everyone, but we try our best to meet the needs of most customers.
sentences.zh: 不可能讓每個人都滿意，但我們盡力滿足大多數顧客的需求。

sentences.en: The chef worked hard to please the food critics who came to the restaurant on its opening night.
sentences.zh: 主廚很努力地讓開幕當晚來到餐廳的美食評論家滿意。

words.note: 語塊：be pleased to（很高興……）、hard to please（很難取悅）、please customers（讓顧客滿意）。please 當動詞是「使高興」；pleased 是「感到高興的」；pleasant 是「令人愉快的」。

sentences.en: Our goal is to make shopping a pleasurable experience for every customer who visits our store.
sentences.zh: 我們的目標是讓每位來店顧客都有愉快的購物經驗。

sentences.en: Comfortable seats and free snacks help make long train trips more pleasurable for passengers of all ages.
sentences.zh: 舒適的座位和免費點心讓乘客的長途火車旅行更愉快。

sentences.en: The spa offers a pleasurable experience that helps guests relax after a long day of work.
sentences.zh: 水療中心提供愉快的體驗，幫助客人在漫長的工作日後放鬆。

sentences.en: Soft music and good lighting can make dining at a restaurant much more pleasurable for guests.
sentences.zh: 輕柔的音樂和良好的燈光可以讓在餐廳用餐更加愉快。

sentences.en: Visitors described the boat tour as a pleasurable experience and recommended it to their friends.
sentences.zh: 遊客形容遊船行程是一次愉快的體驗，還推薦給朋友。

words.note: 語塊：pleasurable experience（愉快的經驗）、make sth more pleasurable（讓……更愉快）。pleasurable 和 pleasant、enjoyable 意思接近；pleasure 是名詞「樂趣」。

sentences.en: Security guards will enforce the rules about parking in front of the building starting next week.
sentences.zh: 從下週開始，保全會執行大樓前面的停車規定。

sentences.en: The city plans to strictly enforce the new law that bans smoking in all public parks.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫嚴格執行禁止在所有公園吸菸的新法律。

sentences.en: It is the manager's job to enforce the dress code and make sure that all staff look professional.
sentences.zh: 執行服裝規定、確保所有員工看起來專業是經理的工作。

sentences.en: Police officers will enforce the speed limit near schools during the hours when children arrive and leave.
sentences.zh: 警察會在孩子上下學的時段，在學校附近執行速限規定。

sentences.en: The library will enforce the rules about noise more strictly because many students have complained.
sentences.zh: 因為很多學生抱怨，圖書館會更嚴格執行噪音規定。

words.note: 語塊：enforce the rules（執行規定）、enforce the law（執法）、strictly enforce（嚴格執行）。enforce 是「強制執行規定」；reinforce 是「加強」，意思不同。

sentences.en: The government is planning to change the tax code in order to support small and medium-sized businesses.
sentences.zh: 政府正計畫修改稅法，以支持中小企業。

sentences.en: Under the tax code, donations to registered charities can be deducted from your yearly income.
sentences.zh: 根據稅法，捐給登記在案的慈善團體的錢可以從年收入中扣除。

sentences.en: Our accountants follow every change in the tax code so that our clients never pay more than necessary.
sentences.zh: 我們的會計師會追蹤稅法的每一項變動，讓客戶不會多繳稅。

sentences.en: Many business owners find the tax code very complicated and hire professionals to file their taxes.
sentences.zh: 很多老闆覺得稅法非常複雜，所以請專業人士幫他們報稅。

sentences.en: Experts say the new tax code will make it easier for foreign companies to invest in the country.
sentences.zh: 專家說新稅法會讓外國公司更容易到國內投資。

words.note: 語塊：change the tax code（修改稅法）、under the tax code（根據稅法）。tax code 是「整套稅務法規」；tax policy 是「稅收政策」；tax return 是「報稅單」。

sentences.en: Careful planning helped the team finish the large construction project on time and within budget.
sentences.zh: 周詳的規劃讓團隊準時且在預算內完成了這項大型工程。

sentences.en: Ms. Watts runs a small business that specializes in event planning for weddings and company parties.
sentences.zh: Watts 小姐經營一家專門規劃婚禮和公司派對的小公司。

sentences.en: The new shopping center is still in the planning stage, so construction will not begin until next year.
sentences.zh: 新購物中心還在規劃階段，所以要到明年才會動工。

sentences.en: Good planning is essential when you are organizing a conference with hundreds of guests from abroad.
sentences.zh: 籌辦一場有數百位海外來賓的研討會時，良好的規劃非常重要。

sentences.en: The city's planning department will hold a public meeting to discuss the design of the new park.
sentences.zh: 市政府規劃部門將舉行公聽會，討論新公園的設計。

words.note: 語塊：careful planning（周詳的規劃）、event planning（活動規劃）、in the planning stage（在規劃階段）。planning 是「規劃的過程」；plan 是「計畫（本身）」。

sentences.en: Please include all pertinent information, such as your order number, when you contact customer service.
sentences.zh: 聯絡客服時，請附上所有相關資訊，例如你的訂單編號。

sentences.en: The lawyer asked only questions that were pertinent to the case and avoided personal topics.
sentences.zh: 律師只問了和案件相關的問題，避開了個人話題。

sentences.en: The report contains pertinent information about the market that will help us decide where to expand.
sentences.zh: 報告包含市場的相關資訊，會幫助我們決定要往哪裡擴展。

sentences.en: Comments that are not pertinent to the topic of the meeting should be discussed at another time.
sentences.zh: 和會議主題無關的意見應該另找時間討論。

sentences.en: The manager reviewed all pertinent documents before making a final decision about the new contract.
sentences.zh: 經理在對新合約做最後決定之前，審閱了所有相關文件。

words.note: 語塊：pertinent information（相關資訊）、pertinent to（與……相關）。pertinent 和 relevant 意思相同，比較正式；impertinent 卻是「無禮的」。

sentences.en: Managers should have strong conflict resolution skills so that they can handle disagreements on their teams.
sentences.zh: 經理應該具備很強的衝突解決能力，才能處理團隊中的意見分歧。

sentences.en: The company offers conflict resolution training to help employees communicate better with one another at work.
sentences.zh: 公司提供衝突處理訓練，幫助員工彼此更好地溝通。

sentences.en: Conflict resolution is an important part of the job for anyone who works in customer service.
sentences.zh: 對任何從事客服工作的人來說，解決衝突是工作中很重要的一部分。

sentences.en: The workshop on conflict resolution taught us how to listen carefully and find solutions that everyone accepts.
sentences.zh: 衝突解決工作坊教我們如何仔細聆聽，找到大家都能接受的解決辦法。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed was praised for her conflict resolution skills after she helped two departments agree on a plan.
sentences.zh: Ahmed 小姐幫助兩個部門對一項計畫達成共識後，她解決衝突的能力受到稱讚。

words.note: 語塊：conflict resolution skills（解決衝突的能力）、conflict resolution training（衝突處理訓練）。conflict resolution 是處理人際或團隊衝突的方法；resolution 也可以指「決議」或「新年新希望」。

sentences.en: The marketing director will present the results of the new advertising campaign at Friday's meeting.
sentences.zh: 行銷總監會在週五的會議上報告新廣告活動的成果。

sentences.en: The managing director approved the plan to open three new branches in South America next year.
sentences.zh: 總經理核准了明年在南美洲開設三家新分行的計畫。

sentences.en: Mr. Rossi was promoted to marketing director after working at the company for more than fifteen years.
sentences.zh: Rossi 先生在公司工作十五年以上後被升為行銷總監。

sentences.en: The film director spent two years making the documentary about small farms in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 那位電影導演花了兩年拍攝關於山區小農場的紀錄片。

sentences.en: Each director is responsible for preparing the budget for his or her department before December.
sentences.zh: 每位主管都要在十二月前準備好自己部門的預算。

words.note: 語塊：marketing director（行銷總監）、managing director（總經理）、film director（電影導演）。director 可以是公司的「主管、總監」，也可以是電影「導演」；board of directors 是「董事會」。

sentences.en: Customer safety is our top priority, so every product is tested carefully before it is sold.
sentences.zh: 顧客安全是我們的首要之務，所以每項產品販售前都經過仔細測試。

sentences.en: The hospital will give priority to patients who need urgent care when the waiting room is full.
sentences.zh: 候診室客滿時，醫院會優先處理需要緊急照護的病人。

sentences.en: Reducing energy costs is a high priority for the company this year because electricity prices have risen.
sentences.zh: 因為電價上漲，降低能源成本是公司今年很重要的事。

sentences.en: Members of our loyalty program will receive priority when booking tickets for the popular concert.
sentences.zh: 我們忠誠計畫的會員在訂購熱門演唱會門票時享有優先權。

sentences.en: Finishing the report for the client is the top priority, so please postpone your other tasks until tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 完成給客戶的報告是首要之務，所以請把你其他的工作延到明天。

words.note: 語塊：top priority（首要之務）、give priority to（優先處理）、a high priority（很重要的事）。priority 是「優先」；prioritize 是動詞「排優先順序」；prior 是形容詞「先前的」。

sentences.en: The factory will close for one day next week so that officials can carry out a safety inspection.
sentences.zh: 工廠下週會停工一天，讓官員進行安全檢查。

sentences.en: All restaurants must pass an inspection by the health department before they can open to the public.
sentences.zh: 所有餐廳在對外營業前都必須通過衛生局的檢查。

sentences.en: The elevator in our building is checked carefully during a safety inspection every six months.
sentences.zh: 我們大樓的電梯每六個月會在安全檢查時檢查一次。

sentences.en: The inspectors will carry out an inspection of the new bridge before it is opened to traffic.
sentences.zh: 新橋開放通車前，檢查員會對它進行檢查。

sentences.en: The hotel was able to pass an inspection easily because the staff had cleaned every room carefully.
sentences.zh: 飯店輕鬆通過了檢查，因為員工把每個房間都仔細打掃過了。

words.note: 語塊：safety inspection（安全檢查）、pass an inspection（通過檢查）、carry out an inspection（進行檢查）。inspection 是名詞；inspect 是動詞；inspector 是「檢查員」；inspiration（靈感）長得像。

sentences.en: The consultant was hired to find and reduce inefficiency in the company's ordering and delivery system.
sentences.zh: 顧問受聘找出並減少公司訂購系統中的效率低落問題。

sentences.en: Inefficiency in the warehouse has caused many orders to be shipped much later than promised to customers.
sentences.zh: 倉庫的效率低落導致許多訂單比承諾的時間晚出貨。

sentences.en: The manager believes that too many meetings are a major source of inefficiency in the office.
sentences.zh: 經理認為太多會議是辦公室效率低落的主要原因。

sentences.en: Using old computers leads to inefficiency because employees must wait a long time for programs to open.
sentences.zh: 使用舊電腦會導致效率低落，因為員工必須等很久程式才會打開。

sentences.en: The new software helped reduce inefficiency by automatically sending invoices and reminders to customers each month.
sentences.zh: 新軟體每個月自動寄發票給顧客，幫助減少效率低落。

words.note: 語塊：reduce inefficiency（減少效率低落）、inefficiency in（……方面的低效率）。inefficiency 是名詞；inefficient 是形容詞「沒效率的」；efficiency 是相反詞。

sentences.en: The new pricing strategy is designed to maximize profits during the busy holiday shopping season.
sentences.zh: 新的定價策略是為了在忙碌的節慶購物季讓利潤最大化。

sentences.en: The factory changed its work schedule to maximize efficiency and reduce the time machines are not in use.
sentences.zh: 工廠調整工作時程，讓效率最大化，並減少機器閒置的時間。

sentences.en: The designer used tall shelves and folding tables to maximize space in the small office.
sentences.zh: 設計師用高架子和折疊桌來充分利用小辦公室的空間。

sentences.en: Companies that want to maximize profits must find ways to reduce costs without lowering quality.
sentences.zh: 想讓利潤最大化的公司必須找到在不降低品質的情況下降低成本的方法。

sentences.en: To maximize space in the warehouse, boxes should be stacked carefully according to their size.
sentences.zh: 為了充分利用倉庫空間，箱子應該按大小仔細堆疊。

words.note: 語塊：maximize profits（使利潤最大化）、maximize efficiency（提高效率到最大）、maximize space（充分利用空間）。maximize 是「讓……最大」；minimize 是「讓……最小」。

sentences.en: Dr. Kim was invited to join the advisory board of a company that develops medical equipment.
sentences.zh: 金博士受邀加入一家開發醫療設備公司的顧問委員會。

sentences.en: The advisory committee will review the proposal and make recommendations to the city council next month.
sentences.zh: 諮詢委員會將審查提案，並向市議會提出建議。

sentences.en: The government issued a travel advisory warning visitors to avoid the coast during the typhoon.
sentences.zh: 政府發布旅遊警示，提醒遊客颱風期間避開海岸地區。

sentences.en: Members of the advisory board meet four times a year to discuss the company's long-term plans.
sentences.zh: 顧問委員會的成員一年開會四次，討論公司的長期計畫。

sentences.en: The school formed an advisory committee of parents and teachers to improve its after-school programs.
sentences.zh: 學校成立了一個由家長和老師組成的諮詢委員會，改善課後課程。

words.note: 語塊：advisory board（顧問委員會）、advisory committee（諮詢委員會）、travel advisory（旅遊警示）。advisory 是形容詞「諮詢的」，也可當名詞「警示、公告」；adviser / advisor 是「顧問（人）」。

sentences.en: Each entrant in the photography contest may submit up to three pictures of the city.
sentences.zh: 攝影比賽的每位參賽者最多可以提交三張城市的照片。

sentences.en: The new entrant to the smartphone market is offering high-quality phones at very low prices.
sentences.zh: 那個手機市場的新進者以非常低的價格提供高品質手機。

sentences.en: Every contest entrant will receive a free ticket to the awards ceremony and dinner in December.
sentences.zh: 每位參賽者都會獲得一張十二月頒獎典禮的免費門票。

sentences.en: Large companies often lower their prices when a new entrant tries to take a share of the market.
sentences.zh: 當有新進者想搶佔市場時，大公司常常會降價。

sentences.en: The judges will choose one entrant from each category to compete in the national final next spring.
sentences.zh: 評審會從每個類別選出一位參賽者，參加明年春天的全國決賽。

words.note: 語塊：contest entrant（參賽者）、new entrant（新進者）、each entrant（每位參賽者）。entrant 是「參加比賽或進入市場的人／公司」；entrance 是「入口」。

sentences.en: We will never share your personal information with other companies or individuals without your written permission.
sentences.zh: 未經你的同意，我們絕不會把你的個人資料提供給其他公司。

sentences.en: Please take all of your personal belongings with you when you leave the train at the final station.
sentences.zh: 在終點站下車時，請帶好所有隨身物品。

sentences.en: Company laptops are intended for work and should not be used for personal use during office hours.
sentences.zh: 公司的筆電是工作用的，上班時間不應該拿來做個人用途。

sentences.en: Visitors may leave their personal belongings in the lockers near the entrance of the museum.
sentences.zh: 參觀者可以把隨身物品放在博物館入口附近的置物櫃。

sentences.en: Employees can update their personal information, such as their home address and phone number, online at any time.
sentences.zh: 員工可以在網路上更新個人資料，例如地址和電話號碼。

words.note: 語塊：personal information（個人資料）、personal belongings（隨身物品）、personal use（個人用途）。personal 是「個人的」；personnel（人員；人事）只差一點拼法，意思不同。

sentences.en: Employees who share confidential documents with outsiders may face serious disciplinary action from the company.
sentences.zh: 把機密文件分享給外人的員工可能會面臨公司的懲處。

sentences.en: The manager will take disciplinary action against any staff member who repeatedly arrives late for work.
sentences.zh: 經理會對任何一再遲到的員工採取懲處。

sentences.en: Before taking disciplinary action, the company will investigate the complaint and speak with everyone involved carefully and fairly.
sentences.zh: 在採取懲處之前，公司會仔細且公平地調查投訴。

sentences.en: Workers who ignore safety rules in the factory will face disciplinary action, including possible dismissal.
sentences.zh: 在工廠忽視安全規定的工人會面臨懲處，可能包括解僱。

sentences.en: The code of conduct explains when disciplinary action may be taken and how employees can appeal.
sentences.zh: 行為準則說明了什麼時候可能會懲處，以及員工可以怎麼申訴。

words.note: 語塊：face disciplinary action（面臨懲處）、take disciplinary action（採取懲處）。disciplinary 是「紀律的、懲戒的」；discipline 是「紀律；懲戒」。

sentences.en: All of our coffee cups are made from recyclable materials and can be placed in the blue bins.
sentences.zh: 我們所有的咖啡杯都是用可回收材料做的，可以丟進藍色回收桶。

sentences.en: The company switched to recyclable packaging to reduce the amount of plastic it sends to landfills.
sentences.zh: 公司改用可回收包裝，減少送到垃圾掩埋場的塑膠量。

sentences.en: Our new water bottles are fully recyclable, so customers can return them to any of our stores.
sentences.zh: 我們的新水瓶完全可回收，顧客可以拿回我們任何一家門市。

sentences.en: Please separate recyclable materials such as paper and glass from regular garbage in the break room.
sentences.zh: 在茶水間，請把紙和玻璃等可回收物和一般垃圾分開。

sentences.en: Customers prefer products with recyclable packaging because they care deeply about protecting the environment for future generations.
sentences.zh: 顧客比較喜歡有可回收包裝的產品，因為他們在乎保護環境。

words.note: 語塊：recyclable materials（可回收材料）、recyclable packaging（可回收包裝）、fully recyclable（完全可回收）。recyclable 是「可回收的」；recycled 是「回收再製的」；reusable 是「可重複使用的」。
