words.note: 語塊：fill a prescription（照處方配藥）、prescription medicine（處方藥）、without a prescription（沒有處方）。prescription 是醫生開的「處方」；prescribe 是動詞「開藥」；description（描述）長得像。

sentences.en: The new community center offers exercise classes and free meals for the elderly in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 新的社區中心為附近的長者提供運動課程和免費餐點。

sentences.en: Many families hire professional workers to care for the elderly at home instead of moving them to nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭請專業看護在家照顧老人，而不是把他們送到安養院。

sentences.en: The city plans to improve services for the elderly, including free bus rides and home visits by nurses.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫改善長者服務，包括免費搭公車和護士到府探訪。

sentences.en: The company designs smartphones with large buttons and simple menus that are easy for the elderly to use.
sentences.zh: 那家公司設計有大按鍵和簡單選單、方便長者使用的手機。

sentences.en: Volunteers visit the elderly who live alone to make sure they are safe and have enough food.
sentences.zh: 志工會探訪獨居長者，確認他們安全且有足夠的食物。

words.note: 語塊：care for the elderly（照顧老人）、services for the elderly（長者服務）、easy for the elderly（方便長者）、visit the elderly（探訪長者）。the elderly 是「老年人（總稱）」，動詞用複數；senior citizens 是比較禮貌的說法。

sentences.en: The old theater was restored at great expense and reopened to the public last month.
sentences.zh: 那座老劇院花了大筆錢修復，上個月重新對外開放。

sentences.en: The company brought in experts from overseas at great expense to train its engineers in the new factory.
sentences.zh: 公司花大錢從海外請專家來訓練工程師。

sentences.en: The museum purchased the famous painting at great expense, but it has attracted many new visitors.
sentences.zh: 博物館花了大筆錢買下那幅名畫，但它吸引了很多新參觀者。

sentences.en: The city built the new stadium at great expense, so officials hope it will be used for many events.
sentences.zh: 市政府花大錢蓋了新體育場，所以官員希望它能用來辦很多活動。

sentences.en: The family flew in a famous chef from Paris at great expense to cook for the wedding dinner.
sentences.zh: 那家人花了大筆錢從巴黎請來一位知名主廚，為婚宴掌廚。

words.note: 語塊：at great expense（花大錢）、restored at great expense（花大錢修復）。at great expense 是「付出很高的費用」；at the expense of 是「犧牲……」。

sentences.en: Each respondent who completes the survey will receive a coupon for a free coffee at our café.
sentences.zh: 每位完成調查的受訪者都會得到一張我們咖啡廳的免費咖啡券。

sentences.en: Almost every survey respondent said that they would like the store to open earlier on weekends.
sentences.zh: 幾乎每位調查受訪者都說希望商店週末早一點開門。

sentences.en: The research team will not share the name of any respondent, so people can answer honestly.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊不會公開任何受訪者的名字，所以大家可以誠實作答。

sentences.en: One respondent suggested adding more vegetarian options to the menu in the company cafeteria on the first floor.
sentences.zh: 一位受訪者建議在公司員工餐廳的菜單上增加更多素食選擇。

sentences.en: More than half of the survey respondents were under thirty, and the oldest respondent was eighty-two.
sentences.zh: 超過一半的調查受訪者未滿三十歲，最年長的受訪者八十二歲。

words.note: 語塊：survey respondent（調查受訪者）、each respondent（每位受訪者）。respondent 是「回答問卷的人」；respond 是動詞「回應」；response 是名詞「回應」。

sentences.en: The concert will be held at the civic center, which can hold more than three thousand people.
sentences.zh: 音樂會將在可以容納三千多人的市民中心舉行。

sentences.en: Many people believe that voting in local elections is an important civic duty for every adult resident.
sentences.zh: 很多人認為在地方選舉投票是重要的公民責任。

sentences.en: Several civic groups have asked the city council to build more parks in the downtown area.
sentences.zh: 好幾個公民團體要求市議會在市中心多蓋公園。

sentences.en: The new civic center includes a library, a swimming pool, and rooms for community meetings.
sentences.zh: 新的市民中心包括圖書館、游泳池和社區會議室。

sentences.en: Local businesses support civic events such as the summer festival and the holiday parade every year.
sentences.zh: 當地商家支持夏季慶典和節日遊行等市民活動。

words.note: 語塊：civic center（市民中心）、civic duty（公民責任）、civic group（公民團體）。civic 是「和市民、城市有關的」；civil 是「公民的；民事的；有禮貌的」。

sentences.en: Passengers must go through immigration and collect their luggage before they leave the airport for the city.
sentences.zh: 乘客離開機場前必須通過入境審查並領取行李。

sentences.en: Foreign workers should contact the immigration office to renew their work permits before they expire.
sentences.zh: 外籍員工應該在工作證到期前聯絡移民署辦理更新。

sentences.en: The government announced a new immigration policy that will make it easier for skilled workers to move here.
sentences.zh: 政府宣布一項新的移民政策，讓技術人才更容易移居這裡。

sentences.en: It can take more than an hour to go through immigration at the airport during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 節慶期間在機場通過入境審查可能要一個多小時。

sentences.en: The conference will discuss how immigration policy affects businesses that need skilled workers from abroad.
sentences.zh: 研討會將討論移民政策如何影響需要海外員工的企業。

words.note: 語塊：immigration office（移民署）、go through immigration（通過入境審查）、immigration policy（移民政策）。immigration 是「移入」；emigration 是「移出」；在機場 immigration 指「入境審查」。

sentences.en: The author hired a publicist to arrange interviews with newspapers and radio stations before her book was released.
sentences.zh: 那位作家在新書出版前聘請公關，安排報紙和電台的訪問。

sentences.en: According to the singer's publicist, the concert in Taipei has been postponed until next spring.
sentences.zh: 根據那位歌手的公關表示，台北的演唱會延到明年春天。

sentences.en: The restaurant's publicist invited food critics to a free dinner on the night before the official opening.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的公關在正式開幕前一晚邀請美食評論家免費吃晚餐。

sentences.en: The company decided to hire a publicist after its new product received very little attention from the media.
sentences.zh: 新產品沒有得到媒體太多關注後，公司決定聘請公關。

sentences.en: A good publicist can help a small business get its name into magazines and popular websites.
sentences.zh: 一位好的公關可以幫助小企業登上雜誌和熱門網站。

words.note: 語塊：hire a publicist（聘請公關）、the singer's publicist（歌手的公關）。publicist 是「負責宣傳的人」；publisher 是「出版商」；publicity 是「宣傳」。

sentences.en: The storm caused damage to several buildings near the coast, but no one was seriously injured.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨對海岸附近的好幾棟建築造成損害，但沒有人受重傷。

sentences.en: Please check the package for damage before you sign for it, and report any problems immediately.
sentences.zh: 簽收包裹前請檢查是否有損壞，有任何問題請立刻回報。

sentences.en: The insurance policy covers water damage caused by broken pipes in your kitchen or bathroom.
sentences.zh: 保單涵蓋廚房或浴室水管破裂造成的水損。

sentences.en: The company will pay for any damage to your furniture that happens during the delivery process.
sentences.zh: 公司會負擔運送過程中對你家具造成的任何損害。

sentences.en: Heavy trucks can cause damage to old roads, so they are not allowed on the bridge.
sentences.zh: 重型卡車可能對老舊道路造成損害，所以不准上橋。

words.note: 語塊：cause damage（造成損害）、damage to（對……的損害）、water damage（水損）。damage 當名詞時不可數（some damage，不是 a damage）；damages（複數）是法律上的「賠償金」。

sentences.en: The temporary closure of the museum's main hall will allow workers to repair the old roof.
sentences.zh: 博物館大廳暫時關閉，讓工人修理舊屋頂。

sentences.en: Drivers should expect delays because of a road closure on Main Street this weekend for the parade.
sentences.zh: 因為這個週末 Main 街封路，駕駛應預期會有延誤。

sentences.en: The closure of the factory will affect hundreds of workers and many small businesses in the town.
sentences.zh: 工廠關閉將影響鎮上數百名工人和許多小商家。

sentences.en: Customers were informed about the temporary closure of the store by email and on social media.
sentences.zh: 顧客透過電子郵件和社群媒體得知店面暫時關閉的消息。

sentences.en: The road closure near the stadium will last until the end of the concert at around eleven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 體育場附近的封路會持續到大約十一點演唱會結束為止。

words.note: 語塊：temporary closure（暫時關閉）、road closure（封路）、the closure of（……的關閉）。closure 是名詞「關閉」；close 是動詞；closing 是形容詞「結束的」。

sentences.en: Please read every instruction on the form carefully before you fill it out and sign your name.
sentences.zh: 填表簽名之前，請仔細閱讀表格上的每一條說明。

sentences.en: The manager gave a clear instruction to the team about how to handle complaints from angry customers.
sentences.zh: 經理對團隊下了一個清楚的指示，說明如何處理生氣顧客的投訴。

sentences.en: Workers who do not follow an instruction from the safety officer will be asked to leave the construction site.
sentences.zh: 不遵照安全人員指示的工人會被要求離開工地。

sentences.en: If you do not understand an instruction in the manual, please contact our customer support team.
sentences.zh: 如果你看不懂手冊上的某一條說明，請聯絡我們的客服團隊。

sentences.en: New employees must follow every safety instruction given by their supervisor during the training period.
sentences.zh: 新員工在訓練期間必須遵守主管給的每一條安全指示。

words.note: 語塊：every instruction（每一條指示）、a clear instruction（清楚的指示）、follow an instruction（遵照一項指示）。instruction 當「說明書上的指示」時常用複數 instructions（follow the instructions）；instructor 是「講師」。

sentences.en: Please book your tickets in advance, as the concert is expected to sell out quickly.
sentences.zh: 請事先訂票，因為演唱會預計很快就會賣光。

sentences.en: Employees must give at least two weeks of advance notice if they want to take a vacation.
sentences.zh: 員工如果要休假，必須至少提前兩週通知。

sentences.en: The bank will not give you an advance on your salary unless your manager approves the request.
sentences.zh: 除非你的經理核准申請，否則銀行不會預支薪水給你。

sentences.en: The hotel requires guests to pay for the first night in advance when they make a reservation.
sentences.zh: 飯店要求客人訂房時先預付第一晚的費用。

sentences.en: The company will receive an advance of fifty thousand dollars before it begins work on the project.
sentences.zh: 公司在開始進行專案之前會先收到五萬美元的預付款。

words.note: 語塊：in advance（事先）、advance notice（事先通知）、an advance of（……的預付款）。in advance 是「事先」；advanced 是形容詞「先進的；高級的」。

sentences.en: Ms. Gomez worked part-time at the bank for two years before she was offered a full-time job.
sentences.zh: Gomez 小姐在銀行兼職兩年後，才得到一份全職工作。

sentences.en: Every full-time employee receives health insurance, paid vacation, and an annual bonus based on performance.
sentences.zh: 每位全職員工都享有健康保險、帶薪休假和年終獎金。

sentences.en: Many students cannot work full-time because they need time to attend classes, study, and prepare for exams.
sentences.zh: 很多學生不能全職工作，因為他們需要時間上課和讀書。

sentences.en: The company plans to hire twenty full-time workers when the new factory opens next spring.
sentences.zh: 新工廠明年春天開工時，公司計畫聘用二十名全職員工。

sentences.en: After the baby was born, Mr. Lee decided to stop working full-time and stay home for six months.
sentences.zh: 寶寶出生後，李先生決定暫停全職工作，在家待六個月。

words.note: 語塊：full-time job（全職工作）、full-time employee（全職員工）、work full-time（全職工作）。full-time 放在名詞前要加連字號；part-time 是「兼職的」。

sentences.en: After working as an intern for six months, Ms. Ito was offered a permanent position at the company.
sentences.zh: 當了六個月的實習生之後，伊藤小姐獲得公司的正職。

sentences.en: The museum's permanent exhibition includes ancient tools, jewelry, and pottery found in the region over many years.
sentences.zh: 博物館的常設展包括該地區的古代工具、珠寶和陶器。

sentences.en: Applicants for the job must be citizens or permanent residents of the country where the office is located.
sentences.zh: 應徵這份工作的人必須是本國公民或永久居民。

sentences.en: The city is looking for a permanent solution to the traffic problems near the airport.
sentences.zh: 市政府正在尋找機場附近交通問題的永久解決辦法。

sentences.en: The temporary office will be used until the company moves into its permanent building next year.
sentences.zh: 臨時辦公室會一直用到公司明年搬進永久的大樓為止。

words.note: 語塊：permanent position（正職）、permanent exhibition（常設展）、permanent resident（永久居民）。permanent 是「永久的」；temporary 是相反詞「暫時的」。

sentences.en: If necessary, we can arrange a car to pick you up at the airport and take you to the hotel.
sentences.zh: 必要時，我們可以安排車到機場接你送你到飯店。

sentences.en: A valid passport is necessary for all passengers who are traveling on international flights from this airport.
sentences.zh: 所有搭國際航班的乘客都必須持有有效的護照。

sentences.en: The editor will make necessary changes to the article before it is published in the magazine.
sentences.zh: 編輯會在文章刊登到雜誌前做必要的修改。

sentences.en: It is not necessary to bring your own laptop, as computers will be provided at the training center.
sentences.zh: 不需要自己帶筆電，因為訓練中心會提供電腦。

sentences.en: Please complete all of the necessary forms before your first day of work at the company.
sentences.zh: 請在你到公司上班的第一天之前填完所有必要的表格。

words.note: 語塊：if necessary（必要時）、necessary for（……所必需的）、make necessary changes（做必要的修改）。necessary 是「必要的」；necessity 是名詞「必需品」；注意拼法：一個 c、兩個 s。

sentences.en: Please read the list of frequently asked questions on our website before you contact customer service.
sentences.zh: 聯絡客服之前，請先閱讀我們網站上的常見問題列表。

sentences.en: The sales manager travels frequently to meet with important clients in Japan, Korea, and Singapore.
sentences.zh: 業務經理經常出差，和日本、韓國及新加坡的客戶見面。

sentences.en: The most frequently used rooms in the office are the small meeting rooms on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 辦公室裡最常用的房間是二樓的小會議室。

sentences.en: Trains to the airport run frequently, so you do not need to check the schedule in advance.
sentences.zh: 往機場的火車班次很密集，所以你不用事先查時刻表。

sentences.en: Employees who travel frequently for work can join the airline's program to earn free flights.
sentences.zh: 經常因公出差的員工可以加入航空公司的計畫，累積免費機票。

words.note: 語塊：frequently asked questions（常見問題）、frequently used（常用的）、travel frequently（經常出差）。frequently 和 often 意思相同；frequent 是形容詞「頻繁的」。

sentences.en: The company decided to hire a psychologist to help employees deal with stress during the busy season.
sentences.zh: 公司決定聘請一位心理師，在旺季期間幫助員工處理壓力。

sentences.en: Dr. Russo is a clinical psychologist who has worked at the hospital for more than twenty years.
sentences.zh: Russo 博士是一位在醫院工作了二十多年的臨床心理師。

sentences.en: Many people see a psychologist when they are going through difficult changes in their lives.
sentences.zh: 很多人在人生經歷困難的轉變時會去看心理師。

sentences.en: A psychologist will give a talk on how to balance work and family life at Thursday's seminar.
sentences.zh: 一位心理學家會在週四的講座上談如何平衡工作和家庭生活。

sentences.en: The research was carried out by a team of doctors and a psychologist from the national university.
sentences.zh: 這項研究是由國立大學的一群醫生和一位心理學家共同進行的。

words.note: 語塊：clinical psychologist（臨床心理師）、see a psychologist（看心理師）、hire a psychologist（聘請心理師）。psychologist 的 p 不發音；psychology 是「心理學」；psychiatrist 是「精神科醫師」。

sentences.en: Applicants for the position must have a degree in engineering and at least five years of experience.
sentences.zh: 應徵這個職位的人必須有工程學位，以及至少五年的經驗。

sentences.en: The engineering department is responsible for testing every new product before it is sold to customers.
sentences.zh: 工程部負責在每項新產品販售前進行測試。

sentences.en: Ms. Park studied civil engineering in college and now designs bridges and highways for the government.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐大學讀土木工程，現在為政府設計橋樑和公路。

sentences.en: The university received a large donation to build a new engineering center with modern laboratories.
sentences.zh: 那所大學獲得一大筆捐款，興建一座有現代化實驗室的新工程中心。

sentences.en: Many students choose engineering because there is a strong demand for engineers in the technology industry.
sentences.zh: 很多學生選擇工程，因為科技業對工程師的需求很大。

words.note: 語塊：engineering department（工程部）、civil engineering（土木工程）、engineering degree（工程學位）。engineering 是「工程學、工程領域」；engineer 是「工程師（人）」。

sentences.en: Many office workers suffer from muscle pain in their backs and shoulders after sitting for long hours.
sentences.zh: 很多上班族久坐後背部和肩膀會肌肉痠痛。

sentences.en: The fitness center offers classes for members who want to build muscle and improve their strength.
sentences.zh: 健身中心為想增肌、增強力氣的會員開設課程。

sentences.en: Please stretch before you exercise so that you do not pull a muscle during the workout.
sentences.zh: 運動前請先伸展，以免運動時拉傷肌肉。

sentences.en: The massage chair is designed to relax every muscle in your back after a long day at work.
sentences.zh: 按摩椅是設計來在辛苦工作一天後，放鬆你背部的每一條肌肉。

sentences.en: Eating enough protein is important for people who want to build muscle through regular exercise.
sentences.zh: 對想透過規律運動增肌的人來說，攝取足夠的蛋白質很重要。

words.note: 語塊：muscle pain（肌肉痠痛）、build muscle（增肌）、pull a muscle（拉傷肌肉）。muscle 的 c 不發音；mussel（淡菜）發音一樣，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: Customers who are not satisfied with our service can file a complaint on our website at any time.
sentences.zh: 對我們服務不滿意的顧客可以隨時在我們網站上提出投訴。

sentences.en: Several residents decided to file a complaint with the city about the noise from the construction site.
sentences.zh: 好幾位居民決定向市政府投訴工地的噪音。

sentences.en: If you want to file a complaint about a product, please include your receipt and a photo of the problem.
sentences.zh: 如果你想針對某個產品投訴，請附上收據和問題的照片。

sentences.en: The passenger plans to file a complaint with the airline because her luggage was damaged during the flight.
sentences.zh: 那位乘客打算向航空公司投訴，因為她的行李在飛行中受損。

sentences.en: Employees who experience unfair treatment at work can file a complaint with the human resources department.
sentences.zh: 在工作中受到不公平對待的員工可以向人資部提出投訴。

words.note: 語塊：file a complaint with（向……提出投訴）、file a complaint about（針對……投訴）。file 在這裡是「正式提出」；make a complaint 意思相同。

sentences.en: The conference will end with a panel discussion about the future of electric cars in Asia.
sentences.zh: 研討會將以一場關於亞洲電動車未來的座談會作結。

sentences.en: A panel of experts will choose the winners of the design competition next Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 一個專家小組將在下週五下午選出設計比賽的得獎者。

sentences.en: The company installed a solar panel on the roof of every store to reduce its electricity costs.
sentences.zh: 公司在每家門市的屋頂裝了太陽能板，以降低電費。

sentences.en: The panel discussion will include business leaders, government officials, and university professors from three countries.
sentences.zh: 座談會的與談人包括企業領袖、政府官員和大學教授。

sentences.en: Each applicant will be interviewed by a panel of experts from different departments of the hospital.
sentences.zh: 每位應徵者都會由醫院不同科別的專家小組面試。

words.note: 語塊：panel discussion（座談會）、a panel of experts（專家小組）、solar panel（太陽能板）。panel 可以是「討論小組、評審團」，也可以是「面板、板子」；panelist 是「與談人」。

sentences.en: Employees can park their cars in the parking lot behind the office building free of charge.
sentences.zh: 員工可以免費把車停在辦公大樓後面的停車場。

sentences.en: The city plans to turn the empty lot next to the library into a small park with benches and trees.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫把圖書館旁邊的空地改建成有長椅和樹木的小公園。

sentences.en: The company bought a large lot near the highway where it will build a new warehouse next year.
sentences.zh: 公司在公路附近買了一大塊地，明年要在那裡蓋新倉庫。

sentences.en: The parking lot at the shopping center is usually full on weekends, so many people take the bus.
sentences.zh: 購物中心的停車場週末通常都滿了，所以很多人搭公車。

sentences.en: A developer plans to build apartments on the empty lot across from the train station.
sentences.zh: 一家建商計畫在火車站對面的空地上蓋公寓。

words.note: 語塊：parking lot（停車場）、empty lot（空地）、a lot of（很多）。lot 可以指「一塊土地」，parking lot 是「停車場」；a lot of 是「很多」。

sentences.en: The flight attendant asked all passengers to fasten their seat belts before the plane took off.
sentences.zh: 空服員請所有乘客在飛機起飛前繫好安全帶。

sentences.en: If you lose your parking ticket, please speak to the parking attendant at the exit gate.
sentences.zh: 如果你遺失停車票，請和出口閘門的停車場管理員說。

sentences.en: Ms. Rivera worked as a flight attendant for ten years before she became a manager at the airline.
sentences.zh: Rivera 小姐當了十年空服員後，成為航空公司的經理。

sentences.en: The gas station attendant checked the air in our tires and cleaned the windows of the car.
sentences.zh: 加油站員工幫我們檢查輪胎的胎壓，還清潔了車窗。

sentences.en: A parking attendant will help visitors find empty spaces in the garage during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 節慶旺季期間，停車場管理員會幫訪客在停車場找空位。

words.note: 語塊：flight attendant（空服員）、parking attendant（停車場管理員）、gas station attendant（加油站員工）。attendant 是「提供服務的人員」；attendance 是「出席（人數）」；attendee 是「與會者」。

sentences.en: Many workers take a second job in order to provide for their families when prices rise.
sentences.zh: 物價上漲時，很多工人會兼第二份工作來養家。

sentences.en: The retirement plan helps employees provide for the future by saving part of their salary each month.
sentences.zh: 退休金計畫幫助員工每個月存下一部分薪水，為未來做準備。

sentences.en: The new law will provide for longer maternity leave and better support for working parents.
sentences.zh: 新法律將規定更長的產假，並為上班族父母提供更好的支持。

sentences.en: Mr. Lopez works long hours at the restaurant to provide for his family, which includes his wife and three young children.
sentences.zh: Lopez 先生在餐廳長時間工作來養家，家裡有妻子和三個年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: The budget will provide for the hiring of twenty new teachers at schools in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 這份預算將為鄉村地區的學校聘用二十位新老師。

words.note: 語塊：provide for one's family（養家）、provide for the future（為未來做準備）。provide for 是「養活、照顧」或「預先準備」；provide sb with sth 是「提供某人某物」。

sentences.en: The new office design gives employees a sense of space and freedom because of its large windows.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室的設計因為有大窗戶，讓員工有空間感和自由感。

sentences.en: It makes sense to buy supplies in bulk because the price per item is much lower.
sentences.zh: 大量購買用品是合理的，因為每件的價格低很多。

sentences.en: The manager is popular with the staff because she has a great sense of humor and is very patient.
sentences.zh: 那位經理很受員工歡迎，因為她很有幽默感，又非常有耐心。

sentences.en: Team-building activities help create a sense of community among employees who work in different departments.
sentences.zh: 團隊建立活動有助於在不同部門的員工之間營造一種社群感。

sentences.en: The plan did not make sense to the board, so the team was asked to prepare a new proposal.
sentences.zh: 董事會覺得那個計畫說不通，所以團隊被要求準備一份新提案。

words.note: 語塊：a sense of（……的感覺）、make sense（合理；說得通）、sense of humor（幽默感）。sense 是「感覺、判斷力」；make sense 是「有道理」；sensible 是「明智的」，sensitive 是「敏感的」。

sentences.en: The lights in the hallway are controlled by a motion sensor, so they turn off when no one is there.
sentences.zh: 走廊的燈由動作感應器控制，所以沒人的時候會自動關掉。

sentences.en: A temperature sensor in the warehouse sends a warning if the room becomes too hot for the food.
sentences.zh: 倉庫的溫度感測器在室溫對食物來說太高時會發出警告。

sentences.en: The company will install a sensor at every door to count the number of customers who enter the store.
sentences.zh: 公司會在每個門口安裝感應器，計算進店的顧客人數。

sentences.en: The new car has a sensor that warns the driver when another vehicle is too close behind it.
sentences.zh: 新車有一個感應器，在後方車輛太靠近時提醒駕駛。

sentences.en: The factory uses a temperature sensor on each machine to prevent it from overheating during use.
sentences.zh: 工廠在每台機器上都裝了溫度感測器，防止使用時過熱。

words.note: 語塊：motion sensor（動作感應器）、temperature sensor（溫度感測器）、install a sensor（安裝感應器）。sensor 是「偵測光、熱、動作的裝置」；censor（審查）發音一樣，意思不同。

sentences.en: Please return the completed form to the front desk before your appointment with the doctor.
sentences.zh: 看診前請把填好的表格交到櫃台。

sentences.en: The completed project was presented to the client two weeks earlier than the deadline in the contract.
sentences.zh: 完成的專案比截止日早兩週交給客戶。

sentences.en: Once the building is fully completed, the company will move all of its employees there.
sentences.zh: 大樓一全部完工，公司就會把所有員工搬過去。

sentences.en: Applicants should send the completed application form along with a copy of their résumé and two references.
sentences.zh: 申請人應該寄出填好的申請表，並附上一份履歷。

sentences.en: The city held a ceremony to celebrate the completed bridge, which took five years to build.
sentences.zh: 市政府舉辦典禮慶祝花了五年建成的大橋完工。

words.note: 語塊：completed form（填好的表格）、completed project（完成的專案）、fully completed（全部完成）。completed 是「已完成的」；complete 也可以當形容詞「完整的」。

sentences.en: In light of the bad weather, the outdoor concert has been moved to the community center.
sentences.zh: 鑑於天氣不佳，戶外音樂會改到社區中心舉行。

sentences.en: The company decided to review its security policy in light of recent events at other banks.
sentences.zh: 鑑於其他銀行最近發生的事件，公司決定檢討它的保全政策。

sentences.en: In light of the situation, all employees are asked to work from home until Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 鑑於目前的情況，所有員工都被要求在家工作到週三。

sentences.en: The prices were changed in light of rising costs for raw materials, fuel, and transportation.
sentences.zh: 考慮到材料和運輸成本上漲，價格做了調整。

sentences.en: In light of the positive feedback from customers, the restaurant will keep the new dish on its menu.
sentences.zh: 鑑於顧客的正面回饋，那家餐廳會把新菜色留在菜單上。

words.note: 語塊：in light of the situation（鑑於情況）、in light of recent events（鑑於最近的事件）、in light of rising costs（考慮到成本上升）、in light of the bad weather（鑑於天氣不佳）。in light of 是「因為考慮到……」；because of、given 意思接近，in light of 比較正式。

sentences.en: It is important to get along with your co-workers, especially when you work closely as a team.
sentences.zh: 和同事相處融洽很重要，尤其是團隊緊密合作的時候。

sentences.en: The new manager seems to get along with everyone in the department, including the senior staff.
sentences.zh: 新經理似乎和部門裡的每個人都相處得很好，包括資深員工。

sentences.en: Employees who get along with their supervisors are usually happier and more productive at work.
sentences.zh: 和主管相處融洽的員工通常在工作上比較快樂、效率也比較高。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim was chosen to lead the project because she can get along with people from many different cultures.
sentences.zh: 金小姐被選來帶領專案，因為她能和來自很多不同文化的人相處融洽。

sentences.en: Some interns found it hard to get along with co-workers at first, but they soon became good friends.
sentences.zh: 有些實習生一開始覺得很難和同事相處，但他們很快就成了好朋友。

words.note: 語塊：get along with everyone（和大家相處融洽）、get along with co-workers（和同事處得來）。get along with 是「和某人相處得好」；get on with（英式）意思相同。

sentences.en: The termination of the contract will take effect thirty days after the written notice is received.
sentences.zh: 合約將在收到書面通知三十天後終止。

sentences.en: Customers who cancel their phone plan early must pay an early termination fee of one hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 提前解約手機方案的顧客必須支付一百美元的提前解約金。

sentences.en: The letter explained the reasons for the termination of employment and the date of his last day at work.
sentences.zh: 信中說明了解僱的原因以及他最後一天上班的日期。

sentences.en: Repeatedly breaking the safety rules can lead to the termination of employment at our factory.
sentences.zh: 一再違反安全規定可能導致在我們工廠被解僱。

sentences.en: Both companies agreed to the early termination of the partnership after the project was canceled.
sentences.zh: 專案取消後，兩家公司都同意提前終止合作。

words.note: 語塊：termination of the contract（合約終止）、termination of employment（解僱）、early termination（提前終止）。termination 是名詞；terminate 是動詞；termination fee 是「解約金」。

sentences.en: The results of the survey indicate that most customers would like the store to stay open later.
sentences.zh: 調查結果顯示大部分顧客希望商店營業到更晚。

sentences.en: Please indicate on the form whether you would prefer a vegetarian meal at the dinner.
sentences.zh: 請在表格上註明你在晚宴上是否偏好素食。

sentences.en: Recent sales figures clearly indicate that the new advertising campaign has been a great success.
sentences.zh: 最近的銷售數字清楚表明新的廣告活動很成功。

sentences.en: The red light on the machine will indicate that the paper tray is empty and needs to be refilled.
sentences.zh: 機器上的紅燈會表示紙匣空了，需要補紙。

sentences.en: Early reports indicate that the storm caused only minor damage to buildings in the city.
sentences.zh: 初步報告顯示暴風雨只對城裡的建築造成輕微損害。

words.note: 語塊：indicate that（顯示……）、clearly indicate（清楚表明）、as indicated（如所示）。indicate 比 show 正式；indication 是名詞「跡象」；indicator 是「指標」。

sentences.en: Workers at the factory assemble the parts by hand, which is why each product takes several hours to make.
sentences.zh: 工廠的工人手工組裝零件，這就是每個產品要花好幾個小時才能做好的原因。

sentences.en: The bookshelf is easy to assemble and comes with all of the tools you need.
sentences.zh: 這個書架很容易組裝，而且附上你需要的所有工具。

sentences.en: All participants should assemble in the hotel lobby at eight o'clock for the bus to the conference center.
sentences.zh: 所有參加者應在八點於飯店大廳集合，搭巴士前往會議中心。

sentences.en: The company hired extra staff to assemble the new furniture for the office before Monday.
sentences.zh: 公司加聘人手，在週一前為辦公室組裝新家具。

sentences.en: Employees were asked to assemble in the parking lot during the fire drill on Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 週四早上消防演習時，員工被要求到停車場集合。

words.note: 語塊：assemble the parts（組裝零件）、easy to assemble（容易組裝）、assemble in（在……集合）。assemble 有「組裝」和「集合」兩個意思；assembly 是名詞。

sentences.en: The editor found an inaccuracy in the article and asked the writer to correct it before printing.
sentences.zh: 編輯在文章中發現一個錯誤，要求作者在印刷前更正。

sentences.en: We apologize for the inaccuracy in last week's newsletter regarding the date of the company picnic.
sentences.zh: 我們為上週電子報中公司野餐日期的錯誤致歉。

sentences.en: Please report any inaccuracy in your bill to our customer service department as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 帳單如有任何錯誤，請盡快通知我們的客服部。

sentences.en: The company issued a correction after a customer pointed out an inaccuracy on its website.
sentences.zh: 一位顧客指出網站上的錯誤後，公司發布了更正。

sentences.en: An inaccuracy in the financial report caused the company's profits to appear higher than they were.
sentences.zh: 財報中的一個錯誤讓公司的獲利看起來比實際還高。

words.note: 語塊：inaccuracy in（……中的錯誤）、correct an inaccuracy（更正錯誤）。inaccuracy 是名詞；inaccurate 是形容詞「不準確的」；accuracy 是「準確性」。

sentences.en: Each registrant will receive a confirmation email with the schedule and location of the workshop.
sentences.zh: 每位報名者都會收到一封確認信，附上工作坊的時程和地點。

sentences.en: The conference organizers will send a name badge to every registrant before the event begins.
sentences.zh: 研討會主辦單位會在活動開始前寄名牌給每位報名者。

sentences.en: Registrant information will be kept confidential and will not be shared with other companies or organizations.
sentences.zh: 報名者資料會保密，不會提供給其他公司。

sentences.en: The first one hundred registrants will receive a free gift, and every registrant will get a discount coupon.
sentences.zh: 前一百位報名者會得到一份免費禮物，每位報名者都會拿到一張折扣券。

sentences.en: Please make sure that each registrant has paid the fee before giving them a ticket at the door.
sentences.zh: 在門口發票之前，請確認每位報名者都已經付費。

words.note: 語塊：each registrant（每位報名者）、registrant information（報名者資料）。registrant 是「報名、登記的人」；registration 是「報名」；participant 是「參加者」。

sentences.en: The startup needs to raise capital from investors before it can open its first factory.
sentences.zh: 那家新創公司需要先向投資人籌措資金，才能開設第一座工廠。

sentences.en: The company plans to make a large capital investment in new equipment over the next three years.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在未來三年對新設備進行大筆資本投資。

sentences.en: Small businesses often need working capital to pay for supplies and salaries during slow months.
sentences.zh: 小企業在淡季時常常需要營運資金來支付用品和薪水。

sentences.en: The bank offers loans to help young entrepreneurs raise capital for their new businesses in the city.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行提供貸款，幫助年輕創業家為新事業籌措資金。

sentences.en: Seoul is the capital of South Korea and one of the largest cities in Asia.
sentences.zh: 首爾是南韓的首都，也是亞洲最大的城市之一。

words.note: 語塊：raise capital（籌措資金）、capital investment（資本投資）、working capital（營運資金）。capital 可以是「資金」或「首都」；capitol（美國州議會大廈）長得像。

sentences.en: The closing ceremony of the festival will include fireworks and a concert by a famous local band.
sentences.zh: 慶典的閉幕典禮會有煙火和一個知名在地樂團的音樂會。

sentences.en: Customers who are still in the store at closing time will be asked to pay for their items quickly.
sentences.zh: 打烊時還在店裡的顧客會被請求盡快結帳。

sentences.en: The director will give the closing speech at the end of the three-day conference on Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 總監會在週五下午三天研討會的最後致閉幕詞。

sentences.en: The closing price of the company's shares rose by five percent after the merger was announced.
sentences.zh: 宣布合併後，公司股票的收盤價上漲了百分之五。

sentences.en: The library's closing time has been changed to nine o'clock so that students can study later.
sentences.zh: 圖書館的閉館時間改成九點，讓學生可以讀書讀晚一點。

words.note: 語塊：closing ceremony（閉幕典禮）、closing time（打烊時間）、closing remarks（閉幕致詞）。closing 是「結束時的」；closure 是名詞「關閉」；opening 是相反詞。

sentences.en: New employees will report to the human resources office at nine o'clock on their first day of work.
sentences.zh: 新員工上班第一天要在九點到人資室報到。

sentences.en: Please report a problem with your computer to the IT department instead of trying to fix it yourself.
sentences.zh: 電腦有問題請回報資訊部，不要自己嘗試修理。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant will report directly to the director of marketing in her new role as brand manager.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐擔任新職品牌經理後，將直接向行銷總監報告。

sentences.en: The local newspaper will report the results of the city election in tomorrow morning's edition.
sentences.zh: 地方報紙會在明天的報紙上報導市長選舉的結果。

sentences.en: If you see anything unusual in the building, please report it to the security guard immediately.
sentences.zh: 如果你在大樓裡看到任何不尋常的事，請立刻通報保全。

words.note: 語塊：report to（向……報告；直屬於）、report a problem（回報問題）、be reported（被報導）。report to sb 也可以表示「直屬於某人」；reporter 是「記者」。

sentences.en: The factory is hiring a machine operator who has at least two years of experience working with heavy equipment.
sentences.zh: 工廠正在招募一位有操作重型設備經驗的機器操作員。

sentences.en: The tour operator offers trips to the mountains that include hotels, meals, and a local guide.
sentences.zh: 那家旅遊業者提供上山的行程，包含飯店、餐點和在地導遊。

sentences.en: If you need help, please press zero and a telephone operator will answer your call.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，請按零，接線生會接聽你的電話。

sentences.en: Every machine operator must complete safety training before working on the production line for the first time.
sentences.zh: 每位機器操作員在上生產線工作前，都必須完成安全訓練。

sentences.en: The airline is the largest operator of flights between the two cities, with ten flights every day.
sentences.zh: 那家航空公司是兩座城市之間最大的航班業者，每天有十個航班。

words.note: 語塊：machine operator（機器操作員）、tour operator（旅遊業者）、telephone operator（接線生）。operator 可以是「操作機器的人」，也可以指「經營某業務的公司」。

sentences.en: The rising cost of raw material such as steel and copper has made it more expensive to produce cars.
sentences.zh: 鋼和銅等原料成本上漲，讓汽車的生產成本變高了。

sentences.en: The factory must import raw material from overseas because it is not available in the country.
sentences.zh: 工廠必須從海外進口原料，因為國內沒有。

sentences.en: Cotton is the main raw material used by the company to make its shirts and dresses.
sentences.zh: 棉花是那家公司用來做襯衫和洋裝的主要原料。

sentences.en: Delays in the delivery of raw material forced the factory to stop production for three days.
sentences.zh: 原料延遲到貨，迫使工廠停產三天。

sentences.en: The company found a new supplier that can provide raw material at a lower price than before.
sentences.zh: 公司找到一家新供應商，能以比以前更低的價格提供原料。

words.note: 語塊：the cost of raw material（原料成本）、import raw material（進口原料）、the main raw material（主要原料）、provide raw material（提供原料）。raw material 常用複數 raw materials；raw 是「未加工的、生的」。

words.meaning: 報導；（保險）承保範圍；涵蓋範圍

sentences.en: The new product received a lot of media coverage after it won an award at the technology fair.
sentences.zh: 新產品在科技展得獎後，獲得大量媒體報導。

sentences.en: Please check your insurance coverage before you travel abroad, as some medical costs may not be included.
sentences.zh: 出國前請確認你的保險保障範圍，因為有些醫療費用可能不包含在內。

sentences.en: The mobile company has improved its network coverage in rural areas and small mountain villages this year.
sentences.zh: 那家電信公司改善了鄉村地區和山區村落的網路覆蓋範圍。

sentences.en: Full-time employees receive health insurance coverage for themselves and their families from the first day of work.
sentences.zh: 全職員工本人和家人都享有健康保險保障。

sentences.en: The television station provided live coverage of the election results throughout the night until the final count.
sentences.zh: 電視台整晚現場報導選舉結果。

words.note: 語塊：media coverage（媒體報導）、insurance coverage（保險保障）、network coverage（網路覆蓋範圍）。coverage 可以是新聞「報導」、保險「保障範圍」或手機訊號「覆蓋範圍」。

sentences.en: Train drivers plan to go on strike next week if their demands for higher wages are not met.
sentences.zh: 如果加薪要求沒有被接受，火車司機打算下週罷工。

sentences.en: Many flights were canceled because the airport workers were on strike for three days last week.
sentences.zh: 因為機場員工罷工三天，很多航班被取消。

sentences.en: A strike by factory workers has delayed the production of the company's new electric car.
sentences.zh: 工廠工人的罷工延誤了公司新電動車的生產。

sentences.en: The union decided to go on strike after talks with management broke down on Friday evening.
sentences.zh: 週五晚上和資方的談判破裂後，工會決定罷工。

sentences.en: Teachers in several cities are on strike, so many schools will be closed until the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 好幾個城市的老師正在罷工，所以很多學校會停課到週末。

words.note: 語塊：go on strike（罷工）、be on strike（正在罷工）、a strike by（……的罷工）。strike 當名詞常指「罷工」；當動詞是「打；（災害）侵襲」，過去式 struck。

sentences.en: The company donated the equivalent of one month's profits to help families affected by the flood.
sentences.zh: 公司捐出相當於一個月利潤的金額，幫助受水災影響的家庭。

sentences.en: A score of 90 on this test is roughly equivalent to an A in most schools.
sentences.zh: 這個考試的 90 分大概等同於大部分學校的 A。

sentences.en: The new factory will produce the equivalent of ten thousand cars every year when it is fully operating.
sentences.zh: 新工廠全面運作時，每年將生產相當於一萬輛汽車的數量。

sentences.en: Applicants must have a university degree in business or an equivalent amount of work experience.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須有商學學位，或同等的工作經驗。

sentences.en: The price of the hotel room is equivalent to about one hundred dollars per night, including breakfast.
sentences.zh: 飯店房價相當於每晚大約一百美元，含早餐。

words.note: 語塊：the equivalent of（相當於……）、equivalent to（等同於）。equivalent 可以當名詞或形容詞；equal 是「相等的」。

sentences.en: A total of three hundred people attended the conference, which was more than the organizers expected.
sentences.zh: 總共有三百人參加研討會，比主辦單位預期的還多。

sentences.en: In total, the renovation of the office took four months and cost about two million dollars.
sentences.zh: 辦公室翻修總共花了四個月，花費大約兩百萬美元。

sentences.en: The grand total for your order, including tax and shipping, is shown at the bottom of the invoice.
sentences.zh: 你訂單的總計金額，含稅和運費，列在發票的最下方。

sentences.en: The company opened a total of fifteen new stores in Asia last year, mostly in large cities.
sentences.zh: 公司去年在亞洲總共開了十五家新店，大部分在大城市。

sentences.en: The total of all expenses must not be higher than the budget that was approved by the director.
sentences.zh: 所有支出的總額不得超過總監核准的預算。

words.note: 語塊：in total（總共）、a total of（總共……）、grand total（總計）。total 可以當名詞、形容詞（total cost）或動詞「總計達」；totally 是副詞「完全地」。

sentences.en: Customer satisfaction is our top priority, so we ask every customer to complete a short survey.
sentences.zh: 顧客滿意度是我們的首要之務，所以我們請每位顧客填寫一份簡短的問卷。

sentences.en: Studies show that job satisfaction is higher among employees who can choose their working hours.
sentences.zh: 研究顯示，可以自己選工作時間的員工工作滿意度比較高。

sentences.en: The repair was completed to the customer's satisfaction, and she gave the technician a good review.
sentences.zh: 維修完成得讓顧客很滿意，她給技師一個好評。

sentences.en: The hotel improved its customer satisfaction scores by training its staff and renovating the rooms.
sentences.zh: 飯店透過訓練員工和翻修客房，提高了顧客滿意度分數。

sentences.en: Many workers say that a friendly team is more important for job satisfaction than a high salary.
sentences.zh: 很多上班族說，對工作滿意度來說，友善的團隊比高薪更重要。

words.note: 語塊：customer satisfaction（顧客滿意度）、job satisfaction（工作滿意度）、to one's satisfaction（令某人滿意）。satisfaction 是名詞；satisfy 是動詞；satisfied 是「感到滿意的」。

sentences.en: The new parking rules will go into effect on the first of next month for all employees and visitors.
sentences.zh: 新停車規定將在下個月一號對所有員工和訪客生效。

sentences.en: The price increase will go into effect in January, so customers should buy their tickets before then.
sentences.zh: 漲價將在一月生效，所以顧客應該在那之前買票。

sentences.en: The law banning plastic bags will go into effect next year, and stores must offer paper bags instead.
sentences.zh: 禁止塑膠袋的法律明年生效，商店必須改提供紙袋。

sentences.en: Changes to the vacation policy will go into effect after they are approved by the board of directors.
sentences.zh: 休假規定的修改經董事會核准後生效。

sentences.en: The new safety rules will immediately go into effect, so all workers must wear helmets starting today.
sentences.zh: 新的安全規定立即生效，所以從今天起所有工人都必須戴安全帽。

words.note: 語塊：go into effect on（在……生效）、immediately go into effect（立即生效）。go into effect 和 take effect、come into effect 意思相同，用在法規、政策。

sentences.en: The two countries signed a trade agreement that will reduce taxes on cars and electronics.
sentences.zh: 兩國簽署了一項貿易協定，將降低汽車和電子產品的關稅。

sentences.en: Our company will display its newest products at the trade show in Frankfurt next month.
sentences.zh: 我們公司下個月會在法蘭克福的商展上展出最新產品。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen studied international trade at university and now works for a shipping company in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐大學讀國際貿易，現在在新加坡一家航運公司工作。

sentences.en: Many small businesses meet new customers and suppliers at the annual trade show in the capital.
sentences.zh: 很多小企業在首都的年度商展上認識新客戶和供應商。

sentences.en: The new trade agreement is expected to increase exports of fruit and vegetables to Asia.
sentences.zh: 新的貿易協定預計會增加蔬果出口到亞洲。

words.note: 語塊：trade agreement（貿易協定）、trade show（商展）、international trade（國際貿易）。trade 可以是「貿易」，也可以指某種「行業、手藝」（learn a trade）。

sentences.en: Ms. Ward is a skilled negotiator who helped the company get much better prices from its suppliers.
sentences.zh: Ward 小姐是一位熟練的談判者，幫公司從供應商那裡拿到更好的價格。

sentences.en: The union chose an experienced negotiator to represent the workers in talks with management about wages.
sentences.zh: 工會選了一位有經驗的談判者代表工人和資方談判。

sentences.en: The chief negotiator for the government will meet with officials from the other country next week.
sentences.zh: 政府的首席談判代表下週會和對方國家的官員見面。

sentences.en: A good negotiator listens carefully and tries to find a solution that benefits both sides.
sentences.zh: 好的談判者會仔細聆聽，努力找到對雙方都有利的解決辦法。

sentences.en: The company hired a professional negotiator to help it buy the land for the new factory.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位專業談判者，幫忙買下新工廠的土地。

words.note: 語塊：skilled negotiator（熟練的談判者）、chief negotiator（首席談判代表）、experienced negotiator（有經驗的談判者）、a good negotiator（好的談判者）。negotiator 是「談判的人」；negotiate 是動詞；negotiation 是名詞「談判」。

sentences.en: You can pick up your package at the post office after showing your ID and the delivery notice.
sentences.zh: 你出示身分證和到貨通知後，就可以在郵局領取包裹。

sentences.en: The hotel shuttle will pick up guests at the airport every thirty minutes from six in the morning.
sentences.zh: 飯店接駁車從早上六點起每三十分鐘到機場接客人。

sentences.en: Sales usually pick up in December, when many people buy gifts for their friends and family.
sentences.zh: 銷售通常在十二月回升，那時很多人會買節慶禮物。

sentences.en: Please pick up your name badge at the registration desk before entering the conference hall.
sentences.zh: 進入會議廳前，請到報到處領取名牌。

sentences.en: I will pick up the clients from their hotel and bring them to the office for the meeting at ten.
sentences.zh: 我會去飯店接客戶，帶他們到辦公室參加十點的會議。

words.note: 語塊：pick up a package（取包裹）、pick sb up（接某人）、sales pick up（銷售回升）。pick up 可以是「去接、去拿」，也可以表示「好轉、回升」。

sentences.en: The construction team has made good progress, and the building should be finished by next spring.
sentences.zh: 施工團隊進展良好，大樓應該在明年春天前完工。

sentences.en: Please do not enter the meeting room while the job interview is in progress this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 面試進行中時，請不要進入會議室。

sentences.en: Each project manager must submit a progress report to the director at the end of every month.
sentences.zh: 每位專案經理都必須在每個月底向總監提交進度報告。

sentences.en: The new employee has made a lot of progress since she started working here three months ago.
sentences.zh: 那位新員工三個月前開始在這裡工作以來，進步了很多。

sentences.en: Renovation work is in progress on the third floor, so please use the stairs on the east side.
sentences.zh: 三樓正在進行翻修工程，所以請走東側的樓梯。

words.note: 語塊：make progress（取得進展）、in progress（進行中）、progress report（進度報告）。progress 當名詞是不可數的（make good progress）；當動詞重音在後。

sentences.en: The company built a new warehouse near the port so that it can ship products overseas more quickly.
sentences.zh: 公司在港口附近蓋了一座新倉庫，可以更快把產品運往海外。

sentences.en: The warehouse manager is responsible for checking every shipment that arrives from the factory each morning.
sentences.zh: 倉庫經理負責檢查從工廠送來的每一批貨。

sentences.en: Unsold products are stored in a warehouse outside the city until they are needed in the stores.
sentences.zh: 賣不完的產品會存放在城外的倉庫，直到門市需要為止。

sentences.en: The warehouse staff work in shifts so that orders can be packed and shipped twenty-four hours a day.
sentences.zh: 倉庫人員輪班工作，讓訂單能二十四小時包裝出貨。

sentences.en: The old warehouse near the river has been turned into a popular market with shops and restaurants.
sentences.zh: 河邊的舊倉庫已經改建成有商店和餐廳的熱門市集。

words.note: 語塊：warehouse manager（倉庫經理）、store in a warehouse（存放在倉庫）、warehouse staff（倉庫人員）。warehouse 是「存放貨物的大倉庫」；storage room 是「儲藏室」。

sentences.en: The university opened a new research laboratory that will focus on developing cleaner sources of energy.
sentences.zh: 那所大學啟用了一座新的研究實驗室，專注開發更乾淨的能源。

sentences.en: The doctor sent the blood samples for a laboratory test to find out the cause of the patient's illness.
sentences.zh: 醫生把血液樣本送去做實驗室檢驗，找出病人生病的原因。

sentences.en: Visitors must wear safety glasses and gloves at all times when they are in the laboratory.
sentences.zh: 訪客在實驗室裡必須隨時戴護目鏡和手套。

sentences.en: The company spent two million dollars on new equipment for its research laboratory in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 公司花了兩百萬美元為首爾的研究實驗室購買新設備。

sentences.en: The results of the laboratory test showed that the water from the river was safe to drink.
sentences.zh: 實驗室檢驗結果顯示河水可以安全飲用。

words.note: 語塊：research laboratory（研究實驗室）、laboratory test（實驗室檢驗）、in the laboratory（在實驗室裡）。laboratory 常縮寫成 lab；lavatory（廁所）長得像，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: Please fill out an application form and attach a copy of your résumé if you are interested in the job.
sentences.zh: 如果你對這份工作有興趣，請填寫申請表並附上一份履歷。

sentences.en: All students must submit an application form for the scholarship by the end of March.
sentences.zh: 所有學生都必須在三月底前提交獎學金申請表。

sentences.en: The online application form takes about fifteen minutes to complete and can be saved at any time.
sentences.zh: 線上申請表大約十五分鐘就能填完，而且隨時可以儲存。

sentences.en: Incomplete application forms will not be accepted, so please check that every application form is fully filled out.
sentences.zh: 不完整的申請表不會被受理，所以請確認每一份申請表都填寫完整。

sentences.en: You can download the application form from our website or pick one up at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 你可以從我們網站下載申請表，或到櫃台索取。

words.note: 語塊：fill out an application form（填寫申請表）、submit an application form（提交申請表）、online application form（線上申請表）。application 是「申請」；applicant 是「申請人」。

sentences.en: The new software will facilitate communication between our offices in Asia, Europe, and North America.
sentences.zh: 新軟體將促進我們亞洲、歐洲和北美辦公室之間的溝通。

sentences.en: To facilitate the process, please bring all of the required documents to your first appointment.
sentences.zh: 為了讓流程更順利，請在第一次預約時帶齊所有必要文件。

sentences.en: Ms. Ito was invited to facilitate discussion at the workshop on leadership for new managers.
sentences.zh: 伊藤小姐受邀在新任經理領導力工作坊上帶領討論。

sentences.en: The government built new roads to facilitate trade between the two neighboring countries in the region.
sentences.zh: 政府興建新道路，促進兩個鄰國之間的貿易。

sentences.en: The online booking system was designed to facilitate the process of reserving meeting rooms in the building.
sentences.zh: 線上預約系統是為了讓預訂會議室的流程更順利而設計的。

words.note: 語塊：facilitate communication（促進溝通）、facilitate the process（讓流程更順利）、facilitate discussion（帶領討論）。facilitate 是「讓事情更容易進行」；facility 是「設施」；facilitator 是「引導者」。

sentences.en: In general, customers prefer to shop online because it is faster and more convenient than visiting stores.
sentences.zh: 一般來說，顧客比較喜歡網路購物，因為比去實體店更快更方便。

sentences.en: The feedback from the training session was positive in general, but some people wanted more examples.
sentences.zh: 訓練課程的回饋大致上是正面的，但有些人希望有更多例子。

sentences.en: People in general are spending more money on travel and entertainment than they did ten years ago.
sentences.zh: 一般大眾現在花在旅遊和娛樂上的錢比十年前多。

sentences.en: In general, the hotel's rooms are clean and comfortable, although the breakfast could be improved.
sentences.zh: 一般來說，飯店的房間乾淨又舒適，不過早餐還可以改進。

sentences.en: Small businesses in general have been affected by the rising cost of rent in the city center.
sentences.zh: 小企業大體上都受到市中心房租上漲的影響。

words.note: 語塊：in general（大體上）、people in general（一般大眾）。in general 和 generally、on the whole 意思接近；放在句首時後面常加逗號。

sentences.en: Nearly all of the tickets for the concert were sold within the first hour of going on sale.
sentences.zh: 演唱會門票開賣第一個小時內幾乎全部賣光。

sentences.en: The construction of the new library is nearly finished and will open to the public in October.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館的工程快完成了，將在十月對外開放。

sentences.en: The number of visitors to the museum has nearly doubled since it added the new science exhibit.
sentences.zh: 自從增加新的科學展後，博物館的參觀人數將近翻倍。

sentences.en: It took nearly three hours to drive to the airport because of the heavy snow on the highway.
sentences.zh: 因為公路上下大雪，開到機場花了將近三個小時。

sentences.en: Nearly all of our employees use public transportation or ride bicycles to get to the office.
sentences.zh: 我們幾乎所有員工都搭大眾運輸或騎腳踏車到辦公室。

words.note: 語塊：nearly all（幾乎全部）、nearly finished（快完成了）、nearly double（將近一倍）。nearly 和 almost 意思相同；near 是「靠近」。

sentences.en: Workers in the laboratory must wear protective clothing when they handle dangerous chemicals or samples.
sentences.zh: 實驗室的工作人員處理危險化學品時必須穿防護衣。

sentences.en: The new clothing store on Main Street sells shirts, dresses, and jackets made from organic cotton.
sentences.zh: Main 街那家新服飾店販售用有機棉做的襯衫、洋裝和外套。

sentences.en: Hikers should bring warm clothing because the temperature on the mountain drops quickly at night.
sentences.zh: 登山客應該帶保暖衣物，因為山上晚上氣溫下降很快。

sentences.en: The charity collects used clothing and gives it to families who cannot afford to buy new items.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善團體收集舊衣，送給買不起新衣的家庭。

sentences.en: Sales of winter clothing increased sharply after the first heavy snow fell in early November.
sentences.zh: 十一月初下了第一場雪後，冬季服飾的銷售大幅增加。

words.note: 語塊：protective clothing（防護衣）、clothing store（服飾店）、warm clothing（保暖衣物）。clothing 是不可數名詞（總稱）；clothes 是複數；cloth 是「布料」。

sentences.en: The new office layout has fewer walls, so employees can communicate with each other more easily.
sentences.zh: 新的辦公室配置牆比較少，所以員工彼此溝通更容易。

sentences.en: The designer changed the page layout of the magazine to make the articles easier to read.
sentences.zh: 設計師改變了雜誌的版面設計，讓文章更容易閱讀。

sentences.en: The store decided to change the layout so that customers could find popular products more quickly.
sentences.zh: 那家店決定改變配置，讓顧客更快找到熱門商品。

sentences.en: Before moving in, we asked an architect to suggest an office layout that would make good use of space.
sentences.zh: 搬進去之前，我們請建築師建議一個能善用空間的辦公室配置。

sentences.en: The layout of the website is simple, with clear menus that help visitors find information quickly.
sentences.zh: 網站的版面很簡潔，有清楚的選單幫助訪客快速找到資訊。

words.note: 語塊：office layout（辦公室配置）、page layout（版面設計）、change the layout（改變配置）。layout 是「空間或版面的安排方式」；lay out（兩個字）是動詞「擺放；規劃」。

sentences.en: Visitors to the city can enjoy local cuisine at the night market near the old temple.
sentences.zh: 到這座城市的遊客可以在老廟附近的夜市享用在地料理。

sentences.en: The restaurant on the top floor of the hotel serves Italian cuisine prepared by a chef from Rome.
sentences.zh: 飯店頂樓的餐廳供應由羅馬主廚烹調的義大利菜。

sentences.en: The cooking class teaches students how to prepare traditional cuisine using fresh vegetables and spices.
sentences.zh: 烹飪課教學生用新鮮蔬菜和香料做傳統料理。

sentences.en: The food festival will feature local cuisine from more than thirty towns across the region.
sentences.zh: 美食節將有來自全區三十多個城鎮的在地料理。

sentences.en: Many tourists say that the traditional cuisine is one of the main reasons they visit the country.
sentences.zh: 很多觀光客說傳統料理是他們造訪這個國家的主要原因之一。

words.note: 語塊：local cuisine（在地料理）、Italian cuisine（義大利菜）、traditional cuisine（傳統料理）。cuisine 是「某地或某種風格的料理」；dish 是「一道菜」；cooking 是「烹飪」。

sentences.en: The new course covers topics related to marketing, accounting, and customer service for small businesses.
sentences.zh: 新課程涵蓋和行銷、會計及客服有關的主題。

sentences.en: Many of the complaints we received were closely related to the delays in delivery last month.
sentences.zh: 我們收到的很多投訴都和上個月的延遲送貨密切相關。

sentences.en: Please contact the IT department if you have any problems related to your computer or email account.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何和電腦或電子郵件帳號有關的問題，請聯絡資訊部。

sentences.en: The increase in sales is closely related to the success of our new advertising campaign.
sentences.zh: 銷售增加和我們新廣告活動的成功密切相關。

sentences.en: Experience related to the hotel industry is helpful but not required for this position at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 和飯店業有關的經驗有幫助，但這個職位不一定要有。

words.note: 語塊：be related to（和……有關）、closely related to（密切相關）、problems related to（與……有關的問題）。be related to 是「有關聯」；relative 是「親戚；相對的」；relation 是「關係」。

sentences.en: Please double-check the details of your order before you click the button to confirm your payment.
sentences.zh: 點選確認付款按鈕之前，請再次確認訂單的細節。

sentences.en: The accountant will double-check that all of the figures in the report are correct before it is sent.
sentences.zh: 會計師在報告寄出前會再次確認所有數字都正確。

sentences.en: It is a good idea to double-check the time of your flight on the day before you travel.
sentences.zh: 出發前一天再確認一次班機時間是個好主意。

sentences.en: Could you double-check the address of the client so that the package is not delivered to the wrong place?
sentences.zh: 你可以再確認一次客戶的地址嗎？以免包裹送錯地方。

sentences.en: The editor asked the writer to double-check the details in the article before it appears in the magazine.
sentences.zh: 編輯要求作者在文章刊登前再次確認其中的細節。

words.note: 語塊：double-check the details（再次確認細節）、double-check that（再次確認……）。double-check 是「再檢查一次」；check 是「檢查」。也可以寫作 double check。

sentences.en: We appreciate your help in organizing the conference and hope that you can join us again next year.
sentences.zh: 感謝你幫忙籌辦研討會，希望你明年能再加入我們。

sentences.en: I would appreciate it if you could send me the report before the meeting on Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 如果你能在週四早上開會前把報告寄給我，我將不勝感激。

sentences.en: Customers who appreciate the value of handmade furniture are willing to pay more for our products.
sentences.zh: 懂得手工家具價值的顧客願意為我們的產品付更多錢。

sentences.en: The manager told the team that she would appreciate their patience while the new system is installed.
sentences.zh: 經理告訴團隊，在新系統安裝期間，她很感謝大家的耐心。

sentences.en: Many visitors appreciate the quiet atmosphere of the library, which is especially popular with university students.
sentences.zh: 很多訪客很欣賞圖書館安靜的氣氛，那裡很受學生歡迎。

words.note: 語塊：appreciate your help（感謝你的幫忙）、would appreciate it if（如果……將不勝感激）、appreciate the value of（了解……的價值）。appreciate 後面接事物（appreciate your help），不直接接人；thank 才接人。

sentences.en: Many companies now offer flexible working hours so that employees can avoid traffic during rush hour.
sentences.zh: 現在很多公司提供彈性工時，讓員工可以避開尖峰時段的交通。

sentences.en: Parents with young children often look for jobs with flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
sentences.zh: 有幼童的父母常會找有彈性工時和可在家工作的職位。

sentences.en: Employees at our firm enjoy flexible working hours, as long as they are in the office between ten and three.
sentences.zh: 我們公司的員工享有彈性工時，只要十點到三點之間在辦公室就好。

sentences.en: Studies show that flexible working hours can improve job satisfaction and reduce stress among workers.
sentences.zh: 研究顯示，彈性工時能提高工作滿意度並減少員工的壓力。

sentences.en: The company decided to offer flexible working hours after employees asked for more balance between work and family.
sentences.zh: 員工要求工作和家庭之間更平衡後，公司決定提供彈性工時。

words.note: 語塊：offer flexible working hours（提供彈性工時）、enjoy flexible working hours（享有彈性工時）。flexible 是「有彈性的」；flextime 是「彈性上班制」的另一種說法。

sentences.en: A number of customers have asked whether the store will be open on the national holiday next week.
sentences.zh: 有一些顧客問過商店下週國定假日會不會營業。

sentences.en: A number of famous people attended the opening of the new art museum on Saturday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 有一些名人參加了週六下午新美術館的開幕。

sentences.en: The company has received a number of complaints about the noise from its new factory near the river.
sentences.zh: 公司收到了一些關於河邊新工廠噪音的投訴。

sentences.en: A number of employees will be working from home this week because the office is being renovated.
sentences.zh: 這週有一些員工會在家工作，因為辦公室正在翻修。

sentences.en: A number of tourists visit the island every summer to enjoy its beaches and seafood restaurants.
sentences.zh: 每年夏天都有一些觀光客造訪那座島，享受海灘和海鮮餐廳。

words.note: 語塊：a number of customers（一些顧客）、a number of complaints（一些投訴）、a number of employees（一些員工）。a number of 是「一些」，動詞用複數；the number of 是「……的數量」，動詞用單數。

sentences.en: The two companies hired lawyers to help them settle a dispute about the terms of their contract.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司請律師幫忙解決合約條款的糾紛。

sentences.en: There has been a long dispute over the price of the land between the developer and the city.
sentences.zh: 開發商和市政府之間對土地價格有長期的爭議。

sentences.en: The amount of money that the supplier owes us is still in dispute, so we have not paid the invoice.
sentences.zh: 供應商欠我們的金額還有爭議，所以我們還沒付那張發票。

sentences.en: The union and the management are trying to settle a dispute about working hours before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 工會和資方正努力在月底前解決工時的糾紛。

sentences.en: A dispute over parking spaces between two neighbors was finally solved by the building manager.
sentences.zh: 兩位鄰居之間的停車位糾紛最後由大樓管理員解決了。

words.note: 語塊：settle a dispute（解決糾紛）、a dispute over（關於……的爭議）、in dispute（有爭議的）。dispute 可以當名詞或動詞；argument 意思接近，dispute 比較正式、常指法律或商業糾紛。

sentences.en: The new office layout makes it easier to make good use of space and fit more desks into each room.
sentences.zh: 新的辦公室配置讓空間更容易被善用，每個房間能擺更多桌子。

sentences.en: Employees who travel by train often make good use of time by answering emails during the journey.
sentences.zh: 搭火車通勤的員工常常善用時間，在路上回覆電子郵件。

sentences.en: The restaurant tries to make good use of fresh ingredients so that very little food is wasted.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳盡量善用新鮮食材，讓浪費的食物很少。

sentences.en: To make good use of your vacation days, please plan your holidays at the beginning of the year.
sentences.zh: 為了善用你的休假天數，請在年初就規劃假期。

sentences.en: The company plans to make good use of the old warehouse by turning it into a training center.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫善用舊倉庫，把它改建成訓練中心。

words.note: 語塊：make good use of time（善用時間）、make good use of space（善用空間）、make good use of your vacation（善用假期）。make good use of 是「好好利用」；make the most of 意思接近。

sentences.en: The company hired a famous celebrity to appear in its television commercials for the new sports drink.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位知名人士為新運動飲料拍電視廣告。

sentences.en: The new restaurant was opened by a celebrity chef who has his own cooking show on television.
sentences.zh: 那家新餐廳是由一位在電視上有自己烹飪節目的名廚開的。

sentences.en: A celebrity guest will attend the opening night of the film festival and sign autographs for fans.
sentences.zh: 一位名人來賓會出席影展的開幕夜，為粉絲簽名。

sentences.en: Many brands pay a celebrity to post about their products on social media in order to reach young people.
sentences.zh: 很多品牌付錢請名人在社群媒體上發文介紹產品，以接觸年輕人。

sentences.en: The charity dinner raised a lot of money because a celebrity chef agreed to cook for the guests.
sentences.zh: 那場慈善晚宴募到很多錢，因為一位名廚同意為賓客下廚。

words.note: 語塊：famous celebrity（知名人士）、celebrity chef（名廚）、celebrity guest（名人來賓）。celebrity 是「名人」；celebration 是「慶祝活動」；celebrate 是動詞。

sentences.en: The cosmetics company will launch a product line for men at department stores next spring.
sentences.zh: 那家化妝品公司明年春天會在百貨公司推出男性產品線。

sentences.en: The bakery plans to expand its product line by adding gluten-free breads and cakes this year.
sentences.zh: 那家麵包店計畫今年增加無麩質麵包和蛋糕，擴充產品線。

sentences.en: Our new product line of kitchen appliances has been very popular with young families in the city.
sentences.zh: 我們新系列的廚房家電很受年輕家庭歡迎。

sentences.en: The company decided to stop selling its old product line because sales had been falling for several years.
sentences.zh: 公司決定停售舊的產品線，因為銷售已經連續好幾年下滑。

sentences.en: The marketing team created a new advertising campaign to promote the new product line online.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊製作了新的廣告活動，在網路上推廣新產品線。

words.note: 語塊：launch a product line（推出產品線）、expand a product line（擴充產品線）、new product line（新產品線）。product line 是「同一系列的產品」；production line 是「生產線」，兩者不同。

sentences.en: Three members of the committee decided to abstain from voting because they did not have enough information.
sentences.zh: 三位委員決定棄權不投票，因為他們沒有足夠的資訊。

sentences.en: Patients are asked to abstain from food and drink for eight hours before the medical examination.
sentences.zh: 病人在健康檢查前八小時被要求禁食禁水。

sentences.en: Pilots must abstain from alcohol for at least twelve hours before they fly an aircraft.
sentences.zh: 飛行員在駕駛飛機前至少十二小時必須禁酒。

sentences.en: Employees involved in the project should abstain from voting on the proposal to avoid any conflict of interest.
sentences.zh: 參與專案的員工應該對提案投票棄權，以避免利益衝突。

sentences.en: The doctor advised Mr. Brown to abstain from alcohol and coffee while he is taking the medication.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議 Brown 先生服藥期間戒酒、不喝咖啡。

words.note: 語塊：abstain from voting（投票棄權）、abstain from alcohol（戒酒）。abstain from 是正式的「不做、克制」；refrain from 意思接近。

sentences.en: The marketing department will carry out a survey to find out what customers think about our new logo.
sentences.zh: 行銷部會進行一項調查，了解顧客對我們新商標的看法。

sentences.en: Scientists at the university carry out research on new medicines for heart disease and diabetes.
sentences.zh: 那所大學的科學家從事心臟病和糖尿病新藥的研究。

sentences.en: The manager asked the team to carry out the plan as quickly as possible before the busy season begins.
sentences.zh: 經理要團隊在旺季開始前盡快執行計畫。

sentences.en: Inspectors will carry out a safety check of the building before it opens to the public next month.
sentences.zh: 大樓下個月對外開放前，檢查員會進行一次安全檢查。

sentences.en: We need more staff and a larger budget in order to carry out a plan of this size successfully.
sentences.zh: 我們需要更多人手和更多預算，才能成功執行這種規模的計畫。

words.note: 語塊：carry out a survey（進行調查）、carry out research（從事研究）、carry out a plan（執行計畫）。carry out 是「執行、完成（計畫、任務）」；conduct 意思接近，比較正式。

sentences.en: The company offers an incentive of five hundred dollars to employees who reach their sales targets.
sentences.zh: 公司提供五百美元獎勵給達成業績目標的員工。

sentences.en: The government introduced a tax incentive to encourage people to buy electric cars instead of gas cars.
sentences.zh: 政府推出租稅優惠，鼓勵民眾買電動車而不是汽油車。

sentences.en: Free parking is a good incentive to attract more shoppers to the new mall outside the city.
sentences.zh: 免費停車是吸引更多購物者到城外新購物中心的好誘因。

sentences.en: Customers have an incentive to join the loyalty program because members receive special discounts and free gifts.
sentences.zh: 顧客有加入忠誠計畫的誘因，因為會員享有特別折扣。

sentences.en: The city plans to offer an incentive to businesses that hire young people from the local area.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫提供獎勵給聘用當地年輕人的企業。

words.note: 語塊：offer an incentive（提供獎勵）、tax incentive（租稅優惠）、incentive to（做……的誘因）。incentive 是「讓人想去做的獎勵」；motivation 是「動機」。

sentences.en: The new machines are more efficient and can produce twice as many products in the same amount of time.
sentences.zh: 新機器更有效率，能在同樣的時間內生產兩倍的產品。

sentences.en: Replacing old lights with energy-efficient ones has helped the company reduce its monthly electricity bills.
sentences.zh: 把舊燈換成節能燈，幫助公司降低了電費。

sentences.en: The online system allows for more efficient use of staff time because forms no longer need to be printed.
sentences.zh: 線上系統讓員工的時間能更有效利用，因為表格不再需要列印。

sentences.en: Our goal is to make the delivery process more efficient so that customers receive their orders sooner.
sentences.zh: 我們的目標是讓配送流程更有效率，讓顧客更快收到訂單。

sentences.en: The hotel installed energy-efficient air conditioners in every room as part of its plan to protect the environment.
sentences.zh: 飯店在每間客房安裝節能冷氣，作為保護環境計畫的一部分。

words.note: 語塊：energy-efficient（節能的）、more efficient（更有效率）、efficient use of（有效利用）。efficient 是「有效率、不浪費」；effective 是「有效果的」，重點不同。

sentences.en: The tourism industry is expected to recover from the effects of the storm by the end of the summer.
sentences.zh: 觀光業預計在夏天結束前從暴風雨的影響中恢復。

sentences.en: The company hopes to recover costs from the new factory within three years of opening it.
sentences.zh: 公司希望在新工廠開工後三年內收回成本。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim needed two months to fully recover after his surgery before he returned to work.
sentences.zh: 金先生手術後需要兩個月才完全康復，回去上班。

sentences.en: It may take several years for the economy to recover from the financial crisis that began last year.
sentences.zh: 經濟可能需要好幾年才能從金融危機中恢復。

sentences.en: The IT team was able to recover most of the files that were lost when the server stopped working.
sentences.zh: 伺服器停止運作時遺失的檔案，資訊團隊救回了大部分。

words.note: 語塊：recover from（從……中恢復）、recover costs（收回成本）、fully recover（完全康復）。recover 可以是「身體康復」、「經濟復甦」或「拿回（損失）」；recovery 是名詞。

sentences.en: Please save your work often, as the old computers in the office sometimes crash without any warning.
sentences.zh: 請經常存檔，因為舊電腦有時會毫無預警地當機。

sentences.en: If the website begins to crash when too many people visit it, we will need more servers.
sentences.zh: 如果網站在太多人造訪時開始當機，我們就需要更多伺服器。

sentences.en: Experts warn that housing prices could crash if interest rates rise too quickly next year.
sentences.zh: 專家警告，如果明年利率上升太快，房價可能會暴跌。

sentences.en: The new software update should stop the program from causing the system to crash every afternoon.
sentences.zh: 新的軟體更新應該能讓程式不再每天下午造成系統當機。

sentences.en: The app may crash if you open too many windows at once, so please close the ones you are not using.
sentences.zh: 如果同時開太多視窗，App 可能會當機，所以請關掉沒在用的。

words.note: 語塊：computer crash（電腦當機）、the system crashed（系統當機）、prices crash（價格暴跌）。crash 可以是「撞擊、墜毀」，電腦「當機」，或市場「崩盤」。

sentences.en: The fire spread quickly through the warehouse, but fortunately no one was injured in the accident.
sentences.zh: 火勢迅速蔓延整座倉庫，但幸好意外中沒有人受傷。

sentences.en: Fortunately for the company, the new product became popular soon after it was launched in stores.
sentences.zh: 對公司來說幸運的是，新產品在門市上市後很快就受到歡迎。

sentences.en: Our flight was delayed by three hours, but fortunately we still arrived in time for the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我們的班機延誤三小時，但幸好還是及時趕上了會議。

sentences.en: Fortunately, the damaged package contained only books and clothing, so nothing inside was broken during delivery.
sentences.zh: 幸好受損的包裹裡只有書和衣服，所以運送過程中沒有東西壞掉。

sentences.en: The computer stopped working this morning, but fortunately all of the files had been saved online.
sentences.zh: 電腦今天早上壞了，但幸好所有檔案都已經存在網路上。

words.note: 語塊：fortunately for（對……來說幸運的是）。fortunately 常放句首，後面加逗號；unfortunately 是「不幸地、可惜」。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim introduced me to a business associate who might be interested in investing in our company.
sentences.zh: 金先生介紹一位可能有興趣投資我們公司的商業夥伴給我認識。

sentences.en: The store is looking for a sales associate who can work on weekends and speak both English and Spanish.
sentences.zh: 那家店在找一位週末能上班、會說英文和西班牙文的店員。

sentences.en: Dr. Lin works as a research associate at the university and studies the effects of air pollution.
sentences.zh: 林博士在大學擔任研究助理，研究空氣污染的影響。

sentences.en: Each sales associate is trained to help customers find the right products and answer their questions.
sentences.zh: 每位店員都受過訓練，幫助顧客找到合適的商品並回答問題。

sentences.en: The lawyer met with a business associate from Japan to discuss the details of the new contract.
sentences.zh: 律師和一位日本的商業夥伴見面，討論新合約的細節。

words.note: 語塊：business associate（商業夥伴）、sales associate（店員）、research associate（研究助理）。associate 當名詞是「工作上的夥伴」；當動詞是「聯想；交往」（associate A with B）。

sentences.en: Please make certain that all of the doors are locked before you leave the office at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上離開辦公室前，請確定所有的門都鎖好了。

sentences.en: The job requires a certain amount of travel, so applicants must be willing to work abroad.
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要一定程度的出差，所以應徵者必須願意到國外工作。

sentences.en: Customers can return products for a full refund only under certain conditions listed on the receipt.
sentences.zh: 顧客只有在收據上列出的某些條件下才能退貨並全額退款。

sentences.en: The manager is certain that the new advertising campaign will increase sales during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 經理確定新的廣告活動會在節慶期間增加銷售。

sentences.en: Certain areas of the factory are closed to visitors for safety reasons, so please follow your guide.
sentences.zh: 工廠的某些區域為了安全不對訪客開放，所以請跟著導覽員走。

words.note: 語塊：be certain that（確定……）、a certain amount of（一定量的）、certain conditions（某些條件）。certain 放在名詞前是「某些的」，放在 be 動詞後是「確定的」；certainly 是「當然」。

sentences.en: The company will release its quarterly earnings report on Thursday, and investors are expecting good results.
sentences.zh: 公司週四將公布季度財報，投資人預期會有好結果。

sentences.en: The average annual earnings of workers in the technology industry have increased over the past five years.
sentences.zh: 科技業員工的平均年收入在過去五年增加了。

sentences.en: Quarterly earnings were lower than expected because of rising costs for raw materials and international shipping.
sentences.zh: 季度盈餘比預期低，因為材料和運輸成本上漲。

sentences.en: Many young people take part-time jobs in the evening to increase their annual earnings and save money.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕人晚上兼差來增加年收入。

sentences.en: The CEO explained the results of the earnings report to shareholders at the annual meeting.
sentences.zh: 執行長在年度大會上向股東說明財報的結果。

words.note: 語塊：annual earnings（年收入）、quarterly earnings（季度盈餘）、earnings report（財報）。earnings 一定用複數，指「賺到的錢」；income、profit 意思接近。

sentences.en: The company makes a charitable donation to the children's hospital every year at Christmas and New Year.
sentences.zh: 公司每年聖誕節都會捐一筆慈善捐款給兒童醫院。

sentences.en: Ms. Lopez volunteers at a charitable organization that provides meals for elderly people who live alone.
sentences.zh: Lopez 小姐在一個為獨居長者提供餐點的慈善機構當志工。

sentences.en: The hotel will host a charitable event next month to raise money for schools in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 飯店下個月會舉辦一場慈善活動，為鄉村地區的學校募款。

sentences.en: Employees who make a charitable donation through the company program will receive a tax receipt.
sentences.zh: 透過公司計畫做慈善捐款的員工會收到一張稅務收據。

sentences.en: The bank works closely with a charitable organization that helps low-income families find safe and affordable housing.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行和一個協助低收入家庭找到安全、負擔得起住處的慈善機構密切合作。

words.note: 語塊：charitable organization（慈善機構）、charitable donation（慈善捐款）、charitable event（慈善活動）。charitable 是形容詞；charity 是名詞「慈善團體；慈善」。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed works for a non-profit organization that helps young people find jobs after they finish school.
sentences.zh: Ahmed 小姐在一個幫助年輕人畢業後找工作的非營利組織工作。

sentences.en: The conference was organized by an international organization that promotes clean energy around the world.
sentences.zh: 研討會是由一個在全球推廣潔淨能源的國際組織主辦的。

sentences.en: Many students join an organization at their university to meet new people and develop leadership skills.
sentences.zh: 很多學生在大學加入社團，認識新朋友並培養領導能力。

sentences.en: The organization raised more than one million dollars last year to build schools in developing countries.
sentences.zh: 那個組織去年募到一百多萬美元，在開發中國家蓋學校。

sentences.en: Each organization that attends the job fair will have a table where students can ask questions.
sentences.zh: 每個參加就業博覽會的機構都會有一張桌子，讓學生可以發問。

words.note: 語塊：non-profit organization（非營利組織）、international organization（國際組織）、join an organization（加入組織）。organization 是「組織、團體」；organize 是動詞「籌辦」；英式拼法 organisation。

sentences.en: The company decided to freeze hiring until the end of the year because sales have been lower than expected.
sentences.zh: 公司決定凍結人事到年底，因為銷售比預期低。

sentences.en: The government asked the electricity company to freeze prices for six months to help families.
sentences.zh: 政府要求電力公司凍漲六個月，幫助家庭度過難關。

sentences.en: You can freeze the soup for up to three months and heat it up whenever you want to eat it.
sentences.zh: 這道湯可以冷凍保存最多三個月，想吃的時候再加熱。

sentences.en: Water pipes can freeze during very cold nights, so please keep the heat on in the building.
sentences.zh: 在非常冷的夜晚水管可能會結冰，所以請讓大樓的暖氣保持開著。

sentences.en: The university will freeze tuition fees next year so that more students can afford to study there.
sentences.zh: 那所大學明年會凍漲學費，讓更多學生負擔得起在那裡就讀。

words.note: 語塊：freeze prices（凍漲）、freeze hiring（凍結人事）、freeze food（冷凍食物）、freeze tuition fees（凍漲學費）。freeze 過去式 froze、過去分詞 frozen；freezer 是「冷凍庫」。

sentences.en: Passengers must turn off their phones before the plane can take off from the runway.
sentences.zh: 飛機從跑道起飛前，乘客必須關掉手機。

sentences.en: Sales of the new phone began to take off after a famous singer used it in her music video.
sentences.zh: 一位知名歌手在音樂錄影帶中使用那支新手機後，銷售開始爆增。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee plans to take off from work next Friday to attend her daughter's graduation ceremony.
sentences.zh: 李小姐打算下週五請假，參加女兒的畢業典禮。

sentences.en: The flight was able to take off on time even though the weather was cloudy and windy.
sentences.zh: 雖然天氣多雲又有風，班機還是準時起飛了。

sentences.en: The online business did not take off until the owner started advertising on social media.
sentences.zh: 直到老闆開始在社群媒體上打廣告，那個網路事業才起飛。

words.note: 語塊：take off on time（準時起飛）、take off from work（請假不上班）、sales take off（銷售爆增）。take off 可以是飛機「起飛」、生意「突然成功」，或 take time off「休假」。

sentences.en: The key finding of the study was that employees who exercise regularly take fewer sick days.
sentences.zh: 這項研究的主要發現是規律運動的員工請病假的天數比較少。

sentences.en: The research team will present its finding at the international conference in Berlin next month.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊下個月會在柏林的國際研討會上發表它的發現。

sentences.en: The finding that most customers prefer shopping online surprised the owners of the department store.
sentences.zh: 大多數顧客偏好網路購物的這項發現讓百貨公司的老闆很意外。

sentences.en: One important finding of the survey is that young people care more about the environment than before.
sentences.zh: 調查的一項重要發現是年輕人比以前更在乎環境。

sentences.en: Based on this finding, the company decided to spend more money on advertising through mobile apps.
sentences.zh: 根據這項發現，公司決定在手機 App 廣告上花更多錢。

words.note: 語塊：research findings（研究結果）、key finding（主要發現）、the finding that（……的發現）。finding 是「調查或研究得到的結果」，常用複數 findings；find 是動詞。

sentences.en: The new manager is determined to improve customer service in all of the company's stores this year.
sentences.zh: 新經理下定決心要在今年改善公司所有門市的客服。

sentences.en: After losing the contract, the sales team was determined to win the next one from the same client.
sentences.zh: 失去那份合約後，業務團隊決心要拿下同一位客戶的下一份合約。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz is determined to finish her degree while working full-time at the bank downtown.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐下定決心要在銀行全職工作的同時完成學位。

sentences.en: The city is determined to reduce traffic in the downtown area by building more bicycle lanes.
sentences.zh: 市政府決心要增建自行車道，減少市中心的車流。

sentences.en: The company was determined to become the market leader in electric cars within ten years.
sentences.zh: 那家公司決心在十年內成為電動車的市場領導者。

words.note: 語塊：be determined to（決心要……）、more determined than ever（比以往更堅決）。be determined to + 原形動詞是「下定決心做」；determination 是名詞「決心」。

sentences.en: Please read through the contract carefully before you sign it and send it back to our office.
sentences.zh: 簽名寄回我們辦公室之前，請仔細讀完合約。

sentences.en: The editor will read through the report one more time to check for spelling mistakes.
sentences.zh: 編輯會再把報告從頭到尾讀一次，檢查拼字錯誤。

sentences.en: New employees should read through the handbook during their first week to learn the company's rules.
sentences.zh: 新員工應該在第一週讀完手冊，了解公司的規定。

sentences.en: It took me two hours to read through all of the comments that customers left on our website.
sentences.zh: 我花了兩個小時才讀完顧客在我們網站上留下的所有評論。

sentences.en: Before the meeting, please read through the proposal and write down any questions you may have.
sentences.zh: 開會前，請讀完提案並寫下你可能有的任何問題。

words.note: 語塊：read through the contract（仔細讀完合約）、read through the report（讀完報告）、read through all of（讀完所有……）、read through the proposal（讀完提案）。read through 是「從頭到尾仔細讀」；look through 是「瀏覽」。

sentences.en: We offer several plans so that customers can choose the one that will suit their needs best.
sentences.zh: 我們提供好幾種方案，讓顧客選擇最符合需求的一種。

sentences.en: The meeting time does not suit everyone, so we will try to find another day next week.
sentences.zh: 會議時間不是每個人都方便，所以我們會試著找下週的另一天。

sentences.en: The designer will help you choose furniture that will best suit the size and style of your office.
sentences.zh: 設計師會幫你挑選最適合你辦公室大小和風格的家具。

sentences.en: The new schedule should suit employees who need to pick up their children from school.
sentences.zh: 新的班表應該適合需要去學校接孩子的員工。

sentences.en: The small apartment does not suit a large family, but it is perfect for a single person.
sentences.zh: 那間小公寓不適合大家庭，但很適合單身的人。

words.note: 語塊：suit one's needs（符合需求）、suit everyone（適合每個人）、best suit（最適合）。suit 當動詞是「適合」（This plan suits me）；當名詞是「西裝」；suitable 是形容詞「合適的」。

sentences.en: The restaurant received an excellent review from a famous food critic in the local newspaper.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳在地方報紙上獲得一位知名美食評論家的極佳評論。

sentences.en: Your application is currently under review, and we will contact you by email within two weeks.
sentences.zh: 你的申請目前正在審查中，我們會在兩週內聯絡你。

sentences.en: Each employee has a performance review with their manager at the end of every year.
sentences.zh: 每位員工每年年底都會和經理進行一次績效考核。

sentences.en: Please leave a customer review on our website to let us know what you think about our service.
sentences.zh: 請在我們網站上留下顧客評論，讓我們知道你對我們服務的看法。

sentences.en: The new safety rules are under review and may be changed before they go into effect.
sentences.zh: 新的安全規定正在審查中，生效前可能會修改。

words.note: 語塊：customer review（顧客評論）、under review（審查中）、performance review（績效考核）。review 可以是「評論」或「審查、檢討」；preview 是「預覽」。

sentences.en: The university uses special software to check for plagiarism in every essay that students submit.
sentences.zh: 那所大學用特殊軟體檢查學生交的每篇報告是否抄襲。

sentences.en: The author was accused of plagiarism after readers found that several pages were copied from another book.
sentences.zh: 讀者發現有好幾頁是從另一本書抄來的之後，那位作家被指控抄襲。

sentences.en: Plagiarism is taken very seriously at our company, and employees who copy others' work may lose their jobs.
sentences.zh: 我們公司非常重視抄襲問題，抄襲別人作品的員工可能會丟掉工作。

sentences.en: The magazine checks every article for plagiarism before it is published online or in print.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌在每篇文章刊登到網路或紙本前，都會檢查是否抄襲。

sentences.en: Students who are found guilty of plagiarism will receive a failing grade for the course.
sentences.zh: 被認定抄襲的學生這門課會被當掉。

words.note: 語塊：accuse sb of plagiarism（指控某人抄襲）、check for plagiarism（檢查抄襲）。plagiarism 是「抄襲別人的作品」；plagiarize 是動詞。

sentences.en: The delay seems to have to do with a problem at the factory rather than with the shipping company.
sentences.zh: 延誤似乎和工廠的問題有關，而不是貨運公司。

sentences.en: Most of the complaints we receive have to do with late deliveries during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 我們收到的投訴大多和節慶期間延遲送貨有關。

sentences.en: The new job will have to do with marketing and social media, which Ms. Lin enjoys very much.
sentences.zh: 新工作會和行銷及社群媒體有關，林小姐非常喜歡這些。

sentences.en: The changes to the schedule have to do with the director's business trip to Japan next week.
sentences.zh: 時程的變動和總監下週去日本出差有關。

sentences.en: Many of the questions at the seminar will have to do with the new tax rules for small businesses.
sentences.zh: 研討會上很多問題會和小企業的新稅務規定有關。

words.note: 語塊：have something to do with（和……有些關係）、have nothing to do with（和……無關）。have to do with 是「有關」；be related to 意思接近。

sentences.en: We anticipate a delay of about two days in shipping because of the heavy snow in the north.
sentences.zh: 因為北部下大雪，我們預料出貨會延誤大約兩天。

sentences.en: Retailers must anticipate demand carefully so that they have enough products before the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 零售商必須仔細預估需求，在節慶季前備足產品。

sentences.en: The organizers anticipate that more than five thousand people will attend the festival this year.
sentences.zh: 主辦單位預期今年會有五千多人參加慶典。

sentences.en: The company did not anticipate such strong demand, so the new phone sold out within a few hours.
sentences.zh: 公司沒預料到需求會這麼強，所以新手機幾個小時內就賣光了。

sentences.en: Travelers should anticipate a delay at the airport during the holiday weekend and arrive early.
sentences.zh: 旅客應預料連假週末機場會有延誤，並提早到達。

words.note: 語塊：anticipate a delay（預料會延誤）、anticipate demand（預估需求）、anticipate that（預期……）。anticipate 比 expect 正式；anticipation 是名詞「期待」。

sentences.en: All restaurants must comply with the health and safety rules set by the city government.
sentences.zh: 所有餐廳都必須遵守市政府制定的衛生和安全規定。

sentences.en: Companies that fail to comply with the new environmental laws will have to pay a large fine.
sentences.zh: 未遵守新環保法規的公司必須支付高額罰款。

sentences.en: Visitors to the factory are required to comply with all safety instructions given by the staff.
sentences.zh: 參觀工廠的訪客必須遵守員工給的所有安全指示。

sentences.en: We will comply with your request and send the documents to your new address by Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們會依照您的要求，在週五前把文件寄到您的新地址。

sentences.en: The new products must comply with the standards of every country where they will be sold.
sentences.zh: 新產品必須符合每個販售國家的標準。

words.note: 語塊：comply with（遵守……）、fail to comply（未遵守）。comply with 是「遵守（法規、要求）」；compliance 是名詞；obey、follow 意思接近。

sentences.en: Travelers can exchange foreign currency at the bank counter on the first floor of the airport.
sentences.zh: 旅客可以在機場一樓的銀行櫃台兌換外幣。

sentences.en: Prices in the hotel restaurant are listed in the local currency, but credit cards are also accepted.
sentences.zh: 飯店餐廳的價格以當地貨幣標示，但也接受信用卡。

sentences.en: The value of the country's currency fell sharply after the government announced the new budget.
sentences.zh: 政府宣布新預算後，該國貨幣的價值大幅下跌。

sentences.en: It is cheaper to exchange currency in the city than at the airport, where the rates are higher.
sentences.zh: 在市區換錢比在機場便宜，機場的匯率比較差。

sentences.en: The online store allows customers to pay in their own local currency, which makes shopping easier.
sentences.zh: 那家網路商店讓顧客用自己的當地貨幣付款，購物更方便。

words.note: 語塊：foreign currency（外幣）、local currency（當地貨幣）、exchange currency（兌換貨幣）。currency 是「貨幣」；current 是「目前的；水流」；currently 是「目前」。

sentences.en: The city is facing a budget shortfall of five million dollars because tax income was lower than expected.
sentences.zh: 因為稅收比預期低，市政府面臨五百萬美元的預算缺口。

sentences.en: A shortfall in staff during the holiday season caused long lines at the supermarket checkout.
sentences.zh: 節慶期間人手短缺，造成超市結帳大排長龍。
