sentences.en: The company will borrow money from the bank to cover the shortfall until sales improve.
sentences.zh: 公司會向銀行借錢填補缺口，直到銷售好轉。

sentences.en: The school had to cancel several programs because of a shortfall in funding from the government.
sentences.zh: 因為政府經費不足，學校只好取消好幾個課程。

sentences.en: The director explained how the department plans to cover the shortfall without laying off any workers.
sentences.zh: 總監說明部門打算如何在不裁員的情況下填補缺口。

words.note: 語塊：a shortfall in（……的短缺）、budget shortfall（預算缺口）、cover the shortfall（填補缺口）。shortfall 是「不夠的部分」；shortage 是「短缺」，意思接近。

sentences.en: The hotel is about ten minutes on foot in the direction of the train station.
sentences.zh: 飯店朝火車站的方向走路大約十分鐘。

sentences.en: The orchestra performed under the direction of a famous conductor from Vienna at the city's new concert hall.
sentences.zh: 管弦樂團在城市新音樂廳由一位維也納知名指揮指導演出。

sentences.en: The company is moving in a new direction by focusing on online sales instead of physical stores.
sentences.zh: 公司正在轉向新方向，把重點放在網路銷售而不是實體店。

sentences.en: The project was completed under the direction of Ms. Patel, who has managed many similar projects.
sentences.zh: 專案是在 Patel 小姐的指導下完成的，她管理過很多類似的專案。

sentences.en: If you get lost, walk in the direction of the large clock tower and you will find the main square.
sentences.zh: 如果你迷路了，朝那座大鐘樓的方向走，就會找到主廣場。

words.note: 語塊：in the direction of（朝……方向）、ask for directions（問路）、under the direction of（在……的指導下）。direction 單數是「方向」；複數 directions 常指「路線說明、使用說明」。

sentences.en: Customers can contact our technicians directly by calling the number on the back of the machine.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以撥打機器背面的電話直接聯絡我們的技師。

sentences.en: The restaurant buys its vegetables directly from local farmers, so they are always fresh and full of flavor.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳直接向在地農民買蔬菜，所以都很新鮮。

sentences.en: In her new role, Ms. Gomez will report directly to the chief executive officer of the company.
sentences.zh: Gomez 小姐擔任新職後，將直接向公司執行長報告。

sentences.en: Please send your application directly to the human resources manager rather than to the general email address.
sentences.zh: 請把申請直接寄給人資經理，而不是寄到一般的電子信箱。

sentences.en: The new train line will take passengers directly from the airport to the center of the city.
sentences.zh: 新的鐵路線會把乘客直接從機場載到市中心。

words.note: 語塊：contact directly（直接聯絡）、directly from（直接從……）、report directly to（直接向……報告）。directly 是「直接」；direct 也可以當副詞（fly direct 直飛）；indirectly 是「間接地」。

sentences.en: The new subway line is expected to ease traffic in the city center during rush hour.
sentences.zh: 新捷運線預計會紓解尖峰時段市中心的交通。

sentences.en: The doctor gave the patient some medicine to ease the pain in his back after the accident.
sentences.zh: 醫生給病人一些藥，減輕他車禍後的背痛。

sentences.en: The CEO met with employees to ease concerns about job losses after the merger was announced.
sentences.zh: 宣布合併後，執行長和員工見面，消除他們對失業的疑慮。

sentences.en: Adding more trains on weekends will help ease crowding at the station during the festival.
sentences.zh: 週末加開列車將有助於緩和慶典期間車站的擁擠。

sentences.en: The company sent a letter to customers to ease concerns about the safety of their personal information.
sentences.zh: 公司寄信給顧客，消除他們對個人資料安全的疑慮。

words.note: 語塊：ease traffic（紓解交通）、ease the pain（減輕疼痛）、ease concerns（消除疑慮）。ease 當動詞是「使減輕」；當名詞是「容易；自在」（with ease 輕鬆地）。

sentences.en: The repair should take two hours at most, so your car will be ready before lunch.
sentences.zh: 維修最多應該要兩個小時，所以你的車在午餐前就會好。

sentences.en: Each team can have five members at most, so please choose your partners carefully before Friday.
sentences.zh: 每組最多五個人，所以請仔細選擇夥伴。

sentences.en: The trip from the hotel to the airport takes thirty minutes at most when there is no traffic.
sentences.zh: 不塞車的話，從飯店到機場頂多三十分鐘。

sentences.en: The new laptop costs at most eight hundred dollars, which is much cheaper than other models.
sentences.zh: 新筆電最多八百美元，比其他機型便宜很多。

sentences.en: At most, the meeting will last one hour, so you will have time to catch your flight in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 會議頂多一小時，所以你下午有時間趕飛機。

words.note: 語塊：at most（最多）。at most 是「最多、不超過」；at least 是相反詞「至少」。

sentences.en: Political instability in the region has caused many foreign companies to delay their investment plans.
sentences.zh: 該地區的政治不穩定讓很多外國公司延後投資計畫。

sentences.en: Economic instability makes it difficult for small businesses to plan for the future and hire new staff.
sentences.zh: 經濟不穩定讓小企業很難為未來做規劃。

sentences.en: The company has suffered from financial instability since it lost its largest client two years ago.
sentences.zh: 自從兩年前失去最大客戶後，公司就一直財務不穩。

sentences.en: Investors are worried about the instability of the stock market and are moving their money into gold.
sentences.zh: 投資人擔心股市的不穩定，正在把錢轉進黃金。

sentences.en: The government introduced new policies to reduce economic instability and create more jobs for young people.
sentences.zh: 政府推出新政策，減少經濟不穩定並創造更多工作。

words.note: 語塊：political instability（政治不穩定）、economic instability（經濟不穩定）、financial instability（財務不穩）。instability 是名詞；unstable 是形容詞「不穩定的」；stability 是相反詞。

sentences.en: Many employees felt anxiety about the changes to the company after the new CEO was announced.
sentences.zh: 新執行長宣布後，很多員工對公司的變化感到焦慮。

sentences.en: Speaking in front of a large audience can cause anxiety, even for experienced managers and business leaders.
sentences.zh: 在一大群聽眾面前說話可能會造成焦慮，即使是有經驗的經理也一樣。

sentences.en: The workshop teaches simple breathing exercises that can help reduce anxiety before important meetings or presentations.
sentences.zh: 工作坊教簡單的呼吸練習，幫助在重要會議前減輕焦慮。

sentences.en: Waiting for the results of the job interview caused a lot of anxiety for Mr. Ito and his family.
sentences.zh: 等待面試結果讓伊藤先生和家人非常焦慮。

sentences.en: Clear communication from managers can reduce anxiety among staff during times of change and uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 在變動時期，經理清楚的溝通可以減輕員工的焦慮。

words.note: 語塊：cause anxiety（造成焦慮）、reduce anxiety（減輕焦慮）、anxiety about（對……的擔憂）。anxiety 是名詞；anxious 是形容詞「焦慮的；渴望的」。

sentences.en: Large companies often exert pressure on their suppliers to lower their prices every year or lose the contract.
sentences.zh: 大公司常常對供應商施加壓力，要他們每年降價，否則就失去合約。

sentences.en: Social media can exert influence on the products that young people decide to buy online.
sentences.zh: 社群媒體會對年輕人決定買什麼產品發揮影響力。

sentences.en: The union plans to exert pressure on the government to raise the minimum wage next year.
sentences.zh: 工會計畫向政府施壓，要求明年調高最低工資。

sentences.en: Famous athletes exert influence on fans who want to wear the same shoes and clothing.
sentences.zh: 知名運動員對想穿同款鞋子和衣服的粉絲有影響力。

sentences.en: Workers must not exert too much force when they lift heavy boxes, as it can cause back injuries.
sentences.zh: 工人搬重箱子時不能太用力，因為可能會造成背部受傷。

words.note: 語塊：exert pressure（施加壓力）、exert influence（發揮影響力）、exert effort（盡力）。exert 是「用力、施加」；exertion 是名詞「努力、費力」。

sentences.en: Many small farms depend on seasonal workers to help them harvest their crops every autumn.
sentences.zh: 很多小農場每年秋天都靠季節性工人幫忙收成。

sentences.en: Whether the outdoor concert takes place will depend on the weather forecast for Saturday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 戶外音樂會是否舉行將取決於週六下午的天氣。

sentences.en: The price of the tour will depend on the number of people who sign up for it.
sentences.zh: 行程的價格將取決於報名的人數。

sentences.en: The company's success will depend on its ability to attract young customers in the coming years.
sentences.zh: 公司的成功將取決於它在未來幾年吸引年輕顧客的能力。

sentences.en: Customers depend on us to deliver their orders on time, so we must avoid delays at the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 顧客依賴我們準時送貨，所以我們必須避免倉庫延誤。

words.note: 語塊：depend on（依賴；取決於）、depend on the number of（取決於……的數量）。depend on 可以是「依靠」或「取決於」；dependent 是形容詞「依賴的」。

sentences.en: The singer's powerful voice will stun the audience at the concert hall on Saturday night.
sentences.zh: 那位歌手強大的歌聲將在週六晚上讓音樂廳的觀眾驚豔。

sentences.en: The news of the merger seemed to stun investors, and the company's share price rose quickly.
sentences.zh: 合併的消息似乎讓投資人很震驚，公司股價迅速上漲。

sentences.en: The beautiful view from the top of the mountain is sure to stun visitors who make the long hike.
sentences.zh: 山頂的美景一定會讓走完漫長健行的遊客驚嘆不已。

sentences.en: The sudden resignation of the CEO did stun many employees, who had not expected any changes.
sentences.zh: 執行長突然辭職確實讓很多員工震驚，他們完全沒料到會有變動。

sentences.en: The designer hopes the bright colors of the new collection will stun the fashion critics in Paris.
sentences.zh: 設計師希望新系列的鮮豔色彩能讓巴黎的時尚評論家驚豔。

words.note: 語塊：stun the audience（讓觀眾驚豔）、be stunned by（被……震驚）。stun 是「讓人驚呆」；stunning 是形容詞「極美的；令人驚豔的」。

sentences.en: The new park is popular with children and adults alike, especially on warm and sunny weekends.
sentences.zh: 新公園受到小孩和大人一致喜愛，尤其是溫暖的週末。

sentences.en: The two models look alike, but the newer one has a larger screen and a longer battery life.
sentences.zh: 兩款機型看起來很像，但新款的螢幕比較大、電池續航也比較久。

sentences.en: Customers and employees alike have praised the new design of the store for being bright and modern.
sentences.zh: 顧客和員工都稱讚新店面設計明亮又現代。

sentences.en: The training program is useful for new and experienced workers alike because it covers the latest rules.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫對新進和資深員工都很有用，因為它涵蓋最新的規定。

sentences.en: Tourists and residents alike enjoy the night market, which offers food from many different countries.
sentences.zh: 觀光客和居民都喜歡那個夜市，那裡有很多不同國家的食物。

words.note: 語塊：A and B alike（A 和 B 都）、look alike（看起來很像）。alike 常放在名詞後面（customers and staff alike）；like 是介系詞「像」。

sentences.en: Regular maintenance reduces the likelihood of the machines breaking down during busy periods such as the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 定期維修能降低機器在忙碌時段故障的可能性。

sentences.en: In all likelihood, the new store will open in May, but the exact date has not been decided yet.
sentences.zh: 新店十之八九會在五月開幕，但確切日期還沒決定。

sentences.en: Practicing your presentation several times will increase the likelihood of success at the meeting with the clients.
sentences.zh: 把簡報練習好幾次，會提高會議成功的可能性。

sentences.en: The weather forecast says there is a high likelihood of rain on Saturday, so the picnic may be postponed.
sentences.zh: 天氣預報說週六很可能下雨，所以野餐可能會延期。

sentences.en: Experts believe that the likelihood of another price increase this year is very low for most products.
sentences.zh: 專家認為今年再漲價的可能性很低。

words.note: 語塊：the likelihood of（……的可能性）、in all likelihood（十之八九）、increase the likelihood（提高可能性）。likelihood 是「發生的可能性」；possibility、probability 意思接近；likely 是形容詞。

sentences.en: Taste in art is highly subjective, so not everyone will like the paintings in the new exhibition.
sentences.zh: 藝術品味非常主觀，所以不是每個人都會喜歡新展覽的畫作。

sentences.en: The review was based on the writer's subjective opinion rather than on facts about the product.
sentences.zh: 那篇評論是根據作者的主觀意見，而不是產品的事實。

sentences.en: Evaluating employees can be subjective, so the company uses clear goals and numbers to measure performance.
sentences.zh: 評估員工可能會很主觀，所以公司用明確的目標來衡量績效。

sentences.en: The judges tried to avoid a subjective decision by using a scoring sheet for each design.
sentences.zh: 評審試著用每個設計的評分表，避免做出主觀的決定。

sentences.en: Customer reviews are subjective, but they still help other people decide which hotel to choose.
sentences.zh: 顧客評論雖然主觀，但仍能幫助其他人決定要選哪家飯店。

words.note: 語塊：subjective opinion（主觀意見）、highly subjective（非常主觀的）、subjective decision（主觀的決定）、can be subjective（可能很主觀）。subjective 是「主觀的、依個人感受」；objective 是相反詞「客觀的」。

sentences.en: Technology companies must continue to innovate if they want to stay ahead of their competitors.
sentences.zh: 科技公司如果想領先競爭對手，就必須持續創新。

sentences.en: The startup hopes to innovate in the field of renewable energy by developing cheaper solar panels.
sentences.zh: 那家新創公司希望開發更便宜的太陽能板，在再生能源領域創新。

sentences.en: Our company encourages employees to innovate by giving them time each week to work on new ideas.
sentences.zh: 我們公司鼓勵員工創新，每週給他們時間發展新點子。

sentences.en: Small businesses often innovate faster than large companies because they can make decisions much more quickly.
sentences.zh: 小企業常常比大公司更快創新，因為它們能很快做決定。

sentences.en: The restaurant continues to innovate in its menu, adding new dishes inspired by different countries.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的菜單持續創新，加入受各國啟發的新菜色。

words.note: 語塊：continue to innovate（持續創新）、innovate in（在……方面創新）。innovate 是動詞；innovation 是名詞「創新」；innovative 是形容詞「創新的」。

sentences.en: We are looking for a highly competent accountant who can manage the finances of several clients.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位能管理好幾位客戶財務、非常能幹的會計師。

sentences.en: Applicants must be competent in using spreadsheets and other basic office software used in the company.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須能熟練使用試算表和其他基本辦公軟體。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant is a competent manager who always finishes her projects on time and within budget.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐是一位能幹的經理，總是準時且在預算內完成專案。

sentences.en: The training program helps new staff become competent in handling customer complaints by phone and email.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫幫助新員工學會妥善處理顧客投訴。

sentences.en: The hospital only hires highly competent nurses who have at least three years of experience.
sentences.zh: 醫院只聘用至少有三年經驗、非常能幹的護士。

words.note: 語塊：highly competent（非常能幹的）、competent in（擅長……）。competent 是「有能力勝任」；competitive 是「有競爭力的」；competence 是名詞。

sentences.en: Some cities are discussing whether to legalize the use of electric scooters on sidewalks in the city center.
sentences.zh: 有些城市正在討論是否讓電動滑板車在人行道上行駛合法化。

sentences.en: The government plans to legalize online gambling, but many citizens are strongly against the idea.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫讓網路賭博合法化，但很多民眾反對。

sentences.en: The new law will legalize the sale of certain medicines in supermarkets instead of only in pharmacies.
sentences.zh: 新法律將使某些藥品在超市販售合法化，而不只限於藥局。

sentences.en: Business owners asked the council to legalize outdoor seating for restaurants on the main street.
sentences.zh: 商家要求議會讓主要街道的餐廳戶外座位合法化。

sentences.en: Several countries decided to legalize working from abroad for people who hold special work visas.
sentences.zh: 幾個國家決定讓持有特殊簽證的人從國外工作合法化。

words.note: 語塊：legalize sth（使某事合法）。legalize 是「讓本來不合法的事變合法」；legal 是形容詞「合法的」；legislate 是「立法」。

sentences.en: Employers are legally required to give workers at least one full day off every week.
sentences.zh: 雇主依法必須讓員工每週至少休一天。

sentences.en: Once both sides sign the document, the contract will be legally binding for both companies.
sentences.zh: 雙方一簽署文件，合約就具有法律效力。

sentences.en: Restaurants are legally required to display information about the ingredients used in all of their dishes.
sentences.zh: 餐廳依法必須標示菜餚的成分資訊。

sentences.en: You cannot legally drive in this country unless you have a valid license from your home country.
sentences.zh: 除非你有有效的駕照，否則不能在這個國家合法開車。

sentences.en: The agreement is not legally binding, but both companies have promised to follow it carefully.
sentences.zh: 這份協議不具法律效力，但兩家公司都承諾會遵守。

words.note: 語塊：legally required（依法要求的）、legally binding（具法律效力的）。legally 是「依照法律地」；illegally 是「違法地」。

sentences.en: The couple hired a real estate broker to help them find an apartment close to their offices.
sentences.zh: 那對夫妻請了一位房地產經紀人，幫他們找離辦公室近的公寓。

sentences.en: An insurance broker can compare plans from several companies to find the best price for you.
sentences.zh: 保險經紀人可以比較好幾家公司的方案，幫你找到最好的價格。

sentences.en: Mr. Diaz worked as a stock broker for ten years before he started his own investment company.
sentences.zh: Diaz 先生當了十年股票經紀人，之後自己開了一家投資公司。

sentences.en: The real estate broker showed us five office spaces in the business district on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 房地產經紀人週二帶我們看了商業區的五個辦公空間。

sentences.en: Our company works with an insurance broker who helps us choose health plans for our employees.
sentences.zh: 我們公司和一位保險經紀人合作，他幫我們為員工挑選健康保險方案。

words.note: 語塊：real estate broker（房地產經紀人）、insurance broker（保險經紀人）、stock broker（股票經紀人）。broker 是「幫人買賣的中間人」；agent 意思接近；broken 是「壞掉的」。

sentences.en: Customers choose our cars because of their reliability and the low cost of repairs over many years.
sentences.zh: 顧客選擇我們的車，是因為它們很可靠，維修費又低。

sentences.en: The airline is known for reliability, and most of its flights arrive at their destination on time.
sentences.zh: 那家航空公司以可靠著稱，大部分航班都準時抵達目的地。

sentences.en: Engineers tested the reliability of the new software for several weeks before it was released.
sentences.zh: 工程師在新軟體推出前測試了好幾週的可靠性。

sentences.en: Some experts question the reliability of the survey because only one hundred people answered it.
sentences.zh: 有些專家質疑這份調查的可信度，因為只有一百個人回答。

sentences.en: The reliability of our delivery service has improved since we hired more drivers last year.
sentences.zh: 自從去年增聘司機後，我們配送服務的可靠性提高了。

words.note: 語塊：reliability of（……的可靠性）、known for reliability（以可靠著稱）。reliability 是名詞；reliable 是形容詞「可靠的」；rely 是動詞。

sentences.en: Many customers are unwilling to pay extra for delivery, so the store decided to offer free shipping.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客不願意多付運費，所以那家店決定提供免運費。

sentences.en: The supplier was unwilling to lower its prices, so we decided to look for another company.
sentences.zh: 供應商不願意降價，所以我們決定找另一家公司。

sentences.en: Some employees are unwilling to work on weekends because they want to spend time with their families.
sentences.zh: 有些員工不願意週末上班，因為他們想陪家人。

sentences.en: The landlord is unwilling to make repairs to the old building until the tenants pay their rent.
sentences.zh: 房東不願意修理那棟舊大樓，直到房客付清房租為止。

sentences.en: The bank was unwilling to approve the loan because the company did not have a clear business plan.
sentences.zh: 銀行不願意核准貸款，因為那家公司沒有明確的營運計畫。

words.note: 語塊：be unwilling to（不願意……）。be unwilling to + 原形動詞；reluctant 意思接近；willing 是「願意的」。

sentences.en: The new marketing strategy focuses on reaching young customers through social media and online videos.
sentences.zh: 新的行銷策略聚焦於透過社群媒體和網路影片接觸年輕顧客。

sentences.en: The board asked the CEO to develop a strategy for expanding the company into South America.
sentences.zh: 董事會要求執行長制定一套把公司擴展到南美的策略。

sentences.en: Our business strategy is to offer high-quality products at prices that most people can afford.
sentences.zh: 我們的經營策略是以大多數人負擔得起的價格提供高品質產品。

sentences.en: The consultant helped the restaurant develop a strategy to attract more customers on weekday evenings.
sentences.zh: 顧問幫餐廳制定了一套在平日晚上吸引更多顧客的策略。

sentences.en: Changing the marketing strategy helped the company increase its online sales by forty percent in one year.
sentences.zh: 改變行銷策略幫助公司把網路銷售提高了四成。

words.note: 語塊：marketing strategy（行銷策略）、business strategy（經營策略）、develop a strategy（制定策略）。strategy 是「整體的計畫方針」；tactic 是「具體戰術」；strategic 是形容詞。

sentences.en: The audience at the conference was mostly made up of engineers and managers from technology companies.
sentences.zh: 研討會的觀眾主要是科技公司的工程師和經理。

sentences.en: Sales increased last year mostly because of the success of our new line of kitchen appliances.
sentences.zh: 去年銷售增加主要是因為新系列廚房家電很成功。

sentences.en: The furniture in the hotel lobby is mostly made of wood that comes from local forests.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳的家具大部分是用當地森林的木材做的。

sentences.en: The weather this week will be mostly sunny, with a small chance of rain on Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 這週天氣大多晴朗，週四下午有小機率下雨。

sentences.en: Our customers are mostly young families who live in the apartments near the new shopping center.
sentences.zh: 我們的顧客大多是住在新購物中心附近公寓的年輕家庭。

words.note: 語塊：mostly made of（主要由……製成）、mostly because（主要是因為）。mostly 是「大多、主要」；most 是「最多的」；almost 是「幾乎」。

sentences.en: The hotel restaurant is run by an award-winning chef who trained in France and Japan for many years.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店餐廳由一位在法國和日本受訓多年的得獎主廚經營。

sentences.en: The new library has an award-winning design that uses natural light and recycled materials in creative ways.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館擁有一個運用自然光和回收材料的得獎設計。

sentences.en: The award-winning film will be shown at the community center on Friday evening, and entry is free.
sentences.zh: 那部得獎電影週五晚上會在社區中心放映，免費入場。

sentences.en: Our team includes several award-winning designers who have worked with famous brands around the world.
sentences.zh: 我們的團隊有好幾位和世界知名品牌合作過的得獎設計師。

sentences.en: Visitors can enjoy an award-winning wine from the local vineyard during the tour of the region.
sentences.zh: 遊客在當地導覽行程中可以品嚐在地葡萄園的得獎葡萄酒。

words.note: 語塊：award-winning chef（得獎主廚）、award-winning design（得獎設計）、award-winning film（得獎電影）。award-winning 放在名詞前要加連字號；prize-winning 意思相同。

sentences.en: Stamp collecting was a popular hobby in the past, but fewer young people do it now.
sentences.zh: 集郵在過去是很受歡迎的嗜好，但現在做的年輕人變少了。

sentences.en: The research team spent six months collecting data from customers in five different cities across Asia.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊花了六個月從五個不同城市的顧客那裡收集資料。

sentences.en: Volunteers will be collecting donations for the children's hospital at the entrance of the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 志工會在超市入口為兒童醫院募集捐款。

sentences.en: Collecting customer feedback regularly helps the company improve its products and services for customers every year.
sentences.zh: 定期收集顧客意見有助於公司改善產品和服務。

sentences.en: Mr. Lee became interested in collecting old cameras when he was a university student in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 李先生大學時開始對收藏老相機產生興趣。

words.note: 語塊：stamp collecting（集郵）、collecting data（收集資料）、collecting donations（募集捐款）。collecting 是「收集的動作或嗜好」；collection 是「收藏品」；collector 是「收藏家」。

sentences.en: All of our products are made in compliance with international safety standards and local laws.
sentences.zh: 我們所有產品都依照國際安全標準製造。

sentences.en: Inspectors will check the factory's compliance with the new environmental rules on Monday and Tuesday next week.
sentences.zh: 檢查員下週會檢查工廠是否遵守新的環保規定。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed works in the compliance department and makes sure that the bank follows every law.
sentences.zh: Ahmed 小姐在法遵部門工作，確保銀行遵守每一條法律。

sentences.en: In compliance with the new law, restaurants must now display the calories of every dish on the menu.
sentences.zh: 為了遵照新法律，餐廳現在必須在菜單上標示每道菜的熱量。

sentences.en: The company hired a lawyer to review its compliance with the tax rules in each country where it operates.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請律師檢查它在每個營運國家是否遵守稅務規定。

words.note: 語塊：in compliance with（遵照……）、compliance with（對……的遵守）、compliance department（法遵部門）。compliance 是名詞；comply 是動詞（comply with）；compliant 是形容詞。

sentences.en: The government announced a tax reform that will lower taxes for families with young children.
sentences.zh: 政府宣布一項稅制改革，將降低有幼童家庭的稅負。

sentences.en: Many teachers support the education reform, which will reduce the number of exams that students take.
sentences.zh: 很多老師支持這項教育改革，它會減少學生要考的考試數量。

sentences.en: The new CEO plans to introduce a reform of the company's structure to make decisions faster.
sentences.zh: 新執行長計畫推行公司結構改革，讓決策更快。

sentences.en: Experts say that the tax reform will help small businesses grow and create more jobs.
sentences.zh: 專家說稅制改革會幫助小企業成長並創造更多工作。

sentences.en: The health care reform will make it easier for elderly people to see a doctor near their homes.
sentences.zh: 醫療改革將讓年長者更容易在家附近看醫生。

words.note: 語塊：tax reform（稅制改革）、education reform（教育改革）、introduce reforms（推行改革）。reform 可以當名詞或動詞「改革」；inform（通知）和 perform（表演）長得像。

words.meaning: 嚴重地；評論上；批判性地

sentences.en: The critically acclaimed play will be performed at the city theater for two weeks in December.
sentences.zh: 那齣廣受好評的舞台劇十二月會在市立劇院演出兩週。

sentences.en: It is critically important to test the software carefully before releasing it to all of our customers.
sentences.zh: 在把軟體推出給顧客之前仔細測試，是極為重要的。

sentences.en: The course teaches students how to think critically about the information they read online every day.
sentences.zh: 這門課教學生如何批判性思考在網路上讀到的資訊。

sentences.en: The patient was critically injured in the accident and was taken to the hospital by helicopter.
sentences.zh: 病人在意外中受重傷，被直升機送到醫院。

sentences.en: The author's first novel was critically acclaimed and has been translated into more than twenty languages.
sentences.zh: 那位作家的第一本小說廣受好評，已被翻譯成二十種語言。

words.note: 語塊：critically acclaimed（廣受好評的）、critically important（極為重要）、think critically（批判性思考）。critically acclaimed 是「受到評論家讚賞」；critical 是形容詞「關鍵的；批評的」。

sentences.en: The museum will host an exhibition of paintings by an internationally acclaimed artist from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 博物館將舉辦一位國際知名墨西哥藝術家的畫展。

sentences.en: The highly acclaimed restaurant is fully booked for the next three months, so please reserve early.
sentences.zh: 那家備受讚譽的餐廳未來三個月都訂滿了，所以請提早預約。

sentences.en: The film was critically acclaimed and won several awards at international film festivals last year.
sentences.zh: 那部電影廣受好評，去年在國際影展上贏得好幾個獎。

sentences.en: Our guest speaker is an acclaimed author who has written several books about leadership and teamwork.
sentences.zh: 我們的演講嘉賓是一位寫過好幾本領導力書籍的知名作家。

sentences.en: The internationally acclaimed orchestra will perform at the new concert hall downtown in early March.
sentences.zh: 那個國際知名的管弦樂團三月將在新音樂廳演出。

words.note: 語塊：critically acclaimed（廣受好評的）、internationally acclaimed（國際知名的）、highly acclaimed（備受讚譽的）。acclaimed 是「受到大家稱讚的」；acclaim 是名詞「讚譽」。

sentences.en: The new factory is expected to create jobs for more than five hundred people in the region.
sentences.zh: 新工廠預計會為該地區五百多人創造工作機會。

sentences.en: We hired a designer to create a website that is easy for customers to use on their phones.
sentences.zh: 我們聘請一位設計師，建立一個顧客用手機也容易使用的網站。

sentences.en: To use the online service, you will first need to create an account with your email address.
sentences.zh: 要使用線上服務，你得先用電子信箱建立一個帳號。

sentences.en: The city hopes that the new park will create a pleasant space for families to relax on weekends.
sentences.zh: 市政府希望新公園能為家庭創造一個週末放鬆的舒適空間。

sentences.en: Small businesses help create jobs and keep the local economy strong in many small towns.
sentences.zh: 小企業在許多小鎮幫助創造工作機會、維持地方經濟的活力。

words.note: 語塊：create jobs（創造工作）、create a website（建立網站）、create an account（建立帳號）。create 是「創造」；creation 是名詞；creative 是形容詞「有創意的」。

sentences.en: The company made her an attractive offer that included a high salary and a car for business use.
sentences.zh: 公司給了她一個誘人的方案，包括高薪和一輛公務車。

sentences.en: The hotel offers rooms at an attractive price during the winter, when fewer tourists visit the island.
sentences.zh: 冬天觀光客較少時，飯店以吸引人的價格提供客房。

sentences.en: The new design makes the product more attractive to young customers who care about style.
sentences.zh: 新設計讓產品對重視風格的年輕顧客更有吸引力。

sentences.en: Free parking and long opening hours make the shopping center attractive to families from nearby towns.
sentences.zh: 免費停車和長營業時間讓購物中心對附近城鎮的家庭很有吸引力。

sentences.en: The bank is offering an attractive interest rate to customers who open a savings account this month.
sentences.zh: 銀行對這個月開立儲蓄帳戶的顧客提供吸引人的利率。

words.note: 語塊：attractive offer（誘人的方案）、attractive price（吸引人的價格）、attractive to（對……有吸引力）。attractive 是「有吸引力的」；attraction 是名詞「吸引力；景點」。

sentences.en: The new laptops are attractively priced, so many students are buying them before the semester begins.
sentences.zh: 新筆電價格誘人，所以很多學生在開學前買。

sentences.en: The hotel rooms are attractively designed with wooden furniture and large windows that face the sea.
sentences.zh: 飯店客房設計精美，有木製家具和面海的大窗戶。

sentences.en: The products in the store window are attractively displayed to catch the attention of people walking by.
sentences.zh: 櫥窗裡的商品陳列得很吸引人，好吸引路人的目光。

sentences.en: Our vacation packages are attractively priced and include flights, hotels, and daily breakfast for the whole family.
sentences.zh: 我們的度假套裝行程價格誘人，包含機票、飯店和每日早餐。

sentences.en: The brochure is attractively designed, with colorful photos and short descriptions of each tour in the region.
sentences.zh: 小冊子設計精美，有彩色照片和每個行程的簡短介紹。

words.note: 語塊：attractively priced（價格誘人）、attractively designed（設計精美）。attractively 是副詞，常放在過去分詞前（attractively priced）；attractive 是形容詞。

sentences.en: The company hired several writers to create content for its website and social media accounts.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請了好幾位寫手，為網站和社群帳號製作內容。

sentences.en: Please check the content of the presentation carefully before you show it to the clients tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天給客戶看之前，請仔細檢查簡報的內容。

sentences.en: The streaming service adds new online content every week, including movies, television series, and documentaries.
sentences.zh: 那家串流平台每週新增網路內容，包括電影、影集和紀錄片。

sentences.en: Teachers are worried that some online content is not appropriate for young children who use tablets.
sentences.zh: 老師擔心有些網路內容不適合幼童。

sentences.en: The content of the training course was updated to include the latest safety rules for factory workers.
sentences.zh: 訓練課程的內容已更新，納入工廠員工最新的安全規定。

words.note: 語塊：online content（網路內容）、the content of（……的內容）、create content（製作內容）。content 當名詞（CON-tent）是「內容」；當形容詞（con-TENT）是「滿足的」；contents 常指「目錄；容器裡的東西」。

sentences.en: Customers can personalize a gift by adding a name or a short message to the box.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在盒子上加上名字或簡短訊息，客製化禮物。

sentences.en: The hotel tries to personalize the service by remembering each guest's favorite room and drink.
sentences.zh: 飯店記住每位客人喜歡的房間和飲料，提供個人化服務。

sentences.en: The app allows users to personalize the screen with their own photos and favorite colors.
sentences.zh: 這個 App 讓使用者可以用自己的照片和顏色個人化畫面。

sentences.en: Online stores use data about past purchases to personalize the products that they show to each customer.
sentences.zh: 網路商店用過去的購買紀錄，為每位顧客個人化推薦商品。

sentences.en: For an extra five dollars, the shop will personalize your mug with any design you choose.
sentences.zh: 多付五美元，店家就會用你選的任何圖案客製化你的馬克杯。

words.note: 語塊：personalize a gift（客製化禮物）、personalize the service（提供個人化服務）、personalize the screen（個人化畫面）、personalize your mug（客製化馬克杯）。personalize 是「依個人需求調整」；customize 意思接近；personalized 是形容詞「個人化的」。

sentences.en: The manager will personally deliver the contract to the client's office on Friday afternoon before the weekend.
sentences.zh: 經理週五下午會親自把合約送到客戶的辦公室。

sentences.en: Please do not take it personally if your idea is not chosen, as there were many good suggestions.
sentences.zh: 如果你的點子沒被選上，請不要往心裡去，因為有很多好建議。

sentences.en: Each department head is personally responsible for making sure that the budget is not exceeded.
sentences.zh: 每位部門主管都要個人負責確保預算不超支。

sentences.en: Personally, I think the second design is better, but we should ask the team for their opinions.
sentences.zh: 就我個人而言，我覺得第二個設計比較好，但我們應該問問團隊的意見。

sentences.en: The CEO personally thanked each employee who worked overtime during the busy holiday season last month.
sentences.zh: 執行長親自感謝每一位在忙碌節慶期間加班的員工。

words.note: 語塊：personally deliver（親自送達）、take it personally（往心裡去）、personally responsible（個人負責）。personally 可以是「親自」或「就我個人來說」；take sth personally 是「把……當成針對自己」。

sentences.en: The two companies will meet next week to discuss the specifics of the new partnership agreement.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司下週會見面，討論新合作協議的細節。

sentences.en: The manager explained the general plan, but the specifics will be decided at the next meeting.
sentences.zh: 經理說明了整體計畫，但細節會在下次會議決定。

sentences.en: Please contact Ms. Lin if you would like to know the specifics of the training schedule.
sentences.zh: 如果你想知道訓練時程的細節，請聯絡林小姐。

sentences.en: The article does not give the specifics of how much money the company paid for the land.
sentences.zh: 文章沒有提到公司買那塊地花了多少錢的細節。

sentences.en: Before signing the contract, we need to discuss the specifics of payment and delivery with the supplier.
sentences.zh: 簽約之前，我們需要和供應商討論付款和交貨的細節。

words.note: 語塊：discuss the specifics（討論細節）、the specifics of（……的細節）。specifics 一定用複數，指「具體細節」；details 意思接近；specific 是形容詞「具體的」。

sentences.en: In an attempt to reduce costs, the company moved its offices to a smaller building outside the city.
sentences.zh: 為了降低成本，公司把辦公室搬到城外一棟比較小的大樓。

sentences.en: Ms. Park passed the accounting exam on her first attempt, which is very unusual for new employees.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐第一次考就通過了會計考試，這非常少見。

sentences.en: The team will make an attempt to finish the project before the holiday so that everyone can rest.
sentences.zh: 團隊會試著在假期前完成專案，讓大家都能休息。

sentences.en: In an attempt to attract more young customers, the café started offering free internet access.
sentences.zh: 為了吸引更多年輕顧客，那家咖啡館開始提供免費網路。

sentences.en: After his first attempt failed, the engineer tried a different method and solved the problem quickly.
sentences.zh: 第一次嘗試失敗後，工程師換了一個方法，很快就解決了問題。

words.note: 語塊：in an attempt to（試圖……）、make an attempt（做一次嘗試）、first attempt（第一次嘗試）。attempt 可以當名詞或動詞「嘗試」；try 是一般說法；tempt 是「引誘」。

sentences.en: There has been a significant improvement in customer satisfaction since we hired more staff last year.
sentences.zh: 自從我們增聘人手以來，顧客滿意度有了顯著的改善。

sentences.en: The report is good, but there is still room for improvement in the section about costs.
sentences.zh: 報告不錯，但成本的部分還有改進空間。

sentences.en: The city plans to make an improvement to the park by adding new benches and lights.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫增加新的長椅和路燈，改善公園。

sentences.en: The new software has led to a big improvement in the speed of processing customer orders.
sentences.zh: 新軟體大幅改善了處理顧客訂單的速度。

sentences.en: Managers should tell employees where there is room for improvement and how they can do better.
sentences.zh: 經理應該告訴員工哪裡還有改進空間，以及他們可以怎麼做得更好。

words.note: 語塊：make improvements（做改善）、room for improvement（改進空間）、improvement in（……的改善）。improvement 是名詞；improve 是動詞；常說 There is room for improvement（還有改進空間）。

sentences.en: In comparison with last year, sales of electric cars have increased by more than fifty percent.
sentences.zh: 和去年相比，電動車的銷售增加了五成以上。

sentences.en: The website allows customers to make a comparison of prices from several different airlines at the same time.
sentences.zh: 那個網站讓顧客可以比較好幾家航空公司的價格。

sentences.en: The old office was small and dark, but by comparison, the new one is bright and spacious.
sentences.zh: 舊辦公室又小又暗，相較之下，新辦公室明亮又寬敞。

sentences.en: The report includes a comparison of the costs of building a new factory and renting an existing one.
sentences.zh: 報告包含興建新工廠和租用現有工廠的成本比較。

sentences.en: In comparison with other hotels in the area, ours offers more services at a lower price.
sentences.zh: 和這一帶其他飯店相比，我們以較低的價格提供更多服務。

words.note: 語塊：in comparison with（和……相比）、make a comparison（做比較）、by comparison（相較之下）。comparison 是名詞；compare 是動詞；comparable 是「可比較的、相當的」。

sentences.en: Scientists say that burning fossil fuels is one of the main things that cause global warming.
sentences.zh: 科學家說，燃燒化石燃料是造成全球暖化的主要原因之一。

sentences.en: Planting more trees and using clean energy can help slow down global warming over time.
sentences.zh: 多種樹和使用潔淨能源，長期下來能幫助減緩全球暖化。

sentences.en: The documentary shows the effects of global warming on animals that live in the Arctic.
sentences.zh: 那部紀錄片呈現全球暖化對住在北極的動物的影響。

sentences.en: Many companies are changing the way they work in order to reduce their role in global warming.
sentences.zh: 很多公司正在改變運作方式，以減少自己對全球暖化的影響。

sentences.en: The conference will discuss how cities can prepare for the effects of global warming, such as stronger storms.
sentences.zh: 研討會將討論城市如何為全球暖化的影響做準備，例如更強的暴風雨。

words.note: 語塊：cause global warming（造成全球暖化）、slow down global warming（減緩全球暖化）、the effects of global warming（全球暖化的影響）。global warming 是「地球氣溫上升」；climate change 是「氣候變遷」，範圍更廣。

sentences.en: Please get in touch with our customer service team if you have any questions about your order.
sentences.zh: 如果你對訂單有任何問題，請和我們的客服團隊聯絡。

sentences.en: I tried to get in touch with the supplier several times, but nobody answered the phone.
sentences.zh: 我試著聯絡供應商好幾次，但都沒人接電話。

sentences.en: The hotel will get in touch with you by email to confirm your reservation within twenty-four hours.
sentences.zh: 飯店會在二十四小時內用電子郵件和你聯絡，確認你的預約。

sentences.en: If you would like to get in touch with Ms. Kim, you can call her assistant at extension 215.
sentences.zh: 如果你想聯絡金小姐，可以撥分機 215 找她的助理。

sentences.en: Former employees who want to get in touch with old colleagues can join the company's online group.
sentences.zh: 想和舊同事聯絡的前員工可以加入公司的線上社群。

words.note: 語塊：get in touch with sb（聯絡某人）。get in touch with 是「聯絡上」；keep in touch with 是「保持聯絡」；contact 是比較正式的說法。

sentences.en: You will receive an email with your ticket and a map of the venue shortly after you complete your purchase.
sentences.zh: 完成購買後不久，你會收到一封附有門票和場地地圖的電子郵件。

sentences.en: Members who shop on Tuesdays will receive a discount of ten percent on all items in the store.
sentences.zh: 週二購物的會員所有商品都能獲得九折優惠。

sentences.en: It is important to receive feedback from customers so that we can improve our products and services.
sentences.zh: 收到顧客的回饋很重要，這樣我們才能改善產品和服務。

sentences.en: If you do not receive an email from us within one hour, please check your spam folder.
sentences.zh: 如果你一小時內沒收到我們的電子郵件，請檢查垃圾郵件資料夾。

sentences.en: Employees who complete the training program will receive a certificate signed by the director of the company.
sentences.zh: 完成訓練計畫的員工會收到一張由總監簽名的證書。

words.note: 語塊：receive an email（收到電子郵件）、receive a discount（獲得折扣）、receive feedback（得到回饋）。receive 是「收到」；注意拼法 ei；receipt 是「收據」；reception 是「接待處；歡迎會」。

sentences.en: The new shopping center will attract customers from the city and the surrounding area every weekend.
sentences.zh: 新購物中心將吸引來自市區和周邊地區的顧客。

sentences.en: Many people who work in the city live in the surrounding towns because housing there is cheaper.
sentences.zh: 很多在城裡工作的人住在附近城鎮，因為那裡的房子比較便宜。

sentences.en: From the top of the tower, visitors can enjoy a view of the surrounding countryside and mountains.
sentences.zh: 從塔頂，遊客可以欣賞周圍的鄉村和山景。

sentences.en: The factory has promised to reduce noise and pollution in the surrounding neighborhoods over the next two years.
sentences.zh: 工廠承諾會減少周圍社區的噪音和污染。

sentences.en: Hotels in the surrounding area are often fully booked during the music festival in July.
sentences.zh: 七月音樂節期間，周邊地區的飯店常常都客滿。

words.note: 語塊：surrounding area（周邊地區）、surrounding towns（附近城鎮）、the surrounding countryside（周圍的鄉村）。surrounding 是形容詞「周圍的」；surroundings（複數名詞）是「環境」。

sentences.en: The company hired a land surveyor to measure the property before building the new warehouse.
sentences.zh: 公司在興建新倉庫之前，請了一位土地測量員測量那塊地。

sentences.en: Before buying an old house, it is a good idea to hire a surveyor to check for any problems.
sentences.zh: 買老房子之前，最好請一位鑑定人檢查是否有任何問題。

sentences.en: The surveyor found that the land was smaller than the size listed in the original documents.
sentences.zh: 測量員發現那塊地比原始文件上列的面積還小。

sentences.en: A land surveyor will visit the site next week to mark the boundaries of the new park.
sentences.zh: 一位土地測量員下週會到現場標出新公園的邊界。

sentences.en: The bank requires a report from a qualified surveyor before it will approve the loan for the building.
sentences.zh: 銀行要求先有合格鑑定人的報告，才會核准那棟建築的貸款。

words.note: 語塊：land surveyor（土地測量員）、hire a surveyor（請測量員）。surveyor 是「測量土地或檢查房屋的專業人員」；survey 是「測量；調查」。

sentences.en: The old bridge was closed after engineers found that it was structurally unsound and dangerous for cars.
sentences.zh: 工程師發現那座舊橋結構不穩固後，橋就被封閉了。

sentences.en: The bank refused the loan because the company's business plan was financially unsound and unrealistic.
sentences.zh: 銀行拒絕貸款，因為那家公司的營運計畫財務上不健全。

sentences.en: Inspectors declared the building structurally unsound, so all of the tenants had to move out.
sentences.zh: 檢查員宣布那棟建築結構不穩固，所以所有房客都必須搬走。

sentences.en: Many experts believe that the plan to build a new airport is financially unsound and too risky.
sentences.zh: 很多專家認為興建新機場的計畫財務上不健全，風險太高。

sentences.en: The roof of the old factory is structurally unsound and must be repaired before workers return.
sentences.zh: 舊工廠的屋頂結構不穩固，必須在工人回去之前修好。

words.note: 語塊：structurally unsound（結構不穩固）、financially unsound（財務不健全）。unsound 是「不安全、不可靠」；sound 當形容詞是「健全的；合理的」。

sentences.en: The company stopped working with the supplier because of the substandard quality of its parts.
sentences.zh: 公司因為那家供應商零件品質不合格而停止合作。

sentences.en: Many families in the old part of the city still live in substandard housing without proper heating.
sentences.zh: 老城區很多家庭仍住在沒有像樣暖氣、不合標準的住宅裡。

sentences.en: The contractor was asked to repair the substandard work on the roof at no extra cost.
sentences.zh: 承包商被要求免費修理屋頂上不合格的工程。

sentences.en: Customers who receive products of substandard quality can return them for a full refund within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 收到品質不合格產品的顧客可以退貨並全額退款。

sentences.en: The government plans to replace substandard housing with new apartments over the next ten years.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫在未來十年用新公寓取代不合標準的住宅。

words.note: 語塊：substandard quality（品質不合格）、substandard housing（不合標準的住宅）、substandard work（不合格的工作）。substandard 是「低於標準」；standard 是「標準」；inferior 意思接近。

sentences.en: The bank plans to open a branch in the new shopping center near the train station next year.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行計畫明年在火車站附近的新購物中心開一家分行。

sentences.en: Ms. Ortiz was transferred to the branch office in Singapore to manage the company's business in Asia.
sentences.zh: Ortiz 小姐被調到新加坡分公司，負責公司在亞洲的業務。

sentences.en: Customers can visit their local branch or use our mobile app to open a new account.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以到當地分行或用我們的 App 開新帳戶。

sentences.en: The restaurant chain will open a branch in every major city in the country within five years.
sentences.zh: 那家連鎖餐廳將在五年內於國內每個大城市開設分店。

sentences.en: Each branch office must send a monthly sales report to the headquarters in New York.
sentences.zh: 每家分公司都必須把月銷售報告寄給紐約總部。

words.note: 語塊：branch office（分公司）、local branch（當地分行）、open a branch（開分店）。branch 是「分公司、分店」，也是樹的「樹枝」；headquarters 是「總部」。

sentences.en: Passengers must turn off every electronic device before the plane takes off from the runway.
sentences.zh: 飛機起飛前，乘客必須關閉所有電子裝置。

sentences.en: Our website is designed to work well on any mobile device, including phones and tablets.
sentences.zh: 我們的網站設計成在任何行動裝置上都很好用，包括手機和平板。

sentences.en: The new car has a safety device that stops the vehicle automatically if it gets too close to another car.
sentences.zh: 新車有一個安全裝置，在太靠近其他車時會自動煞車。

sentences.en: Employees may not connect a personal device to the company network without permission from the IT department.
sentences.zh: 沒有資訊部的許可，員工不得把個人裝置連上公司網路。

sentences.en: This small device can measure the temperature and air quality in a room and send the data to your phone.
sentences.zh: 這個小裝置可以測量房間的溫度和空氣品質，並把資料傳到你的手機。

words.note: 語塊：mobile device（行動裝置）、electronic device（電子裝置）、safety device（安全裝置）。device 是名詞「裝置」；devise 是動詞「設計、想出」，只差一個字母。

sentences.en: Please allow for delays when you travel to the airport during the long holiday weekend.
sentences.zh: 連假週末去機場時，請預留延誤的時間。

sentences.en: The budget should allow for changes in the price of materials during the construction of the building.
sentences.zh: 預算應該考慮到大樓施工期間材料價格的變動。

sentences.en: The organizers made sure the schedule would allow for changes if a speaker arrives late or becomes ill.
sentences.zh: 主辦單位確保時程表保留調整空間，以防講者遲到或生病。

sentences.en: When you plan the trip, allow for extra time in case the weather is bad in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 規劃旅程時，要預留額外時間，以防山區天氣不好。

sentences.en: The new office design will allow for more meeting rooms and a larger space for the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 新的辦公室設計將容納更多會議室和更大的廚房空間。

words.note: 語塊：allow for delays（預留延誤時間）、allow for changes（保留調整空間）、allow for extra time（預留額外時間）。allow for 是「把……算進去、預先考慮」；allow sb to do 是「允許某人做」。

sentences.en: The bus drivers plan to go on strike next Monday if they do not receive a pay increase.
sentences.zh: 如果沒有加薪，公車司機打算下週一罷工。

sentences.en: Workers at the factory threatened to go on strike because of the long hours and poor conditions.
sentences.zh: 工廠工人因為工時長、條件差，威脅要罷工。

sentences.en: The nurses decided to go on strike for better pay after talks with the hospital failed.
sentences.zh: 和醫院的談判失敗後，護士們決定為了更好的薪水罷工。

sentences.en: If the pilots go on strike, hundreds of flights will be canceled during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 如果飛行員罷工，忙碌的節慶期間會有數百班航班被取消。

sentences.en: The union said it would go on strike only if the company refused to discuss the new contract.
sentences.zh: 工會說只有在公司拒絕討論新合約時才會罷工。

words.note: 語塊：go on strike for（為了……罷工）、threaten to go on strike（威脅要罷工）。go on strike 是「開始罷工」；be on strike 是「正在罷工」。

sentences.en: Sales in the first quarter of the year were higher than expected because of the new product line.
sentences.zh: 因為新產品線，今年第一季的銷售比預期高。

sentences.en: The company will announce its results for the third quarter at a press conference on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 公司將在週四的記者會上公布第三季的成績。

sentences.en: About a quarter of our employees work from home at least two days a week.
sentences.zh: 我們大約四分之一的員工每週至少在家工作兩天。

sentences.en: Profits fell in the last quarter because of rising costs for fuel and raw materials.
sentences.zh: 因為燃料和原料成本上漲，上一季的利潤下滑。

sentences.en: The manager wants each team to set new sales goals before the start of the next quarter.
sentences.zh: 經理希望每個團隊在下一季開始前設定新的業績目標。

words.note: 語塊：first quarter（第一季）、quarterly report（季報）、a quarter of（四分之一的）。quarter 是「一年的四分之一（季）」，也可以是「四分之一」；quarterly 是「每季的」。

sentences.en: The staff were enthusiastic about the new project and offered many creative ideas at the first meeting.
sentences.zh: 員工對新專案很熱衷，在第一次會議上提出了很多有創意的點子。

sentences.en: The new menu received an enthusiastic response from customers, so the restaurant will keep it all year.
sentences.zh: 新菜單獲得顧客熱烈的反應，所以餐廳會整年都保留它。

sentences.en: We are looking for enthusiastic people who enjoy working with children and have plenty of patience.
sentences.zh: 我們在找喜歡和孩子相處、又很有耐心的熱情人士。

sentences.en: The audience gave the speaker an enthusiastic response at the end of her talk about clean energy.
sentences.zh: 聽眾在講者談潔淨能源的演講結束時給予熱烈的回應。

sentences.en: Many young people are enthusiastic about starting their own businesses after they finish university or college.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕人對大學畢業後自己創業很熱衷。

words.note: 語塊：enthusiastic about（對……很熱衷）、enthusiastic response（熱烈的反應）。enthusiastic 是「充滿熱情的」；enthusiasm 是名詞「熱情」；eager 意思接近。

sentences.en: Please check our website for up-to-date information about flight times, gate changes, and delays at the airport.
sentences.zh: 請上我們網站查看航班時間和延誤的最新資訊。

sentences.en: It is important to keep the customer database up-to-date so that we do not send letters to old addresses.
sentences.zh: 保持顧客資料庫是最新的很重要，這樣才不會把信寄到舊地址。

sentences.en: The library provides up-to-date computers and free internet access for all of its members and visitors.
sentences.zh: 圖書館為所有會員提供最新的電腦和免費網路。

sentences.en: Our sales team uses up-to-date software that shows the status of every order in real time.
sentences.zh: 我們的業務團隊使用最新的軟體，即時顯示每筆訂單的狀態。

sentences.en: Employees must keep their skills up-to-date by attending at least one training course every year.
sentences.zh: 員工必須每年至少參加一門訓練課程，讓技能保持與時俱進。

words.note: 語塊：keep up-to-date（保持最新）、up-to-date information（最新資訊）。up-to-date 放在名詞前要加連字號；out-of-date 是「過時的」；也可以說 keep sb up to date（讓某人掌握最新消息）。

sentences.en: The market value of the company has doubled since it launched its popular mobile app.
sentences.zh: 自從推出熱門 App 後，公司的市值翻了一倍。

sentences.en: Before selling your house, you should ask an expert to estimate its current market value carefully.
sentences.zh: 賣房子之前，你應該請專家估算它的市場價值。

sentences.en: The old painting turned out to have a market value of more than two million dollars.
sentences.zh: 那幅舊畫原來有超過兩百萬美元的市場價值。

sentences.en: Investors were pleased with the increase in market value after the merger was announced last Monday.
sentences.zh: 宣布合併後，投資人對市值的增加感到滿意。

sentences.en: The market value of used cars has risen sharply because new cars are difficult to buy.
sentences.zh: 因為新車很難買到，二手車的市場價值大幅上漲。

words.note: 語塊：the market value of（……的市值）、increase in market value（市值增加）。market value 是「在市場上能賣多少錢」；market share 是「市佔率」。

words.meaning: 積極進取的；強勢的；具攻擊性的

sentences.en: The company's aggressive marketing campaign helped it become the market leader within only two years.
sentences.zh: 那家公司積極的行銷活動讓它在兩年內成為市場領導者。

sentences.en: The startup has an aggressive growth plan that includes opening fifty new stores next year.
sentences.zh: 那家新創公司有一個快速擴張的計畫，包括明年開五十家新店。

sentences.en: Small shops find it hard to survive when an aggressive competitor offers much lower prices.
sentences.zh: 當強勢的競爭對手提供低很多的價格時，小店很難生存。

sentences.en: Some customers do not like aggressive sales methods, such as frequent phone calls and emails.
sentences.zh: 有些顧客不喜歡強勢的推銷方式，例如頻繁的電話和電子郵件。

sentences.en: The board approved an aggressive plan to reduce costs by thirty percent over the next three years.
sentences.zh: 董事會核准了一個在未來三年削減三成成本的強勢計畫。

words.note: 語塊：aggressive marketing（積極的行銷）、aggressive growth（快速擴張）、aggressive competitor（強勢的競爭對手）。aggressive 在商業上常指「積極、強勢」；也可以是「有攻擊性的」，看情境。

sentences.en: The company hopes its new electric car will help it pull ahead of competitors in the European market.
sentences.zh: 公司希望新電動車能幫助它在歐洲市場領先競爭對手。

sentences.en: Our online sales began to pull ahead of store sales for the first time last year.
sentences.zh: 去年網路銷售首次開始超越門市銷售。

sentences.en: With the new advertising campaign, the brand was able to pull ahead of its main rival.
sentences.zh: 有了新的廣告活動，那個品牌得以超越主要對手。

sentences.en: The small airline managed to pull ahead of larger companies by offering cheaper tickets and better service.
sentences.zh: 那家小航空公司以更便宜的機票和更好的服務，成功超越了大公司。

sentences.en: If we can reduce delivery times, we will pull ahead of competitors who take a week to ship orders.
sentences.zh: 如果我們能縮短配送時間，就能領先那些要一週才出貨的競爭對手。

words.note: 語塊：pull ahead of competitors（領先競爭對手）。pull ahead of 是「從後面追上並超過」；get ahead of 意思接近。

sentences.en: The city holds many cultural events, such as concerts and art exhibitions, throughout the summer.
sentences.zh: 這座城市整個夏天舉辦很多文化活動，例如音樂會和藝術展。

sentences.en: The new cultural center will include a theater, a library, and space for community classes.
sentences.zh: 新的文化中心將包括劇院、圖書館和社區課程的空間。

sentences.en: Managers who work abroad should learn about cultural differences in order to communicate well with local staff.
sentences.zh: 在國外工作的經理應該了解文化差異，才能好好溝通。

sentences.en: The tourism office organizes cultural events to help visitors learn about local traditions and food.
sentences.zh: 觀光處舉辦文化活動，幫助遊客了解當地傳統。

sentences.en: Training on cultural differences is provided to all employees who will work with clients overseas.
sentences.zh: 所有將和海外客戶合作的員工都會接受文化差異的訓練。

words.note: 語塊：cultural event（文化活動）、cultural center（文化中心）、cultural differences（文化差異）。cultural 是形容詞；culture 是名詞「文化」；agricultural 是「農業的」。

sentences.en: More than one hundred companies will display their products at the international exposition in Osaka.
sentences.zh: 一百多家公司將在大阪的國際博覽會上展示產品。

sentences.en: The trade exposition attracts buyers from around the world who are looking for new suppliers.
sentences.zh: 那場商展吸引世界各地在找新供應商的買家。

sentences.en: The city plans to hold an exposition next year to show its latest projects in clean energy.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫明年舉辦一場博覽會，展示最新的潔淨能源計畫。

sentences.en: Our booth at the trade exposition was very busy, and we met many potential customers.
sentences.zh: 我們在商展的攤位非常忙，認識了很多潛在顧客。

sentences.en: Tickets for the international exposition can be purchased online or at the entrance on the day of the event.
sentences.zh: 國際博覽會的門票可以在網路上或活動當天在入口購買。

words.note: 語塊：international exposition（國際博覽會）、trade exposition（商展）、hold an exposition（舉辦博覽會）。exposition 是大型的「博覽會」，常縮寫成 expo；exhibition 是「展覽」。

sentences.en: The company made a sizable donation to the local hospital to help it buy new equipment.
sentences.zh: 公司捐了一筆相當大的款項給當地醫院，幫它買新設備。

sentences.en: There has been a sizable increase in the number of tourists visiting the island since the new airport opened.
sentences.zh: 自從新機場啟用後，造訪那座島的觀光客人數大幅增加。

sentences.en: The restaurant earned a sizable profit in its first year, so the owner plans to open another location.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳第一年就賺了可觀的利潤，所以老闆打算再開一家分店。

sentences.en: A sizable amount of the budget will be used to train new employees in customer service.
sentences.zh: 預算中相當大的一部分會用來訓練新員工的客服能力。

sentences.en: The new office is sizable, with enough space for two hundred employees and several meeting rooms.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室相當大，有足夠空間容納兩百名員工和好幾間會議室。

words.note: 語塊：sizable amount（相當大的數量）、sizable increase（大幅增加）、sizable profit（可觀的利潤）。sizable 是「相當大」；也可以拼成 sizeable；considerable 意思接近。

sentences.en: I am in a rush this morning, so could we discuss the report after lunch instead?
sentences.zh: 我今天早上在趕時間，我們可以改在午餐後討論報告嗎？

sentences.en: Ms. Grant left the office in a rush because her flight to Tokyo was leaving in two hours.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐匆忙離開辦公室，因為她飛東京的班機兩小時後就要起飛。

sentences.en: Customers who are in a rush can order their coffee through the app and pick it up at the counter.
sentences.zh: 趕時間的顧客可以用 App 點咖啡，再到櫃台取。

sentences.en: The report was written in a rush, so it contained several mistakes that the manager had to correct.
sentences.zh: 那份報告寫得很匆忙，所以有好幾個錯誤需要經理修正。

sentences.en: Please do not make important decisions in a rush, as it is better to take time to think carefully.
sentences.zh: 請不要匆忙做重要決定，花時間仔細思考比較好。

words.note: 語塊：be in a rush（在趕時間）、leave in a rush（匆忙離開）。in a rush 和 in a hurry 意思相同；rush 也可以當動詞「衝、趕」。

sentences.en: The museum's newest paintings are now on display in the gallery on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 博物館最新的畫作現在在二樓展廳展示中。

sentences.en: The store changes its window display every season to show customers the latest fashion and colors.
sentences.zh: 那家店每季更換櫥窗展示，讓顧客看到最新的流行。

sentences.en: The festival ended with a display of fireworks over the river that lasted for twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 慶典以河上一場持續二十分鐘的煙火秀作結。

sentences.en: Several new models of electric cars will be on display at the trade show next weekend.
sentences.zh: 下週末的商展將展示好幾款新電動車。

sentences.en: The holiday window display attracted many people who stopped to take photos in front of the store.
sentences.zh: 節慶櫥窗展示吸引很多人停在店門口拍照。

words.note: 語塊：on display（展示中）、window display（櫥窗展示）、display of（……的展示）。display 可以當名詞或動詞「展示」；exhibit 意思接近。

sentences.en: The machine suddenly stopped working, so the technician had to check every part of it.
sentences.zh: 機器突然停止運作，所以技師得檢查它的每個零件。

sentences.en: Sales of umbrellas suddenly increased when it started to rain heavily in the city in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午開始下大雨時，雨傘的銷售突然增加。

sentences.en: The lights in the conference room suddenly went out during the presentation on Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 週四早上簡報時，會議室的燈突然熄了。

sentences.en: The price of coffee beans suddenly rose last month because of bad weather in South America.
sentences.zh: 因為南美天氣不好，咖啡豆的價格上個月突然上漲。

sentences.en: Our flight was suddenly canceled, so we had to stay at a hotel near the airport for one night.
sentences.zh: 我們的班機突然被取消，所以只好在機場附近的飯店住一晚。

words.note: 語塊：suddenly stop（突然停止）、suddenly increase（突然增加）、suddenly rise（突然上漲）、suddenly canceled（突然取消）。suddenly 和 all of a sudden 意思相同；abruptly 帶有「令人措手不及」的感覺。

sentences.en: Please call the clinic to make an appointment if you would like to see a doctor this week.
sentences.zh: 如果你這週想看醫生，請打電話到診所預約。

sentences.en: If you need to cancel an appointment, please tell us at least one day in advance.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要取消預約，請至少提前一天通知我們。

sentences.en: The showroom is open by appointment only, so please contact us by phone before you visit.
sentences.zh: 展示間僅限預約參觀，所以來訪前請先聯絡我們。

sentences.en: The board announced the appointment of Ms. Lin as the new director of the marketing department.
sentences.zh: 董事會宣布任命林小姐為行銷部的新總監。

sentences.en: I have an appointment with the dentist at three o'clock, so I will leave the office a little early today.
sentences.zh: 我三點和牙醫有約，所以今天會早一點離開辦公室。

words.note: 語塊：make an appointment（預約）、cancel an appointment（取消預約）、by appointment only（僅限預約）。appointment 是「事先約好的見面」，例如看醫生；date 是「約會（情侶）」。

sentences.en: The airline will investigate the cause of the delay and report its findings next week.
sentences.zh: 航空公司會調查延誤的原因，下週公布調查結果。

sentences.en: The manager promised to investigate the complaint and contact the customer by phone within two days.
sentences.zh: 經理承諾會調查投訴，並在兩天內聯絡顧客。

sentences.en: The police will thoroughly investigate the accident that happened on the busy highway late last night.
sentences.zh: 警方將徹底調查昨晚在公路上發生的事故。

sentences.en: A team of experts was hired to investigate why the new machines use so much electricity.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一組專家調查新機器為什麼這麼耗電。

sentences.en: We will investigate the problem with your account and send you an email with the results.
sentences.zh: 我們會調查你帳戶的問題，並寄電子郵件告訴你結果。

words.note: 語塊：investigate the cause（調查原因）、investigate a complaint（調查投訴）、thoroughly investigate（徹底調查）。investigate 是「深入調查」；investigation 是名詞；look into 意思接近。

sentences.en: Please send me the first draft of the report by Wednesday so that I have time to review it.
sentences.zh: 請在週三前把報告的初稿寄給我，讓我有時間審閱。

sentences.en: The lawyer is preparing a draft of the contract, which will be sent to both companies next week.
sentences.zh: 律師正在準備合約的草稿，下週會寄給兩家公司。

sentences.en: The final draft of the speech was much shorter than the first one, and it was easier to understand.
sentences.zh: 演講的定稿比初稿短很多，也更容易理解。

sentences.en: After reading the first draft, the editor suggested several changes to make the article clearer.
sentences.zh: 讀完初稿後，編輯建議了幾處修改，讓文章更清楚。

sentences.en: The marketing team will discuss the draft of the new advertisement at Friday's meeting with the client.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊會在週五的會議上討論新廣告的草稿。

words.note: 語塊：first draft（初稿）、final draft（定稿）、draft of（……的草稿）。draft 可以當名詞「草稿」或動詞「起草」；drafting 是「起草、擬稿」。

sentences.en: Guests can check into the hotel any time after two o'clock in the afternoon on the day of arrival.
sentences.zh: 客人下午兩點以後隨時都可以入住飯店。

sentences.en: After we check into the hotel, we will have dinner at the restaurant near the beach.
sentences.zh: 我們辦好飯店入住後，會到海邊附近的餐廳吃晚餐。

sentences.en: The manager promised to check into the matter and find out why the package was delivered late.
sentences.zh: 經理承諾會調查這件事，找出包裹為什麼遲送。

sentences.en: Please show your passport and credit card when you check into the hotel at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 在櫃台辦理飯店入住時，請出示護照和信用卡。

sentences.en: The IT department will check into the problem with the printer and let you know when it is fixed.
sentences.zh: 資訊部會調查印表機的問題，修好時會通知你。

words.note: 語塊：check into a hotel（入住飯店）、check into the matter（調查此事）。check into 可以是「辦理入住」或「調查」（= look into）；check in 也是「報到、入住」。

sentences.en: The most popular amenity at the hotel is the rooftop pool, which offers a view of the entire city.
sentences.zh: 飯店最受歡迎的設施是頂樓泳池，可以看到整座城市的景色。

sentences.en: Each apartment comes with every modern amenity, including a dishwasher, a washing machine, and air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 每間公寓都配備各種現代化設施，包括洗碗機和冷氣。

sentences.en: Free internet access is now considered a basic amenity that every hotel should provide to its guests.
sentences.zh: 免費網路現在被視為每家飯店都應該提供給客人的基本設施。

sentences.en: The new office building has a fitness center, which is an amenity that many employees appreciate.
sentences.zh: 新辦公大樓有健身中心，這是很多員工都很喜歡的設施。

sentences.en: The campsite does not offer any amenity except toilets, so visitors should bring their own food and water.
sentences.zh: 露營區除了廁所之外沒有任何設施，所以遊客應該自備食物和水。

words.note: 語塊：hotel amenity（飯店設施）、modern amenity（現代化設施）、basic amenity（基本設施）。amenity 常用複數 amenities，指「讓生活更方便舒適的設施」，例如泳池、健身房。

sentences.en: The new office chairs are very comfortable and can be adjusted to fit each employee's height.
sentences.zh: 新的辦公椅非常舒適，還可以依每位員工的身高調整。

sentences.en: We want every guest to feel comfortable and welcome as soon as they arrive at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 我們希望每位客人一抵達飯店就覺得自在又受歡迎。

sentences.en: Some employees are not comfortable with speaking in front of large groups, so we offer training.
sentences.zh: 有些員工不太習慣在一大群人面前說話，所以我們提供訓練。

sentences.en: The hotel rooms are small but comfortable, and they are located close to the train station.
sentences.zh: 飯店房間雖小但很舒適，而且離火車站很近。

sentences.en: The airline has installed more comfortable seats in its business class for long international flights.
sentences.zh: 航空公司在商務艙為長途國際航班裝了更舒適的座椅。

words.note: 語塊：comfortable chair（舒適的椅子）、feel comfortable（覺得自在）、comfortable with（對……感到放心）。comfortable 是「舒服的」；comfort 是名詞「舒適；安慰」；convenient 是「方便的」。

sentences.en: The storm caused a power outage that affected thousands of homes in the northern part of the city.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨造成停電，影響了城市北部數千戶家庭。

sentences.en: During the power outage, the hospital used its emergency generators to keep important machines running.
sentences.zh: 停電期間，醫院用緊急發電機讓重要的機器繼續運轉。

sentences.en: Please save your work often, as a power outage could cause you to lose important files.
sentences.zh: 請經常存檔，因為停電可能會讓你遺失重要檔案。

sentences.en: The factory had to stop production for several hours because of a power outage on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 因為週一早上停電，工廠只好停產好幾個小時。

sentences.en: The electricity company apologized for the power outage and said that it was caused by old equipment.
sentences.zh: 電力公司為停電道歉，並說那是老舊設備造成的。

words.note: 語塊：cause a power outage（造成停電）、during the power outage（停電期間）。power outage 和 blackout、power failure 意思相同。

sentences.en: Customers have praised the promptness of our delivery service, as most orders arrive the next day.
sentences.zh: 顧客稱讚我們配送服務很迅速，大部分訂單隔天就到。

sentences.en: We appreciate your promptness in responding to our questions about the new contract with our company.
sentences.zh: 感謝你迅速回覆我們關於新合約的問題。

sentences.en: The hotel is known for the promptness of its room service, which usually arrives within twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店以客房服務迅速著稱，通常二十分鐘內就送到。

sentences.en: The manager thanked the technician for his promptness in repairing the air conditioner on such a hot day.
sentences.zh: 經理感謝技師在這麼熱的天迅速修好冷氣。

sentences.en: Promptness in answering customer complaints is one of the most important parts of good service.
sentences.zh: 迅速回應顧客投訴是優質服務最重要的一環。

words.note: 語塊：with promptness（迅速地）、promptness in（在……方面的迅速）。promptness 是名詞；prompt 是形容詞「迅速的、準時的」；promptly 是副詞。

sentences.en: The company is known for its progressive policies, such as flexible hours and long parental leave.
sentences.zh: 那家公司以進步的政策聞名，例如彈性工時和長期育嬰假。

sentences.en: Many young people want to work for a progressive company that cares about the environment.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕人想在一家關心環境、觀念進步的公司工作。

sentences.en: There has been a progressive increase in the number of customers who pay with their phones.
sentences.zh: 用手機付款的顧客人數逐步增加。

sentences.en: The city has introduced several progressive ideas to make public transportation free for students and seniors.
sentences.zh: 市政府推出了幾個進步的構想，讓學生免費搭大眾運輸。

sentences.en: The school's progressive approach to teaching encourages students to solve real problems in small groups.
sentences.zh: 那所學校進步的教學方式鼓勵學生分組解決真實的問題。

words.note: 語塊：progressive company（觀念進步的公司）、progressive policy（進步的政策）、progressive increase（逐步增加）。progressive 是「進步、開明的」或「逐步的」；progress 是名詞「進展」。

sentences.en: Please buy spare parts only from an authorized dealer so that your warranty remains valid.
sentences.zh: 請只向授權經銷商購買備用零件，這樣保固才會有效。

sentences.en: This area of the factory is for authorized personnel only, so visitors must stay in the lobby.
sentences.zh: 工廠這一區只限授權人員進入，所以訪客必須待在大廳。

sentences.en: All payments over one thousand dollars must be authorized by the finance manager in advance.
sentences.zh: 所有超過一千美元的付款都必須事先經財務經理授權。

sentences.en: The authorized dealer offers free maintenance for the first year after you buy a new car.
sentences.zh: 授權經銷商在你買新車後的第一年提供免費保養。

sentences.en: Only authorized personnel may enter the server room, and every visit must be recorded in the logbook.
sentences.zh: 只有授權人員可以進入機房，每次進入都必須登記。

words.note: 語塊：authorized dealer（授權經銷商）、authorized personnel（授權人員）、authorized by（經……授權）。authorized 是「有正式許可的」；unauthorized 是「未經授權的」。

sentences.en: Many new coffee shops have started to spring up near the university since the new campus opened.
sentences.zh: 自從新校區啟用後，大學附近開始冒出很多新咖啡店。

sentences.en: Small technology companies continue to spring up all over the city because rent is cheaper here.
sentences.zh: 小型科技公司持續在城市各處冒出來，因為這裡房租比較便宜。

sentences.en: After the new highway was built, hotels and restaurants started to spring up along the road.
sentences.zh: 新公路蓋好後，沿路開始出現飯店和餐廳。

sentences.en: Online stores spring up every day, so it is important to make your business stand out.
sentences.zh: 網路商店每天都在冒出來，所以讓你的生意脫穎而出很重要。

sentences.en: New apartment buildings spring up quickly in areas that are close to subway stations and schools.
sentences.zh: 靠近捷運站的地區很快就會蓋起新的公寓大樓。

words.note: 語塊：spring up all over（到處冒出來）、start to spring up（開始冒出來）、spring up quickly（迅速出現）。spring up 是「迅速出現、冒出來」；過去式 sprang up；pop up 意思接近。

sentences.en: Many people prefer social media for news because of the immediacy of the information it provides.
sentences.zh: 很多人比較喜歡從社群媒體看新聞，因為它提供的資訊很即時。

sentences.en: The immediacy of video calls allows teams in different countries to solve problems quickly and easily.
sentences.zh: 視訊通話的即時性讓不同國家的團隊能快速解決問題。

sentences.en: Live broadcasts are popular with sports fans because of their immediacy and the excitement they create.
sentences.zh: 現場直播很受體育迷歡迎，因為它很即時又刺激。

sentences.en: The immediacy of online shopping means that customers expect their orders to arrive within a day.
sentences.zh: 網路購物的即時性意味著顧客期待訂單在一天內送達。

sentences.en: The report emphasized the immediacy of the problem and asked the board to take action this month.
sentences.zh: 報告強調了問題的急迫性，要求董事會這個月就採取行動。

words.note: 語塊：the immediacy of（……的即時性）。immediacy 是名詞；immediate 是形容詞「立即的」；immediately 是副詞。

sentences.en: The company hopes the new advertising campaign will boost sales during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 公司希望新的廣告活動能在節慶期間提升銷售。

sentences.en: The government plans to lower taxes in order to boost the economy after a difficult year.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫減稅，在艱難的一年後振興經濟。

sentences.en: The manager organized a team dinner to boost morale after the busy months of work.
sentences.zh: 經理在忙碌了好幾個月之後安排團隊聚餐，提振士氣。

sentences.en: Free samples can boost sales of a new product because customers like to try things before buying.
sentences.zh: 免費試用品可以提升新產品的銷售，因為顧客喜歡先試再買。

sentences.en: The new airport is expected to boost the economy of the region by attracting more tourists.
sentences.zh: 新機場預計會吸引更多觀光客，振興地區經濟。

words.note: 語塊：boost sales（提升銷售）、boost the economy（振興經濟）、boost morale（提振士氣）。boost 是「提高、推動」；increase 意思接近；當名詞是「推動力」。

sentences.en: Sales in Asia increased last year; in contrast, sales in Europe fell by ten percent.
sentences.zh: 去年亞洲的銷售增加了；相比之下，歐洲的銷售下降了一成。

sentences.en: In contrast to the old office, the new one is bright, quiet, and close to the subway station.
sentences.zh: 和舊辦公室不同，新辦公室明亮、安靜，又離捷運站很近。

sentences.en: The first hotel was expensive and noisy; in contrast, the second one was cheap and very comfortable.
sentences.zh: 第一家飯店又貴又吵；相比之下，第二家便宜又非常舒適。

sentences.en: In contrast to many large companies, our firm allows employees to work from home every Friday.
sentences.zh: 和很多大公司不同，我們公司讓員工每週五在家工作。

sentences.en: The weather in the north is cold and wet; in contrast, the south is warm and sunny most of the year.
sentences.zh: 北部天氣又冷又濕；相比之下，南部一年大部分時間都溫暖晴朗。

words.note: 語塊：in contrast to（和……形成對比）、by contrast（相比之下）。in contrast 放句首表示「相對地」；in contrast to / with + 名詞 是「和……相比」。

sentences.en: Customers can try out the new coffee machine at the store before they decide to buy it.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在決定購買之前先在店裡試用新咖啡機。

sentences.en: The company will try out the new software in one department before using it across the whole office.
sentences.zh: 公司會先在一個部門試用新軟體，再推廣到整個辦公室。

sentences.en: Visitors are invited to try out the latest virtual reality games at the technology fair this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末的科技展邀請訪客試玩最新的虛擬實境遊戲。

sentences.en: The restaurant plans to try out several new dishes before adding them to the main menu.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳打算先試推幾道新菜，再把它們加進主菜單。

sentences.en: Students who want to try out for the school basketball team should attend the practice on Friday.
sentences.zh: 想參加學校籃球隊選拔的學生，應該參加週五的練習。

words.note: 語塊：try out a new product（試用新產品）、try out for（參加……選拔）。try out 是「試用、測試看看」；try on 是「試穿」。

sentences.en: The company has introduced several new policies to promote gender equality in the workplace this year.
sentences.zh: 公司推出了好幾項新政策，促進職場的性別平等。

sentences.en: Equality of opportunity means that every applicant should be judged only on their skills and experience.
sentences.zh: 機會均等意味著每位應徵者都應該只根據技能和經驗被評斷。

sentences.en: The conference will discuss how businesses can promote equality and support workers from different backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 研討會將討論企業如何促進平等，並支持不同背景的員工。

sentences.en: Many young employees say that gender equality is an important factor when they choose a company.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕員工說，性別平等是他們選擇公司時的重要因素。

sentences.en: The new law was passed to protect equality of opportunity in education for children from poor families.
sentences.zh: 新法律的通過是為了保障貧困家庭孩子受教育的機會均等。

words.note: 語塊：gender equality（性別平等）、equality of opportunity（機會均等）、promote equality（促進平等）。equality 是名詞；equal 是形容詞「平等的」；quality（品質）長得像。

sentences.en: The company plans to equalize pay for men and women who do the same job by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在年底前讓做相同工作的男女薪資平等。

sentences.en: The government introduced new rules to equalize the price of electricity in rural and urban areas.
sentences.zh: 政府推出新規定，讓鄉村和城市地區的電價一致。

sentences.en: The team scored a goal in the last minute to equalize the score and avoid losing the game.
sentences.zh: 球隊在最後一分鐘進球扳平比分，避免輸掉比賽。

sentences.en: The new system will equalize the workload so that no employee has much more work than the others.
sentences.zh: 新系統會平衡工作量，讓沒有員工比其他人多很多工作。

sentences.en: Experts believe that better schools in poor areas could help equalize opportunities for young people.
sentences.zh: 專家認為貧困地區有更好的學校，能幫助讓年輕人的機會更平等。

words.note: 語塊：equalize pay（讓薪資平等）、equalize the score（扳平比分）、equalize the workload（平衡工作量）、equalize the price（讓價格一致）、equalize opportunities（讓機會平等）。equalize 是「讓……變得一樣」；equal 是形容詞；equality 是名詞。

sentences.en: Please make a comment on the report if you think any of the figures are not correct.
sentences.zh: 如果你覺得報告中有任何數字不正確，請提出意見。

sentences.en: When the reporter asked about the merger, the spokesperson simply replied with no comment and left the room.
sentences.zh: 記者問到合併時，發言人回答無可奉告。

sentences.en: The manager thanked each employee who left a comment about how to improve the office.
sentences.zh: 經理感謝每一位留下改善辦公室意見的員工。

sentences.en: Customers can leave a comment on our website to tell us what they think about our service.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在我們網站上留言，告訴我們他們對我們服務的看法。

sentences.en: The director's comment about the budget surprised several people at the meeting on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 總監對預算的評論讓會議上好幾個人很意外。

words.note: 語塊：make a comment（發表評論）、no comment（無可奉告）、comments on（對……的意見）。comment 可以當名詞或動詞（comment on）；commentary 是「評論、解說」。

sentences.en: Many customers choose our phone because of the simplicity of its design and its easy menus.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客選擇我們的手機，是因為它設計簡單、選單容易操作。

sentences.en: For simplicity, all prices in the report are shown in US dollars rather than in local currencies.
sentences.zh: 為了簡單起見，報告中所有價格都以美元表示，而不是當地貨幣。

sentences.en: The restaurant is popular because of the simplicity of its menu, which has only ten dishes.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳很受歡迎，因為它的菜單很簡單，只有十道菜。

sentences.en: The architect is known for the simplicity of her buildings, which use clean lines and natural materials.
sentences.zh: 那位建築師以建築的簡約聞名，運用俐落的線條和天然材料。

sentences.en: The simplicity of the online form means that most customers can complete it in less than five minutes.
sentences.zh: 線上表格很簡單，大部分顧客不到五分鐘就能填完。

words.note: 語塊：for simplicity（為了簡單起見）、the simplicity of（……的簡單）。simplicity 是名詞；simple 是形容詞；simplify 是動詞「簡化」。

sentences.en: The company announced a restructuring plan that will combine the sales and marketing departments next year.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布一項重組計畫，將合併業務部和行銷部。

sentences.en: Several managers lost their positions during the company restructuring that took place in the spring.
sentences.zh: 去年春天公司重組期間，好幾位經理失去了職位。

sentences.en: The bank will undergo restructuring next year in order to reduce costs and improve its online services.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行明年將進行重組，以降低成本並改善線上服務。

sentences.en: Employees were worried about the restructuring, but the CEO promised that no one would lose their job.
sentences.zh: 員工擔心重組，但執行長承諾不會有人失業。

sentences.en: The restructuring plan includes closing ten small branches and opening two large centers in the city.
sentences.zh: 重組計畫包括關閉十家小分行，並在市區開設兩個大型中心。

words.note: 語塊：company restructuring（公司重組）、undergo restructuring（進行重組）、restructuring plan（重組計畫）。restructuring 是「重新調整組織架構」；restructure 是動詞。

sentences.en: The new employees are eager to learn and have asked many questions during the training sessions.
sentences.zh: 新員工很渴望學習，在訓練課程中問了很多問題。

sentences.en: Investors are eager to see the results of the company's new strategy at the end of the quarter.
sentences.zh: 投資人很想在季末看到公司新策略的成果。

sentences.en: The team was eager to start the project, so they began working on it the day after it was approved.
sentences.zh: 團隊很急著開始專案，所以核准後隔天就開始動工。

sentences.en: Many customers are eager to try the new restaurant, which has received excellent reviews online.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客很想去試那家在網路上獲得極佳評價的新餐廳。

sentences.en: Ms. Ortiz is eager to learn more about marketing, so she signed up for an evening course at the university.
sentences.zh: Ortiz 小姐很渴望多學行銷，所以報名了大學的夜間課程。

words.note: 語塊：be eager to（渴望做……）、eager to learn（渴望學習）。be eager to + 原形動詞；eager 和 keen 意思接近；eagerly 是副詞。

sentences.en: If you are looking for an apartment, a real estate agent can show you several options in one afternoon.
sentences.zh: 如果你在找公寓，房仲可以在一個下午帶你看好幾個選擇。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen worked as a real estate agent for five years before she opened her own agency.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐當了五年房仲，之後開了自己的仲介公司。

sentences.en: We decided to contact a real estate agent to help us find a larger office near the city center.
sentences.zh: 我們決定聯絡一位房仲，幫我們在市中心附近找更大的辦公室。

sentences.en: The real estate agent said that prices in this neighborhood have risen by twenty percent in two years.
sentences.zh: 房仲說這一帶的房價兩年內漲了兩成。

sentences.en: Before you sign a lease, ask the real estate agent to explain every part of the contract.
sentences.zh: 簽租約之前，請房仲解釋合約的每一個部分。

words.note: 語塊：contact a real estate agent（聯絡房仲）、work as a real estate agent（擔任房仲）。real estate 是「房地產」；agent 是「代理人」；realtor 是美式說法。

sentences.en: The meeting with the new clients is scheduled for Thursday afternoon at two o'clock in Room 5.
sentences.zh: 和新客戶的會議預定在週四下午兩點。

sentences.en: The grand opening of the store is scheduled for the first weekend of December, just before the holidays.
sentences.zh: 那家店的盛大開幕預定在十二月的第一個週末。

sentences.en: The repairs to the elevator are scheduled for Saturday morning, when the office will be closed.
sentences.zh: 電梯維修預定在週六早上，那時辦公室不上班。

sentences.en: Your next appointment with the doctor is scheduled for the twentieth of March at ten in the morning.
sentences.zh: 你下次看診預定在三月二十日早上十點。

sentences.en: The product launch was scheduled for June, but it has been postponed until the end of summer.
sentences.zh: 產品上市原本預定在六月，但已經延到夏末。

words.note: 語塊：be scheduled for（預定在……）、be scheduled to（預定做……）。be scheduled for + 時間；be scheduled to + 原形動詞；schedule 是「時程表」。

sentences.en: The government has introduced strict rules to protect the environment during oil extraction near the coast.
sentences.zh: 政府推出嚴格規定，在海岸附近開採石油時保護環境。

sentences.en: The dentist said that a tooth extraction was necessary because the tooth was badly damaged.
sentences.zh: 牙醫說必須拔牙，因為那顆牙損壞得很嚴重。

sentences.en: The new software makes data extraction from old files much faster and more accurate for our staff.
sentences.zh: 新軟體讓從舊檔案擷取資料變得更快、更準確。

sentences.en: The company uses special machines for the extraction of oil from olives grown on local farms.
sentences.zh: 那家公司用特殊機器，從在地農場種的橄欖中提取油。

sentences.en: Patients should not eat for two hours after a tooth extraction and should rest for the rest of the day.
sentences.zh: 病人拔牙後兩小時內不應進食，當天應該好好休息。

words.note: 語塊：oil extraction（石油開採）、tooth extraction（拔牙）、data extraction（資料擷取）。extraction 是名詞；extract 是動詞「提取」；extract 也可以當名詞「萃取物」。

sentences.en: The car rental office at the airport is open twenty-four hours a day for travelers.
sentences.zh: 機場的租車櫃台二十四小時為旅客開放。

sentences.en: The rental fee for the conference hall includes chairs, tables, a projector, and free internet access.
sentences.zh: 會議廳的租金包含椅子、桌子和投影機。

sentences.en: Please read the rental agreement carefully before you sign it and pay the deposit to the owner.
sentences.zh: 簽約並支付押金之前，請仔細閱讀租約。

sentences.en: Bicycle rental is available at the park entrance, and helmets are provided free of charge.
sentences.zh: 公園入口有腳踏車出租，並免費提供安全帽。

sentences.en: The rental agreement states that tenants must give two months' notice in writing before moving out.
sentences.zh: 租約規定房客搬走前必須提前兩個月通知。

words.note: 語塊：car rental（租車）、rental fee（租金）、rental agreement（租約）。rental 是「出租、租金」；rent 可以是名詞「租金」或動詞「租」。

sentences.en: Customers must pay a deposit of twenty percent when they order furniture from our store.
sentences.zh: 顧客在我們店訂購家具時必須先付兩成訂金。

sentences.en: The landlord will return the security deposit if the apartment is clean and undamaged when you move out.
sentences.zh: 如果你搬走時公寓乾淨沒有損壞，房東會退還保證金。

sentences.en: You can make a deposit at any of our branches or through the mobile app on your phone.
sentences.zh: 你可以在我們任何一家分行或透過手機 App 存款。

sentences.en: The hotel requires a deposit for the first night when you make a reservation online.
sentences.zh: 在網路上訂房時，飯店要求先付第一晚的訂金。

sentences.en: Please pay a deposit by Friday to confirm your place in the cooking class next month.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前付訂金，確認你下個月烹飪課的名額。

words.note: 語塊：pay a deposit（付押金）、security deposit（保證金）、make a deposit（存款）。deposit 可以是「押金、訂金」或銀行「存款」；當動詞是「存入」。

sentences.en: If anything in the apartment is broken, please contact the landlord as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 如果公寓裡有任何東西壞了，請盡快聯絡房東。

sentences.en: The landlord agreed to repair the heating system before the cold weather begins next month.
sentences.zh: 房東同意在下個月天氣變冷之前修好暖氣系統。

sentences.en: The contract explains the responsibilities of the landlord and the tenant in clear and simple language.
sentences.zh: 合約用清楚的文字說明房東和房客的責任。

sentences.en: The landlord increased the rent by five percent, so several tenants decided to move out.
sentences.zh: 房東把房租調漲百分之五，所以有好幾位房客決定搬走。

sentences.en: Our landlord lives in the building and is always happy to help when there is a problem.
sentences.zh: 我們的房東就住在大樓裡，有問題時總是很樂意幫忙。

words.note: 語塊：contact the landlord（聯絡房東）、landlord and tenant（房東和房客）。landlord 是「把房子租出去的人」；tenant 是「房客」；landlady 是女性房東。

sentences.en: The company is discussing the renewal of its contract with the cleaning service for another two years.
sentences.zh: 公司正在討論和清潔公司再續約兩年的事。

sentences.en: Members will receive a reminder about membership renewal by email one month before their membership expires.
sentences.zh: 會員資格到期前一個月，會員會收到續約提醒。

sentences.en: The city's urban renewal project will turn the old factory area into parks, shops, and apartments.
sentences.zh: 城市的都市更新計畫將把舊工廠區變成公園、商店和公寓。

sentences.en: Please submit your passport renewal application at least three months before your planned trip abroad.
sentences.zh: 請在出國前至少三個月提出護照更新申請。

sentences.en: The renewal of the lease will include a small increase in rent starting in January.
sentences.zh: 租約續約將從一月起小幅調漲房租。

words.note: 語塊：contract renewal（續約）、membership renewal（會員續約）、urban renewal（都市更新）。renewal 是名詞；renew 是動詞「續約；更新」。

sentences.en: Scientists warn that pollution could cause irreversible damage to the coral reefs near the island.
sentences.zh: 科學家警告，污染可能對島嶼附近的珊瑚礁造成無法挽回的損害。

sentences.en: Closing the factory is an irreversible decision, so the board wants to study every option carefully first.
sentences.zh: 關閉工廠是不可改變的決定，所以董事會想先仔細研究每個選項。

sentences.en: Some changes to the environment are irreversible, which is why we must act quickly to protect forests.
sentences.zh: 環境的某些變化是不可逆的，這就是我們必須快速行動保護森林的原因。

sentences.en: The doctor explained that the injury was not irreversible and that the patient would recover with rest.
sentences.zh: 醫生解釋說傷勢並非不可逆，病人休息後就會康復。

sentences.en: Deleting the files is irreversible, so please make sure you have a backup before you continue.
sentences.zh: 刪除檔案是無法復原的，所以繼續之前請確認你有備份。

words.note: 語塊：irreversible damage（無法挽回的損害）、irreversible decision（不可改變的決定）、irreversible changes（不可逆的變化）。irreversible 是「回不去了」；reversible 是「可逆的；（衣服）兩面穿的」。

sentences.en: The new law will protect wildlife in the forest by banning hunting and limiting the number of visitors.
sentences.zh: 新法律將禁止狩獵並限制遊客人數，保護森林裡的野生動物。

sentences.en: Families can see lions, giraffes, and other animals at the wildlife park outside the city.
sentences.zh: 家庭可以在城外的野生動物園看到獅子、長頸鹿和其他動物。

sentences.en: The tour guide will explain how the local wildlife survives during the long, cold winter months.
sentences.zh: 導遊會說明當地野生動物如何度過漫長寒冷的冬季。

sentences.en: Visitors to the national park must not feed the wildlife, as human food can make the animals sick.
sentences.zh: 國家公園的遊客不可以餵野生動物，因為人類的食物會讓動物生病。

sentences.en: The company donated money to protect wildlife living in the wetlands near its new factory.
sentences.zh: 公司捐錢保護新工廠附近濕地裡的野生動物。
