words.note: 語塊：protect wildlife（保護野生動物）、wildlife park（野生動物園）、local wildlife（當地野生動物）。wildlife 是不可數名詞（總稱）；wild 是形容詞「野生的」。

sentences.en: Please report any broken equipment in the gym to the front desk so that it can be repaired.
sentences.zh: 健身房裡有任何故障的設備，請通報櫃台以便維修。

sentences.en: The coffee machine in the break room is broken, so a technician will come to fix it this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 茶水間的咖啡機壞了，所以技師今天下午會來修。

sentences.en: The store will replace any broken items that were damaged during delivery at no extra cost.
sentences.zh: 店家會免費更換運送過程中損壞的任何物品。

sentences.en: A broken window on the third floor was repaired after the storm caused damage to the building.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨損壞大樓後，三樓的一扇破窗被修好了。

sentences.en: Customers who receive a broken product should take a photo of it and contact our customer service team.
sentences.zh: 收到破損產品的顧客應該拍照並聯絡我們的客服團隊。

words.note: 語塊：broken window（破窗）、broken equipment（故障設備）、be broken（壞了）。broken 是 break 的過去分詞，當形容詞是「壞了的」；out of order 也可以表示「故障」。

sentences.en: The electrician will replace the old light fixture in the meeting room with a more efficient one.
sentences.zh: 電工會把會議室的舊燈具換成更節能的。

sentences.en: Each new apartment has a modern bathroom fixture in the shower that saves water and energy.
sentences.zh: 每間新公寓的淋浴間都有一個節水又節能的現代化衛浴設備。

sentences.en: The hotel spent a large amount of money replacing every light fixture in the lobby and the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 飯店花了很多錢更換大廳和餐廳的每一盞燈具。

sentences.en: Tenants are not allowed to remove any fixture from the apartment without permission from the landlord.
sentences.zh: 沒有房東許可，房客不得移除公寓裡的任何固定裝置。

sentences.en: The store sells every light fixture you might need for your home, office, or garden.
sentences.zh: 那家店販售你居家、辦公室或花園可能需要的每一種燈具。

words.note: 語塊：light fixture（燈具）、bathroom fixture（衛浴設備）、fixtures and fittings（固定裝置和配件）。fixture 是「固定在房子裡的設備」，例如燈具、水龍頭；furniture 是可移動的「家具」。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim received an award in recognition of her work to improve customer service at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 金小姐因為致力改善飯店的客服而獲得一個獎項，以表彰她的工作。

sentences.en: The company gave all employees an extra day off in recognition of their hard work during the busy season.
sentences.zh: 為了表彰員工在旺季的辛勤工作，公司給所有員工多一天假。

sentences.en: The city named a street after the scientist in recognition of her achievements in medicine.
sentences.zh: 市政府以那位科學家的名字為一條街命名，表揚她在醫學上的成就。

sentences.en: In recognition of his thirty years of service, Mr. Lopez was invited to speak at the annual dinner.
sentences.zh: 為了表彰 Lopez 先生三十年的服務，他受邀在年度晚宴上致詞。

sentences.en: The volunteers were given certificates in recognition of their help in organizing the city marathon.
sentences.zh: 志工獲頒證書，表彰他們協助籌辦馬拉松。

words.note: 語塊：in recognition of one's work（表彰某人的工作）、in recognition of achievements（表揚成就）。in recognition of 是「為了表揚、肯定……」；recognize 是動詞「認可；認出」。

sentences.en: The hotel offers comfortable rooms at a moderate price, so it is popular with business travelers.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店以中等價格提供舒適的房間，所以很受商務旅客歡迎。

sentences.en: Doctors recommend at least thirty minutes of moderate exercise, such as walking or cycling, every day.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議每天至少做三十分鐘的適度運動，例如散步。

sentences.en: Economists expect moderate growth in the economy next year, with prices rising slowly in most areas.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家預期明年經濟會溫和成長，物價緩慢上升。

sentences.en: The weather will be moderate this weekend, with temperatures around twenty degrees in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 這個週末天氣溫和，氣溫大約二十度。

sentences.en: The company reported moderate growth in sales, which was better than many analysts had expected.
sentences.zh: 公司公布銷售溫和成長，比很多分析師預期的好。

words.note: 語塊：moderate price（中等價格）、moderate exercise（適度運動）、moderate growth（溫和成長）。moderate 是「不多不少、適中的」；當動詞是「主持（討論）」；moderator 是「主持人」。

sentences.en: The conference will hold a panel discussion about the future of electric cars on Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 研討會週五早上將舉辦一場關於電動車未來的座談會。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed was invited to take part in a panel discussion with three other business leaders.
sentences.zh: Ahmed 小姐受邀和另外三位企業領袖一起參加座談會。

sentences.en: After the panel discussion, members of the audience will have time to ask the speakers questions.
sentences.zh: 座談會結束後，觀眾會有時間向講者提問。

sentences.en: The panel discussion focused on how small businesses can use social media to attract customers.
sentences.zh: 座談會聚焦在小企業如何利用社群媒體吸引顧客。

sentences.en: The university will hold a panel discussion on climate change, and students can attend for free.
sentences.zh: 那所大學將舉辦一場氣候變遷座談會，學生可以免費參加。

words.note: 語塊：hold a panel discussion（舉辦座談會）、take part in a panel discussion（參加座談）。panel discussion 是「幾位專家在台上一起討論」；panel 也可以指「評審團」。

sentences.en: The company follows strict ethical standards when it chooses suppliers for its clothing and shoes.
sentences.zh: 那家公司選擇服裝供應商時遵守嚴格的道德標準。

sentences.en: Many customers prefer to buy from an ethical business that treats its workers and suppliers fairly.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客比較喜歡向公平對待員工、有道德的企業購買。

sentences.en: The use of personal data in advertising raises an important ethical issue for technology companies.
sentences.zh: 在廣告中使用個人資料，對科技公司來說是一個重要的倫理問題。

sentences.en: Employees who are unsure about an ethical issue should talk to their manager or the legal department.
sentences.zh: 對倫理問題不確定的員工應該找經理或法務部談。

sentences.en: The firm was praised for its ethical standards after it refused to work with a company that polluted rivers.
sentences.zh: 那家公司拒絕和污染河川的企業合作後，因道德標準而受到稱讚。

words.note: 語塊：ethical standards（道德標準）、ethical business（有道德的經營）、ethical issue（倫理問題）。ethical 是形容詞；ethics 是名詞「倫理；道德規範」。

sentences.en: The tour package includes round-trip airfare, four nights at a hotel, and breakfast every day.
sentences.zh: 這個套裝行程包含來回機票、四晚飯店住宿和每天早餐。

sentences.en: Travelers can find cheap airfare by booking their flights several months in advance on the internet.
sentences.zh: 旅客提前幾個月訂機票，就能找到便宜的機票。

sentences.en: The company will pay for your airfare and hotel when you travel to the conference in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 你去首爾參加研討會時，公司會負擔你的機票和飯店。

sentences.en: Airfare to popular destinations usually increases during the summer and holiday seasons every single year.
sentences.zh: 飛往熱門地點的機票價格通常在夏天和節慶期間上漲。

sentences.en: The prize for the winner of the contest will include airfare for two people to Japan.
sentences.zh: 比賽得獎者的獎品包含兩人飛日本的機票。

words.note: 語塊：round-trip airfare（來回機票）、cheap airfare（便宜機票）、include airfare（包含機票）。airfare 是「機票錢」；air ticket 是「機票本身」。

sentences.en: Many people find a sense of contentment in simple activities such as gardening and cooking.
sentences.zh: 很多人在園藝和做菜等簡單的活動中找到滿足感。

sentences.en: The survey showed that contentment at work depends more on good relationships than on salary.
sentences.zh: 調查顯示，工作上的滿足感更取決於良好的人際關係，而不是薪水。

sentences.en: After retiring, Mr. Brown was able to find contentment in traveling and spending time with his grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 退休後，Brown 先生得以在旅行和陪孫子中找到滿足。

sentences.en: The hotel's quiet garden gives guests a sense of contentment after a busy day in the city.
sentences.zh: 飯店安靜的花園讓客人在城裡忙碌一天後感到滿足。

sentences.en: Experts say that regular exercise and enough sleep can increase feelings of contentment in daily life.
sentences.zh: 專家說規律運動和充足睡眠能增加滿足感。

words.note: 語塊：a sense of contentment（滿足感）、find contentment（找到滿足）。contentment 是名詞「心滿意足」；content 當形容詞是「滿足的」。

sentences.en: All of the stores will be open on Monday, with the exception of the one at the airport.
sentences.zh: 除了機場那家以外，所有門市週一都會營業。

sentences.en: With the exception of Ms. Lee, everyone on the team will attend the conference in Tokyo next week.
sentences.zh: 除了李小姐之外，團隊每個人下週都會參加東京的研討會。

sentences.en: The museum is open every day with the exception of national holidays and the first Monday of each month.
sentences.zh: 博物館除了國定假日和每月第一個週一以外每天開放。

sentences.en: All of the rooms have been renovated, with the exception of the suites on the top floor.
sentences.zh: 除了頂樓的套房以外，所有房間都已經翻修過了。

sentences.en: With the exception of a few small problems, the opening of the new office went very smoothly.
sentences.zh: 除了幾個小問題之外，新辦公室的開幕進行得非常順利。

words.note: 語塊：with the exception of（除了……以外）。with the exception of 和 except (for) 意思相同，比較正式；exception 是「例外」。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant is a strong advocate of flexible working hours and has introduced them at her company.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐是彈性工時的強力支持者，已在她的公司實施。

sentences.en: The mayor has long been an advocate of public transportation and plans to build two new subway lines.
sentences.zh: 市長長期以來都是大眾運輸的提倡者，計畫興建兩條新捷運線。

sentences.en: As an advocate of healthy eating, the chef uses fresh vegetables in every dish on her menu.
sentences.zh: 身為健康飲食的提倡者，那位主廚菜單上每道菜都用新鮮蔬菜。

sentences.en: The author is a strong advocate of reading to children every day, even before they can speak.
sentences.zh: 那位作家強力提倡每天唸書給孩子聽，甚至在他們會說話之前。

sentences.en: Many business leaders are an advocate of training programs that help employees learn new skills.
sentences.zh: 很多企業領袖都是幫助員工學新技能的訓練計畫的支持者。

words.note: 語塊：an advocate of（……的提倡者）、strong advocate（強力支持者）。advocate 當名詞是「支持者」；當動詞是「提倡、主張」；supporter 意思接近。

sentences.en: The government plans to invest in early education by building more kindergartens in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫在鄉村地區蓋更多幼兒園，投資幼兒教育。

sentences.en: Studies show that children who attend an early education program do better in primary school.
sentences.zh: 研究顯示，參加幼兒教育計畫的孩子在小學表現比較好。

sentences.en: Ms. Park has worked in early education for fifteen years and now trains new kindergarten teachers.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐從事幼兒教育十五年，現在負責訓練新的幼兒園老師。

sentences.en: The city will offer a free early education program for families with low incomes starting next year.
sentences.zh: 市政府明年起將為低收入家庭提供免費的幼兒教育計畫。

sentences.en: Many experts believe that money spent on early education helps the economy in the long term.
sentences.zh: 很多專家認為花在幼兒教育上的錢長期來看有助經濟。

words.note: 語塊：invest in early education（投資幼兒教育）、early education program（幼兒教育計畫）。early education 指學齡前的教育；primary education 是「小學教育」。

sentences.en: The company will celebrate its fiftieth anniversary with a party for all employees and their families.
sentences.zh: 公司將舉辦一場邀請所有員工和家人的派對，慶祝五十週年。

sentences.en: The department store's anniversary sale offers discounts of up to fifty percent on many items.
sentences.zh: 百貨公司的週年慶很多商品最多打五折。

sentences.en: To celebrate the tenth anniversary of the restaurant, the owners will offer a free dessert to every guest.
sentences.zh: 為了慶祝餐廳十週年，老闆會招待每位客人一份免費甜點。

sentences.en: The museum is preparing a special exhibition for its hundredth anniversary celebration early next spring.
sentences.zh: 博物館正在為明年春天的百年紀念準備特展。

sentences.en: Many customers wait for the anniversary sale every year because it has the lowest prices of the season.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客每年都在等週年慶，因為那是這一季價格最低的時候。

words.note: 語塊：celebrate an anniversary（慶祝週年）、tenth anniversary（十週年）、anniversary sale（週年慶）。anniversary 是「每年的紀念日」；birthday 是「生日」；annual 是「每年的」。

sentences.en: Many people now search for information about products online before they visit a store in person.
sentences.zh: 很多人現在去店裡之前，會先上網搜尋產品資訊。

sentences.en: After leaving his job at the bank, Mr. Diaz began to search for a job in marketing.
sentences.zh: 離開銀行的工作後，Diaz 先生開始找行銷方面的工作。

sentences.en: The engineers will continue to search for a solution to the problem with the factory's cooling system.
sentences.zh: 工程師會繼續尋找工廠冷卻系統問題的解決辦法。

sentences.en: The company hired a recruitment agency to search for a new director with experience in Asia.
sentences.zh: 公司請了一家人力仲介公司，尋找一位有亞洲經驗的新總監。

sentences.en: Customers can search for products by name, price, size, or color on our new website.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在我們的新網站上依名稱、價格或顏色搜尋商品。

words.note: 語塊：search for information（搜尋資訊）、search for a job（找工作）、search for a solution（尋找解決辦法）。search for 是「找（某物）」；search + 地點 是「搜查某處」（search the room）。

sentences.en: The hotel is within easy distance of the airport, so it is popular with business travelers.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店離機場很近，所以很受商務旅客歡迎。

sentences.en: Our new office is within easy distance of several restaurants, banks, and a large park.
sentences.zh: 我們的新辦公室離好幾家餐廳、銀行和一座大公園都很近。

sentences.en: The apartment is within easy distance of the subway station, which makes it convenient for commuters.
sentences.zh: 那間公寓離捷運站很近，對通勤族來說很方便。

sentences.en: Many families choose this neighborhood because it is within easy distance of several good schools.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭選擇這個社區，因為它離好學校很近。

sentences.en: The conference center is within easy distance of the old town, where visitors can enjoy shopping and dining.
sentences.zh: 會議中心離老城區很近，訪客可以在那裡逛街吃飯。

words.note: 語塊：within easy distance of（離……很近）、within walking distance（走路可到）。within easy distance of 是「很容易到達」；within walking distance of 是「走路就能到」。

sentences.en: Please do not take offense if the manager changes your report, as she does this for everyone.
sentences.zh: 如果經理修改你的報告，請不要覺得被冒犯，因為她每個人都這樣。

sentences.en: Parking in a space for disabled drivers is a minor offense, but it can result in a large fine.
sentences.zh: 停在身障車位是輕微違規，但可能會被處以高額罰款。

sentences.en: No offense, but I think the second design is more suitable for our clients than the first one.
sentences.zh: 沒有惡意，但我覺得第二個設計比第一個更適合我們的客戶。

sentences.en: The customer took offense at the waiter's comment and asked to speak with the manager.
sentences.zh: 那位顧客對服務生的話感到不悅，要求和經理談。

sentences.en: Driving without a valid license is a serious offense in most countries around the world.
sentences.zh: 無照駕駛在世界上大多數國家都是嚴重的違法行為。

words.note: 語塊：take offense（生氣；覺得被冒犯）、no offense（沒有惡意）、a minor offense（輕微違規）。offense 是美式拼法，英式為 offence；offend 是動詞「冒犯」；offensive 是「冒犯的」。

sentences.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget for next year's online marketing campaign.
sentences.zh: 議程上的第一個項目是明年行銷活動的預算。

sentences.en: Please note that a sale item cannot be returned or exchanged once it has been purchased.
sentences.zh: 請注意，特價品一經購買就不能退換。

sentences.en: Each item in the store has a barcode that shows its price and the date it arrived.
sentences.zh: 店裡的每一件商品都有一個顯示價格和到貨日期的條碼。

sentences.en: The package arrived on time, but one item was missing, so I contacted customer service.
sentences.zh: 包裹準時到了，但少了一件物品，所以我聯絡了客服。

sentences.en: Customers can order up to ten of each item, and delivery is free for orders over fifty dollars.
sentences.zh: 顧客每項商品最多可以訂十件，訂單超過五十美元免運費。

words.note: 語塊：item on the agenda（議程上的項目）、sale item（特價品）、each item（每一件）。item 是「一件東西、一個項目」；items 常指「商品」。

sentences.en: The company will shoot a commercial for its new sports drink at the beach next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月會在海邊為新運動飲料拍一支廣告。

sentences.en: The film crew plans to shoot several scenes in the old part of the city, so some streets will be closed.
sentences.zh: 電影劇組計畫在老城區拍好幾場戲，所以有些街道會封閉。

sentences.en: The magazine hired a famous photographer to shoot the cover for its special holiday issue.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌請了一位知名攝影師為節慶特刊拍封面。

sentences.en: It took three days to shoot a film about the history of the company for its anniversary celebration.
sentences.zh: 為了週年慶，花了三天拍一部關於公司歷史的影片。

sentences.en: The director wants to shoot a commercial that shows how easy the new phone is to use.
sentences.zh: 導演想拍一支展現新手機有多容易使用的廣告。

words.note: 語塊：shoot a film（拍電影）、shoot a commercial（拍廣告）、photo shoot（拍照）。shoot 在商業英文常指「拍攝」；過去式 shot；photo shoot 是名詞「拍攝工作」。

sentences.en: The restaurant is in a prime location on the main street, so it attracts many tourists every day.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳位於主要街道的黃金地段，所以每天都吸引很多觀光客。

sentences.en: Advertisements shown during prime time are much more expensive than those shown late at night.
sentences.zh: 黃金時段播出的廣告比深夜播出的貴很多。

sentences.en: The new library is a prime example of how modern design can use natural light and save energy.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館是現代設計如何運用自然光並節能的最好例子。

sentences.en: The company paid a high price for the office because it is in a prime location near the subway.
sentences.zh: 公司為那間辦公室付了很高的價格，因為它位於捷運附近的黃金地段。

sentences.en: The cooking show will be broadcast during prime time on Saturday evenings starting next month.
sentences.zh: 那個烹飪節目下個月起將在週六晚上的黃金時段播出。

words.note: 語塊：prime location（黃金地段）、prime time（黃金時段）、prime example（最好的例子）。prime 是「最重要的、最好的」；primary 是「主要的；初級的」。

sentences.en: The project was constrained by a small budget, so the team had to find cheaper materials.
sentences.zh: 專案受限於很少的預算，所以團隊必須找更便宜的材料。

sentences.en: Many small businesses are financially constrained and cannot afford to hire more staff this year.
sentences.zh: 很多小企業財務受限，今年無法負擔增聘人手。

sentences.en: The design of the new office was constrained by the size and shape of the old building.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室的設計受到舊大樓大小和形狀的限制。

sentences.en: Because we are constrained by time, we will discuss only the most important items at today's meeting.
sentences.zh: 因為時間有限，我們今天的會議只討論最重要的項目。

sentences.en: Schools in rural areas are often constrained by a lack of teachers and modern equipment.
sentences.zh: 鄉村地區的學校常受限於缺乏老師和現代化設備。

words.note: 語塊：financially constrained（財務受限）、constrained by（受……限制）。constrained 是「被限制住的」；constraint 是名詞「限制」；restricted 意思接近。

sentences.en: The bag is made of genuine leather and comes with a two-year warranty from the manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 這個包包是真皮做的，還附有製造商兩年的保固。

sentences.en: The interviewer could tell that the applicant had a genuine interest in working with children.
sentences.zh: 面試官看得出那位應徵者對和孩子一起工作有真正的興趣。

sentences.en: The manager showed genuine concern for the employee who was injured and visited him in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 經理對那位受傷的員工表現出真誠的關心，還到醫院探望他。

sentences.en: Customers should buy spare parts only from authorized dealers to make sure they are genuine.
sentences.zh: 顧客應該只向授權經銷商購買備用零件，確保它們是正品。

sentences.en: The museum confirmed that the painting is genuine and was painted by the artist in the 1890s.
sentences.zh: 博物館確認那幅畫是真跡，由那位藝術家在 1890 年代所畫。

words.note: 語塊：genuine leather（真皮）、genuine interest（真正的興趣）、genuine concern（真誠的關心）。genuine 是「真的、不是假的」；authentic 意思接近；fake 是「假的」。

sentences.en: The painting in the hotel lobby is a reproduction of a famous work that is kept in a museum in Paris.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳的那幅畫是巴黎一家博物館收藏的名畫的複製品。

sentences.en: The gift shop sells a reproduction of every major painting in the museum's large collection at low prices.
sentences.zh: 禮品店販售博物館館藏中每幅重要畫作的複製品。

sentences.en: The reproduction of documents without written permission from the author or the publisher is not allowed.
sentences.zh: 未經作者或出版社的書面許可，不得複製文件。

sentences.en: Scientists are studying the reproduction of rare birds that live in the wetlands near the river.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在研究住在河邊濕地的稀有鳥類的繁殖。

sentences.en: This chair is a reproduction of a classic design from the 1950s, and it costs much less than the original.
sentences.zh: 這張椅子是 1950 年代經典設計的複製品，價格比原版便宜很多。

words.note: 語塊：a reproduction of（……的複製品）、reproduction of documents（文件複製）。reproduction 可以是「複製品」或生物「繁殖」；reproduce 是動詞；original 是「原作」。

sentences.en: The film received a nomination for best picture at the international film festival this year.
sentences.zh: 那部電影今年在國際影展獲得最佳影片提名。

sentences.en: Employees can submit a nomination for the annual award by sending an email to human resources.
sentences.zh: 員工可以寄電子郵件給人資部，提交年度獎項的提名。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin was surprised to receive a nomination for employee of the year after only two years.
sentences.zh: 林小姐才到職兩年就獲得年度最佳員工提名，讓她很意外。

sentences.en: The deadline for each nomination is the end of March, and the winners will be announced in May.
sentences.zh: 每項提名的截止日是三月底，得獎者將在五月公布。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim decided to accept a nomination to become the new chairperson of the business association.
sentences.zh: 金先生決定接受提名，成為商業協會的新主席。

words.note: 語塊：receive a nomination（獲得提名）、nomination for（……的提名）、accept a nomination（接受提名）。nomination 是名詞；nominate 是動詞「提名」；nominee 是「被提名人」。

sentences.en: The company has more than two thousand people on the payroll in its factories around the world.
sentences.zh: 那家公司在全球的工廠中有兩千多名員工。

sentences.en: Please contact the payroll department if there is a mistake on your monthly pay slip.
sentences.zh: 如果你的每月薪資單有錯誤，請聯絡薪資部門。

sentences.en: The new payroll system automatically calculates taxes and sends salaries to employees' bank accounts every month.
sentences.zh: 新的薪資系統會自動計算稅金，並把薪水匯到員工的銀行帳戶。

sentences.en: Small businesses often hire an accountant to manage their payroll and other important financial matters.
sentences.zh: 小企業常常聘請會計師管理薪資和其他財務事項。

sentences.en: The restaurant added ten new workers to the payroll before the busy summer season began.
sentences.zh: 忙碌的夏季開始前，那家餐廳新增了十名員工。

words.note: 語塊：on the payroll（受僱於）、payroll department（薪資部門）、payroll system（薪資系統）。payroll 是「公司付薪水的名單或總額」；salary 是個人的「薪水」。

sentences.en: Residents of the apartment building pay a monthly maintenance fee for cleaning, repairs, and security.
sentences.zh: 公寓大樓的住戶每月要付清潔和保全的管理費。

sentences.en: The bank charges a small maintenance fee if the balance in your account falls below one hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 如果你帳戶的餘額低於一百美元，銀行會收取一小筆維護費。

sentences.en: The software company offers free updates to customers in exchange for an annual maintenance fee.
sentences.zh: 那家軟體公司收取年度維護費，提供免費更新。

sentences.en: The monthly maintenance fee will increase slightly next year because of higher costs for repairs.
sentences.zh: 因為維修成本增加，明年每月管理費會小幅調漲。

sentences.en: Customers who buy the printer must pay an annual maintenance fee to receive regular service.
sentences.zh: 購買印表機的顧客必須付年度維護費，才能享有定期服務。

words.note: 語塊：monthly maintenance fee（每月管理費）、annual maintenance fee（年度維護費）。maintenance 是「維修、保養」；fee 是「費用」；maintain 是動詞。

sentences.en: There are some risks associated with investing in new technology, so we must plan carefully.
sentences.zh: 投資新科技有一些相關風險，所以我們必須仔細規劃。

sentences.en: The brand is associated with high quality and excellent service in the minds of most customers.
sentences.zh: 在大多數顧客心中，那個品牌和高品質及優質服務連在一起。

sentences.en: Please read about the costs associated with renting the hall before you sign the contract.
sentences.zh: 簽約前，請先看看租用會場的相關費用。

sentences.en: Long working hours are often associated with stress and health problems among office workers in large cities.
sentences.zh: 長工時常常和上班族的壓力及健康問題有關。

sentences.en: The company explained the risks associated with the new product before it was sold in stores.
sentences.zh: 公司在新產品於門市販售前說明了相關風險。

words.note: 語塊：be associated with（和……有關）、risks associated with（與……相關的風險）。be associated with 是「和……有關聯」；be related to 意思接近；associate 是動詞「聯想」。

sentences.en: Each member of the sales team must meet a quota of twenty new customers every month.
sentences.zh: 業務團隊的每位成員每個月都必須達成二十位新客戶的配額。

sentences.en: Employees who reach their sales quota before the end of the quarter will receive a bonus.
sentences.zh: 在季末前達成業績配額的員工會獲得獎金。

sentences.en: The government set an import quota to protect local farmers from cheap rice imported from abroad.
sentences.zh: 政府設定進口配額，保護在地農民不受便宜外國米的衝擊。

sentences.en: The factory was unable to meet a quota for production because several machines broke down.
sentences.zh: 因為好幾台機器故障，工廠無法達成生產配額。

sentences.en: The new sales quota is higher than last year's, but the manager believes the team can reach it.
sentences.zh: 新的業績配額比去年高，但經理相信團隊能達成。

words.note: 語塊：sales quota（業績配額）、meet a quota（達成配額）、import quota（進口配額）。quota 是「規定的數量」；quote 是「報價；引用」，只差一個字母。

sentences.en: The company plans to launch a product for elderly customers that is easy to use and very affordable.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫推出一款容易使用又非常平價、給年長顧客的產品。

sentences.en: The city will launch a campaign to encourage residents to recycle more of their household waste.
sentences.zh: 市政府將發起一項活動，鼓勵居民回收更多家庭垃圾。

sentences.en: We will launch a website next month where customers can order our products and track their deliveries.
sentences.zh: 我們下個月會上線一個網站，讓顧客可以訂購產品並追蹤配送。

sentences.en: The airline is expected to launch new routes to Southeast Asia at the beginning of next year.
sentences.zh: 那家航空公司預計明年初推出飛往東南亞的新航線。

sentences.en: Before you launch a product, it is important to test it carefully and listen to feedback from customers.
sentences.zh: 推出產品之前，仔細測試並聽取顧客意見很重要。

words.note: 語塊：launch a product（推出產品）、launch a campaign（發起活動）、launch a website（上線網站）。launch 是「推出（新產品、活動）」；也可以當名詞「上市」；release 意思接近。

sentences.en: Online shopping has grown quickly over the past decade, and many stores now sell most items online.
sentences.zh: 網路購物在過去十年快速成長，很多店現在大部分商品都在網路上賣。

sentences.en: Mr. Lopez has worked at the bank for a decade and knows almost every customer by name.
sentences.zh: Lopez 先生在銀行工作十年了，幾乎叫得出每位顧客的名字。

sentences.en: The company plans to open one hundred new stores across Asia during the next decade.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在未來十年於亞洲各地開設一百家新店。

sentences.en: The price of houses in the city has nearly doubled over the past decade because of strong demand.
sentences.zh: 因為需求強勁，城市的房價在過去十年將近翻倍。

sentences.en: Experts believe that electric cars will become more common than gas cars within the next decade.
sentences.zh: 專家認為未來十年內電動車將比汽油車更普遍。

words.note: 語塊：over the past decade（過去十年）、for a decade（十年來）、the next decade（未來十年）。decade 是「十年」；century 是「一百年」；decay（腐爛）長得像。

sentences.en: The young chef hopes to make a name for herself by opening a small restaurant in the city center.
sentences.zh: 那位年輕主廚希望在市中心開一家小餐廳，為自己打響名號。

sentences.en: It can take many years for a new designer to make a name in the fashion industry.
sentences.zh: 新設計師可能要很多年才能在時尚界成名。

sentences.en: The company was able to make a name for itself by offering excellent service at low prices.
sentences.zh: 那家公司以低價提供優質服務，成功打響了名號。

sentences.en: Many young musicians move to large cities in order to make a name in the music business.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕音樂人搬到大城市，想在音樂界成名。

sentences.en: The architect began to make a name for himself after he designed the new library downtown.
sentences.zh: 那位建築師設計了市中心的新圖書館後開始成名。

words.note: 語塊：make a name for oneself（為自己打響名號）、make a name in（在……領域成名）。make a name for oneself 是「讓自己出名」；become famous 意思接近。

sentences.en: The airline will start offering a direct flight to Seoul from our city at the beginning of next year.
sentences.zh: 那家航空公司明年初將開始提供從我們城市直飛首爾的班機。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant prefers to take a direct flight when she travels for business because it saves time.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐出差時比較喜歡搭直飛班機，因為比較省時間。

sentences.en: There is no direct flight to the island, so passengers must change planes in the capital.
sentences.zh: 沒有直飛那座島的班機，所以乘客必須在首都轉機。

sentences.en: A direct flight from Taipei to London takes about fourteen hours, which is much faster than flying through Dubai.
sentences.zh: 從台北直飛倫敦大約要十四小時，比經杜拜轉機快很多。

sentences.en: The company will pay for a direct flight to the conference so that employees arrive rested.
sentences.zh: 公司會支付前往研討會的直飛機票，讓員工抵達時精神飽滿。

words.note: 語塊：take a direct flight（搭直飛班機）、direct flight to（直飛……的班機）。direct flight 是「不用轉機的班機」；connecting flight 是「轉機航班」；nonstop flight 也是「直飛」。

sentences.en: The new concert hall has a seating capacity of three thousand people and excellent sound.
sentences.zh: 新音樂廳有三千個座位，音響效果極佳。

sentences.en: The factory is operating at full capacity in order to meet the strong demand for its products.
sentences.zh: 工廠正全力運轉，以滿足產品的強勁需求。

sentences.en: In her capacity as team leader, Ms. Ito is responsible for checking the quality of every report.
sentences.zh: 以團隊領導的身分，伊藤小姐負責檢查每份報告的品質。

sentences.en: The hotel was filled to capacity during the music festival, so many visitors stayed in nearby towns.
sentences.zh: 音樂節期間飯店全部客滿，所以很多訪客住在附近的城鎮。

sentences.en: The company plans to increase the capacity of its warehouse by building a second floor next year.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫明年加蓋二樓，增加倉庫的容量。

words.note: 語塊：seating capacity（座位數）、at full capacity（滿載；全力運轉）、in one's capacity as（以……的身分）。capacity 可以是「容量」、「生產能力」或「身分、職位」；capable 是「有能力的」。

sentences.en: The new machines will drastically reduce the time it takes to produce each car at the factory.
sentences.zh: 新機器將大幅縮短工廠生產每輛車所需的時間。

sentences.en: The way people shop has drastically changed since online stores and mobile apps became popular around the world.
sentences.zh: 自從網路商店流行以來，人們購物的方式劇烈改變。

sentences.en: The price of the old computers dropped drastically after the new models were released in the spring.
sentences.zh: 新機型推出後，舊電腦的價格大幅下跌。

sentences.en: The company plans to drastically reduce its use of plastic by changing the packaging of all its products.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫改變所有產品的包裝，大幅減少塑膠使用。

sentences.en: The number of visitors to the museum increased drastically after the new exhibition opened in March.
sentences.zh: 三月新展覽開幕後，博物館的參觀人數大幅增加。

words.note: 語塊：drastically reduce（大幅減少）、drastically change（劇烈改變）、drastically increase（大幅增加）。drastically 是「變化非常大」；dramatically 意思接近；drastic 是形容詞。

sentences.en: Applicants for the designer position should send a portfolio of their recent work with their résumé.
sentences.zh: 應徵設計師職位的人應該隨履歷寄上近期作品的作品集。

sentences.en: A financial advisor can help you build an investment portfolio that matches your goals and your income.
sentences.zh: 理財顧問可以幫你建立符合目標的投資組合。

sentences.en: The company expanded its product portfolio by adding kitchen appliances, home furniture, and garden tools.
sentences.zh: 公司增加了廚房家電和居家家具，擴充產品組合。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee showed the client her portfolio, which included designs for several famous hotels in Asia.
sentences.zh: 李小姐給客戶看她的作品集，裡面有好幾家知名飯店的設計。

sentences.en: Experts recommend that you review your investment portfolio at least once a year with a professional.
sentences.zh: 專家建議至少每年檢視一次你的投資組合。

words.note: 語塊：design portfolio（設計作品集）、investment portfolio（投資組合）、product portfolio（產品組合）。portfolio 可以是「作品集」或「投資組合」；briefcase 是「公事包」。

sentences.en: The training program will consist of five workshops and a final test at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫將由五場工作坊和月底的最後測驗組成。

sentences.en: The committee will consist of ten members from different departments and offices of the company.
sentences.zh: 委員會將由公司不同部門的十位成員組成。

sentences.en: The new menu will mainly consist of dishes made with fresh vegetables from local farms.
sentences.zh: 新菜單主要將由使用在地農場新鮮蔬菜做的料理組成。

sentences.en: A typical day at the conference will consist of presentations in the morning and workshops in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 研討會典型的一天會是上午簡報、下午工作坊。

sentences.en: The tour package will consist of three nights at a hotel, two meals a day, and a local guide.
sentences.zh: 這個套裝行程包含三晚飯店住宿、一天兩餐和一位當地導遊。

words.note: 語塊：consist of（由……構成）、mainly consist of（主要由……組成）。consist of 不用被動式（不能說 be consisted of）；be made up of 意思相同。

words.meaning: 引人入勝的；耐人尋味的

sentences.en: The speaker presented an intriguing idea about how cities could use rooftops to grow vegetables.
sentences.zh: 講者提出一個有趣的點子，說明城市如何利用屋頂種菜。

sentences.en: The book raises an intriguing question about whether robots will replace workers in the future.
sentences.zh: 那本書提出一個耐人尋味的問題：機器人未來是否會取代工人。

sentences.en: Many visitors find the museum's new exhibition about ancient trade routes across Asia very intriguing.
sentences.zh: 很多參觀者覺得博物館關於古代貿易路線的新展覽非常引人入勝。

sentences.en: The designer's intriguing idea for the new logo was chosen by the board out of twenty proposals.
sentences.zh: 董事會從二十份提案中選中了那位設計師對新商標的有趣構想。

sentences.en: The results of the survey were intriguing, as they showed that young people prefer printed books.
sentences.zh: 調查結果很耐人尋味，顯示年輕人比較喜歡紙本書。

words.note: 語塊：intriguing idea（有趣的點子）、intriguing question（耐人尋味的問題）。intriguing 是「讓人好奇、很有意思」；interesting 意思接近但較普通。

sentences.en: The date of the new store's opening remains uncertain because of problems with the building permit.
sentences.zh: 因為建築許可證的問題，新店的開幕日期仍不確定。

sentences.en: Many workers feel worried about their uncertain future after the company announced its restructuring plan.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布重組計畫後，很多員工對不確定的未來感到擔心。

sentences.en: If you are uncertain about any part of the contract, please ask our lawyer before you sign it.
sentences.zh: 如果你對合約的任何部分不確定，請在簽名前請教我們的律師。

sentences.en: The economy is uncertain, so the company has decided to wait before hiring more staff.
sentences.zh: 經濟情況不確定，所以公司決定先等一等再增聘人手。

sentences.en: The weather remains uncertain, so the organizers will decide on Friday whether the event will be held outdoors.
sentences.zh: 天氣仍不確定，所以主辦單位週五會決定活動是否在戶外舉行。

words.note: 語塊：remain uncertain（仍不確定）、uncertain future（不確定的未來）、be uncertain about（對……不確定）。uncertain 是「不確定」；certain 是「確定的」；uncertainty 是名詞。

sentences.en: The new building will house the company's research center as well as several meeting rooms.
sentences.zh: 新大樓將容納公司的研究中心和好幾間會議室。

sentences.en: The museum will house a collection of more than five hundred paintings by local artists.
sentences.zh: 那座博物館將收藏五百多幅在地藝術家的畫作。

sentences.en: The old factory was renovated to house offices, shops, and a small theater for local performances.
sentences.zh: 舊工廠經過整修，用來容納辦公室、商店和一間小劇場。

sentences.en: The city built a new shelter to house families who lost their homes in the flood.
sentences.zh: 市政府蓋了一個新的收容所，安置在水災中失去家園的家庭。

sentences.en: The library will house a special room for children with books, games, and comfortable chairs.
sentences.zh: 圖書館將設一間有書、遊戲和舒適椅子的兒童專屬房間。

words.note: 語塊：house a collection（收藏）、house offices（容納辦公室）、be housed in（設在……）。house 當動詞（唸 /haʊz/）是「容納、安置」；當名詞是「房子」。

sentences.en: The company plans to open a regional office in Singapore to manage its business in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在新加坡設立區域辦公室，管理東南亞的業務。

sentences.en: Ms. Patel works at the regional office in Chicago and travels to the head office twice a year.
sentences.zh: Patel 小姐在芝加哥的區域辦公室工作，一年到總公司兩次。

sentences.en: All requests for vacation should be sent to the regional office at least two weeks in advance.
sentences.zh: 所有休假申請都應該至少提前兩週寄到區域辦公室。

sentences.en: The regional office is responsible for training staff at every store in the northern part of the country.
sentences.zh: 區域辦公室負責訓練國內北部每家門市的員工。

sentences.en: After the merger, the two companies decided to share one regional office instead of having two.
sentences.zh: 合併之後，兩家公司決定共用一個區域辦公室，而不是兩個。

words.note: 語塊：open a regional office（設立區域辦公室）、work at the regional office（在區域辦公室工作）、sent to the regional office（寄到區域辦公室）、share one regional office（共用一個區域辦公室）。regional office 負責一個地區的業務；head office 是「總公司」；branch office 是「分公司」。

sentences.en: Employees who travel for work receive a daily travel allowance for meals and local transportation.
sentences.zh: 因公出差的員工每天都有餐費和當地交通的差旅津貼。

sentences.en: The job offer includes a housing allowance, which helps new staff pay rent in the expensive city.
sentences.zh: 這份工作提供住房津貼，幫助新員工支付昂貴城市的房租。

sentences.en: The baggage allowance for international flights is two pieces of luggage per passenger in economy class.
sentences.zh: 國際航班的行李限額是每位乘客兩件。

sentences.en: The company increased the travel allowance this year because hotel prices have risen in many countries.
sentences.zh: 因為很多國家的飯店價格上漲，公司今年調高了差旅津貼。

sentences.en: Please check the baggage allowance on your ticket before you pack for your trip to Europe.
sentences.zh: 為歐洲之旅打包前，請先確認機票上的行李限額。

words.note: 語塊：travel allowance（差旅津貼）、housing allowance（住房津貼）、baggage allowance（行李限額）。allowance 是「固定給的一筆錢」或「允許的量」；allow 是動詞「允許」。

sentences.en: A sales representative will contact you within two days to discuss the price of the equipment.
sentences.zh: 業務代表會在兩天內聯絡你，討論設備的價格。

sentences.en: Mr. Diaz works as a sales representative for a company that sells office furniture to large businesses.
sentences.zh: Diaz 先生是一家把辦公家具賣給大企業的公司的業務代表。

sentences.en: If you would like a demonstration of the software, please contact a sales representative by phone.
sentences.zh: 如果你想看軟體示範，請打電話聯絡業務代表。

sentences.en: Each sales representative is responsible for about fifty clients in a particular area of the country.
sentences.zh: 每位業務代表負責國內某個特定地區的大約五十位客戶。

sentences.en: The company is hiring a sales representative who can speak Japanese and travel to Asia regularly.
sentences.zh: 公司正在招聘一位會說日文、能定期到亞洲出差的業務代表。

words.note: 語塊：sales representative for（……的業務代表）、contact a sales representative（聯絡業務代表）。sales representative 常縮寫成 sales rep；salesperson 意思接近。

sentences.en: Applicants should have at least five years of experience in the field of marketing or advertising.
sentences.zh: 應徵者應該在行銷或廣告領域至少有五年的經驗。

sentences.en: Our technicians spend most of their time working in the field, repairing machines at customers' factories.
sentences.zh: 我們的技師大部分時間都在現場工作，到客戶的工廠修理機器。

sentences.en: Dr. Chen is an expert in the field of renewable energy and has written several books on the subject.
sentences.zh: 陳博士是再生能源領域的專家，寫過好幾本相關的書。

sentences.en: The research team will collect data in the field for three months before writing its final report.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊會在實地收集三個月的資料，再撰寫最終報告。

sentences.en: The conference brings together leading experts in the field to share their latest research and ideas.
sentences.zh: 研討會聚集該領域的頂尖專家，分享他們最新的研究。

words.note: 語塊：experience in the field（該領域的經驗）、work in the field（在現場工作）、expert in the field（該領域的專家）。in the field 可以是「在某個專業領域」，也可以是「在外面實地（不在辦公室）」。

sentences.en: Please keep all of your receipts so that the company can pay you back for every travel expense.
sentences.zh: 請保留所有收據，讓公司能償還你每一筆差旅費。

sentences.en: Employees who want to attend the conference at their own expense must still ask their manager first.
sentences.zh: 想自費參加研討會的員工仍須先詢問經理。

sentences.en: The company will cover the expense of moving for staff who transfer to the new office in another city.
sentences.zh: 公司會負擔調到其他城市新辦公室的員工的搬家費用。

sentences.en: Rent is the largest expense for most small restaurants located in the busy downtown area.
sentences.zh: 對大部分位於市中心的小餐廳來說，房租是最大的開支。

sentences.en: To reduce expense, the office now prints documents only when it is absolutely necessary for meetings.
sentences.zh: 為了減少開支，辦公室現在只在絕對必要時才列印文件。

words.note: 語塊：travel expense（差旅費）、at one's own expense（自費）、cover the expense（負擔費用）。expense 是「花費」；expenses 常指「（公司的）各項開支」；expensive 是「昂貴的」。

sentences.en: An incomplete application will not be accepted, so please fill out every part of the form.
sentences.zh: 不完整的申請不會被受理，所以請填寫表格的每一個部分。

sentences.en: The report was based on incomplete information, so the manager asked the team to collect more data.
sentences.zh: 那份報告是根據不完整的資訊寫的，所以經理要求團隊收集更多資料。

sentences.en: The construction of the bridge is still incomplete because of a shortage of steel and workers.
sentences.zh: 因為鋼材和工人短缺，橋樑的工程仍未完成。

sentences.en: If your order is incomplete when it arrives, please contact us and we will send the missing items.
sentences.zh: 如果你的訂單到貨時不完整，請聯絡我們，我們會寄出缺少的品項。

sentences.en: The editor returned the article because it was incomplete and did not include any interviews.
sentences.zh: 編輯退回了那篇文章，因為內容不完整，沒有任何訪談。

words.note: 語塊：incomplete application（不完整的申請）、incomplete information（不完整的資訊）、still incomplete（仍未完成）、be incomplete（不完整）。incomplete 是「缺了一部分」；complete 是「完整的」；unfinished 意思接近。

sentences.en: The government plans to invest in infrastructure such as roads, bridges, and railways next year.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫明年投資道路、橋樑和鐵路等基礎建設。

sentences.en: Many companies choose to build factories in areas with good transportation infrastructure and many skilled workers.
sentences.zh: 很多公司選擇在交通基礎建設完善的地區設廠。

sentences.en: The city's old public infrastructure needs to be repaired, especially the water pipes under the streets.
sentences.zh: 城市老舊的公共基礎建設需要修繕，尤其是街道下方的水管。

sentences.en: Investing in infrastructure creates jobs and helps the economy grow in the long term for everyone.
sentences.zh: 投資基礎建設能創造工作，長期幫助經濟成長。

sentences.en: The new airport is part of a large project to improve the transportation infrastructure of the region.
sentences.zh: 新機場是改善該地區交通基礎建設的大型計畫的一部分。

words.note: 語塊：public infrastructure（公共基礎建設）、invest in infrastructure（投資基礎建設）、transportation infrastructure（交通基礎建設）。infrastructure 指道路、橋樑、水電等「基礎設施」；不可數名詞。

words.meaning: 無與倫比的；無法匹敵的

sentences.en: The hotel is famous for its unmatched service, and many guests return to stay there every year.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店以無可比擬的服務聞名，很多客人每年都會再回來住。

sentences.en: Our furniture is made by hand and offers unmatched quality at a very reasonable price for families.
sentences.zh: 我們的家具是手工製作的，以合理的價格提供無與倫比的品質。

sentences.en: The view from the top of the tower is unmatched, especially when the sun is setting over the sea.
sentences.zh: 從塔頂看出去的景色無與倫比，尤其是夕陽落在海面的時候。

sentences.en: The company's experience in building bridges is unmatched by any other firm in the country.
sentences.zh: 那家公司建造橋樑的經驗在國內無人能比。

sentences.en: Customers choose our cameras because of their unmatched quality and long-lasting batteries for long trips abroad.
sentences.zh: 顧客選擇我們的相機，是因為它們無與倫比的品質和持久的電池。

words.note: 語塊：unmatched quality（無與倫比的品質）、unmatched service（無可比擬的服務）。unmatched 是「沒有對手、最好的」；unrivaled、unparalleled 意思接近。

sentences.en: Please fill out a registration form at the front desk before you attend your first class at the gym.
sentences.zh: 第一次上健身房課程之前，請在櫃台填寫報名表。

sentences.en: The online registration form for the conference will close at midnight on Friday this week.
sentences.zh: 研討會的線上報名表將在週五午夜截止。

sentences.en: Each participant must complete a registration form and pay the fee before the workshop begins.
sentences.zh: 每位參加者都必須在工作坊開始前填好報名表並繳費。

sentences.en: The registration form asks for your name, address, and the name of your emergency contact.
sentences.zh: 報名表要填你的姓名、地址和緊急聯絡人的名字。

sentences.en: If you have any problems with the online registration form, please call our office for help.
sentences.zh: 如果你填線上報名表有任何問題，請打電話到我們辦公室尋求協助。

words.note: 語塊：fill out a registration form（填寫報名表）、online registration form（線上報名表）。registration 是「報名、註冊」；register 是動詞；application form 是「申請表」。

sentences.en: The factory needs a stable power supply to keep its machines running twenty-four hours a day.
sentences.zh: 工廠需要穩定的電力供應，讓機器二十四小時運轉。

sentences.en: The storm damaged the power supply to several neighborhoods, and repairs will take two days.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨損壞了好幾個社區的電力供應，維修要兩天。

sentences.en: The technician replaced the power supply unit in the computer, and now it works perfectly.
sentences.zh: 技師更換了電腦的電源供應器，現在運作得很完美。

sentences.en: Hospitals have emergency generators in case the main power supply fails during a storm or earthquake.
sentences.zh: 醫院有緊急發電機，以防暴風雨期間主電力供應中斷。

sentences.en: The new solar panels will provide a stable power supply for the village, which often had blackouts.
sentences.zh: 新的太陽能板會為那個常常停電的村莊提供穩定的電力供應。

words.note: 語塊：stable power supply（穩定的電力供應）、power supply unit（電源供應器）。power supply 可以指「電力供應」或電腦的「電源供應器」；power outage 是「停電」。

sentences.en: The store sells every household appliance you need, from washing machines to small coffee makers.
sentences.zh: 那家店販售你需要的每一種家用電器，從洗衣機到咖啡機都有。

sentences.en: Our new kitchen appliance line includes ovens, refrigerators, and dishwashers that save energy and water.
sentences.zh: 我們新的廚房家電系列包括節能的烤箱、冰箱和洗碗機。

sentences.en: Please unplug every electrical appliance in the office before you leave for the long holiday.
sentences.zh: 放長假離開辦公室之前，請拔掉辦公室每一台電器的插頭。

sentences.en: The apartment comes with a new kitchen appliance package that includes a stove and a microwave.
sentences.zh: 那間公寓附有一套新的廚房家電，包括爐子和微波爐。

sentences.en: Customers can recycle an old household appliance at the store when they buy a new one.
sentences.zh: 顧客買新家電時，可以在店裡回收舊的家用電器。

words.note: 語塊：household appliance（家用電器）、kitchen appliance（廚房家電）、electrical appliance（電器）。appliance 是「家用電器」；常用複數 appliances；application 是「申請；應用程式」。

sentences.en: Customers can place an order online or by phone, and most items will be delivered within two days.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以線上或打電話下訂單，大部分商品兩天內送達。

sentences.en: The restaurant needs to place an order for more vegetables before the weekend, when it is busiest.
sentences.zh: 餐廳需要在最忙的週末之前訂購更多蔬菜。

sentences.en: If you place an order before noon, it will be shipped from our warehouse on the same day.
sentences.zh: 如果你中午前下單，貨會在當天從我們倉庫寄出。

sentences.en: Please place an order for printer paper because we only have a few boxes left in the supply room.
sentences.zh: 請訂購印表機用紙，因為儲藏室只剩幾箱了。

sentences.en: Members who place an order online this week will receive a free gift with their purchase.
sentences.zh: 這週在網路上下單的會員購物會得到一份免費禮物。

words.note: 語塊：place an order for（訂購……）、place an order online（線上下單）。place an order 是「下訂單」；make an order 較少用；cancel an order 是「取消訂單」。

sentences.en: Orders placed on Saturday or Sunday will be shipped from our warehouse on the next business day.
sentences.zh: 週六或週日下的訂單會在下一個工作天從我們倉庫出貨。

sentences.en: Our customer service team will reply to every email within one business day of receiving it.
sentences.zh: 我們的客服團隊會在收到每封電子郵件後一個工作天內回覆。

sentences.en: Applications received after the last business day of the month will be reviewed in the following month.
sentences.zh: 月底最後一個工作天之後收到的申請會在下個月審核。

sentences.en: Salaries are paid into employees' bank accounts on the last business day of every month.
sentences.zh: 薪水會在每個月最後一個工作天匯入員工的銀行帳戶。

sentences.en: If you report a problem with your bill before noon, we will fix it by the end of the business day.
sentences.zh: 如果你在中午前回報帳單的問題，我們會在當天營業結束前修正。

words.note: 語塊：the next business day（下一個工作天）、within one business day（一個工作天內）、the last business day（最後一個工作天）。business day 指週一到週五（不含假日），常用複數 business days；working day 意思相同。

sentences.en: Thank you for your inquiry about our services, and we will send you a price list by email today.
sentences.zh: 感謝您詢問我們的服務，我們今天會寄價目表給您。

sentences.en: If you would like to make an inquiry about your order, please include your order number.
sentences.zh: 如果你想詢問訂單的事，請附上訂單編號。

sentences.en: In response to your inquiry, the hotel still has several rooms available for the dates you requested.
sentences.zh: 回覆您的詢問，飯店在您要求的日期仍有幾間空房。

sentences.en: The company received an inquiry about its products from a large supermarket chain in Japan.
sentences.zh: 公司收到日本一家大型連鎖超市對其產品的詢問。

sentences.en: Every customer inquiry is answered by a member of our team within twenty-four hours, even on weekends.
sentences.zh: 每一則顧客詢問都會在二十四小時內由我們團隊的成員回覆。

words.note: 語塊：make an inquiry（詢問）、in response to your inquiry（回覆您的詢問）、an inquiry about（關於……的詢問）。inquiry 是「詢問」，英式拼法 enquiry；inquire 是動詞。

sentences.en: The hotel hired a famous designer to update the interior of its restaurant and lobby.
sentences.zh: 飯店請了一位知名設計師翻新餐廳和大廳的內部。

sentences.en: Ms. Park studied interior design and now plans offices for large technology companies in the city.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐讀室內設計，現在為科技公司規劃辦公室。

sentences.en: The interior of the new car is spacious and comfortable, with leather seats and a large screen.
sentences.zh: 新車內部寬敞舒適，有皮椅和大螢幕。

sentences.en: We are looking for an interior designer who can make our small office feel bright and open.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位能讓我們小辦公室感覺明亮開闊的室內設計師。

sentences.en: The interior of the old theater was restored to look exactly as it did one hundred years ago.
sentences.zh: 老劇院的內部被修復成和一百年前一模一樣。

words.note: 語塊：interior design（室內設計）、interior of（……的內部）、interior designer（室內設計師）。interior 是「裡面」；exterior 是「外面」；inferior 是「較差的」，長得像。

sentences.en: The overall cost of the project was lower than expected because the team found cheaper materials.
sentences.zh: 專案的總成本比預期低，因為團隊找到更便宜的材料。

sentences.en: The manager was pleased with the overall performance of the sales team during the third quarter.
sentences.zh: 經理對業務團隊第三季的整體表現很滿意。

sentences.en: The survey showed that overall satisfaction among guests has increased since the hotel was renovated.
sentences.zh: 調查顯示，飯店翻修後房客的整體滿意度提高了。

sentences.en: Overall, the conference was a success, although some participants wanted more time for questions and discussion.
sentences.zh: 整體而言，研討會很成功，雖然有些與會者希望有更多提問時間。

sentences.en: The overall performance of the new software is much better than the old version, especially its speed.
sentences.zh: 新軟體的整體表現比舊版好很多，尤其是速度。

words.note: 語塊：overall cost（總成本）、overall performance（整體表現）、overall satisfaction（整體滿意度）。overall 可以當形容詞或副詞（Overall, ... 整體而言）；overalls 是「吊帶褲」。

sentences.en: The new software will improve efficiency by allowing staff to share files instantly with each other.
sentences.zh: 新軟體讓員工能立即分享檔案，將提高效率。

sentences.en: The company replaced its old lights to increase energy efficiency and reduce its monthly electricity costs.
sentences.zh: 公司更換舊燈，以提升能源效率並降低電費。

sentences.en: The factory hired a consultant to find ways to increase efficiency on the production line.
sentences.zh: 工廠聘請一位顧問，尋找提高生產線效率的方法。

sentences.en: Energy efficiency is an important factor for customers who are buying new air conditioners or heaters.
sentences.zh: 能源效率對購買新冷氣的顧客來說是重要的考量因素。

sentences.en: Working from home has helped some employees improve efficiency because there are fewer interruptions at home.
sentences.zh: 在家工作幫助一些員工提高效率，因為干擾比較少。

words.note: 語塊：improve efficiency（提高效率）、energy efficiency（能源效率）、increase efficiency（增加效率）。efficiency 是名詞；efficient 是形容詞「有效率的」；effectiveness 是「有效性」。

sentences.en: The chief executive announced that the company will open twenty new stores in Asia next year.
sentences.zh: 執行長宣布公司明年將在亞洲開設二十家新店。

sentences.en: Ms. Lopez was appointed as chief executive officer after working at the company for fifteen years.
sentences.zh: Lopez 小姐在公司工作十五年後被任命為執行長。

sentences.en: The board of directors will appoint a chief executive to replace Mr. Kim, who is retiring in June.
sentences.zh: 董事會將任命一位執行長接替六月退休的金先生。

sentences.en: The chief executive gave a speech to all employees about the company's plans for the future.
sentences.zh: 執行長向全體員工發表了關於公司未來計畫的演講。

sentences.en: Reporters asked the chief executive officer several questions about the merger at the press conference.
sentences.zh: 記者在記者會上問了執行長好幾個關於合併的問題。

words.note: 語塊：chief executive officer（執行長，CEO）、appoint a chief executive（任命執行長）。chief executive 常寫成 CEO；chief financial officer（CFO）是「財務長」。

sentences.en: The bright colors of the poster are designed to grab attention from people walking past the store.
sentences.zh: 海報鮮豔的顏色是為了吸引經過店門口行人的注意。

sentences.en: A short and surprising title can help grab attention and make readers want to read the whole article.
sentences.zh: 簡短又驚人的標題能幫忙吸引注意，讓讀者想讀完整篇文章。

sentences.en: Many companies hire famous actors for their advertisements because they want to grab attention on social media.
sentences.zh: 很多公司請知名演員拍廣告，因為想在社群媒體上吸引注意。

sentences.en: The first few seconds of a video are important because you need to grab attention quickly.
sentences.zh: 影片的前幾秒很重要，因為你需要快速吸引注意。

sentences.en: The speaker began with a surprising story to grab attention before explaining the main points of her talk.
sentences.zh: 講者先以一個驚人的故事吸引注意，再說明演講的重點。

words.note: 語塊：grab attention quickly（快速吸引注意）、help grab attention（幫忙吸引注意）、want to grab attention（想吸引注意）、designed to grab attention（為了吸引注意而設計）。grab attention 比 attract attention 更口語；也常說 grab sb's attention（吸引某人的注意）。

sentences.en: The government lowered taxes to stimulate the economy after a long period of slow growth.
sentences.zh: 經過一段緩慢成長期後，政府減稅以刺激經濟。

sentences.en: The store offered big discounts to stimulate demand for winter clothing before the season ended.
sentences.zh: 那家店在季末前大打折，刺激冬季服飾的需求。

sentences.en: The museum's new interactive exhibit is designed to stimulate interest in science among young children.
sentences.zh: 博物館新的互動展覽是為了激發幼童對科學的興趣。

sentences.en: Building new roads and bridges can stimulate the economy by creating jobs for many workers.
sentences.zh: 興建新道路和橋樑能為很多工人創造工作，進而刺激經濟。

sentences.en: Free samples are a good way to stimulate demand for a new product that customers do not know yet.
sentences.zh: 免費試用品是刺激顧客還不認識的新產品需求的好方法。

words.note: 語塊：stimulate the economy（刺激經濟）、stimulate demand（刺激需求）、stimulate interest（激發興趣）。stimulate 是「促使更活躍」；stimulus 是名詞「刺激」；simulate 是「模擬」，少了 t。

sentences.en: The manager thanked the staff for their hard work and dedication during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 經理感謝員工在忙碌節慶期間的努力與奉獻。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant received an award for her dedication to improving the lives of children in the city.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐因致力改善城市兒童的生活而獲獎。

sentences.en: The success of the project was the result of the team's dedication and careful planning.
sentences.zh: 專案的成功是團隊投入和周詳規劃的結果。

sentences.en: Doctors and nurses showed great dedication to their patients during the difficult and busy winter months.
sentences.zh: 醫生和護士在艱難的冬季對病人展現了極大的奉獻。

sentences.en: The company values dedication to customer service, so it rewards employees who receive good reviews.
sentences.zh: 公司重視對客服的投入，所以會獎勵獲得好評的員工。

words.note: 語塊：dedication to（對……的投入）、hard work and dedication（努力與奉獻）。dedication 是名詞；dedicate 是動詞「奉獻」；dedicated 是形容詞「敬業的」。

sentences.en: The coffee shop started a loyalty program that gives customers a free drink after ten purchases.
sentences.zh: 那家咖啡店推出會員回饋計畫，顧客買十杯就送一杯。

sentences.en: Good service and friendly staff are the best ways to build customer loyalty over many years.
sentences.zh: 優質的服務和親切的員工是多年來建立顧客忠誠度的最好方法。

sentences.en: Please show your loyalty card to the cashier so that you can collect points for your purchase.
sentences.zh: 請把集點卡給收銀員看，這樣你購物就能集點。

sentences.en: The company rewards loyalty by giving employees extra vacation days after ten years of service.
sentences.zh: 公司以額外假期獎勵忠誠，員工服務滿十年就能多放假。

sentences.en: Many airlines have a loyalty program that allows frequent travelers to earn free flights and hotel stays.
sentences.zh: 很多航空公司都有會員回饋計畫，讓常搭飛機的旅客累積免費機票。

words.note: 語塊：customer loyalty（顧客忠誠度）、loyalty program（會員回饋計畫）、loyalty card（集點卡）。loyalty 是名詞；loyal 是形容詞「忠誠的」；royalty（版稅；皇室）長得像。

sentences.en: The company donates five percent of its profits to charity every year at the end of December.
sentences.zh: 公司每年十二月底都會把百分之五的利潤捐給慈善機構。

sentences.en: Employees organized a charity event to raise money for several children's hospitals in the region.
sentences.zh: 員工籌辦了一場慈善活動，為該地區的兒童醫院募款。

sentences.en: Runners in the city marathon can raise money for charity by asking friends to support them.
sentences.zh: 城市馬拉松的跑者可以請朋友支持，為慈善募款。

sentences.en: The famous singer will perform at a charity event to help families who lost their homes in the flood.
sentences.zh: 那位知名歌手將在一場慈善活動中演出，幫助在水災中失去家園的家庭。

sentences.en: Old clothes and books can be donated to charity at the collection box near the entrance.
sentences.zh: 舊衣服和書可以放在入口附近的回收箱捐給慈善機構。

words.note: 語塊：donate to charity（捐給慈善機構）、charity event（慈善活動）、raise money for charity（為慈善募款）。charity 可以是「慈善機構」或「慈善行為」；charitable 是形容詞。

sentences.en: One benefit of working from home is that employees do not have to spend time commuting.
sentences.zh: 在家工作的一個好處是員工不用花時間通勤。

sentences.en: The main benefit of the new system is that customers can check their orders at any time on their phones.
sentences.zh: 新系統的主要好處是顧客可以隨時用手機查詢訂單。

sentences.en: Small businesses will benefit from the new tax rules, which lower the cost of hiring young workers.
sentences.zh: 小企業將受惠於新的稅務規定，因為它降低了聘用年輕員工的成本。

sentences.en: The benefit of buying in bulk is that the price per item is much lower than usual.
sentences.zh: 大量購買的好處是每件商品的價格比平常低很多。

sentences.en: Students can benefit from the free tutoring program, which is offered every evening at the library.
sentences.zh: 學生可以從每晚在圖書館開設的免費輔導計畫中受益。

words.note: 語塊：the main benefit（主要好處）、the benefit of（……的好處）、benefit from（從……受益）。benefit 可以當名詞「好處、福利」或動詞（benefit from）；beneficial 是形容詞「有益的」。

sentences.en: Volunteers at the animal shelter take care of dogs and cats until new families adopt them.
sentences.zh: 動物收容所的志工照顧貓狗，直到有新家庭領養牠們。

sentences.en: The city opened a new homeless shelter that can provide beds and meals for one hundred people.
sentences.zh: 市政府開了一間新的遊民收容所，可以提供一百人的床位和餐點。

sentences.en: During the storm, the school gym was used to provide shelter for families from the coast.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨期間，學校體育館被用來為沿海的家庭提供庇護。

sentences.en: The company donated blankets and food to the homeless shelter before the cold winter began.
sentences.zh: 寒冬來臨前，公司捐了毯子和食物給遊民收容所。

sentences.en: Many people adopt pets from the animal shelter instead of buying them from pet stores.
sentences.zh: 很多人從動物收容所領養寵物，而不是從寵物店購買。

words.note: 語塊：animal shelter（動物收容所）、homeless shelter（遊民收容所）、provide shelter（提供庇護）。shelter 是「遮蔽、躲避的地方」；當動詞是「保護、遮蔽」。

sentences.en: The charity provides free books and school supplies to underprivileged children who live in small villages in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善團體為鄉村地區的弱勢兒童提供免費書籍和文具。

sentences.en: The company offers scholarships to students from underprivileged families who want to study engineering at university.
sentences.zh: 公司提供獎學金給想讀工程、來自弱勢家庭的學生。

sentences.en: Volunteers teach English to underprivileged children at the local community center every Saturday and Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 志工每週六和週日早上在社區中心教弱勢兒童英文。

sentences.en: The new program will help underprivileged families find safe and affordable housing in the city.
sentences.zh: 新計畫將幫助弱勢家庭在城裡找到安全又負擔得起的住處。

sentences.en: Many underprivileged students cannot afford computers, so the public library lends laptops to them for free.
sentences.zh: 很多弱勢學生買不起電腦，所以圖書館免費出借筆電。

words.note: 語塊：underprivileged children（弱勢兒童）、underprivileged families（弱勢家庭）。underprivileged 是「缺少機會、經濟弱勢的」；disadvantaged 意思接近。

sentences.en: Employees who lose their jobs because of the restructuring will receive a severance package next month.
sentences.zh: 因重組而失去工作的員工會獲得資遣補償。

sentences.en: The company offered a generous severance package that included six months of salary and health insurance.
sentences.zh: 公司提供了一份優渥的資遣方案，包括六個月的薪水。

sentences.en: Mr. Hall used his severance package to start his own business after leaving the bank.
sentences.zh: Hall 先生離開銀行後，用資遣補償自己創業。

sentences.en: The union asked the company to improve the severance package for workers who have been there for many years.
sentences.zh: 工會要求公司為服務多年的員工改善資遣方案。

sentences.en: A severance package usually depends on how long the employee has worked at the company.
sentences.zh: 資遣方案通常取決於員工在公司工作了多久。

words.note: 語塊：receive a severance package（獲得資遣補償）、generous severance package（優渥的資遣方案）、improve the severance package（改善資遣方案）、used his severance package（用了他的資遣補償）。severance 是「切斷、終止（僱傭關係）」；severance pay 是「資遣費」。

sentences.en: The new factory will create employment opportunities for hundreds of people in the small town.
sentences.zh: 新工廠將為小鎮數百人創造就業機會。

sentences.en: Many graduates seek employment in large cities, where salaries are usually higher than in small towns.
sentences.zh: 很多畢業生到大城市求職，因為那裡的薪水通常比較高。

sentences.en: After working part-time for two years, Ms. Ruiz finally found full-time employment at a bank.
sentences.zh: 兼職工作兩年後，Ruiz 小姐終於在一家銀行找到全職工作。

sentences.en: The government is working to increase employment opportunities for young people who live in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 政府正努力為鄉村地區的年輕人增加就業機會。

sentences.en: Applicants must provide proof of their previous employment, such as a letter from a former employer.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須提供以前的工作證明，例如前雇主的信。

words.note: 語塊：full-time employment（全職工作）、employment opportunities（就業機會）、seek employment（求職）。employment 是名詞；employ 是動詞「僱用」；unemployment 是「失業」。

sentences.en: Finishing the project two weeks early was a great accomplishment for such a small team.
sentences.zh: 提前兩週完成專案，對這麼小的團隊來說是很大的成就。

sentences.en: Many employees feel a sense of accomplishment when they solve a difficult problem for a customer.
sentences.zh: 很多員工為顧客解決難題時會有成就感。

sentences.en: The award recognizes the accomplishment of scientists who have made important discoveries in modern medicine.
sentences.zh: 這個獎項表彰在醫學上有重大發現的科學家的成就。

sentences.en: Opening twenty stores in one year was the company's greatest accomplishment since it was founded.
sentences.zh: 一年內開二十家店是公司成立以來最大的成就。

sentences.en: Completing a marathon gives runners a strong sense of accomplishment, even if they finish slowly.
sentences.zh: 跑完馬拉松會讓跑者有很強的成就感，即使跑得很慢。

words.note: 語塊：a great accomplishment（很大的成就）、sense of accomplishment（成就感）。accomplishment 是名詞；accomplish 是動詞「完成」；achievement 意思接近。

sentences.en: The factory plans to increase output by adding a second shift that will work at night.
sentences.zh: 工廠計畫加開夜班以增加產量。

sentences.en: The total output of the farm this year was much higher than last year because of the good weather.
sentences.zh: 因為天氣好，農場今年的總產量比去年高很多。

sentences.en: New machines have doubled the output of the factory without increasing the number of workers.
sentences.zh: 新機器讓工廠的產量翻倍，而不用增加工人數量。

sentences.en: The country's output of rice fell last year because of a long period of dry weather.
sentences.zh: 由於長期乾旱，該國去年的稻米產量下降。

sentences.en: The company hopes to increase output next year so that it can sell its products in more countries.
sentences.zh: 公司希望明年增加產量，好在更多國家販售產品。

words.note: 語塊：increase output（增加產量）、total output（總產量）、output of（……的產量）。output 是「生產出來的量」；input 是「投入」；outcome 是「結果」。

sentences.en: Many homeowners decided to refinance their mortgages when interest rates fell sharply at the end of last year.
sentences.zh: 去年利率下降時，很多屋主決定把房貸轉貸。

sentences.en: The company plans to refinance a loan from the bank in order to reduce its monthly payments.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫向銀行轉貸，以減少每月還款金額。

sentences.en: It may be a good idea to refinance your mortgage if you can get a lower interest rate.
sentences.zh: 如果你能拿到更低的利率，轉貸房貸可能是個好主意。

sentences.en: The bank offers free advice to customers who want to refinance a loan for their car or house.
sentences.zh: 銀行為想轉貸汽車或房屋貸款的顧客提供免費建議。

sentences.en: Before you refinance a mortgage, compare the fees and interest rates offered by several banks.
sentences.zh: 轉貸房貸之前，先比較好幾家銀行的手續費和利率。

words.note: 語塊：refinance a loan（轉貸）、refinance a mortgage（房貸轉貸）。refinance 是「用新的貸款還舊的貸款」，通常為了更低的利率；finance 是「資金；融資」。

sentences.en: The region has an abundance of fresh fruit and vegetables, so many famous restaurants are located there.
sentences.zh: 那個地區有豐富的新鮮蔬果，所以很多知名餐廳都在那裡。

sentences.en: The new office building has an abundance of natural light because of its large glass windows.
sentences.zh: 新辦公大樓因為有大玻璃窗，自然光非常充足。

sentences.en: Fish were found in abundance in the lake before the factories began to pollute the water.
sentences.zh: 在工廠開始污染湖水之前，湖裡有大量的魚。

sentences.en: The city offers an abundance of activities for tourists, including museums, parks, and night markets.
sentences.zh: 這座城市為觀光客提供大量的活動，包括博物館、公園和夜市。

sentences.en: During the summer, the farmers' market has strawberries in abundance at very low prices every weekend.
sentences.zh: 夏天時，農夫市集有大量便宜的草莓。

words.note: 語塊：an abundance of（大量的）、in abundance（大量地）。abundance 是名詞；abundant 是形容詞「豐富的」；plenty 意思接近。

sentences.en: The speaker made a lasting impression on the audience with her stories about starting a business.
sentences.zh: 講者分享創業故事，給聽眾留下深刻的印象。

sentences.en: Experts warn that the oil spill could have a lasting effect on the fish and birds in the area.
sentences.zh: 專家警告，漏油可能對該地區的魚和鳥造成長期影響。

sentences.en: Our new phone has a long-lasting battery that can be used for two days without charging.
sentences.zh: 我們的新手機有超耐用的電池，不充電可以用兩天。

sentences.en: The training program had a lasting effect on the way managers communicate with their teams.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫對經理和團隊溝通的方式產生了長期影響。

sentences.en: Good customer service leaves a lasting impression and makes customers want to come back again.
sentences.zh: 好的客服會留下深刻的印象，讓顧客想再回來。

words.note: 語塊：lasting impression（深刻的印象）、lasting effect（長期影響）、long-lasting（耐久的）。lasting 是「能維持很久的」；last 當動詞是「持續」；temporary 是相反詞。

sentences.en: The CEO tried to reassure employees that no one would lose their job after the merger.
sentences.zh: 執行長試著向員工保證，合併後不會有人失業。

sentences.en: The airline sent emails to reassure customers that their flights would not be affected by the strike.
sentences.zh: 航空公司寄電子郵件讓顧客放心，他們的航班不會受到罷工影響。

sentences.en: The doctor will reassure patients before the surgery by explaining every step of the process.
sentences.zh: 醫生會在手術前解說每一個步驟，讓病人安心。

sentences.en: The bank wanted to reassure customers that their personal information was safe after the system problem.
sentences.zh: 系統出問題後，銀行想讓顧客放心，他們的個人資料很安全。

sentences.en: The manager called the client to reassure her that the order would arrive before the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 經理打電話給客戶，向她保證訂單會在週末前送達。

words.note: 語塊：reassure customers（讓顧客放心）、reassure sb that（向某人保證……）。reassure 是「讓人不再擔心」；assure 是「保證」；reassurance 是名詞。

sentences.en: The factory had to lay off two hundred workers after it lost its largest customer last year.
sentences.zh: 失去最大客戶後，工廠去年只好裁員兩百人。

sentences.en: The company promised not to lay off any staff during the restructuring of the sales department.
sentences.zh: 公司承諾在業務部重組期間不會裁員。

sentences.en: Many airlines were forced to lay off pilots and flight attendants when travel decreased sharply.
sentences.zh: 旅遊人數大幅減少時，很多航空公司被迫裁掉飛行員和空服員。

sentences.en: Instead of deciding to lay off workers, the company reduced working hours for everyone by ten percent.
sentences.zh: 公司沒有決定裁員，而是把每個人的工時減少一成。

sentences.en: The store may lay off some part-time employees after the busy holiday season ends in January.
sentences.zh: 一月忙碌的節慶季結束後，那家店可能會資遣一些兼職員工。

words.note: 語塊：lay off workers（裁員）、lay off staff（裁減員工）、lay off employees（資遣員工）。lay off 是「因為公司原因讓員工離開」；fire 是「因為表現開除」；layoff 是名詞。

sentences.en: The board approved a strategic plan to expand the company into three new countries over five years.
sentences.zh: 董事會核准了一項策略計畫，在五年內把公司擴展到三個新國家。

sentences.en: The warehouse is in a strategic location near the port and the highway, so goods can be shipped quickly.
sentences.zh: 倉庫位於靠近港口和公路的戰略位置，所以貨物能快速運送。

sentences.en: The two companies became strategic partners in order to develop and sell electric cars together.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司成為策略夥伴，一起開發電動車。

sentences.en: Hiring a marketing expert was a strategic decision that helped the company reach younger customers.
sentences.zh: 聘請行銷專家是一個策略性的決定，幫助公司接觸到更年輕的顧客。

sentences.en: The new strategic plan focuses on online sales and reducing the number of physical stores.
sentences.zh: 新的策略計畫著重於網路銷售和減少實體店數量。

words.note: 語塊：strategic plan（策略計畫）、strategic location（戰略位置）、strategic partner（策略夥伴）。strategic 是形容詞；strategy 是名詞「策略」；strategically 是副詞。

sentences.en: The office will switch over to a new email system on Monday, so please save your messages before then.
sentences.zh: 辦公室週一將改用新的電子郵件系統，所以請在那之前存好你的郵件。

sentences.en: Many families decided to switch over to solar power after the price of electricity increased.
sentences.zh: 電價上漲後，很多家庭決定改用太陽能。

sentences.en: The factory plans to switch over to electric delivery trucks within the next three years.
sentences.zh: 工廠計畫在未來三年內改用電動送貨卡車。

sentences.en: It took the bank several weeks to switch over from the old computer system to the new one.
sentences.zh: 銀行花了好幾週才從舊電腦系統轉換到新系統。

sentences.en: Customers who want to switch over to our phone service can keep their old phone numbers.
sentences.zh: 想改用我們電話服務的顧客可以保留原本的電話號碼。

words.note: 語塊：switch over to（改用……）。switch over to 是「從一種換到另一種」；switch to 意思相同；change over 意思接近。

sentences.en: It would make sense to hire more staff before the busy holiday season begins next month.
sentences.zh: 在下個月忙碌的節慶季開始之前增聘人手是合理的。

sentences.en: The instructions did not make sense to many customers, so the company rewrote them in simpler language.
sentences.zh: 說明對很多顧客來說看不懂，所以公司用更簡單的文字重寫。

sentences.en: It took me a while to make sense of the new rules, but now I understand them well.
sentences.zh: 我花了一段時間才搞懂新規定，但現在已經很了解了。

sentences.en: Does it make sense to buy a new printer, or should we repair the old one instead?
sentences.zh: 買新印表機合理嗎？還是應該修舊的就好？

sentences.en: The plan will make sense to the board only if we can show how it will increase profits.
sentences.zh: 只有我們能說明它如何提高獲利，這個計畫對董事會來說才合理。

words.note: 語塊：make sense to（對……來說合理）、it makes sense to（……是合理的）、make sense of（理解）。make sense 是「有道理」；make sense of 是「搞懂、理解」。

sentences.en: Please contact our technical support team if you have any problems installing the software on your computer.
sentences.zh: 如果你安裝軟體有任何問題，請聯絡我們的技術支援團隊。

sentences.en: The new manager received strong support from the staff when she suggested more flexible hours.
sentences.zh: 新經理建議更彈性的工時時，獲得員工的強力支持。

sentences.en: Customer support is available twenty-four hours a day by phone, email, and online chat on our website.
sentences.zh: 客戶支援全天二十四小時都可以透過電話、電子郵件和線上聊天聯繫。

sentences.en: Many residents signed a letter in support of the plan to build a new park near the river.
sentences.zh: 很多居民簽了一封信，支持在河邊興建新公園的計畫。

sentences.en: Thanks to the support of local businesses, the festival was able to offer free concerts this year.
sentences.zh: 多虧當地商家的支持，慶典今年能提供免費音樂會。

words.note: 語塊：technical support（技術支援）、customer support（客戶支援）、in support of（支持……）。support 可以當名詞或動詞；supporter 是「支持者」；supportive 是「支持的」。

sentences.en: The inspector will certify that the building is safe before people are allowed to move in.
sentences.zh: 在人們被允許搬進去之前，檢查員會證明那棟建築是安全的。

sentences.en: The doctor will certify that the employee was too ill to work during the last week of March.
sentences.zh: 醫生會證明那位員工三月最後一週病得太重無法上班。

sentences.en: An independent company will certify that our coffee is grown on farms without any harmful chemicals.
sentences.zh: 一家獨立公司會證明我們的咖啡是在沒有有害化學物質的情況下種植的。

sentences.en: Only trained technicians can certify that the elevators meet the government's safety standards for public buildings.
sentences.zh: 只有受過訓練的技師可以證明電梯符合政府的安全標準。

sentences.en: The accountant must certify that the financial report is accurate before it is shared with investors.
sentences.zh: 財報分享給投資人之前，會計師必須證明它是準確的。

words.note: 語塊：certify that（證明……）、be certified as（被認證為）。certify 是「正式證明」；certificate 是「證書」；certified 是形容詞「經認證的」。

sentences.en: All employees will receive the same bonus regardless of how long they have worked at the company.
sentences.zh: 不管在公司工作了多久，所有員工都會得到相同的獎金。

sentences.en: The concert will take place regardless of the weather, so please bring an umbrella just in case.
sentences.zh: 不管天氣如何，演唱會都會舉行，所以請帶把傘以防萬一。

sentences.en: Regardless of the price, customers are willing to buy products that are made with high quality.
sentences.zh: 不管價格如何，顧客都願意購買高品質的產品。

sentences.en: The shop offers free delivery to every customer regardless of the size of the order.
sentences.zh: 不管訂單大小，那家店都為每位顧客提供免費配送。

sentences.en: We will finish the project on time regardless of the problems we have had with our suppliers.
sentences.zh: 不管我們和供應商遇到什麼問題，我們都會準時完成專案。

words.note: 語塊：regardless of（不管……）。regardless of + 名詞，表示「不論」；irregardless 是錯誤用法。

words.meaning: 可用的；有空的；可取得的

sentences.en: Tickets for the concert are available online and at the box office in front of the stadium.
sentences.zh: 演唱會門票可以在網路上和體育場前的售票處購買。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee is not available for a meeting this afternoon, but she can meet you tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 李小姐今天下午沒空開會，但她明天早上可以和你見面。

sentences.en: Free internet access is available to all guests in the hotel rooms and in the lobby.
sentences.zh: 所有房客在飯店房間和大廳都可以使用免費網路。

sentences.en: Spare parts for this machine are readily available, so repairs can usually be done within a day.
sentences.zh: 這台機器的備用零件隨時都買得到，所以通常一天內就能修好。

sentences.en: The new phone will be available in stores across the country starting next Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 新手機從下週五起將在全國各地的門市上市。

words.note: 語塊：be available for（可以做……）、readily available（隨時可取得）、available to（提供給……）。available 可以形容東西「買得到、可使用」，也可以形容人「有空」；availability 是名詞。

sentences.en: Please make sure that your passport is valid for at least six months before you travel abroad.
sentences.zh: 出國前請確認你的護照至少還有六個月效期。

sentences.en: This coupon is valid for one free coffee and can be used at any of our stores until the end of May.
sentences.zh: 這張優惠券可以兌換一杯免費咖啡，五月底前在任何一家分店都能使用。

sentences.en: Passengers without a valid ticket will be asked to pay a fine when they leave the train station.
sentences.zh: 沒有有效車票的乘客出火車站時會被要求支付罰款。

sentences.en: Employees who are absent must give a valid reason, such as illness or a family emergency.
sentences.zh: 缺勤的員工必須提供合理的理由，例如生病或家庭緊急事故。

sentences.en: The special offer is valid for new customers who sign up for the service before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 這個特別優惠適用於月底前註冊服務的新顧客。

words.note: 語塊：valid ticket（有效的票）、valid for（有效期……）、valid reason（合理的理由）。valid 是「有效、合法的」；invalid 是「無效的」；validity 是名詞。

sentences.en: Many people take a dietary supplement such as vitamin D during the long winter months.
sentences.zh: 很多人在冬天會服用維他命 D 之類的膳食補充品。

sentences.en: Please ask your doctor before you take a dietary supplement, especially if you are taking other medicine.
sentences.zh: 服用保健食品之前請先問醫生，尤其是你正在吃其他藥的時候。

sentences.en: The pharmacy sells every kind of dietary supplement, including fish oil, vitamins, and protein powder.
sentences.zh: 那家藥局販售各種保健食品，包括魚油、維他命和蛋白粉。

sentences.en: The company was fined for making false claims about its dietary supplement in television advertisements.
sentences.zh: 那家公司因為在電視廣告中對保健食品做了不實宣傳而被罰款。

sentences.en: A healthy diet is more important than any dietary supplement, according to most doctors and nutrition experts.
sentences.zh: 根據大多數醫生的說法，健康的飲食比任何保健食品都重要。

words.note: 語塊：take a dietary supplement（服用保健食品）、sell dietary supplements（販售保健食品）。dietary 是「飲食的」；supplement 是「補充品」；vitamin 是「維他命」。

sentences.en: Please consult a physician before you begin any new exercise program, especially if you have health problems.
sentences.zh: 開始任何新的運動計畫之前，請先請教醫師，尤其是你有健康問題的話。

sentences.en: Our family physician recommended that I walk for thirty minutes every day to lower my blood pressure.
sentences.zh: 我們的家庭醫師建議我每天走路三十分鐘來降低血壓。

sentences.en: The hospital is looking for an experienced physician to lead its new heart center in the east wing.
sentences.zh: 醫院在找一位有經驗的醫師帶領新的心臟中心。

sentences.en: Patients should bring a list of their medications when they visit their family physician for a checkup.
sentences.zh: 病人去看家庭醫師時應該帶一份正在服用的藥物清單。

sentences.en: The new clinic has three physicians, and each physician can see about thirty patients a day.
sentences.zh: 新診所有三位醫師，每位醫師一天大約可以看三十位病人。

words.note: 語塊：family physician（家庭醫師）、consult a physician（請教醫師）。physician 是「醫師」，比 doctor 正式；physicist 是「物理學家」，很容易搞混。

sentences.en: Members in good standing can use the library's online services and borrow up to ten books.
sentences.zh: 信譽良好的會員可以使用圖書館的線上服務，並最多借十本書。

sentences.en: The bank checks the financial standing of every company before it approves a large loan.
sentences.zh: 銀行在核准大筆貸款之前會檢查每家公司的財務狀況。

sentences.en: The two companies have a long-standing relationship and have worked together for over twenty years.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司有長期的關係，合作超過二十年了。

sentences.en: The scandal damaged the standing of the company among its loyal customers and investors around the world.
sentences.zh: 那件醜聞損害了公司在顧客和投資人之間的名聲。

sentences.en: Only members in good standing are allowed to vote at the annual meeting of the association.
sentences.zh: 只有信譽良好的會員才可以在協會的年度大會上投票。

words.note: 語塊：financial standing（財務狀況）、in good standing（信譽良好）、long-standing（長期的）。standing 是「地位、身分」；long-standing 是「存在已久的」。

sentences.en: I agree with your idea, but we need to check whether we have enough money in the budget.
sentences.zh: 我同意你的想法，但我們需要確認預算夠不夠。

sentences.en: The two companies were finally able to agree on a price for the land after several weeks of talks.
sentences.zh: 經過幾週的談判，兩家公司終於對土地價格達成共識。

sentences.en: The supplier did not agree to the new terms, so we will continue to use the old contract.
sentences.zh: 供應商不同意新條款，所以我們會繼續使用舊合約。

sentences.en: Most of the managers agree with the decision to move the office closer to the train station.
sentences.zh: 大部分經理都同意把辦公室搬到離火車站近一點的決定。

sentences.en: The team members could not agree on a name for the new product, so they asked customers for ideas.
sentences.zh: 組員無法對新產品的名稱達成共識，所以他們向顧客徵求點子。

words.note: 語塊：agree with（同意某人）、agree to（同意某事）、agree on（對……達成共識）。agree with + 人／意見；agree to + 計畫、條件；agree on + 共同決定的事。

sentences.en: The company signed a lucrative contract with the government to build three new bridges over the river.
sentences.zh: 那家公司和政府簽了一份利潤豐厚的合約，興建三座新橋。

sentences.en: Online education has become a lucrative business, especially for courses in computer programming and design.
sentences.zh: 線上教育已經成為很賺錢的生意，尤其是程式設計和設計課程。

sentences.en: Many companies want to enter the lucrative market for electric cars in Europe and Asia.
sentences.zh: 很多公司想進入歐洲和亞洲有利可圖的電動車市場。

sentences.en: Ms. Park left her lucrative job at the bank in order to start a small bakery in her hometown.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐辭掉銀行的高薪工作，在家鄉開了一家小麵包店。

sentences.en: Selling coffee to office workers turned out to be a lucrative business for the young entrepreneurs.
sentences.zh: 賣咖啡給上班族，結果對那些年輕創業家來說是一門很賺錢的生意。

words.note: 語塊：lucrative business（賺錢的生意）、lucrative contract（利潤豐厚的合約）、lucrative market（有利可圖的市場）。lucrative 是「能賺很多錢的」；profitable 意思接近。

sentences.en: The ideal candidate will have at least five years of experience in sales and excellent communication skills.
sentences.zh: 理想人選需要至少五年業務經驗和優秀的溝通能力。

sentences.en: The successful candidate will start work on the first of June and will be based in our Seoul office.
sentences.zh: 錄取者將在六月一日到職，並在我們的首爾辦公室上班。

sentences.en: We interviewed every qualified candidate, but none of them could speak both Japanese and Korean.
sentences.zh: 我們面試了每位合格的應徵者，但沒有一位能同時說日文和韓文。

sentences.en: Each candidate will be asked to give a short presentation about their previous work experience.
sentences.zh: 每位應徵者都會被要求做一個關於過去工作經驗的簡短報告。

sentences.en: The committee will choose the successful candidate after the final round of interviews next Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 委員會將在下週四最後一輪面試後選出錄取者。

words.note: 語塊：ideal candidate（理想人選）、successful candidate（錄取者）、qualified candidate（合格的應徵者）。candidate 是「應徵者、候選人」；applicant 是「申請人」；candid 是「坦率的」。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz has been employed by the bank for twelve years and now manages the customer service team.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐受僱於那家銀行十二年，現在管理客服團隊。

sentences.en: Applicants who are currently employed should tell us when they would be able to start the new job.
sentences.zh: 目前在職的應徵者應告訴我們何時可以開始新工作。

sentences.en: Many designers are self-employed and work with several different clients at the same time from home.
sentences.zh: 很多設計師是自營工作者，同時和好幾位不同的客戶合作。

sentences.en: More than two thousand people are employed at the factory, which makes it the largest employer in town.
sentences.zh: 那座工廠僱用了兩千多人，是鎮上最大的雇主。

sentences.en: The survey found that most people who are self-employed work longer hours than office workers.
sentences.zh: 調查發現，大部分自營工作者的工時比上班族長。

words.note: 語塊：be employed by（受僱於）、currently employed（目前在職）、self-employed（自營的）。employed 是「有工作的」；unemployed 是「失業的」；employ 是動詞。

sentences.en: The price of the hotel room does include breakfast and free use of the swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 飯店房價確實包含早餐和免費使用游泳池。

sentences.en: Please include your order number in the email so that we can find your purchase quickly.
sentences.zh: 請在電子郵件中附上你的訂單編號，讓我們能快速找到你的購買紀錄。

sentences.en: The tour will include visits to three museums and lunch at a traditional restaurant in the old town.
sentences.zh: 行程將包括參觀三間博物館，以及在一家傳統餐廳吃午餐。

sentences.en: The report should include a summary of sales for each region and a plan for next year.
sentences.zh: 報告應該包括每個地區的銷售摘要和明年的計畫。

sentences.en: The prices on our menu include tax, but a service charge of ten percent will be added to your bill.
sentences.zh: 我們菜單上的價格含稅，但帳單會另加一成服務費。

words.note: 語塊：include tax（含稅）、be included in（被包含在）、including（包括）。include 是「包含」；exclude 是「排除」；inclusive 是形容詞「包含在內的」。

sentences.en: Many teachers work during the summer to earn supplemental income for their families and pay for vacations.
sentences.zh: 很多老師暑假打工，為家裡賺額外收入。

sentences.en: Please read the supplemental information attached to the email before the meeting with the clients on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 週四開會前，請先閱讀郵件附件的補充資料。

sentences.en: Employees can buy supplemental insurance that covers dental care and eye examinations for their families.
sentences.zh: 員工可以購買涵蓋牙科和眼科檢查的附加保險。

sentences.en: The teacher gave the students supplemental reading materials to help them prepare for the exam.
sentences.zh: 老師給學生補充閱讀資料，幫助他們準備考試。

sentences.en: Renting out a room is a popular way for homeowners to earn supplemental income in the city.
sentences.zh: 在城裡出租一個房間，是屋主賺額外收入的熱門方式。

words.note: 語塊：supplemental income（額外收入）、supplemental information（補充資料）、supplemental insurance（附加保險）。supplemental 和 supplementary 意思相同；supplement 是名詞「補充品」。

sentences.en: The publisher plans to release the author's new novel in both print and digital formats next spring.
sentences.zh: 出版社計畫明年春天以紙本和電子形式發行那位作家的新小說。

sentences.en: Ms. Ward sent her manuscript to several publishers, and one publisher offered her a contract.
sentences.zh: Ward 小姐把原稿寄給好幾家出版社，其中一家提供她合約。

sentences.en: The publisher of the magazine announced that it will stop printing paper copies at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌的出版商宣布年底將停止印刷紙本。

sentences.en: The book publisher is looking for an editor with experience in children's books and good design skills.
sentences.zh: 那家圖書出版社在找一位有童書經驗、設計能力也好的編輯。
