sentences.en: The publisher will hold a party to celebrate the success of the best-selling cookbook this year.
sentences.zh: 出版社將舉辦一場派對，慶祝那本暢銷食譜的成功。

words.note: 語塊：book publisher（圖書出版社）、the publisher of（……的出版商）。publisher 是「出版社」；publish 是動詞「出版」；publicist 是「公關人員」。

sentences.en: The automotive industry is changing quickly as more and more companies begin to produce electric cars.
sentences.zh: 隨著越來越多公司開始生產電動車，汽車產業正快速改變。

sentences.en: The factory produces automotive parts for several large car companies in Japan, Korea, and Germany.
sentences.zh: 那座工廠為日本和德國好幾家汽車公司生產汽車零件。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim worked as an automotive engineer for fifteen years before he started teaching at the university.
sentences.zh: 金先生當了十五年汽車工程師，之後開始在大學教書。

sentences.en: Many jobs in the region depend on the automotive industry, so the new factory is very important.
sentences.zh: 該地區很多工作都依賴汽車產業，所以新工廠非常重要。

sentences.en: The store sells automotive parts and tools, and it also offers free advice to customers.
sentences.zh: 那家店販售汽車零件和工具，還為顧客提供免費建議。

words.note: 語塊：automotive industry（汽車產業）、automotive parts（汽車零件）、automotive engineer（汽車工程師）。automotive 是「和汽車有關的」；automatic 是「自動的」，長得像。

sentences.en: The museum will hold an exhibition of modern paintings by young artists from across Asia this summer.
sentences.zh: 博物館今年夏天將舉辦一場來自亞洲各地年輕藝術家的現代畫展。

sentences.en: The art exhibition attracted more than ten thousand visitors during its first week at the museum.
sentences.zh: 那場藝術展第一週就吸引了一萬多名參觀者。

sentences.en: The famous paintings will be on exhibition at the city gallery until the end of March.
sentences.zh: 那些名畫將在市立美術館展出到三月底。

sentences.en: Tickets for the art exhibition can be bought online or at the entrance of the museum.
sentences.zh: 藝術展的門票可以在網路上或博物館入口購買。

sentences.en: The company will hold an exhibition of its new products for clients and reporters next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月將為客戶和記者舉辦一場新產品展覽。

words.note: 語塊：art exhibition（藝術展）、hold an exhibition（舉辦展覽）、on exhibition（展出中）。exhibition 是「展覽」；exhibit 可以是動詞「展出」或名詞「展品」。

sentences.en: Customers should take advantage of the offer on winter jackets, which ends this Sunday at midnight.
sentences.zh: 顧客應該把握冬季外套的優惠，這週日午夜就結束了。

sentences.en: Many employees take advantage of the free gym in the office building during their lunch break.
sentences.zh: 很多員工利用午休時間使用辦公大樓的免費健身房。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee decided to take advantage of the opportunity to work abroad for two years.
sentences.zh: 李小姐決定把握到國外工作兩年的機會。

sentences.en: Visitors can take advantage of the free shuttle bus, which runs between the hotel and the beach.
sentences.zh: 遊客可以利用往返飯店和海灘的免費接駁車。

sentences.en: Small businesses should take advantage of social media to reach new customers at a low cost.
sentences.zh: 小企業應該善用社群媒體，以低成本接觸新顧客。

words.note: 語塊：take advantage of the opportunity（把握機會）、take advantage of the offer（利用優惠）、take advantage of the free（利用免費的……）、take advantage of social media（善用社群媒體）。take advantage of 是「好好利用」；也可以是「佔……便宜」（負面）。

sentences.en: This hotel is suitable for families because it has large rooms and a swimming pool for children.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店適合家庭入住，因為房間大，還有兒童游泳池。

sentences.en: The company has not yet found a suitable candidate for the position of marketing director.
sentences.zh: 公司還沒找到行銷總監職位的合適人選。

sentences.en: We need to find a suitable location for the new store that is close to public transportation.
sentences.zh: 我們需要為新店找一個靠近大眾運輸的合適地點。

sentences.en: The training course is suitable for beginners who have never used the accounting software before.
sentences.zh: 這門訓練課程適合從沒用過這套軟體的初學者。

sentences.en: Please wear clothing that is suitable for outdoor activities, as the tour includes a long walk.
sentences.zh: 請穿適合戶外活動的服裝，因為行程包含長時間步行。

words.note: 語塊：suitable for（適合……）、suitable candidate（合適的人選）、find a suitable（找到合適的……）。suitable 是「合適的」；appropriate 意思接近；suit 是動詞「適合」。

sentences.en: Our new office is located in the business district, just five minutes from the subway station.
sentences.zh: 我們的新辦公室位於商業區，離捷運站只要五分鐘。

sentences.en: Many families move to this neighborhood because it is in the best school district in the city.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭搬到這個社區，因為它位在城裡最好的學區。

sentences.en: The shopping district is very crowded on weekends, so we recommend visiting on a weekday morning.
sentences.zh: 購物區週末非常擁擠，所以我們建議平日早上去。

sentences.en: The city plans to build a new park in the eastern district, where there is very little green space.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫在綠地很少的東區興建一座新公園。

sentences.en: Hotels in the business district are often fully booked during the week because of business travelers.
sentences.zh: 商業區的飯店平日常常因為商務旅客而客滿。

words.note: 語塊：business district（商業區）、school district（學區）、shopping district（購物區）。district 是「行政或功能上的區域」；region 是「較大的地區」；area 是一般說法。

sentences.en: All employees must follow the dress code when they meet with clients at the office.
sentences.zh: 所有員工在辦公室和客戶見面時都必須遵守服裝規定。

sentences.en: The company has a casual dress code on Fridays, so employees can wear jeans and sneakers.
sentences.zh: 公司週五採休閒服裝規定，員工可以穿牛仔褲和運動鞋。

sentences.en: The restaurant has a strict dress code, and guests are not allowed to wear shorts or sandals.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳有嚴格的服裝規定，客人不能穿短褲或涼鞋。

sentences.en: New employees receive a handbook that explains the dress code and other rules of the company.
sentences.zh: 新員工會拿到一本說明服裝規定和公司其他規定的手冊。

sentences.en: Please check the dress code on the invitation before you attend the awards dinner next week.
sentences.zh: 參加下週的頒獎晚宴之前，請先看邀請函上的服裝規定。

words.note: 語塊：follow the dress code（遵守服裝規定）、casual dress code（休閒服裝規定）、strict dress code（嚴格的服裝規定）。dress code 是公司或場合的「穿著規範」；code of conduct 是「行為準則」。

sentences.en: Our company only hires certified accountants who have passed the difficult national exam for accountants.
sentences.zh: 我們公司只聘用通過國家考試、有證照的會計師。

sentences.en: All of the coffee sold in our stores is certified organic and comes from small farms in Colombia.
sentences.zh: 我們門市販售的所有咖啡都是經認證的有機咖啡，來自哥倫比亞的小農場。

sentences.en: Important legal documents should be sent by certified mail so that you have proof of delivery.
sentences.zh: 重要的法律文件應該用雙掛號寄送，這樣你才有送達證明。

sentences.en: The gym's personal trainers are all certified and have at least three years of experience.
sentences.zh: 健身房的私人教練都有證照，而且至少有三年的經驗。

sentences.en: Please hire a certified electrician to install the new lights, as it can be dangerous to do it yourself.
sentences.zh: 請找有證照的電工安裝新燈，因為自己安裝可能很危險。

words.note: 語塊：certified accountant（有證照的會計師）、certified organic（經認證的有機）、certified mail（雙掛號）。certified 是「經過正式認證的」；certify 是動詞；certificate 是「證書」。

sentences.en: Dr. Kim works at a research institute that studies new ways to produce clean energy.
sentences.zh: 金博士在一家研究潔淨能源新生產方式的研究所工作。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin graduated from the institute of technology and now designs computer chips for a large company.
sentences.zh: 林小姐畢業於理工學院，現在為一家大公司設計電腦晶片。

sentences.en: The research institute received a large grant from the government to study air pollution in cities.
sentences.zh: 那家研究所獲得政府一大筆補助，研究城市的空氣污染。

sentences.en: The institute offers evening courses for adults who want to learn new skills for their careers.
sentences.zh: 那所學院為想學習職涯新技能的成人開設夜間課程。

sentences.en: Scientists from the institute will present their findings at an international conference in Tokyo next month.
sentences.zh: 那家研究所的科學家下個月將在國際研討會上發表研究結果。

words.note: 語塊：research institute（研究所）、institute of technology（理工學院）。institute 是「研究或教育機構」；institution 是「機構；制度」，意思接近。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee left her job at a large corporation to start her own small design company.
sentences.zh: 李小姐辭去大企業的工作，自己開了一家小設計公司。

sentences.en: The multinational corporation has offices in more than forty countries and employs fifty thousand people.
sentences.zh: 那家跨國企業在四十多個國家設有辦公室，僱用五萬人。

sentences.en: Many young people prefer to work for a small company rather than a large corporation.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕人比較喜歡在小公司工作，而不是大企業。

sentences.en: The corporation announced plans to build a new research center near the university next year.
sentences.zh: 那家企業宣布明年要在大學附近興建新的研究中心。

sentences.en: Working for a multinational corporation gives employees the chance to travel and learn about other cultures.
sentences.zh: 在跨國企業工作讓員工有機會出差並了解其他文化。

words.note: 語塊：large corporation（大企業）、multinational corporation（跨國企業）。corporation 是「法人公司、大企業」；corporate 是形容詞「公司的」；cooperation 是「合作」。

sentences.en: The team worked late every night this week in order to meet the deadline for the project.
sentences.zh: 團隊這週每晚都加班，為了趕上專案的截止日。

sentences.en: If you miss the deadline, your application will not be considered for this year's program.
sentences.zh: 如果你錯過截止日，你的申請不會被列入今年的計畫考慮。

sentences.en: The manager agreed to extend the deadline by one week because several team members were sick.
sentences.zh: 因為好幾位組員生病，經理同意把截止日延長一週。

sentences.en: The deadline for submitting expense reports is the fifth day of every month at five o'clock.
sentences.zh: 提交支出報告的截止日是每個月五日。

sentences.en: Please let me know as soon as possible if you think you will not be able to meet the deadline.
sentences.zh: 如果你覺得趕不上截止日，請盡快告訴我。

words.note: 語塊：meet the deadline（趕上截止日）、miss the deadline（錯過截止日）、extend the deadline（延長截止日）。deadline 是「最後期限」；due date 意思接近。

sentences.en: Please download the latest version of the app to use the new features we have added.
sentences.zh: 請下載最新版本的 App，使用我們新增的功能。

sentences.en: You can read the latest news about the company on our website or in the monthly newsletter.
sentences.zh: 你可以在我們網站或每月電子報上看到公司的最新消息。

sentences.en: The new hospital uses the latest technology to treat patients more quickly and safely than before.
sentences.zh: 新醫院使用最新科技，更快速安全地治療病人。

sentences.en: The store displays the latest fashion from Paris and Milan in its windows every season.
sentences.zh: 那家店每季都在櫥窗展示巴黎和米蘭的最新流行。

sentences.en: The latest sales figures show that the new product has been very popular with young customers.
sentences.zh: 最新的銷售數字顯示新產品很受年輕顧客歡迎。

words.note: 語塊：the latest version（最新版本）、latest news（最新消息）、latest technology（最新科技）。latest 是「最新的」；last 是「最後的；上一個」；lately 是「最近」。

sentences.en: The company will pay tuition for employees who want to study for a master's degree in business.
sentences.zh: 公司會為想攻讀企管碩士的員工支付學費。

sentences.en: Many students work part-time in the evenings so that they can pay tuition and living costs.
sentences.zh: 很多學生晚上兼差，好支付學費和生活費。

sentences.en: The university offers free tuition to students from low-income families who have excellent grades in high school.
sentences.zh: 那所大學為成績優秀的低收入家庭學生提供免學費。

sentences.en: The cost of tuition has increased by ten percent this year, so many families are worried.
sentences.zh: 今年學費漲了一成，所以很多家庭很擔心。

sentences.en: The scholarship covers tuition as well as the cost of books and housing for four years.
sentences.zh: 這份獎學金支付學費以及四年的書籍和住宿費用。

words.note: 語塊：pay tuition（付學費）、tuition fees（學費）、free tuition（免學費）。tuition 是「學費」，也可以指「教學、輔導」；intuition 是「直覺」，長得像。

sentences.en: The museum, which was formerly a train station, now attracts thousands of visitors every month.
sentences.zh: 那座以前是火車站的博物館，現在每個月吸引數千名參觀者。

sentences.en: The company, formerly known as Bright Foods, changed its name after it was bought by a larger firm.
sentences.zh: 那家公司以前叫做 Bright Foods，被一家更大的公司收購後改了名字。

sentences.en: Ms. Park formerly worked as a teacher before she became the director of the education program.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐成為教育計畫的主任之前，以前是一名老師。

sentences.en: The building was formerly used as a factory, but it has been turned into apartments and shops.
sentences.zh: 那棟建築以前是工廠，但已經改建成公寓和商店。

sentences.en: The restaurant formerly known as Blue Garden reopened last month with a new menu and chef.
sentences.zh: 以前叫做 Blue Garden 的餐廳上個月重新開幕，有了新菜單和新主廚。

words.note: 語塊：formerly known as（以前叫做……）、formerly used as（以前用作……）、formerly worked as（以前擔任……）。formerly 是「以前（現在不是了）」；formally 是「正式地」，很容易搞混。

sentences.en: To avoid delays, please submit all of the required documents before the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 為了避免延誤，請在週末前提交所有必要文件。

sentences.en: Many employees leave home early in the morning to avoid traffic on the busy highway into the city.
sentences.zh: 很多員工一大早出門，避開公路上的車潮。

sentences.en: Please avoid using your phone during the meeting so that everyone can focus on the discussion.
sentences.zh: 開會時請避免使用手機，讓大家能專心討論。

sentences.en: The company changed its shipping company in order to avoid delays during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 公司換了貨運公司，以避免忙碌節慶期間的延誤。

sentences.en: Travelers should avoid driving in the mountains during the storm because the roads may be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨期間旅客應避免在山區開車，因為道路可能很危險。

words.note: 語塊：avoid doing（避免做……）、avoid delays（避免延誤）、avoid traffic（避開車潮）。avoid 後面接名詞或 V-ing（avoid making mistakes），不接 to do；avoidable 是「可避免的」。

sentences.en: Please find attached a copy of the contract, which you should sign and return by Friday.
sentences.zh: 隨信附上合約副本，請在週五前簽名寄回。

sentences.en: The attached file contains the schedule for next week's training sessions and a map of the building.
sentences.zh: 附件檔案包含下週訓練課程的時程表和大樓地圖。

sentences.en: Please fill out the attached form and send it back to the human resources department by email.
sentences.zh: 請填寫附件的表格，並用電子郵件寄回人資部。

sentences.en: A small card with care instructions is attached to every piece of clothing in our store.
sentences.zh: 我們店裡每件衣服都附有一張寫著保養說明的小卡。

sentences.en: I have reviewed the attached report, and I have a few questions about the figures on page five.
sentences.zh: 我看過附件的報告了，對第五頁的數字有幾個問題。

words.note: 語塊：attached file（附件檔案）、please find attached（隨信附上）、attached to（附在……上）。attached 是「附上的」；attachment 是名詞「附件」；be attached to 也可以是「喜歡、依戀」。

sentences.en: Please put the signed documents in the envelope and send them to our office by mail.
sentences.zh: 請把簽好的文件放進信封，郵寄到我們辦公室。

sentences.en: Applicants should include a stamped envelope with their address so that we can return the documents.
sentences.zh: 申請人應附上一個寫好地址、貼好郵票的信封，讓我們把文件寄回。

sentences.en: The results of the competition are in a sealed envelope that will be opened at the awards ceremony.
sentences.zh: 比賽結果裝在一個密封的信封裡，將在頒獎典禮上打開。

sentences.en: The tickets will arrive in an envelope with the company's logo, so please check your mail carefully.
sentences.zh: 門票會裝在印有公司商標的信封裡寄出，所以請仔細查看你的信件。

sentences.en: Please write the name of the department clearly on the envelope so that it reaches the right person.
sentences.zh: 請在信封上清楚寫上部門名稱，讓它送到對的人手上。

words.note: 語塊：sealed envelope（密封的信封）、stamped envelope（貼好郵票的信封）、in an envelope（裝在信封裡）。envelope 是「信封」（名詞）；envelop（少一個 e）是動詞「包住」。

sentences.en: All new employees will receive an information packet about the company's benefits on their first day.
sentences.zh: 所有新員工到職第一天都會收到一份關於公司福利的資料袋。

sentences.en: The information packet includes a map of the campus, a list of courses, and the dates of important events.
sentences.zh: 資料袋裡有校園地圖、課程清單和重要活動的日期。

sentences.en: Please read the information packet carefully before you attend the training session next Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 下週一參加訓練課程之前，請仔細閱讀資料袋。

sentences.en: Visitors to the conference can pick up an information packet at the registration desk in the lobby.
sentences.zh: 研討會的訪客可以在大廳的報到處領取資料袋。

sentences.en: The hotel sends an information packet to every guest by email one week before they arrive.
sentences.zh: 飯店會在每位客人抵達前一週，用電子郵件寄出一份資訊手冊。

words.note: 語塊：receive an information packet（收到資料袋）、information packet about（關於……的資料）。packet 是「一小包、一份資料」；package 是「包裹」；brochure 是「宣傳小冊子」。

sentences.en: Please send me an outline of your presentation by Friday so that I can give you some feedback.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前把你的簡報大綱寄給我，讓我給你一些意見。

sentences.en: The manager gave an outline of the new project and explained what each team would be responsible for.
sentences.zh: 經理概述了新專案，並說明每個團隊要負責什麼。

sentences.en: The course outline lists the topics that will be covered each week and the dates of the exams.
sentences.zh: 課程大綱列出每週要教的主題和考試日期。

sentences.en: Before writing the report, it is helpful to prepare an outline of the main points you want to include.
sentences.zh: 寫報告之前，先準備一份你想涵蓋重點的大綱很有幫助。

sentences.en: The director presented an outline of the budget for next year at the meeting on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 總監在週三的會議上報告了明年預算的概要。

words.note: 語塊：an outline of（……的大綱）、in outline（概略地）、give an outline（概述）。outline 可以當名詞「大綱」或動詞「概述」；summary 是「摘要」。

sentences.en: The sales representative will demonstrate how to use the new coffee machine at the store on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 業務代表週六會在店裡示範如何使用新咖啡機。

sentences.en: The results of the study demonstrate that regular exercise can improve productivity and happiness at work.
sentences.zh: 研究結果證明規律運動能提高工作效率。

sentences.en: The company will demonstrate a product that can clean the air in a room in less than ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 公司將展示一款能在十分鐘內淨化房間空氣的產品。

sentences.en: Applicants must demonstrate that they have at least three years of experience in customer service.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須證明自己至少有三年的客服經驗。

sentences.en: The chef will demonstrate how to prepare traditional dishes at the cooking class next week.
sentences.zh: 主廚下週會在烹飪課上示範如何做傳統料理。

words.note: 語塊：demonstrate how to（示範如何……）、demonstrate that（證明……）、demonstrate a product（展示產品）。demonstrate 是「示範、展示」；demonstration 是名詞「示範；示威」。

sentences.en: We are looking for a highly qualified engineer who can lead our new research team.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位能帶領新研究團隊、非常合格的工程師。

sentences.en: Ms. Ortiz is qualified for the position because she has a degree in finance and ten years of experience.
sentences.zh: Ortiz 小姐有資格擔任這個職位，因為她有財務學位和十年經驗。

sentences.en: Only a qualified candidate who speaks both English and Spanish will be invited for an interview.
sentences.zh: 只有同時會說英文和西班牙文的合格人選才會受邀面試。

sentences.en: All of our teachers are highly qualified and have many years of experience working with young children.
sentences.zh: 我們所有老師都非常合格，而且有和幼童相處的經驗。

sentences.en: The company needs to hire more qualified workers to operate the new machines in the factory.
sentences.zh: 公司需要聘用更多合格的工人來操作工廠的新機器。

words.note: 語塊：highly qualified（非常合格的）、qualified for（有資格擔任……）、qualified candidate（合格的人選）。qualified 是「有資格、能力夠的」；qualify 是動詞「取得資格」；qualification 是「資格」。

sentences.en: A financial advisor can help you plan for retirement and choose the right investments for your future.
sentences.zh: 理財顧問可以幫你規劃退休並選擇合適的投資。

sentences.en: The company hired a legal advisor to review the contract before it was signed by both sides.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位法律顧問，在雙方簽約前審閱合約。

sentences.en: Students should meet with their academic advisor at least once a semester to discuss their courses.
sentences.zh: 學生每學期至少應該和學業導師見一次面，討論修課。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim works as a financial advisor at a bank and helps families save money for their children's education.
sentences.zh: 金小姐在銀行擔任理財顧問，幫助家庭為孩子的教育存錢。

sentences.en: The president asked his advisor for an opinion before making a final decision about the new policy.
sentences.zh: 總裁在對新政策做最後決定之前，詢問了顧問的意見。

words.note: 語塊：financial advisor（理財顧問）、legal advisor（法律顧問）、academic advisor（學業導師）。advisor 也可以拼成 adviser；advise 是動詞「建議」；advice 是名詞「建議」。

sentences.en: Our knowledgeable staff can help you choose the right computer for your work or studies.
sentences.zh: 我們專業的員工可以幫你挑選適合工作或課業的電腦。

sentences.en: The tour guide was very knowledgeable about the history of the city and answered all of our questions.
sentences.zh: 導遊對這座城市的歷史非常了解，回答了我們所有的問題。

sentences.en: We are looking for a sales associate who is knowledgeable about cameras, lenses, and photography.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位對相機和攝影很懂的店員。

sentences.en: Customers appreciate knowledgeable staff who can explain the differences between similar products clearly and quickly in the store.
sentences.zh: 顧客很欣賞能清楚說明產品差異的專業員工。

sentences.en: The speaker is knowledgeable about renewable energy and has worked on several large projects in Asia.
sentences.zh: 講者對再生能源很了解，在亞洲參與過好幾個大型專案。

words.note: 語塊：knowledgeable about（對……很了解）、knowledgeable staff（專業的員工）。knowledgeable 是「懂很多」；knowledge 是名詞「知識」；注意拼法有 e。

sentences.en: A dinner will be held in honor of Mr. Brown, who is retiring after thirty years at the company.
sentences.zh: 將舉辦一場晚宴表揚在公司服務三十年後退休的 Brown 先生。

sentences.en: It is an honor to welcome so many talented designers to our annual conference this year.
sentences.zh: 今年能歡迎這麼多優秀設計師參加我們的年度研討會，是我們的榮幸。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee received an honor from the city for her work helping elderly residents in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 李小姐因為幫助社區年長居民，獲得市政府頒發的榮譽。

sentences.en: The new library was named in honor of the author who donated money to build it.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館以捐款興建它的那位作家之名命名，以示紀念。

sentences.en: It was a great honor to be chosen to represent our company at the international trade show.
sentences.zh: 被選為代表公司參加國際商展是一份很大的榮譽。

words.note: 語塊：in honor of（為了紀念、表揚……）、an honor to（……的榮幸）、receive an honor（獲得榮譽）。honor 是美式拼法，英式為 honour；honorable 是「光榮的」；honorary 是「名譽的」。

sentences.en: The new printer is compatible with most computers and can also print directly from smartphones.
sentences.zh: 新印表機和大部分電腦相容，也可以直接從手機列印。

sentences.en: Please check that the software is compatible with your operating system before you download it.
sentences.zh: 下載軟體之前，請確認它和你的作業系統相容。

sentences.en: The charger is fully compatible with all of our phones, including the older models sold before 2020.
sentences.zh: 這個充電器和我們所有手機完全相容，包括舊機型。

sentences.en: The new design must be compatible with the company's goal of reducing plastic waste in all of its products.
sentences.zh: 新設計必須符合公司減少塑膠垃圾的目標。

sentences.en: Some customers complained that the new app was not compatible with their older tablets and phones.
sentences.zh: 有些顧客抱怨新 App 和他們的平板不相容。

words.note: 語塊：be compatible with（和……相容）、fully compatible with（完全相容）。compatible 是「可以一起使用、相容的」；incompatible 是「不相容的」。

sentences.en: The architect showed the client a blueprint of the new office building before construction began.
sentences.zh: 施工開始前，建築師給客戶看了新辦公大樓的設計圖。

sentences.en: The report offers a blueprint for reducing traffic in the city over the next ten years.
sentences.zh: 報告提供了未來十年減少城市交通量的藍圖。

sentences.en: Engineers must study the blueprint carefully before they start building the new bridge over the river.
sentences.zh: 工程師開始建造新橋之前，必須仔細研究設計圖。

sentences.en: The new CEO presented a blueprint for the company's growth in Asia at the annual meeting.
sentences.zh: 新執行長在年度大會上提出公司在亞洲成長的藍圖。

sentences.en: The blueprint of the house shows three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a large kitchen, and a garden.
sentences.zh: 那棟房子的設計圖顯示有三間臥室、兩間浴室和一個大廚房。

words.note: 語塊：a blueprint for（……的藍圖）、draw a blueprint（畫藍圖）。blueprint 原指「建築設計圖」，也可比喻「詳細的計畫」。

sentences.en: The organizers announced the postponement of the outdoor concert because of the heavy rain this weekend.
sentences.zh: 因為大雨，主辦單位宣布戶外音樂會延期。

sentences.en: The postponement of the product launch will give the engineers more time to fix the problems.
sentences.zh: 產品延後上市會讓工程師有更多時間修正問題。

sentences.en: We apologize for the postponement of the meeting and will let you know the new date soon.
sentences.zh: 我們為會議延期致歉，會盡快告知新的日期。

sentences.en: The postponement of the construction project was caused by a shortage of materials and workers.
sentences.zh: 工程延期是材料短缺造成的。

sentences.en: After the postponement, the conference will now take place in the first week of November.
sentences.zh: 延期之後，研討會現在將在十一月的第一週舉行。

words.note: 語塊：the postponement of（……的延期）、announce a postponement（宣布延期）。postponement 是名詞；postpone 是動詞「延期」；cancellation 是「取消」。

sentences.en: The lawyer will draw up a contract for the two companies and send it to them next week.
sentences.zh: 律師會為兩家公司擬定合約，下週寄給他們。

sentences.en: The committee was asked to draw up a plan to reduce energy use in all of the city's schools.
sentences.zh: 委員會被要求擬定一項減少市內所有學校用電的計畫。

sentences.en: Before the event, please draw up a list of everyone who will need a hotel room.
sentences.zh: 活動之前，請列出所有需要飯店房間的人。

sentences.en: The manager will draw up a schedule for the new employees' training during their first month.
sentences.zh: 經理會為新員工第一個月的訓練擬定時程表。

sentences.en: It took the team two weeks to draw up a plan that everyone in the department agreed with.
sentences.zh: 團隊花了兩週才擬定出部門裡每個人都同意的計畫。

words.note: 語塊：draw up a contract（擬定合約）、draw up a plan（擬定計畫）、draw up a list（列出清單）。draw up 是「寫出（正式文件）」；make up 是「編造；組成」。

sentences.en: The diagram on page three shows how the different parts of the machine fit together.
sentences.zh: 第三頁的示意圖說明機器的各個零件如何組裝在一起。

sentences.en: The teacher drew a diagram on the board to help the students understand how the system works.
sentences.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一張圖，幫助學生了解系統如何運作。

sentences.en: Please look at the diagram in the manual before you try to install the new shelves.
sentences.zh: 嘗試安裝新架子之前，請先看手冊裡的示意圖。

sentences.en: The engineer used a simple diagram to explain the design of the bridge to the city council.
sentences.zh: 工程師用一張簡單的示意圖向市議會說明橋樑的設計。

sentences.en: The diagram shows that most of the company's sales come from customers in Asia and Europe.
sentences.zh: 圖表顯示公司大部分的銷售來自亞洲的顧客。

words.note: 語塊：draw a diagram（畫圖表）、the diagram shows（圖表顯示）、the diagram in the manual（手冊裡的圖）、a simple diagram（簡單的圖）。diagram 是「說明用的圖」；chart 是「圖表（多為數字）」；graph 是「曲線圖」。

sentences.en: The company studies the spending pattern of each customer group to decide which products to sell in its stores.
sentences.zh: 公司研究每個顧客族群的消費模式，決定門市要賣哪些產品。

sentences.en: The changing weather pattern in the region has made it harder for farmers to know when to plant their crops.
sentences.zh: 地區天氣型態的改變讓農民更難判斷何時播種。

sentences.en: The dress has a simple pattern of blue and white flowers that is popular with young women.
sentences.zh: 那件洋裝有藍白花朵的簡單圖案，很受年輕女性歡迎。

sentences.en: Analysts noticed a pattern of increasing sales every December, when people buy holiday gifts for their families.
sentences.zh: 分析師注意到每年十二月銷售都會增加的模式，那時大家會買節慶禮物。

sentences.en: The new software can find a pattern in large amounts of data much faster than people can.
sentences.zh: 新軟體能比人更快地在大量資料中找出模式。

words.note: 語塊：spending pattern（消費模式）、weather pattern（天氣型態）、a pattern of（……的模式）。pattern 可以是「規律、模式」或布料上的「圖案」。

sentences.en: The government announced that it will raise the minimum wage by five percent next January.
sentences.zh: 政府宣布明年一月將把最低工資調高百分之五。

sentences.en: Many young people who work in restaurants earn the minimum wage, so they often have two jobs.
sentences.zh: 很多在餐廳工作的年輕人領最低工資，所以常常兼兩份工作。

sentences.en: The company pays all of its workers more than the minimum wage and offers free meals.
sentences.zh: 公司付給所有員工高於最低工資的薪水，還提供免費餐點。

sentences.en: Some business owners worry that a higher minimum wage will increase their costs too much.
sentences.zh: 有些老闆擔心更高的最低工資會讓他們的成本增加太多。

sentences.en: Workers held a protest in front of city hall to ask the government to raise the minimum wage.
sentences.zh: 工人在市政府前抗議，要求政府調高最低工資。

words.note: 語塊：raise the minimum wage（調高最低工資）、earn the minimum wage（領最低工資）。minimum wage 是「法律規定的最低工資」；maximum 是「最大值」。

sentences.en: Many families in the region live below the poverty level and need help paying for food and housing.
sentences.zh: 該地區很多家庭生活在貧窮線以下，需要幫助支付食物和住房費用。

sentences.en: The government program provides free health care to families whose income is below the poverty level.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫為收入低於貧窮線的家庭提供免費醫療。

sentences.en: The report shows that the number of people living below the poverty level has decreased over the past decade.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示，過去十年生活在貧窮線以下的人數減少了。

sentences.en: The charity helps elderly people who live at the poverty level by delivering meals to their homes.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善團體為生活在貧窮線上的長者送餐到家。

sentences.en: Children from families below the poverty level can receive free lunches at school every day.
sentences.zh: 來自貧窮線以下家庭的孩子每天都可以在學校吃免費午餐。

words.note: 語塊：below the poverty level（低於貧窮線）、live at the poverty level（生活在貧窮線上）。poverty level 也叫 poverty line；poverty 是名詞「貧窮」。

sentences.en: Customers can place an order online and pick it up at the store the next day.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在網路上下訂單，隔天到店取貨。

sentences.en: The company decided to place an advertisement in the local newspaper to find new employees.
sentences.zh: 公司決定在地方報紙刊登廣告，招募新員工。

sentences.en: Our school will place emphasis on practical skills that students can use in their future jobs.
sentences.zh: 我們學校將強調學生未來工作中用得到的實用技能。

sentences.en: Please place your bags on the shelf at the entrance before you enter the museum's exhibition hall.
sentences.zh: 進入博物館展廳之前，請把包包放在入口的架子上。

sentences.en: The manager will place new employees in different departments based on their experience and skills.
sentences.zh: 經理會根據新員工的經驗和技能，把他們安排到不同部門。

words.note: 語塊：place an order（下訂單）、place an advertisement（刊登廣告）、place emphasis on（強調）。place 當動詞是「放、安排」；place an order 是「下訂單」。

sentences.en: The construction of the new library has been put on hold until the city finds more funding.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館的工程暫停，直到市政府找到更多經費。

sentences.en: I was put on hold for twenty minutes when I called the customer service line this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上打客服專線時被要求等了二十分鐘。

sentences.en: The company put the project on hold because the costs were much higher than expected.
sentences.zh: 公司暫停了那個專案，因為成本比預期高很多。

sentences.en: Please stay on hold, and the next available representative will answer your call shortly, thank you.
sentences.zh: 請稍候，下一位有空的客服人員很快就會接聽您的電話。

sentences.en: Plans to open a new branch in Europe are on hold until the economy becomes more stable.
sentences.zh: 在歐洲開設新分公司的計畫暫停，直到經濟變得更穩定。

words.note: 語塊：put sb on hold（讓某人在電話上等候）、put a project on hold（暫停專案）。on hold 是「暫時停止、等一下」；hold on 是口語的「等一下」。

sentences.en: Please file all of the signed contracts in the large cabinet in the manager's office.
sentences.zh: 請把所有簽好的合約歸檔到經理辦公室的櫃子裡。

sentences.en: Customers who are unhappy with the service can file a complaint on our website at any time.
sentences.zh: 對服務不滿意的顧客可以在我們網站上提出投訴。

sentences.en: The police officer will file a report about the accident and send a copy to the insurance company.
sentences.zh: 警察會提交事故報告，並寄一份副本給保險公司。

sentences.en: Every business must file a tax return with the government by the end of May each year.
sentences.zh: 每家企業都必須在每年五月底前報稅。

sentences.en: The assistant spends an hour every morning helping to file documents and answer emails from clients.
sentences.zh: 助理每天早上花一小時幫忙歸檔文件和回覆電子郵件。

words.note: 語塊：file a complaint（提出投訴）、file a report（提交報告）、file documents（歸檔文件）。file 當動詞可以是「歸檔」或「正式提出」；當名詞是「檔案」。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers a free dessert to every regular patron on his or her birthday.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳在每位常客生日時招待一份免費甜點。

sentences.en: Each library patron can borrow up to ten books and three movies at a time for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 每位圖書館使用者一次最多可以借十本書和三部電影，借期兩週。

sentences.en: Mr. Lee is a well-known patron of the arts who has donated millions of dollars to museums.
sentences.zh: 李先生是知名的藝術贊助者，捐了數百萬美元給博物館。

sentences.en: Every patron of the theater is asked to turn off his or her phone before the performance begins.
sentences.zh: 劇院的每位觀眾都被要求在演出開始前關掉手機。

sentences.en: The café has become popular, and each patron receives a stamp card for free coffee.
sentences.zh: 那家咖啡廳變得很受歡迎，每位顧客都會拿到一張免費咖啡集點卡。

words.note: 語塊：regular patron（常客）、library patron（圖書館使用者）、patron of the arts（藝術贊助者）。patron 是「常光顧的客人」或「贊助者」；patrol 是「巡邏」；pattern 是「模式」。

sentences.en: The manager had to intervene when two employees started arguing loudly in the meeting room.
sentences.zh: 兩位員工在會議室大聲爭吵時，經理只好介入。

sentences.en: The government decided to intervene in the dispute between the workers and the company last month.
sentences.zh: 政府決定介入工人和公司之間的糾紛。

sentences.en: The bank may intervene to stop the value of the currency from falling too quickly.
sentences.zh: 銀行可能會介入，防止貨幣價值下跌太快。

sentences.en: Teachers are trained to intervene quickly if they see students having problems with each other.
sentences.zh: 老師受過訓練，看到學生之間有問題時要迅速介入。

sentences.en: The city council decided not to intervene in the plans to build the new shopping center.
sentences.zh: 市議會決定不介入興建新購物中心的計畫。

words.note: 語塊：intervene in（介入……）、intervene to（介入以……）。intervene 是「插手、出面處理」；interfere 是「干涉（較負面）」；intervention 是名詞。

sentences.en: A downswing in tourism has caused several hotels on the island to close for the winter.
sentences.zh: 觀光業下滑導致島上好幾家飯店冬天停業。

sentences.en: During the economic downswing, many companies stopped hiring new staff and reduced their spending on advertising.
sentences.zh: 經濟下滑期間，很多公司停止招聘並減少支出。

sentences.en: The report predicts a downswing in car sales next year because of higher interest rates.
sentences.zh: 報告預測明年汽車銷售會下滑，因為利率較高。

sentences.en: The company managed to keep its profits stable despite the downswing in the housing market.
sentences.zh: 儘管房市下滑，公司仍設法維持穩定的獲利。

sentences.en: Analysts believe that the downswing in consumer spending will end before the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 分析師認為消費支出的下滑會在節慶季前結束。

words.note: 語塊：a downswing in（……的下滑）、economic downswing（經濟下滑）。downswing 是「往下走的趨勢」；upswing 是「上升」；downturn 意思接近。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz decided to accept the job offer from the bank because it included a higher salary.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐決定接受那家銀行的工作邀約，因為薪水比較高。

sentences.en: The restaurant does not accept credit cards, so please bring enough cash when you visit.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳不收信用卡，所以去的時候請帶現金。

sentences.en: The company will accept responsibility for the mistake and offer a full refund to every customer.
sentences.zh: 公司會為這次錯誤負責，並為每位顧客全額退款。

sentences.en: We cannot accept applications that arrive after the deadline on Friday at five o'clock in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們不能受理在週五五點截止時間之後送達的申請。

sentences.en: The hotel will accept reservations for the holiday season starting on the first of September.
sentences.zh: 飯店從九月一日起開始接受節慶期間的訂房。

words.note: 語塊：accept an offer（接受提議）、accept credit cards（接受信用卡）、accept responsibility（承擔責任）。accept 是「接受」；except 是「除了」，發音相近很容易搞混。

sentences.en: The hotel received an award for its exceptional service and friendly staff at the tourism awards this year.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店今年因卓越的服務和親切的員工而獲獎。

sentences.en: Our furniture is made by hand and is known for its exceptional quality and long life.
sentences.zh: 我們的家具是手工製作的，以極佳的品質和耐用著稱。

sentences.en: In exceptional cases, the manager may allow employees to take more than two weeks of vacation.
sentences.zh: 在特殊情況下，經理可能允許員工休超過兩週的假。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee was promoted because of her exceptional work on the project in Japan last year.
sentences.zh: 李小姐因為去年在日本專案上的傑出表現而升職。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers exceptional food at reasonable prices, so it is always full on weekends.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳以合理的價格提供極佳的料理，所以週末總是客滿。

words.note: 語塊：exceptional service（卓越的服務）、exceptional quality（極佳的品質）、in exceptional cases（在特殊情況下）。exceptional 是「特別好的」或「例外的」；exception 是名詞「例外」。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed was promoted to senior manager after working at the company for eight years.
sentences.zh: Ahmed 小姐在公司工作八年後被升為資深經理。

sentences.en: New employees will be trained by senior staff who have many years of experience in the industry.
sentences.zh: 新員工將由經驗豐富的資深員工訓練。

sentences.en: The museum offers free admission to senior citizens on the first Sunday of every month.
sentences.zh: 博物館每月第一個週日對長者免費開放。

sentences.en: Senior staff members are expected to attend the planning meeting on Monday morning in the main hall.
sentences.zh: 資深員工應出席週一早上的規劃會議。

sentences.en: The bus company offers a discount to senior citizens who are over the age of sixty-five.
sentences.zh: 公車公司為六十五歲以上的長者提供優惠。

words.note: 語塊：senior manager（資深經理）、senior staff（資深員工）、senior citizen（長者）。senior 是「資深、較高階的」；junior 是「資淺的」；當名詞是「長者」或「（高中、大學）最高年級生」。

sentences.en: Several customers expressed dissatisfaction with the slow delivery service during the busy holiday season last year.
sentences.zh: 好幾位顧客對節慶期間緩慢的配送服務表達不滿。

sentences.en: The survey showed growing dissatisfaction with the long working hours among young employees in the sales department.
sentences.zh: 調查顯示年輕員工對長工時越來越不滿。

sentences.en: To reduce dissatisfaction among guests, the hotel renovated all of its bathrooms and bedrooms last year.
sentences.zh: 為了減少房客的不滿，飯店去年翻修了所有浴室。

sentences.en: Workers expressed dissatisfaction with the new schedule at the meeting with the factory manager last Friday.
sentences.zh: 工人在和廠長的會議上對新班表表達不滿。

sentences.en: Customer dissatisfaction with the old design led the company to create a completely new product.
sentences.zh: 顧客對舊設計的不滿讓公司打造了一款全新的產品。

words.note: 語塊：express dissatisfaction（表達不滿）、dissatisfaction with（對……不滿）。dissatisfaction 是名詞；dissatisfied 是形容詞「不滿意的」；satisfaction 是「滿意」。

sentences.en: The new restaurant is bound to be popular because it is located right next to the train station.
sentences.zh: 那家新餐廳一定會很受歡迎，因為就在火車站旁邊。

sentences.en: The train bound for Kaohsiung will leave from platform three in about fifteen minutes from now.
sentences.zh: 開往高雄的列車將在十五分鐘後從第三月台出發。

sentences.en: With so many people working on the project, there are bound to be a few small mistakes.
sentences.zh: 這麼多人參與專案，難免會有一些小錯誤。

sentences.en: Passengers bound for Tokyo should go to gate twelve, where boarding will begin at three o'clock.
sentences.zh: 前往東京的乘客請到十二號登機門，三點開始登機。

sentences.en: Prices are bound to rise if the cost of fuel continues to increase over the next few months.
sentences.zh: 如果燃料成本在接下來幾個月持續上漲，價格一定會上升。

words.note: 語塊：be bound to（一定會……）、bound for（開往……）。be bound to + 原形動詞 是「必然會」；bound for 是「開往某地」。

sentences.en: Please leave early, as you may get stuck in traffic on the highway during rush hour.
sentences.zh: 請早點出發，因為尖峰時段你可能會在公路上塞車。

sentences.en: If you get stuck on any part of the online form, please call our customer service team for help.
sentences.zh: 如果你在線上表單的任何部分卡住，請打給我們的客服團隊尋求協助。

sentences.en: Many travelers get stuck at the airport when flights are canceled because of bad weather.
sentences.zh: 班機因天氣不好取消時，很多旅客被困在機場。

sentences.en: The project may get stuck if we do not receive the necessary materials from the supplier soon.
sentences.zh: 如果我們沒有很快收到供應商的必要材料，專案可能會卡住。

sentences.en: Students who get stuck on a difficult question can ask the teacher for help after class.
sentences.zh: 遇到難題卡住的學生可以下課後請老師幫忙。

words.note: 語塊：get stuck in traffic（塞在車陣中）、get stuck on（卡在……）。get stuck 是「被困住、動彈不得」；stuck 是 stick 的過去分詞。

sentences.en: Customers can track an order on our website by entering the number in the confirmation email.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在我們網站上輸入確認信中的號碼來追蹤訂單。

sentences.en: The manager uses a simple spreadsheet to keep track of the progress of every project.
sentences.zh: 經理用一個簡單的試算表來掌握每個專案的進度。

sentences.en: The new app helps users track their spending and save more money for the future each month.
sentences.zh: 新 App 幫助使用者追蹤開支，每個月存錢。

sentences.en: Teachers track progress by giving students short tests at the end of each week in the semester.
sentences.zh: 老師在每週末給學生小考，追蹤他們的進度。

sentences.en: It is important to keep track of your receipts so that you can report your expenses correctly.
sentences.zh: 保存好收據很重要，這樣你才能正確申報開支。

words.note: 語塊：track an order（追蹤訂單）、keep track of（記錄；掌握）、track progress（追蹤進度）。track 當動詞是「追蹤」；keep track of 是「持續掌握」；當名詞是「軌道；跑道」。

sentences.en: Sales have increased significantly since the company started advertising on social media and television last spring.
sentences.zh: 自從公司開始在社群媒體打廣告以來，銷售大幅增加。

sentences.en: The new machines will significantly reduce the amount of time needed to produce each product.
sentences.zh: 新機器將顯著減少生產每項產品所需的時間。

sentences.en: The cost of living in the city is significantly higher than in the small towns nearby.
sentences.zh: 城市的生活成本比附近小鎮明顯高很多。

sentences.en: The results of the second survey were significantly different from those of the first one.
sentences.zh: 第二次調查的結果和第一次明顯不同。

sentences.en: Using public transportation can significantly reduce the amount of pollution in large and crowded cities.
sentences.zh: 使用大眾運輸可以顯著減少大城市的污染。

words.note: 語塊：significantly increase（大幅增加）、significantly reduce（顯著減少）、significantly different（明顯不同）。significantly 是「明顯地、大幅地」；significant 是形容詞「重要的；顯著的」。

sentences.en: The new menu is designed to appeal to young people who want healthy and affordable food.
sentences.zh: 新菜單是設計來吸引想吃健康又平價食物的年輕人。

sentences.en: The city will appeal to residents to save water during the long dry season this summer.
sentences.zh: 市政府將呼籲居民在今年夏天漫長的乾季節約用水。

sentences.en: The charity plans to appeal for donations to help families who lost their homes in the fire.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善團體計畫呼籲捐款，幫助在火災中失去家園的家庭。

sentences.en: The bright colors of the toys appeal to young children, so they sell very well in stores.
sentences.zh: 玩具鮮豔的顏色吸引幼童，所以在店裡賣得很好。

sentences.en: The company may appeal to the court if the judge's decision is not changed by next month.
sentences.zh: 如果法官的判決沒有改變，公司可能會向法院上訴。

words.note: 語塊：appeal to（吸引……；向……呼籲）、appeal for（呼籲……）。appeal to sb 是「吸引某人」；appealing 是形容詞「吸引人的」；當名詞是「吸引力；上訴」。

sentences.en: Please fill out a form at the front desk before your first appointment with the doctor.
sentences.zh: 第一次看診之前，請在櫃台填一張表。

sentences.en: All applicants must fill out an application and send it to the human resources department by Friday.
sentences.zh: 所有應徵者都必須填寫申請書，並在週五前寄到人資部。

sentences.en: It only takes about five minutes to fill out the online survey about our customer service.
sentences.zh: 填寫我們客服的線上問卷只要大約五分鐘。

sentences.en: Passengers must fill out a customs form before they arrive at the airport in Japan.
sentences.zh: 乘客抵達日本機場前必須填寫海關申報單。

sentences.en: If you need help to fill out the form, our staff will be happy to assist you.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要幫忙填表，我們的員工很樂意協助你。

words.note: 語塊：fill out a form（填表）、fill out an application（填申請書）。fill out 和 fill in 都可以表示「填寫」；fill up 是「裝滿」。

sentences.en: The company expects its online sales to double over the next two years because of the new app.
sentences.zh: 因為新 App，公司預期網路銷售在未來兩年會翻倍。

sentences.en: The number of tourists visiting the island could double in size after the new airport opens.
sentences.zh: 新機場啟用後，造訪那座島的遊客人數可能會翻倍。

sentences.en: Some hotels double the price of their rooms during the international music festival every summer.
sentences.zh: 有些飯店在每年夏天的國際音樂節期間把房價加倍。

sentences.en: The factory plans to double its production of electric bicycles to meet the growing demand.
sentences.zh: 工廠計畫把電動自行車的產量加倍，以滿足日益成長的需求。

sentences.en: If we hire two more designers, we can double the number of projects that we finish each month.
sentences.zh: 如果我們再聘兩位設計師，每個月完成的專案數量就能加倍。

words.note: 語塊：double in size（規模翻倍）、double the price（價格加倍）、double its production（產量加倍）、double the number of（數量加倍）。double 可以當動詞「加倍」、形容詞「雙倍的」或名詞；triple 是「三倍」。

sentences.en: Please send the signed contract to our office via email by the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 請在今天下班前用電子郵件把簽好的合約寄到我們辦公室。

sentences.en: The flight to London travels via Dubai, where passengers will change planes and wait for about two hours.
sentences.zh: 飛往倫敦的班機經由杜拜，乘客要在那裡轉機。

sentences.en: Customers can contact our support team via phone, email, or the chat function on our website.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以透過電話、電子郵件或我們網站上的聊天功能聯絡支援團隊。

sentences.en: The results of the survey will be shared with all employees via the company's internal website.
sentences.zh: 調查結果會透過公司內部網站分享給所有員工。

sentences.en: We will notify you via text message when your package has been delivered to your home.
sentences.zh: 你的包裹送達時，我們會透過簡訊通知你。

words.note: 語塊：via email（透過電子郵件）、travel via（經由……前往）。via 是「透過某方式」或「經過某地」；through、by way of 意思接近。

sentences.en: The government took several steps to stabilize prices after they rose very quickly last year.
sentences.zh: 去年物價快速上漲後，政府採取了幾項措施穩定物價。

sentences.en: The central bank raised interest rates in order to stabilize the economy and reduce inflation.
sentences.zh: 央行調高利率，以穩定經濟並降低通膨。

sentences.en: Doctors worked through the night to stabilize the patient after the serious car accident on the highway.
sentences.zh: 醫生通宵工作，在車禍後穩定病人的狀況。

sentences.en: Sales are expected to stabilize next quarter after falling for three months in a row.
sentences.zh: 在連續三個月下滑後，銷售預計下一季會穩定下來。

sentences.en: The company hopes the new strategy will stabilize its profits during the difficult economic period.
sentences.zh: 公司希望新策略能在經濟艱困時期穩定獲利。

words.note: 語塊：stabilize prices（穩定物價）、stabilize the economy（穩定經濟）。stabilize 是「讓……穩定下來」；stable 是形容詞「穩定的」；stability 是名詞。

sentences.en: The price of coffee beans rose sharply last month because of bad weather in South America.
sentences.zh: 因為南美天氣不好，咖啡豆的價格上個月急劇上漲。

sentences.en: Sales of winter clothing fell sharply when the weather became unusually warm in early December.
sentences.zh: 十二月天氣異常溫暖時，冬季服飾的銷售急劇下降。

sentences.en: The number of people shopping online has increased sharply over the past five years in most countries.
sentences.zh: 過去五年網路購物的人數急遽增加。

sentences.en: The company's share price fell sharply after it announced much lower profits than investors had expected.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布獲利低於預期後，股價急劇下跌。

sentences.en: Demand for electric cars is expected to increase sharply as more charging stations are built.
sentences.zh: 隨著更多充電站興建，電動車的需求預計會急遽增加。

words.note: 語塊：rise sharply（急劇上升）、fell sharply（大幅下跌）、increase sharply（急遽增加）。sharply 是「突然大幅地」；sharp 是形容詞「尖銳的；急劇的」。

sentences.en: A shortage of doctors in rural areas means that patients often have to travel far for treatment.
sentences.zh: 鄉村地區醫生短缺，意味著病人常常要長途跋涉去看病。

sentences.en: The restaurant had to close early on Sunday because of a staff shortage in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳週日因為廚房人手不足只好提早打烊。

sentences.en: The city asked residents to save water during the water shortage caused by the long dry summer.
sentences.zh: 漫長乾燥的夏天造成缺水期間，市政府要求居民節約用水。

sentences.en: A shortage of computer chips has delayed the production of cars and smartphones around the world.
sentences.zh: 電腦晶片短缺延誤了全世界汽車和手機的生產。

sentences.en: The company raised wages to deal with the staff shortage at its warehouses during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 公司調高薪資，以因應節慶期間倉庫的人手不足。

words.note: 語塊：a shortage of（……的短缺）、staff shortage（人手不足）、water shortage（缺水）。shortage 是「不夠」；shortfall 意思接近；surplus 是「過剩」。

sentences.en: Rising fuel costs have forced the airline to increase ticket prices on all of its international flights.
sentences.zh: 燃料成本上漲迫使航空公司調高所有國際航班的票價。

sentences.en: Many drivers are buying electric cars because fuel prices have increased so much this year.
sentences.zh: 很多駕駛在買電動車，因為今年油價漲了很多。

sentences.en: The new trucks have better fuel efficiency, which will help the company reduce its delivery costs.
sentences.zh: 新卡車的燃油效率更好，有助於公司降低配送成本。

sentences.en: The ship stopped at the port to take on fuel and supplies before continuing its journey to Asia.
sentences.zh: 那艘船停靠港口補充燃料和物資，再繼續前往亞洲。

sentences.en: Higher fuel prices usually lead to higher prices for food and other goods in supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 油價上漲通常會讓超市的食物和其他商品價格跟著上漲。

words.note: 語塊：fuel costs（燃料成本）、fuel prices（油價）、fuel efficiency（燃油效率）。fuel 是「燃料」，也可以當動詞「加燃料；刺激」；gas 在美式英文也指「汽油」。

sentences.en: Please contact the front desk if you need extra towels or have any problems with your room.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要額外的毛巾或房間有任何問題，請聯絡櫃台。

sentences.en: If you have any questions about your order, please contact us by email or phone at any time.
sentences.zh: 如果你對訂單有任何問題，請隨時用電子郵件或電話聯絡我們。

sentences.en: Applicants should include their contact information, such as an email address and a mobile phone number.
sentences.zh: 應徵者應附上聯絡資訊，例如電子信箱和電話號碼。

sentences.en: You can contact Ms. Lin directly at extension 210 if you need help with the new software.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要新軟體的協助，可以撥分機 210 直接聯絡林小姐。

sentences.en: The hotel will contact you one day before your arrival to confirm the time you will check in.
sentences.zh: 飯店會在你抵達前一天聯絡你，確認你入住的時間。

words.note: 語塊：contact sb directly（直接聯絡某人）、contact us（聯絡我們）、contact information（聯絡資訊）。contact 當動詞後面直接接人，不加 to／with（contact the manager）；contract 是「合約」。

sentences.en: Ms. Park is in charge of the marketing department and reports directly to the CEO.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐負責行銷部，並直接向執行長報告。

sentences.en: Please speak to the person in charge if you have a complaint about the service at the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 如果你對餐廳的服務有任何抱怨，請找負責人。

sentences.en: The director decided to put Mr. Lopez in charge of the new project because of his experience.
sentences.zh: 因為 Lopez 先生的經驗，總監決定讓他負責新專案。

sentences.en: Who will be in charge of the office while the manager is on vacation next week?
sentences.zh: 經理下週休假時，誰會負責辦公室？

sentences.en: The engineer in charge of the construction site checks the safety equipment carefully every morning.
sentences.zh: 負責工地的工程師每天早上都會檢查安全設備。

words.note: 語塊：be in charge of（負責……）、person in charge（負責人）、put sb in charge（讓某人負責）。be in charge of 是「負責管理」；responsible for 意思接近。

sentences.en: Each participant in the workshop will receive a certificate at the end of the three-day course.
sentences.zh: 每位工作坊學員在三天課程結束時都會拿到一張證書。

sentences.en: The survey was completed by more than five hundred participants from twenty different countries, and each participant answered thirty questions.
sentences.zh: 那份調查由來自二十個國家的五百多位參加者完成，每位參加者回答了三十個問題。

sentences.en: Every participant must register online and pay the fee before the conference begins next Monday.
sentences.zh: 每位與會者都必須在下週一研討會開始前在線上報名並繳費。

sentences.en: The trainer asked each participant to introduce himself or herself at the beginning of the session.
sentences.zh: 講師請每位學員在課程開始時自我介紹。

sentences.en: Lunch will be provided for every participant in the training program on both days of the course.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫的兩天都會為每位參加者提供午餐。

words.note: 語塊：workshop participant（工作坊學員）、each participant（每位參加者）。participant 是「參加的人」；participate 是動詞（participate in）；participation 是名詞。

sentences.en: Members of our loyalty program will receive an exclusive offer for the new product next week.
sentences.zh: 我們忠誠計畫的會員下週會收到新產品的獨家優惠。

sentences.en: The magazine published an exclusive interview with the famous designer about her new collection for the spring.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌刊登了一篇對那位知名設計師談新系列的獨家專訪。

sentences.en: This discount is exclusive to customers who shop on our website and cannot be used in stores.
sentences.zh: 這個折扣是網路購物顧客專屬的，不能在門市使用。

sentences.en: The hotel has an exclusive lounge for guests who stay in the suites on the top floor.
sentences.zh: 飯店有一間專為頂樓套房房客設置的專屬貴賓室。

sentences.en: The company signed an exclusive contract to sell its products only in one chain of supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 公司簽了一份獨家合約，只在一家連鎖超市販售產品。

words.note: 語塊：exclusive offer（獨家優惠）、exclusive interview（獨家專訪）、exclusive to（……專屬的）。exclusive 是「只給特定人的」；inclusive 是「包含在內的」；exclusively 是副詞。

sentences.en: Hotels in the city center are very expensive, so many tourists stay in the suburbs instead.
sentences.zh: 市中心的飯店非常貴，所以很多觀光客改住在郊區。

sentences.en: The new phone is too expensive for many students, so the company will release a cheaper model.
sentences.zh: 新手機對很多學生來說太貴了，所以公司會推出比較便宜的機型。

sentences.en: It is expensive to repair old machines, so the factory decided to buy new ones instead.
sentences.zh: 修理舊機器很花錢，所以工廠決定改買新的。

sentences.en: Rent in this neighborhood has become so expensive that many small shops have moved away.
sentences.zh: 這一帶的房租變得太貴，很多小店都搬走了。

sentences.en: The restaurant is expensive, but its food and service are excellent, so it is always full.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳很貴，但食物和服務都很好，所以總是客滿。

words.note: 語塊：too expensive（太貴）、expensive to（……很花錢）。expensive 是「價格高」；costly 意思接近；inexpensive 是「便宜的」。

sentences.en: Dr. Lee is an expert in renewable energy and has advised several governments in Asia.
sentences.zh: 李博士是再生能源方面的專家，曾為亞洲好幾個政府提供建議。

sentences.en: Before investing your money, it is a good idea to get expert advice from a financial advisor.
sentences.zh: 投資之前，最好向理財顧問尋求專家建議。

sentences.en: The conference will bring together industry experts, and each expert will give a short talk.
sentences.zh: 研討會將匯集業界專家，每位專家都會做簡短演講。

sentences.en: The company hired an expert in online marketing to help increase its sales to young customers.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位網路行銷專家，幫助提升對年輕顧客的銷售。

sentences.en: Several experts were interviewed for the report, and one expert said that prices would fall next year.
sentences.zh: 報告訪問了好幾位專家，其中一位專家說明年價格會下降。

words.note: 語塊：an expert in（……方面的專家）、expert advice（專家建議）、industry expert（業界專家）。expert 可以當名詞或形容詞「專業的」；expertise 是名詞「專業知識」。

sentences.en: A journalist from the local newspaper will interview the CEO about the company's plans next week.
sentences.zh: 地方報紙的一位記者下週會訪問執行長，談公司的計畫。

sentences.en: Ms. Park worked as a freelance journalist for ten years before she joined the magazine full-time.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐當了十年自由記者，之後全職加入那本雜誌。

sentences.en: The sports journalist has written several books about famous football players and their long careers in Europe.
sentences.zh: 那位體育記者寫過好幾本關於知名足球員和他們職涯的書。

sentences.en: Every journalist at the press conference was given a copy of the company's annual report.
sentences.zh: 記者會上每位記者都拿到一份公司年報。

sentences.en: The journalist spent three months researching the story before it was published online last week.
sentences.zh: 那位記者花了三個月研究這則報導，才在網路上發表。

words.note: 語塊：freelance journalist（自由記者）、sports journalist（體育記者）、a journalist from（來自……的記者）、every journalist（每位記者）。journalist 是「記者」；journal 是「期刊；日記」；reporter 意思接近。

sentences.en: Please complete a form at the front desk before you see the doctor for the first time.
sentences.zh: 第一次看醫生之前，請在櫃台填寫表格。

sentences.en: The team worked hard to complete the project before the end of the year as planned.
sentences.zh: 團隊努力在年底前完成專案。

sentences.en: Employees who complete the training course will receive a certificate from the company at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 修完訓練課程的員工會收到公司頒發的證書。

sentences.en: It took the workers two years to complete the new bridge over the river near the city center.
sentences.zh: 工人花了兩年才完成河上的新橋。

sentences.en: Customers who complete the online survey will receive a coupon for ten percent off their next purchase.
sentences.zh: 完成線上問卷的顧客下次購物可獲得九折優惠券。

words.note: 語塊：complete a form（填寫表格）、complete a project（完成專案）、complete a course（修完課程）。complete 可以當動詞「完成」或形容詞「完整的」；completion 是名詞。

sentences.en: Other scientists were not able to reproduce the results of the experiment in their laboratories.
sentences.zh: 其他科學家無法在自己的實驗室重現那個實驗的結果。

sentences.en: You may not reproduce any part of this book without written permission from the publisher.
sentences.zh: 未經出版社書面許可，不得複製本書任何部分。

sentences.en: The company uses special machines to reproduce famous paintings for its customers around the world.
sentences.zh: 那家公司用特殊機器為顧客複製名畫。

sentences.en: The chef tried to reproduce the taste of his grandmother's cooking in his new restaurant.
sentences.zh: 那位主廚試著在新餐廳重現他奶奶料理的味道。

sentences.en: Some fish reproduce only in clean water, so pollution has caused their numbers to fall.
sentences.zh: 有些魚只在乾淨的水中繁殖，所以污染讓牠們的數量減少了。

words.note: 語塊：reproduce the results（重現結果）、reproduce any part of（複製任何部分）、reproduce famous paintings（複製名畫）、reproduce the taste of（重現……的味道）。reproduce 是「再做出一樣的」；reproduction 是名詞「複製品；繁殖」。

sentences.en: The manager praised the report for its clarity and asked the writer to prepare the next one too.
sentences.zh: 經理稱讚那份報告寫得很清楚，請作者也準備下一份。

sentences.en: For clarity, all prices in the brochure are shown in US dollars and include tax.
sentences.zh: 為了清楚起見，小冊子裡的所有價格都以美元表示並含稅。

sentences.en: The new camera is known for the clarity of its pictures, even when they are taken at night.
sentences.zh: 新相機以照片的清晰度聞名，即使在晚上拍也一樣。

sentences.en: Several employees complained about the lack of clarity in the new vacation policy announced last week.
sentences.zh: 好幾位員工抱怨新的休假規定不夠清楚。

sentences.en: The speaker explained the plan with great clarity, so everyone in the audience understood it easily.
sentences.zh: 講者非常清楚地說明計畫，所以每位聽眾都很容易理解。

words.note: 語塊：for clarity（為了清楚起見）、clarity of（……的清晰度）、lack of clarity（不夠清楚）。clarity 是名詞；clear 是形容詞；clarify 是動詞「澄清」。

sentences.en: If you have not used your account for a year, you will need to reactivate it before you can log in.
sentences.zh: 如果你一年沒用帳號，登入前需要先重新啟用。

sentences.en: Customers can reactivate a card that has been blocked by calling the bank's customer service line.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以打銀行客服專線，重新啟用被鎖住的卡片。

sentences.en: To reactivate an account, please enter your email address and follow the instructions we send you.
sentences.zh: 要重新啟用帳號，請輸入你的電子信箱，並依照我們寄給你的說明操作。

sentences.en: The gym will reactivate your membership as soon as you pay the fee for the next six months.
sentences.zh: 你一繳交接下來六個月的費用，健身房就會恢復你的會員資格。

sentences.en: Employees who return from long leave must ask the IT department to reactivate their computer accounts.
sentences.zh: 長假回來的員工必須請資訊部重新啟用電腦帳號。

words.note: 語塊：reactivate an account（重新啟用帳號）、reactivate a card（重新開卡）。reactivate 是「讓停用的東西再次啟用」；activate 是「啟用」；deactivate 是「停用」。

sentences.en: Visitors can rent bicycles to explore the city and its many beautiful parks and museums.
sentences.zh: 遊客可以租腳踏車探索這座城市和它的許多公園和博物館。

sentences.en: The company is starting to explore options for opening a new factory in Southeast Asia next year.
sentences.zh: 公司開始研究在東南亞設廠的各種選擇。

sentences.en: The two firms met to explore the possibility of working together on a new project.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司見面探討合作新專案的可能性。

sentences.en: The new program allows students to explore different careers before they choose a university major.
sentences.zh: 新計畫讓學生在選大學科系前探索不同的職涯。

sentences.en: Before making a decision, we should explore the possibility of renting the equipment instead of buying it.
sentences.zh: 做決定之前，我們應該探討租用設備而不是購買的可能性。

words.note: 語塊：explore the city（探索城市）、explore options（研究各種選擇）、explore the possibility（探討可能性）。explore 是「探索、仔細研究」；explorer 是「探險家」；exploration 是名詞。

sentences.en: The supply of paper in the printer room is low, so please order more boxes before next week.
sentences.zh: 印表機室的紙張存量不多了，所以請在下週前多訂幾箱。

sentences.en: Fresh vegetables are in short supply this winter because of the unusually cold weather in the south.
sentences.zh: 因為天氣寒冷，今年冬天新鮮蔬菜供不應求。

sentences.en: Problems in the supply chain have delayed deliveries of many products to stores around the world.
sentences.zh: 供應鏈的問題延誤了很多產品送到世界各地商店。

sentences.en: The new pipe will provide a stable supply of water to the farms in the valley.
sentences.zh: 新水管將為山谷裡的農場提供穩定的水源供應。

sentences.en: The company keeps a large supply of spare parts so that machines can be repaired quickly.
sentences.zh: 公司備有大量的備用零件，讓機器能快速修好。

words.note: 語塊：a large supply of（大量的……）、a stable supply of（穩定的……供應）、in short supply（供不應求）、supply chain（供應鏈）。supply 可以當名詞或動詞「供應」；supplier 是「供應商」；demand 是「需求」。

sentences.en: The company announced an expansion plan that will create one thousand new jobs over five years.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布一項擴張計畫，將在五年內創造一千個新工作。

sentences.en: The rapid expansion of the city has caused serious traffic problems in many old neighborhoods downtown.
sentences.zh: 城市的快速擴張在很多社區造成交通問題。

sentences.en: The bank is preparing for its expansion into South America by hiring staff who speak Spanish.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行正在招聘會說西班牙文的員工，為拓展到南美做準備。

sentences.en: The expansion of the airport will allow it to handle twice as many passengers each year.
sentences.zh: 機場擴建後每年能處理兩倍的旅客。

sentences.en: Investors were excited about the expansion plan, and the company's share price rose quickly the next day.
sentences.zh: 投資人對擴張計畫很興奮，公司股價迅速上漲。

words.note: 語塊：expansion plan（擴張計畫）、rapid expansion（快速擴張）、expansion into（拓展到……）。expansion 是名詞；expand 是動詞「擴大」；expensive（昂貴的）長得像。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant will submit a resignation letter to her manager because she has accepted a job overseas.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐會向經理提出辭職信，因為她接受了一份海外工作。

sentences.en: The CEO announced his resignation at the end of the meeting, and it surprised many employees.
sentences.zh: 執行長在會議最後宣布辭職，讓很多員工很驚訝。

sentences.en: Please give your manager a letter of resignation at least one month before your last day of work.
sentences.zh: 請在最後上班日前至少一個月把辭職信交給經理。

sentences.en: The board decided to accept the resignation of the director, who will leave the company in June.
sentences.zh: 董事會決定接受那位總監的辭職，他將在六月離開公司。

sentences.en: After the resignation of the team leader, Mr. Kim was asked to manage the project until a new person is hired.
sentences.zh: 團隊領導辭職後，金先生被要求管理專案，直到聘到新人為止。

words.note: 語塊：submit a resignation（提出辭呈）、letter of resignation（辭職信）、accept a resignation（接受辭職）。resignation 是名詞；resign 是動詞「辭職」；注意 resign 的 g 不發音，resignation 的 g 要發音。

sentences.en: For an additional fee, we can expedite delivery so that your order arrives the next day.
sentences.zh: 只要另外付費，我們可以加速送貨，讓你的訂單隔天就到。

sentences.en: The new online system will expedite the process of approving loans for small and medium-sized businesses.
sentences.zh: 新的線上系統將加快核准小企業貸款的流程。

sentences.en: Please call the supplier and ask whether they can expedite the order of spare parts this week.
sentences.zh: 請打給供應商，問他們這週能不能加急備用零件的訂單。

sentences.en: To expedite the process, please send all of the required documents together in one email.
sentences.zh: 為了加快流程，請把所有必要文件用一封電子郵件一起寄出。

sentences.en: The government hired more staff to expedite the processing of visa applications before the summer.
sentences.zh: 政府增聘人手，在夏天前加快簽證申請的處理。

words.note: 語塊：expedite the process（加快流程）、expedite delivery（加速送貨）、expedite an order（加急訂單）。expedite 比 speed up 正式；expedition 是「探險；遠征」，意思不同。

sentences.en: You can return the item for a full refund provided that you still have the original receipt.
sentences.zh: 只要你還有原始收據，就可以退貨並全額退款。

sentences.en: Employees may work from home on Fridays provided that they finish all of their tasks on time.
sentences.zh: 只要員工準時完成所有工作，週五就可以在家工作。

sentences.en: The outdoor concert will take place on Saturday provided that the weather is good in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 只要天氣好，戶外音樂會將在週六舉行。

sentences.en: We will deliver the furniture next week provided that you pay the remaining balance by Friday.
sentences.zh: 只要你在週五前付清餘款，我們下週就會送家具過去。

sentences.en: Guests can check out late provided that they inform the front desk by nine o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 只要客人早上九點前通知櫃台，就可以延遲退房。

words.note: 語塊：provided that（只要……）。provided (that) 和 as long as、if 意思接近，比較正式。

sentences.en: The company will manufacture its new electric cars at a factory in the southern part of the country.
sentences.zh: 公司將在國內南部的一座工廠製造新的電動車。

sentences.en: Many companies manufacture goods in Asia because labor and materials are much less expensive there.
sentences.zh: 很多公司在亞洲製造商品，因為那裡的勞工和材料比較便宜。

sentences.en: It takes about three hours to manufacture each bicycle, including painting and testing in the factory.
sentences.zh: 製造每台腳踏車大約需要三小時，包括上漆和測試。

sentences.en: The factory plans to manufacture more face masks because demand has increased sharply this winter.
sentences.zh: 工廠計畫製造更多口罩，因為今年冬天需求急劇增加。

sentences.en: Our furniture is designed in Italy, but we manufacture it in a factory near the port to save on shipping.
sentences.zh: 我們的家具在義大利設計，但為了節省運費，在港口附近的工廠製造。

words.note: 語塊：manufacture goods（製造商品）、be manufactured in（在……製造）。manufacture 是「大量生產」；manufacturer 是「製造商」；manufacturing 是「製造業」。

sentences.en: Sales of electric bicycles have increased sharply over the past year in most large cities.
sentences.zh: 過去一年，大部分大城市的電動自行車銷售急劇增加。

sentences.en: In the past, most people bought their groceries in small shops near their homes every day.
sentences.zh: 過去，大部分人每天在家附近的小店買雜貨。

sentences.en: Based on past experience, we expect the store to be very busy during the first week of the sale.
sentences.zh: 根據過去的經驗，我們預期特賣第一週店裡會非常忙。

sentences.en: The company has opened twenty new stores over the past five years, mostly in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 公司過去五年開了二十家新店，大部分在東南亞。

sentences.en: Our past experience with this supplier has been positive, so we will sign another contract with them.
sentences.zh: 我們過去和這家供應商的合作經驗很好，所以會再和他們簽一份合約。

words.note: 語塊：over the past year（過去一年）、in the past（過去）、past experience（過去的經驗）。past 可以是形容詞、名詞或介系詞（walk past 經過）；passed 是 pass 的過去式。

sentences.en: To our disappointment, the concert was canceled because the singer became ill on the morning of the show.
sentences.zh: 令我們失望的是，演唱會因為歌手生病而取消了。

sentences.en: Several customers expressed disappointment with the new design of the website, which is hard to use.
sentences.zh: 好幾位顧客對難用的新網站設計表達失望。

sentences.en: The low sales of the new phone were a big disappointment for the company and its investors.
sentences.zh: 新手機的低銷量讓公司和投資人非常失望。

sentences.en: The manager expressed disappointment that the project was not finished before the deadline in the contract.
sentences.zh: 經理對專案沒有在截止日前完成表達失望。

sentences.en: To the disappointment of many fans, the team lost the final game by only one point.
sentences.zh: 令很多球迷失望的是，球隊在決賽中只差一分落敗。

words.note: 語塊：to one's disappointment（令某人失望的是）、express disappointment（表達失望）、a big disappointment（很大的失望）。disappointment 是名詞；disappoint 是動詞；disappointed 是「感到失望的」。

sentences.en: The company's sales reached a record high last year because of strong demand in Asia.
sentences.zh: 因為亞洲需求強勁，公司去年的銷售創下歷史新高。

sentences.en: Please keep a record of all of your expenses during the business trip so that you can be paid back.
sentences.zh: 出差期間請記錄所有開支，這樣才能拿回墊付的錢。

sentences.en: The runner was able to break a record that had lasted for more than twenty years.
sentences.zh: 那位跑者打破了一項維持二十多年的紀錄。

sentences.en: Temperatures reached a record high this summer, and many people stayed inside during the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天氣溫創下歷史新高，很多人下午都待在室內。

sentences.en: The doctor will check your medical record before deciding which treatment is best for you.
sentences.zh: 醫生會先檢查你的病歷，再決定哪種治療最適合你。

words.note: 語塊：break a record（打破紀錄）、keep a record of（記錄……）、record high（歷史新高）。record 當名詞（REC-ord）是「紀錄」；當動詞（re-CORD）是「記錄；錄音」。

sentences.en: The supplier may refuse to lower its prices, so we should look for other companies as well.
sentences.zh: 供應商可能會拒絕降價，所以我們也應該找找其他公司。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee decided to refuse the offer from the bank because she wanted to stay in her hometown.
sentences.zh: 李小姐決定拒絕那家銀行的邀約，因為她想留在家鄉。

sentences.en: The store has the right to refuse service to customers who do not follow the rules.
sentences.zh: 店家有權拒絕為不守規定的顧客服務。

sentences.en: Some workers refuse to work on Sundays because they want to spend time with their families.
sentences.zh: 有些工人拒絕週日上班，因為想陪家人。

sentences.en: The landlord did not refuse the request to keep a small dog in the apartment.
sentences.zh: 房東沒有拒絕在公寓裡養小狗的請求。

words.note: 語塊：refuse to（拒絕做……）、refuse an offer（拒絕提議）。refuse to + 原形動詞；refusal 是名詞；reject、decline 意思接近。

sentences.en: The company offers in-house training for new employees so that they can learn the software quickly.
sentences.zh: 公司為新員工提供內部訓練，讓他們能很快學會軟體。

sentences.en: Instead of hiring an outside agency, we asked our in-house designer to create the new logo.
sentences.zh: 我們沒有請外面的公司，而是請公司內部的設計師設計新商標。

sentences.en: Our in-house team of engineers can repair most machines quickly without help from outside companies.
sentences.zh: 我們的內部工程師團隊不需要外部公司幫忙，就能修好大部分機器。

sentences.en: The hotel has an in-house restaurant that serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner to guests every day.
sentences.zh: 飯店有一家館內餐廳，每天供應早餐、午餐和晚餐。

sentences.en: In-house training is usually cheaper than sending employees to courses at other locations or abroad.
sentences.zh: 內部訓練通常比送員工到其他地方上課便宜。

words.note: 語塊：in-house training（內部訓練）、in-house designer（公司內部設計師）、in-house team（內部團隊）。in-house 是「公司自己內部的（不外包）」；outsource 是「外包」。

sentences.en: Many customers are willing to pay more for products that are made in an environmentally friendly way.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客願意為環保方式製造的產品多付錢。

sentences.en: Applicants must be willing to travel abroad several times a year for business meetings with clients.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須願意一年出國好幾次參加商務會議。

sentences.en: The supplier is willing to lower its prices if we agree to sign a three-year contract.
sentences.zh: 如果我們同意簽三年合約，供應商願意降價。

sentences.en: Are you willing to work on weekends during the busy holiday season at the end of next month?
sentences.zh: 你願意在下個月忙碌的節慶期間週末上班嗎？

sentences.en: The landlord is willing to repair the kitchen before the new tenants move in next week.
sentences.zh: 房東願意在新房客下週搬進來之前修好廚房。

words.note: 語塊：be willing to（願意做……）。be willing to + 原形動詞；willingness 是名詞「意願」；unwilling 是「不願意的」。

sentences.en: The teacher gave the students supplementary materials to help them prepare for the final exam.
sentences.zh: 老師給學生補充資料，幫助他們準備期末考。

sentences.en: Please read the supplementary information on our website before you fill out the online application form.
sentences.zh: 填寫申請表之前，請先閱讀我們網站上的補充資訊。

sentences.en: The book comes with supplementary materials, including videos and practice tests that you can use online.
sentences.zh: 那本書附有補充資料，包括網路上的影片和練習測驗。

sentences.en: The report includes supplementary information about the cost of each part of the construction project.
sentences.zh: 報告包含專案每個部分成本的補充資訊。

sentences.en: Supplementary lessons are offered on Saturday mornings for students who need extra help with math and science.
sentences.zh: 週六早上為需要額外幫助的學生開設補充課程。

words.note: 語塊：supplementary materials（補充資料）、supplementary information（補充資訊）。supplementary 和 supplemental 意思相同；supplement 是名詞「補充品」。

sentences.en: The company will form a committee to plan the celebration of its fiftieth anniversary next year.
sentences.zh: 公司將成立一個委員會，籌劃明年的五十週年慶。

sentences.en: Each committee member must read the proposal carefully before the important meeting on Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 每位委員都必須在週四下午開會前仔細閱讀提案。

sentences.en: The planning committee has chosen a hotel near the beach for the annual conference in September.
sentences.zh: 籌備委員會為九月的年度研討會選了一家海邊的飯店。

sentences.en: The committee will review all of the applications and choose three candidates for the final interview.
sentences.zh: 委員會將審查所有申請，選出三位候選人參加最後面試。

sentences.en: Ms. Park was elected as the head of the committee because of her experience in organizing events.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐因為有籌辦活動的經驗而被選為委員會主席。

words.note: 語塊：form a committee（成立委員會）、committee member（委員）、planning committee（籌備委員會）。committee 是「委員會」；注意拼法雙 m、雙 t、雙 e；commitment 是「承諾」。

sentences.en: The government will allocate funds to build new schools in rural areas over the next five years.
sentences.zh: 政府將在未來五年撥款在鄉村地區興建新學校。

sentences.en: Managers must allocate resources carefully so that every project has enough staff, time, and money.
sentences.zh: 經理必須仔細分配資源，讓每個專案都有足夠的人力和資金。

sentences.en: Please allocate time in your schedule next week for a short meeting with the new clients.
sentences.zh: 請在下週的行程中撥出時間，和新客戶開個簡短的會。

sentences.en: The company decided to allocate more of its budget to online advertising and social media this year.
sentences.zh: 公司決定今年把更多預算撥給網路廣告。

sentences.en: The city council will allocate funds for repairing the old roads in the northern district.
sentences.zh: 市議會將撥款修繕北區的老舊道路。

words.note: 語塊：allocate funds（撥款）、allocate resources（分配資源）、allocate time（分配時間）。allocate 是「把資源分給特定用途」；allocation 是名詞；assign 意思接近。

sentences.en: The team will prepare a report on the results of the survey and present it next Monday.
sentences.zh: 團隊會準備一份調查結果的報告，下週一報告。

sentences.en: Stores are hiring extra staff to prepare for the busy holiday season in December and January.
sentences.zh: 商店正在增聘人手，準備十二月忙碌的節慶季。

sentences.en: Please prepare a short presentation about your project for the team meeting on Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 請為週五早上的會議準備一份關於你專案的簡短簡報。

sentences.en: The chef arrives at the restaurant at six o'clock every morning to prepare the food for lunch.
sentences.zh: 主廚每天早上六點到餐廳準備午餐的食物。

sentences.en: Students should start to prepare for the final exam at least one month before the test date.
sentences.zh: 學生應該至少在考試日期前一個月開始準備期末考。

words.note: 語塊：prepare for（為……做準備）、prepare a report（準備報告）、be prepared to（準備好……）。prepare for + 事件；prepare + 東西；be prepared to do 是「願意、準備好做」。

sentences.en: Please visit our website for detailed information about the prices and schedules of our tours.
sentences.zh: 請上我們網站查看行程價格和時間的詳細資訊。

sentences.en: The manager asked for a detailed report on the costs of the project before the board meeting.
sentences.zh: 經理要求在董事會之前提交一份專案成本的詳細報告。

sentences.en: The box includes detailed instructions that explain how to put the furniture together in ten easy steps.
sentences.zh: 盒子裡附有詳細說明，解釋如何組裝家具。

sentences.en: The architect showed the client a detailed plan of the new building, including every room.
sentences.zh: 建築師給客戶看新大樓的詳細規劃，包括每一個房間。

sentences.en: A detailed report about the accident will be sent to all employees by the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 一份關於事故的詳細報告會在週末前寄給所有員工。

words.note: 語塊：detailed information（詳細資訊）、detailed report（詳細報告）、detailed instructions（詳細說明）。detailed 是「很詳細的」；detail 是名詞「細節」；brief 是「簡短的」。

sentences.en: Before signing the contract, it is a good idea to consult a lawyer who understands the industry.
sentences.zh: 簽合約之前，最好諮詢一位了解這個產業的律師。

sentences.en: The company decided to hire a lawyer to help with the dispute over the land near the river.
sentences.zh: 公司決定請律師處理河邊土地的糾紛。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed works as a corporate lawyer and helps large companies with mergers and contracts.
sentences.zh: Ahmed 小姐是一位企業律師，協助公司處理合併和合約。

sentences.en: The lawyer explained each part of the agreement to the clients before they signed it.
sentences.zh: 律師在客戶簽約前向他們說明協議的每一部分。

sentences.en: If you have questions about the new law, you should consult a lawyer as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 如果你對新法律有疑問，應該盡快諮詢律師。

words.note: 語塊：hire a lawyer（請律師）、consult a lawyer（諮詢律師）、corporate lawyer（企業律師）。lawyer 是「律師」；attorney 是美式說法；legal 是形容詞「法律的」。

sentences.en: Please contact the legal department before you sign any contract with a new supplier or client.
sentences.zh: 和新供應商簽任何合約之前，請先聯絡法務部。

sentences.en: Small businesses can receive free legal advice from the city's business center every Tuesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 小企業每週二可以在市政府的商業中心獲得免費法律建議。

sentences.en: Wearing a seat belt is a legal requirement for all passengers in the car, including those in the back.
sentences.zh: 車上所有乘客繫安全帶是法律規定，包括後座乘客。

sentences.en: The company hired an outside firm to provide legal advice about the merger with its competitor.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一家外部事務所，就和競爭對手合併一事提供法律建議。

sentences.en: Before you open a restaurant, make sure you understand every legal requirement for food safety.
sentences.zh: 開餐廳之前，要確認你了解食品安全的每一項法律規定。

words.note: 語塊：legal advice（法律建議）、legal department（法務部）、legal requirement（法律規定）。legal 是「和法律有關的、合法的」；illegal 是「違法的」；legally 是副詞。

sentences.en: Please remind the staff to turn off the lights and lock the doors before they leave the office.
sentences.zh: 請提醒員工離開辦公室前關燈鎖門。

sentences.en: The old photos in the hotel lobby remind guests of what the city looked like one hundred years ago.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳的老照片讓客人想起這座城市一百年前的樣子。

sentences.en: I would like to remind everyone that the meeting has been moved to Thursday at ten o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我想提醒大家，會議改到週四十點了。

sentences.en: The app will remind users to take a break after they have been working for two hours.
sentences.zh: 這個 App 會在使用者工作兩小時後提醒他們休息。

sentences.en: The manager sent an email to remind employees that they must submit their reports by Friday.
sentences.zh: 經理寄電子郵件提醒員工必須在週五前交報告。

words.note: 語塊：remind sb to（提醒某人做……）、remind sb of（讓某人想起）、remind sb that（提醒某人……）。remind sb to do 是「提醒某人去做」；remind sb of sth 是「讓某人想起某事」；reminder 是名詞。

sentences.en: The new manager is determined to make the store the most successful in the region.
sentences.zh: 新經理決心要讓那家店成為地區最成功的門市。

sentences.en: Thanks to a determined effort by the whole team, the project was finished two weeks early.
sentences.zh: 多虧全體團隊堅決的努力，專案提前兩週完成。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz was determined to pass the accounting exam, so she studied every evening for six months.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐決心要通過會計考試，所以六個月來每天晚上都在讀書。

sentences.en: The city is determined to reduce air pollution by encouraging people to ride bicycles to work.
sentences.zh: 市政府決心藉由鼓勵民眾騎腳踏車上班來減少空氣污染。

sentences.en: The company made a determined effort to improve customer service after receiving many complaints last year.
sentences.zh: 公司接到很多投訴後，下定決心努力改善客服。

words.note: 語塊：be determined to（決心……）、a determined effort（堅決的努力）。determined 是「意志堅定的」；determine 是動詞「決定」；determination 是名詞「決心」。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim was asked to organize an event to celebrate the opening of the new office in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 金小姐被要求籌辦一場慶祝首爾新辦公室開幕的活動。

sentences.en: Could you organize a meeting with the clients for next Tuesday afternoon at their office?
sentences.zh: 你可以安排下週二下午在客戶辦公室和他們開會嗎？

sentences.en: The volunteers will organize the donated books by subject before they are given to the library.
sentences.zh: 志工會在把捐贈的書送到圖書館前，先按主題整理好。

sentences.en: It takes a lot of planning to organize a conference where all of the sessions start and end on time.
sentences.zh: 要籌辦一場所有場次都準時開始和結束的研討會，需要很多規劃。

sentences.en: The company hired a professional to organize the annual dinner for more than five hundred guests.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請專業人士籌辦有五百多位賓客的年度晚宴。

words.note: 語塊：organize an event（籌辦活動）、organize a meeting（安排會議）、organize a conference（籌辦研討會）。organize 是「安排、籌劃」；organization 是名詞「組織」；organizer 是「主辦人」。

sentences.en: Many employees admire the CEO for her honesty and her ability to make difficult decisions.
sentences.zh: 很多員工欽佩執行長的誠實和她做艱難決定的能力。

sentences.en: Visitors can admire the view of the mountains from the restaurant on the top floor of the hotel.
sentences.zh: 遊客可以從飯店頂樓的餐廳欣賞山景。

sentences.en: I really admire the way you handled the angry customer during the busy lunch hour today.
sentences.zh: 我真的很佩服你今天在忙碌的午餐時間處理那位生氣顧客的方式。

sentences.en: Tourists stop on the bridge to admire the old buildings along the river, especially at night.
sentences.zh: 遊客停在橋上欣賞河邊的老建築，尤其是晚上。

sentences.en: The young designers admire the famous architect for her creative use of natural light and wood.
sentences.zh: 年輕設計師欽佩那位知名建築師對自然光和木材富有創意的運用。

words.note: 語塊：admire sb for（因……欽佩某人）、admire the view（欣賞風景）。admire 是「很佩服、很欣賞」；admiration 是名詞；admirable 是「令人欽佩的」。

sentences.en: Ms. Park studied linguistics at university and now works as a translator for an international company.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐大學讀語言學，現在在一家國際公司擔任翻譯。

sentences.en: The professor of applied linguistics will give a talk on how children learn a second language.
sentences.zh: 應用語言學教授將演講談孩子如何學習第二語言。

sentences.en: Students who study linguistics learn about the history and structure of many different languages around the world.
sentences.zh: 讀語言學的學生學習很多不同語言的歷史和結構。

sentences.en: Her background in linguistics helped her design an app that teaches English to young learners.
sentences.zh: 她的語言學背景幫助她設計了一款教小朋友英文的 App。

sentences.en: The university offers a master's degree in applied linguistics for people who want to teach languages.
sentences.zh: 那所大學為想教語言的人開設應用語言學碩士學位。

words.note: 語塊：study linguistics（研讀語言學）、applied linguistics（應用語言學）。linguistics 是學科名稱，結尾有 s 但當單數用；linguist 是「語言學家；通曉多種語言的人」。

sentences.en: I inadvertently deleted the file, but the IT department was able to restore it from the backup.
sentences.zh: 我不小心刪了檔案，但資訊部從備份中救了回來。

sentences.en: The assistant inadvertently sent the email to the wrong client, so she called him to apologize.
sentences.zh: 助理不小心把郵件寄錯客戶，所以打電話向他道歉。

sentences.en: The company inadvertently printed the wrong price on the brochure and had to correct it later.
sentences.zh: 公司不小心在小冊子上印錯價格，後來只好更正。

sentences.en: If you inadvertently share confidential information with others, please report it to your manager immediately.
sentences.zh: 如果你無意中把機密資訊分享給別人，請立刻向你的經理報告。

sentences.en: The driver inadvertently left the package at the wrong address, but it was found the next day.
sentences.zh: 司機不小心把包裹放錯地址，但隔天就找到了。

words.note: 語塊：inadvertently deleted（不小心刪除了）、inadvertently sent（誤寄了）、inadvertently printed（不小心印了）、inadvertently left（不小心留在）。inadvertently 是「不是故意的」；accidentally 意思接近；intentionally 是相反詞。

sentences.en: The tour may be canceled depending on the weather, so please check our website on the morning of the trip.
sentences.zh: 行程可能視天氣取消，所以請在出發當天早上查看我們網站。

sentences.en: The price of shipping will change depending on the size and weight of your package.
sentences.zh: 運費會依包裹的大小和重量而有所不同。

sentences.en: Depending on the number of guests, the dinner will be held in the small room or the main hall.
sentences.zh: 視客人數量而定，晚宴會在小廳或大廳舉行。

sentences.en: Salaries for the position will range from forty to fifty thousand dollars depending on experience.
sentences.zh: 這個職位的薪水視經驗而定，介於四萬到五萬美元之間。

sentences.en: The trip from the airport takes between thirty and sixty minutes depending on the traffic.
sentences.zh: 從機場出發的車程視交通狀況需要三十到六十分鐘。

words.note: 語塊：depending on the weather（視天氣而定）、depending on the size（依大小而定）、depending on experience（視經驗而定）、depending on the traffic（視交通狀況而定）、depending on the number of（視……的數量而定）。depending on 後面接名詞，意思是「根據……而不同」；depend on 是動詞片語。

sentences.en: The foreman checks the work of every builder on the construction site before the end of each day.
