sentences.zh: 領班每天收工前都會檢查工地每位工人的工作。

sentences.en: Mr. Diaz worked as a construction foreman for ten years before he started his own building company.
sentences.zh: Diaz 先生當了十年工地領班，之後自己開了營造公司。

sentences.en: The factory foreman is responsible for making sure that workers follow all of the safety rules.
sentences.zh: 工廠領班負責確保工人遵守所有安全規定。

sentences.en: If you have any questions about the job, please speak to the foreman at the entrance of the site.
sentences.zh: 如果你對工作有任何問題，請找工地入口的領班。

sentences.en: The foreman told the workers to stop working because heavy rain was expected in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 因為下午預計會下大雨，領班要工人停工。

words.note: 語塊：construction foreman（工地領班）、factory foreman（工廠領班）。foreman 是「帶領工人的領班」；supervisor 意思接近；也可說 forewoman 或 supervisor。

sentences.en: The bridge is made of steel and concrete, so it can carry heavy trucks and buses safely.
sentences.zh: 那座橋是用鋼和混凝土建造的，所以可以安全承載重型卡車。

sentences.en: The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances that are easy to clean and very durable.
sentences.zh: 廚房配備容易清潔的不鏽鋼家電。

sentences.en: The steel industry was once the largest employer in the city, but many factories have closed.
sentences.zh: 鋼鐵業曾經是城裡最大的雇主，但很多工廠已經關閉了。

sentences.en: Rising prices for steel have increased the cost of building new apartments and offices in the city.
sentences.zh: 鋼材價格上漲，增加了興建新公寓和辦公室的成本。

sentences.en: Steel production in the region has fallen because of lower demand from car manufacturers in Asia.
sentences.zh: 因為汽車製造商的需求降低，該地區的鋼鐵生產下滑。

words.note: 語塊：steel industry（鋼鐵業）、stainless steel（不鏽鋼）、steel production（鋼鐵生產）。steel 是「鋼」；steal（偷）發音一樣，意思完全不同。

sentences.en: The manager was willing to admit a mistake and apologized to the team for the confusion.
sentences.zh: 經理願意承認錯誤，並為造成的混亂向團隊道歉。

sentences.en: The company had to admit that the new product was not as popular as it had hoped.
sentences.zh: 公司不得不承認新產品沒有它期望的那麼受歡迎。

sentences.en: The museum will admit children under twelve for free on weekends during the long summer holiday.
sentences.zh: 博物館暑假週末讓十二歲以下兒童免費入場。

sentences.en: The staff will admit only people with a ticket to the concert hall, so please bring yours with you.
sentences.zh: 工作人員只讓持票的人進入音樂廳，所以請帶著你的票。

sentences.en: It is important to admit a mistake quickly so that the problem can be fixed before it gets worse.
sentences.zh: 快速承認錯誤很重要，這樣問題才能在惡化前被解決。

words.note: 語塊：admit a mistake（承認錯誤）、admit that（承認……）、be admitted to（被准許進入）。admit 有「承認」和「讓進入」兩個意思；admission 是名詞「入場；承認」。

sentences.en: The company plans to focus on online sales and close some of its physical stores next year.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫專注於網路銷售，明年關閉部分實體店。

sentences.en: Our restaurant will focus on quality rather than quantity, so the menu will have fewer dishes.
sentences.zh: 我們餐廳會注重品質而不是數量，所以菜單上的菜會比較少。

sentences.en: Please turn off your phone during the meeting so that everyone can focus on the discussion.
sentences.zh: 開會時請關掉手機，讓大家能專注於討論。

sentences.en: The new manager wants the team to focus on customers and respond to their emails more quickly.
sentences.zh: 新經理希望團隊以顧客為重，更快回覆他們的郵件。

sentences.en: The workshop will focus on simple ways to reduce stress and improve productivity at work.
sentences.zh: 工作坊將聚焦在減輕壓力、提升工作效率的簡單方法。

words.note: 語塊：focus on customers（以顧客為重）、focus on quality（注重品質）、focus on the discussion（專注於討論）、focus on simple ways（聚焦在簡單的方法）。focus on 是「把注意力集中在……」；concentrate on 意思接近。

sentences.en: Customers want to buy from a trustworthy company that keeps its promises and protects their data.
sentences.zh: 顧客想向信守承諾又保護資料、值得信賴的公司購買。

sentences.en: Please make sure that the information in your report comes from a trustworthy source such as a government website.
sentences.zh: 請確認你報告中的資訊來自可信的來源。

sentences.en: We are looking for a trustworthy person who can manage the store when the owner is away.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位老闆不在時能管理店面、值得信賴的人。

sentences.en: The bank has a reputation for being trustworthy, so many families keep their savings there.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行以值得信賴著稱，所以很多家庭把存款放在那裡。

sentences.en: Online reviews are not always trustworthy, so it is a good idea to ask friends for advice too.
sentences.zh: 網路評論不一定可信，所以也問問朋友的建議是個好主意。

words.note: 語塊：trustworthy source（可信的來源）、trustworthy person（可靠的人）、trustworthy company（值得信賴的公司）、be trustworthy（值得信任）。trustworthy 是「可以信任的」；reliable 意思接近；trust 是名詞或動詞「信任」。

sentences.en: The hotel has several meeting rooms that are often used for corporate events and conferences.
sentences.zh: 飯店有好幾間常用來辦公司活動和研討會的會議室。

sentences.en: Many young workers say that a friendly corporate culture is more important than a high salary.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕員工說友善的企業文化比高薪更重要。

sentences.en: Please send your application to our corporate office in New York rather than to a local store.
sentences.zh: 請把申請寄到我們紐約的公司總部，而不是當地門市。

sentences.en: The new CEO wants to change the corporate culture so that employees feel free to share ideas.
sentences.zh: 新執行長想改變企業文化，讓員工能自在地分享想法。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers special menus for corporate events, such as holiday parties and business lunches.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳為公司活動提供特別菜單，例如節慶派對和商務午餐。

words.note: 語塊：corporate office（公司總部）、corporate culture（企業文化）、corporate event（公司活動）。corporate 是「公司的」；corporation 是名詞「公司」；cooperate 是「合作」。

sentences.en: Delivery is free of charge for all orders over fifty dollars placed on our website.
sentences.zh: 在我們網站上下單超過五十美元，送貨就免費。

sentences.en: A service charge of ten percent will be added to your bill at the end of your meal.
sentences.zh: 用餐結束時，帳單會另加一成服務費。

sentences.en: There is an extra charge for guests who want to check out of the hotel after noon.
sentences.zh: 想在中午之後退房的客人要額外付費。

sentences.en: The museum offers guided tours free of charge every Saturday and Sunday morning at ten o'clock.
sentences.zh: 博物館每週六和週日早上提供免費導覽。

sentences.en: Customers who choose same-day delivery must pay an extra charge of fifteen dollars per order.
sentences.zh: 選擇當日到貨的顧客必須額外支付十五美元。

words.note: 語塊：free of charge（免費）、service charge（服務費）、extra charge（額外費用）。charge 可以當名詞「費用」或動詞「收費；充電」；in charge of 是「負責」。

sentences.en: Drivers must follow the speed limit near the school, especially when children are arriving in the morning.
sentences.zh: 駕駛在學校附近必須遵守速限，尤其是早上孩子到校的時候。

sentences.en: Each speaker has a time limit of fifteen minutes, so please prepare a short presentation.
sentences.zh: 每位講者有十五分鐘的時間限制，所以請準備簡短的簡報。

sentences.en: The store has placed a limit on the number of items that each customer can buy during the sale.
sentences.zh: 那家店對特賣期間每位顧客能買的商品數量設了上限。

sentences.en: There is no limit to the number of times you can use the free shuttle bus during your stay.
sentences.zh: 住宿期間你搭免費接駁車的次數沒有限制。

sentences.en: The new law sets a limit on how much rent landlords can increase each year.
sentences.zh: 新法律對房東每年能調漲多少房租設了上限。

words.note: 語塊：speed limit（速限）、time limit（時間限制）、a limit on（對……的限制）。limit 可以當名詞或動詞「限制」；limited 是形容詞「有限的」；limitation 是名詞「限制」。

sentences.en: When it comes to customer service, our company is one of the best in the industry.
sentences.zh: 說到客服，我們公司是業界最好的之一。

sentences.en: Ms. Park is very careful when it comes to checking the figures in financial reports.
sentences.zh: 說到檢查財報中的數字，朴小姐非常仔細。

sentences.en: When it comes to choosing a hotel, most travelers care about the location, the price, and the reviews.
sentences.zh: 說到選飯店，大部分旅客在意的是地點和價格。

sentences.en: The manager has a lot of experience when it comes to dealing with difficult clients.
sentences.zh: 說到應付難搞的客戶，那位經理經驗豐富。

sentences.en: When it comes to saving money, buying in bulk is one of the easiest things that families can do.
sentences.zh: 說到省錢，大量購買是家庭最容易做到的事之一。

words.note: 語塊：when it comes to + 名詞／V-ing（說到……）。when it comes to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing；in terms of 意思接近。

sentences.en: Working as a nurse is a demanding job that requires long hours and a lot of patience.
sentences.zh: 當護士是一份吃重的工作，需要長時間工作和很大的耐心。

sentences.en: The hotel staff are trained to deal with demanding customers in a calm and polite way.
sentences.zh: 飯店員工受過訓練，以冷靜禮貌的方式應對要求高的顧客。

sentences.en: Construction work is physically demanding, so workers take frequent short breaks during hot summer weather.
sentences.zh: 營造工作體力負擔大，所以天熱時工人會經常休息。

sentences.en: The new position is more demanding than her old one, but it also comes with a higher salary.
sentences.zh: 新職位比她以前的工作更吃重，但薪水也比較高。

sentences.en: Some clients are very demanding and expect replies to their emails within a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 有些客戶要求很高，期待電子郵件幾分鐘內就得到回覆。

words.note: 語塊：demanding job（吃重的工作）、demanding customer（要求高的顧客）、physically demanding（體力負擔大）。demanding 是「需要很多時間、精力」或「要求很多的」；demand 是動詞或名詞「需求；要求」。

sentences.en: The weather will be mostly sunny this weekend, with occasional rain in the late afternoon.
sentences.zh: 這個週末天氣大致晴朗，下午偶有陣雨。

sentences.en: Passengers should expect occasional delays on the train line while the tracks are being repaired.
sentences.zh: 鐵軌維修期間，乘客應預期列車偶爾會有延誤。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee works mostly from home but comes to the office on an occasional basis for meetings.
sentences.zh: 李小姐大部分在家工作，但偶爾會到辦公室開會。

sentences.en: The job requires occasional travel to Japan and Korea, so applicants should have a valid passport.
sentences.zh: 這份工作偶爾需要到日本和韓國出差，所以應徵者應持有有效護照。

sentences.en: Apart from an occasional complaint about the noise, customers have been happy with the new café.
sentences.zh: 除了偶爾有人抱怨噪音之外，顧客對新咖啡廳都很滿意。

words.note: 語塊：occasional delays（偶爾的延誤）、occasional rain（偶有陣雨）、on an occasional basis（偶爾地）。occasional 是「偶爾發生的」；occasionally 是副詞「偶爾」；frequent 是「頻繁的」。

sentences.en: The newly appointed director will begin her work at the company on the first of next month.
sentences.zh: 新任總監將在下個月一號開始在公司工作。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim was appointed as head of the marketing department after the previous manager retired.
sentences.zh: 前任經理退休後，金先生被任命為行銷部主管。

sentences.en: Please arrive at the appointed time so that the interview can start without any delay.
sentences.zh: 請在約定時間抵達，讓面試可以準時開始。

sentences.en: The newly appointed CEO plans to visit every branch of the bank during her first year.
sentences.zh: 新任執行長計畫在第一年走訪銀行的每一家分行。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed was appointed as the company's first female chairperson in its long one-hundred-year history.
sentences.zh: Ahmed 小姐被任命為公司百年歷史上第一位女性主席。

words.note: 語塊：be appointed as（被任命為）、newly appointed（新任的）、at the appointed time（在約定時間）。appointed 是「被正式任命的」或「約定好的」；appoint 是動詞；appointment 是名詞。

sentences.en: The chairman of the board will open the annual meeting with a short speech about last year's results.
sentences.zh: 董事長將以一段關於去年成果的簡短演講開啟年度大會。

sentences.en: Mr. Lopez served as chairman of the association for ten years before he retired last spring.
sentences.zh: Lopez 先生擔任協會主席十年，去年春天退休。

sentences.en: The vice chairman will lead the meeting this week because the head of the board is traveling in Europe.
sentences.zh: 因為董事長這週在歐洲出差，會議將由副主席主持。

sentences.en: The chairman thanked all of the employees for their hard work during a difficult year.
sentences.zh: 董事長感謝所有員工在艱難的一年中辛勤工作。

sentences.en: Reporters asked the chairman several questions about the merger after the press conference on Monday.
sentences.zh: 記者會結束後，記者問了董事長好幾個關於合併的問題。

words.note: 語塊：chairman of the board（董事長）、vice chairman（副主席）、the chairman thanked（主席感謝）、asked the chairman（問主席）。chairman 是「主席、董事長」；chairperson 是不分性別的說法。

sentences.en: We should invite Ms. Lee to the meeting; after all, she has the most experience with this client.
sentences.zh: 我們應該邀請李小姐來開會，畢竟她和這位客戶最有經驗。

sentences.en: The concert was canceled because of the storm, but it took place the following week after all.
sentences.zh: 演唱會因為暴風雨取消了，但結果還是在下一週舉行了。

sentences.en: Please be patient with new employees; after all, they have only been working here for a week.
sentences.zh: 請對新員工有耐心，畢竟他們才來這裡工作一週。

sentences.en: The team thought the project would fail, but it was finished on time after all.
sentences.zh: 團隊原本以為專案會失敗，結果還是準時完成了。

sentences.en: It makes sense to buy the more expensive printer; after all, it will last much longer than the cheap one.
sentences.zh: 買比較貴的印表機是合理的，畢竟它會比便宜的那台耐用很多。

words.note: 語塊：after all（畢竟；到頭來）。after all 可以表示「畢竟（說明理由）」或「結果還是」；at last 是「終於」。

sentences.en: We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the elevator repairs in our building this week.
sentences.zh: 我們為這週電梯維修造成的不便致歉。

sentences.en: The road construction may cause inconvenience for drivers, so please use the highway if possible.
sentences.zh: 道路施工可能會為駕駛帶來不便，所以可以的話請走公路。

sentences.en: The airline offered free meals to passengers to make up for the inconvenience of the long delay.
sentences.zh: 航空公司提供乘客免費餐點，彌補長時間延誤造成的不便。

sentences.en: The workers will start early in the morning to minimize inconvenience to the people who live nearby.
sentences.zh: 工人會一大早開始施工，盡量減少對附近居民的不便。

sentences.en: Thank you for your patience, and we are sorry for any inconvenience this change may cause.
sentences.zh: 謝謝您的耐心，對這次變更可能造成的任何不便深感抱歉。

words.note: 語塊：cause inconvenience（造成不便）、apologize for the inconvenience（為不便道歉）、minimize inconvenience（減少不便）。inconvenience 是名詞；inconvenient 是形容詞「不方便的」；convenience 是「便利」。

sentences.en: Please book your tickets in advance, as the concert is expected to sell out very quickly.
sentences.zh: 請事先訂票，因為演唱會預計很快就會賣光。

sentences.en: Guests must pay in advance for the first night when they make a reservation online.
sentences.zh: 客人在網路上訂房時必須預先支付第一晚的費用。

sentences.en: If you need to cancel your appointment, please let us know at least two days in advance.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要取消預約，請至少提前兩天告訴我們。

sentences.en: It is a good idea to plan your vacation in advance so that you can find cheaper flights.
sentences.zh: 提早規劃假期是個好主意，這樣才能找到比較便宜的機票。

sentences.en: The speaker sent her slides to the organizers in advance so that they could check them.
sentences.zh: 講者事先把投影片寄給主辦單位，讓他們可以檢查。

words.note: 語塊：book in advance（事先預訂）、pay in advance（預先付款）、two days in advance（提前兩天）。in advance 是「提前」；beforehand 意思接近；advance 是「前進；預付款」。

sentences.en: The hotel is close to the beach; besides, it offers a free breakfast to every guest.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店離海灘很近，而且每位客人都有免費早餐。

sentences.en: I do not have time to attend the meeting today, and besides, I have already read the report.
sentences.zh: 我今天沒時間參加會議，而且我已經看過報告了。

sentences.en: The new phone is cheaper than the old model; besides, its battery lasts much longer.
sentences.zh: 新手機比舊款便宜，而且電池續航更久。

sentences.en: Besides that, the job offers flexible working hours and the option to work from home on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，這份工作提供彈性工時，週五也可以選擇在家工作。

sentences.en: The restaurant has excellent food; besides, the staff are friendly and the prices are reasonable.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的食物很好，此外，員工很親切，價格也合理。

words.note: 語塊：besides that（除此之外）、and besides（而且）、besides, the staff（而且員工……）。besides 當副詞是「而且、此外」；當介系詞是「除了……之外（還有）」；beside（沒有 s）是「在……旁邊」。

sentences.en: The hotel hires experienced staff who can speak several languages and help guests from many countries.
sentences.zh: 飯店聘用會說好幾種語言、能協助各國客人的有經驗員工。

sentences.en: We are looking for a highly experienced engineer to lead the design of our new factory in Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位經驗豐富的工程師，帶領我們越南新工廠的設計。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant is experienced in organizing large events, so she will plan the company's anniversary party.
sentences.zh: Grant 小姐在籌辦大型活動方面很有經驗，所以由她規劃公司的週年派對。

sentences.en: New employees will work with experienced staff for their first three months at the company.
sentences.zh: 新員工到公司的頭三個月會和有經驗的員工一起工作。

sentences.en: The restaurant is looking for an experienced chef who can create new dishes every season.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳在找一位能每季設計新菜色的有經驗主廚。

words.note: 語塊：experienced staff（有經驗的員工）、highly experienced（經驗豐富的）、experienced in（在……方面有經驗）。experienced 是「有經驗的」；experience 是名詞或動詞「經驗；經歷」。

sentences.en: Managers must communicate effectively with their teams so that everyone understands the goals of each project.
sentences.zh: 經理必須和團隊有效溝通，讓每個人都了解目標。

sentences.en: The training program teaches employees how to work effectively in teams with people from other countries.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫教員工如何和來自其他國家的人有效地團隊合作。

sentences.en: The new software allows us to use our time more effectively by reducing paperwork in the office.
sentences.zh: 新軟體減少了文書工作，讓我們能更有效地運用時間。

sentences.en: The medicine works effectively for most patients, but some people may need a stronger treatment.
sentences.zh: 那種藥對大部分病人都很有效，但有些人可能需要更強的治療。

sentences.en: The company solved the problem effectively by hiring more staff during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 公司在旺季增聘人手，有效地解決了問題。

words.note: 語塊：communicate effectively（有效溝通）、work effectively（有效率地工作）、use effectively（有效運用）。effectively 是「有效果地」；efficiently 是「有效率地（不浪費）」；effective 是形容詞。

sentences.en: On average, our customers receive their orders within two days of placing them on our website.
sentences.zh: 平均來說，我們的顧客在網路下單後兩天內就會收到訂單。

sentences.en: Employees at the company work on average forty hours a week, including one evening of overtime.
sentences.zh: 公司員工平均每週工作四十小時，包括一個晚上的加班。

sentences.en: On average, the hotel receives about five hundred guests every weekend during the busy summer months.
sentences.zh: 平均來說，飯店夏天每個週末大約接待五百位客人。

sentences.en: Prices for apartments in the city center have risen on average by ten percent each year.
sentences.zh: 市中心公寓的價格平均每年上漲一成。

sentences.en: On average, it takes new employees about three months to learn how to use all of the software.
sentences.zh: 平均來說，新員工大約要三個月才能學會使用所有軟體。

words.note: 語塊：on average（平均而言）。on average 是「平均下來」；average 可以是名詞「平均數」或形容詞「平均的；普通的」。

sentences.en: The factory needs more skilled workers who know how to operate the new machines safely.
sentences.zh: 工廠需要更多懂得操作新機器的技術工人。

sentences.en: Our furniture is made by highly skilled craftsmen who have worked with wood for many years.
sentences.zh: 我們的家具是由和木頭打交道多年、技術高超的工匠製作的。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin is skilled in negotiating contracts and has helped the company save a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 林小姐擅長談判合約，幫公司省了很多錢。

sentences.en: There is a shortage of skilled workers in the construction industry, so wages have increased.
sentences.zh: 營造業缺乏技術工人，所以薪資提高了。

sentences.en: The company offers training programs to help employees become more skilled in using new technology.
sentences.zh: 公司提供訓練計畫，幫助員工更熟練地使用新科技。

words.note: 語塊：skilled workers（技術工人）、highly skilled（技術高超的）、skilled in（擅長……）。skilled 是「有技術、熟練的」；unskilled 是「沒有技術的」；skillful 意思接近。

sentences.en: Dr. Kim is a well-known expert in the field of renewable energy and has won several awards.
sentences.zh: 金博士是再生能源領域的知名專家，得過好幾個獎。

sentences.en: The students went on a field trip to a local farm to learn how vegetables are grown.
sentences.zh: 學生到當地農場進行校外教學，學習蔬菜如何種植。

sentences.en: The new playing field near the school will be used for football games and other sports.
sentences.zh: 學校附近的新運動場將用來舉辦足球比賽和其他運動。

sentences.en: Many young people want to work in the field of technology because salaries are high.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕人想在科技領域工作，因為薪水很高。

sentences.en: The company sent a team on a field trip to visit factories in Japan and learn new methods.
sentences.zh: 公司派一組人實地考察日本的工廠，學習新方法。

words.note: 語塊：in the field of（在……領域）、field trip（校外教學；實地考察）、playing field（運動場）。field 可以是「專業領域」、「田地」或「運動場」；in the field 是「在現場」。

sentences.en: The city will host an international conference on clean energy next spring at the new convention center.
sentences.zh: 這座城市明年春天將在新會議中心舉辦一場國際潔淨能源研討會。

sentences.en: The hotel plans to host an event for local businesses to celebrate its tenth anniversary.
sentences.zh: 飯店計畫舉辦一場邀請當地企業的活動，慶祝十週年。

sentences.en: The famous chef will host a show on television where he teaches people how to cook simple meals.
sentences.zh: 那位知名主廚將主持一個電視節目，教大家做簡單的料理。

sentences.en: Our company will host a conference for more than five hundred engineers from around the world.
sentences.zh: 我們公司將為五百多位來自世界各地的工程師舉辦一場研討會。

sentences.en: The museum will host an event for children every Saturday morning during the summer holidays.
sentences.zh: 暑假期間，博物館每週六早上會為孩子舉辦活動。

words.note: 語塊：host an event（主辦活動）、host a conference（舉辦研討會）、host a show（主持節目）。host 可以當動詞「主辦、主持」或名詞「主人；主持人」；hostess 是「女主人」。

sentences.en: The forest is home to several endangered species, so visitors must stay on the marked paths.
sentences.zh: 那座森林是好幾種瀕危物種的家，所以遊客必須走在標示的步道上。

sentences.en: Scientists discovered a rare species of bird that had not been seen in the area for fifty years.
sentences.zh: 科學家發現一種五十年來沒在該地區出現過的稀有鳥類。

sentences.en: The lake contains more than thirty species of fish, which attract many visitors who enjoy fishing.
sentences.zh: 湖裡有三十多種魚，吸引很多喜歡釣魚的遊客。

sentences.en: The new law will protect endangered species by limiting the number of trees that can be cut down.
sentences.zh: 新法律將限制可以砍伐的樹木數量，保護瀕危物種。

sentences.en: The garden has more than one hundred species of flowers from many different parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 那座花園有一百多種來自世界各地的花。

words.note: 語塊：endangered species（瀕危物種）、rare species（稀有物種）、species of（……的種類）。species 單複數同形（one species、two species）；special 是「特別的」。

sentences.en: The property manager is responsible for repairs, security, and cleaning in the large apartment building.
sentences.zh: 物業經理負責公寓大樓的維修和清潔。

sentences.en: Many people buy a rental property as an investment so that they can earn money every month.
sentences.zh: 很多人買出租房產當作投資，好每個月賺錢。

sentences.en: This land is private property, so visitors are not allowed to enter without permission from the owner.
sentences.zh: 這塊地是私人土地，所以訪客未經許可不得進入。

sentences.en: The value of property in the city center has increased sharply over the past ten years.
sentences.zh: 市中心房地產的價值在過去十年急劇上升。

sentences.en: The company's largest property in the area is a hotel near the station that has three hundred rooms.
sentences.zh: 公司在這一帶最大的房產是車站附近一家有三百間客房的飯店。

words.note: 語塊：property manager（物業經理）、rental property（出租房產）、private property（私人土地）。property 可以是「房地產、財產」，也可以是「特性」；proper 是「適當的」。

sentences.en: The new machine is capable of producing one thousand bottles every hour without stopping for repairs.
sentences.zh: 新機器每小時能不停地生產一千個瓶子。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz is a highly capable manager who can handle several large projects at the same time.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐是一位非常能幹的經理，能同時處理好幾個大型專案。

sentences.en: The new airport will be capable of handling more than twenty million passengers each year.
sentences.zh: 新機場每年能處理兩千多萬名旅客。

sentences.en: We need a capable assistant who can organize meetings and answer emails quickly and politely.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一位能安排會議、快速回覆郵件的能幹助理。

sentences.en: The software is capable of translating documents into ten different languages in a few seconds.
sentences.zh: 那套軟體能在幾秒內把文件翻譯成十種不同的語言。

words.note: 語塊：be capable of（能夠……）、highly capable（非常能幹的）。be capable of + 名詞／V-ing；able to + 原形動詞 意思接近；capability 是名詞。

sentences.en: The restaurant became profitable in its second year, so the owner plans to open another one.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳第二年開始獲利，所以老闆打算再開一家。

sentences.en: Selling coffee online has turned out to be a highly profitable business for the small company.
sentences.zh: 在網路上賣咖啡，結果對那家小公司來說是非常賺錢的生意。

sentences.en: The factory will close next year because it is no longer profitable to produce cars there.
sentences.zh: 那座工廠明年將關閉，因為在那裡生產汽車已經不再有利潤。

sentences.en: Many investors believe that renewable energy will become a profitable business in the near future.
sentences.zh: 很多投資人認為再生能源未來會成為賺錢的生意。

sentences.en: The company is looking for ways to make its stores in Europe more profitable next year.
sentences.zh: 公司正在尋找讓歐洲門市明年更賺錢的方法。

words.note: 語塊：highly profitable（非常賺錢的）、become profitable（開始獲利）、profitable business（賺錢的生意）、no longer profitable（不再賺錢）、more profitable（更賺錢）。profitable 是「能賺錢的」；profit 是名詞「利潤」；lucrative 意思接近。

sentences.en: The city plans to construct a new bridge across the river to reduce traffic in the downtown area.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫在河上建造一座新橋，減少市中心的交通量。

sentences.en: It will take about three years to construct the new hospital, which will have five hundred beds.
sentences.zh: 建造那座有五百張病床的新醫院大約要三年。

sentences.en: The company hired an experienced firm to construct a building that uses less energy than older ones.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一家有經驗的公司，建造一棟比舊建築更節能的大樓。

sentences.en: Engineers will construct a temporary road while the main highway into the city is being repaired.
sentences.zh: 主要公路維修期間，工程師會建造一條臨時道路。

sentences.en: The government will construct new schools in rural areas so that children do not have to travel far.
sentences.zh: 政府將在鄉村地區興建新學校，讓孩子不用走很遠。

words.note: 語塊：construct a building（建造大樓）、construct a bridge（建橋）、be constructed of（由……建成）。construct 比 build 正式；construction 是名詞「建設；工程」。

sentences.en: The park is covered with dense vegetation, so visitors should stay on the paths to avoid getting lost.
sentences.zh: 公園長滿茂密的植物，所以遊客應該走在步道上以免迷路。

sentences.en: The fire destroyed much of the natural vegetation on the mountain, but new plants are already growing.
sentences.zh: 大火燒毀了山上大部分的天然植被，但新植物已經在生長了。

sentences.en: The lack of rain has caused the vegetation in the area to turn brown during the summer.
sentences.zh: 缺雨讓該地區的植物在夏天變成褐色。

sentences.en: Scientists are studying how the vegetation near the river has changed over the past fifty years.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在研究河邊的植被在過去五十年如何改變。

sentences.en: Planting more vegetation along the roads can help reduce noise and improve air quality in the city.
sentences.zh: 沿著道路種更多植物可以幫助減少噪音並改善城市的空氣品質。

words.note: 語塊：dense vegetation（茂密的植物）、natural vegetation（天然植被）、the vegetation in the area（該地區的植物）、the vegetation near（……附近的植被）、more vegetation（更多植物）。vegetation 是「某地區所有植物的總稱」；vegetable 是「蔬菜」；vegetarian 是「素食者」。

sentences.en: The company will decide whether to open a new store in the city after reviewing the survey results.
sentences.zh: 公司在審閱調查結果後，會決定是否在城裡開新店。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee will decide to accept the job in Tokyo if the company offers her a higher salary.
sentences.zh: 如果公司提供更高的薪水，李小姐會決定接受東京的工作。

sentences.en: The committee will decide on a location for the conference at its meeting next Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 委員會將在下週二的會議上決定研討會的地點。

sentences.en: Please decide which dish you would like for the dinner and tell the event organizer by Friday.
sentences.zh: 請決定晚宴想吃哪道菜，並在週五前告訴活動負責人。

sentences.en: It is difficult to decide whether to buy a new printer or repair the old one, so let's compare the prices.
sentences.zh: 很難決定要買新印表機還是修舊的，所以我們來比較價格吧。

words.note: 語塊：decide to（決定做……）、decide on（決定選……）、decide whether（決定是否）。decide to + 原形動詞；decide on + 名詞；decision 是名詞。

sentences.en: The hospital runs an outreach program that sends nurses to visit elderly people who live alone.
sentences.zh: 醫院推行一項外展計畫，派護士探訪獨居長者。

sentences.en: The company's community outreach includes free classes for children and regular donations to local schools.
sentences.zh: 公司的社區服務包括為孩子開免費課程和捐款給當地學校。

sentences.en: The library hired a new staff member to manage its outreach program for people in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 圖書館聘了一位新員工，管理針對鄉村地區民眾的外展計畫。

sentences.en: Volunteers play an important role in community outreach by helping families find food and housing.
sentences.zh: 志工在社區服務中扮演重要角色，幫助家庭找到食物和住處。

sentences.en: The museum's outreach program brings art classes to schools that do not have art teachers.
sentences.zh: 博物館的外展計畫把美術課帶到沒有美術老師的學校。

words.note: 語塊：community outreach（社區服務）、outreach program（外展計畫）。outreach 是「主動到外面接觸群眾的服務或活動」；reach out 是動詞片語「主動聯繫」。

sentences.en: It is imperative that all employees wear safety helmets while they are on the construction site.
sentences.zh: 所有員工在工地都必須戴安全帽，這是絕對必要的。

sentences.en: It is imperative to back up important files before the computer system is upgraded this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末電腦系統升級前，必須備份重要檔案。

sentences.en: The doctor said that it was imperative for the patient to rest for at least two weeks after surgery.
sentences.zh: 醫生說病人手術後至少休息兩週是絕對必要的。

sentences.en: It is imperative that we finish the report before the meeting with the investors on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我們必須在週一和投資人開會前完成報告，這非常重要。

sentences.en: Quick action is imperative when a customer reports a safety problem with one of our products.
sentences.zh: 顧客回報我們產品有安全問題時，迅速行動是絕對必要的。

words.note: 語塊：it is imperative that（……是絕對必要的）、imperative to（必須……）。imperative 比 important、necessary 更強烈；it is imperative that 後面的動詞常用原形。

sentences.en: The company will introduce a new product for young customers at the technology fair next month.
sentences.zh: 公司下個月會在科技展推出一款針對年輕顧客的新產品。

sentences.en: Please let me introduce you to Ms. Park, who will be managing your account from now on.
sentences.zh: 請讓我把你介紹給朴小姐，她從現在起會負責你的帳戶。

sentences.en: The government plans to introduce a policy that will reduce taxes for families with young children.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫推行一項為有幼童家庭減稅的政策。

sentences.en: The restaurant will introduce several new dishes to its menu at the beginning of the summer.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳夏天一開始會在菜單上推出幾道新菜。

sentences.en: The manager will introduce the new employees to the rest of the team at the meeting on Monday.
sentences.zh: 經理會在週一的會議上把新員工介紹給團隊其他成員。

words.note: 語塊：introduce a new product（推出新產品）、introduce sb to（把某人介紹給）、introduce a policy（推行政策）。introduce 可以是「介紹（人）」或「引進、推出（新東西）」；introduction 是名詞。

sentences.en: The new phone is similar to the old model, but it has a larger screen and a better camera.
sentences.zh: 新手機和舊款很像，但螢幕比較大、相機比較好。

sentences.en: The two hotels are similar in price, but the one near the beach has better reviews.
sentences.zh: 兩家飯店價格差不多，但海邊那家的評價比較好。

sentences.en: Many companies in the area have had similar problems with finding skilled workers this year.
sentences.zh: 這一帶很多公司今年在找技術工人方面都遇到類似的問題。

sentences.en: Our product is similar to our competitor's, but ours comes with a longer warranty and free delivery.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品和競爭對手的很像，但我們的保固比較長。

sentences.en: If you have a similar question, please read the answers on the frequently asked questions page first.
sentences.zh: 如果你有類似的問題，請先閱讀常見問題頁面上的答案。

words.note: 語塊：similar to（和……相似）、similar in（在……方面相似）。similar to 是「和……很像」；the same as 是「完全一樣」；similarity 是名詞。

sentences.en: The new employees showed great enthusiasm during their first week and asked many good questions.
sentences.zh: 新員工第一週展現了很大的熱情，問了很多好問題。

sentences.en: Customers responded with enthusiasm to the new menu, so the restaurant will keep it all year.
sentences.zh: 顧客對新菜單反應熱烈，所以餐廳會整年保留。

sentences.en: The manager was impressed by Ms. Kim's enthusiasm for the project and asked her to lead the team.
sentences.zh: 經理對金小姐對這個專案的熱忱印象深刻，請她帶領團隊。

sentences.en: Applicants who show enthusiasm for working with children are encouraged to apply for the position.
sentences.zh: 對和孩子一起工作展現熱情的應徵者，歡迎申請這個職位。

sentences.en: The audience listened with enthusiasm as the speaker explained her ideas for reducing plastic waste.
sentences.zh: 聽眾熱切地聆聽講者說明她減少浪費的想法。

words.note: 語塊：with enthusiasm（熱情地）、enthusiasm for（對……的熱忱）、show enthusiasm（展現熱情）。enthusiasm 是名詞；enthusiastic 是形容詞「熱情的」；passion 意思接近。

sentences.en: Ms. Ortiz decided to apply for a position in the marketing department at a large company.
sentences.zh: Ortiz 小姐決定應徵一家大公司行銷部的職位。

sentences.en: The company hopes to fill a position in customer service before the busy holiday season begins.
sentences.zh: 公司希望在忙碌的節慶季開始前補上客服的職缺。

sentences.en: We are not in a position to lower our prices because the cost of materials has increased.
sentences.zh: 因為材料成本上漲，我們無法降價。

sentences.en: The store moved the new products to a better position near the entrance so that customers would see them.
sentences.zh: 店家把新產品移到入口附近更好的位置，讓顧客能看到。

sentences.en: The board explained its position on the merger in a letter that was sent to all shareholders.
sentences.zh: 董事會在寄給所有股東的信中說明了它對合併的立場。

words.note: 語塊：apply for a position（應徵職位）、fill a position（補職缺）、in a position to（能夠……）。position 可以是「職位」、「位置」或「立場」；post 也可以表示「職位」。

sentences.en: The storm may result in delays for many flights leaving the airport late this evening.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨可能會導致今晚從機場起飛的航班延誤。

sentences.en: Using cheaper materials could result in higher costs later because the products may break more easily.
sentences.zh: 使用比較便宜的材料之後可能會造成更高的成本，因為產品更容易壞。

sentences.en: The new training program is expected to result in better customer service at all of our stores.
sentences.zh: 新的訓練計畫預計會讓我們所有門市的客服更好。

sentences.en: Not following the safety rules can result in serious injuries, so please read them carefully.
sentences.zh: 不遵守安全規定可能會導致嚴重受傷，所以請仔細閱讀。

sentences.en: The merger will result in a larger company that can compete with the biggest firms in the industry.
sentences.zh: 這次合併將造就一家能和業界最大公司競爭的更大企業。

words.note: 語塊：result in delays（導致延誤）、result in higher costs（造成成本增加）、result in serious injuries（導致重傷）、result in better（帶來更好的……）。result in + 結果；result from + 原因（The delay resulted from the storm）。

sentences.en: Every worker must follow each safety regulation in the factory, including wearing gloves and helmets.
sentences.zh: 每位工人都必須遵守工廠的每一項安全規定，包括戴手套和安全帽。

sentences.en: The new regulation requires restaurants to show the calories of every dish on their menus.
sentences.zh: 新規定要求餐廳在菜單上標示每道菜的熱量。

sentences.en: Companies that break the new regulation on plastic packaging will have to pay a large fine.
sentences.zh: 違反塑膠包裝新規定的公司必須支付高額罰款。

sentences.en: The government introduced a new regulation to protect workers who are employed through agencies or work part-time.
sentences.zh: 政府推出一項新規定，保護透過派遣公司受僱的勞工。

sentences.en: Please read the safety regulation posted on the wall before you begin using the machines.
sentences.zh: 開始使用機器之前，請先閱讀貼在牆上的安全規定。

words.note: 語塊：safety regulation（安全規定）、comply with regulations（遵守法規）、new regulation（新規定）。regulation 是「正式的規定」，常用複數；regulate 是動詞「管理、規範」。

sentences.en: All employees must follow the procedure for reporting accidents, which is explained in the handbook.
sentences.zh: 所有員工都必須遵照手冊中說明的事故通報程序。

sentences.en: It is standard procedure to check every package for damage before signing for it at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 簽收前檢查每個包裹是否損壞是標準程序。

sentences.en: The new safety procedure requires workers to turn off the machines completely before cleaning them.
sentences.zh: 新的安全程序要求工人在清潔機器前先關機。

sentences.en: The hospital changed its procedure for checking in patients so that they wait less time.
sentences.zh: 醫院改變了病人報到的程序，讓他們等待的時間更短。

sentences.en: If you are not sure about the procedure, please ask your supervisor before you start working.
sentences.zh: 如果你不確定程序，請在開始工作前問你的主管。

words.note: 語塊：follow the procedure（遵照程序）、standard procedure（標準程序）、safety procedure（安全程序）。procedure 是「做事的正式步驟」；process 是「過程」；proceed 是動詞「繼續進行」。

sentences.en: The company will proceed with the construction of the new factory after the city approves the plan.
sentences.zh: 市政府核准計畫後，公司將繼續進行新工廠的興建。

sentences.en: Passengers on the flight to Seoul should proceed to gate twelve, where boarding will begin soon.
sentences.zh: 飛往首爾的旅客請前往十二號登機門，即將開始登機。

sentences.en: Before we proceed with the meeting, I would like to welcome our guests from the head office.
sentences.zh: 在我們繼續開會之前，我想歡迎來自總公司的客人。

sentences.en: Please proceed to the second floor, where the registration desk for the conference is located.
sentences.zh: 請前往二樓，研討會的報到處在那裡。

sentences.en: The board decided not to proceed with the merger after reviewing the financial reports of both companies.
sentences.zh: 看過財務報告後，董事會決定不繼續進行合併。

words.note: 語塊：proceed with（繼續進行……）、proceed to（前往……）。proceed 比 continue、go 正式；procedure 是「程序」；precede 是「在……之前」。

sentences.en: The manager worked hard to make sure there was a smooth transition when the new software was introduced.
sentences.zh: 經理努力確保導入新軟體時能順利過渡。

sentences.en: The table has a smooth surface that is easy to clean, so it is perfect for restaurants.
sentences.zh: 那張桌子表面平滑又容易清潔，所以非常適合餐廳使用。

sentences.en: Thanks to careful planning, the opening of the new store was smooth and very successful for everyone involved.
sentences.zh: 多虧周詳的規劃，新店的開幕順利又成功。

sentences.en: The flight was smooth, and we arrived in Tokyo twenty minutes earlier than planned in the schedule.
sentences.zh: 航程很平穩，我們比預定時間早二十分鐘抵達東京。

sentences.en: To ensure a smooth transition, the old manager will work with her replacement for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 為了確保順利交接，舊經理會和接替她的人一起工作兩週。

words.note: 語塊：smooth transition（順利過渡）、run smoothly（順利運作）、smooth surface（平滑表面）。smooth 是「順利、沒有問題的」或「平滑的」；smoothly 是副詞。

sentences.en: The city will host a tennis tournament next summer, and players from twenty countries will take part.
sentences.zh: 這座城市明年夏天將主辦網球錦標賽，二十個國家的選手會參加。

sentences.en: Our company sponsors a golf tournament every year to raise money for local schools and libraries.
sentences.zh: 我們公司每年贊助一場高爾夫錦標賽，為當地學校募款。

sentences.en: The young player surprised everyone when she was able to win a tournament in her first year.
sentences.zh: 那位年輕選手第一年就贏得錦標賽，讓大家都很驚訝。

sentences.en: Hotels near the stadium are fully booked during the tournament, so fans should reserve rooms early.
sentences.zh: 錦標賽期間體育場附近的飯店都客滿了，所以球迷應該提早訂房。

sentences.en: The tennis tournament will be broadcast live on television, and tickets are already sold out.
sentences.zh: 網球錦標賽將在電視上現場直播，門票已經賣光了。

words.note: 語塊：tennis tournament（網球錦標賽）、host a tournament（主辦錦標賽）、win a tournament（贏得錦標賽）。tournament 是「多場比賽的大型賽事」；match 是「一場比賽」；competition 是「比賽（統稱）」。

sentences.en: Please make sure there are sufficient funds in your account before you make the payment.
sentences.zh: 付款之前，請確認你的帳戶有足夠的資金。

sentences.en: The team did not have sufficient time to finish the project, so the deadline was extended.
sentences.zh: 團隊沒有足夠的時間完成專案，所以截止日延長了。

sentences.en: The police did not have sufficient evidence to prove that the company had broken the law.
sentences.zh: 警方沒有充分的證據證明那家公司違法。

sentences.en: One hour should be sufficient time to tour the museum and see all of the main exhibits.
sentences.zh: 一小時應該足夠參觀博物館並看完所有主要展品。

sentences.en: The bank will approve the loan only if the company can show that it has sufficient funds.
sentences.zh: 只有公司能證明它有足夠的資金，銀行才會核准貸款。

words.note: 語塊：sufficient funds（足夠的資金）、sufficient time（足夠的時間）、sufficient evidence（充分的證據）。sufficient 和 enough 意思相同，比較正式；insufficient 是「不足的」。

sentences.en: A senior government official will visit the factory next week to learn about its new technology.
sentences.zh: 一位高級政府官員下週會參觀工廠，了解它的新技術。

sentences.en: The company's managers will meet with a government official to discuss the plans for the new airport.
sentences.zh: 公司的經理們將和一位政府官員會面，討論新機場的計畫。

sentences.en: Every government official must follow strict rules about accepting gifts or money from businesses and individuals.
sentences.zh: 每位政府官員都必須遵守接受企業禮物的嚴格規定。

sentences.en: The government official explained the new tax rules to small business owners at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 那位政府官員在會議上向小企業老闆說明新的稅務規定。

sentences.en: A senior government official said that the new highway will be finished by the end of next year.
sentences.zh: 一位高級政府官員說新公路將在明年底完工。

words.note: 語塊：senior government official（高級政府官員）、meet with government officials（會見政府官員）。official 當名詞是「官員」；當形容詞是「正式的；官方的」。

sentences.en: Ms. Park has run a small bakery in the city center for more than twenty years.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐在市中心經營一家小麵包店二十多年了。

sentences.en: The new software helps the factory run smoothly by tracking every order and every machine.
sentences.zh: 新軟體追蹤每筆訂單和每台機器，幫助工廠順利運作。

sentences.en: Buses to the airport run every fifteen minutes from five in the morning until midnight.
sentences.zh: 往機場的公車從早上五點到午夜每十五分鐘一班。

sentences.en: It takes a lot of hard work to run a business, especially during the first few years.
sentences.zh: 經營事業需要很多努力，尤其是頭幾年。

sentences.en: The museum will run a special program for children during the long summer holidays in July and August.
sentences.zh: 博物館暑假期間將為孩子舉辦一個特別活動。

words.note: 語塊：run a business（經營事業）、run smoothly（順利運作）、run every（每……一班）。run 除了「跑」，在商業上常指「經營、管理」；runner 是「跑者」。

sentences.en: The job requires specialized training, so the company will send new employees to a course in Germany.
sentences.zh: 這份工作需要專業訓練，所以公司會送新員工去德國上課。

sentences.en: The hospital bought specialized equipment for treating patients with heart problems and other serious illnesses last year.
sentences.zh: 醫院購買了治療心臟病患者的專門設備。

sentences.en: The law firm is specialized in helping small businesses with contracts, taxes, and other legal issues.
sentences.zh: 那家律師事務所專精於協助小企業處理合約和稅務。

sentences.en: Repairing this machine requires specialized tools that only a few technicians in the country have.
sentences.zh: 修理這台機器需要只有少數技師才有的專門工具。

sentences.en: The store sells specialized equipment for mountain climbing and camping in very cold or snowy weather.
sentences.zh: 那家店販售在寒冷天氣登山和露營用的專門裝備。

words.note: 語塊：specialized training（專業訓練）、specialized equipment（專門設備）、specialized in（專精於……）。specialized 是「專門針對某領域的」；specialize 是動詞（specialize in）；special 是「特別的」。

sentences.en: Dr. Lee's area of specialization is heart disease, and she has worked at the hospital for twenty years.
sentences.zh: 李醫師的專業領域是心臟病，她在醫院工作了二十年。

sentences.en: The university offers a master's degree with a specialization in international business and trade for working adults.
sentences.zh: 那所大學開設專攻國際商務和貿易的碩士學位。

sentences.en: Each lawyer at the firm has an area of specialization, such as taxes, contracts, or family law.
sentences.zh: 事務所的每位律師都有專業領域，例如稅務、合約或家事法。

sentences.en: Her specialization in online marketing made her the best candidate for the new position in our team.
sentences.zh: 她在網路行銷方面的專長讓她成為新職位的最佳人選。

sentences.en: Students must choose a specialization at the end of their second year of study at the university.
sentences.zh: 學生必須在大學第二年結束時選擇專業領域。

words.note: 語塊：area of specialization（專業領域）、specialization in（專攻……）。specialization 是名詞；specialize 是動詞（specialize in）；specialist 是「專家」。

sentences.en: Employees can request reimbursement for travel expenses by submitting their receipts to the finance office within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 員工可以在三十天內提交收據，申請差旅費報銷。

sentences.en: The company provides full reimbursement for training courses that are directly related to your current job.
sentences.zh: 公司對和工作相關的訓練課程提供全額報銷。

sentences.en: Please attach the original receipts to the form when you request reimbursement for meals during business trips.
sentences.zh: 申請餐費報銷時，請在表格上附上原始收據。

sentences.en: Reimbursement for hotel costs will be paid with your salary at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 飯店費用的報銷會在月底和薪水一起發放。

sentences.en: The finance department will process your reimbursement request within five business days of receiving it.
sentences.zh: 財務部會在五個工作天內處理你的報銷申請。

words.note: 語塊：request reimbursement（申請報銷）、reimbursement for（……的報銷）、full reimbursement（全額報銷）。reimbursement 是「公司把你墊付的錢還給你」；reimburse 是動詞；refund 是「退款」。

sentences.en: Employees can nominate a colleague for the annual award by sending an email to human resources.
sentences.zh: 員工可以寄電子郵件給人資部，提名一位同事角逐年度獎項。

sentences.en: The committee decided to nominate Ms. Ruiz for the position of chairperson of the association.
sentences.zh: 委員會決定提名 Ruiz 小姐擔任協會主席。

sentences.en: Each department may nominate one person to represent the team at the international conference in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 每個部門可以提名一人代表團隊參加國際研討會。

sentences.en: Customers can nominate their favorite restaurant for the award on the magazine's website until the end of May.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在雜誌網站上提名他們最喜歡的餐廳角逐獎項。

sentences.en: The board will nominate three candidates, and the members will vote for one of them in May.
sentences.zh: 董事會將提名三位候選人，會員將在五月投票選出其中一位。

words.note: 語塊：nominate sb for（提名某人角逐……）、be nominated as（被提名為）。nominate 是「正式推薦某人當候選人」；nomination 是名詞；nominee 是「被提名人」。

sentences.en: The company earned profits in excess of ten million dollars last year, which was a new record.
sentences.zh: 公司去年獲利超過一千萬美元，創下新紀錄。

sentences.en: Purchases in excess of five thousand dollars must be approved in writing by the finance director.
sentences.zh: 超過五千美元的採購必須經財務總監核准。

sentences.en: The new stadium will be able to hold crowds in excess of fifty thousand people.
sentences.zh: 新體育場將能容納超過五萬人的觀眾。

sentences.en: Passengers whose bags weigh in excess of twenty kilograms will have to pay an extra fee.
sentences.zh: 行李超過二十公斤的乘客必須支付額外費用。

sentences.en: The project cost in excess of what was planned, so the board asked for a detailed report.
sentences.zh: 專案的花費超過原先的規劃，所以董事會要求一份詳細報告。

words.note: 語塊：in excess of（超過……）。in excess of 比 more than 正式；excess 是名詞「過量」；excessive 是形容詞「過度的」。

sentences.en: The new subway line will make it easier for every daily commuter who travels into the city center.
sentences.zh: 新捷運線會讓每位每天通勤到市中心的人更方便。

sentences.en: The commuter train from the suburbs is very crowded between seven and nine o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 從郊區出發的通勤列車在早上七點到九點之間非常擁擠。

sentences.en: Commuter traffic on the highway is heavy, so many people prefer to take the bus to work.
sentences.zh: 公路上的通勤車潮很多，所以很多人比較喜歡搭公車上班。

sentences.en: The café near the station opens early to serve coffee to every commuter on the way to work.
sentences.zh: 車站附近的咖啡館很早就開門，為每位上班途中的通勤者供應咖啡。

sentences.en: The city added more buses to reduce commuter traffic in the downtown area during rush hour.
sentences.zh: 市政府增加公車班次，減少尖峰時段市中心的通勤車潮。

words.note: 語塊：daily commuter（每天通勤的人）、commuter train（通勤列車）、commuter traffic（通勤車潮）。commuter 是「每天往返家和工作地點的人」；commute 是動詞或名詞「通勤」。

sentences.en: Please arrive at the airport at least two hours before your departure time for international flights.
sentences.zh: 搭國際航班時，請至少在出發時間前兩小時抵達機場。

sentences.en: The departure gate for the flight to Tokyo has been changed from gate five to gate twelve.
sentences.zh: 飛往東京的班機登機門已從五號改為十二號。

sentences.en: Passengers must check in at least one hour prior to departure, or they may not be allowed to board.
sentences.zh: 乘客必須在出發前至少一小時報到，否則可能無法登機。

sentences.en: The manager's departure from the company surprised many employees who had worked with him for years.
sentences.zh: 經理離開公司讓很多和他共事多年的員工很驚訝。

sentences.en: The departure time of the bus has been moved to eight o'clock because of the heavy traffic.
sentences.zh: 因為交通繁忙，巴士的出發時間改到八點。

words.note: 語塊：departure time（出發時間）、departure gate（登機門）、prior to departure（出發前）。departure 是名詞；depart 是動詞「出發」；arrival 是「抵達」。

sentences.en: Please make sure that all of the windows are closed before you leave the office this evening.
sentences.zh: 今晚離開辦公室之前，請確認所有的窗戶都關好了。

sentences.en: Make sure to bring your passport and ticket with you when you go to the airport tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天去機場時務必帶護照和機票。

sentences.en: The manager will make sure that everyone receives a copy of the new schedule by Friday.
sentences.zh: 經理會確保每個人在週五前都拿到一份新的時程表。

sentences.en: Please make sure to save your work often, as the old computers sometimes stop suddenly.
sentences.zh: 請務必經常存檔，因為舊電腦有時會突然當機。

sentences.en: We check every product carefully to make sure that it meets our high standards of quality.
sentences.zh: 我們仔細檢查每項產品，確保它符合我們的高品質標準。

words.note: 語塊：make sure that（確保……）、make sure to（務必……）。make sure 是「確定、確認」；ensure 意思接近，比較正式。

sentences.en: The supplier's refusal to lower its prices forced us to look for another company quickly.
sentences.zh: 供應商拒絕降價，迫使我們找另一家公司。

sentences.en: The bank sent a letter to explain its refusal of the loan application from the small business.
sentences.zh: 銀行寄信說明它拒絕那家小企業貸款申請的原因。

sentences.en: The workers' refusal to work overtime caused delays at the factory during the busy season.
sentences.zh: 工人拒絕加班，造成工廠在旺季時延誤。

sentences.en: After the refusal of her first proposal, Ms. Lee prepared a new one with a smaller budget.
sentences.zh: 第一份提案被拒絕後，李小姐準備了一份預算較少的新提案。

sentences.en: The government's refusal to approve the new airport has disappointed many local business owners and residents.
sentences.zh: 政府拒絕核准新機場，讓很多當地商家很失望。

words.note: 語塊：refusal to（拒絕做……）、a refusal of（對……的拒絕）。refusal 是名詞；refuse 是動詞「拒絕」；rejection 意思接近。

sentences.en: The accident at the factory was caused by negligence, as the machines had not been checked for months.
sentences.zh: 工廠的意外是疏忽造成的，因為機器好幾個月都沒有檢查。

sentences.en: The company was found guilty of gross negligence and had to pay a large fine to the government.
sentences.zh: 那家公司被判定有重大過失，必須繳一大筆罰款給政府。

sentences.en: Damage due to negligence is not covered by the warranty, so please follow the instructions carefully.
sentences.zh: 保固不包含因疏忽造成的損壞，所以請仔細遵守說明。

sentences.en: The hotel apologized for the negligence of its staff, who forgot to clean the guest's room.
sentences.zh: 飯店為員工忘記清潔客人房間的疏忽道歉。

sentences.en: The investigation found no evidence of negligence by the pilots or the airline's technicians on the ground.
sentences.zh: 調查沒有發現飛行員或航空公司技師有任何疏忽的證據。

words.note: 語塊：due to negligence（由於疏忽）、gross negligence（重大過失）、caused by negligence（疏忽造成）、evidence of negligence（疏忽的證據）、the negligence of（……的疏忽）。negligence 是「沒有盡到應有的小心」；negligent 是形容詞；neglect 是動詞「忽視」。

sentences.en: Many young families cannot afford to buy a house in the city center because prices are so high.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕家庭負擔不起在市中心買房，因為房價太高了。

sentences.en: The small company cannot afford to hire more staff this year, so the team will have to work harder.
sentences.zh: 那家小公司今年負擔不起增聘人手，所以團隊必須更努力工作。

sentences.en: If you cannot afford the full price, you can pay for the course in three monthly payments.
sentences.zh: 如果你負擔不起全額，可以分三個月付課程費用。

sentences.en: The school provides free laptops to students whose families cannot afford to buy one for them.
sentences.zh: 學校為家裡買不起筆電的學生提供免費筆電。

sentences.en: We can afford to spend a little more on advertising this year because sales have been strong.
sentences.zh: 今年我們可以在廣告上多花一點，因為銷售很好。

words.note: 語塊：can afford to（負擔得起做……）、cannot afford（負擔不起）。afford 常和 can / cannot 連用；affordable 是形容詞「負擔得起的」。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim will go on a business trip to Singapore next week to meet with several new clients.
sentences.zh: 金先生下週會去新加坡出差，和幾位新客戶見面。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee is on a business trip this week, so please send any urgent questions to her assistant.
sentences.zh: 李小姐這週在出差，所以有任何緊急問題請寄給她的助理。

sentences.en: The company will pay for your hotel and meals while you are on a business trip abroad.
sentences.zh: 你在國外出差期間，公司會負擔飯店和餐費。

sentences.en: Please keep all of your receipts from the business trip so that you can request reimbursement.
sentences.zh: 請保留出差的所有收據，以便申請報銷。

sentences.en: The manager had to cancel her business trip to London because of the strike at the airport.
sentences.zh: 因為機場罷工，經理只好取消她去倫敦的出差。

words.note: 語塊：go on a business trip（去出差）、be on a business trip（出差中）。business trip 是「因公出差」；vacation 是「度假」；travel 是「旅行」。

sentences.en: Ms. Park was hired to manage a team of ten engineers at the new research center in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐受聘管理首爾新研究中心的一個十人工程師團隊。

sentences.en: Despite the heavy snow, the delivery driver hopes to manage to deliver all of the packages on time today.
sentences.zh: 儘管下大雪，送貨司機希望今天還是能設法準時送完所有包裹。

sentences.en: The workshop teaches employees how to manage time more effectively when they have many tasks.
sentences.zh: 工作坊教員工在工作很多時如何更有效地管理時間。

sentences.en: It is not easy to manage a restaurant, especially when several staff members are absent at once.
sentences.zh: 經營一家餐廳不容易，尤其是好幾位員工同時缺勤的時候。

sentences.en: The new software will help us manage our customers' orders and track every delivery to their homes.
sentences.zh: 新軟體將幫助我們管理顧客的訂單並追蹤每一筆配送。

words.note: 語塊：manage a team（管理團隊）、manage to（設法做到）、manage time（管理時間）。manage 可以是「管理」，也可以是 manage to do「設法做成」；management 是名詞。

sentences.en: The marketing team prepared promotional materials, such as posters and brochures, for the trade show.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊為商展準備了海報和小冊子等宣傳資料。

sentences.en: Customers who sign up this month can take advantage of a special promotional offer of twenty percent off.
sentences.zh: 這個月註冊的顧客可以享有八折的特別促銷優惠。

sentences.en: The store will hold a promotional event on Saturday, where customers can try the new coffee for free.
sentences.zh: 那家店週六會舉辦宣傳活動，顧客可以免費試喝新咖啡。

sentences.en: The company spent a large amount of money on promotional videos for its new line of sports shoes.
sentences.zh: 公司在新系列運動鞋的宣傳影片上花了大筆錢。

sentences.en: Please send the promotional materials to every store before the start of the holiday sale.
sentences.zh: 請在節慶特賣開始前，把宣傳資料寄到每家門市。

words.note: 語塊：promotional materials（宣傳資料）、promotional offer（促銷優惠）、promotional event（宣傳活動）。promotional 是形容詞；promotion 是名詞「促銷；升遷」；promote 是動詞。

sentences.en: The new café near the university has become very popular with students because of its low prices.
sentences.zh: 大學附近的新咖啡廳因為價格便宜，很受學生歡迎。

sentences.en: The beach resort is popular with families who want a quiet vacation away from the busy city.
sentences.zh: 那個海灘度假村很受想遠離喧囂城市、安靜度假的家庭歡迎。

sentences.en: Our new app has been popular with older customers because it is very simple to use.
sentences.zh: 我們的新 App 很受年長顧客歡迎，因為它非常容易使用。

sentences.en: The night market is popular with tourists, especially those who want to try traditional food.
sentences.zh: 夜市很受觀光客歡迎，尤其是想嚐傳統食物的人。

sentences.en: The manager is popular with her team because she always listens to their ideas and concerns.
sentences.zh: 那位經理很受團隊歡迎，因為她總是聆聽大家的想法和擔憂。

words.note: 語塊：be popular with（受……歡迎）。be popular with + 人（受某群人歡迎）；be popular among 意思相同。

sentences.en: I did not realize that the meeting had been moved to Thursday until I received your email.
sentences.zh: 直到收到你的郵件，我才發現會議改到週四了。

sentences.en: After many years of hard work, Ms. Lee was able to realize her dream of opening her own restaurant.
sentences.zh: 經過多年努力，李小姐終於實現了開自己餐廳的夢想。

sentences.en: Many people do not realize how much energy they can save by turning off lights when they leave a room.
sentences.zh: 很多人沒意識到離開房間時關燈能省多少電。

sentences.en: The company hopes to realize its goal of becoming the market leader in electric bicycles.
sentences.zh: 公司希望實現成為電動自行車市場領導者的目標。

sentences.en: When the manager began to realize that sales were falling, she decided to change the strategy.
sentences.zh: 經理開始意識到銷售在下滑時，決定改變策略。

words.note: 語塊：realize that（意識到……）、realize a goal（實現目標）、realize a dream（實現夢想）。realize 可以是「意識到」或「實現（目標）」；realization 是名詞；英式拼法 realise。

sentences.en: The manager explained the new procedure in detail so that everyone understood what to do.
sentences.zh: 經理詳細說明了新程序，讓每個人都知道該怎麼做。

sentences.en: We are looking for someone who pays attention to detail and can check financial reports carefully.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位注重細節、能仔細檢查財務報告的人。

sentences.en: Please contact our office if you would like to discuss the project in detail before signing the contract.
sentences.zh: 如果你想在簽約前詳細討論專案，請聯絡我們的辦公室。

sentences.en: Every detail of the wedding was planned carefully, from the flowers on the tables to the music.
sentences.zh: 婚禮的每一個細節都經過仔細規劃，從花到音樂都是。

sentences.en: The designer's attention to detail is the reason why her work is so popular with clients.
sentences.zh: 那位設計師對細節的注重是她的作品這麼受客戶歡迎的原因。

words.note: 語塊：in detail（詳細地）、details of（……的細節）、pay attention to detail（注重細節）。detail 是「細節」；detailed 是形容詞「詳細的」；details 常用複數。

sentences.en: After two hours of discussion, the committee was able to reach a consensus on the new budget.
sentences.zh: 經過兩小時的討論，委員會對新預算達成了共識。

sentences.en: The general consensus among experts is that electric cars will become cheaper over the next ten years.
sentences.zh: 專家之間的普遍共識是電動車在未來十年會變得更便宜。

sentences.en: It was difficult to reach a consensus because each department wanted to spend more money.
sentences.zh: 很難達成共識，因為每個部門都想花更多錢。

sentences.en: There is a general consensus that the new office is much better than the old one.
sentences.zh: 大家普遍認為新辦公室比舊的好很多。

sentences.en: The manager hopes the team will reach a consensus about the design before the client meeting.
sentences.zh: 經理希望團隊在和客戶開會之前對設計達成共識。

words.note: 語塊：reach a consensus（達成共識）、general consensus（普遍共識）。consensus 是「大家都同意的意見」；agreement 意思接近；census 是「人口普查」。

sentences.en: Many employees agreed to forgo a bonus this year so that the company would not have to lay off staff.
sentences.zh: 很多員工同意今年放棄獎金，讓公司不用裁員。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee decided to forgo the opportunity to work abroad because she wanted to stay near her family.
sentences.zh: 李小姐決定放棄出國工作的機會，因為她想留在家人身邊。

sentences.en: Travelers who forgo the hotel breakfast can receive a discount of fifteen dollars per night.
sentences.zh: 不吃飯店早餐的旅客每晚可以獲得十五美元的折扣。

sentences.en: The company chose to forgo a large advertising campaign and spend the money on training instead.
sentences.zh: 公司選擇放棄大型廣告活動，改把錢花在訓練上。

sentences.en: Some customers are willing to forgo free delivery if they can receive their orders more quickly.
sentences.zh: 有些顧客如果能更快收到訂單，願意放棄免運費。

words.note: 語塊：forgo a bonus（放棄獎金）、forgo the opportunity（放棄機會）、forgo free delivery（放棄免運）、forgo the hotel breakfast（不吃飯店早餐）。forgo 是「主動不要、放棄」；give up 意思接近；forego 是另一種拼法。

sentences.en: The company plans to expand into South America by opening ten new stores over the next three years.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在未來三年開十家新店，拓展到南美市場。

sentences.en: The owners want to expand the business by adding a second restaurant in the city center.
sentences.zh: 老闆們想在市中心開第二家餐廳，擴大事業。

sentences.en: The store will expand the range of products it sells by adding furniture and home decorations.
sentences.zh: 那家店會增加家具和居家裝飾，擴大販售產品的範圍。

sentences.en: The airport will expand its terminal so that it can handle more passengers during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 機場將擴建航廈，讓它在節慶期間能處理更多旅客。

sentences.en: The university hopes to expand its research program by hiring twenty new professors next year.
sentences.zh: 那所大學希望明年聘用二十位新教授，擴大研究計畫。

words.note: 語塊：expand into（拓展到……）、expand the business（擴大事業）、expand the range of（擴大……的範圍）。expand 是「變大、擴大」；expansion 是名詞；extend 是「延長」。

sentences.en: The company uses bright colors in its packaging to differentiate its products from those of competitors.
sentences.zh: 公司在包裝上使用鮮豔的顏色，讓產品和競爭對手的做出區隔。

sentences.en: It can be difficult for customers to differentiate between the two models because they look so similar.
sentences.zh: 顧客可能很難分辨這兩款機型，因為它們看起來很像。

sentences.en: Good customer service is one way that small shops can differentiate themselves from large chains.
sentences.zh: 好的客服是小店和大型連鎖店做出區隔的方法之一。

sentences.en: The training teaches staff how to differentiate between serious complaints and simple questions from customers.
sentences.zh: 訓練教員工如何區分嚴重的投訴和簡單的問題。

sentences.en: To differentiate our hotel from others in the area, we offer free bicycles and cooking classes.
sentences.zh: 為了和這一帶其他飯店做出區隔，我們提供免費腳踏車和烹飪課。

words.note: 語塊：differentiate between（區分……）、differentiate from（和……區隔）。differentiate 是「分辨不同」或「做出差異」；distinguish 意思接近；difference 是名詞。

sentences.en: Please report any malfunctioning equipment in the gym to the front desk so that it can be repaired.
sentences.zh: 健身房裡有任何故障的設備，請通報櫃台以便維修。

sentences.en: The delay was caused by a malfunctioning machine on the production line, which was fixed in an hour.
sentences.zh: 延誤是生產線上一台故障的機器造成的，一小時內就修好了。

sentences.en: The technician replaced the malfunctioning part, and the office printer is now working perfectly again.
sentences.zh: 技師更換了故障的零件，印表機現在又運作得很好了。

sentences.en: A malfunctioning elevator in the building caused many employees to arrive late for the meeting.
sentences.zh: 大樓裡一台故障的電梯讓很多員工開會遲到。

sentences.en: Customers who receive a malfunctioning product can return it for a full refund within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 收到故障產品的顧客可以在三十天內退貨並全額退款。

words.note: 語塊：malfunctioning equipment（故障的設備）、a malfunctioning machine（故障的機器）、the malfunctioning part（故障的零件）、a malfunctioning product（故障的產品）、malfunctioning elevator（故障的電梯）。malfunctioning 是「運作出問題的」；malfunction 可以當名詞或動詞「故障」；broken 是「壞掉的」。

sentences.en: Passengers may board the plane thirty minutes before the departure time shown on their tickets.
sentences.zh: 乘客可以在機票上標示的出發時間前三十分鐘登機。

sentences.en: Please have your boarding pass and passport ready when you go to the gate to board the plane.
sentences.zh: 到登機門登機時，請準備好你的登機證和護照。

sentences.en: Travelers must board the train at least five minutes before it leaves, as the doors close automatically.
sentences.zh: 旅客必須在火車開動前至少五分鐘上車，因為車門會自動關閉。

sentences.en: Passengers with young children will be invited to board first so that they have time to find their seats.
sentences.zh: 帶著幼童的乘客會先被請上機，讓他們有時間找座位。

sentences.en: The ship will board passengers at the port from ten o'clock until noon on Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 那艘船週六上午十點到中午會在港口讓乘客登船。

words.note: 語塊：board a plane（登機）、board a train（上火車）、boarding pass（登機證）。board 當動詞是「上（飛機、船、車）」；當名詞是「董事會；板子」。

sentences.en: Could you arrange a meeting with the clients for next Tuesday afternoon at their office?
sentences.zh: 你可以安排下週二下午在客戶辦公室和他們開會嗎？

sentences.en: The hotel can arrange transportation from the airport if you send us your flight details in advance.
sentences.zh: 如果你事先寄航班資料給我們，飯店可以安排機場接送。

sentences.en: The company will arrange for a technician to visit your home and install the new air conditioner.
sentences.zh: 公司會安排技師到你家安裝新冷氣。

sentences.en: Please arrange the chairs in rows before the presentation begins in the large conference room.
sentences.zh: 簡報在會議室開始前，請把椅子排成一排一排。

sentences.en: The travel agency can arrange a tour of the old city that includes lunch at a traditional restaurant.
sentences.zh: 旅行社可以安排一趟包含傳統餐廳午餐的老城區導覽。

words.note: 語塊：arrange a meeting（安排會議）、arrange for（安排……）、arrange transportation（安排交通）。arrange 是「事先安排」；arrangement 是名詞；organize 意思接近。

sentences.en: Employees who are having problems at work should seek advice from their manager or human resources.
sentences.zh: 工作上遇到問題的員工應該向經理或人資部尋求建議。

sentences.en: Many graduates seek employment in large cities because there are many more job opportunities there.
sentences.zh: 很多畢業生到大城市求職，因為那裡機會比較多。

sentences.en: If you feel stressed or tired for a long time, it is important to seek help from a doctor.
sentences.zh: 如果你長時間感到壓力大或疲倦，尋求醫生的協助很重要。

sentences.en: The company will seek help from investors who can help it build a new factory in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 公司將向能幫助它在東南亞建新工廠的投資人尋求協助。

sentences.en: Small business owners can seek advice from experts at the city's business center for free.
sentences.zh: 小企業老闆可以在市政府的商業中心免費向專家尋求建議。

words.note: 語塊：seek advice（尋求建議）、seek employment（求職）、seek help（尋求協助）。seek 比 look for 正式；過去式和過去分詞是 sought。

sentences.en: Thank you for your understanding while we repair the elevators in the building this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末我們維修大樓電梯期間，感謝您的諒解。

sentences.en: Applicants should have a good understanding of accounting software and basic tax rules for small businesses.
sentences.zh: 應徵者應對會計軟體和基本稅務規定有很好的了解。

sentences.en: The two companies reached an understanding about the price after several weeks of long discussion.
sentences.zh: 經過幾週的討論，兩家公司對價格達成了協議。

sentences.en: The training program is designed to give new employees a better understanding of our products.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫的目的是讓新員工更了解我們的產品。

sentences.en: We apologize for the delay and thank you for your understanding during this busy period.
sentences.zh: 我們為延誤致歉，並感謝您在這段忙碌期間的諒解。

words.note: 語塊：thank you for your understanding（感謝您的諒解）、a good understanding of（對……有很好的了解）、reach an understanding（達成協議）。understanding 是名詞「理解」，也可以當形容詞「體諒的」。

sentences.en: Workers must wear gloves when they handle any harmful substance in the laboratory or the factory.
sentences.zh: 工作人員在實驗室處理任何有害物質時都必須戴手套。

sentences.en: The factory was fined for allowing a chemical substance to flow into the river near the town.
sentences.zh: 那座工廠因為讓一種化學物質流進鎮上附近的河川而被罰款。

sentences.en: The report was long, but it seemed to lack substance and did not offer any new ideas.
sentences.zh: 那份報告很長，但似乎缺乏實質內容，也沒有提出任何新想法。

sentences.en: Please store every chemical substance in the locked cabinet and label it clearly with its name.
sentences.zh: 請把每一種化學物質存放在上鎖的櫃子裡，並清楚標上名稱。

sentences.en: Scientists found a harmful substance in the water, so residents were told not to drink it.
sentences.zh: 科學家在水中發現一種有害物質，所以居民被告知不要飲用。

words.note: 語塊：harmful substance（有害物質）、chemical substance（化學物質）、lack substance（缺乏實質內容）。substance 可以是「物質」或「內容的實質」；substantial 是形容詞「大量的；實質的」。

sentences.en: The company reported a substantial increase in profits after it began selling its products online.
sentences.zh: 公司開始在網路上販售產品後，獲利大幅增加。

sentences.en: The new factory will require a substantial amount of money, so the company will borrow from the bank.
sentences.zh: 新工廠需要相當大筆的資金，所以公司會向銀行借款。

sentences.en: The manager made substantial changes to the plan after listening to feedback from the team.
sentences.zh: 經理聽取團隊的意見後，對計畫做了重大修改。

sentences.en: There has been a substantial increase in the number of tourists visiting the island this year.
sentences.zh: 今年造訪那座島的觀光客人數大幅增加。

sentences.en: Renovating the old hotel will take a substantial amount of time, so it will be closed for a year.
sentences.zh: 翻修那家老飯店需要相當長的時間，所以會停業一年。

words.note: 語塊：substantial increase（大幅增加）、substantial amount（相當大的數量）、substantial changes（重大改變）。substantial 是「數量或程度很大的」；considerable 意思接近；substance 是名詞。

sentences.en: The new company will occupy the entire tenth floor of the office building starting next month.
sentences.zh: 新公司從下個月起將佔用辦公大樓的整個十樓。

sentences.en: The new furniture will occupy a space that was used for storage, so please move the boxes today.
sentences.zh: 新家具會佔用原本用來存放東西的空間，所以請今天把箱子搬走。

sentences.en: Large machines occupy most of the space in the factory, so there is little room for storage.
sentences.zh: 大型機器佔用了工廠大部分的空間，所以幾乎沒有存放的地方。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim will occupy the position of director until a permanent replacement is found later this year.
sentences.zh: 在找到正式接替者之前，金先生會擔任總監一職。

sentences.en: Restaurants that occupy a space in the shopping center must pay rent as well as a monthly maintenance fee.
sentences.zh: 在購物中心佔用空間的餐廳必須繳房租以及每月管理費。

words.note: 語塊：occupy a space（佔用空間）、occupy most of（佔用大部分的……）、occupy a position（擔任職位）。occupy 是「佔據（空間、時間）」；occupied 是「有人的、被佔用的」；occupation 是「職業」。

sentences.en: The team spent a great deal of time preparing for the presentation, and the clients were impressed.
sentences.zh: 團隊花了很多時間準備簡報，客戶印象很深刻。

sentences.en: The company invested a great deal of money in new technology to make its factory more efficient.
sentences.zh: 公司投資了大筆金錢在新科技上，讓工廠更有效率。

sentences.en: Organizing an international conference requires a great deal of planning and careful communication with every speaker.
sentences.zh: 籌辦國際研討會需要大量的規劃和仔細的溝通。

sentences.en: Ms. Park has a great deal of experience in marketing, so she was chosen to lead the new campaign.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐在行銷方面經驗豐富，所以被選來帶領新的活動。

sentences.en: The new law has caused a great deal of confusion among small business owners in the region.
sentences.zh: 新法律在該地區的小企業老闆之間造成很大的困惑。

words.note: 語塊：a great deal of time（很多時間）、a great deal of money（很多錢）、a great deal of experience（豐富的經驗）、a great deal of planning（大量的規劃）。a great deal of 後面接不可數名詞（time、money、work）；a large number of 接可數名詞。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz decided to dedicate herself to helping children in rural areas after she retired from the bank.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐從銀行退休後，決定致力於幫助鄉村地區的孩子。

sentences.en: Managers should dedicate time to meeting with each member of their team at least once a month.
sentences.zh: 經理應該每個月至少花時間和每位組員見一次面。

sentences.en: The company will dedicate one floor of the new building to research and the development of new products.
sentences.zh: 公司將把新大樓的一層樓專門用來做研究和開發新產品。

sentences.en: The author chose to dedicate the book to her parents, who encouraged her to become a writer.
sentences.zh: 那位作家選擇把書獻給鼓勵她成為作家的父母。

sentences.en: Many volunteers dedicate their weekends to cleaning the beaches and parks in the city every month.
sentences.zh: 很多志工把週末時間奉獻給清理城市的海灘和公園。

words.note: 語塊：dedicate oneself to（致力於……）、dedicate time to（把時間用在……）、be dedicated to（專門用於）。dedicate 是「把時間、精力奉獻給」；dedication 是名詞；devote 意思接近。

words.meaning: 令人信服地；有說服力地

sentences.en: Ms. Park argued convincingly that the company should invest more money in online advertising next year.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐有說服力地論證公司應該在網路廣告上投入更多錢。

sentences.en: The team won convincingly in the final game, scoring five goals in the first half alone.
sentences.zh: 球隊在決賽中大勝，光是上半場就進了五球。

sentences.en: The speaker explained convincingly why electric cars will become much cheaper over the next decade.
sentences.zh: 講者令人信服地說明了電動車為什麼在未來十年會變得更便宜。

sentences.en: The lawyer argued convincingly that her client had not broken any part of the contract.
sentences.zh: 律師有說服力地主張她的客戶沒有違反合約的任何部分。

sentences.en: The new product performed convincingly in the tests, so the company decided to launch it in May.
sentences.zh: 新產品在測試中表現令人信服，所以公司決定在五月上市。

words.note: 語塊：argue convincingly（有說服力地論證）、win convincingly（大勝）、explained convincingly（令人信服地說明）、performed convincingly（表現令人信服）。convincingly 是副詞；convincing 是形容詞「有說服力的」；convince 是動詞「說服」。

sentences.en: Sales of electric cars have increased sharply as more charging stations are built in the city.
sentences.zh: 隨著城裡興建更多充電站，電動車的銷售急劇增加。

sentences.en: Our electric bill was much higher this summer because we used the air conditioner every day.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天我們的電費帳單高很多，因為每天都開冷氣。

sentences.en: Many commuters now ride an electric bicycle to work because it is fast and does not cause pollution.
sentences.zh: 很多通勤族現在騎電動自行車上班，因為很快又不會造成污染。

sentences.en: The company plans to replace all of its delivery trucks with electric vehicles by next year.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在明年前把所有送貨卡車換成電動車。

sentences.en: The hotel offers free charging for guests who arrive in an electric car and park in the garage.
sentences.zh: 飯店為開電動車來、停在停車場的客人提供免費充電。

words.note: 語塊：electric car（電動車）、electric bill（電費帳單）、electric bicycle（電動自行車）。electric 是「用電的」；electrical 是「和電有關的」（electrical engineer 電機工程師）；electronic 是「電子的」。

sentences.en: The two companies formed a joint venture to build electric cars for the Asian market.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司成立一家合資企業，為亞洲市場製造電動車。

sentences.en: Opening a restaurant is a risky business venture, but Mr. Lopez is confident it will succeed.
sentences.zh: 開餐廳是一項有風險的商業投資，但 Lopez 先生有信心會成功。

sentences.en: After leaving the bank, Ms. Kim started a new venture that sells organic coffee online.
sentences.zh: 離開銀行後，金小姐創辦了一個在網路上賣有機咖啡的新事業。

sentences.en: The joint venture between the two airlines will offer more flights to Europe starting next year.
sentences.zh: 兩家航空公司的合資企業明年起將提供更多飛往歐洲的航班。

sentences.en: Investors were interested in the new venture because it uses technology to reduce food waste.
sentences.zh: 投資人對那個新事業很有興趣，因為它用科技減少食物浪費。

words.note: 語塊：business venture（商業投資）、joint venture（合資企業）、new venture（新事業）。venture 是「有風險的新事業」；adventure 是「冒險」；venture capital 是「創投資金」。

sentences.en: The two companies will meet next week to formalize the agreement and sign the contract.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司下週會見面，正式簽訂協議並簽署合約。

sentences.en: The manager wants to formalize the plan before presenting it to the board of directors.
sentences.zh: 經理想在向董事會報告之前，把計畫正式化。

sentences.en: After working together for a year, the two firms decided to formalize their partnership with a new contract.
sentences.zh: 合作一年後，兩家公司決定讓合作關係正式化。

sentences.en: The city will formalize the new rules for street parking at its meeting on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 市政府將在週四的會議上把街道停車的新規定正式化。

sentences.en: We need to formalize the process for approving expenses so that every department follows the same rules.
sentences.zh: 我們需要把核准支出的流程正式化，讓每個部門都遵守相同的規定。

words.note: 語塊：formalize an agreement（正式簽訂協議）、formalize a plan（將計畫正式化）、formalize their partnership（使合作正式化）、formalize the process（使流程正式化）。formalize 是「讓事情變成正式的」；formal 是形容詞「正式的」。

sentences.en: Please bring an umbrella in case it rains during the outdoor concert in the park this evening.
sentences.zh: 請帶把傘，以防今晚戶外音樂會時下雨。

sentences.en: In case of fire, please use the stairs to leave the building and do not take the elevator.
sentences.zh: 萬一發生火災，請走樓梯，不要搭電梯。

sentences.en: I will print an extra copy of the report just in case someone forgets theirs.
sentences.zh: 我會多印一份報告，以防萬一有人忘了帶。

sentences.en: Save your work often in case the computer stops working suddenly during the busy afternoon.
sentences.zh: 經常存檔，以防電腦下午突然當機。

sentences.en: The hotel keeps extra blankets in every room in case guests feel cold during the night.
sentences.zh: 飯店在每間房間都放了額外的毯子，以防客人晚上覺得冷。

words.note: 語塊：in case of（如果發生……）、just in case（以防萬一）。in case + 子句 是「以防……」；in case of + 名詞 是「萬一發生……時」。

sentences.en: Applicants should have at least three years of work experience in sales or customer service.
sentences.zh: 應徵者應該在業務或客服方面至少有三年的工作經驗。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee has many years of experience in marketing, so she will lead the new advertising campaign.
sentences.zh: 李小姐在行銷方面有多年經驗，所以由她帶領新的廣告活動。

sentences.en: Working abroad for a year was a great experience that helped him learn a new language.
sentences.zh: 在國外工作一年是很棒的經歷，幫助他學會了一種新語言。

sentences.en: The hotel wants every guest to have a pleasant experience, from the moment they check in to the moment they check out.
sentences.zh: 飯店希望每位客人從入住到退房都有愉快的體驗。

sentences.en: Interns gain valuable work experience that helps them find full-time jobs after graduation from university.
sentences.zh: 實習生獲得寶貴的工作經驗，幫助他們畢業後找到全職工作。

words.note: 語塊：work experience（工作經驗）、years of experience（多年經驗）、a great experience（很棒的經歷）。experience 當「經驗」時不可數；當「一次經歷」時可數（a great experience）；experienced 是形容詞。

sentences.en: Please contact Ms. Ruiz if you have any questions concerning the new vacation policy for next year.
sentences.zh: 如果你對新的休假規定有任何問題，請聯絡 Ruiz 小姐。

sentences.en: The manager sent an email concerning the changes to the schedule for next week's training.
sentences.zh: 經理寄了一封關於下週訓練時程變更的電子郵件。

sentences.en: I am writing concerning the order that I placed last week, which has not arrived yet.
sentences.zh: 我來信是關於我上週下的訂單，到現在還沒送到。

sentences.en: The board will discuss several issues concerning the budget at its monthly meeting next Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 董事會將在下週二的會議上討論幾個關於預算的問題。

sentences.en: Information concerning the matter will be shared with all employees once the investigation is complete.
sentences.zh: 調查完成後，關於這件事的資訊會分享給所有員工。

words.note: 語塊：concerning the matter（關於這件事）、questions concerning（關於……的問題）、concerning the changes（關於變更）、concerning the order（關於訂單）、issues concerning（關於……的議題）。concerning 和 regarding、about 意思相同，比較正式；concerned 是「擔心的」。

sentences.en: Customers who are not satisfied with their purchase can receive a full refund within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 對購買的商品不滿意的顧客可以在三十天內獲得全額退款。

sentences.en: To request a refund, please fill out the form on our website and include your order number.
sentences.zh: 要申請退款，請填寫我們網站上的表格並附上訂單編號。

sentences.en: Passengers whose flights were canceled will receive a refund within five business days of the cancellation.
sentences.zh: 航班被取消的乘客會在五個工作天內收到退款。

sentences.en: The store does not give a refund for sale items, but customers can exchange them for other products.
sentences.zh: 那家店特價商品不退款，但顧客可以換其他商品。

sentences.en: If the product arrives damaged, please contact us immediately to request a refund or a replacement.
sentences.zh: 如果產品送到時已損壞，請立刻聯絡我們申請退款或換貨。

words.note: 語塊：full refund（全額退款）、request a refund（要求退款）、receive a refund（收到退款）。refund 可以當名詞或動詞「退款」；refundable 是形容詞「可退款的」。

sentences.en: Doctors recommend a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains for everyone.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議多吃水果、蔬菜和全穀類的均衡飲食。

sentences.en: The city council passed a balanced budget that does not require any increase in taxes.
sentences.zh: 市議會通過了一份不需要加稅的平衡預算。

sentences.en: The report gives a balanced view of the benefits and risks of working from home.
sentences.zh: 報告平衡地呈現了在家工作的好處和風險。

sentences.en: The school cafeteria serves well-balanced meals that are healthy and affordable for students of all ages.
sentences.zh: 學校餐廳供應健康又平價、營養均衡的餐點給學生。

sentences.en: Eating a balanced diet and exercising regularly can help employees stay healthy and productive at work.
sentences.zh: 均衡飲食和規律運動能幫助員工保持健康和工作效率。

words.note: 語塊：balanced diet（均衡飲食）、balanced budget（平衡的預算）、well-balanced（很均衡的）。balanced 是「各方面平均的」；balance 是名詞「平衡；餘額」或動詞「使平衡」。

sentences.en: Good communication is a key element of successful teamwork in any large company or school.
sentences.zh: 良好的溝通是任何公司成功團隊合作的關鍵要素。

sentences.en: The new office design includes a traditional element in every room, such as wooden doors or paper lamps.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室的設計在每個房間都加入一個傳統元素，例如木門或紙燈。

sentences.en: There is always an element of risk when a company decides to enter a new market.
sentences.zh: 公司決定進入新市場時總是有一定的風險。

sentences.en: Customer service is a key element of our success, so we train every employee carefully.
sentences.zh: 客服是我們成功的關鍵要素，所以我們仔細訓練每位員工。

sentences.en: The designer added a modern element to the old building by installing large glass windows.
sentences.zh: 設計師裝了大型玻璃窗，為那棟老建築加入現代元素。

words.note: 語塊：key element（關鍵要素）、an element of（……的成分）、design element（設計元素）。element 是「組成的一部分」；component 意思接近；elementary 是「基礎的；初級的」。

sentences.en: The museum is famous for its architectural design, which uses glass and natural light in creative ways.
sentences.zh: 那座博物館以建築設計聞名，以很有創意的方式運用玻璃和自然光。

sentences.en: The old part of the city has buildings in many different architectural styles from the past three centuries.
sentences.zh: 老城區有過去三百年來許多不同建築風格的建築。

sentences.en: The company hired an architectural firm to design its new headquarters near the river and the park.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一家建築事務所設計河邊的新總部。

sentences.en: Visitors can join a free tour to learn about the architectural history of the city's old train station.
sentences.zh: 遊客可以參加免費導覽，了解城市舊火車站的建築歷史。

sentences.en: The new library won an award for its architectural design and its use of recycled materials.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館因為建築設計和回收材料的運用而獲獎。

words.note: 語塊：architectural design（建築設計）、architectural style（建築風格）、architectural firm（建築事務所）。architectural 是形容詞；architecture 是名詞「建築」；architect 是「建築師」。

sentences.en: Because of the impending storm, all flights to the island have been canceled for tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 因為暴風雨即將來臨，明天所有飛往那座島的航班都取消了。

sentences.en: The team worked late every night this week because of the impending deadline for the project.
sentences.zh: 因為專案截止日迫近，團隊這週每晚都加班。

sentences.en: Employees are worried about the impending changes to the company after the merger is completed.
sentences.zh: 員工擔心合併完成後公司即將到來的改變。

sentences.en: The city warned residents about the impending storm and asked them to stay inside on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 市政府警告居民暴風雨即將來臨，要求他們週六待在室內。

sentences.en: The manager held a meeting to explain the impending changes to the vacation policy next year.
sentences.zh: 經理開會說明明年休假規定即將到來的改變。

words.note: 語塊：impending storm（即將來臨的暴風雨）、impending deadline（迫近的截止日）、impending changes（即將到來的改變）。impending 多用在不好的事「快要發生了」；upcoming 比較中性。

sentences.en: The government plans to invest in alternative energy such as solar and wind power over the next decade.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫在未來十年投資太陽能和風力等替代能源。

sentences.en: Many companies are looking for alternative energy sources to reduce their use of oil and coal.
sentences.zh: 很多公司在尋找替代能源來源，以減少石油和煤的使用。

sentences.en: The conference will discuss how cities can use more alternative energy in their public buildings.
sentences.zh: 研討會將討論城市如何在公共建築中使用更多替代能源。

sentences.en: The university received a large grant to study alternative energy and develop cheaper solar panels.
sentences.zh: 那所大學獲得一大筆補助，研究替代能源並開發更便宜的太陽能板。

sentences.en: Investing in alternative energy can create new jobs and help protect the environment at the same time.
sentences.zh: 投資替代能源能創造新工作，同時幫助保護環境。

words.note: 語塊：invest in alternative energy（投資替代能源）、alternative energy sources（替代能源來源）。alternative energy 指太陽能、風力等取代化石燃料的能源；renewable energy 是「再生能源」。

sentences.en: The park installed solar-powered lights along the walking paths so that they turn on automatically at night.
sentences.zh: 公園沿著步道安裝了太陽能燈，晚上會自動亮起。

sentences.en: The company is developing a solar-powered car that can travel five hundred kilometers on a sunny day.
sentences.zh: 那家公司正在開發一款晴天可以跑五百公里的太陽能車。

sentences.en: Many farms in the region use solar-powered pumps to bring water from the river to their fields.
sentences.zh: 該地區很多農場用太陽能幫浦把水引到田裡。

sentences.en: The new solar-powered charger allows hikers to charge their phones while they are in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 新的太陽能充電器讓登山客在山上也能為手機充電。

sentences.en: The school's solar-powered roof produces enough electricity for all of its classrooms during the day.
sentences.zh: 學校的太陽能屋頂白天產生的電足夠供應所有教室。

words.note: 語塊：solar-powered car（太陽能車）、solar-powered lights（太陽能燈）、solar-powered pumps（太陽能幫浦）、solar-powered charger（太陽能充電器）、solar-powered roof（太陽能屋頂）。solar-powered 放在名詞前要加連字號；solar 是「太陽的」；solar panel 是「太陽能板」。

sentences.en: As requested, I have attached a copy of the contract and the price list for your review.
sentences.zh: 如您所要求，我附上了一份合約副本和價目表供您審閱。

sentences.en: Please send the requested information to our office by Friday so that we can process your application.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前把所要求的資料寄到我們辦公室，讓我們處理你的申請。
