sentences.en: The hotel prepared the room as requested, with flowers and a bottle of wine on the table.
sentences.zh: 飯店照要求準備了房間，桌上放了花和一瓶葡萄酒。

sentences.en: The requested documents must be submitted before the end of the month, or the loan cannot be approved.
sentences.zh: 所要求的文件必須在月底前提交，否則貸款無法核准。

sentences.en: The meeting has been moved to Thursday as requested by the client, who will be traveling on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 會議應客戶要求改到週四，因為客戶週三要出差。

words.note: 語塊：as requested（如您所要求）、requested information（所要求的資料）、requested documents（所要求的文件）。requested 是「被要求的」；request 可以當名詞或動詞「要求」。

sentences.en: The old building must be repaired and brought up to code before people can move into it again.
sentences.zh: 那棟舊建築必須修好並符合法規，人們才能再搬進去。

sentences.en: The inspector checked whether the electrical system in the restaurant's kitchen was up to code.
sentences.zh: 檢查員檢查餐廳的電力系統是否符合法規。

sentences.en: The landlord spent a lot of money to bring the apartments up to code after the inspection.
sentences.zh: 檢查之後，房東花了很多錢讓公寓符合法規。

sentences.en: All of the fire exits in the hotel are up to code and are checked by the city every year.
sentences.zh: 飯店所有的逃生出口都符合法規，每年都由市政府檢查。

sentences.en: The school cannot open until the new playground is up to code and has passed a safety inspection.
sentences.zh: 新遊樂場符合法規並通過安全檢查之前，學校不能開學。

words.note: 語塊：bring up to code（使符合法規）、be up to code（符合法規）。up to code 指建築、電線等「符合安全法規」；code 在這裡是「法規」。

sentences.en: Students must write an essay of at least one thousand words about a business they admire.
sentences.zh: 學生必須寫一篇至少一千字、關於一家他們欣賞的企業的文章。

sentences.en: The winner of the essay contest will receive a scholarship to study abroad for one year.
sentences.zh: 作文比賽的優勝者將獲得一年出國留學的獎學金。

sentences.en: The magazine published an essay on the future of work by a famous economist from Harvard University.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌刊登了一位知名經濟學家關於未來工作的文章。

sentences.en: Applicants for the program must submit an essay that explains why they want to study engineering.
sentences.zh: 申請這個計畫的人必須提交一篇文章，說明他們為什麼想讀工程。

sentences.en: The professor asked each student to write an essay about the effects of social media on young people.
sentences.zh: 教授要每位學生寫一篇關於社群媒體對年輕人影響的文章。

words.note: 語塊：write an essay（寫文章）、essay contest（作文比賽）、essay on（關於……的文章）。essay 是「短篇文章、論說文」；assay 是「化驗」，長得像。

sentences.en: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty that covers any problems with the screen or battery.
sentences.zh: 那台筆電附有兩年保固，涵蓋螢幕或電池的任何問題。

sentences.en: If your phone is still under warranty, we will repair it for free at any of our service centers.
sentences.zh: 如果你的手機還在保固期內，我們任何一家服務中心都會免費維修。

sentences.en: Customers can extend the warranty for an additional three years by paying a small fee.
sentences.zh: 顧客只要付一小筆費用，就能把保固再延長三年。

sentences.en: The warranty does not cover damage caused by water, so please be careful with the device.
sentences.zh: 保固不包含水損，所以請小心使用裝置。

sentences.en: Please keep your receipt, as you will need it if you want to make a claim under the warranty.
sentences.zh: 請保留收據，因為如果你要申請保固，就會需要它。

words.note: 語塊：under warranty（在保固期內）、extend the warranty（延長保固）、a two-year warranty（兩年保固）。warranty 是「產品保固」；guarantee 意思接近；warrant 是「搜索令；保證」。

sentences.en: The plan to build a new airport near the wetlands has been criticized by every environmentalist group in the region.
sentences.zh: 在濕地附近興建新機場的計畫遭到該地區每個環保團體的批評。

sentences.en: A famous environmentalist will give a talk at the university about ways to reduce plastic waste.
sentences.zh: 一位知名環保人士將在大學演講，談減少塑膠垃圾的方法。

sentences.en: The company invited an environmentalist to help design a factory that uses less water and energy.
sentences.zh: 公司邀請一位環保人士協助設計一座用水和用電都更少的工廠。

sentences.en: Each environmentalist at the meeting asked the city to plant more trees along the busy roads.
sentences.zh: 會議上的每位環保人士都要求市政府在繁忙的道路旁多種樹。

sentences.en: The documentary follows an environmentalist who spent ten years protecting forests and rivers in South America.
sentences.zh: 那部紀錄片記錄一位花了十年保護南美森林的環保人士。

words.note: 語塊：environmentalist group（環保團體）、a famous environmentalist（知名環保人士）、invited an environmentalist（邀請一位環保人士）、each environmentalist（每位環保人士）。environmentalist 是「關心並推動環保的人」；environmental 是形容詞「環境的」。

sentences.en: The speaker will make reference to several recent studies about the benefits of working from home.
sentences.zh: 講者將提到幾項關於在家工作好處的最新研究。

sentences.en: In her report, the manager did not make reference to the problems that the team had last month.
sentences.zh: 經理在報告中沒有提到團隊上個月遇到的問題。

sentences.en: Please make reference to your order number when you contact our customer service team by email.
sentences.zh: 聯絡我們的客服團隊時，請提及你的訂單編號。

sentences.en: The article makes no reference to the company's plans, and it does not make reference to its new CEO either.
sentences.zh: 那篇文章沒有提到公司的計畫，也沒有提及它的新執行長。

sentences.en: Students should make reference to at least three books when they write their essays this semester.
sentences.zh: 學生這學期寫文章時應該參考至少三本書。

words.note: 語塊：make reference to（提及……）。make reference to 比 mention 正式；refer to 意思相同；reference 是名詞「參考」。

sentences.en: The new prices reflect the rising cost of materials and transportation over the past year.
sentences.zh: 新價格反映了過去一年材料和運輸成本的上漲。

sentences.en: Please take some time to reflect on what went well and what could be improved after the project.
sentences.zh: 專案結束後，請花點時間反思哪些地方做得好、哪些可以改進。

sentences.en: The report will reflect the changes that were made to the budget at last week's meeting.
sentences.zh: 報告會反映上週會議對預算所做的修改。

sentences.en: The growing number of customers who return every year seems to reflect the success of our new service.
sentences.zh: 每年回購的顧客越來越多，似乎反映出我們新服務的成功。

sentences.en: The large windows reflect the sunlight, which keeps the inside of the building cool in summer.
sentences.zh: 大窗戶會反射陽光，讓建築內部在夏天保持涼爽。

words.note: 語塊：reflect on（反思……）、reflect the changes（反映變化）、reflect the success（反映成功）。reflect 可以是「反映」或「反射（光）」；reflection 是名詞「倒影；反思」。

sentences.en: The airline decided to suspend service to the island until the damage from the storm is repaired.
sentences.zh: 航空公司決定暫停飛往那座島的服務，直到暴風雨的損害修復為止。

sentences.en: The factory will suspend production for two weeks while new machines are installed and tested.
sentences.zh: 安裝新機器期間，工廠將暫停生產兩週。

sentences.en: The bank may suspend your account if it notices any unusual activity, so please check your email.
sentences.zh: 如果銀行發現任何異常活動，可能會暫停你的帳戶，所以請查看你的電子郵件。

sentences.en: The city had to suspend train service on the northern line because of problems with the tracks.
sentences.zh: 因為軌道出問題，市政府只好暫停北線的列車服務。

sentences.en: The company will suspend the sale of the product until the safety problem has been solved.
sentences.zh: 公司會暫停販售那項產品，直到安全問題解決為止。

words.note: 語塊：suspend service（暫停服務）、suspend production（暫停生產）、be suspended from（被停職）。suspend 是「暫時停止」；suspension 是名詞；cancel 是「取消」。

sentences.en: If you need assistance with your luggage, please ask a member of our staff at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要協助搬行李，請找櫃台的工作人員。

sentences.en: The government will provide financial assistance to families who lost their homes in the flood.
sentences.zh: 政府將為在水災中失去家園的家庭提供經濟援助。

sentences.en: Please do not hesitate to ask for assistance if you have any problems with the new software.
sentences.zh: 如果你使用新軟體有任何問題，請不要猶豫，儘管尋求協助。

sentences.en: The volunteers provide assistance to elderly people who need help with shopping, cooking, and cleaning.
sentences.zh: 志工為需要幫忙購物和打掃的長者提供協助。

sentences.en: Students who need financial assistance can apply for a scholarship before the end of March.
sentences.zh: 需要經濟援助的學生可以在三月底前申請獎學金。

words.note: 語塊：ask for assistance（請求協助）、provide assistance（提供協助）、financial assistance（經濟援助）。assistance 是不可數名詞；assistant 是「助理（人）」；assist 是動詞。

sentences.en: Please do not duplicate any confidential documents without written permission from your manager or the director.
sentences.zh: 未經經理許可，請不要複製任何機密文件。

sentences.en: The two departments should work together so that they do not duplicate efforts on the same project.
sentences.zh: 兩個部門應該合作，以免在同一個專案上重複做工。

sentences.en: The store can duplicate your key in five minutes while you wait at the counter.
sentences.zh: 那家店可以在你在櫃台等候時，五分鐘內幫你打一把備份鑰匙。

sentences.en: The new software will duplicate the files automatically so that nothing is lost if a computer breaks.
sentences.zh: 新軟體會自動複製檔案，這樣電腦壞掉時也不會遺失任何東西。

sentences.en: It is difficult to duplicate the success of the first product, but the team is working hard to do so.
sentences.zh: 要複製第一項產品的成功很難，但團隊正努力這麼做。

words.note: 語塊：duplicate a document（複製文件）、duplicate efforts（重複做工）、duplicate your key（打備份鑰匙）、duplicate the files（複製檔案）、duplicate the success（複製成功）。duplicate 可以當動詞「複製」或名詞「副本」；a duplicate key 是「備份鑰匙」。

sentences.en: Customers can return a product within thirty days if they are not satisfied with it.
sentences.zh: 顧客如果不滿意，可以在三十天內退貨。

sentences.en: Please return the borrowed equipment to the IT department before you leave for the weekend on Friday.
sentences.zh: 週五離開前，請把借用的設備歸還資訊部。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee will return to the office on Monday after attending the conference in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 李小姐參加完東京的研討會後，週一會回到辦公室。

sentences.en: I am sorry I missed your phone call this morning, and I will return a call as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉我今天早上錯過你的電話，我會盡快回電。

sentences.en: Library books must be returned within two weeks, and members who return them late must pay a fine.
sentences.zh: 圖書館的書必須在兩週內歸還，逾期歸還的會員必須繳罰款。

words.note: 語塊：return a product（退貨）、return to（回到……）、return a call（回電）。return 本身就是「回去、歸還」，不要說 return back；returnable 是「可退回的」。

sentences.en: The city plans to name the new library after the author who donated money to build it.
sentences.zh: 市政府打算以捐款興建新圖書館的那位作家為它命名。

sentences.en: The board decided to name Ms. Park as the new director of the marketing department.
sentences.zh: 董事會決定任命朴小姐為行銷部的新總監。

sentences.en: The seller refused to name a price until he had seen the condition of the car.
sentences.zh: 賣家在看到車子的狀況之前拒絕開價。

sentences.en: The magazine will name the best restaurant in the city in its special issue next month.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌將在下個月的特刊中選出城裡最好的餐廳。

sentences.en: The company plans to name its new product after the small village where its founder was born.
sentences.zh: 公司打算以創辦人出生的小村莊為新產品命名。

words.note: 語塊：name A after B（以 B 為 A 命名）、be named as（被任命為）、name a price（開價）。name 當動詞是「命名」或「任命」；name after 是「以……命名」。

sentences.en: Mr. Lopez decided to found a company that helps small farms sell their products online.
sentences.zh: Lopez 先生決定創立一家幫助小農場在網路上賣產品的公司。

sentences.en: The two friends plan to found a design studio together after they graduate from university.
sentences.zh: 那兩位朋友打算大學畢業後一起創立一間設計工作室。

sentences.en: The wealthy family wants to found a museum that will display the paintings they collected from around the world.
sentences.zh: 那個富裕家族想創立一座博物館，展示他們從世界各地收藏的畫作。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim used her savings to found a school that teaches computer skills to elderly people.
sentences.zh: 金小姐用她的積蓄創立了一所教長者電腦技能的學校。

sentences.en: It takes a lot of courage to found a company in a small garage and grow it into a global business.
sentences.zh: 在小車庫創立公司並把它發展成全球企業，需要很大的勇氣。

words.note: 語塊：found a company（創立公司）、found a school（創立學校）。found 當「創立」時是規則動詞（found-founded-founded）；別和 find 的過去式 found 搞混；founder 是「創辦人」。

sentences.en: The board decided to reject the proposal because the costs were much higher than expected.
sentences.zh: 董事會決定否決那份提案，因為成本比預期高很多。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee chose to reject the offer from the bank because she wanted to stay at her current company.
sentences.zh: 李小姐選擇拒絕那家銀行的邀約，因為她想留在現在的公司。

sentences.en: The bank may reject an application for a loan if the applicant does not have a stable income.
sentences.zh: 如果申請人沒有穩定收入，銀行可能會駁回貸款申請。

sentences.en: The factory will reject any parts that do not meet its quality standards and return them to the supplier.
sentences.zh: 工廠會拒收任何不符合品質標準的零件，並退回給供應商。

sentences.en: The city council voted to reject the plan to build a shopping center next to the old park.
sentences.zh: 市議會投票否決了在老公園旁蓋購物中心的計畫。

words.note: 語塊：reject a proposal（否決提案）、reject an offer（拒絕提議）、reject an application（駁回申請）。reject 比 refuse 更正式，常用在提案、申請；rejection 是名詞。

sentences.en: The chairman will convene a meeting of the board next week to discuss the merger.
sentences.zh: 主席下週將召開董事會會議討論合併。

sentences.en: The city decided to convene a committee to study the problem of traffic in the downtown area.
sentences.zh: 市政府決定召集一個委員會研究市中心的交通問題。

sentences.en: The organizers will convene the conference in Singapore because it is easy to reach from many countries.
sentences.zh: 主辦單位將在新加坡召開研討會，因為從很多國家都很容易抵達。

sentences.en: The manager plans to convene a meeting of all department heads on Friday morning in the main office.
sentences.zh: 經理打算週五早上召集所有部門主管開會。

sentences.en: The committee will convene again next month to review the results of the new program.
sentences.zh: 委員會將在下個月再次召開，檢討新計畫的成果。

words.note: 語塊：convene a meeting（召開會議）、convene a committee（召集委員會）。convene 是「正式召集（會議）」；convention 是名詞「大會」；convenient 是「方便的」。

sentences.en: The new design will combine traditional materials with modern technology to create a unique building.
sentences.zh: 新設計將結合傳統材料和現代科技，打造一棟獨特的建築。

sentences.en: The two companies decided to combine forces in order to compete with larger firms in the market.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司決定聯手，和市場上更大的公司競爭。

sentences.en: The course will combine online lessons with practice sessions at the main office every Friday.
sentences.zh: 這門課將結合線上課程和每週五在辦公室的實作課。

sentences.en: Many travelers combine a business trip with a short vacation so that they can see more of the country.
sentences.zh: 很多旅客把出差和短暫的假期結合在一起，好多看看那個國家。

sentences.en: The restaurant's new menu will combine dishes from Japan and Italy in creative and delicious ways.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的新菜單將以創意的方式結合日本和義大利的料理。

words.note: 語塊：combine A with B（把 A 和 B 結合）、combine forces（聯手）。combine 是「把兩個以上的東西放在一起」；combination 是名詞「組合」。

sentences.en: Visitors to the old town can witness a traditional festival every spring, when the streets are filled with music.
sentences.zh: 到老城區的遊客每年春天都能親眼看到傳統慶典，那時街上充滿音樂。

sentences.en: Anyone who saw or might witness an accident on the highway should report it to the police immediately.
sentences.zh: 任何在公路上看到或目睹事故的人都應該立刻向警方通報。

sentences.en: Over the past decade, the city has been able to witness a big change in the way people travel to work.
sentences.zh: 過去十年，這座城市見證了人們通勤方式的巨大改變。

sentences.en: Visitors to the factory can witness every step of the process used to make the famous chocolate.
sentences.zh: 參觀工廠的遊客可以親眼看到製作那款知名巧克力的每一個步驟。

sentences.en: Many people traveled to the coast to witness the launch of the new ship on Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 很多人前往海岸，見證週六早上新船的下水典禮。

words.note: 語塊：witness an accident（目擊事故）、witness a change（見證改變）、witness every step（親眼看到每一個步驟）、witness the launch（見證下水／發表）、witness a traditional festival（親眼看到傳統慶典）。witness 可以當動詞「目睹」或名詞「目擊者；證人」。

sentences.en: Please deliver the furniture on the specified date, as no one will be at home on other days.
sentences.zh: 請在指定日期送家具過來，因為其他日子家裡沒人。

sentences.en: All work must be completed as specified in the contract, including the type of materials used.
sentences.zh: 所有工作都必須依照合約規定完成，包括所使用的材料種類。

sentences.en: Unless otherwise specified, all prices on our website include tax and free delivery to your home.
sentences.zh: 除非另有規定，我們網站上的所有價格都含稅和免運費。

sentences.en: The package will arrive within the specified time, so please make sure someone is there to receive it.
sentences.zh: 包裹會在指定時間內送達，所以請確定有人在場簽收。

sentences.en: The building was designed as specified by the client, with large windows and an open kitchen.
sentences.zh: 那棟建築依照客戶的規定設計，有大窗戶和開放式廚房。

words.note: 語塊：specified date（指定日期）、unless otherwise specified（除非另有規定）、as specified（依照規定）。specified 是「被明確指定的」；specify 是動詞；specific 是「具體的」。

sentences.en: The store will display new merchandise in its windows every month to attract more customers.
sentences.zh: 那家店每個月都會在櫥窗陳列新商品，吸引更多顧客。

sentences.en: Customers who receive damaged merchandise can return it within thirty days for a full refund.
sentences.zh: 收到損壞商品的顧客可以在三十天內退貨並全額退款。

sentences.en: The museum shop sells merchandise such as books, posters, and cups with famous paintings on them.
sentences.zh: 博物館商店販售印有名畫的書、海報和杯子等商品。

sentences.en: The company plans to sell merchandise online as well as in its stores starting next month.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫從下個月起除了門市之外也在網路上販售商品。

sentences.en: All merchandise in the store will be fifty percent off during the closing sale this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這個週末結束營業特賣期間，店裡所有商品都打五折。

words.note: 語塊：sell merchandise（販售商品）、display merchandise（陳列商品）、damaged merchandise（損壞的商品）。merchandise 是不可數名詞（商品總稱）；merchant 是「商人」。

sentences.en: Many analysts speculate that the two companies will announce a merger at some point later this year.
sentences.zh: 很多分析師推測兩家公司今年稍晚會宣布合併。

sentences.en: Reporters continued to speculate about the reasons for the CEO's sudden resignation last Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 記者持續推測執行長突然辭職的原因。

sentences.en: It is too early to speculate about how the new law will affect small businesses in the region.
sentences.zh: 現在推測新法律會如何影響該地區的小企業還太早。

sentences.en: Some people speculate that housing prices will fall next year because interest rates are rising.
sentences.zh: 有些人猜測明年房價會下跌，因為利率正在上升。

sentences.en: The manager asked the staff not to speculate about the changes until the official announcement.
sentences.zh: 經理要求員工在正式宣布之前不要臆測會有什麼變動。

words.note: 語塊：speculate about（推測……）、speculate that（猜測……）。speculate 是「沒有確定的根據就猜」；speculation 是名詞；guess 意思接近。

sentences.en: Many people still book their vacations through a travel agent because it saves them time.
sentences.zh: 很多人還是透過旅行社業務預訂假期，因為比較省時間。

sentences.en: If you would like help planning your trip to Japan, please contact a travel agent at our office.
sentences.zh: 如果你想有人幫忙規劃日本之旅，請聯絡我們辦公室的旅行社業務。

sentences.en: The travel agent found a hotel near the beach that was much cheaper than the ones we found online.
sentences.zh: 旅行社業務找到一家海邊的飯店，比我們在網路上找到的便宜很多。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee worked as a travel agent for ten years before she started her own tour company.
sentences.zh: 李小姐當了十年旅行社業務，之後自己開了一家旅遊公司。

sentences.en: The company uses a travel agent to book flights and hotels for employees who go on business trips.
sentences.zh: 公司透過旅行社業務為出差的員工訂機票和飯店。

words.note: 語塊：contact a travel agent（聯絡旅行社）、book through a travel agent（透過旅行社預訂）、the travel agent found（旅行社業務找到了）、uses a travel agent（請旅行社業務）、work as a travel agent（擔任旅行社業務）。travel agent 是「幫人安排旅行的人」；travel agency 是「旅行社（公司）」。

sentences.en: Most employees characterize the new manager as friendly, patient, and very well organized in her work.
sentences.zh: 大部分員工形容新經理親切、有耐心又很有條理。

sentences.en: Most visitors characterize the city as a place with narrow streets, small shops, and very old buildings.
sentences.zh: 大部分遊客形容這座城市有狹窄的街道、小商店和非常古老的建築。

sentences.en: Critics characterize the new restaurant as one of the most creative places to eat in the city.
sentences.zh: 評論家形容那家新餐廳是城裡最有創意的用餐地點之一。

sentences.en: Customers usually characterize our company as reliable because of its excellent service and high-quality products.
sentences.zh: 顧客通常形容我們公司很可靠，因為服務優質、產品品質高。

sentences.en: How would you characterize the relationship between the sales team and the marketing team at your office?
sentences.zh: 你會如何描述業務團隊和行銷團隊之間的關係？

words.note: 語塊：characterize as（形容為……）、characterize the relationship（描述關係）、characterize the city（描述城市）。characterize 是「描述特點」或「是……的特徵」；character 是「特性；角色」；characteristic 是「特徵」。

sentences.en: Ms. Park received a promotion to senior manager after five years of excellent work at the company.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐在公司表現優秀五年後，獲得升遷成為資深經理。

sentences.en: The store is running a special promotion this week, with free gifts for customers who spend over fifty dollars.
sentences.zh: 那家店這週有特別促銷，消費超過五十美元的顧客可以拿到免費禮物。

sentences.en: The sales promotion helped the company sell all of its winter clothing before the end of the season.
sentences.zh: 促銷活動幫助公司在季末前賣光了所有冬季服飾。

sentences.en: Employees who complete the leadership course may be considered for a promotion at the end of next year.
sentences.zh: 完成領導力課程的員工明年可能會被考慮升遷。

sentences.en: The restaurant's new promotion offers a free dessert to every customer who orders a main dish.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的新促銷活動為每位點主餐的顧客招待一份免費甜點。

words.note: 語塊：get a promotion（獲得升遷）、sales promotion（促銷活動）、special promotion（特別促銷）、considered for a promotion（被考慮升遷）、new promotion（新促銷活動）。promotion 有「升職」和「促銷」兩個意思；promote 是動詞。

sentences.en: The hotel lobby is currently under renovation, so guests should use the side entrance this month.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳目前正在整修，所以客人這個月請使用側門。

sentences.en: The renovation of the old train station will take about two years and cost several million dollars.
sentences.zh: 舊火車站的整修大約需要兩年，花費好幾百萬美元。

sentences.en: Renovation work on the third floor may be noisy, so please close the doors to your offices.
sentences.zh: 三樓的整修工程可能會很吵，所以請關上辦公室的門。

sentences.en: The museum will reopen next month after it completes the renovation of its main exhibition hall.
sentences.zh: 博物館完成主展廳的翻修後，將在下個月重新開放。

sentences.en: The renovation of the kitchen included new cabinets, a larger refrigerator, and much better lighting.
sentences.zh: 廚房的翻修包括新櫥櫃、更大的冰箱和更好的照明。

words.note: 語塊：under renovation（整修中）、complete the renovation（完成翻修）、renovation work（整修工程）。renovation 是名詞；renovate 是動詞「翻新」；innovation 是「創新」。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim has extensive experience in international trade and speaks four different languages very fluently.
sentences.zh: 金先生在國際貿易方面經驗豐富，能流利說四種語言。

sentences.en: The company did extensive research before deciding to open a new store in the city center.
sentences.zh: 公司在決定於市中心開新店之前做了廣泛的研究。

sentences.en: The storm caused extensive damage to buildings along the coast, and many roads were closed.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨對海岸沿線的建築造成大面積的損害，很多道路封閉了。

sentences.en: The library has an extensive collection of books about history, art, science, and travel for all ages.
sentences.zh: 那座圖書館有大量關於歷史、藝術和科學的藏書。

sentences.en: The hotel offers an extensive breakfast menu with dishes from Asia, Europe, and North America.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供豐富的早餐菜單，有來自亞洲、歐洲和北美的料理。

words.note: 語塊：extensive experience（豐富的經驗）、extensive research（廣泛的研究）、extensive damage（大面積的損害）。extensive 是「範圍很大、很廣」；intensive 是「密集的」；extend 是動詞「延伸」。

sentences.en: The old facade of the theater was carefully restored to look exactly as it did one hundred years ago.
sentences.zh: 劇院的舊正面被仔細修復成和一百年前一模一樣。

sentences.en: The new hotel has a glass facade that reflects the mountains and the lake in front of it.
sentences.zh: 新飯店有一面玻璃正面，反射出前方的山和湖。

sentences.en: Workers will clean and paint the facade of the building during the summer, so please use the back door.
sentences.zh: 工人夏天會清潔並粉刷大樓正面，所以請走後門。

sentences.en: The city requires owners to keep the historic facade of their buildings when they renovate them.
sentences.zh: 市政府要求屋主翻修時保留建築的歷史正面。

sentences.en: The architect designed a modern facade for the museum, but the inside still looks very traditional.
sentences.zh: 建築師為博物館設計了現代的外觀，但內部看起來仍然非常傳統。

words.note: 語塊：building facade（建築正面）、restore the facade（修復正面外觀）。facade 是建築物「正面的外牆」，也可以比喻「表面的假象」；也寫作 façade。

words.meaning: 有競爭力的；競爭激烈的

sentences.en: The company offers a competitive salary and excellent benefits to attract talented engineers from around the world.
sentences.zh: 公司提供有競爭力的薪水和優渥的福利，吸引優秀的工程師。

sentences.en: Our products are sold at a competitive price, so many small businesses choose to buy from us.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品價格有競爭力，所以很多小企業選擇向我們購買。

sentences.en: The smartphone market is highly competitive, and companies must release new and better models every year.
sentences.zh: 手機市場競爭激烈，公司每年都必須推出新機型。

sentences.en: The hotel lowered its prices to stay competitive with the new hotels that opened near the airport.
sentences.zh: 飯店降價，以便和機場附近新開的飯店保持競爭力。

sentences.en: Applicants for the job will face a highly competitive process, as more than five hundred people have applied.
sentences.zh: 應徵這份工作的人將面臨激烈的競爭，因為已經有五百多人申請。

words.note: 語塊：competitive price（有競爭力的價格）、competitive salary（有競爭力的薪水）、highly competitive（競爭激烈的）。competitive 可以是「價格有吸引力」或「競爭激烈的」；compete 是動詞；competition 是名詞。

sentences.en: Our fast delivery service gives us a competitive edge over other online stores in the region.
sentences.zh: 我們快速的配送服務讓我們在地區網路商店中佔有競爭優勢。

sentences.en: The hotel is located on the edge of the city, so it is quiet but still close to the airport.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店位於城市邊緣，所以很安靜，但離機場還是很近。

sentences.en: The company invests heavily in research to stay at the cutting edge of technology in its industry.
sentences.zh: 公司在研究上投入大量資金，以保持在科技的最前端。

sentences.en: Speaking several languages can give job applicants a competitive edge in the international job market today.
sentences.zh: 會說好幾種語言能讓求職者在國際市場上佔有競爭優勢。

sentences.en: Please be careful near the edge of the platform when the train is arriving at the station.
sentences.zh: 火車進站時，請小心月台邊緣。

words.note: 語塊：competitive edge（競爭優勢）、on the edge of（在……邊緣）、cutting edge（最前端）。edge 可以是「邊緣」，也可以是「優勢」；cutting-edge 是形容詞「最先進的」。

sentences.en: The store sells high-end products such as designer bags, watches, and jewelry from Europe and Japan.
sentences.zh: 那家店販售名牌包、手錶和珠寶等高檔產品。

sentences.en: The company plans to enter the high-end market by launching a new line of luxury cars.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫推出新系列豪華車，進軍高端市場。

sentences.en: The couple celebrated their anniversary at a high-end restaurant on the top floor of the hotel.
sentences.zh: 那對夫妻在飯店頂樓的一家高級餐廳慶祝結婚週年。

sentences.en: Many high-end hotels in the city offer free car service to and from the airport for their guests.
sentences.zh: 城裡很多高檔飯店為客人提供免費機場接送服務。

sentences.en: The new laptop is a high-end model with a powerful processor and a very bright screen.
sentences.zh: 新筆電是一款有強大處理器和非常明亮螢幕的高階機型。

words.note: 語塊：high-end products（高檔產品）、high-end market（高端市場）、high-end restaurant（高級餐廳）。high-end 是「高價位、高品質的」；low-end 是「低價位的」；luxury 意思接近。

sentences.en: Workers will paint the exterior of the building during the summer, so please use the back entrance.
sentences.zh: 工人夏天會粉刷大樓外觀，所以請使用後門。

sentences.en: The exterior walls of the old factory were cleaned and repaired as part of the renovation project.
sentences.zh: 舊工廠的外牆在翻修工程中被清洗和修繕。

sentences.en: The car has a modern exterior design, and its interior is spacious and very comfortable.
sentences.zh: 那輛車有現代的外觀設計，內部寬敞又舒適。

sentences.en: The exterior of the hotel looks very old, but the rooms inside were renovated last year.
sentences.zh: 飯店的外觀看起來很舊，但裡面的房間去年都翻修過了。

sentences.en: The architect chose glass and steel for the exterior walls so that the building would be bright inside.
sentences.zh: 建築師選用玻璃和鋼材做外牆，讓建築內部明亮。

words.note: 語塊：the exterior of（……的外觀）、exterior walls（外牆）、exterior design（外觀設計）。exterior 是「外面」；interior 是「裡面」；external 是「外部的」。

sentences.en: The startup took an unconventional approach to marketing by using only social media and no advertisements.
sentences.zh: 那家新創公司採取不尋常的行銷方式，只用社群媒體，不打任何廣告。

sentences.en: The museum's unconventional design has made it one of the most photographed buildings in the city.
sentences.zh: 博物館的非傳統設計讓它成為城裡最常被拍照的建築之一。

sentences.en: The manager's unconventional ideas were not popular at first, but they helped the company grow quickly.
sentences.zh: 經理不尋常的點子起初不受歡迎，但幫助公司快速成長。

sentences.en: Some customers found the unconventional shape of the new chair strange, but most found it comfortable.
sentences.zh: 有些顧客覺得新椅子的非傳統造型很奇怪，但大多數人覺得很舒服。

sentences.en: The school uses an unconventional approach to teaching, with students learning outside the classroom twice a week.
sentences.zh: 那所學校採用不尋常的教學方式，學生每週兩次在教室外學習。

words.note: 語塊：unconventional approach（不尋常的做法）、unconventional design（非傳統設計）。unconventional 是「和一般做法不同的」；conventional 是「傳統的、一般的」。

sentences.en: The company decided to hire an architect to design a new office that uses less energy.
sentences.zh: 公司決定聘請一位建築師，設計一間更節能的新辦公室。

sentences.en: The new museum was designed by an award-winning architect who is famous for using natural light.
sentences.zh: 新博物館由一位以運用自然光聞名的得獎建築師設計。

sentences.en: A landscape architect was hired to plan the gardens and walking paths around the new hotel.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位景觀建築師規劃新飯店周圍的花園和步道。

sentences.en: The architect showed the client several designs for the house before they chose the final one.
sentences.zh: 建築師在客戶選定最終設計之前，給他們看了好幾種房子的設計。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee studied for seven years to become an architect, and she now designs schools and hospitals.
sentences.zh: 李小姐讀了七年書才成為建築師，現在設計學校和醫院。

words.note: 語塊：hire an architect（聘請建築師）、award-winning architect（得獎建築師）、landscape architect（景觀建築師）。architect 是「建築師（人）」；architecture 是「建築」；architectural 是形容詞。

sentences.en: The doctor gave the patient some medicine to alleviate the pain in her back after the accident.
sentences.zh: 醫生給病人一些藥，減輕她車禍後的背痛。

sentences.en: The new subway line is expected to alleviate traffic in the city center during rush hour.
sentences.zh: 新捷運線預計會緩解尖峰時段市中心的交通。

sentences.en: The company offers yoga classes at lunch to help employees alleviate stress during busy periods.
sentences.zh: 公司在午餐時間開瑜伽課，幫助員工在忙碌期間減輕壓力。

sentences.en: Hiring more staff will help alleviate the problem of long lines at the checkout counters.
sentences.zh: 增聘人手將有助於緩解結帳櫃台大排長龍的問題。

sentences.en: The government introduced new programs to alleviate poverty in the rural areas of the country.
sentences.zh: 政府推出新計畫，減輕國內鄉村地區的貧窮問題。

words.note: 語塊：alleviate pain（減輕疼痛）、alleviate traffic（緩解交通）、alleviate stress（減輕壓力）。alleviate 比 reduce、ease 正式；relieve 意思接近。

sentences.en: This software is commonly used by small businesses to manage their accounts and invoices every month.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體常被小企業用來管理帳目和發票。

sentences.en: The plant, commonly known as the snake plant, is popular in offices because it is easy to care for.
sentences.zh: 那種俗稱虎尾蘭的植物在辦公室很受歡迎，因為很容易照顧。

sentences.en: These birds are commonly found near rivers and lakes in the southern part of the country.
sentences.zh: 這些鳥在國內南部的河川和湖泊附近很常見。

sentences.en: Credit cards are commonly accepted in shops and restaurants, but some small markets accept only cash.
sentences.zh: 商店和餐廳普遍接受信用卡，但有些小市場只收現金。

sentences.en: The word is commonly used in business emails, so it is useful for office workers to learn it.
sentences.zh: 這個字常用在商業電子郵件中，所以上班族學起來很有用。

words.note: 語塊：commonly used（常用的）、commonly known as（俗稱）、commonly found（常見的）。commonly 是「常見地、一般來說」；common 是形容詞「常見的」；usually 意思接近。

sentences.en: The new restaurant is supposedly the best in the city, but it is very difficult to get a reservation.
sentences.zh: 那家新餐廳據說是城裡最好的，但很難訂到位子。

sentences.en: The package was supposedly delivered yesterday, but the customer says that it never arrived at her home.
sentences.zh: 包裹照理說昨天就送到了，但顧客說根本沒收到。

sentences.en: The new software is supposedly easier to use, but many employees still prefer the old version.
sentences.zh: 新軟體據說比較好用，但很多員工還是比較喜歡舊版本。

sentences.en: The hotel is supposedly only five minutes from the beach, but it actually takes twenty minutes to walk there.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店據說離海灘只有五分鐘，但實際上走路要二十分鐘。

sentences.en: The meeting was supposedly canceled, but several people still came to the conference room anyway.
sentences.zh: 會議照理說已經取消了，但還是有好幾個人來到會議室。

words.note: 語塊：supposedly the best（據說是最好的）、supposedly delivered（照理說已送達）、supposedly easier（據說比較容易）、supposedly canceled（照理說已取消）。supposedly 是「大家這麼說（但不一定是真的）」；supposed 是形容詞；allegedly 意思接近。

sentences.en: The museum is temporarily closed while workers repair the roof of the main exhibition hall.
sentences.zh: 工人修理主展廳屋頂期間，博物館暫時關閉。

sentences.en: The website is temporarily unavailable because of maintenance, but it will be back online by noon.
sentences.zh: 網站因為維護暫時無法使用，但中午前會恢復。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee will temporarily manage the sales team until a new director is hired next month.
sentences.zh: 在下個月聘到新總監之前，李小姐會暫時管理業務團隊。

sentences.en: The road near the school will be temporarily closed for two days while the new pipes are installed.
sentences.zh: 安裝新管線期間，學校附近的道路會暫時封閉兩天。

sentences.en: Several flights were temporarily delayed this morning because of very strong winds at the airport.
sentences.zh: 今天早上因為機場風很大，好幾個航班暫時延誤。

words.note: 語塊：temporarily closed（暫時關閉）、temporarily unavailable（暫時無法使用）。temporarily 是副詞；temporary 是形容詞「暫時的」；permanently 是「永久地」。

sentences.en: The dispute between the two companies could escalate if they do not reach an agreement soon.
sentences.zh: 如果兩家公司沒有很快達成協議，糾紛可能會擴大。

sentences.en: If the customer is still unhappy, please escalate the problem to the manager on duty.
sentences.zh: 如果顧客還是不滿意，請把問題上報給值班經理。

sentences.en: Prices for building materials began to escalate quickly after the storm damaged several large factories.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨損壞好幾座工廠後，建材價格開始迅速上漲。

sentences.en: The staff are trained to stay calm so that small complaints do not escalate into serious problems.
sentences.zh: 員工受過訓練要保持冷靜，以免小抱怨變成嚴重的問題。

sentences.en: Costs may escalate if the construction is delayed again, so we must finish the work on time.
sentences.zh: 如果工程再次延誤，成本可能會升高，所以我們必須準時完成。

words.note: 語塊：escalate quickly（迅速升高）、escalate a problem（把問題上報）。escalate 是「變得更嚴重」或「交給上級處理」；escalator 是「手扶梯」。

sentences.en: Good customer service staff can empathize with customers who are upset about late deliveries during the holidays.
sentences.zh: 好的客服人員能同理那些對延遲送貨感到不滿的顧客。

sentences.en: Managers who empathize with their employees often have teams that are happier and more productive.
sentences.zh: 能同理員工的經理，團隊通常比較快樂、效率也比較高。

sentences.en: The nurse was able to empathize with the patient because she had experienced the same illness.
sentences.zh: 那位護士能體會病人的感受，因為她得過同樣的病。

sentences.en: It is important to empathize with clients and listen carefully before offering any solutions to their problems.
sentences.zh: 在提出任何解決辦法之前，同理客戶並仔細聆聽是很重要的。

sentences.en: The training teaches teachers how to empathize with students who are having problems at home.
sentences.zh: 訓練教老師如何同理家裡有狀況的學生。

words.note: 語塊：empathize with（同理……）。empathize with sb 是「能體會別人的感受」；empathy 是名詞「同理心」；sympathize 是「同情」。

sentences.en: The technicians are trying to isolate the problem that caused the network to fail this morning.
sentences.zh: 技師正在設法找出今天早上造成網路故障的問題所在。

sentences.en: Patients with the flu are isolated from others, and nurses isolate them in a separate room.
sentences.zh: 得流感的病人會和其他人隔離，護士會把他們安置在另一個房間。

sentences.en: Working from home can isolate some employees, so the company holds team events every month.
sentences.zh: 在家工作可能會讓一些員工感到孤立，所以公司每個月都舉辦團隊活動。

sentences.en: The engineers will isolate the damaged part of the system so that the rest can keep working.
sentences.zh: 工程師會把系統中受損的部分隔離，讓其他部分能繼續運作。

sentences.en: Living in a small village can isolate elderly people who do not have cars or family nearby.
sentences.zh: 住在小村莊可能會讓沒有車或附近沒有家人的長者感到孤立。

words.note: 語塊：isolate the problem（找出問題所在）、isolate from（和……隔離）。isolate 是「把……分開來」；isolated 是形容詞「孤立的；偏遠的」；isolation 是名詞。

sentences.en: The two managers have different skills that complement each other very well on the project.
sentences.zh: 兩位經理擁有不同的技能，在專案上相輔相成。

sentences.en: The wooden furniture will complement the design of the new office, which has many large windows.
sentences.zh: 木製家具會和新辦公室的設計很相配，那裡有很多大窗戶。

sentences.en: The chef chose a light wine to complement the flavor of the fish dishes on the menu.
sentences.zh: 主廚選了一款清淡的葡萄酒，搭配菜單上魚料理的風味。

sentences.en: Online lessons can complement classes in the classroom by giving students extra practice at home.
sentences.zh: 線上課程可以讓學生在家多練習，補充教室裡的課。

sentences.en: The new products will complement our existing range and help us attract younger customers in the city.
sentences.zh: 新產品將補充我們現有的產品系列，幫助我們吸引更年輕的顧客。

words.note: 語塊：complement each other（相輔相成）、complement the design（和設計相配）、complement the flavor（搭配風味）、complement our existing range（補充現有產品系列）。complement 是「互補、搭配得好」；compliment 是「讚美」，只差一個字母。

sentences.en: The company provides ongoing support to customers who buy its software, including free updates and online help.
sentences.zh: 公司為購買軟體的顧客提供持續的支援，包括免費更新。

sentences.en: The renovation of the train station is an ongoing project that will be finished next year.
sentences.zh: 火車站的整修是一項進行中的專案，將在明年完工。

sentences.en: Traffic in the city center has been an ongoing problem, so the council plans to build a new road.
sentences.zh: 市中心的交通一直是持續的問題，所以議會計畫蓋一條新路。

sentences.en: The investigation into the accident is ongoing, and the results will be shared next month.
sentences.zh: 事故調查還在進行中，結果將在下個月公布。

sentences.en: Employees receive ongoing training throughout the year so that their skills stay up to date.
sentences.zh: 員工全年都接受持續的訓練，讓技能保持與時俱進。

words.note: 語塊：ongoing project（進行中的專案）、ongoing problem（持續的問題）、ongoing support（持續的支援）。ongoing 是「正在進行、還沒結束的」；continuing 意思接近。

sentences.en: The price of the hotel room is one hundred dollars per night plus tax and a small service charge.
sentences.zh: 飯店房價每晚一百美元，外加稅和一小筆服務費。

sentences.en: The total cost of the order is fifty dollars plus shipping, which will be calculated at checkout.
sentences.zh: 訂單總價是五十美元加運費，運費會在結帳時計算。

sentences.en: The job offers a good salary plus a yearly bonus and four weeks of paid vacation.
sentences.zh: 那份工作提供不錯的薪水，外加年終獎金和四週帶薪休假。

sentences.en: The tour includes four nights at a hotel plus breakfast every day and a guided walk around the city.
sentences.zh: 行程包含四晚飯店住宿，外加每天早餐和一次城市導覽散步。

sentences.en: Experience with social media is a plus, but it is not required for the marketing assistant position.
sentences.zh: 有社群媒體經驗是加分，但行銷助理這個職位不一定要有。

words.note: 語塊：plus tax（加稅）、plus shipping（加運費）、plus breakfast（外加早餐）、plus a yearly bonus（外加年終獎金）。plus 是「加上」；也可以當形容詞「有利的」（a plus 是「優點」）。

sentences.en: The new printer costs only a fraction of the price of the old model, but it works much faster.
sentences.zh: 新印表機只要舊機型價格的零頭，但速度快很多。

sentences.en: Only a small fraction of the customers who visit the website actually buy something from the store.
sentences.zh: 造訪網站的顧客中，只有一小部分真的會買東西。

sentences.en: Online advertising costs a fraction of what television commercials cost, so many small businesses use it.
sentences.zh: 網路廣告的費用只有電視廣告的一小部分，所以很多小企業使用。

sentences.en: The new machine can finish the job in a fraction of the time that it used to take by hand.
sentences.zh: 新機器只要過去人工所需時間的一小部分就能完成工作。

sentences.en: A small fraction of the budget will be used to buy new computers for the training center.
sentences.zh: 預算中有一小部分會用來為訓練中心購買新電腦。

words.note: 語塊：a fraction of（……的一小部分）、a small fraction（一小部分）。a fraction of the price 是「價格的零頭」；fracture 是「骨折」。

sentences.en: The restaurant is short of staff this weekend, so the manager will help in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳這個週末人手不足，所以經理會到廚房幫忙。

sentences.en: We are running short of paper, so please order more boxes before the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 我們的紙快用完了，所以請在週末前多訂幾箱。

sentences.en: The hospital is short of nurses, and it is offering higher salaries to attract new staff.
sentences.zh: 那家醫院缺護士，正提供更高的薪水吸引新員工。

sentences.en: The team was short of time, so they decided to focus only on the most important tasks.
sentences.zh: 團隊時間不夠，所以決定只專注於最重要的工作。

sentences.en: The project was canceled because the company was short of money after a difficult year.
sentences.zh: 因為艱難的一年後公司資金不足，專案被取消了。

words.note: 語塊：be short of（缺少……）、run short of（快用完）。be short of 是「不夠」；run short of 是「快要用完」；lack 意思接近。

sentences.en: The new factory has been in operation since March and now employs more than three hundred workers.
sentences.zh: 新工廠從三月開始運作，現在僱用了三百多名工人。

sentences.en: The company's business operation in Asia has grown quickly, especially in Vietnam, Thailand, and Malaysia.
sentences.zh: 公司在亞洲的業務營運成長迅速，尤其是在越南和泰國。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim will undergo an operation on his knee next week and will return to work in a month.
sentences.zh: 金先生下週要動膝蓋手術，一個月後回來上班。

sentences.en: The bus service will be in operation from six in the morning until midnight every day.
sentences.zh: 公車服務每天從早上六點運作到午夜。

sentences.en: The new manager is responsible for the daily operation of the hotel, including its restaurant.
sentences.zh: 新經理負責飯店的日常營運，包括它的餐廳。

words.note: 語塊：business operation（業務營運）、in operation（運作中）、undergo an operation（動手術）。operation 可以是「營運、運作」，也可以是醫療的「手術」；operate 是動詞。

sentences.en: The labor union is negotiating with the company for higher wages and better working conditions.
sentences.zh: 工會正在和公司談判，爭取更高的薪資和更好的工作條件。

sentences.en: Many factory workers decided to join a union so that they could have more power in discussions.
sentences.zh: 很多工廠工人決定加入工會，讓他們在協商時更有力量。

sentences.en: The union said that its members would go on strike if the company did not agree to their demands.
sentences.zh: 工會表示，如果公司不同意他們的要求，成員就會罷工。

sentences.en: The company met with union leaders to discuss the new schedule for the night shift workers.
sentences.zh: 公司和工會領袖開會，討論夜班工人的新班表。

sentences.en: Each union member will vote on the new contract at a meeting next Thursday evening.
sentences.zh: 每位工會成員將在下週四晚上的會議上對新合約投票。

words.note: 語塊：labor union（工會）、join a union（加入工會）、union members（工會成員）。union 是「工會」或「聯合」；the European Union 是「歐盟」；unity 是「團結」。

sentences.en: Applicants must possess strong communication skills and at least three years of experience in sales.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須具備很強的溝通能力，以及至少三年的業務經驗。

sentences.en: The museum is lucky to possess several paintings by the famous artist, which were donated by a local family.
sentences.zh: 博物館很幸運擁有幾幅那位知名藝術家的畫作，是當地一個家族捐贈的。

sentences.en: Managers should possess the ability to stay calm and make good decisions when problems happen.
sentences.zh: 經理應該具備在出問題時保持冷靜、做出好決定的能力。

sentences.en: Very few companies possess the technology needed to build such a large and complicated bridge.
sentences.zh: 很少公司擁有建造這麼大又複雜的橋所需的技術。

sentences.en: Our engineers possess knowledge of both old and new systems, so they can repair any machine.
sentences.zh: 我們的工程師擁有新舊系統的知識，所以能修理任何機器。

words.note: 語塊：possess skills（具備技能）、possess knowledge（擁有知識）、possess the ability（具備能力）、possess the technology（擁有技術）。possess 比 have、own 正式；possession 是名詞「擁有物」。

sentences.en: The formulation of the new tax policy took more than a year because many experts were involved.
sentences.zh: 新稅收政策的制定花了一年多，因為參與的專家很多。

sentences.en: The shampoo has a new formulation that is gentler on the skin and better for the environment.
sentences.zh: 那款洗髮精有一種對皮膚更溫和、對環境也更好的新配方。

sentences.en: Employees were invited to take part in the formulation of the company's new vacation policy.
sentences.zh: 員工受邀參與公司新休假規定的制定。

sentences.en: The medicine was sold with a new formulation after doctors reported problems with the old one.
sentences.zh: 醫生回報舊配方有問題後，那種藥改用新配方販售。

sentences.en: The board is responsible for the formulation of the company's long-term strategy and goals for growth.
sentences.zh: 董事會負責制定公司的長期策略和目標。

words.note: 語塊：the formulation of（……的制定）、new formulation（新配方）。formulation 是「制定（計畫、政策）」或產品的「配方」；formulate 是動詞；formula 是「公式；配方」。

sentences.en: The acquisition of the small software company will help us develop new products more quickly.
sentences.zh: 收購那家小型軟體公司將幫助我們更快開發新產品。

sentences.en: The company's recent acquisition of a hotel chain has made it the largest hotel group in the region.
sentences.zh: 公司最近收購了一家連鎖飯店，成為該地區最大的飯店集團。

sentences.en: The bank hired lawyers who specialize in merger and acquisition deals to help with the negotiations.
sentences.zh: 銀行聘請專門處理併購案的律師協助談判。

sentences.en: The acquisition was announced on Monday, and the company's share price rose by ten percent.
sentences.zh: 收購案在週一宣布，公司股價上漲了一成。

sentences.en: The museum's latest acquisition is a painting from the 1800s that was bought at an auction in London.
sentences.zh: 博物館最新的收藏是一幅在倫敦拍賣會買下的 1800 年代畫作。

words.note: 語塊：acquisition of（……的收購）、merger and acquisition（併購）、recent acquisition（最近的收購）。acquisition 是名詞；acquire 是動詞「取得；收購」。

sentences.en: Rising costs for fuel and materials have forced the company to increase its prices this year.
sentences.zh: 燃料和材料成本上升，迫使公司今年漲價。

sentences.en: Many families are worried about rising prices for food, electricity, and housing in the city.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭擔心城市食物和住房價格上漲。

sentences.en: The factory hired fifty new workers to meet the rising demand for its electric bicycles.
sentences.zh: 工廠新聘五十名工人，以滿足電動自行車日益增加的需求。

sentences.en: Because of rising rents downtown, several small shops have moved to cheaper areas outside the city.
sentences.zh: 因為市中心房租上漲，好幾家小店搬到城外比較便宜的地區。

sentences.en: The rising number of tourists has created many new jobs in hotels and restaurants on the island.
sentences.zh: 觀光客人數增加為島上的飯店和餐廳創造了很多新工作。

words.note: 語塊：rising costs（上升的成本）、rising prices（上漲的物價）、rising demand（增加的需求）。rising 是「正在上升的」；rise 是動詞或名詞「上升」；raising 是「提高（某物）」。

sentences.en: Many companies build factories in other countries in order to reduce labor cost and taxes.
sentences.zh: 很多公司到其他國家設廠，以降低人力成本和稅負。

sentences.en: The rising labor cost in the city has made it difficult for small restaurants to make a profit.
sentences.zh: 城市人力成本上升，讓小餐廳很難獲利。

sentences.en: New machines helped the factory reduce labor cost by doing work that used to be done by hand.
sentences.zh: 新機器取代了過去的人工，幫助工廠降低人力成本。

sentences.en: The report compares the labor cost in five Asian countries for companies that want to open factories.
sentences.zh: 報告為想設廠的公司比較了五個亞洲國家的人力成本。

sentences.en: Because of the rising labor cost, the company decided to use more robots on its production line.
sentences.zh: 因為人力成本上升，公司決定在生產線上使用更多機器人。

words.note: 語塊：reduce labor cost（降低人力成本）、rising labor cost（上升的人力成本）。labor cost 常用複數 labor costs；labor 是「勞動、勞工」，英式拼法 labour。

sentences.en: Now that the new software has been installed, employees can share files much more easily.
sentences.zh: 既然新軟體已經安裝好了，員工分享檔案就容易多了。

sentences.en: Now that the project is finished, the team can finally take a few days off to rest.
sentences.zh: 既然專案完成了，團隊終於可以休息幾天。

sentences.en: Now that the weather is warmer, the café has started serving drinks on its outdoor patio.
sentences.zh: 既然天氣變暖了，咖啡館開始在戶外露台供應飲料。

sentences.en: Now that you have joined our company, please read the employee handbook carefully this week.
sentences.zh: 既然你已經加入我們公司，請在這週仔細閱讀員工手冊。

sentences.en: Now that the new subway line is open, it takes only twenty minutes to get to the airport.
sentences.zh: 既然新捷運線已經開通，到機場只要二十分鐘。

words.note: 語塊：now that + 子句（既然……）。now that 是「因為現在已經……」；since 意思接近。

sentences.en: The new CEO shared her vision for the future of the company at the meeting with all employees.
sentences.zh: 新執行長在和全體員工的會議上分享了她對公司未來的願景。

sentences.en: A good leader must have a clear vision and be able to explain it to the whole team.
sentences.zh: 好的領導者必須有清楚的願景，並能向整個團隊說明。

sentences.en: The city's long-term vision is to become a place where people can live without needing a car.
sentences.zh: 城市的長期願景是成為人們不需要汽車也能生活的地方。

sentences.en: The founder's vision was to create furniture that was both beautiful and affordable for every family.
sentences.zh: 創辦人的願景是打造美觀又讓每個家庭都負擔得起的家具。

sentences.en: The company's long-term vision includes opening stores in every major city in Asia within ten years.
sentences.zh: 公司的長期願景包括在十年內於亞洲每個主要城市開店。

words.note: 語塊：a vision for（對……的願景）、long-term vision（長期願景）、clear vision（清楚的願景）。vision 可以是「眼光、願景」或「視力」；visionary 是「有遠見的人」。

sentences.en: The storm caused disruption to train services across the country for most of the weekend.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨在週末大部分時間造成全國火車服務中斷。

sentences.en: The workers will repair the road at night in order to minimize disruption to drivers during the day.
sentences.zh: 工人會在晚上修路，盡量減少白天對駕駛的干擾。

sentences.en: The strike at the port may cause disruption to the delivery of goods to stores around the country.
sentences.zh: 港口罷工可能會造成全國商店的貨物配送中斷。

sentences.en: We apologize for any disruption caused by the renovation work on the third floor this week.
sentences.zh: 我們為本週三樓整修工程造成的任何干擾致歉。

sentences.en: The company prepared a backup plan to avoid disruption if the main computer system stops working.
sentences.zh: 公司準備了備用計畫，以防主要電腦系統停止運作時造成中斷。

words.note: 語塊：cause disruption（造成中斷）、minimize disruption（減少干擾）、disruption to（對……的干擾）。disruption 是名詞；disrupt 是動詞「擾亂」；interruption 意思接近。

sentences.en: The designer made a minor adjustment to the logo after the client asked for a brighter color.
sentences.zh: 客戶要求更亮的顏色後，設計師對商標做了小幅調整。

sentences.en: Moving to a new country requires a big adjustment, especially if you do not speak the language.
sentences.zh: 搬到新國家需要很大的適應，尤其是你不會說當地語言的話。

sentences.en: The manager will make an adjustment to the schedule so that everyone can attend the training.
sentences.zh: 經理會調整時程表，讓每個人都能參加訓練。

sentences.en: After a period of adjustment, the new employees became comfortable with the company's software and systems.
sentences.zh: 經過一段適應期後，新員工就習慣公司的軟體了。

sentences.en: A small adjustment to the price helped the store sell many more of its winter jackets.
sentences.zh: 價格的小幅調整幫助那家店多賣出很多冬季外套。

words.note: 語塊：make adjustments（做調整）、minor adjustment（小幅調整）、adjustment to（對……的適應）。adjustment 是名詞；adjust 是動詞「調整」；adjustable 是「可調整的」。

sentences.en: Reports that contain information about customers must be kept in a locked cabinet at all times.
sentences.zh: 含有顧客資訊的報告必須隨時鎖在櫃子裡。

sentences.en: These cookies may contain nuts, so people with allergies should read the label carefully before eating them.
sentences.zh: 這些餅乾可能含有堅果，所以過敏的人吃之前應仔細閱讀標籤。

sentences.en: Firefighters worked through the night to contain the fire before it reached the nearby houses.
sentences.zh: 消防員通宵工作，在火勢蔓延到附近房屋之前控制住它。

sentences.en: The new storage room is large enough to contain all of the boxes from the old warehouse.
sentences.zh: 新儲藏室大到足以容納舊倉庫的所有箱子。

sentences.en: The email may contain confidential information, so please do not share it with anyone outside the company.
sentences.zh: 這封郵件可能包含機密資訊，所以請不要分享給公司以外的任何人。

words.note: 語塊：contain information（包含資訊）、contain the fire（控制火勢）、may contain（可能含有）。contain 是「裡面有」；include 是「包括（其中一部分）」；container 是「容器」。

sentences.en: Visitors must ask for permission before taking photographs inside the factory or the research laboratory.
sentences.zh: 訪客在工廠或實驗室內拍照前必須先請求許可。

sentences.en: Employees may not share confidential documents with people outside the company without permission from their manager.
sentences.zh: 未經經理許可，員工不得把機密文件分享給公司以外的人。

sentences.en: The city gave permission for the restaurant to put tables and chairs on the sidewalk during the summer.
sentences.zh: 市政府允許那家餐廳夏天在人行道上擺放桌椅。

sentences.en: Students need permission from their parents to join the school trip to the science museum next week.
sentences.zh: 學生需要家長同意才能參加下週去科學博物館的校外教學。

sentences.en: Please do not use the company car without permission, as it is reserved for business trips only.
sentences.zh: 未經許可請不要使用公司的車，因為它只供出差使用。

words.note: 語塊：ask for permission（請求許可）、without permission（未經許可）、give permission（給予許可）。permission 是不可數名詞；permit 可以當動詞「允許」或名詞「許可證」。

sentences.en: Regular maintenance will help the machines last longer and reduce the number of expensive repairs.
sentences.zh: 定期保養能讓機器用得更久，並減少昂貴的維修次數。

sentences.en: The website will be under maintenance from midnight until six in the morning on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 網站週日午夜到早上六點將進行維修。

sentences.en: Maintenance work on the elevators will take place on Saturday, so please use the stairs that day.
sentences.zh: 電梯維修工程將在週六進行，所以那天請走樓梯。

sentences.en: The building manager is responsible for the maintenance of the heating and air conditioning systems.
sentences.zh: 大樓管理員負責暖氣和空調系統的保養。

sentences.en: The car needs regular maintenance, such as changing the oil every six months, to run safely.
sentences.zh: 汽車需要定期保養，例如每六個月換一次機油，才能安全行駛。

words.note: 語塊：regular maintenance（定期保養）、maintenance work（維修工程）、under maintenance（維修中）。maintenance 是名詞；maintain 是動詞「維持；保養」；注意拼法 main-te-nance。

sentences.en: The hotel is popular with business travelers because of its proximity to the airport and the convention center.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店很受商務旅客歡迎，因為它靠近機場。

sentences.en: Many families choose this neighborhood because of its close proximity to good schools and parks.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭選擇這個社區，因為它非常靠近好學校和公園。

sentences.en: The new office is in close proximity to the subway station, so most employees can walk to work.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室非常靠近捷運站，所以大部分員工可以走路上班。

sentences.en: The factory's proximity to the port allows the company to ship its products overseas quickly.
sentences.zh: 工廠靠近港口，讓公司能快速把產品運往海外。

sentences.en: The restaurant's proximity to the theater makes it a popular place to eat before a show.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳靠近劇院，所以是看表演前吃飯的熱門地點。

words.note: 語塊：in close proximity to（非常靠近）、proximity to（靠近……）。proximity 是「距離很近」；nearness 意思接近；approximately 是「大約」。

sentences.en: Many residents signed a letter in support of the plan to build a new park near the river.
sentences.zh: 很多居民簽了一封信，支持在河邊興建新公園的計畫。

sentences.en: The company donated money in support of local schools that need new computers and books.
sentences.zh: 公司捐款支持需要新電腦和書的當地學校。

sentences.en: Several business leaders spoke in support of the new tax policy at the meeting on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 好幾位企業領袖在週四的會議上發言支持新的稅收政策。

sentences.en: The runners in the marathon are raising money in support of the children's hospital in the city.
sentences.zh: 馬拉松跑者正在為支持城裡的兒童醫院募款。

sentences.en: The board voted in support of the proposal to open a new office in Singapore next year.
sentences.zh: 董事會投票支持明年在新加坡開設新辦公室的提案。

words.note: 語塊：in support of（支持……）。in support of 是「為了支持某事」；in favor of 意思接近。

sentences.en: Dr. Lee studied genetics at university and now works at a laboratory that develops new medicines.
sentences.zh: 李博士大學讀遺傳學，現在在一家開發新藥的實驗室工作。

sentences.en: The university received a large grant to support its genetics research on rare diseases in children.
sentences.zh: 那所大學獲得一大筆補助，支持它針對罕見疾病的遺傳學研究。

sentences.en: Advances in genetics have helped doctors understand why some people are more likely to get certain diseases.
sentences.zh: 遺傳學的進步幫助醫生了解為什麼有些人比較容易得某些疾病。

sentences.en: Students who are interested in genetics can take an introductory course during their first year.
sentences.zh: 對遺傳學有興趣的學生可以在第一年修一門入門課程。

sentences.en: The company uses genetics to develop crops that can grow well even when there is little rain.
sentences.zh: 那家公司運用遺傳學開發雨量少也能長得好的作物。

words.note: 語塊：study genetics（研究遺傳學）、genetics research（遺傳學研究）。genetics 是學科名稱，當單數用；genetic 是形容詞「遺傳的」；gene 是「基因」。

sentences.en: The store sells a variety of products, including clothing, furniture, and kitchen appliances for the home.
sentences.zh: 那家店販售各式各樣的產品，包括服飾、家具和廚房家電。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers a variety of dishes from Asia, Europe, and South America on its new menu.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的新菜單提供各式各樣的亞洲、歐洲和南美料理。

sentences.en: The conference will include a variety of workshops on marketing, finance, and leadership for small businesses.
sentences.zh: 研討會將有各種關於行銷、財務和領導力的工作坊。

sentences.en: Employees can choose from a variety of training courses that are offered online every month.
sentences.zh: 員工每個月可以從線上提供的各種訓練課程中選擇。

sentences.en: The hotel provides a variety of activities for guests, such as cooking classes and bicycle tours.
sentences.zh: 飯店為客人提供各種活動，例如烹飪課和腳踏車導覽。

words.note: 語塊：a variety of products（各式各樣的產品）、a variety of workshops（各種工作坊）、a variety of training courses（各種訓練課程）、a variety of activities（各種活動）。a variety of 後面接複數名詞；various 意思相同；variety 是名詞「多樣性」。

sentences.en: The doctor explained that the patient's heart problem was a hereditary condition from his father's side.
sentences.zh: 醫生解釋說病人的心臟問題是從父親那邊遺傳來的狀況。

sentences.en: Scientists are working to find new treatments for hereditary diseases that affect young children and their families.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在努力尋找影響幼童的遺傳疾病的新療法。

sentences.en: Some eye problems are hereditary, so doctors ask patients about their family history during checkups.
sentences.zh: 有些眼睛問題是遺傳的，所以醫生在檢查時會問病人的家族病史。

sentences.en: The new test can show whether a person is likely to develop a hereditary disease in the future.
sentences.zh: 新的檢測可以顯示一個人未來是否可能發展出遺傳疾病。

sentences.en: Research on hereditary conditions has improved greatly over the past ten years because of new technology.
sentences.zh: 因為新科技，過去十年遺傳性狀況的研究大幅進步。

words.note: 語塊：hereditary disease（遺傳疾病）、hereditary condition（遺傳性狀況）。hereditary 是「從父母遺傳下來的」；heredity 是名詞「遺傳」；genetic 意思接近。

sentences.en: Learning a new language takes a lot of practice and repetition, especially when you are an adult.
sentences.zh: 學新語言需要大量的練習和反覆，尤其是成年人。

sentences.en: Please edit the report to avoid repetition, as several of the paragraphs say exactly the same thing.
sentences.zh: 請編輯報告避免重複，因為有好幾段在說同樣的事。

sentences.en: Through repetition, new employees quickly learn how to use the cash register and the ordering system.
sentences.zh: 透過反覆練習，新員工很快就學會使用收銀機和點餐系統。

sentences.en: Factory work often involves a lot of repetition, so workers change tasks every two hours.
sentences.zh: 工廠工作常常有很多重複性的動作，所以工人每兩小時換一次工作。

sentences.en: The teacher believes that repetition is the best way for children to remember new words.
sentences.zh: 老師認為反覆練習是孩子記住新單字最好的方法。

words.note: 語塊：through repetition（透過反覆練習）、avoid repetition（避免重複）、practice and repetition（練習與反覆）、a lot of repetition（很多重複）。repetition 是名詞；repeat 是動詞「重複」；repetitive 是形容詞「重複的」。

sentences.en: The company will proceed with the plan to open a new factory after the city approves the permits.
sentences.zh: 市政府核准許可後，公司將繼續進行開設新工廠的計畫。

sentences.en: Drivers should proceed with caution on the mountain roads because of the heavy snow this weekend.
sentences.zh: 因為這個週末下大雪，駕駛在山路上應謹慎行駛。

sentences.en: Before we proceed with the meeting, I would like to welcome our new colleagues from the Seoul office.
sentences.zh: 在我們繼續開會之前，我想歡迎首爾辦公室的新同事。

sentences.en: The board decided not to proceed with the merger after reviewing the financial reports of both companies.
sentences.zh: 看過財務報告後，董事會決定不繼續進行合併。

sentences.en: Please proceed with the order once the customer has paid the deposit and signed the contract.
sentences.zh: 顧客付了訂金並簽約後，請繼續處理訂單。

words.note: 語塊：proceed with the plan（繼續進行計畫）、proceed with caution（謹慎行事）、proceed with the meeting（繼續開會）、proceed with the merger（繼續進行合併）、proceed with the order（繼續處理訂單）。proceed with 是「著手、繼續做」；go ahead with 意思接近。

sentences.en: The research team will receive funding from the government to study air pollution in large cities.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊將獲得政府資金，研究大城市的空氣污染。

sentences.en: Many small theaters depend on government funding because ticket sales are not enough to cover costs.
sentences.zh: 很多小劇場依賴政府經費，因為門票收入不夠支付成本。

sentences.en: The project was delayed because of a lack of funding, but it will continue once new investors are found.
sentences.zh: 專案因為資金不足而延誤，但找到新投資人後就會繼續。

sentences.en: The startup received funding from several investors who believe in its new technology for farms.
sentences.zh: 那家新創公司獲得好幾位相信它新技術的投資人資金。

sentences.en: The school is looking for funding to build a new library and buy computers for its students.
sentences.zh: 那所學校正在尋找資金，興建新圖書館並為學生購買電腦。

words.note: 語塊：receive funding（獲得資金）、government funding（政府經費）、lack of funding（資金不足）。funding 是「為計畫提供的資金」；fund 可以當名詞「基金」或動詞「資助」。

sentences.en: The incorporation of customer feedback into the new design helped make the product more popular.
sentences.zh: 把顧客意見納入新設計，幫助讓產品更受歡迎。

sentences.en: The lawyer helped the two founders with the incorporation of their new company last spring.
sentences.zh: 律師去年春天協助兩位創辦人成立新公司。

sentences.en: The incorporation of solar panels into the building's design will reduce its electricity costs every month.
sentences.zh: 把太陽能板納入大樓設計，將降低它的電費。

sentences.en: Please keep a copy of the certificate of incorporation in a safe place, as you may need it for the bank.
sentences.zh: 請把公司設立證明的副本放在安全的地方，因為銀行可能會需要。

sentences.en: The incorporation of new technology into the factory has made production much faster and safer.
sentences.zh: 把新科技導入工廠，讓生產變得更快更安全。

words.note: 語塊：incorporation of（……的納入）、certificate of incorporation（公司設立證明）。incorporation 是「把……納入」或「成立公司」；incorporate 是動詞。

sentences.en: The budget is based on the assumption that sales will increase by ten percent next year.
sentences.zh: 預算是基於明年銷售會增加一成的假設。

sentences.en: Please do not make an assumption about what customers want without asking them first in a survey.
sentences.zh: 不要沒先問顧客就假設他們想要什麼。

sentences.en: The plan was built on the assumption that the new factory would open in March, but it was delayed.
sentences.zh: 計畫是建立在新工廠三月開工的假設上，但工廠延後了。

sentences.en: It is a common assumption that young people do not read books, but the survey shows otherwise.
sentences.zh: 一般常假設年輕人不讀書，但調查顯示並非如此。

sentences.en: The manager made an assumption that everyone had read the report, but several people had not.
sentences.zh: 經理假設每個人都看過報告了，但好幾個人其實沒看。

words.note: 語塊：make an assumption（做假設）、based on the assumption that（基於……的假設）、on the assumption that（在……的假設上）、a common assumption（常見的假設）。assumption 是名詞；assume 是動詞「假設；承擔」。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim will undergo surgery on his knee next week and will return to work in one month.
sentences.zh: 金先生下週要接受膝蓋手術，一個月後回來上班。

sentences.en: The company will undergo several changes after the merger, including a new name and logo.
sentences.zh: 合併之後，公司將經歷幾項改變，包括新名稱和新商標。

sentences.en: All new pilots must undergo training for at least six months before they can fly passengers.
sentences.zh: 所有新飛行員都必須接受至少六個月的訓練才能載客。

sentences.en: The old bridge will undergo repairs next summer, so drivers should use the highway instead.
sentences.zh: 舊橋明年夏天將進行修繕，所以駕駛應改走公路。

sentences.en: Every product must undergo careful testing before it is sold in stores across the country.
sentences.zh: 每項產品在全國門市販售之前都必須經過仔細測試。

words.note: 語塊：undergo surgery（接受手術）、undergo changes（經歷改變）、undergo training（接受訓練）。undergo 比 go through、experience 正式；過去式 underwent、過去分詞 undergone。

sentences.en: The hotel has a good reputation for its friendly staff and excellent breakfast every morning.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店以親切的員工和極佳的早餐享有好名聲。

sentences.en: It took the company many years to build a reputation as a reliable supplier of quality products.
sentences.zh: 公司花了很多年才建立起可靠的優質產品供應商的名聲。

sentences.en: The restaurant's reputation grew quickly after a famous food critic wrote about it in a magazine.
sentences.zh: 一位知名美食評論家在雜誌上寫了那家餐廳之後，它的名聲迅速擴大。

sentences.en: The scandal damaged the bank's reputation, and many customers decided to move their money elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 那件醜聞損害了銀行的聲譽，很多顧客決定把錢轉到別處。

sentences.en: Our firm has a reputation for finishing every project on time and within the agreed budget.
sentences.zh: 我們公司以每個專案都準時且在預算內完成而出名。

words.note: 語塊：good reputation（好名聲）、build a reputation（建立名聲）、reputation for（以……出名）。reputation 是「別人對你的評價」；fame 是「名氣」；repetition 是「重複」，長得像。

sentences.en: The restaurant is famous for its excellent service and fresh seafood from the local market.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳以極佳的服務和當地市場的新鮮海鮮聞名。

sentences.en: The used car is in excellent condition and has been driven fewer than ten thousand kilometers.
sentences.zh: 那輛二手車狀況極佳，開了不到一萬公里。

sentences.en: Ms. Park has excellent communication skills, which makes her perfect for the customer service position.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐溝通能力很好，非常適合客服這個職位。

sentences.en: The hotel received excellent reviews from guests who praised the clean rooms and the quiet location.
sentences.zh: 飯店獲得房客極佳的評價，他們稱讚房間乾淨、地點安靜。

sentences.en: The team did excellent work on the project, so the manager took everyone out to dinner.
sentences.zh: 團隊在專案上表現優秀，所以經理請大家吃晚餐。

words.note: 語塊：excellent service（極佳的服務）、excellent condition（狀況極佳）、in excellent（極好的……）。excellent 是「非常好」；excel 是動詞「擅長」；excellence 是名詞。

words.meaning: 入門的；介紹性的；促銷的

sentences.en: The university offers an introductory course in programming for students who have no experience with computers.
sentences.zh: 那所大學為沒有經驗的學生開設程式設計入門課程。

sentences.en: The new magazine is available at an introductory price of only two dollars for the first issue.
sentences.zh: 新雜誌第一期以只要兩美元的上市優惠價販售。

sentences.en: Customers who sign up this month can take advantage of an introductory offer of fifty percent off.
sentences.zh: 這個月註冊的顧客可以享有五折的新品優惠。

sentences.en: The introductory chapter of the book explains the main ideas that will be discussed in later chapters.
sentences.zh: 書的介紹章節說明了後面章節將討論的主要概念。

sentences.en: New employees attend an introductory session on their first day to learn about the company's history.
sentences.zh: 新員工第一天參加一場介紹課程，了解公司的歷史。

words.note: 語塊：introductory course（入門課程）、introductory offer（新品優惠）、introductory price（上市優惠價）。introductory 是「入門、介紹用的」，也可以指新品上市的「試用優惠」。

sentences.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow, so please dress accordingly for the outdoor event.
sentences.zh: 天氣預報說明天會下雨，所以請為戶外活動穿合適的衣服。

sentences.en: The price of materials has risen, and we will adjust accordingly by changing our prices next month.
sentences.zh: 材料價格上漲了，我們會相應調整，下個月改變價格。

sentences.en: The schedule has changed, so please plan accordingly and arrive at the airport two hours early.
sentences.zh: 時程表變了，所以請據此規劃，提前兩小時到機場。

sentences.en: Employees who work overtime will be paid accordingly for the extra hours at the end of each month.
sentences.zh: 加班的員工會在每月底獲得相應的薪資。

sentences.en: The meeting room is small, so please plan accordingly and bring only the documents you need.
sentences.zh: 會議室很小，所以請據此安排，只帶需要的文件。

words.note: 語塊：act accordingly（相應地行動）、plan accordingly（據此規劃）、adjust accordingly（相應調整）、paid accordingly（獲得相應薪資）、dress accordingly（穿著合宜）。accordingly 是「根據情況做出相應的事」或「因此」；according to 是「根據」。

sentences.en: The conversion of the old factory into apartments will be finished by the end of next year.
sentences.zh: 舊工廠改建成公寓的工程將在明年底前完成。

sentences.en: The bank charges a small fee for currency conversion when you use your card in other countries.
sentences.zh: 在其他國家用卡時，銀行會收一小筆貨幣兌換手續費。

sentences.en: The website's conversion rate increased after the company made it easier for customers to pay.
sentences.zh: 公司讓顧客更容易付款後，網站的轉換率提高了。

sentences.en: The conversion of the warehouse into a museum has brought many new visitors to the area.
sentences.zh: 倉庫改建成博物館後，為這一帶帶來了很多新遊客。

sentences.en: The conversion of all files to the new system will take about three days to complete.
sentences.zh: 把所有檔案轉換到新系統大約需要三天才能完成。

words.note: 語塊：conversion of（……的改建）、currency conversion（貨幣兌換）、conversion rate（轉換率）。conversion 是名詞；convert 是動詞「轉換；改建」；conversation 是「對話」，長得像。

sentences.en: The accumulation of snow on the roof caused damage to the old building last winter.
sentences.zh: 屋頂積雪造成那棟老建築去年冬天受損。

sentences.en: The report studies the accumulation of wealth among families in different parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 報告研究國內不同地區家庭的財富累積。

sentences.en: The accumulation of small mistakes over many months led to a large problem with the accounts.
sentences.zh: 好幾個月累積下來的小錯誤，導致帳目出現大問題。

sentences.en: Regular cleaning prevents the accumulation of dust inside the machines, which can cause them to break.
sentences.zh: 定期清潔能防止機器內累積灰塵，那可能會讓機器故障。

sentences.en: The accumulation of plastic waste in the ocean is a serious problem for fish and birds.
sentences.zh: 海洋中塑膠垃圾的累積對魚和鳥來說是嚴重的問題。

words.note: 語塊：accumulation of（……的累積）、the accumulation of wealth（財富的累積）。accumulation 是名詞；accumulate 是動詞「累積」。

sentences.en: The government took decisive action to protect jobs during the long economic downturn last year.
sentences.zh: 政府在經濟衰退期間採取果斷行動保護就業。

sentences.en: Price was the decisive factor when the company chose a supplier for its new product.
sentences.zh: 公司為新產品選擇供應商時，價格是決定性因素。

sentences.en: Employees respect the CEO because she is a decisive leader who explains her decisions clearly.
sentences.zh: 員工很尊敬執行長，因為她是一位果斷又能清楚說明決定的領導者。

sentences.en: The location of the hotel was the decisive factor in our decision to hold the conference there.
sentences.zh: 飯店的地點是我們決定在那裡辦研討會的決定性因素。

sentences.en: Quick and decisive action by the staff prevented the fire from spreading to other parts of the building.
sentences.zh: 員工迅速果斷的行動，防止火勢蔓延到大樓其他地方。

words.note: 語塊：decisive action（果斷的行動）、decisive factor（決定性因素）、decisive leader（果斷的領導者）。decisive 是「能很快做決定的」或「決定性的」；decision 是名詞；indecisive 是「優柔寡斷的」。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee is a resourceful employee who always finds a way to solve problems without spending much money.
sentences.zh: 李小姐是一位機靈的員工，總能找到不花大錢就解決問題的方法。

sentences.en: The team was resourceful in finding cheaper materials when the price of steel increased suddenly.
sentences.zh: 鋼材價格突然上漲時，團隊很有辦法找到更便宜的材料。

sentences.en: Small business owners must be resourceful because they often have limited budgets and few staff.
sentences.zh: 小企業老闆必須很有辦法，因為他們的預算常常有限、員工又少。

sentences.en: The resourceful manager used old furniture from the warehouse to set up the new office quickly.
sentences.zh: 那位機靈的經理用倉庫裡的舊家具，很快就布置好新辦公室。

sentences.en: We are looking for a resourceful assistant who can handle unexpected problems calmly and quickly.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位能冷靜快速處理突發問題、機靈的助理。

words.note: 語塊：a resourceful employee（機靈的員工）、resourceful in（在……方面很有辦法）。resourceful 是「遇到問題很有辦法解決的」；resource 是名詞「資源」。

sentences.en: The redevelopment of the old harbor area will include new apartments, shops, and a large park.
sentences.zh: 舊港區的重建將包括新公寓、商店和一座大公園。

sentences.en: The city council approved a redevelopment project that will turn the old factory into offices.
sentences.zh: 市議會核准了一項把舊工廠改建成辦公室的重建計畫。

sentences.en: Urban redevelopment has made the downtown area more popular with young families and tourists from abroad.
sentences.zh: 都市再開發讓市中心更受年輕家庭和觀光客歡迎。

sentences.en: Some residents are worried that the redevelopment of their neighborhood will make rents too expensive.
sentences.zh: 有些居民擔心社區的重建會讓房租變得太貴。

sentences.en: The redevelopment project is expected to create hundreds of jobs over the next five years.
sentences.zh: 重建計畫預計在未來五年創造數百個工作機會。

words.note: 語塊：urban redevelopment（都市再開發）、redevelopment project（重建計畫）、redevelopment of（……的重建）。redevelopment 是「把舊區域重新規劃建設」；development 是「開發；發展」。

words.meaning: 樂於接受的；接受度高的

sentences.en: The new manager is receptive to ideas from employees and often asks for their opinions.
sentences.zh: 新經理樂於接受員工的想法，常常徵詢他們的意見。

sentences.en: Young customers are usually more receptive to new technology and online shopping than older customers.
sentences.zh: 年輕顧客通常比年長顧客更容易接受新科技。

sentences.en: The speaker found a receptive audience among the students, who asked many interesting questions after the talk.
sentences.zh: 講者在學生中找到接受度很高的聽眾，他們問了很多有趣的問題。

sentences.en: The board was receptive to the proposal and agreed to discuss it further at the next meeting.
sentences.zh: 董事會樂於接受那份提案，同意在下次會議進一步討論。

sentences.en: Customers have been very receptive to the new menu, so the restaurant plans to keep it all year.
sentences.zh: 顧客對新菜單接受度很高，所以餐廳打算整年保留。

words.note: 語塊：receptive to（樂於接受……）、receptive audience（接受度高的觀眾）。receptive 是「願意聽取新想法的」；open to 意思接近；reception 是「接待；歡迎會」。

sentences.en: The company plans to reduce carbon emission from its factories by using solar power and wind energy.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫使用太陽能，減少工廠的碳排放。

sentences.en: All new cars must meet strict emission standards before they can be sold in the country.
sentences.zh: 所有新車都必須符合嚴格的排放標準才能在國內販售。

sentences.en: The government introduced new laws to limit the emission of harmful gases from power plants.
sentences.zh: 政府推出新法律，限制發電廠排放有害氣體。

sentences.en: Electric buses produce no emission, so they help improve the air quality in the city center.
sentences.zh: 電動公車沒有排放，所以有助於改善市中心的空氣品質。

sentences.en: The report shows that carbon emission from cars has increased because more people drive to work.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示汽車的碳排放增加了，因為更多人開車上班。

words.note: 語塊：carbon emission（碳排放）、reduce emissions（減少排放）、emission standards（排放標準）。emission 是「排放出來的氣體或物質」，常用複數 emissions；emit 是動詞。

sentences.en: Ms. Park is responsible for training new employees and answering their questions during their first month.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐負責訓練新員工，並在他們第一個月回答問題。

sentences.en: The bad weather was responsible for the delay of more than fifty flights at the airport yesterday.
sentences.zh: 壞天氣是昨天機場五十多個航班延誤的原因。

sentences.en: Each department manager is responsible for preparing a budget for the next year by the end of October.
sentences.zh: 每位部門經理都負責在十月底前準備下一年的預算。

sentences.en: The building manager is responsible for making sure that the fire exits are always clear.
sentences.zh: 大樓管理員負責確保逃生出口隨時保持暢通。

sentences.en: The company is not responsible for any items that are lost or stolen in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 公司對停車場內遺失或被竊的任何物品概不負責。

words.note: 語塊：be responsible for（負責……）、responsible for the delay（造成延誤的原因）。be responsible for 後面接名詞或 V-ing；in charge of 意思接近；responsibility 是名詞。

sentences.en: The marketing team will carry out an analysis of customer data to find out which products sell best.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊將進行顧客資料分析，找出哪些產品賣得最好。

sentences.en: The report includes a detailed analysis of the costs and benefits of moving the factory.
sentences.zh: 報告包含搬遷工廠成本和效益的詳細分析。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin has strong skills in data analysis, which makes her an excellent candidate for the job.
sentences.zh: 林小姐的資料分析能力很強，讓她成為這份工作的優秀人選。

sentences.en: According to the analysis, the new store could make a profit within its first two years.
sentences.zh: 根據分析，新店在頭兩年內就可能獲利。

sentences.en: The company hired a consultant to carry out an analysis of its spending on travel and advertising.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請顧問分析它在差旅和廣告上的支出。

words.note: 語塊：data analysis（資料分析）、carry out an analysis（進行分析）、detailed analysis（詳細的分析）。analysis 複數是 analyses；analyze 是動詞；analyst 是「分析師」。

sentences.en: The company ships goods from its warehouse to stores across the country early every morning.
sentences.zh: 公司每天早上從倉庫把貨物運到全國各地的門市。

sentences.en: Prices for consumer goods such as food and clothing have risen sharply in many countries this year.
sentences.zh: 今年食物和服飾等消費品的價格大幅上漲。

sentences.en: The new port will make it easier to export goods to countries in Asia and Europe.
sentences.zh: 新港口會讓出口貨物到亞洲和歐洲國家更容易。

sentences.en: The tax applies to all goods and services sold in the country, including online purchases.
sentences.zh: 這項稅適用於國內銷售的所有商品和服務，包括網路購物。

sentences.en: The truck was delayed at the border, so the goods did not arrive at the store until Friday.
sentences.zh: 卡車在邊境被耽擱，所以貨物直到週五才送到店裡。

words.note: 語塊：consumer goods（消費品）、deliver goods（運送貨物）、goods and services（商品和服務）、ship goods（運送貨物）、export goods（出口貨物）。goods 一定是複數，指「商品、貨物」；good 單數是「好的；利益」。

sentences.en: The farm hires seasonal workers every autumn to help harvest the apples and pears in the valley.
sentences.zh: 農場每年秋天都會僱用季節性工人幫忙採收蘋果和梨子。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers a seasonal menu that changes four times a year to use fresh local ingredients.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳提供一年換四次的季節菜單，使用新鮮的在地食材。

sentences.en: Hotels on the island depend on seasonal demand, so many of them close during the winter months.
sentences.zh: 島上的飯店依賴季節性的需求，所以很多在冬季月份歇業。

sentences.en: The store hires seasonal staff in December because it is the busiest time of the year.
sentences.zh: 那家店在十二月僱用季節性員工，因為那是一年中最忙的時候。

sentences.en: Sales of ice cream are highly seasonal, with most of the profit made during the summer.
sentences.zh: 冰淇淋的銷售季節性很強，大部分利潤都在夏天賺到。

words.note: 語塊：seasonal workers（季節性員工）、seasonal menu（季節菜單）、seasonal demand（季節性需求）。seasonal 是「依季節而變的」；season 是名詞「季節」；seasoned 是「經驗豐富的；調味過的」。

sentences.en: Contrary to what many people believe, the new software is very easy to learn and use.
sentences.zh: 和很多人以為的相反，新軟體非常容易學習和使用。

sentences.en: The report did not show a drop in sales; on the contrary, sales increased by ten percent last year.
sentences.zh: 報告並沒有顯示銷售下滑；相反地，去年銷售增加了一成。

sentences.en: Contrary to expectations, the small café made more money than the large restaurant next door.
sentences.zh: 和預期相反，那家小咖啡館賺得比隔壁的大餐廳還多。

sentences.en: The manager was not angry about the mistake; on the contrary, she thanked the team for reporting it.
sentences.zh: 經理沒有對錯誤生氣；相反地，她感謝團隊回報問題。

sentences.en: Contrary to the weather forecast, the sun came out in the afternoon, and the outdoor concert went ahead.
sentences.zh: 和天氣預報相反，下午出太陽了，戶外音樂會照常舉行。

words.note: 語塊：on the contrary（相反地）、contrary to（與……相反）。contrary to 是「和……相反」；on the contrary 用來否定前面的說法；opposite 意思接近。

sentences.en: The new theater offers comfortable seats and free snacks to attract every moviegoer in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 新電影院提供舒適的座位和免費點心，吸引附近的每一位影迷。

sentences.en: Every moviegoer who buys a ticket this weekend will receive a free poster of the new film.
sentences.zh: 這個週末每位買票的觀眾都會得到一張新電影的免費海報。

sentences.en: The film was popular with critics, but the average moviegoer found the story too long and slow.
sentences.zh: 那部電影很受評論家喜愛，但一般觀眾覺得故事太長又太慢。

sentences.en: The theater changed its prices after a survey showed that the typical moviegoer wanted cheaper tickets.
sentences.zh: 調查顯示一般觀眾希望票價便宜一點後，電影院調整了價格。

sentences.en: Many a moviegoer now prefers to watch films at home, so theaters are offering special events to attract them.
sentences.zh: 現在很多影迷比較喜歡在家看電影，所以電影院推出特別活動吸引他們。

words.note: 語塊：moviegoers（觀影民眾）。moviegoer 是「去電影院看電影的人」；audience 是「觀眾」；filmgoer 是英式說法。

words.meaning: 有說服力的；引人入勝的

sentences.en: The manager gave a compelling reason for moving the office closer to the train station.
sentences.zh: 經理提出一個令人信服的理由，說明為什麼要把辦公室搬到離火車站近一點。

sentences.en: The scientists found compelling evidence that the new medicine helps patients recover more quickly after surgery.
sentences.zh: 科學家找到有力的證據，證明新藥能幫助病人更快康復。

sentences.en: The documentary tells a compelling story about a family that started a successful business from nothing.
sentences.zh: 那部紀錄片講述一個家庭白手起家成功創業的扣人心弦的故事。

sentences.en: Customers need a compelling reason to switch from their current phone company to our new service.
sentences.zh: 顧客需要一個令人信服的理由，才會從目前的電信公司轉到我們這裡。

sentences.en: The lawyer presented compelling evidence to the court, and the judge decided in favor of her client.
sentences.zh: 律師向法院提出有力的證據，法官判她的客戶勝訴。

words.note: 語塊：compelling reason（令人信服的理由）、compelling evidence（有力的證據）、compelling story（扣人心弦的故事）。compelling 是「讓人無法不相信或不注意的」；convincing 意思接近；compel 是動詞「迫使」。

sentences.en: The store lowered its prices in order to attract customers away from the new shopping center.
sentences.zh: 那家店降價，想把顧客從新購物中心吸引過來。

sentences.en: The bright colors of the poster are designed to attract attention from people walking by.
sentences.zh: 海報鮮豔的顏色是為了吸引路人的注意。

sentences.en: The government lowered taxes to attract investment from foreign companies in the growing technology sector.
sentences.zh: 政府減稅，以吸引外國公司在科技業投資。

sentences.en: The new museum is expected to attract more than one million visitors in its first year.
sentences.zh: 新博物館預計第一年會吸引一百多萬名參觀者。

sentences.en: Free parking and long opening hours help attract customers who live in towns outside the city.
sentences.zh: 免費停車和長營業時間有助於吸引住在城外的顧客。

words.note: 語塊：attract customers（吸引顧客）、attract attention（吸引注意）、attract investment（吸引投資）。attract 是「吸引」；attraction 是名詞「吸引力；景點」；attractive 是形容詞。

sentences.en: Customers who buy the new washing machine this month will receive a rebate of fifty dollars.
sentences.zh: 這個月購買新洗衣機的顧客可以獲得五十美元的退款。

sentences.en: Families with young children may be able to receive a tax rebate at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 有幼童的家庭年底可能可以拿到退稅。

sentences.en: The electricity company will offer a rebate to customers who install solar panels on their homes.
sentences.zh: 電力公司將為在家安裝太陽能板的顧客提供折讓。

sentences.en: To receive a rebate, please send a copy of your receipt and the form to the manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 要獲得退款，請把收據副本和表格寄給製造商。

sentences.en: The government offered a rebate to people who bought electric cars in order to reduce pollution.
sentences.zh: 政府為購買電動車的人提供退款，以減少污染。

words.note: 語塊：receive a rebate（獲得退款）、tax rebate（退稅）、offer a rebate（提供折讓）。rebate 是「付款後退回的一部分錢」；refund 是「全部退款」；discount 是「付款前的折扣」。

sentences.en: Our fast delivery service gives us a distinct advantage over other online stores in the region.
sentences.zh: 我們快速的配送服務讓我們比地區其他網路商店有明顯的優勢。

sentences.en: The new phone is distinct from the old model because it has a much larger screen and better camera.
sentences.zh: 新手機和舊款截然不同，因為螢幕大很多、相機也更好。

sentences.en: There is a distinct difference between the two hotels, as one is much quieter than the other.
sentences.zh: 兩家飯店有明顯的差異，因為其中一家安靜很多。

sentences.en: Each neighborhood in the city has a distinct style, with its own shops, restaurants, and markets.
sentences.zh: 城市的每個社區都有明顯不同的風格，有自己的商店、餐廳和市場。

sentences.en: Speaking Japanese gave Ms. Lee a distinct advantage when she applied for the job in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 會說日文讓李小姐在應徵東京的工作時有明顯的優勢。

words.note: 語塊：distinct advantage（明顯的優勢）、distinct from（和……不同）、a distinct difference（明顯的差異）。distinct 是「清楚不同的」；distinctive 是「有特色的」；distinguish 是動詞「區分」。
