sentences.en: The payment could not be completed because of insufficient funds in the customer's bank account.
sentences.zh: 因為顧客銀行帳戶資金不足，付款無法完成。

sentences.en: The report was rejected because it contained insufficient information about the costs of the project.
sentences.zh: 那份報告被退回，因為關於專案成本的資訊不足。

sentences.en: The police said there was insufficient evidence to show that the company had broken the law.
sentences.zh: 警方表示沒有足夠的證據顯示那家公司違法。

sentences.en: Many small farms struggle because of insufficient rain during the long, hot, and dry summer months.
sentences.zh: 很多小農場因為漫長炎熱的夏季雨量不足而陷入困境。

sentences.en: The hotel apologized to the guests because of insufficient staff at the front desk during the busy weekend.
sentences.zh: 飯店因為忙碌週末時櫃台人手不足而向客人道歉。

words.note: 語塊：insufficient funds（資金不足）、insufficient information（資訊不足）、insufficient evidence（證據不足）。insufficient 是「不夠的」；sufficient 是「足夠的」；inefficient 是「沒效率的」，長得像。

sentences.en: The company provides medical coverage for all full-time employees and their families from the first day.
sentences.zh: 公司為所有全職員工和他們的家人提供醫療保險。

sentences.en: Part-time workers do not receive medical coverage, but they can buy insurance through the company.
sentences.zh: 兼職員工沒有醫療保險，但可以透過公司購買保險。

sentences.en: Many people choose jobs with good medical coverage because doctors and hospitals can be expensive.
sentences.zh: 很多人選擇有好醫療保險的工作，因為看醫生和住院可能很貴。

sentences.en: The new plan offers better medical coverage, including dental care and eye examinations every year.
sentences.zh: 新方案提供更好的醫療保障，包括牙科和眼科檢查。

sentences.en: Please check your medical coverage before you travel abroad, as some costs may not be included.
sentences.zh: 出國前請確認你的醫療保險，因為有些費用可能不包含在內。

words.note: 語塊：provide medical coverage（提供醫療保險）、medical coverage for（……的醫療保障）。coverage 是「保險的保障範圍」；health insurance 意思接近。

sentences.en: A sales representative will contact you within two days to discuss the price of the equipment.
sentences.zh: 業務代表會在兩天內聯絡你，討論設備的價格。

sentences.en: Please call our customer service representative if you have any questions about your monthly bill.
sentences.zh: 如果你對帳單有任何問題，請打電話給我們的客服代表。

sentences.en: A company representative will attend the job fair at the university to answer students' questions.
sentences.zh: 一位公司代表會參加大學的就業博覽會，回答學生的問題。

sentences.en: Each department will choose one representative to join the committee that plans the annual party.
sentences.zh: 每個部門會選一位代表，加入籌辦年度派對的委員會。

sentences.en: The customer service representative was very helpful and solved my problem in only five minutes.
sentences.zh: 那位客服代表很有幫助，只花五分鐘就解決了我的問題。

words.note: 語塊：sales representative（業務代表）、customer service representative（客服代表）、company representative（公司代表）。representative 是「代表某單位的人」；represent 是動詞「代表」。

sentences.en: The assistant will make an arrangement with the hotel so that the clients can check in early during their visit.
sentences.zh: 助理會和飯店談妥，讓客戶來訪期間可以提早入住。

sentences.en: Please send me your travel arrangement for next week so that someone can meet you at the airport.
sentences.zh: 請把你下週的行程安排寄給我，讓我們派人到機場接你。

sentences.en: The two companies have an arrangement that allows them to share the same warehouse near the port.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司有一項協議，讓它們可以共用同一間倉庫。

sentences.en: A beautiful flower arrangement was placed on each table for the wedding dinner at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 飯店婚宴的每張桌上都擺了一盆漂亮的插花。

sentences.en: The manager has made an arrangement with the restaurant so that employees can eat lunch there at a discount.
sentences.zh: 經理和那家餐廳談好了，讓員工可以用折扣價在那裡吃午餐。

words.note: 語塊：make an arrangement（做安排；談妥）、travel arrangement（行程安排）、flower arrangement（插花）。arrangement 是名詞，常用複數 arrangements（安排）；arrange 是動詞。

sentences.en: The bank is hiring a financial analyst to help its clients choose the right investments.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行正在招聘一位財務分析師，幫助客戶選擇合適的投資。

sentences.en: A market analyst said that sales of electric cars will continue to grow over the next ten years.
sentences.zh: 一位市場分析師說，電動車的銷售在未來十年會持續成長。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim works as a data analyst and studies information about customers to find useful patterns.
sentences.zh: 金小姐擔任資料分析師，研究顧客資訊以找出有用的模式。

sentences.en: Every analyst at the firm must write a report about the market at the end of each month.
sentences.zh: 公司的每位分析師都必須在每月底寫一份市場報告。

sentences.en: The financial analyst warned that the company's profits might fall next year because of rising costs.
sentences.zh: 財務分析師警告公司的獲利可能因成本上升而下滑。

words.note: 語塊：financial analyst（財務分析師）、market analyst（市場分析師）、data analyst（資料分析師）。analyst 是「做分析的人」；analysis 是「分析」；analyze 是動詞。

sentences.en: Please arrive at the airport at least two hours before your flight for international travel.
sentences.zh: 搭國際航班時，請至少提前兩小時抵達機場。

sentences.en: Applicants must have at least three years of experience in sales or customer service at a large company.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須至少有三年的業務或客服經驗。

sentences.en: The repairs will take at least one week, so the elevator will be closed until next Friday.
sentences.zh: 維修至少要一週，所以電梯會關到下週五。

sentences.en: Employees should change their passwords at least once every three months for important security reasons.
sentences.zh: 為了安全，員工應該至少每三個月更換一次密碼。

sentences.en: The restaurant was busy, but at least the food was delicious and the staff were friendly.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳很忙，但至少食物很好吃，員工也很親切。

words.note: 語塊：at least（至少）。at least 是「至少、最少」；at most 是「最多」；at last 是「終於」。

sentences.en: Please be patient with new employees, as it takes time to learn how to use the system.
sentences.zh: 請對新員工有耐心，因為學會使用系統需要時間。

sentences.en: The customer service staff are patient and friendly, even when customers are upset or confused.
sentences.zh: 客服人員即使在顧客不滿或困惑時也很有耐心又親切。

sentences.en: Teachers must be patient with young children who are learning to read and write for the first time.
sentences.zh: 老師對第一次學讀寫的幼童必須很有耐心。

sentences.en: Thank you for being patient while we repaired the problem with the website this morning.
sentences.zh: 謝謝您在今天早上我們修理網站問題時耐心等候。

sentences.en: The manager is known for being patient with her team and always explaining things clearly.
sentences.zh: 那位經理以對團隊很有耐心、總是把事情解釋清楚而出名。

words.note: 語塊：be patient with（對……有耐心）、patient and friendly（有耐心又親切）。patient 當形容詞是「有耐心的」，當名詞是「病人」；patience 是名詞「耐心」。

sentences.en: Rest assured that your personal information will be kept safe and will not be shared with anyone.
sentences.zh: 請放心，你的個人資料會被妥善保管，不會分享給任何人。

sentences.en: Please rest assured that we will send the missing items to you by express mail today.
sentences.zh: 請放心，我們今天會用快遞把缺少的品項寄給您。

sentences.en: You can rest assured that our technicians will fix the problem as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 您可以放心，我們的技師會盡快解決問題。

sentences.en: Rest assured that the hotel will hold your room even if your flight arrives late at night.
sentences.zh: 請放心，即使你的航班深夜才抵達，飯店也會保留你的房間。

sentences.en: Customers can rest assured that all of our products are tested carefully before they are sold.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以放心，我們所有產品在販售前都經過仔細測試。

words.note: 語塊：rest assured that（請放心……）。rest assured 是正式的「請放心」，常用在商業書信；don't worry 是口語說法。

sentences.en: The company will offer a stock option to every senior employee as part of their compensation package.
sentences.zh: 公司將為每位資深員工提供股票選擇權，作為薪酬方案的一部分。

sentences.en: Many technology companies use a stock option to attract talented engineers who might go elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 很多科技公司用股票選擇權吸引可能跳槽的優秀工程師。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee received a stock option when she joined the startup, and its value has increased greatly.
sentences.zh: 李小姐加入那家新創公司時獲得股票選擇權，現在價值大增。

sentences.en: The new CEO's contract will include a stock option that can be used after three years.
sentences.zh: 新執行長的合約將包含一筆三年後才能行使的股票選擇權。

sentences.en: Employees who stay at the company for five years can use a stock option to buy shares at a low price.
sentences.zh: 在公司待滿五年的員工可以用股票選擇權以低價買股票。

words.note: 語塊：receive a stock option（獲得股票選擇權）、offer a stock option（提供股票選擇權）、use a stock option（用股票選擇權）、include a stock option（包含股票選擇權）。stock option 是「員工能以特定價格買公司股票的權利」，常用複數 stock options。

sentences.en: Ms. Park previously worked as a teacher before she joined the company as a training manager.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐以前當過老師，之後才以訓練經理的身分加入公司。

sentences.en: As previously mentioned, the meeting has been moved to Thursday at ten o'clock in the main room.
sentences.zh: 如先前所提，會議改到週四十點在主會議室。

sentences.en: The store was previously located on Main Street, but it moved to the shopping center last year.
sentences.zh: 那家店以前在 Main 街，但去年搬到購物中心了。

sentences.en: The new manager previously worked at a large bank in London for more than ten years.
sentences.zh: 新經理以前在倫敦一家大銀行工作了十多年。

sentences.en: As previously announced, all employees must complete the safety training by the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 如先前公告，所有員工都必須在月底前完成安全訓練。

words.note: 語塊：previously worked（以前曾在……工作）、as previously mentioned（如先前所提）。previously 是「之前」；previous 是形容詞「先前的」；formerly 意思接近。

sentences.en: The proposal will be presented to senior management at the monthly meeting next Tuesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 提案將在下週二的會議上向高階管理層報告。

sentences.en: The workshop on time management helped employees learn how to finish their tasks more quickly.
sentences.zh: 時間管理工作坊幫助員工學會如何更快完成工作。

sentences.en: The restaurant is under new management, and the new owners have changed the menu completely.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳換了新經營者，新老闆把菜單完全改了。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz has a degree in business management and ten years of experience in the hotel industry.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐有企業管理學位，以及十年的飯店業經驗。

sentences.en: Good management of the budget allowed the team to finish the project without spending extra money.
sentences.zh: 良好的預算管理讓團隊在不多花錢的情況下完成專案。

words.note: 語塊：senior management（高階管理層）、time management（時間管理）、under new management（換了新經營者）。management 可以是「管理（行為）」或「管理階層（人）」；manage 是動詞；manager 是「經理」。

sentences.en: After several hours of discussion, the two sides were able to reach a compromise on the price.
sentences.zh: 經過幾個小時的討論，雙方終於在價格上達成妥協。

sentences.en: The manager had to make a compromise so that both teams would be happy with the new schedule.
sentences.zh: 經理必須做出妥協，讓兩個團隊都對新班表滿意。

sentences.en: The final design was a compromise between what the client wanted and what the budget allowed.
sentences.zh: 最終設計是客戶的需求和預算允許範圍之間的折衷。

sentences.en: The union and the company reached a compromise that gave workers a small increase in pay.
sentences.zh: 工會和公司達成妥協，讓工人小幅加薪。

sentences.en: It is sometimes necessary to make a compromise in business, especially when working with large clients.
sentences.zh: 在商場上有時必須做出妥協，尤其是和大客戶合作的時候。

words.note: 語塊：reach a compromise（達成妥協）、make a compromise（做出妥協）。compromise 可以當名詞或動詞；也可以是動詞「損害（安全、品質）」。

sentences.en: The new parking rules are pending approval by the city council, which will meet next week.
sentences.zh: 新停車規定正等待市議會核准，議會下週會開會。

sentences.en: Your application is pending review, and we will contact you within two weeks with a decision.
sentences.zh: 你的申請正在待審，我們會在兩週內聯絡你告知結果。

sentences.en: The payment is still pending, so the order will not be shipped until the bank confirms it.
sentences.zh: 付款還在處理中，所以銀行確認之前訂單不會出貨。

sentences.en: The construction of the new library is pending, as the city has not yet found enough funding.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館的興建還沒確定，因為市政府還沒找到足夠的經費。

sentences.en: All pending orders will be shipped on Monday morning after the warehouse reopens for business.
sentences.zh: 所有待處理的訂單會在週一早上倉庫重新開工後出貨。

words.note: 語塊：pending approval（待核准）、pending review（待審查）、still pending（仍在處理中）、pending orders（待處理訂單）。pending 是「還在等待決定的」；當介系詞是「在……之前」（pending the results）。

sentences.en: Many small towns in the region are dependent on tourism for most of their income.
sentences.zh: 該地區很多小鎮大部分收入依賴觀光業。

sentences.en: The success of the outdoor concert is dependent on good weather in the park on Saturday evening.
sentences.zh: 戶外音樂會能否成功取決於週六晚上的好天氣。

sentences.en: The company is too dependent on one large customer, so it is looking for new clients.
sentences.zh: 公司太依賴一位大客戶，所以正在尋找新客戶。

sentences.en: The price of the tour is dependent on the number of people who sign up for it.
sentences.zh: 行程的價格取決於報名的人數。

sentences.en: Farmers in the valley are dependent on the river for the water they use on their crops.
sentences.zh: 山谷裡的農民依賴河水灌溉作物。

words.note: 語塊：be dependent on（依賴……；取決於……）。be dependent on 是「依靠」或「取決於」；independent 是「獨立的」；dependable 是「可靠的」。

sentences.en: The doctor referred the patient to a heart specialist at the hospital for further tests.
sentences.zh: 醫生把病人轉介給醫院的心臟科醫生做進一步檢查。

sentences.en: Please contact our IT specialist if you have any problems with your computer or email account.
sentences.zh: 如果你的電腦或電子郵件帳號有任何問題，請聯絡我們的資訊專家。

sentences.en: The company hired a marketing specialist to help increase its sales to young customers online.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一位行銷專員，幫助提高對年輕網路顧客的銷售。

sentences.en: Each specialist at the clinic has at least ten years of experience in his or her field.
sentences.zh: 診所的每位專科醫生在自己的領域都有至少十年經驗。

sentences.en: The museum invited a specialist in ancient art to give a talk about its new exhibition.
sentences.zh: 博物館邀請一位古代藝術專家，針對新展覽發表演講。

words.note: 語塊：heart specialist（心臟科醫生）、IT specialist（資訊專家）、marketing specialist（行銷專員）。specialist 是「某領域的專家」；special 是「特別的」；specialize 是動詞。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed works at a law firm that helps small businesses with contracts and taxes.
sentences.zh: Ahmed 小姐在一家協助小企業處理合約和稅務的律師事務所工作。

sentences.en: The company hired an accounting firm to check its financial records before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 公司聘請一家會計師事務所在年底前檢查財務紀錄。

sentences.en: The consulting firm advised the hotel to improve its website and offer more online services.
sentences.zh: 顧問公司建議那家飯店改善網站，提供更多線上服務。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim left the bank to start his own consulting firm, which now has twenty employees.
sentences.zh: 金先生離開銀行，自己開了一家顧問公司，現在有二十名員工。

sentences.en: Our firm has worked with clients in more than thirty countries over the past twenty years.
sentences.zh: 我們公司過去二十年和三十多個國家的客戶合作過。

words.note: 語塊：law firm（律師事務所）、accounting firm（會計師事務所）、consulting firm（顧問公司）。firm 當名詞是「公司（常指專業服務公司）」；當形容詞是「堅固的；堅定的」。

sentences.en: Ms. Park decided to set up a business that sells handmade furniture online after she left her job.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐辭職後決定創業，在網路上賣手工家具。

sentences.en: Could you set up a meeting with the clients for next Tuesday afternoon at their office?
sentences.zh: 你可以安排下週二下午在客戶辦公室和他們開會嗎？

sentences.en: The technicians will set up the equipment in the conference room before the presentation begins.
sentences.zh: 技師會在簡報開始前，在會議室架設好設備。

sentences.en: The company plans to set up a new office in Singapore to manage its business in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在新加坡設立新辦公室，管理東南亞的業務。

sentences.en: It took the volunteers two hours to set up the tables and chairs for the charity dinner.
sentences.zh: 志工花了兩小時為慈善晚宴擺好桌椅。

words.note: 語塊：set up a business（創業）、set up a meeting（安排會議）、set up equipment（架設設備）。set up 是「建立、架設」；setup 是名詞「設置；配置」。

sentences.en: Because of declining sales, the store has decided to close two of its branches next year.
sentences.zh: 因為銷售下滑，那家店決定明年關閉兩家分店。

sentences.en: Many small towns are facing a declining population as young people move to large cities.
sentences.zh: 隨著年輕人搬到大城市，很多小鎮面臨人口減少。

sentences.en: The company changed its advertising strategy because of declining interest in its products among young customers.
sentences.zh: 因為年輕顧客的興趣降低，公司改變了廣告策略。

sentences.en: Declining prices for solar panels have made it easier for families to use clean energy at home.
sentences.zh: 太陽能板價格下降，讓家庭更容易在家使用潔淨能源。

sentences.en: The newspaper has suffered from declining sales since more people began reading the news online.
sentences.zh: 自從更多人開始在網路上看新聞，那家報紙的銷量就一直下滑。

words.note: 語塊：declining sales（下滑的銷售）、declining population（減少的人口）、declining interest（降低的興趣）。declining 是「正在減少的」；decline 可以當動詞「下降；婉拒」或名詞「下降」。

sentences.en: The new factory will have a big impact on the local economy by creating hundreds of jobs.
sentences.zh: 新工廠將創造數百個工作，對地方經濟產生很大的影響。

sentences.en: The training program had a positive impact on customer service in all of our stores.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫對我們所有門市的客服都有正面影響。

sentences.en: The company must study the environmental impact of the new road before construction can begin.
sentences.zh: 施工開始前，公司必須研究新道路對環境的衝擊。

sentences.en: Rising fuel prices have had an impact on the cost of shipping goods around the world.
sentences.zh: 油價上漲對全球貨物運輸的成本造成了影響。

sentences.en: Social media has a strong impact on the products that young people decide to buy online.
sentences.zh: 社群媒體對年輕人決定在網路上買什麼產品有很大的影響。

words.note: 語塊：have an impact on（對……有影響）、a positive impact（正面影響）、environmental impact（環境衝擊）。impact 可以當名詞或動詞「影響」；effect、influence 意思接近。

sentences.en: The engineer came up with an ingenious idea for reducing the noise from the factory's machines.
sentences.zh: 那位工程師想出一個巧妙的點子，減少工廠機器的噪音。

sentences.en: The chair has an ingenious design that allows it to be folded into a small box for storage.
sentences.zh: 那張椅子有巧妙的設計，可以摺成一個小盒子收納。

sentences.en: The team found an ingenious solution to the problem without spending any extra money or time.
sentences.zh: 團隊找到一個巧妙的解決辦法，沒有多花任何錢。

sentences.en: Many visitors were impressed by the ingenious use of sunlight to heat the new library.
sentences.zh: 很多訪客對新圖書館巧妙利用陽光取暖印象深刻。

sentences.en: The student's ingenious invention won first prize at the national science competition held in the capital this year.
sentences.zh: 那位學生巧妙的發明今年在全國科學競賽中獲得第一名。

words.note: 語塊：ingenious idea（巧妙的點子）、ingenious design（巧妙的設計）、ingenious solution（巧妙的解決辦法）。ingenious 是「聰明又有創意的」；ingenuous 是「天真的」，只差一個字母。

words.meaning: 無法接受的；不可接受的

sentences.en: The manager said that the long delays in delivery were unacceptable and must be fixed immediately.
sentences.zh: 經理說長時間的延遲送貨是無法接受的，必須立刻改善。

sentences.en: Rude comments to customers are totally unacceptable, and staff who make them may lose their jobs.
sentences.zh: 對顧客說無禮的話是完全無法接受的，這麼做的員工可能會丟掉工作。

sentences.en: The school has strict rules about unacceptable behavior, such as using mobile phones during class.
sentences.zh: 學校對不可接受的行為有嚴格規定，例如上課時用手機。

sentences.en: Many customers found the new prices unacceptable and decided to shop at other stores instead.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客覺得新價格無法接受，決定改去其他店購物。

sentences.en: The report described the working conditions at the factory as unacceptable and called for changes.
sentences.zh: 報告形容工廠的工作條件無法接受，並呼籲改變。

words.note: 語塊：totally unacceptable（完全無法接受）、unacceptable behavior（不可接受的行為）、found sth unacceptable（覺得……無法接受）、were unacceptable（是無法接受的）。unacceptable 是「不能被接受的」；acceptable 是「可接受的」。

sentences.en: Many people underestimate the cost of moving to a new city, especially the price of housing.
sentences.zh: 很多人低估搬到新城市的花費，尤其是房價。

sentences.en: Please do not underestimate the time it takes to prepare a good presentation for the clients.
sentences.zh: 請不要低估為客戶準備一份好簡報所需的時間。

sentences.en: The company did not underestimate the competition and invested heavily in new technology and training.
sentences.zh: 公司沒有低估競爭，大舉投資新科技。

sentences.en: It is easy to underestimate how much energy a building uses when the lights are left on at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上燈一直開著時，很容易低估一棟建築用了多少電。

sentences.en: The team tends to underestimate the cost of projects, so the manager now adds ten percent to every budget.
sentences.zh: 團隊常常低估專案成本，所以經理現在每份預算都多加一成。

words.note: 語塊：underestimate the cost（低估成本）、underestimate the time（低估所需時間）。underestimate 是「估計得太少」；overestimate 是「高估」；estimate 是「估計」。

sentences.en: The city is trying to stop the uncontrolled growth of buildings near the beautiful old harbor.
sentences.zh: 市政府正努力阻止美麗舊港口附近的建築失控成長。

sentences.en: Uncontrolled spending on travel and meals caused the department to go over its budget last year.
sentences.zh: 差旅和餐費的支出失控，讓部門去年超出預算。

sentences.en: The fire was uncontrolled for several hours before firefighters were finally able to stop it.
sentences.zh: 火勢失控了好幾個小時，消防員才終於撲滅。

sentences.en: Experts warn that uncontrolled use of plastic is causing serious damage to rivers and oceans.
sentences.zh: 專家警告，塑膠使用不受控制，正對河川和海洋造成嚴重損害。

sentences.en: The new rules are designed to prevent uncontrolled price increases for rent in the city center.
sentences.zh: 新規定的目的是防止市中心房租失控上漲。

words.note: 語塊：uncontrolled growth（失控的成長）、uncontrolled spending（失控的支出）、uncontrolled use（不受控制的使用）、uncontrolled price increases（失控的漲價）。uncontrolled 是「沒有被控制的」；controlled 是「受控制的」。

sentences.en: The employee spoke resentfully about the new schedule, which required him to work every weekend.
sentences.zh: 那位員工不滿地談起新班表，因為那要求他每個週末都上班。

sentences.en: Some workers agreed resentfully to the pay cut because they were afraid of losing their jobs.
sentences.zh: 有些工人很不甘願地同意減薪，因為怕丟掉工作。

sentences.en: The customer looked at the bill resentfully when she saw the extra charge for the delivery.
sentences.zh: 那位顧客看到額外的運費時，不滿地看著帳單。

sentences.en: He resentfully accepted the decision of the committee, even though he did not agree with it.
sentences.zh: 他雖然不同意，還是不甘願地接受了委員會的決定。

sentences.en: The staff spoke resentfully about the lack of communication from management during the merger last year.
sentences.zh: 員工不滿地談論合併期間管理階層缺乏溝通。

words.note: 語塊：speak resentfully（不滿地說）、spoke resentfully（不滿地說了）、resentfully accepted（不甘願地接受）、agreed resentfully（不甘願地同意）。resentfully 是「心裡不爽、不甘願地」；resent 是動詞「憤恨」；resentment 是名詞。

sentences.en: The investors listened skeptically as the young entrepreneur explained his plan for the new business.
sentences.zh: 年輕創業家說明新事業的計畫時，投資人半信半疑地聽著。

sentences.en: Many customers reacted skeptically to the company's claim that its new product could save energy.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客對公司宣稱新產品能節能的說法抱持懷疑。

sentences.en: The manager looked skeptically at the report because the sales numbers seemed much too high to be true.
sentences.zh: 經理懷疑地看著報告，因為數字看起來太高了。

sentences.en: Some residents responded skeptically when the city promised that the new road would reduce traffic.
sentences.zh: 市政府承諾新道路會減少交通量時，有些居民抱持懷疑。

sentences.en: The board reacted skeptically to the proposal at first, but it approved the plan after more discussion.
sentences.zh: 董事會起初對提案抱持懷疑，但經過更多討論後核准了計畫。

words.note: 語塊：look skeptically（懷疑地看）、react skeptically（以懷疑態度回應）。skeptically 是「半信半疑地」；skeptical 是形容詞「懷疑的」；skeptic 是「懷疑者」。

words.meaning: 資訊豐富的；有教育意義的

sentences.en: The workshop was very informative, and many participants said they learned useful tips for their jobs.
sentences.zh: 工作坊資訊很豐富，很多學員說他們學到了對工作有用的訣竅。

sentences.en: The museum's new website is informative and easy to use, with maps and details about every exhibit.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新網站資訊豐富又好用，有地圖和每個展品的細節。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee gave an informative presentation about the changes to the company's health insurance plan.
sentences.zh: 李小姐針對公司健康保險方案的變更，做了一場資訊豐富的簡報。

sentences.en: The brochure is highly informative and explains everything that new students need to know about the school.
sentences.zh: 這本小冊子非常有用，說明了新生需要知道的所有事情。

sentences.en: Customers found the video about the new software very informative, so we will make more of them.
sentences.zh: 顧客覺得那支介紹新軟體的影片非常有用，所以我們會再多拍幾支。

words.note: 語塊：informative presentation（資訊豐富的簡報）、highly informative（非常有用的）、very informative（非常有用的）、informative and easy（資訊豐富又容易）。informative 是「提供很多有用資訊的」；information 是名詞；informal 是「非正式的」，長得像。

sentences.en: Customers can check their transaction history online at any time by logging in to their bank account.
sentences.zh: 顧客隨時都可以登入銀行帳戶，在網路上查詢交易紀錄。

sentences.en: If you see a payment that you do not recognize in your transaction history, please call the bank.
sentences.zh: 如果你在交易紀錄中看到不認得的付款，請打電話給銀行。

sentences.en: The app allows users to view transaction history for the past twelve months and download it as a file.
sentences.zh: 這個 App 讓使用者檢視過去十二個月的交易紀錄，並下載成檔案。

sentences.en: Please print your transaction history and attach it to the form when you request a refund.
sentences.zh: 申請退款時，請把你的交易紀錄印出來附在表格上。

sentences.en: The accountant asked the client to send a copy of her transaction history for the last three months.
sentences.zh: 會計師請客戶寄一份她最近三個月的交易紀錄。

words.note: 語塊：check their transaction history（查詢交易紀錄）、view transaction history（檢視交易紀錄）、in your transaction history（在你的交易紀錄中）、print your transaction history（印出交易紀錄）。transaction 是「交易」；history 在這裡是「紀錄」；statement 是「對帳單」。

sentences.en: The new advertising campaign is expected to bring in more customers during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 新的廣告活動預計在節慶期間招攬更多顧客。

sentences.en: The summer festival will bring in a large amount of revenue for local hotels and restaurants.
sentences.zh: 夏季慶典將為當地飯店和餐廳帶來大筆營收。

sentences.en: The company decided to bring in experts from Germany to help train its engineers at the new factory.
sentences.zh: 公司決定從德國請專家來協助訓練工程師。

sentences.en: The museum hopes the new exhibition will bring in visitors who have never been there before.
sentences.zh: 博物館希望新展覽能吸引從沒來過的參觀者。

sentences.en: The new menu helped the restaurant bring in more revenue on weekday evenings, which used to be quiet.
sentences.zh: 新菜單幫助那家餐廳在以前很冷清的平日晚上帶來更多營收。

words.note: 語塊：bring in customers（招攬顧客）、bring in revenue（帶來營收）、bring in experts（請來專家）。bring in 可以是「帶來（錢、顧客）」或「請（人）來幫忙」。

sentences.en: The company's gross profit increased by fifteen percent last year because of lower material costs.
sentences.zh: 因為材料成本降低，公司去年的毛利增加了一成五。

sentences.en: The store hopes to increase gross profit by selling more of its own brand of products.
sentences.zh: 那家店希望多賣自有品牌產品來提高毛利。

sentences.en: The report shows the gross profit margin for each product line over the past three years.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示過去三年每條產品線的毛利率。

sentences.en: Rising shipping costs have reduced the gross profit of many small online retailers this year.
sentences.zh: 運費上漲讓今年很多網路零售商的毛利減少了。

sentences.en: The new manager wants to improve the gross profit margin of the restaurant by reducing food waste.
sentences.zh: 新經理希望減少食物浪費來提高餐廳的毛利率。

words.note: 語塊：increase gross profit（提高毛利）、gross profit margin（毛利率）。gross profit 是「營收減去成本（還沒扣其他費用）」；net profit 是「淨利」。

sentences.en: The mayor's inauguration ceremony will take place in front of city hall on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 市長的就職典禮將在週一早上於市政府前舉行。

sentences.en: Thousands of people attended the inauguration of the new bridge, which connects the two cities.
sentences.zh: 數千人參加了連接兩座城市的新橋啟用典禮。

sentences.en: The inauguration of the new president of the university was broadcast live on the internet.
sentences.zh: 大學新校長的就職典禮在網路上現場直播。

sentences.en: Several famous guests were invited to the inauguration ceremony of the new concert hall downtown last weekend.
sentences.zh: 好幾位知名來賓受邀參加新音樂廳的啟用典禮。

sentences.en: Roads near the stadium will be closed during the inauguration ceremony, so please take the subway.
sentences.zh: 就職典禮期間體育場附近的道路會封閉，所以請搭捷運。

words.note: 語塊：inauguration ceremony（就職典禮）、the inauguration of（……的就職／啟用）。inauguration 是正式的「就任、啟用儀式」；inaugurate 是動詞；opening ceremony 是「開幕典禮」。

sentences.en: The company's diversification into healthcare and education has helped it grow steadily during difficult economic times.
sentences.zh: 公司拓展到醫療和教育的多元化發展，幫助它在艱困時期持續成長。

sentences.en: Financial advisors recommend the diversification of investments to reduce the risk of losing money in the stock market.
sentences.zh: 理財顧問建議投資多元化，以降低虧損的風險。

sentences.en: Business diversification allows farmers to earn money from tourism as well as from their crops.
sentences.zh: 業務多元化讓農民除了作物之外，也能從觀光賺錢。

sentences.en: The diversification of the city's economy has created many new jobs in technology and services.
sentences.zh: 城市經濟的多元化在科技和服務業創造了新工作。

sentences.en: The board approved a plan for the diversification of the company's products over the next five years.
sentences.zh: 董事會核准了一項在未來五年讓公司產品多元化的計畫。

words.note: 語塊：business diversification（業務多元化）、diversification of（……的多元化）。diversification 是「往多方面發展、分散」；diversify 是動詞；diverse 是形容詞「多樣的」。

sentences.en: The new software is indeed easier to use than the old one, and most employees prefer it.
sentences.zh: 新軟體確實比舊的好用，大部分員工都比較喜歡。

sentences.en: The restaurant was indeed very busy on Saturday night, so we had to wait thirty minutes for a table.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳週六晚上確實非常忙，所以我們等了三十分鐘才有位子。

sentences.en: Sales did indeed increase after the advertising campaign, just as the marketing team had predicted.
sentences.zh: 廣告活動後銷售確實增加了，正如行銷團隊預測的那樣。

sentences.en: The view from the top of the tower is indeed beautiful, especially at sunset when the sky is orange.
sentences.zh: 從塔頂看出去的景色確實很美，尤其是天空變成橘色的日落時分。

sentences.en: We are indeed grateful for your help with the event, and we hope to work with you again.
sentences.zh: 我們真的很感謝你協助這次活動，希望能再次合作。

words.note: 語塊：indeed（確實）、very ... indeed（真的非常……）。indeed 用來加強語氣或確認前面的說法；really、certainly 意思接近。

sentences.en: The meeting will begin precisely at nine o'clock, so please arrive a few minutes early.
sentences.zh: 會議九點整準時開始，所以請提早幾分鐘到。

sentences.en: The machine can cut the wood precisely, so every piece is exactly the same size.
sentences.zh: 那台機器能精確地切割木材，所以每一塊都一樣大。

sentences.en: The hotel is popular precisely because it is so close to the beach and the train station.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店受歡迎，正是因為它離海灘和火車站都很近。

sentences.en: Please follow the instructions precisely when you mix the chemicals in the school laboratory today.
sentences.zh: 在實驗室混合化學品時，請精確地照說明操作。

sentences.en: The new phone was released precisely one year after the previous model went on sale.
sentences.zh: 新手機正好在前一款開賣一年後推出。

words.note: 語塊：precisely at（準時在……）、precisely because（正是因為）。precisely 是「準確地」或「正是」；exactly 意思接近；precise 是形容詞。

sentences.en: We must regretfully decline your invitation, as our whole team will be traveling abroad that week.
sentences.zh: 我們必須遺憾地婉拒您的邀請，因為我們團隊那週要出差。

sentences.en: The company regretfully announced that the factory will close at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 公司遺憾地宣布工廠將在年底關閉。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee regretfully told the client that the order could not be delivered before the holiday.
sentences.zh: 李小姐遺憾地告訴客戶，訂單無法在假期前送達。

sentences.en: The organizers regretfully canceled the outdoor concert because of the heavy rain on Saturday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 主辦單位因為週六大雨，遺憾地取消了戶外音樂會。

sentences.en: I must regretfully inform you that the position has already been filled by another candidate.
sentences.zh: 我必須遺憾地通知您，這個職位已經由另一位候選人補上了。

words.note: 語塊：regretfully decline（遺憾地婉拒）、regretfully announced（遺憾地宣布了）、regretfully inform（遺憾地通知）、regretfully told（遺憾地告訴）。regretfully 是「很遺憾地（帶著後悔或抱歉）」；regrettably 是「令人遺憾的是」。

sentences.en: The heavy rain could adversely affect the crops on many farms in the southern region this year.
sentences.zh: 大雨今年可能會對南部很多農場的作物造成不利影響。

sentences.en: Rising interest rates may adversely affect sales of houses and cars over the next few months.
sentences.zh: 利率上升可能在未來幾個月對房屋和汽車的銷售造成不利影響。

sentences.en: Several small businesses were adversely affected by the long construction work on the main street.
sentences.zh: 好幾家小商家受到主要街道施工的不利影響。

sentences.en: Working long hours without rest can adversely affect your health and your performance at work.
sentences.zh: 長時間工作不休息，可能會對你的健康和工作表現造成負面影響。

sentences.en: The strike at the port could adversely affect the delivery of goods to stores across the country.
sentences.zh: 港口罷工可能會對全國門市的貨物配送造成不利影響。

words.note: 語塊：adversely affect（不利地影響）、be adversely affected（受到不利影響）。adversely 是「造成壞影響地」；negatively 意思接近；adverse 是形容詞「不利的」。

sentences.en: The main function of the new software is to help managers track the progress of each project.
sentences.zh: 新軟體的主要功能是幫助經理追蹤每個專案的進度。

sentences.en: The hotel has a large hall that can be used for a wedding, a conference, or any other social function.
sentences.zh: 飯店有一個大廳，可以用來辦婚禮、研討會或任何其他社交活動。

sentences.en: Each part of the machine performs a function, so the whole system stops if one part breaks.
sentences.zh: 機器的每個零件都有作用，所以一個零件壞了整個系統就會停。

sentences.en: The new phone has a camera function that can take clear pictures even in low light.
sentences.zh: 新手機有一個在光線不足時也能拍清楚照片的相機功能。

sentences.en: The main function of the committee is to review the budget and make recommendations to the board.
sentences.zh: 委員會的主要功能是審查預算並向董事會提出建議。

words.note: 語塊：main function（主要功能）、perform a function（發揮作用）、social function（社交活動）。function 可以是「功能」或正式的「宴會、活動」；functional 是形容詞「實用的」。

sentences.en: Delivery typically takes three to five business days, but it may take longer during the holidays.
sentences.zh: 送貨通常需要三到五個工作天，但節慶期間可能會更久。

sentences.en: This type of software is typically used by small businesses to manage their accounts and invoices.
sentences.zh: 這種軟體通常被小企業用來管理帳目和發票。

sentences.en: The store is typically busiest on Saturday afternoons, so we schedule more staff at that time.
sentences.zh: 那家店通常在週六下午最忙，所以我們在那個時段排更多人手。

sentences.en: New employees typically receive two weeks of training before they begin working with customers on their own.
sentences.zh: 新員工通常在開始接觸顧客前接受兩週的訓練。

sentences.en: The weather in the region is typically warm and dry in the summer, which attracts many tourists.
sentences.zh: 那個地區夏天通常溫暖乾燥，吸引很多觀光客。

words.note: 語塊：typically take（通常需要）、typically used（通常用於）、typically busiest（通常最忙）、typically receive（通常會得到）、typically warm（通常溫暖）。typically 是「一般情況下」；usually、normally 意思接近；typical 是形容詞「典型的」。

sentences.en: Some customers think the new phone is overly expensive for the features that it offers.
sentences.zh: 有些顧客認為新手機就它提供的功能來說太貴了。

sentences.en: The manager warned that the sales forecast for next year might be overly optimistic about the economy.
sentences.zh: 經理警告明年的銷售預測可能過度樂觀。

sentences.en: The instructions for the machine are overly complicated, so we will write a simpler version.
sentences.zh: 機器的說明書太複雜了，所以我們會寫一個比較簡單的版本。

sentences.en: Please do not be overly worried about the test, as most people pass it on their first attempt.
sentences.zh: 請不要對考試過度擔心，因為大部分人第一次就通過。

sentences.en: The design of the website was overly complicated, so many customers had trouble finding products.
sentences.zh: 網站的設計太複雜了，所以很多顧客找不到產品。

words.note: 語塊：overly expensive（太貴）、overly optimistic（過度樂觀）、overly complicated（太複雜）。overly 是「太……、過度地」；too 意思接近；over 當字首也有「過度」的意思。

sentences.en: The new study may call into question the safety of the chemicals used in some cleaning products.
sentences.zh: 新研究可能讓人質疑某些清潔用品中化學物質的安全性。

sentences.en: The mistakes in the report call into question the reliability of the data that the team collected.
sentences.zh: 報告中的錯誤讓人質疑團隊收集的資料的可靠性。

sentences.en: The delays could call into question whether the company can finish the bridge before next summer.
sentences.zh: 延誤可能讓人質疑公司能否在明年夏天前完成那座橋。

sentences.en: The manager's sudden resignation will call into question the future of the project he was leading.
sentences.zh: 經理突然辭職，會讓人質疑他所帶領的專案的未來。

sentences.en: Several experts call into question the claim that the new diet helps people lose weight quickly.
sentences.zh: 好幾位專家質疑新飲食法能幫助人快速減重的說法。

words.note: 語塊：call into question（質疑……）。call sth into question 是「讓人開始懷疑某事」；question 當動詞也是「質疑」。

sentences.en: Customers waited patiently in line outside the store for the new phone to go on sale.
sentences.zh: 顧客在店外耐心排隊，等新手機開賣。

sentences.en: The teacher explained patiently how to use the new software until every student understood it.
sentences.zh: 老師耐心地解釋如何使用軟體，直到每位學生都懂為止。

sentences.en: Thank you for waiting patiently while we repaired the problem with the elevator this morning.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你在今天早上我們修理電梯問題時耐心等候。

sentences.en: The customer service representative listened patiently to the complaint and then offered a full refund.
sentences.zh: 客服代表耐心聆聽投訴，並提供全額退款。

sentences.en: Passengers waited patiently at the airport for several hours until the terrible storm had passed.
sentences.zh: 乘客在機場耐心等了好幾個小時，直到暴風雨過去。

words.note: 語塊：wait patiently（耐心等候）、explain patiently（耐心解釋）。patiently 是副詞；patient 是形容詞「有耐心的」或名詞「病人」；patience 是名詞。

sentences.en: The construction of the new library is on schedule and will be finished in October.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館的工程按進度進行，將在十月完工。

sentences.en: The team finished the project two weeks ahead of schedule, so the client was very pleased.
sentences.zh: 團隊提前兩週完成專案，所以客戶非常滿意。

sentences.en: The project is behind schedule because some of the materials arrived late from the supplier.
sentences.zh: 專案落後進度，因為有些材料從供應商那裡晚到了。

sentences.en: Please check the schedule on the website before you visit, as the museum closes early on Mondays.
sentences.zh: 參觀前請先查看網站上的時程表，因為博物館週一提早閉館。

sentences.en: The manager will send everyone a copy of the new work schedule for next month by Friday.
sentences.zh: 經理會在週五前寄給每個人一份下個月的新工作時程表。

words.note: 語塊：on schedule（按進度）、ahead of schedule（提前）、behind schedule（落後進度）。schedule 可以當名詞或動詞「安排時間」；timetable 是「時刻表」。

sentences.en: Inexperienced staff will work with a senior employee during their first month at the company.
sentences.zh: 缺乏經驗的員工在公司的第一個月會和一位資深員工一起工作。

sentences.en: An inexperienced driver should avoid driving on narrow mountain roads when the weather is bad.
sentences.zh: 新手駕駛在天氣不好時應該避免開山路。

sentences.en: The company prefers to hire inexperienced workers and train them in its own way from the start.
sentences.zh: 公司比較喜歡聘用沒有經驗的員工，再用自己的方式訓練他們。

sentences.en: Many inexperienced investors lose money because they do not understand the risks of the stock market.
sentences.zh: 很多沒經驗的投資人賠錢，因為他們不了解股市的風險。

sentences.en: The manager was patient with the inexperienced team and explained every step of the process carefully.
sentences.zh: 經理對缺乏經驗的團隊很有耐心，仔細解說流程的每一個步驟。

words.note: 語塊：inexperienced staff（缺乏經驗的員工）、inexperienced driver（新手駕駛）、inexperienced workers（沒經驗的員工）、inexperienced investors（沒經驗的投資人）、inexperienced team（缺乏經驗的團隊）。inexperienced 是「經驗不足的」；experienced 是「有經驗的」。

sentences.en: Train service will resume on Monday morning after the damaged tracks near the station have been repaired.
sentences.zh: 受損的軌道修好後，火車服務將在週一早上恢復。

sentences.en: The meeting will resume after a short break, so please return to the conference room by eleven.
sentences.zh: 會議短暫休息後會繼續，所以請在十一點前回到會議室。

sentences.en: The factory will resume production next week once the new machines have been installed and tested.
sentences.zh: 新機器安裝並測試完成後，工廠將在下週恢復生產。

sentences.en: Workers will resume work on the bridge when the weather improves later this week, the manager said.
sentences.zh: 這週稍晚天氣好轉時，工人將恢復橋樑的工程。

sentences.en: The airline plans to resume service to the island after the airport is repaired next month.
sentences.zh: 機場下個月修好後，航空公司計畫恢復飛往那座島的服務。

words.note: 語塊：resume work（恢復工作）、resume service（恢復服務）、resume production（恢復生產）。resume 當動詞（re-ZOOM）是「恢復」；résumé（REZ-oo-may）是名詞「履歷」。

sentences.en: The hotel has a private room that is perfect for a small gathering or a business dinner with clients.
sentences.zh: 飯店有一間私人包廂，非常適合小型聚會或和客戶的商務晚餐。

sentences.en: Many families travel long distances to attend a family gathering during the long national holidays.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭在國定假日長途跋涉參加家庭聚會。

sentences.en: The police closed the main street for a large gathering of people who were celebrating the team's victory.
sentences.zh: 警方因為大批民眾聚集慶祝球隊勝利而封閉主要街道。

sentences.en: The company organizes a social gathering every Friday evening so that employees can get to know each other.
sentences.zh: 公司每週五晚上舉辦社交聚會，讓員工彼此認識。

sentences.en: The park is a popular place for a family gathering on weekends, especially when the weather is warm.
sentences.zh: 那座公園是週末家庭聚會的熱門地點，尤其是天氣溫暖的時候。

words.note: 語塊：social gathering（社交聚會）、family gathering（家庭聚會）、a large gathering（大型集會）、a small gathering（小型聚會）。gathering 是「聚在一起的活動」；gather 是動詞「聚集；收集」。

sentences.en: For additional information about our services, please visit our website or call our main office.
sentences.zh: 想了解我們服務的更多資訊，請上我們的網站或打電話到辦公室。

sentences.en: Customers can upgrade to a larger room at no additional charge if they book before the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 顧客如果在週末前訂房，可以免費升等到較大的房間。

sentences.en: The hotel charges an additional cost for guests who want to check out after noon.
sentences.zh: 飯店對想在中午後退房的客人收取額外費用。

sentences.en: The company plans to hire additional staff during the busy holiday season to help in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在忙碌的節慶期間增聘人手到倉庫幫忙。

sentences.en: If you need additional time to finish the report, please let the manager know before Friday.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要更多時間完成報告，請在週五前告訴經理。

words.note: 語塊：additional cost（額外費用）、additional information（更多資訊）、at no additional charge（不另收費）。additional 是「另外多的」；extra 意思接近；additionally 是副詞「此外」。

sentences.en: The new product received an overwhelming response from customers, and it sold out within a week.
sentences.zh: 新產品獲得顧客熱烈的回應，一週內就賣光了。

sentences.en: An overwhelming majority of employees voted in favor of the new flexible working hours last week.
sentences.zh: 壓倒性多數的員工投票支持新的彈性工時。

sentences.en: The plan to build a new park received overwhelming support from residents of the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 興建新公園的計畫獲得社區居民壓倒性的支持。

sentences.en: The amount of work can feel overwhelming at first, but it becomes easier after a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 工作量一開始可能會讓人招架不住，但幾週後就會變得比較容易。

sentences.en: The charity thanked donors for the overwhelming response to its campaign to help families after the flood.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善團體感謝捐款人對它水災後幫助家庭的活動給予熱烈回應。

words.note: 語塊：overwhelming response（熱烈的回應）、overwhelming majority（壓倒性多數）、overwhelming support（壓倒性的支持）。overwhelming 是「多到讓人招架不住的」；overwhelmed 是「（人）不知所措的」。

sentences.en: The factory hired more workers to meet the demand for its electric bicycles during the summer.
sentences.zh: 工廠增聘工人，以滿足夏天對電動自行車的需求。

sentences.en: Experienced nurses are in high demand, so hospitals are offering higher salaries to attract them.
sentences.zh: 有經驗的護士需求很高，所以醫院提供更高的薪水吸引他們。

sentences.en: There has been a sharp increase in demand for online courses since more people started working from home.
sentences.zh: 自從更多人開始在家工作，線上課程的需求大幅增加。

sentences.en: The store could not meet the demand for the new phone, so many customers had to wait for weeks.
sentences.zh: 那家店無法滿足新手機的需求，所以很多顧客要等好幾週。

sentences.en: The demand for organic food is growing quickly, especially among young families in large cities.
sentences.zh: 有機食品的需求正快速成長，尤其是在大城市的年輕家庭之間。

words.note: 語塊：demand for（對……的需求）、meet the demand（滿足需求）、in high demand（需求很高）。demand 可以當名詞或動詞「要求」；supply and demand 是「供給與需求」。

sentences.en: Managers will review the job performance of every employee at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 經理會在年底檢討每位員工的工作表現。

sentences.en: Each employee has a performance review with their manager twice a year to discuss their goals.
sentences.zh: 每位員工一年和經理進行兩次績效考核，討論他們的目標。

sentences.en: The band's live performance at the music festival was the most popular event of the weekend.
sentences.zh: 那個樂團在音樂節的現場演出是週末最受歡迎的活動。

sentences.en: The new software has improved the performance of our computers, which now run much faster.
sentences.zh: 新軟體改善了我們電腦的效能，現在跑得快多了。

sentences.en: Bonuses are based on each employee's performance and the overall profits of the company each year.
sentences.zh: 獎金根據每位員工的表現和公司的整體獲利決定。

words.note: 語塊：job performance（工作表現）、performance review（績效考核）、live performance（現場演出）。performance 可以是「工作表現」或「演出」；perform 是動詞；performer 是「表演者」。

sentences.en: Some companies claim that their phones have the longest battery life, but tests often show otherwise.
sentences.zh: 有些公司聲稱自家手機電池續航最久，但測試常常顯示並非如此。

sentences.en: Customers can claim a refund within thirty days if they are not satisfied with their purchase.
sentences.zh: 顧客如果不滿意購買的商品，可以在三十天內要求退款。

sentences.en: Passengers can claim baggage at the end of the hall after they pass through immigration.
sentences.zh: 乘客通過入境審查後，可以在大廳盡頭領取行李。

sentences.en: Employees who travel for work can claim expenses for meals and local transportation each month.
sentences.zh: 因公出差的員工每個月可以申請餐費和交通費。

sentences.en: Some critics claim that the new law will hurt small businesses, but the government disagrees.
sentences.zh: 有些批評者聲稱新法律會傷害小企業，但政府不同意。

words.note: 語塊：claim that（聲稱……）、claim a refund（要求退款）、claim baggage（領取行李）。claim 可以是「聲稱」或「要求得到（權利、物品）」；baggage claim 是「行李提領處」。

sentences.en: The price of the new office is acceptable to the board, so they will sign the lease next week.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室的價格董事會可以接受，所以下週會簽租約。

sentences.en: After several weeks of negotiations, the two companies agreed on an acceptable price for the land.
sentences.zh: 經過幾週的談判，兩家公司對土地達成了可接受的價格。

sentences.en: The handbook explains what kinds of acceptable behavior are expected from employees at work and at events.
sentences.zh: 手冊說明了員工在工作中應有的可接受行為。

sentences.en: Is the delivery date acceptable to you, or would you prefer us to send the order earlier?
sentences.zh: 送貨日期你可以接受嗎，還是你希望我們早點寄出訂單？

sentences.en: The quality of the samples was acceptable, so the company placed a large order with the supplier.
sentences.zh: 樣品的品質可以接受，所以公司向那家供應商下了一筆大訂單。

words.note: 語塊：acceptable to（……可以接受的）、an acceptable price（可接受的價格）、acceptable behavior（可接受的行為）。acceptable 是「可以被接受的」；unacceptable 是「無法接受的」；accept 是動詞。

sentences.en: The company held a dinner in appreciation of the employees who worked overtime during the busy season.
sentences.zh: 公司舉辦了一場晚宴，感謝在旺季加班的員工。

sentences.en: The manager sent a card to each volunteer to show appreciation for their help with the event.
sentences.zh: 經理寄卡片給每位志工，表示對他們協助活動的感謝。

sentences.en: The museum offers free classes to help children develop an appreciation of art from an early age.
sentences.zh: 博物館提供免費課程，幫助孩子從小培養藝術欣賞能力。

sentences.en: In appreciation of his thirty years of service, Mr. Lopez received a gift from the company.
sentences.zh: 為了感謝 Lopez 先生三十年的服務，他收到公司送的一份禮物。

sentences.en: Customers showed their appreciation for the new service by leaving many positive reviews on the website.
sentences.zh: 顧客在網路上留下很多正面評價，表達他們對新服務的欣賞。

words.note: 語塊：in appreciation of（為了感謝……）、show appreciation（表示感謝）、appreciation of art（藝術欣賞）。appreciation 是名詞；appreciate 是動詞「感謝；欣賞」。

sentences.en: The project has been divided into five discrete parts, and each team is responsible for one part.
sentences.zh: 專案被分成五個獨立的部分，每個團隊負責一部分。

sentences.en: The training course is made up of several discrete steps that students can complete at their own pace.
sentences.zh: 訓練課程由幾個分開的步驟組成，學員可以按自己的步調完成。

sentences.en: The factory has discrete areas for storing raw materials, spare parts, and finished products safely.
sentences.zh: 工廠有分開的區域存放原料和成品。

sentences.en: The report divides customers into discrete groups based on their age and where they live.
sentences.zh: 報告根據顧客的年齡和居住地，把他們分成幾個獨立的群組。

sentences.en: Each discrete part of the machine can be replaced easily if it stops working properly.
sentences.zh: 機器的每個獨立零件如果不能正常運作，都可以很容易地更換。

words.note: 語塊：discrete parts（獨立的部分）、discrete steps（分開的步驟）。discrete 是「各自分開的」；discreet 是「謹慎的、低調的」，發音一樣但意思不同。

sentences.en: The company will commit to reducing its plastic waste by fifty percent over the next five years.
sentences.zh: 公司承諾在未來五年把塑膠垃圾減少一半。

sentences.en: The government plans to commit resources to improving public schools and hospitals in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫投入資源改善鄉村地區的公立學校。

sentences.en: Please check your work carefully so that you do not commit a mistake in the financial report.
sentences.zh: 請仔細檢查你的工作，以免在財務報告中犯錯。

sentences.en: Before you commit to a long-term contract, compare the prices offered by several different suppliers.
sentences.zh: 在承諾簽長期合約之前，先比較幾家供應商的價格。

sentences.en: The new CEO promised to commit more money to research and the development of new products.
sentences.zh: 新執行長承諾投入更多資金在研究和新產品開發上。

words.note: 語塊：commit to（承諾……）、commit resources（投入資源）、commit a mistake（犯錯）。commit to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing；committed 是形容詞「投入的」；commitment 是名詞。

sentences.en: Many graduates move to large cities to look for a job in technology or finance.
sentences.zh: 很多畢業生搬到大城市找科技或金融方面的工作。

sentences.en: The engineers will look for ways to save energy in the factory without slowing down production.
sentences.zh: 工程師會在不拖慢生產的情況下，尋找讓工廠節能的方法。

sentences.en: If you cannot find the room, please look for the signs on the wall near the elevator.
sentences.zh: 如果你找不到房間，請找電梯附近牆上的標示。

sentences.en: The manager asked the team to look for a cheaper supplier because prices have increased.
sentences.zh: 因為價格上漲，經理要團隊尋找更便宜的供應商。

sentences.en: Tourists often look for restaurants that serve traditional food when they visit a new city.
sentences.zh: 觀光客造訪新城市時常常會尋找供應傳統食物的餐廳。

words.note: 語塊：look for a job（找工作）、look for ways to（尋找方法）、look for the signs（找標示）、look for a cheaper（找更便宜的……）、look for restaurants（找餐廳）。look for 是「尋找」；search for 意思接近；look after 是「照顧」。

sentences.en: We are looking for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines.
sentences.zh: 我們在找喜歡在截止期限緊、快節奏環境中工作的人。

sentences.en: Technology is a fast-paced industry, so employees must learn new skills and tools every single year.
sentences.zh: 科技是一個快節奏的產業，所以員工每一年都必須學新技能。

sentences.en: Working in a fast-paced restaurant kitchen requires good teamwork and clear communication between the cooks.
sentences.zh: 在快節奏的餐廳廚房工作需要良好的團隊合作和清楚的溝通。

sentences.en: The fast-paced training program prepares new employees to work with customers in only two weeks.
sentences.zh: 快節奏的訓練計畫讓新員工只要兩週就能準備好接待顧客。

sentences.en: Some people enjoy the fast-paced life of the city, while others prefer the quiet countryside.
sentences.zh: 有些人喜歡城市快節奏的生活，有些人則比較喜歡安靜的鄉下。

words.note: 語塊：fast-paced environment（快節奏的環境）、fast-paced industry（快節奏的產業）、fast-paced restaurant（快節奏的餐廳）、fast-paced life（快節奏的生活）。fast-paced 放在名詞前要加連字號；slow-paced 是「步調緩慢的」。

sentences.en: Because of a time constraint, we will discuss only the most important items at today's meeting.
sentences.zh: 因為時間有限，我們今天的會議只討論最重要的項目。

sentences.en: The team had to work under a strict time constraint to finish the project before the holiday.
sentences.zh: 團隊必須在嚴格的時間限制下工作，在假期前完成專案。

sentences.en: The speaker could not answer every question because of the time constraint at the end of the session.
sentences.zh: 因為場次最後時間有限，講者無法回答每個問題。

sentences.en: A tight time constraint made it difficult for the designers to try several different ideas.
sentences.zh: 緊迫的時間限制讓設計師很難嘗試好幾個不同的點子。

sentences.en: Good planning can help employees deal with any time constraint that they face at work.
sentences.zh: 良好的規劃能幫助員工應付工作中遇到的任何時間限制。

words.note: 語塊：because of time constraints（因為時間有限）、work under time constraints（在時間壓力下工作）。time constraint 常用複數 time constraints；constraint 是「限制」。

sentences.en: The new sports facility near the school has a swimming pool, a gym, and two tennis courts.
sentences.zh: 學校附近的新運動設施有游泳池、健身房和兩座網球場。

sentences.en: The company plans to build a production facility in Vietnam to make parts for its electric cars.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫在越南興建一座生產工廠，製造電動車的零件。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a facility for business meetings, with modern equipment and free internet access.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供商務會議的設施，配備現代化設備和免費網路。

sentences.en: Visitors to the research facility must wear safety glasses and sign in at the security desk.
sentences.zh: 參觀研究設施的訪客必須戴護目鏡，並在保全櫃台登記。

sentences.en: The city will open a new facility for recycling plastic and glass on the edge of town next year.
sentences.zh: 市政府明年將在鎮郊啟用一座新的塑膠和玻璃回收設施。

words.note: 語塊：sports facility（運動設施）、production facility（生產工廠）、facility for（……的設施）。facility 是「為某目的蓋的地方或設備」，常用複數 facilities；facilitate 是「促進」。

sentences.en: The grand opening of the new shopping center will take place on the first Saturday of next month.
sentences.zh: 新購物中心的盛大開幕將在下個月第一個週六舉行。

sentences.en: There is a job opening in the marketing department for someone with experience in social media.
sentences.zh: 行銷部有一個職缺，要找有社群媒體經驗的人。

sentences.en: The mayor will give a short speech at the opening ceremony of the new library on Friday.
sentences.zh: 市長將在週五新圖書館的開幕典禮上簡短致詞。

sentences.en: Please check our website regularly, as we post every new job opening there before anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 請定期查看我們的網站，因為每個新職缺都會先貼在那裡。

sentences.en: Hundreds of people attended the grand opening of the restaurant, which offered free food all day.
sentences.zh: 數百人參加了那家餐廳的盛大開幕，當天整天提供免費食物。

words.note: 語塊：grand opening（盛大開幕）、job opening（職缺）、opening ceremony（開幕典禮）。opening 可以是「開幕」、「職缺」或「開頭」；open 是動詞或形容詞。

sentences.en: Hundreds of customers began to line up outside the store early in the morning for the new phone.
sentences.zh: 數百位顧客一大早就開始在店外排隊買新手機。

sentences.en: The organizers have managed to line up several famous speakers for the conference next spring.
sentences.zh: 主辦單位已經為明年春天的研討會安排好幾位知名講者。

sentences.en: Please line up at the gate and have your ticket ready before the doors open at seven.
sentences.zh: 請在門口排隊，並在七點開門前準備好門票。

sentences.en: The manager will line up interviews with three candidates for the open position next week.
sentences.zh: 經理下週會為那個職缺安排三位候選人的面試。

sentences.en: Fans line up for hours to buy tickets whenever the popular band announces a new concert.
sentences.zh: 每當那個熱門樂團宣布新演唱會，歌迷都會排好幾個小時買票。

words.note: 語塊：line up for（為……排隊）、line up speakers（安排講者）。line up 可以是「排隊」或「事先安排好（人、活動）」；lineup 是名詞「陣容」。

words.meaning: 口齒清晰的；表達清楚的

sentences.en: Ms. Lee is an articulate speaker who can explain complicated ideas in a simple way.
sentences.zh: 李小姐是一位口才很好的講者，能用簡單的方式解釋複雜的概念。

sentences.en: We are looking for an articulate and friendly person to give tours of the museum to visitors.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位表達清楚又親切的人，為訪客做博物館導覽。

sentences.en: The candidate was articulate during the interview and answered every difficult question clearly and confidently.
sentences.zh: 那位候選人面試時表達清楚，每個問題都回答得清晰又有自信。

sentences.en: The CEO gave an articulate explanation of the company's plans for the next five years.
sentences.zh: 執行長清楚地說明了公司未來五年的計畫。

sentences.en: Customer service staff must be articulate and patient when they speak with customers on the phone.
sentences.zh: 客服人員和顧客通電話時必須表達清楚又有耐心。

words.note: 語塊：articulate speaker（口才好的講者）、clear and articulate（清楚又有條理）。articulate 當形容詞是「表達能力好的」；當動詞是「清楚表達」。

sentences.en: The new factory will support economic growth in the region by creating hundreds of jobs.
sentences.zh: 新工廠將創造數百個工作機會，支持該地區的經濟成長。

sentences.en: Many small businesses closed during the economic crisis that began several years ago in Europe.
sentences.zh: 好幾年前開始的經濟危機期間，很多小企業倒閉了。

sentences.en: The government is investing in roads and schools to encourage economic development in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 政府正在投資道路和學校，鼓勵鄉村地區的經濟發展。

sentences.en: Economic experts expect prices to rise slowly over the next year as demand slowly increases.
sentences.zh: 經濟專家預期隨著需求增加，物價明年會緩慢上漲。

sentences.en: The conference will discuss the economic effects of tourism on small towns along the coast.
sentences.zh: 研討會將討論觀光業對沿海小鎮的經濟影響。

words.note: 語塊：economic growth（經濟成長）、economic crisis（經濟危機）、economic development（經濟發展）。economic 是「和經濟有關的」；economical 是「節省的、划算的」，意思不同。

sentences.en: The ideal candidate will have at least five years of experience in sales and speak English fluently.
sentences.zh: 理想人選需要至少五年業務經驗，並能流利說英文。

sentences.en: The quiet hotel near the beach is ideal for families who want to relax during the summer.
sentences.zh: 海邊那家安靜的飯店非常適合想在夏天放鬆的家庭。

sentences.en: The building is in an ideal location for a new store because it is next to the train station.
sentences.zh: 那棟建築是開新店的理想地點，因為就在火車站旁邊。

sentences.en: The spacious conference room is ideal for large meetings and training sessions with many people.
sentences.zh: 那間寬敞的會議室非常適合人很多的大型會議和訓練課程。

sentences.en: Spring is the ideal time to visit the city, as the weather is warm and the parks are full of flowers.
sentences.zh: 春天是造訪這座城市的理想時節，因為天氣溫暖、公園裡開滿花。

words.note: 語塊：ideal candidate（理想人選）、ideal for（非常適合……）、ideal location（理想地點）。ideal 是「最適合的」；idea 是「想法」；idealistic 是「理想主義的」。

sentences.en: Tickets for the concert will go on sale online at ten o'clock on Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 演唱會門票將在週五早上十點於網路開賣。

sentences.en: The new phone will go on sale in stores across the country starting next Monday.
sentences.zh: 新手機從下週一起將在全國門市開賣。

sentences.en: The author's new book will go on sale next month, and many fans have already ordered copies.
sentences.zh: 那位作家的新書下個月開賣，很多書迷已經預購了。

sentences.en: Winter clothing will go on sale at the end of January to make room for the spring collection.
sentences.zh: 冬季服飾將在一月底開賣特價，為春季系列騰出空間。

sentences.en: The new model is expected to go on sale in Europe before it is released in Asia.
sentences.zh: 新機型預計會先在歐洲開賣，再在亞洲推出。

words.note: 語塊：go on sale at（在……開賣）。go on sale 是「開始賣」；be on sale 是「在特價中」，意思不同。

sentences.en: The quality of the new store brand is comparable to that of the famous brands, but it is much cheaper.
sentences.zh: 新的自有品牌品質和知名品牌相當，但便宜很多。

sentences.en: Salaries at our company are comparable to those at other firms of the same size in the city.
sentences.zh: 我們公司的薪水和城裡同規模的其他公司相當。

sentences.en: The two hotels offer rooms at a comparable price, so we chose the one that is closer to the beach.
sentences.zh: 兩家飯店的房價相近，所以我們選了離海灘近的那家。

sentences.en: The new laptop has a battery life comparable to that of much more expensive models.
sentences.zh: 新筆電的電池續航和更貴的機型相當。

sentences.en: It is difficult to find a comparable apartment in the city center for such a low rent.
sentences.zh: 在市中心很難找到房租這麼低又差不多條件的公寓。

words.note: 語塊：comparable to（和……相當）、comparable price（相近的價格）。comparable 是「差不多、可以相比的」；compare 是動詞；comparison 是名詞。

sentences.en: The online store offers free shipping on all orders over fifty dollars placed before Friday.
sentences.zh: 那家網路商店週五前下單滿五十美元全部免運費。

sentences.en: The shipping cost will be added to your order when you check out on our website.
sentences.zh: 在我們網站結帳時，運費會加到你的訂單上。

sentences.en: The company changed to a new shipping company because the old one often delivered packages late.
sentences.zh: 公司換了一家新的貨運公司，因為舊的那家常常晚送包裹。

sentences.en: Customers can choose express shipping if they need their order to arrive the next day.
sentences.zh: 如果顧客需要訂單隔天送到，可以選擇快速運送。

sentences.en: Rising fuel prices have increased the shipping cost for many small online businesses this year.
sentences.zh: 油價上漲增加了今年很多小企業的運費。

words.note: 語塊：free shipping（免運費）、shipping cost（運費）、shipping company（貨運公司）。shipping 是「運送、運費」；ship 當動詞是「運送」；shipment 是「一批貨」。

sentences.en: A small handling charge will be added to every order that is sent to an address overseas.
sentences.zh: 每一筆寄往海外地址的訂單都會加收一小筆手續費。

sentences.en: The ticket price includes a handling charge of three dollars for all tickets bought online.
sentences.zh: 票價包含線上購買的三美元手續費。

sentences.en: Customers who return items after thirty days may have to pay a handling charge of five dollars.
sentences.zh: 超過三十天退貨的顧客可能需要支付處理費。

sentences.en: The total cost of the order, including the shipping and handling charge, is shown at the bottom of the page.
sentences.zh: 訂單總金額，包括運費和處理費，顯示在頁面最下方。

sentences.en: The bank does not add a handling charge if you pay your bill online instead of at the counter.
sentences.zh: 如果你在網路上繳費而不是到櫃台，銀行不會加收手續費。

words.note: 語塊：a handling charge of（……的手續費）、shipping and handling charge（運費及處理費）。handling charge 是「處理訂單、包裝等的費用」；handle 是動詞「處理」。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee decided to accept a job offer from a bank in Singapore because the salary was much higher.
sentences.zh: 李小姐決定接受新加坡一家銀行的工作邀約，因為薪水高很多。

sentences.en: After three interviews, Mr. Kim was happy to receive a job offer from the technology company.
sentences.zh: 經過三次面試，金先生很開心收到那家科技公司的錄取通知。

sentences.en: She had to turn down a job offer in Tokyo because she did not want to move away from her family.
sentences.zh: 她只好拒絕東京的工作邀約，因為她不想離開家人。

sentences.en: Please reply to the job offer by Friday so that we can prepare your contract and start date.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前回覆工作邀約，讓我們準備你的合約和到職日。

sentences.en: The job offer includes a good salary, health insurance, and four weeks of paid vacation every year.
sentences.zh: 這份工作邀約包括不錯的薪水、健康保險和每年四週的帶薪休假。

words.note: 語塊：accept a job offer（接受工作邀約）、receive a job offer（收到錄取通知）、turn down a job offer（拒絕工作邀約）。job offer 是「公司正式提供的工作機會」；offer 也可以是動詞「提供」。

sentences.en: The hotel's spa offers a relaxing atmosphere where guests can rest after a busy day of meetings.
sentences.zh: 飯店的水療中心提供放鬆的氣氛，讓客人在忙碌開會一天後休息。

sentences.en: Many families choose the small island for a relaxing vacation away from the noise of the city.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭選擇那座小島，度過遠離城市喧囂的輕鬆假期。

sentences.en: The café plays soft music to create a relaxing environment for customers who want to read or work.
sentences.zh: 咖啡館播放輕柔的音樂，為想看書或工作的顧客營造放鬆的環境。

sentences.en: A short walk in the park during lunch can be very relaxing for office workers who sit all day.
sentences.zh: 午餐時間在公園散個步，對整天坐著的上班族來說非常放鬆。

sentences.en: The resort is famous for its relaxing atmosphere, beautiful gardens, and excellent food made from local ingredients.
sentences.zh: 那個度假村以放鬆的氣氛、美麗的花園和極佳的食物聞名。

words.note: 語塊：relaxing atmosphere（放鬆的氣氛）、relaxing vacation（輕鬆的假期）。relaxing 是「讓人放鬆的（事物）」；relaxed 是「（人）感到放鬆的」。

sentences.en: I am writing regarding your order, which will be delivered on Thursday instead of Monday.
sentences.zh: 我來信是關於您的訂單，它會在週四而不是週一送達。

sentences.en: Please contact Ms. Park if you have any questions regarding the new vacation policy for next year.
sentences.zh: 如果你對新的休假規定有任何問題，請聯絡朴小姐。

sentences.en: The manager sent an email regarding the changes to the schedule for next week's training session.
sentences.zh: 經理寄了一封關於下週訓練課程時程變更的電子郵件。

sentences.en: The board will make a decision regarding the merger at its meeting at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 董事會將在月底的會議上對合併做出決定。

sentences.en: Regarding your request for a refund, we will send the money to your bank account within five days.
sentences.zh: 關於您的退款申請，我們會在五天內把錢匯到您的銀行帳戶。

words.note: 語塊：regarding your order（關於您的訂單）、questions regarding（關於……的問題）。regarding 和 concerning、about 意思相同，比較正式；with regard to 意思相同。

sentences.en: The company plans to reduce its carbon emissions by using electric trucks for all of its deliveries.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫所有配送都改用電動卡車，以減少碳排放。

sentences.en: Trees absorb carbon dioxide from the air, so planting more of them can help slow climate change.
sentences.zh: 樹木會吸收空氣中的二氧化碳，所以多種樹有助於減緩氣候變遷。

sentences.en: Many travelers want to reduce their carbon footprint by taking trains instead of airplanes when they travel.
sentences.zh: 很多旅客想搭火車而不是飛機，來減少碳足跡。

sentences.en: The new building uses solar power and very little energy, so its carbon footprint is small.
sentences.zh: 新大樓使用太陽能且耗能極少，所以碳足跡很小。

sentences.en: Factories that produce high carbon emissions will have to pay a new tax starting next year.
sentences.zh: 碳排放量高的工廠從明年起將須繳一項新稅。

words.note: 語塊：carbon emissions（碳排放）、carbon dioxide（二氧化碳）、carbon footprint（碳足跡）。carbon 是「碳」；carbon footprint 是一個人或公司造成的碳排放量。

sentences.en: Please do not leave your bags unattended in the airport, as they may be removed by security.
sentences.zh: 請不要把行李留在機場無人看管，因為可能會被保全移走。

sentences.en: Unattended bags found in the train station will be taken to the lost and found office.
sentences.zh: 火車站裡發現的無人看管行李會被送到失物招領處。

sentences.en: Children must not be left unattended in the swimming pool area at any time of the day.
sentences.zh: 任何時候都不可以讓孩子在游泳池區無人看管。

sentences.en: The store is not responsible for any items left unattended in the shopping carts in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 商店對留在購物車裡無人看管的任何物品概不負責。

sentences.en: Never leave cooking food unattended in the kitchen, as it can easily cause a fire.
sentences.zh: 絕對不要讓廚房裡正在煮的食物無人看管，因為很容易引起火災。

words.note: 語塊：leave sth unattended（把……留著不管）、unattended bags（無人看管的行李）。unattended 是「沒有人在旁邊看著的」；attend 是「照料；出席」。

sentences.en: In recent years, many young people have moved to the city to look for jobs in technology.
sentences.zh: 近年來，很多年輕人搬到城市找科技業的工作。

sentences.en: A recent survey showed that most customers prefer to pay with their phones instead of cash.
sentences.zh: 最近的一項調查顯示，大多數顧客比較喜歡用手機而不是現金付款。

sentences.en: Please send me the most recent version of the report so that I can check the numbers.
sentences.zh: 請把報告的最新版本寄給我，讓我檢查數字。

sentences.en: Prices for housing in the city have increased sharply in recent years because of strong demand.
sentences.zh: 近年來因為需求強勁，城市的房價大幅上漲。

sentences.en: The recent storm caused damage to several buildings near the coast, but no one was hurt.
sentences.zh: 最近的暴風雨損壞了海岸附近好幾棟建築，但沒有人受傷。

words.note: 語塊：recent years（近年來）、recent survey（最近的調查）、most recent（最新的）。recent 是「最近發生的」；recently 是副詞「最近」；decent 是「得體的」。

sentences.en: The company suffered a loss last year because of rising costs and lower sales in Europe.
sentences.zh: 因為成本上漲和歐洲銷售下滑，公司去年蒙受損失。

sentences.en: Many workers are worried about job loss after the factory announced that it would use more robots.
sentences.zh: 工廠宣布要使用更多機器人後，很多工人擔心失業。

sentences.en: The store sold its old products at a loss in order to make room for the new collection.
sentences.zh: 那家店虧本出售舊產品，為新系列騰出空間。

sentences.en: The storm caused a loss of electricity in thousands of homes for more than ten hours.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨造成數千戶家庭停電十多個小時。

sentences.en: Insurance can protect small businesses from a large loss if there is a fire or a flood.
sentences.zh: 保險可以在發生火災或水災時保護小企業免於重大損失。

words.note: 語塊：suffer a loss（蒙受損失）、job loss（失業）、at a loss（虧本；不知所措）。loss 是名詞；lose 是動詞「失去；輸」；loose 是「鬆的」。

sentences.en: Customers return to the restaurant because the food has consistent quality every time they visit.
sentences.zh: 顧客會再回到那家餐廳，因為每次來食物品質都很穩定。

sentences.en: The results of the second test were consistent with those of the first one, so the product is safe.
sentences.zh: 第二次測試的結果和第一次一致，所以產品是安全的。

sentences.en: The company has shown consistent growth over the past five years, mainly because of online sales.
sentences.zh: 公司過去五年持續成長，主要是因為網路銷售。

sentences.en: It is important to be consistent when you train new employees, so everyone learns the same rules.
sentences.zh: 訓練新員工時保持一致很重要，這樣每個人學到的規定都一樣。

sentences.en: The new policy is consistent with the company's goal of reducing waste and saving energy.
sentences.zh: 新政策和公司減少浪費、節約能源的目標一致。

words.note: 語塊：consistent with（和……一致）、consistent quality（穩定的品質）、consistent growth（持續成長）。consistent 是「一直都一樣、穩定的」；consistency 是名詞；constant 是「不斷的」。

sentences.en: Please respond to all customer emails in a timely manner, ideally within twenty-four hours of receiving them.
sentences.zh: 請及時回覆所有顧客的電子郵件，最好在二十四小時內。

sentences.en: We chose this supplier because it has a reputation for timely delivery and high-quality products.
sentences.zh: 我們選這家供應商，因為它以準時交貨和高品質產品著稱。

sentences.en: Thank you for your timely response to our questions about the contract, which helped us a lot.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你及時回覆我們關於合約的問題，幫了我們很大的忙。

sentences.en: The bank processes all loan applications in a timely manner so that customers can plan ahead.
sentences.zh: 銀行及時處理所有貸款申請，讓顧客能提前規劃。

sentences.en: Timely delivery is important for restaurants, which need fresh ingredients from local farms every morning.
sentences.zh: 準時交貨對每天早上都需要新鮮食材的餐廳來說很重要。

words.note: 語塊：in a timely manner（及時地）、timely delivery（準時交貨）、timely response（及時的回應）。timely 雖然是 -ly 結尾，但是形容詞；on time 是「準時」。

sentences.en: As a result of the heavy snow, many flights were canceled and the airport was closed for a day.
sentences.zh: 由於大雪，很多航班被取消，機場也關閉了一天。

sentences.en: Sales increased by twenty percent as a result of the new advertising campaign on social media.
sentences.zh: 由於社群媒體上的新廣告活動，銷售增加了兩成。

sentences.en: Several employees left the company as a result of the changes to the working hours last year.
sentences.zh: 因為去年工時的變動，好幾位員工離開了公司。

sentences.en: As a result of the merger, the new company will have offices in more than thirty countries.
sentences.zh: 因為合併，新公司將在三十多個國家設有辦公室。

sentences.en: The road was closed for several hours as a result of an accident involving two trucks.
sentences.zh: 因為一起兩輛卡車的事故，那條路封閉了好幾個小時。

words.note: 語塊：as a result of（因為……）。as a result of + 名詞 是「因為……」；as a result 放句首是「因此」。

sentences.en: The workshop teaches employees simple ways to cope with stress during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 工作坊教員工在忙碌節慶期間應付壓力的簡單方法。

sentences.en: The factory hired fifty new workers to cope with demand for its products during the summer.
sentences.zh: 工廠新聘五十名工人，以應付夏天對產品的需求。

sentences.en: Many small businesses found it difficult to cope with the rising cost of rent in the city center.
sentences.zh: 很多小企業發現很難應付市中心不斷上漲的房租。

sentences.en: The hospital added more beds to cope with the large number of patients during the flu season.
sentences.zh: 醫院增加病床，以應付流感季大量的病人。

sentences.en: New employees often need time to cope with the fast pace of work in our busy office.
sentences.zh: 新員工常常需要時間才能應付我們忙碌辦公室的快速工作步調。

words.note: 語塊：cope with stress（應付壓力）、cope with demand（應付需求）、cope with the rising cost（應付上漲的費用）、cope with the large number of（應付大量的……）、cope with the fast pace（應付快速步調）。cope with 是「設法處理（困難）」；deal with、handle 意思接近。

sentences.en: Extreme weather such as floods and storms has become more common in many parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 洪水和暴風雨等極端天氣在世界很多地方變得更常見。

sentences.en: Workers on the construction site take frequent breaks because of the extreme heat in the summer.
sentences.zh: 因為夏天酷熱，工地的工人經常休息。

sentences.en: The new jackets are designed to keep people warm even in extreme cold in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 新外套的設計即使在山上的嚴寒中也能讓人保暖。

sentences.en: The airport was closed for two days because of extreme weather that caused heavy snow and strong winds.
sentences.zh: 因為極端天氣帶來大雪和強風，機場關閉了兩天。

sentences.en: Doctors warn that elderly people should stay indoors during long periods of extreme heat in summer.
sentences.zh: 醫生警告長者在酷熱期間應該待在室內。

words.note: 語塊：extreme weather（極端天氣）、extreme heat（酷熱）、extreme cold（嚴寒）。extreme 是「非常、到極點的」；extremely 是副詞「極度地」。

sentences.en: The government introduced a new measure to reduce traffic in the city center during rush hour.
sentences.zh: 政府推出一項新措施，減少尖峰時段市中心的交通量。

sentences.en: As a safety measure, all visitors to the factory must wear helmets and safety glasses.
sentences.zh: 作為安全措施，所有參觀工廠的訪客都必須戴安全帽和護目鏡。

sentences.en: Customer satisfaction is one important measure of the success of our new online delivery service.
sentences.zh: 顧客滿意度是衡量我們新服務成功與否的一項重要標準。

sentences.en: The company introduced a measure to save energy by turning off all lights at eight o'clock every evening.
sentences.zh: 公司推出一項節能措施，每天晚上八點關掉所有的燈。

sentences.en: As a temporary measure, employees will work from home until the office is completely repaired.
sentences.zh: 作為暫時措施，員工會在家工作到辦公室修好為止。

words.note: 語塊：take measures（採取措施）、safety measures（安全措施）、a measure of（衡量……的標準）。measure 當名詞常指「措施」（常用複數）；當動詞是「測量」；measurement 是「尺寸」。

sentences.en: Please keep in mind that the office will be closed on Monday because of the national holiday.
sentences.zh: 請記得辦公室週一因國定假日休息。

sentences.en: Keep in mind that prices may change, so please check our website before you place an order.
sentences.zh: 請記得價格可能會變動，所以下單前請先查看我們的網站。

sentences.en: When you write the report, keep in mind that the clients may not understand technical words.
sentences.zh: 寫報告時，請記得客戶可能看不懂專業術語。

sentences.en: Travelers should keep in mind that the museum is closed on the first Monday of every month.
sentences.zh: 旅客應記得博物館每月第一個週一休館。

sentences.en: Please keep in mind that the deadline for submitting applications is the end of this week.
sentences.zh: 請記得提交申請的截止日是本週末。

words.note: 語塊：keep in mind that（記得……）。keep in mind 是「放在心上、記得」；bear in mind 意思相同；remember 是一般說法。

sentences.en: Many companies stopped hiring new staff during the recession and reduced their spending on advertising.
sentences.zh: 經濟衰退期間，很多公司停止招聘並減少廣告支出。

sentences.en: Economists warn that the country could enter a recession if consumer spending continues to fall.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家警告，如果消費支出持續下滑，該國可能陷入衰退。

sentences.en: The restaurant managed to survive the economic recession by offering cheaper lunch menus to office workers.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳推出比較便宜的午餐菜單，撐過了經濟衰退。

sentences.en: During the recession, many people lost their jobs and had to look for work in other cities.
sentences.zh: 衰退期間，很多人失業，只好到其他城市找工作。

sentences.en: The government lowered taxes to help small businesses during the long economic recession last year.
sentences.zh: 政府去年在經濟衰退期間減稅，幫助小企業。

words.note: 語塊：economic recession（經濟衰退）、during the recession（衰退期間）、enter a recession（陷入衰退）。recession 是「經濟衰退」；depression 是更嚴重的「蕭條」；recess 是「休會；休息」。

sentences.en: The town is heavily reliant on tourism, so the loss of visitors last year hurt many local businesses.
sentences.zh: 那個小鎮非常依賴觀光業，所以去年遊客減少傷害了很多當地商家。

sentences.en: Many farmers are reliant on seasonal workers to help them harvest their crops every autumn.
sentences.zh: 很多農民依賴季節性工人每年秋天幫忙收成。

sentences.en: The company is too reliant on one large customer, so it is trying to find new clients in Asia.
sentences.zh: 公司太依賴一位大客戶，所以正努力在亞洲尋找新客戶。

sentences.en: Small shops in the area are reliant on regular customers who live in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 這一帶的小店依賴住在附近的常客。

sentences.en: The country is heavily reliant on imported oil, so it is investing more in solar and wind power.
sentences.zh: 該國非常依賴進口石油，所以正在加大太陽能和風力的投資。

words.note: 語塊：be reliant on（依賴……）、heavily reliant（非常依賴）。reliant 是「依靠……的」；dependent 意思接近；reliable 是「可靠的」，意思不同。

words.meaning: 友善的；親切的；（對……）友好的

sentences.en: The hotel received excellent reviews because of its friendly staff and its clean, comfortable rooms.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店因為親切的員工和舒適的房間而獲得極佳的評價。

sentences.en: The new app is very user-friendly, so even elderly customers can use it without any help.
sentences.zh: 新 App 非常容易使用，連年長的顧客也不用別人幫忙就會用。

sentences.en: The company uses environmentally friendly packaging made from recycled paper for all of its products.
sentences.zh: 公司所有產品都使用回收紙製的環保包裝。

sentences.en: The friendly staff at the front desk helped us find a good restaurant near the hotel.
sentences.zh: 櫃台親切的員工幫我們找到飯店附近一家好餐廳。

sentences.en: Customers prefer products that are environmentally friendly, even if they cost a little more money.
sentences.zh: 顧客比較喜歡環保的產品，即使價格稍微貴一點。

words.note: 語塊：friendly staff（親切的員工）、user-friendly（容易使用的）、environmentally friendly（環保的）。friendly 雖然是 -ly 結尾，但是形容詞；user-friendly 是「對使用者友善的」。

sentences.en: Travelers must declare any goods worth more than five hundred dollars when they arrive at the airport.
sentences.zh: 旅客抵達機場時，必須申報價值超過五百美元的物品。

sentences.en: The government will declare a national holiday to celebrate the one-hundredth anniversary of the city.
sentences.zh: 政府將宣布一個國定假日，慶祝城市建城一百週年。

sentences.en: The judges will declare the winner of the competition at the end of the awards ceremony.
sentences.zh: 評審將在頒獎典禮最後宣布比賽的得獎者。

sentences.en: The company had to declare that it could not pay its debts after it lost its largest customer.
sentences.zh: 失去最大客戶後，公司不得不宣布無力償還債務。

sentences.en: Please declare all of your income on the tax form, including money from part-time jobs.
sentences.zh: 請在報稅表上申報你所有的收入，包括兼職的收入。

words.note: 語塊：declare goods（申報物品）、declare that（宣布……）、declare a national holiday（宣布國定假日）、declare the winner（宣布得獎者）、declare all of your income（申報所有收入）。declare 是「正式宣布」或在海關「申報」；declaration 是名詞。

sentences.en: The two airlines formed an alliance so that passengers can travel to more cities with one ticket.
sentences.zh: 兩家航空公司結盟，讓乘客一張票就能飛到更多城市。

sentences.en: The company entered into a strategic alliance with a technology firm to develop new products.
sentences.zh: 那家公司和一家科技公司建立策略聯盟，開發新產品。

sentences.en: Several small businesses in the town formed an alliance to compete with the large supermarket.
sentences.zh: 鎮上好幾家小商家結盟，和大型超市競爭。

sentences.en: The hotel works in alliance with local restaurants to offer hotel guests special discounts on meals.
sentences.zh: 飯店和當地餐廳結盟，為客人提供特別折扣。

sentences.en: The strategic alliance between the two banks will allow customers to use both banks' machines for free.
sentences.zh: 兩家銀行的策略聯盟將讓顧客免費使用雙方的提款機。

words.note: 語塊：form an alliance（結盟）、strategic alliance（策略聯盟）、in alliance with（與……結盟）。alliance 是「為共同目標合作的關係」；ally 是「盟友」；allowance 是「津貼」，長得像。

sentences.en: Old computers are more vulnerable to attacks from hackers, so please update your software regularly.
sentences.zh: 舊電腦比較容易受到駭客攻擊，所以請定期更新軟體。

sentences.en: Elderly people are especially vulnerable to the extreme heat, so they should drink plenty of water.
sentences.zh: 長者特別容易受到酷熱的影響，所以應該多喝水。

sentences.en: The charity provides food and housing for vulnerable people who have nowhere else to go.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善團體為無處可去的弱勢族群提供食物和住處。

sentences.en: Small businesses are more vulnerable to changes in the economy than large companies with more money.
sentences.zh: 小企業比大公司更容易受到經濟變化的影響。

sentences.en: Farms near the river are vulnerable to flooding, so many farmers have built walls to protect their fields.
sentences.zh: 河邊的農場容易淹水，所以很多農民築了牆保護田地。

words.note: 語塊：vulnerable to（容易受到……）、vulnerable people（弱勢族群）。vulnerable 是「容易受到傷害或攻擊的」；weak 意思接近；vulnerability 是名詞。

sentences.en: The company focuses on continuous improvement, so it asks customers for feedback by email every month.
sentences.zh: 公司注重持續改善，所以每個月都徵詢顧客意見。

sentences.en: The factory needs a continuous supply of electricity so that the machines can run day and night.
sentences.zh: 工廠需要不間斷的電力供應，讓機器能日夜運轉。

sentences.en: The city has enjoyed continuous growth over the past decade because of new businesses and tourism.
sentences.zh: 因為新企業和觀光業，城市過去十年持續成長。

sentences.en: Workers on the production line take a break every two hours because continuous work can be tiring.
sentences.zh: 生產線的工人每兩小時休息一次，因為連續工作很累。

sentences.en: The hospital provides continuous care for patients who need help and support twenty-four hours a day.
sentences.zh: 醫院為需要全天候協助的病人提供不間斷的照護。

words.note: 語塊：continuous improvement（持續改善）、continuous growth（持續成長）、continuous supply（不間斷的供應）。continuous 是「沒有中斷的」；continual 是「一再發生的」；continue 是動詞。

sentences.en: The customer service team is trained to deal with complaints from customers quickly and politely.
sentences.zh: 客服團隊受過訓練，能快速又有禮貌地處理投訴。

sentences.en: The manager will deal with the problem with the printer as soon as she returns to the office.
sentences.zh: 經理一回到辦公室就會處理印表機的問題。

sentences.en: Staff at the front desk must be patient when they deal with customers who are upset or confused.
sentences.zh: 櫃台員工應對不滿或困惑的顧客時必須有耐心。

sentences.en: The city hired more workers to deal with the large amount of snow on the roads this winter.
sentences.zh: 市政府增聘工人，處理今年冬天道路上的大量積雪。

sentences.en: It can be stressful to deal with problems at work, so the company offers support to its employees.
sentences.zh: 處理工作上的問題可能壓力很大，所以公司為員工提供支持。

words.note: 語塊：deal with complaints（處理投訴）、deal with problems（處理問題）、deal with customers（應對顧客）。deal with 是「處理（問題、人）」；過去式 dealt with；handle 意思接近。

sentences.en: The students listened attentively as the speaker explained how to start and run a small business.
sentences.zh: 講者說明如何創業時，學生們專心聆聽。

sentences.en: The new employees watched attentively while the manager showed them how to use the machine.
sentences.zh: 經理示範如何使用機器時，新員工仔細觀看。

sentences.en: Good salespeople always listen attentively to their customers before suggesting any products or services to them.
sentences.zh: 好的銷售員在推薦任何產品給顧客之前，總會先專心聽他們說。

sentences.en: The audience listened attentively during the presentation and asked many good questions at the end.
sentences.zh: 聽眾在簡報期間專心聆聽，最後問了很多問題。

sentences.en: The waiter served the guests attentively and made sure that their glasses were always full.
sentences.zh: 服務生很細心地招待客人，確保他們的杯子一直是滿的。

words.note: 語塊：listen attentively（專心聆聽）、watch attentively（仔細觀看）。attentively 是「很專注地」；attentive 是形容詞「專心的；體貼的」；attention 是名詞。

sentences.en: Please insert your card into the machine and enter your password to withdraw money from your account.
sentences.zh: 請把卡插進機器並輸入密碼來提款。

sentences.en: To use the parking machine, insert a coin or pay with your phone at the screen.
sentences.zh: 要使用停車機，請投幣或在螢幕上用手機付款。

sentences.en: The editor asked the writer to insert a short paragraph about the history of the company.
sentences.zh: 編輯請作者插入一段關於公司歷史的簡短段落。

sentences.en: Please insert the new battery carefully, making sure that it faces the correct direction inside the machine.
sentences.zh: 請小心放入新電池，確認方向正確。

sentences.en: Before the meeting, I will insert the latest sales figures into the presentation slides for the clients.
sentences.zh: 開會前，我會把最新的銷售數字放進簡報投影片。

words.note: 語塊：insert a card（插卡）、insert a coin（投幣）、insert into（插入……）。insert 是「把東西放進去」；insertion 是名詞；當名詞 insert 是「插頁」。

sentences.en: The previous occupant of the apartment left some furniture, which the landlord will remove next week.
sentences.zh: 公寓的前住戶留下了一些家具，房東會清走。

sentences.en: Each occupant of the building must have a key card to enter the main door after nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 大樓的每位住戶晚上九點後都必須有門禁卡才能進大門。

sentences.en: The letter was addressed to the occupant, so it was delivered to everyone who lives on the street.
sentences.zh: 那封信寫給「住戶」，所以送到了這條街的每一戶。

sentences.en: The new occupant of the office on the third floor is a small design company from Seoul.
sentences.zh: 三樓辦公室的新使用者是一家來自首爾的小設計公司。
