sentences.en: The occupant of the car was not injured in the accident, but the vehicle was badly damaged.
sentences.zh: 車上的乘客在事故中沒有受傷，但車子嚴重損壞。

words.note: 語塊：the occupant of（……的住戶）、previous occupant（前住戶）。occupant 是「住在或使用某空間的人」；occupy 是動詞；occupation 是「職業」。

sentences.en: Visitors are not allowed to take photographs inside the museum, so please put away your cameras.
sentences.zh: 訪客不准在博物館內拍照，所以請收起相機。

sentences.en: Employees are allowed to work from home on Fridays if their manager agrees in advance.
sentences.zh: 如果經理事先同意，員工週五可以在家工作。

sentences.en: Children under twelve are not allowed to use the hotel swimming pool without an adult.
sentences.zh: 十二歲以下的孩子沒有大人陪同不准使用游泳池。

sentences.en: Passengers are allowed to bring one small bag and one suitcase on the plane for free on international flights.
sentences.zh: 乘客可以免費帶一個小包和一個行李箱上飛機。

sentences.en: Only staff are allowed to enter the kitchen, so customers should order at the counter.
sentences.zh: 只有員工可以進廚房，所以顧客應該到櫃台點餐。

words.note: 語塊：be allowed to（被允許做……）、not allowed to（不准……）。be allowed to + 原形動詞；be permitted to 意思接近；allow 是動詞「允許」。

sentences.en: Please put empty bottles and cans in the recycling bin near the kitchen door on each floor.
sentences.zh: 請把空瓶和空罐放進廚房門旁邊的回收桶。

sentences.en: There is a trash bin next to every bench in the park, so please do not leave garbage on the ground.
sentences.zh: 公園每張長椅旁都有垃圾桶，所以請不要把垃圾留在地上。

sentences.en: The office bought a large storage bin for old documents that must be kept for five years.
sentences.zh: 辦公室買了一個大收納箱，存放必須保留五年的舊文件。

sentences.en: The city has placed a recycling bin on every street corner to encourage people to recycle.
sentences.zh: 市政府在每個街角都放了回收桶，鼓勵民眾回收。

sentences.en: Please empty the trash bin in your office before you leave the office on Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 週五下午離開前，請把你辦公室的垃圾桶清空。

words.note: 語塊：recycling bin（回收桶）、trash bin（垃圾桶）、storage bin（收納箱）。bin 是「桶、箱」，英式英文常指垃圾桶；trash can 是美式說法。

sentences.en: The parking lot is located at the rear of the building, next to the loading area.
sentences.zh: 停車場位於大樓後面，就在裝卸區旁邊。

sentences.en: Please use the rear entrance while the main door of the building is being repaired this week.
sentences.zh: 這週正門維修期間，請使用後門。

sentences.en: Passengers in the rear seat must also wear seat belts while the car is moving.
sentences.zh: 車子行駛時，後座乘客也必須繫安全帶。

sentences.en: The kitchen is at the rear of the restaurant, so customers cannot hear the noise from the cooks.
sentences.zh: 廚房在餐廳後方，所以顧客聽不到廚師的聲音。

sentences.en: Deliveries should be made through the rear entrance so that customers in the store are not disturbed.
sentences.zh: 送貨應該走後門，以免打擾顧客。

words.note: 語塊：at the rear of（在……的後面）、rear entrance（後門）、rear seat（後座）。rear 可以當名詞或形容詞「後面的」；front 是「前面」；behind 是介系詞「在……後面」。

sentences.en: The new hotel has a modern design with large windows, clean lines, and simple furniture.
sentences.zh: 新飯店有現代的設計，有大窗戶、俐落的線條和簡單的家具。

sentences.en: The hospital uses modern technology to diagnose illnesses much more quickly and accurately than before.
sentences.zh: 醫院使用現代科技，比以前更快更準確地診斷疾病。

sentences.en: The factory replaced its old machines with modern equipment that uses much less electricity and water.
sentences.zh: 工廠把舊機器換成用電少很多的新式設備。

sentences.en: The museum combines old buildings with a modern glass entrance that attracts many visitors every day.
sentences.zh: 博物館結合了老建築和吸引很多遊客的現代玻璃入口。

sentences.en: The apartments are small but modern, and each one has a new kitchen and bathroom.
sentences.zh: 那些公寓雖小但很現代，每間都有新的廚房和浴室。

words.note: 語塊：modern design（現代設計）、modern technology（現代科技）、modern equipment（新式設備）。modern 是「現代的、新的」；contemporary 意思接近；modest 是「謙虛的」，長得像。

sentences.en: The hotel is in a convenient location near the train station and several good restaurants.
sentences.zh: 飯店位於火車站和幾家好餐廳附近的便利地點。

sentences.en: Is Thursday afternoon convenient for you, or would you prefer to meet on Friday morning?
sentences.zh: 週四下午你方便嗎，還是比較想週五早上見面？

sentences.en: Online banking is convenient for customers who do not have time to visit a branch during the day.
sentences.zh: 網路銀行對白天沒時間去分行的顧客來說很方便。

sentences.en: Please call the office at a convenient time to schedule your appointment with the doctor.
sentences.zh: 請在方便的時間打電話到辦公室，預約看醫生。

sentences.en: The new subway line is convenient for commuters because it stops right in front of the business district.
sentences.zh: 新捷運線對通勤族很方便，因為它就停在商業區正前方。

words.note: 語塊：convenient location（便利的地點）、convenient for（對……方便）、at a convenient time（在方便的時間）。convenient 是「方便的」；convenience 是名詞；comfortable 是「舒適的」，意思不同。

sentences.en: The company offers good benefits and flexible hours in order to retain employees for many years.
sentences.zh: 公司提供好的福利和彈性工時，以便長期留住員工。

sentences.en: It is much cheaper to retain customers than to find new ones, so we focus on excellent service.
sentences.zh: 留住顧客比找新顧客便宜很多，所以我們專注於提供優質服務。

sentences.en: Please retain a copy of your receipt in case you need to return the product later this month.
sentences.zh: 請保留一份收據副本，以防這個月稍晚需要退貨。

sentences.en: The old building will retain its historic facade, but the inside will be completely renovated.
sentences.zh: 那棟老建築會保留歷史正面，但內部將全面翻修。

sentences.en: The hotel was able to retain most of its staff during the renovation by moving them to other locations.
sentences.zh: 翻修期間，飯店把員工調到其他分館，因此留住了大部分人。

words.note: 語塊：retain employees（留住員工）、retain customers（留住顧客）、retain a copy（保留副本）。retain 比 keep 正式；retention 是名詞「保留；留任」。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a unique experience, with rooms built inside the trees of an old forest.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店提供獨特的體驗，房間就蓋在古老森林的樹上。

sentences.en: The internship is a unique opportunity for students to work with engineers at a large company.
sentences.zh: 這份實習是學生和大公司工程師一起工作的難得機會。

sentences.en: The museum's unique design has made it one of the most famous buildings in the city.
sentences.zh: 博物館獨特的設計讓它成為城裡最有名的建築之一。

sentences.en: This type of tea is unique to the mountain region, where the weather is cool and wet all year.
sentences.zh: 這種茶是山區獨有的，那裡全年氣候涼爽潮濕。

sentences.en: Each piece of jewelry in the shop is handmade, so every item has a unique shape and color.
sentences.zh: 店裡每件珠寶都是手工做的，所以每件都有獨特的形狀和顏色。

words.note: 語塊：unique design（獨特的設計）、unique opportunity（難得的機會）、unique to（……獨有的）。unique 是「獨一無二的」；special 意思接近；uniquely 是副詞。

sentences.en: The famous actor will make an appearance at the opening of the new shopping center on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 那位知名演員週六會在新購物中心的開幕式上露面。

sentences.en: The renovation greatly improved the appearance of the old hotel, which now looks modern and bright.
sentences.zh: 翻修大幅改善了老飯店的外觀，現在看起來現代又明亮。

sentences.en: Employees who meet with clients should pay attention to their appearance and dress professionally every day.
sentences.zh: 會和客戶見面的員工應該注意外表，穿著專業。

sentences.en: The appearance of the new phone is similar to the old one, but it has a much larger screen.
sentences.zh: 新手機的外觀和舊款相似，但螢幕大很多。

sentences.en: The CEO made a brief appearance at the party to thank the staff for their hard work this year.
sentences.zh: 執行長在派對上短暫露面，感謝員工今年的辛勤工作。

words.note: 語塊：make an appearance（露面）、physical appearance（外表）、the appearance of（……的外觀）。appearance 是名詞；appear 是動詞「出現；看起來」；disappearance 是「消失」。

sentences.en: The engineers made a minor modification to the design after the first tests showed a small problem.
sentences.zh: 第一次測試發現小問題後，工程師對設計做了小幅修改。

sentences.en: Any modification to the contract must be approved in writing by both companies before it takes effect.
sentences.zh: 合約的任何修改都必須在生效前經雙方書面同意。

sentences.en: The customer asked for a modification to her order because she wanted the sofa in a different color.
sentences.zh: 那位顧客要求修改訂單，因為她想要不同顏色的沙發。

sentences.en: The software will need some modification before it can be used by our offices in other countries.
sentences.zh: 軟體需要做一些修改，才能給我們其他國家的辦公室使用。

sentences.en: After a small modification to the menu, the restaurant now offers more vegetarian dishes at lunch.
sentences.zh: 菜單稍作修改後，那家餐廳現在午餐提供更多素食料理。

words.note: 語塊：make modifications（做修改）、minor modification（小幅修改）、modification to（對……的修改）。modification 是名詞；modify 是動詞「修改」；change 意思接近。

sentences.en: The company owns a fleet of delivery trucks that bring products to stores across the country.
sentences.zh: 那家公司擁有一支送貨卡車隊，把產品送到全國各地的門市。

sentences.en: The airline plans to add twenty new planes to its fleet over the next five years.
sentences.zh: 航空公司計畫在未來五年為機隊增加二十架新飛機。

sentences.en: The city will replace its fleet of old buses with electric ones to reduce air pollution downtown.
sentences.zh: 市政府將把老舊的公車隊換成電動公車，以減少市中心的空氣污染。

sentences.en: A fleet of boats takes tourists around the islands every morning during the summer season.
sentences.zh: 夏季期間，每天早上都有一隊船載觀光客環繞那些島嶼。

sentences.en: The taxi company has a fleet of more than five hundred cars, and most of them are electric.
sentences.zh: 那家計程車公司有五百多輛車的車隊，大部分是電動車。

words.note: 語塊：a fleet of（一隊……）、fleet of vehicles（車隊）。fleet 是「同一公司擁有的一群車、船或飛機」；flee 是「逃跑」，長得像。

sentences.en: Old copies of the newspaper are kept in the archive on the third floor of the library.
sentences.zh: 報紙的舊報存放在圖書館三樓的檔案庫裡。

sentences.en: Customers can find every past issue of the magazine in our online archive for free.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在我們的線上檔案庫免費找到雜誌的每一期過刊。

sentences.en: The company keeps an archive of all of its contracts and important documents for at least ten years.
sentences.zh: 公司把所有合約和重要文件存入檔案庫，至少保留十年。

sentences.en: Researchers spent several weeks in the archive reading letters that were written more than a century ago.
sentences.zh: 研究人員在檔案庫花了好幾週，閱讀一百多年前寫的信。

sentences.en: Please save a copy of the report in the online archive so that other teams can read it later.
sentences.zh: 請把報告的副本存到線上檔案庫，讓其他團隊之後可以閱讀。

words.note: 語塊：in the archive（在檔案庫中）、online archive（線上檔案庫）、archive of（……的檔案）。archive 可以當名詞「檔案庫」或動詞「歸檔」；常用複數 archives。

sentences.en: Customers can make payment online, by phone, or at any of our branches in the city.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在網路上、打電話或到城裡任何一家分行付款。

sentences.en: Please make payment by the end of the month to avoid paying a late fee on your bill.
sentences.zh: 請在月底前付款，以免帳單產生滯納金。

sentences.en: Guests must make payment for the first night when they book a room on our website.
sentences.zh: 客人在我們網站訂房時，必須先支付第一晚的費用。

sentences.en: If you would like to make payment by credit card, please call our billing department.
sentences.zh: 如果你想用信用卡付款，請打電話給我們的帳務部。

sentences.en: The supplier asked us to make payment within thirty days of receiving the goods at our warehouse.
sentences.zh: 供應商要求我們收到貨物後三十天內付款。

words.note: 語塊：make payment by（以……付款）、make payment online（線上付款）。make payment 和 pay 意思相同，比較正式；make a payment 也很常見。

sentences.en: The sudden change in the weather forced the organizers to move the outdoor concert indoors.
sentences.zh: 天氣突然改變，迫使主辦單位把音樂會移到室內。

sentences.en: There was a sudden increase in orders after the product appeared on a popular television show.
sentences.zh: 產品出現在熱門電視節目後，訂單突然增加。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, the lights in the office went out, and everyone had to stop working for an hour.
sentences.zh: 突然之間，辦公室的燈熄了，大家只好停工一小時。

sentences.en: The sudden resignation of the director surprised many employees who had worked with him for years.
sentences.zh: 主任突然辭職，讓很多和他共事多年的員工很驚訝。

sentences.en: A sudden drop in temperature can damage crops, so farmers watch the weather forecast carefully.
sentences.zh: 氣溫驟降可能會損害作物，所以農民會仔細注意天氣預報。

words.note: 語塊：sudden change（突然的改變）、all of a sudden（突然）、sudden increase（突然增加）。sudden 是形容詞；suddenly 是副詞；all of a sudden 是「突然之間」。

sentences.en: Please ask your direct supervisor for permission before you take any days off next month.
sentences.zh: 下個月請假之前，請先徵求你直屬主管的許可。

sentences.en: If you have a problem with a customer, you should report to a supervisor as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 如果你和顧客之間有問題，請盡快向主管報告。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz was promoted to supervisor after working on the night shift for three years.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐上了三年夜班後，被升為主管。

sentences.en: Each supervisor is responsible for checking the work of the employees on his or her team.
sentences.zh: 每位主管都負責檢查自己團隊員工的工作。

sentences.en: New employees will meet with their supervisor every Friday during their first month at the company.
sentences.zh: 新員工到公司的第一個月，每週五都會和主管見面。

words.note: 語塊：direct supervisor（直屬主管）、report to a supervisor（向主管報告）、promoted to supervisor（升為主管）、each supervisor（每位主管）、meet with their supervisor（和主管見面）。supervisor 是「監督別人工作的人」；supervise 是動詞；supervision 是名詞。

sentences.en: Customers will receive a monthly billing statement by email at the beginning of each month.
sentences.zh: 顧客每月初會透過電子郵件收到一份每月帳單。

sentences.en: Please review your billing statement carefully and contact us right away if you see any mistakes.
sentences.zh: 請仔細檢查你的帳單，如果發現任何錯誤請聯絡我們。

sentences.en: The billing statement shows every payment you made last month and the amount you still owe.
sentences.zh: 帳單列出你上個月的每一筆付款，以及你還欠的金額。

sentences.en: If you would like to receive a paper billing statement, please change your settings on our website.
sentences.zh: 如果你想收到紙本帳單，請在我們網站上更改設定。

sentences.en: The company sends a billing statement to each client at the end of every project.
sentences.zh: 公司在每個專案結束時都會寄帳單給客戶。

words.note: 語塊：monthly billing statement（每月帳單）、review your billing statement（檢查你的帳單）。billing statement 是「列出應付金額的帳單」；bill、invoice 意思接近。

sentences.en: Employees who want to improve their English can sign up for a free class at the training center.
sentences.zh: 想加強英文的員工可以報名訓練中心的免費課程。

sentences.en: Customers who sign up for our newsletter will receive a coupon for ten percent off their next order.
sentences.zh: 訂閱我們電子報的顧客下次訂購可以拿到九折優惠券。

sentences.en: More than two hundred runners have already signed up, so please sign up for the race before Friday.
sentences.zh: 已經有兩百多位跑者報名了，所以請在週五前報名參加比賽。

sentences.en: Students must sign up for at least four courses each semester in order to stay in the program.
sentences.zh: 學生每學期必須至少報名四門課，才能留在學程中。

sentences.en: Please sign up for the company picnic by Wednesday so that we know how much food to order.
sentences.zh: 請在週三前報名公司野餐，讓我們知道要訂多少食物。

words.note: 語塊：sign up for a class（報名課程）、sign up for a newsletter（訂閱電子報）、sign up for the race（報名比賽）、sign up for the company picnic（報名公司野餐）、sign up for at least（至少報名……）。sign up for 是「報名、登記參加」；register for 意思接近；sign in 是「登入」。

sentences.en: All of our products are tested carefully to make sure that they meet every safety standard in Europe.
sentences.zh: 我們所有產品都經過仔細測試，確保符合歐洲的每一項安全標準。

sentences.en: The hotel is known for its high standard of service and its excellent restaurant on the top floor.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店以高水準的服務和頂樓的極佳餐廳聞名。

sentences.en: Products that do not meet the standard set by the government cannot be sold in stores.
sentences.zh: 不符合政府標準的產品不能在商店販售。

sentences.en: The company expects every employee to maintain a high standard of work and treat customers politely.
sentences.zh: 公司期待每位員工維持高水準的工作，並有禮貌地對待顧客。

sentences.en: The new law raises the standard for clean air in cities, so factories must reduce their pollution.
sentences.zh: 新法律提高了城市的空氣品質標準，所以工廠必須減少污染。

words.note: 語塊：safety standards（安全標準）、high standard（高標準）、meet the standard（達到標準）。standard 可以當名詞「標準」或形容詞「標準的；一般的」。

sentences.en: All of the participants must register for the conference online before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 所有與會者都必須在月底前在線上報名研討會。

sentences.en: You need to register online with your email address before you can use the library's services.
sentences.zh: 你需要先用電子信箱在網路上註冊，才能使用圖書館的服務。

sentences.en: It takes about two weeks to register a company with the government and receive a business license.
sentences.zh: 向政府登記公司並拿到營業執照大約需要兩週。

sentences.en: Guests must register at the front desk and show a photo ID when they arrive at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 客人抵達飯店時必須在櫃台登記並出示附照片的證件。

sentences.en: Students who register for the course before Friday will receive a discount of twenty percent.
sentences.zh: 週五前報名這門課的學生可以享有八折優惠。

words.note: 語塊：register for（報名……）、register online（線上註冊）、register a company（登記公司）。register 是「正式登記」；registration 是名詞；sign up 意思接近。

sentences.en: Customers who no longer need the extra features can downgrade to a cheaper plan at any time.
sentences.zh: 不再需要額外功能的顧客，隨時可以降級到比較便宜的方案。

sentences.en: The bank decided to downgrade the company's credit rating because of its rising debts and falling profits.
sentences.zh: 因為負債增加，銀行決定調降那家公司的信用評等。

sentences.en: If you downgrade your membership, you will no longer have access to the gym's swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 如果你降級會員資格，就不能再使用健身房的游泳池。

sentences.en: The airline had to downgrade several passengers to economy class because business class was full.
sentences.zh: 因為商務艙客滿，航空公司只好把好幾位乘客降到經濟艙。

sentences.en: Many families decided to downgrade their phone plans to save money when prices increased last year.
sentences.zh: 漲價時，很多家庭決定把手機方案降級來省錢。

words.note: 語塊：downgrade to（降級到……）、downgrade a service（降級服務）。downgrade 是「降到比較低的等級」；upgrade 是「升級」。

sentences.en: Customers can set up automatic payment so that their bills are paid on the same day every month.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以設定自動扣款，讓帳單每個月在同一天繳清。

sentences.en: The store installed automatic doors at the entrance to make it easier for customers with carts.
sentences.zh: 那家店在入口裝了自動門，方便推購物車的顧客進出。

sentences.en: Your membership will continue because of automatic renewal unless you cancel it before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 除非你在年底前取消，否則會員資格會因自動續約而繼續。

sentences.en: The new car has an automatic system that stops the vehicle if it gets too close to another car.
sentences.zh: 新車有一個自動系統，在太靠近其他車時會讓車子停下。

sentences.en: The office has an automatic lighting system that turns off the lights when no one is in the room.
sentences.zh: 辦公室有自動照明系統，房間裡沒人時會自動關燈。

words.note: 語塊：automatic payment（自動扣款）、automatic doors（自動門）、automatic renewal（自動續約）。automatic 是「自動的」；automatically 是副詞；manual 是「手動的」。

sentences.en: The company will plan to open three new stores in Southeast Asia if sales continue to grow.
sentences.zh: 如果銷售持續成長，公司會規劃在東南亞開三家新店。

sentences.en: It is important to plan ahead when you travel during the holiday season, as hotels fill up quickly.
sentences.zh: 節慶期間旅行時事先規劃很重要，因為飯店很快就會客滿。

sentences.en: The city must plan for the growing number of people who will move there in the next decade.
sentences.zh: 市政府必須為未來十年將搬來的越來越多人口做準備。

sentences.en: We plan to finish the report by Friday so that the manager has time to review it over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們打算在週五前完成報告，讓經理週末有時間審閱。

sentences.en: Families who plan ahead can save a lot of money by booking flights several months in advance.
sentences.zh: 事先規劃的家庭提前幾個月訂機票，可以省很多錢。

words.note: 語塊：plan to（打算……）、plan ahead（事先規劃）、plan for（為……做準備）。plan 可以當動詞或名詞「計畫」；planning 是「規劃」。

sentences.en: Small changes in the way we work can make a difference to the amount of energy we use.
sentences.zh: 工作方式的小改變可以影響我們用電的多寡。

sentences.en: Can you explain the difference between the two plans before I decide which one to choose?
sentences.zh: 在我決定選哪一個之前，你可以說明兩個方案的差異嗎？

sentences.en: There is a big difference in price between the hotels in the city center and those outside the city.
sentences.zh: 市中心的飯店和城外的飯店價格差很多。

sentences.en: The new manager has made a big difference, and the team is now much happier and more productive.
sentences.zh: 新經理帶來了很大的改變，團隊現在快樂多了，效率也高多了。

sentences.en: Volunteers can make a difference in the community by helping elderly people with shopping and cleaning.
sentences.zh: 志工可以幫長者購物和打掃，為社區帶來改變。

words.note: 語塊：make a difference（產生影響）、the difference between（……之間的差異）、a big difference（很大的差別）。difference 是名詞；different 是形容詞；differ 是動詞。

sentences.en: The manager will discuss the matter with the client and give you an answer by tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 經理會和客戶討論這件事，明天早上前給你答覆。

sentences.en: Finding a good apartment in the city is often a matter of luck as well as money.
sentences.zh: 在城市找到好公寓常常不只是錢的問題，也要看運氣。

sentences.en: No matter what the weather is like, the festival will take place in the park on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 無論天氣如何，慶典週六都會在公園舉行。

sentences.en: The police are investigating the matter and will report their findings to the public later this week.
sentences.zh: 警方正在調查這件事，這週稍晚會公布調查結果。

sentences.en: It is only a matter of time before electric cars become more common than gas cars in the city.
sentences.zh: 電動車在城裡比汽油車更普遍只是時間問題。

words.note: 語塊：a matter of（……的問題）、no matter what（無論如何）、discuss the matter（討論這件事）。matter 當名詞是「事情」；當動詞是「要緊」（It doesn't matter 沒關係）。

sentences.en: The manager will be with you shortly, so please have a seat in the waiting room.
sentences.zh: 經理很快就會來見你，所以請在等候室坐一下。

sentences.en: Shortly after the store opened, a long line of customers formed outside the main entrance.
sentences.zh: 那家店開門後不久，正門外就排起了長長的顧客隊伍。

sentences.en: The train to the airport will arrive shortly, so please wait behind the yellow line.
sentences.zh: 往機場的列車很快就會進站，所以請在黃線後等候。

sentences.en: The CEO resigned shortly before the company announced its plan to close several of its factories.
sentences.zh: 就在公司宣布關閉幾座工廠的計畫之前不久，執行長辭職了。

sentences.en: We received your order, and a confirmation email with the details will be sent to you shortly.
sentences.zh: 我們已收到你的訂單，很快會寄確認信給你。

words.note: 語塊：shortly after（……之後不久）、shortly before（……之前不久）、arrive shortly（很快到達）。shortly 是「很快、馬上」；soon 意思接近；briefly 是「簡短地」。

sentences.en: The accountant will calculate the cost of the project and send a report to the director by Friday.
sentences.zh: 會計師會計算專案的成本，並在週五前把報告寄給總監。

sentences.en: The website will calculate the total price of your order, including tax and shipping, automatically.
sentences.zh: 網站會自動計算你訂單的總價，包括稅和運費。

sentences.en: It is difficult to calculate exactly how much energy the new building will save each year.
sentences.zh: 很難精確計算新大樓每年能省多少能源。

sentences.en: The app can calculate how many calories you burn during your workout at the gym.
sentences.zh: 這個 App 可以計算你在健身房運動時消耗多少卡路里。

sentences.en: Please calculate the cost of hotel rooms and meals for everyone who will attend the conference.
sentences.zh: 請計算所有參加研討會的人的飯店和餐費。

words.note: 語塊：calculate the cost（計算成本）、calculate the total（計算總額）。calculate 是「用數學算出」；calculator 是「計算機」；calculation 是名詞。

sentences.en: The airline will compensate passengers for the long delay by giving them free meals and hotel rooms.
sentences.zh: 航空公司將提供免費餐點和飯店房間，補償長時間延誤的乘客。

sentences.en: The company will compensate employees for any travel expenses they pay while on business trips.
sentences.zh: 公司會補償員工出差期間支付的任何差旅費用。

sentences.en: Hiring more staff should compensate for the time we lost when the machines were broken last week.
sentences.zh: 增聘人手應該能彌補上週機器故障時損失的時間。

sentences.en: The store offered a discount to compensate customers for the inconvenience caused by the renovation.
sentences.zh: 那家店提供折扣，補償顧客因整修造成的不便。

sentences.en: Good customer service can compensate for small problems, such as a short wait for a table.
sentences.zh: 好的客服可以彌補小問題，例如等位子等一下下。

words.note: 語塊：compensate for（彌補……）、compensate sb for（補償某人……）。compensate for 是「彌補損失」；compensation 是名詞「補償；薪酬」。

sentences.en: Every member of the team helped contribute to the success of the project in different ways.
sentences.zh: 團隊每位成員都以不同的方式為專案的成功做出貢獻。

sentences.en: Many local businesses contribute money to the festival so that it can offer free concerts.
sentences.zh: 很多當地商家捐款給慶典，讓它能提供免費音樂會。

sentences.en: Long working hours and stress can contribute to serious health problems among office workers in the city.
sentences.zh: 長工時和壓力可能導致上班族的健康問題。

sentences.en: Employees are encouraged to contribute ideas for improving customer service at the weekly team meeting.
sentences.zh: 公司鼓勵員工在週會上貢獻改善客服的點子。

sentences.en: The new factory will contribute to economic growth in the region by creating hundreds of jobs.
sentences.zh: 新工廠將創造數百個工作機會，促進該地區的經濟成長。

words.note: 語塊：contribute to（貢獻於……；促成……）、contribute money（捐款）。contribute to 的 to 是介系詞；contribution 是名詞；contributor 是「貢獻者」。

sentences.en: The new phone will be released simultaneously in Asia, Europe, and North America next month.
sentences.zh: 新手機下個月將在亞洲、歐洲和北美同時上市。

sentences.en: The two teams worked simultaneously on different parts of the project so that it could be finished sooner.
sentences.zh: 兩個團隊同時進行專案的不同部分，好讓它能早點完成。

sentences.en: The software allows several people to edit the same document simultaneously from different offices around the world.
sentences.zh: 這套軟體讓好幾個人可以在不同辦公室同時編輯同一份文件。

sentences.en: The conference will be translated simultaneously into three languages for the guests from many other countries.
sentences.zh: 研討會會同步翻譯成三種語言，給來自其他國家的來賓。

sentences.en: It is difficult to manage several large projects simultaneously, so the manager hired an assistant.
sentences.zh: 同時管理好幾個大型專案很困難，所以經理聘了一位助理。

words.note: 語塊：released simultaneously（同時上市）、worked simultaneously（同時進行）、edit simultaneously（同時編輯）、translated simultaneously（同步翻譯）。simultaneously 是「在同一時間」；at the same time 意思相同；simultaneous 是形容詞。

sentences.en: Employees who have worked at the company for one year are eligible for an extra week of vacation.
sentences.zh: 在公司工作滿一年的員工有資格多放一週假。

sentences.en: Students who live in the city are eligible to receive a discount on public transportation.
sentences.zh: 住在城裡的學生有資格享有大眾運輸的優惠。

sentences.en: Only members of the loyalty program are eligible for the free gift that comes with each purchase.
sentences.zh: 只有忠誠計畫的會員才有資格在每次購物時獲得免費禮物。

sentences.en: To be eligible for the scholarship, students must have good grades and need financial help.
sentences.zh: 要有資格申請獎學金，學生必須成績好且需要經濟協助。

sentences.en: Customers who spend more than one hundred dollars are eligible to enter the prize draw this month.
sentences.zh: 這個月消費超過一百美元的顧客有資格參加抽獎。

words.note: 語塊：be eligible for（有資格得到……）、be eligible to（有資格做……）。eligible for + 名詞；eligible to + 原形動詞；eligibility 是名詞。

sentences.en: We apologize for the delay in shipping your order, which was caused by the heavy snow last week.
sentences.zh: 我們為訂單出貨延遲致歉，這是上週大雪造成的。

sentences.en: Please send the documents to our office without delay so that we can process your application.
sentences.zh: 請立刻把文件寄到我們辦公室，讓我們處理你的申請。

sentences.en: An accident on the highway caused a delay of more than one hour for many commuters this morning.
sentences.zh: 公路上的事故讓很多通勤族今天早上延誤了一個多小時。

sentences.en: The construction of the bridge is behind schedule because of a delay in the delivery of steel.
sentences.zh: 因為鋼材延遲交貨，橋樑工程落後進度。

sentences.en: Passengers were given free drinks because of the delay at the airport caused by bad weather.
sentences.zh: 因為壞天氣造成機場延誤，乘客獲得了免費飲料。

words.note: 語塊：without delay（立即）、cause a delay（造成延誤）、a delay in（……的延遲）。delay 可以當名詞或動詞「延誤」；postpone 是「延期（到之後）」。

sentences.en: To find your profit, subtract the cost of materials and labor from the total amount of sales.
sentences.zh: 要算出利潤，就從總銷售額中減去材料和人工成本。

sentences.en: The system will automatically subtract the discount from the price when you enter the code.
sentences.zh: 你輸入代碼時，系統會自動從價格中扣除折扣。

sentences.en: Please subtract any items that you have already returned from the total on the form.
sentences.zh: 請從表格上的總數中扣掉你已經退回的物品。

sentences.en: If you subtract the time spent in meetings, employees have only a few hours for their main tasks.
sentences.zh: 如果扣掉開會的時間，員工只剩幾個小時做主要工作。

sentences.en: The accountant will subtract the deposit from the final bill so that you pay only the remaining amount.
sentences.zh: 會計會從最後的帳單中扣掉訂金，讓你只付剩下的金額。

words.note: 語塊：subtract from（從……減去）、subtract the cost（扣除費用）。subtract 是數學的「減」；deduct 是「從金額中扣除」；add 是「加」。

sentences.en: Please remove all of your personal items from your desk before the carpets are replaced on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 週六更換地毯之前，請把你桌上的所有私人物品拿走。

sentences.en: The hotel staff will remove the old furniture from the rooms before the renovation begins.
sentences.zh: 翻修開始前，飯店員工會把舊家具從房間搬走。

sentences.en: This cleaning product can remove a stain from carpets and sofas without damaging the material.
sentences.zh: 這款清潔用品能去除地毯和沙發上的污漬，又不傷材質。

sentences.en: Please remove the cover carefully before you replace the old battery in the remote control.
sentences.zh: 更換遙控器的電池之前，請小心拿掉蓋子。

sentences.en: The company decided to remove the product from its stores after customers reported safety problems.
sentences.zh: 顧客回報安全問題後，公司決定把那項產品從門市下架。

words.note: 語塊：remove from（從……移除）、remove a stain（去除污漬）、remove the cover（拿掉蓋子）。remove 是「拿走、去掉」；removal 是名詞；move 是「移動」。

sentences.en: Please use the main entrance on the north side of the building while the side door is being repaired.
sentences.zh: 側門維修期間，請使用大樓北側的正門。

sentences.en: The main reason customers choose our store is the friendly service and very reasonable prices.
sentences.zh: 顧客選擇我們店的主要原因是親切的服務和合理的價格。

sentences.en: All applications should be sent to the main office in Seoul rather than to the local branches.
sentences.zh: 所有申請都應該寄到首爾的總辦公室，而不是當地分公司。

sentences.en: The main goal of the training program is to help new employees understand our products.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫的主要目標是幫助新員工了解我們的產品。

sentences.en: The museum's main hall will be closed for two weeks while workers install new lights.
sentences.zh: 工人安裝新燈期間，博物館的主廳將關閉兩週。

words.note: 語塊：main office（總辦公室）、main entrance（正門）、main reason（主要原因）。main 是「最主要、最大的」；major 意思接近；mainly 是副詞「主要地」。

sentences.en: The restaurant has received numerous awards for its excellent food and friendly service over the years.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳因為極佳的食物和親切的服務獲得了許多獎項。

sentences.en: The company received numerous complaints about the new website, so it returned to the old design.
sentences.zh: 公司收到許多關於新網站的投訴，所以改回了舊設計。

sentences.en: I have called the supplier numerous times, but nobody has answered the phone this week.
sentences.zh: 我打給供應商很多次了，但這週都沒有人接電話。

sentences.en: The city has numerous parks and museums that are free for residents and visitors to enjoy.
sentences.zh: 這座城市有許多公園和博物館，居民和遊客都可以免費享受。

sentences.en: The manager has warned the team on numerous occasions about the importance of meeting deadlines.
sentences.zh: 經理曾多次警告團隊趕上截止日的重要性。

words.note: 語塊：numerous times（很多次）、numerous complaints（許多投訴）、on numerous occasions（多次）。numerous 是「很多的」，比 many 正式；後面接複數名詞。

sentences.en: Every visitor must sign in at the security desk and wear a badge at all times while in the building.
sentences.zh: 每位訪客都必須在保全櫃台登記，並在大樓內隨時配戴識別證。

sentences.en: The visitor center at the park provides maps and information about the hiking trails in the area.
sentences.zh: 公園的遊客中心提供地圖和該地區健行步道的資訊。

sentences.en: The new museum is expected to attract more than one million visitors in its first year, and each visitor will receive a free guide.
sentences.zh: 新博物館預計第一年會吸引一百多萬名參觀者，每位參觀者都會拿到一份免費導覽。

sentences.en: The hotel offers free coffee to every visitor who waits in the lobby for a meeting.
sentences.zh: 飯店為每位在大廳等候開會的訪客提供免費咖啡。

sentences.en: A visitor from the head office will meet with the sales team on Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 一位總公司的訪客週四下午會和業務團隊見面。

words.note: 語塊：visitor center（遊客中心）、every visitor（每位訪客）、attract visitors（吸引遊客）。visitor 是「來訪的人」；visit 是動詞或名詞「拜訪」；guest 是「客人」。

sentences.en: Our company will attend a trade fair in Frankfurt next month to show our newest kitchen appliances.
sentences.zh: 我們公司下個月會參加法蘭克福的商展，展示最新的廚房家電。

sentences.en: The international trade fair attracts thousands of buyers who are looking for new suppliers every year.
sentences.zh: 那個國際商展每年都吸引數千位在找新供應商的買家。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee met several new clients at the trade fair and signed two contracts the following week.
sentences.zh: 李小姐在商展上認識了幾位新客戶，隔週就簽了兩份合約。

sentences.en: Please prepare enough brochures and samples for the trade fair, as we expect many visitors at our booth.
sentences.zh: 請為商展準備足夠的小冊子和樣品，因為我們預期攤位會有很多訪客。

sentences.en: The city will host an international trade fair for the food industry at the new convention center.
sentences.zh: 這座城市將在新會議中心舉辦一場食品業的國際商展。

words.note: 語塊：attend a trade fair（參加商展）、international trade fair（國際商展）。trade fair 和 trade show 意思相同；exhibition 是「展覽」。

sentences.en: Ms. Park left her business card with the receptionist and asked the manager to call her back.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐把名片留給櫃台人員，請經理回電給她。

sentences.en: Before the meeting ended, the client gave me a business card with her email address and phone number.
sentences.zh: 會議結束前，客戶給了我一張印有她電子信箱和電話號碼的名片。

sentences.en: If you would like more information, please leave a business card at our booth and we will contact you.
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解更多資訊，請在我們攤位留下名片，我們會聯絡你。

sentences.en: Every new employee receives a business card with the company logo during the first week at work.
sentences.zh: 每位新員工第一週上班時都會拿到一張印有公司商標的名片。

sentences.en: The printing shop can design a business card for you in one day for a very reasonable price.
sentences.zh: 那家印刷店一天內就能以很合理的價格為你設計名片。

words.note: 語塊：left her business card（留下她的名片）、leave a business card（留下名片）、gave me a business card（給我一張名片）、receives a business card（拿到名片）。business card 是「名片」，常用複數 business cards；card 也可以指「卡片；信用卡」。

sentences.en: The company spent three years trying to develop a product that can charge a phone in five minutes.
sentences.zh: 公司花了三年試圖開發一款五分鐘就能充飽手機的產品。

sentences.en: The training program helps employees develop skills in communication, leadership, and teamwork at the office.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫幫助員工培養溝通、領導和團隊合作的技能。

sentences.en: The marketing team will develop a plan to attract young customers through social media next year.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊將擬定一項明年透過社群媒體吸引年輕顧客的計畫。

sentences.en: Scientists at the university are working to develop new medicines for heart disease and other serious illnesses.
sentences.zh: 大學的科學家正在努力開發治療心臟病的新藥。

sentences.en: It takes time to develop good relationships with clients, so please be patient and keep in touch.
sentences.zh: 和客戶發展良好的關係需要時間，所以請保持耐心並持續聯絡。

words.note: 語塊：develop a product（開發產品）、develop skills（培養技能）、develop a plan（擬定計畫）。develop 可以是「開發」、「發展」或「培養」；development 是名詞；developer 是「開發商」。

sentences.en: The new café in the old warehouse has become a trendy place for young people to meet on weekends.
sentences.zh: 舊倉庫裡的新咖啡館成了年輕人週末聚會的時髦地點。

sentences.en: The store sells trendy clothes at low prices, so it is very popular with students.
sentences.zh: 那家店以低價販售時髦的衣服，所以很受學生歡迎。

sentences.en: The neighborhood near the river has become trendy, and many new restaurants have opened there.
sentences.zh: 河邊那個社區變得很新潮，很多新餐廳在那裡開幕。

sentences.en: Many young professionals want to live in a trendy area close to shops, cafés, and public transportation.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕上班族想住在靠近商店、咖啡館和大眾運輸的新潮地區。

sentences.en: The trendy restaurant is fully booked every weekend, so you should make a reservation early.
sentences.zh: 那家時髦的餐廳每個週末都客滿，所以你應該早點訂位。

words.note: 語塊：trendy clothes（時髦的衣服）、trendy restaurant（時髦的餐廳）、trendy neighborhood（新潮的社區）。trendy 是「很流行的」；fashionable 意思接近；trend 是名詞「趨勢」。

sentences.en: The online marketplace allows small businesses to sell their products to customers around the world.
sentences.zh: 那個網路市集讓小企業可以把產品賣給世界各地的顧客。

sentences.en: Companies must keep improving their products to stay competitive in the busy and crowded global marketplace.
sentences.zh: 公司必須不斷改善產品，才能在全球市場上保持競爭力。

sentences.en: The old marketplace in the town center is open every Saturday morning and sells fresh vegetables.
sentences.zh: 鎮中心的舊市集每週六早上開放，販售新鮮蔬菜。

sentences.en: There are many similar products in the marketplace, so our brand must offer something unique.
sentences.zh: 市場上有很多類似的產品，所以我們的品牌必須提供獨特的東西。

sentences.en: Local artists sell their paintings and handmade goods at the marketplace near the harbor on weekends.
sentences.zh: 在地藝術家在港口附近的市集販售畫作和手工製品。

words.note: 語塊：online marketplace（網路市集）、global marketplace（全球市場）、in the marketplace（在市場上）。marketplace 可以是實體「市集」或抽象的「市場」；market 意思接近。

sentences.en: The charity builds schools and provides clean water to villages in developing countries in Asia and Africa.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善團體在開發中國家的村莊蓋學校並提供乾淨的水。

sentences.en: Many companies are expanding into developing markets in Asia and Africa, where demand is growing.
sentences.zh: 很多公司正在拓展到亞洲和非洲需求成長中的新興市場。

sentences.en: The conference will discuss how developing countries can grow their economies without harming the environment.
sentences.zh: 研討會將討論開發中國家如何在不傷害環境的情況下發展經濟。

sentences.en: The bank provides loans to small businesses in developing countries so that they can buy equipment.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行為開發中國家的小企業提供貸款，讓它們購買設備。

sentences.en: Mobile phones have changed the way people do business in many developing countries around the world.
sentences.zh: 手機改變了許多開發中國家人們做生意的方式。

words.note: 語塊：developing country（開發中國家）、developing market（新興市場）。developing 是「正在發展中的」；developed 是「已開發的」。

sentences.en: The company is hiring an administrative assistant who can answer phones, organize meetings, and handle paperwork.
sentences.zh: 公司正在招聘一位能接電話和安排會議的行政助理。

sentences.en: Please contact my assistant to schedule a meeting, as I will be traveling for most of next week.
sentences.zh: 請聯絡我的助理安排會議，因為我下週大部分時間都在出差。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim was promoted to assistant manager after working at the store for three years.
sentences.zh: 金先生在那家店工作三年後被升為副理。

sentences.en: The director's personal assistant manages her calendar and books her flights and hotels for business trips.
sentences.zh: 總監的私人助理管理她的行程，並幫她訂機票和飯店。

sentences.en: Each manager has an assistant who helps with paperwork and answering emails from clients every day.
sentences.zh: 每位經理都有一位助理，幫忙處理文件和回覆客戶的郵件。

words.note: 語塊：administrative assistant（行政助理）、personal assistant（私人助理）、assistant manager（副理）。assistant 是「助理（人）」；assistance 是「協助」；assist 是動詞。

sentences.en: Could you please pass on a message to Ms. Lee that the meeting has been moved to Thursday?
sentences.zh: 可以請你轉告李小姐，會議改到週四了嗎？

sentences.en: Many companies pass on the rising cost of fuel to their customers by increasing prices.
sentences.zh: 很多公司透過漲價把燃料成本上漲轉嫁給顧客。

sentences.en: After you read the report, please pass on the main points to the other members of your team.
sentences.zh: 看完報告後，請把重點轉告給你團隊的其他成員。

sentences.en: The store decided not to pass on costs to customers, even though the price of materials went up.
sentences.zh: 雖然材料價格上漲，那家店決定不把成本轉嫁給顧客。

sentences.en: The manager asked me to pass on her thanks to everyone who helped organize the event.
sentences.zh: 經理請我轉達她對每位幫忙籌辦活動的人的感謝。

words.note: 語塊：pass on a message（轉達訊息）、pass on costs（轉嫁成本）、pass on to（傳給……）。pass on 可以是「轉告」或把成本「轉嫁」給別人；pass away 是「過世」。

sentences.en: All new employees must attend an orientation session on their first day at the company.
sentences.zh: 所有新員工到職第一天都必須參加說明會。

sentences.en: The new employee orientation includes a tour of the office and an introduction to our main products.
sentences.zh: 新進員工說明會包括參觀辦公室和介紹我們的主要產品。

sentences.en: During orientation, students learn about the university's rules and the many services that are available to them.
sentences.zh: 說明會期間，學生會了解大學的規定和可以使用的服務。

sentences.en: The orientation session will last about three hours and will be held in the training room.
sentences.zh: 說明會大約進行三小時，將在訓練室舉行。

sentences.en: Please bring your ID card and a pen to the new employee orientation next Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 下週一早上的新進員工說明會請帶身分證和一支筆。

words.note: 語塊：new employee orientation（新進員工說明會）、orientation session（說明會）。orientation 是「新人的介紹和訓練」；orient 是動詞「使熟悉」；oriental 是「東方的」。

sentences.en: Many small businesses hire an accountant to help them with their taxes at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 很多小企業在年底聘請會計師幫忙處理稅務。

sentences.en: Ms. Park is a certified accountant who has worked at the firm for more than fifteen years.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐是一位在事務所工作了十五年以上、有證照的會計師。

sentences.en: The accountant found several mistakes in the financial report and asked the team to correct them.
sentences.zh: 會計師在財報中發現好幾個錯誤，要求團隊更正。

sentences.en: Please send all of your receipts to the accountant by Friday so that she can prepare your tax return.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前把所有收據寄給會計師，讓她準備你的報稅資料。

sentences.en: The company is looking for an experienced accountant to manage its finances in Asia and Europe.
sentences.zh: 公司在找一位有經驗的會計師管理它在亞洲的財務。

words.note: 語塊：hire an accountant（聘請會計師）、certified accountant（有證照的會計師）、experienced accountant（有經驗的會計師）、send ... to the accountant（寄給會計師）。accountant 是「會計（人）」；accounting 是「會計（工作、學科）」；account 是「帳戶」。

sentences.en: All employees must attend the training session at the main office in Taipei next Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 所有員工下週一早上都必須到台北總辦公室參加訓練課程。

sentences.en: Please contact the main office if you have any questions about your salary or health insurance.
sentences.zh: 如果你對薪水或健康保險有任何問題，請聯絡總辦公室。

sentences.en: The company plans to move its main office to a larger building near the train station next year.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫明年把總辦公室搬到火車站附近一棟比較大的大樓。

sentences.en: Important documents should be sent to the main office rather than to the local branches.
sentences.zh: 重要文件應該寄到總辦公室，而不是當地分公司。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee works at the main office, but she visits the stores in other cities twice a month.
sentences.zh: 李小姐在總辦公室上班，但每個月會到其他城市的門市兩次。

words.note: 語塊：at the main office（在總辦公室）、contact the main office（聯絡總辦公室）。main office 是「主要辦公室」；head office、headquarters 意思接近；branch office 是「分公司」。

sentences.en: All workers must be adequately trained before they are allowed to use the heavy machines in the factory.
sentences.zh: 所有工人在被允許使用工廠重型機器前都必須受過足夠的訓練。

sentences.en: Please make sure that you are adequately prepared for the presentation, as the clients will ask many questions.
sentences.zh: 請確認你為簡報做了充分準備，因為客戶會問很多問題。

sentences.en: The old building was not adequately protected from the storm, so the roof was badly damaged.
sentences.zh: 那棟老建築沒有受到充分的保護，所以屋頂在暴風雨中嚴重損壞。

sentences.en: The report did not adequately explain why the project was so much more expensive than planned.
sentences.zh: 報告沒有充分說明為什麼專案比計畫貴那麼多。

sentences.en: The hotel staff are adequately trained to deal with emergencies such as fires and medical problems.
sentences.zh: 飯店員工受過足夠的訓練，能處理火災和醫療等緊急狀況。

words.note: 語塊：adequately prepared（準備充分）、adequately trained（受過足夠訓練）、adequately protected（受到充分保護）。adequately 是「足夠地、夠好地」；adequate 是形容詞「足夠的」。

sentences.en: Dr. Kim's area of expertise is heart disease, and she has worked at the hospital for twenty years.
sentences.zh: 金醫師的專業領域是心臟病，她在醫院工作了二十年。

sentences.en: The question is outside my area of expertise, so I will ask a colleague from the legal department.
sentences.zh: 這個問題超出我的專業範圍，所以我會去問法務部的同事。

sentences.en: Each consultant at the firm has a different area of expertise, such as marketing, finance, or law.
sentences.zh: 事務所的每位顧問都有不同的專業領域，例如行銷、財務或法律。

sentences.en: Please describe your area of expertise in the application so that we can match you with the right project.
sentences.zh: 請在申請表中描述你的專業領域，讓我們能把你配到合適的專案。

sentences.en: Her area of expertise in online marketing helped the company increase its sales to young customers.
sentences.zh: 她在網路行銷的專業領域幫助公司提高了對年輕顧客的銷售。

words.note: 語塊：one's area of expertise（某人的專業領域）、outside one's area of expertise（超出專業範圍）。expertise 是「專業知識或技能」；area 在這裡是「領域」；field 意思接近。

sentences.en: The new marketing strategy is expected to yield results within the first three months of next year.
sentences.zh: 新的行銷策略預計在頭三個月內就會產生成果。

sentences.en: The investment in solar panels will yield a profit for the company within five years.
sentences.zh: 投資太陽能板將在五年內為公司帶來利潤。

sentences.en: The farm is able to yield crops twice a year because of the warm weather and rich soil.
sentences.zh: 因為天氣溫暖、土壤肥沃，那座農場一年可以收成兩次。

sentences.en: Careful planning and hard work usually yield good results in any kind of business, large or small.
sentences.zh: 周詳的規劃和努力工作在任何生意中，不論大小，通常都會帶來好的成果。

sentences.en: The research did not yield any useful information, so the team will try a different method.
sentences.zh: 那項研究沒有產生任何有用的資訊，所以團隊會嘗試不同的方法。

words.note: 語塊：yield results（產生成果）、yield a profit（帶來利潤）、yield crops（收成作物）。yield 可以當動詞「產出」或名詞「產量；收益」；也有「讓步」的意思（交通標誌 YIELD）。

sentences.en: The region exports agricultural products such as rice, fruit, and tea to many countries in Asia.
sentences.zh: 那個地區把稻米、水果和茶等農產品出口到亞洲很多國家。

sentences.en: Much of the agricultural land near the city has been turned into houses and shopping centers.
sentences.zh: 城市附近很多農地已經變成住宅和購物中心。

sentences.en: The company sells agricultural machinery to farmers across the country and offers free repairs for one year.
sentences.zh: 那家公司把農業機械賣給全國的農民，並提供免費維修。

sentences.en: The government provides support to agricultural workers whose crops were damaged by the storm last month.
sentences.zh: 政府為作物被暴風雨損壞的農業工作者提供支援。

sentences.en: The university has an agricultural research center that develops new ways to grow vegetables and fruit.
sentences.zh: 那所大學有一個開發種植蔬菜新方法的農業研究中心。

words.note: 語塊：agricultural products（農產品）、agricultural land（農地）、agricultural machinery（農業機械）。agricultural 是形容詞；agriculture 是名詞「農業」；architectural 是「建築的」，長得像。

sentences.en: Many employees work out at the gym in the building during their lunch break every day.
sentences.zh: 很多員工午休時間在大樓的健身房運動。

sentences.en: The two companies need to work out a plan for sharing the costs of the new warehouse.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司需要想出分攤新倉庫費用的計畫。

sentences.en: The manager met with the team to work out a problem with the delivery schedule.
sentences.zh: 經理和團隊開會解決配送時程的問題。

sentences.en: It took several weeks to work out the details of the contract, but both sides are now happy with it.
sentences.zh: 花了好幾週才把合約細節談妥，但雙方現在都很滿意。

sentences.en: Doctors recommend that people work out for at least thirty minutes three times a week.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議大家每週至少運動三次，每次三十分鐘。

words.note: 語塊：work out a plan（想出計畫）、work out a problem（解決問題）、work out at the gym（在健身房運動）。work out 可以是「運動」或「想辦法解決」；workout 是名詞「健身」。

sentences.en: The company hopes that the new machines will bring down costs by about twenty percent.
sentences.zh: 公司希望新機器能把成本降低大約兩成。

sentences.en: Competition from online stores has helped bring down prices for electronics such as phones and laptops.
sentences.zh: 網路商店的競爭幫助降低了手機和筆電等電子產品的價格。

sentences.en: The government is taking steps to bring down the cost of housing for young families in the city.
sentences.zh: 政府正採取措施降低城市年輕家庭的住房成本。

sentences.en: Buying in bulk can bring down the price of office supplies for small businesses in the area.
sentences.zh: 大量購買可以降低小企業辦公用品的價格。

sentences.en: The new medicine helped bring down the patient's fever within a few hours of taking it.
sentences.zh: 新藥在幾小時內幫病人退了燒。

words.note: 語塊：bring down costs（降低成本）、bring down prices（降低價格）。bring down 是「讓……下降」；reduce、lower 意思接近；bring up 是「提出」。

sentences.en: All passengers must pass through security before they go to the gate for their flight.
sentences.zh: 所有乘客在前往登機門之前都必須通過安檢。

sentences.en: The train will pass through several small towns before it arrives in the capital this evening.
sentences.zh: 火車今晚抵達首都之前會經過幾個小鎮。

sentences.en: Visitors must pass through the main entrance and show their tickets to the staff at the door.
sentences.zh: 訪客必須通過正門並向工作人員出示門票。

sentences.en: The parade will pass through the city center on Saturday, so several streets will be closed.
sentences.zh: 遊行週六會經過市中心，所以有好幾條街道會封閉。

sentences.en: It can take more than an hour to pass through security at the airport during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 節慶期間在機場通過安檢可能要一個多小時。

words.note: 語塊：pass through security（通過安檢）、pass through a town（經過一個小鎮）。pass through 是「從……穿過」；go through 意思接近；pass by 是「經過旁邊」。

sentences.en: The bank decided to raise the interest rate on home loans by half a percent starting next month.
sentences.zh: 銀行決定從下個月起把房貸利率調高半個百分點。

sentences.en: Many people bought houses last year because the interest rate on loans was very low.
sentences.zh: 很多人去年買房，因為貸款利率很低。

sentences.en: A fixed interest rate means that your monthly payment will stay the same for the whole loan.
sentences.zh: 固定利率表示你的每月還款金額在整個貸款期間都會一樣。

sentences.en: The central bank may lower the interest rate to help the economy grow more quickly.
sentences.zh: 央行可能會調降利率，幫助經濟更快成長。

sentences.en: Before choosing a savings account, compare the interest rate offered by several different banks in your area.
sentences.zh: 選擇儲蓄帳戶之前，先比較好幾家不同銀行提供的利率。

words.note: 語塊：raise interest rates（調高利率）、low interest rate（低利率）、fixed interest rate（固定利率）。interest rate 是「借錢或存錢的利率」；interest 也可以指「興趣」。

sentences.en: Many parents open a savings account for their children so that they can save money for university.
sentences.zh: 很多父母為孩子開儲蓄帳戶，為上大學存錢。

sentences.en: The bank offers a higher interest rate to customers who open a savings account online.
sentences.zh: 銀行為在網路上開儲蓄帳戶的顧客提供更高的利率。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee puts part of her salary into a savings account every month for her retirement.
sentences.zh: 李小姐每個月把一部分薪水存進儲蓄帳戶，為退休做準備。

sentences.en: You can move money from your savings account to your checking account by using the mobile app.
sentences.zh: 你可以用手機 App 把錢從儲蓄帳戶轉到支票帳戶。

sentences.en: Experts recommend keeping enough money in a savings account to pay for six months of expenses.
sentences.zh: 專家建議在儲蓄帳戶裡存足夠支付六個月開銷的錢。

words.note: 語塊：open a savings account（開儲蓄帳戶）、put money into a savings account（把錢存進儲蓄帳戶）、from your savings account（從你的儲蓄帳戶）、in a savings account（在儲蓄帳戶裡）。savings account 是「用來存錢的帳戶」；savings 一定加 s；checking account 是「支票帳戶」。

sentences.en: It took Ms. Lee ten years to build up a business that now has stores in five cities.
sentences.zh: 李小姐花了十年才建立起現在在五個城市都有門市的事業。

sentences.en: Young workers should start to build up savings as early as possible for emergencies and retirement.
sentences.zh: 年輕上班族應該盡早開始累積存款，以備不時之需。

sentences.en: Working part-time while studying helps students build up experience in the workplace before they graduate.
sentences.zh: 邊讀書邊兼職幫助學生在畢業前累積經驗。

sentences.en: Dust can build up inside the machines, so they should be cleaned at least once a month.
sentences.zh: 灰塵可能會在機器裡累積，所以至少每個月要清潔一次。

sentences.en: The company plans to build up its online sales by offering free delivery on every order.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫提供每筆訂單免運費來增加網路銷售。

words.note: 語塊：build up savings（累積存款）、build up a business（建立事業）、build up experience（累積經驗）。build up 是「慢慢增加、建立起來」；buildup 是名詞「累積」。

sentences.en: The old system for ordering supplies was very complicated, so the company introduced a simpler one.
sentences.zh: 舊的用品訂購系統非常複雜，所以公司推出了一個比較簡單的。

sentences.en: Many customers said that the instructions were too complicated and asked for a shorter version.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客說說明書太複雜，要求一個比較短的版本。

sentences.en: Applying for a visa can be a complicated process, so the company helps employees with the paperwork.
sentences.zh: 申請簽證可能是一個複雜的流程，所以公司會協助員工處理文件。

sentences.en: The new software is not as complicated as it looks, and most employees learn it in one day.
sentences.zh: 新軟體沒有看起來那麼複雜，大部分員工一天就學會了。

sentences.en: The tax rules for small businesses are complicated, so many owners hire an accountant to help them.
sentences.zh: 小企業的稅務規定很複雜，所以很多老闆會請會計師幫忙。

words.note: 語塊：complicated process（複雜的流程）、complicated instructions（複雜的說明）、too complicated（太複雜）、very complicated（非常複雜）、not as complicated（沒那麼複雜）。complicated 是「很複雜、難懂的」；complex 意思接近；complicate 是動詞。

sentences.en: The company has limited resources, so it must choose its new projects very carefully this year.
sentences.zh: 公司的資源有限，所以必須仔細挑選專案。

sentences.en: The country is rich in natural resources such as oil, gas, and wood, which it exports to Asia.
sentences.zh: 那個國家擁有豐富的石油、天然氣和木材等自然資源，出口到亞洲。

sentences.en: The human resources department is responsible for hiring and training new employees in every department.
sentences.zh: 人力資源部負責招聘和訓練新員工。

sentences.en: The library offers many free resources for students, including books, computers, and quiet study rooms.
sentences.zh: 圖書館為學生提供很多免費資源，包括書、電腦和自習室。

sentences.en: Small businesses with limited resources often find it difficult to compete with large companies in the market.
sentences.zh: 資源有限的小企業常常覺得很難和大公司競爭。

words.note: 語塊：human resources（人力資源）、natural resources（自然資源）、limited resources（有限的資源）。resources 常用複數，指「可以使用的錢、人力、材料」；resourceful 是「足智多謀的」。

sentences.en: The customer service team is trained to handle complaints from angry customers quickly and politely.
sentences.zh: 客服團隊受過訓練，能快速又有禮貌地處理投訴。

sentences.en: Please handle the boxes with care, as they contain glass bottles that can break easily.
sentences.zh: 請小心處理這些箱子，因為裡面有容易破的玻璃瓶。

sentences.en: The manager stayed calm and was able to handle the situation when the power went out.
sentences.zh: 停電時經理保持冷靜，處理好了狀況。

sentences.en: Our warehouse can handle more than five thousand orders a day during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 我們的倉庫在節慶期間每天能處理五千多筆訂單。

sentences.en: The new assistant will handle all of the travel arrangements for the conference in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 新助理會處理東京研討會的所有行程安排。

words.note: 語塊：handle complaints（處理投訴）、handle with care（小心輕放）、handle the situation（處理情況）。handle 當動詞是「處理」；當名詞是「把手」；handling 是「處理」。

sentences.en: The library has a large collection of periodicals, and each periodical is kept on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 圖書館有大量期刊，每一本期刊都放在二樓。

sentences.en: Dr. Kim's research was published in an academic periodical that is read by doctors around the world.
sentences.zh: 金博士的研究刊登在一本全世界醫生都會閱讀的學術期刊上。

sentences.en: The company publishes a monthly periodical for its customers with news about new products and services.
sentences.zh: 公司為顧客發行一本月刊，介紹新產品的消息。

sentences.en: Students can borrow any periodical from the library for one week, but they cannot take reference books home.
sentences.zh: 學生可以從圖書館借任何期刊一週，但參考書不能帶回家。

sentences.en: The magazine is a popular periodical for people who are interested in cooking and travel.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌是對烹飪和旅遊有興趣的人很喜歡的定期刊物。

words.note: 語塊：academic periodical（學術期刊）、monthly periodical（月刊）、each periodical（每一本期刊）、any periodical（任何期刊）、popular periodical（受歡迎的刊物）。periodical 是「定期出版的雜誌或期刊」；periodic 是形容詞「定期的」；magazine 意思接近。

sentences.en: The research team will gather information from customers by sending them a short online survey.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊會寄一份簡短的線上問卷，向顧客收集資訊。

sentences.en: Employees will gather in the main hall at nine o'clock to hear the CEO's announcement.
sentences.zh: 員工九點會聚集在大廳聽執行長宣布消息。

sentences.en: It took the scientists two years to gather data about the birds that live near the river.
sentences.zh: 科學家花了兩年收集住在河邊的鳥類的資料。

sentences.en: The family likes to gather together for a large dinner during the national holidays every year.
sentences.zh: 那家人每年國定假日都喜歡聚在一起吃一頓豐盛的晚餐。

sentences.en: Before writing the report, please gather all of the receipts and invoices from the last three months.
sentences.zh: 寫報告之前，請收集最近三個月所有的收據和發票。

words.note: 語塊：gather information（收集資訊）、gather data（收集資料）、gather together（聚在一起）。gather 是「聚集、收集」；collect 意思接近；gathering 是名詞「聚會」。

sentences.en: The bank will approve the loan only if the applicant has a stable income from a full-time job.
sentences.zh: 只有申請人有全職工作的穩定收入，銀行才會核准貸款。

sentences.en: Prices for food have remained stable this year, which is good news for families and restaurants.
sentences.zh: 今年食物價格保持穩定，對家庭和餐廳來說是好消息。

sentences.en: A stable economy encourages companies to invest in new factories and hire more local workers.
sentences.zh: 穩定的經濟會鼓勵公司投資新工廠並聘用更多工人。

sentences.en: The patient's condition is now stable, and doctors expect him to leave the hospital next week.
sentences.zh: 病人的狀況現在很穩定，醫生預期他下週就能出院。

sentences.en: The company has been able to keep its prices stable for three years by reducing its costs.
sentences.zh: 公司透過降低成本，三年來一直讓價格保持穩定。

words.note: 語塊：stable income（穩定的收入）、stable economy（穩定的經濟）、remain stable（保持穩定）。stable 是「不會大幅變動的」；stability 是名詞；unstable 是「不穩定的」。

sentences.en: By selling directly to customers online, the farm can cut out the middleman and offer lower prices.
sentences.zh: 透過在網路上直接賣給顧客，農場可以不經過中間商，提供更低的價格。

sentences.en: The company acts as a middleman between small factories in Asia and large stores in Europe.
sentences.zh: 那家公司擔任亞洲小工廠和歐洲大型商店之間的中間商。

sentences.en: Buying from the middleman is more expensive, but it saves time because they handle all of the shipping.
sentences.zh: 向中間商購買比較貴，但能省時間，因為他們處理所有運送。

sentences.en: Many farmers prefer to sell at local markets so that they do not have to pay a middleman.
sentences.zh: 很多農民比較喜歡在當地市場賣，這樣就不用付錢給中間商。

sentences.en: The new app allows customers to book hotels directly without using a middleman such as a travel agency.
sentences.zh: 新 App 讓顧客可以直接訂飯店，不用透過旅行社之類的中間人。

words.note: 語塊：cut out the middleman（不經過中間商）、act as a middleman（擔任中間人）、pay a middleman（付錢給中間商）、using a middleman（透過中間人）、from the middleman（向中間商）。middleman 是「在買賣雙方之間賺差價的人」；broker、agent 意思接近。

sentences.en: Each team member will receive an assignment and must complete it before the meeting on Friday.
sentences.zh: 每位組員都會收到一項任務，必須在週五開會前完成。

sentences.en: The teacher gave the students a writing assignment about a company that they admire and respect.
sentences.zh: 老師給學生一份寫作作業，寫一家他們欣賞的公司。

sentences.en: The journalist is on assignment in Tokyo and will return to the office at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 那位記者正在東京執行採訪任務，月底會回到辦公室。

sentences.en: Ms. Park accepted a new assignment in the marketing department after working in sales for five years.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐在業務部工作五年後，接受了行銷部的新任務。

sentences.en: Please let me know if you need more time to complete the assignment, as the deadline is flexible.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要更多時間完成任務，請告訴我，因為截止日很有彈性。

words.note: 語塊：complete an assignment（完成任務）、writing assignment（寫作作業）、on assignment（出差執行任務）。assignment 是「被分配的工作」；assign 是動詞「指派」。

sentences.en: You are under no obligation to buy anything if you attend the free demonstration this weekend.
sentences.zh: 如果你參加這個週末的免費示範，沒有義務購買任何東西。

sentences.en: Employers have a legal obligation to provide a safe working environment for all of their employees.
sentences.zh: 雇主有法律義務為員工提供安全的工作環境。

sentences.en: The company has an obligation to tell customers about any problems with the safety of its products.
sentences.zh: 公司有義務告訴顧客其產品的任何安全問題。

sentences.en: Landlords have an obligation to repair any problems with the heating or water in their apartments.
sentences.zh: 房東有義務修理公寓暖氣或用水的任何問題。

sentences.en: The free trial lasts for thirty days, and you are under no obligation to continue after that.
sentences.zh: 免費試用為期三十天，之後你沒有義務繼續使用。

words.note: 語塊：be under no obligation（沒有義務）、legal obligation（法律義務）、obligation to（……的義務）。obligation 是「必須做的責任」；obligate 是動詞；oblige 是「使有義務」。

sentences.en: Unemployment is an important economic indicator that shows how well the economy of a country is doing.
sentences.zh: 失業率是顯示經濟表現好壞的重要經濟指標。

sentences.en: Customer satisfaction is a key indicator of the success of our new service in every store.
sentences.zh: 顧客滿意度是我們每家門市新服務成功與否的關鍵指標。

sentences.en: The number of visitors to our website is a good indicator of how popular the new product is.
sentences.zh: 網站的造訪人數是新產品受歡迎程度的好指標。

sentences.en: A red light on the machine is an indicator that the paper tray needs to be refilled.
sentences.zh: 機器上的紅燈是紙匣需要補紙的指示。

sentences.en: Rising house prices are often seen as an indicator of a strong economy in the region.
sentences.zh: 房價上漲常被視為該地區經濟強勁的指標。

words.note: 語塊：economic indicator（經濟指標）、key indicator（關鍵指標）、a good indicator of（……的好指標）。indicator 是「顯示狀況的東西」；indicate 是動詞「指出」；indication 是「跡象」。

sentences.en: Please turn in your expense report to the accounting department by the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 請在週末前把支出報告交給會計部。

sentences.en: Students who turn in their assignments late will lose points unless they have a good reason.
sentences.zh: 遲交作業的學生會被扣分，除非有好理由。

sentences.en: All employees must turn in their old badges before they receive the new ones on Monday.
sentences.zh: 所有員工在週一拿到新識別證之前，必須先繳交舊的。

sentences.en: The manager asked the team to turn in a report about the results of the customer survey.
sentences.zh: 經理要求團隊交一份顧客調查結果的報告。

sentences.en: If you find a wallet in the building, please turn in the item to the security office on the first floor.
sentences.zh: 如果你在大樓裡撿到錢包，請把它交到一樓的保全室。

words.note: 語塊：turn in a report（交報告）、turn in an assignment（交作業）。turn in 是「交出去（給上級或老師）」；hand in、submit 意思接近；turn down 是「拒絕」。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim will take over the role of marketing director when Mr. Lopez retires next month.
sentences.zh: 下個月 Lopez 先生退休後，金小姐將接任行銷總監一職。

sentences.en: A large technology firm plans to take over a small software company based in Berlin.
sentences.zh: 一家大型科技公司計畫收購一家總部在柏林的小軟體公司。

sentences.en: Could you take over the project while I am on vacation for two weeks in August?
sentences.zh: 我八月休假兩週期間，你可以接手這個專案嗎？

sentences.en: The new manager will take over from Ms. Park, who is moving to the office in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 新經理將接替要調到新加坡辦公室的朴小姐。

sentences.en: The son is expected to take over the family business when his father retires next year.
sentences.zh: 兒子預計在父親明年退休時接手家族事業。

words.note: 語塊：take over a company（收購公司）、take over the role（接任職務）、take over from（接替……）。take over 是「接手管理」；takeover 是名詞「收購」。

sentences.en: The research team will collect data from customers through a short online survey next month.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊下個月會透過線上問卷向顧客收集資料。

sentences.en: Passengers can collect their luggage at the end of the hall after they pass through immigration.
sentences.zh: 乘客通過入境審查後，可以在大廳盡頭領取行李。

sentences.en: The company will collect payment from customers when the furniture is delivered to their homes.
sentences.zh: 家具送到顧客家時，公司會向他們收款。

sentences.en: Volunteers will collect old clothes and books for the charity at the entrance of the shopping center.
sentences.zh: 志工會在購物中心入口為慈善團體收集舊衣服和書。

sentences.en: Please collect your name badge at the registration desk before entering the main conference hall.
sentences.zh: 進入會議廳之前，請到報到處領取名牌。

words.note: 語塊：collect data（收集資料）、collect payment（收款）、collect one's luggage（領取行李）。collect 可以是「收集」或「去拿」；collection 是名詞；collector 是「收藏家」。

sentences.en: Mr. Lee and his business partner opened their first restaurant in the city center ten years ago.
sentences.zh: 李先生和他的事業夥伴十年前在市中心開了第一家餐廳。

sentences.en: The company is looking for a strategic partner to help it sell its products in South America.
sentences.zh: 公司在找一位策略夥伴，協助它在南美販售產品。

sentences.en: The hotel decided to partner with local restaurants to offer guests special discounts on dinner.
sentences.zh: 飯店決定和當地餐廳合作，為客人提供晚餐的特別折扣。

sentences.en: Our firm has worked with the same partner in Japan for more than twenty years.
sentences.zh: 我們公司和同一位日本夥伴合作了二十多年。

sentences.en: The two companies became partners after they realized that each partner had skills the other needed.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司發現雙方擁有對方需要的技能後，成為了合作夥伴。

words.note: 語塊：business partner（事業夥伴）、strategic partner（策略夥伴）、partner with（和……合作）。partner 可以當名詞或動詞（partner with）；partnership 是「合夥關係」。

sentences.en: The prospect of working abroad for two years excited Ms. Lee, so she accepted the offer.
sentences.zh: 能到國外工作兩年的可能性讓李小姐很興奮，所以她接受了那份工作。

sentences.en: The sales team will meet with every prospect who visited our booth at the trade fair last week.
sentences.zh: 業務團隊會和上週在商展造訪我們攤位的每一位潛在客戶見面。

sentences.en: Many investors see electric cars as a good prospect because more people want clean transportation.
sentences.zh: 很多投資人認為電動車前景很好，因為越來越多人想要乾淨的交通工具。

sentences.en: The prospect of a long delay at the airport made many travelers decide to take the train instead.
sentences.zh: 機場可能長時間延誤，讓很多旅客決定改搭火車。

sentences.en: Each new prospect receives a free sample and a phone call from a sales representative within a week.
sentences.zh: 每位新的潛在客戶都會在一週內收到一份免費樣品和業務代表的電話。

words.note: 語塊：the prospect of（……的可能性）、a good prospect（好的前景）、every prospect（每一位潛在客戶）。prospect 可以是「未來的可能性」或「潛在客戶」；常用複數 prospects（前景）；prospective 是形容詞「潛在的」。

sentences.en: To the best of my knowledge, the meeting has not been canceled, but I will check with the manager.
sentences.zh: 就我所知，會議還沒取消，但我會和經理確認。

sentences.en: The team will finish the project to the best of their ability, even though the deadline is very tight.
sentences.zh: 即使截止日很緊，團隊也會盡全力完成專案。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, all of the information in this brochure is correct and up to date.
sentences.zh: 就我們所知，這本小冊子裡的所有資訊都是正確且最新的。

sentences.en: Please answer every question on the form to the best of your ability and ask for help if you need it.
sentences.zh: 請盡你所能回答表格上的每個問題，需要時請尋求協助。

sentences.en: To the best of my knowledge, the store will be open on the national holiday next Monday.
sentences.zh: 就我所知，那家店下週一國定假日會營業。

words.note: 語塊：to the best of my knowledge（就我所知）、to the best of one's ability（盡全力）。to the best of my knowledge 是「就我所知」；as far as I know 意思接近。

sentences.en: If the printer does not work properly, please turn it off and call the IT department.
sentences.zh: 如果印表機不能正常運作，請關機並打給資訊部。

sentences.en: All workers must be properly trained before they are allowed to use the machines in the factory.
sentences.zh: 所有工人在被允許使用工廠機器之前，都必須受過適當的訓練。

sentences.en: Employees who meet with clients are expected to dress properly and arrive on time for every meeting.
sentences.zh: 和客戶見面的員工應該穿著得體並準時到達。

sentences.en: Please make sure that the doors are properly locked before you leave the office at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上離開辦公室前，請確認門都鎖好了。

sentences.en: The food must be stored properly in the refrigerator so that it stays fresh for several days.
sentences.zh: 食物必須妥善存放在冰箱裡，才能保鮮好幾天。

words.note: 語塊：work properly（正常運作）、properly trained（受過適當訓練）、dress properly（穿著得體）。properly 是「以正確的方式」；proper 是形容詞「適當的」；correctly 意思接近。

sentences.en: Please send all of your receipts to the accounting department by the fifth day of every month.
sentences.zh: 請在每月五日前把所有收據寄到會計部。

sentences.en: Ms. Park works at an accounting firm that helps small businesses prepare their tax returns.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐在一家幫小企業準備報稅資料的會計師事務所工作。

sentences.en: The company bought new accounting software that makes it easier to track income and expenses.
sentences.zh: 公司買了新的會計軟體，讓追蹤收入和支出更容易。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim studied accounting at university before he started working at the bank as an analyst.
sentences.zh: 金先生大學讀會計，之後才到銀行擔任分析師。

sentences.en: The accounting department will be closed on Friday afternoon for a special training session on taxes.
sentences.zh: 會計部週五下午將因訓練課程暫停服務。

words.note: 語塊：accounting department（會計部）、accounting firm（會計師事務所）、accounting software（會計軟體）。accounting 是「會計（工作、學科）」；accountant 是「會計（人）」；account 是「帳戶」。

sentences.en: Employees must give two weeks of advance notice if they want to take a vacation.
sentences.zh: 員工如果要休假，必須提前兩週通知。

sentences.en: The museum will be closed until further notice because of damage to the roof caused by the storm.
sentences.zh: 因為屋頂被暴風雨損壞，博物館將關閉直到另行通知。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee decided to give notice and leave the company at the end of the month to start her own business.
sentences.zh: 李小姐決定提出辭職，月底離開公司自己創業。

sentences.en: A notice was posted on the bulletin board to tell employees about the new parking rules.
sentences.zh: 公告欄上貼了一則通知，告訴員工新的停車規定。

sentences.en: Prices may change without notice, so please check our website before you place an order.
sentences.zh: 價格可能隨時變動、恕不另行通知，所以下單前請先查看我們的網站。

words.note: 語塊：advance notice（事先通知）、until further notice（直到另行通知）、give notice（提出辭職通知）。notice 可以當名詞「通知」或動詞「注意到」；noticeable 是「明顯的」。

sentences.en: The new work schedule has been posted on the bulletin board in the break room.
sentences.zh: 新的工作時程表已經貼在茶水間的公告欄上了。

sentences.en: Please check the bulletin board every Monday for news about company events and training sessions.
sentences.zh: 請每週一查看公告欄，了解公司活動和訓練課程的消息。

sentences.en: Students can find information about part-time jobs on the bulletin board outside the main library.
sentences.zh: 學生可以在圖書館外的公告欄找到兼職工作的資訊。

sentences.en: Anyone who wants to sell used furniture can post a notice on the bulletin board in the lobby.
sentences.zh: 想賣二手家具的人可以在大廳的公告欄貼一則告示。

sentences.en: The manager posted a thank-you letter on the bulletin board for everyone who helped with the event.
sentences.zh: 經理在公告欄貼了一封感謝信，給所有幫忙活動的人。

words.note: 語塊：post on the bulletin board（貼在公告欄）、check the bulletin board（看公告欄）。bulletin board 是「張貼公告的板子」；notice board 是英式說法；bulletin 是「公告」。

sentences.en: The tailor will take a measurement of your shoulders and arms before making the new suit.
sentences.zh: 裁縫在做新西裝之前會量你肩膀和手臂的尺寸。

sentences.en: An accurate measurement of the room is necessary before we order the new carpet for the office.
sentences.zh: 我們訂購新地毯之前，必須先精確測量房間。

sentences.en: Please write down each measurement in centimeters so that the factory can make the table correctly.
sentences.zh: 請把每個尺寸都用公分寫下來，讓工廠能正確製作桌子。

sentences.en: The engineers use special tools to make sure that every measurement on the bridge is correct.
sentences.zh: 工程師用特殊工具確保橋上的每一個測量都是正確的。

sentences.en: The kitchen designer came to our home to take a measurement of the space for the new cabinets.
sentences.zh: 廚房設計師到我們家，為新櫥櫃丈量空間。

words.note: 語塊：take measurements（量尺寸）、accurate measurement（精確的測量）、unit of measurement（測量單位）。measurement 是名詞「尺寸、測量」；measure 是動詞「測量」或名詞「措施」。

sentences.en: If you are not sure which plan to choose, our staff will be happy to give advice.
sentences.zh: 如果你不確定要選哪個方案，我們的員工很樂意給你建議。

sentences.en: Small business owners can seek advice from experts at the city's business center for free.
sentences.zh: 小企業老闆可以在市政府的商業中心免費向專家尋求建議。

sentences.en: My manager gave me a piece of advice that I still remember: always listen before you speak.
sentences.zh: 我的經理給了我一個至今仍記得的建議：說話之前一定要先聽。

sentences.en: Before you sign the contract, it is a good idea to get advice from a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 簽合約之前，最好先聽聽律師的建議。

sentences.en: The doctor's advice was to rest for one week and drink plenty of water every day.
sentences.zh: 醫生的建議是休息一週，每天多喝水。

words.note: 語塊：give advice（給建議）、seek advice（尋求建議）、a piece of advice（一個建議）。advice 是不可數名詞（不能說 an advice）；advise 是動詞「建議」。

sentences.en: The store will display the newest model of the phone in its window starting next Monday.
sentences.zh: 那家店從下週一起將在櫥窗展示最新型號的手機。

sentences.en: Our newest product is a coffee machine that can make ten different drinks at the touch of a button.
sentences.zh: 我們的最新產品是一台按一下就能做十種不同飲料的咖啡機。

sentences.en: The newest employees will attend a training session on their first day at the company.
sentences.zh: 最新進的員工到職第一天會參加訓練課程。

sentences.en: The hotel's newest restaurant is located on the top floor and offers a view of the whole city.
sentences.zh: 飯店最新的餐廳位於頂樓，可以看到整座城市。

sentences.en: Customers can see the newest products at the trade fair before they are sold in stores.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在商展上看到還沒在門市販售的最新產品。

words.note: 語塊：the newest model（最新型號）、newest product（最新產品）。newest 是 new 的最高級；latest 意思接近。

sentences.en: Customers can browse the website to see all of our products before they visit the store.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以先瀏覽網站，看我們所有的產品，再到店裡。

sentences.en: Many people like to browse the shelves of the bookstore on weekends, even if they do not buy anything.
sentences.zh: 很多人週末喜歡逛書店的書架，即使什麼都沒買。

sentences.en: You can browse online for hotels in the city and compare their prices before you book a room.
sentences.zh: 訂房之前，你可以在網路上瀏覽城裡的飯店並比較價格。

sentences.en: The store has comfortable chairs so that customers can relax while they browse the new books.
sentences.zh: 那家店有舒服的椅子，讓顧客瀏覽新書時可以放鬆。

sentences.en: Please feel free to browse our collection, and let us know if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 請隨意瀏覽我們的商品，有任何問題請告訴我們。

words.note: 語塊：browse the website（瀏覽網站）、browse the shelves（逛書架）、browse online（線上瀏覽）。browse 是「隨便看看、瀏覽」；browser 是「瀏覽器」；brows（眉毛）只少一個 e。

sentences.en: Please make sure that all of the information on the form is accurate before you submit it.
sentences.zh: 送出表格之前，請確認上面的所有資訊都是準確的。

sentences.en: The accountant keeps accurate records of every payment that the company receives and makes each month.
sentences.zh: 會計師對公司的每一筆收付款都有精確的紀錄。

sentences.en: The weather forecast was not accurate, and it rained heavily during the outdoor concert on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 天氣預報不準確，戶外音樂會期間下了大雨。

sentences.en: The new machine is more accurate than the old one, so there are fewer mistakes in production.
sentences.zh: 新機器比舊的更精確，所以生產中的錯誤比較少。

sentences.en: Journalists must check their facts carefully so that the information in their articles is accurate.
sentences.zh: 記者必須仔細查證事實，讓文章中的資訊是準確的。

words.note: 語塊：accurate information（準確的資訊）、accurate records（精確的紀錄）。accurate 是「正確、沒有錯誤的」；accuracy 是名詞；inaccurate 是「不準確的」。

sentences.en: Please read the contract in its entirety before you sign it, as some important details are on the last page.
sentences.zh: 簽約前請把合約全部讀完，因為有些重要細節在最後一頁。

sentences.en: The concert will be broadcast in its entirety on national television at eight on Saturday evening.
sentences.zh: 演唱會將在週六晚上在電視上完整播出。

sentences.en: The report was published in its entirety on the company's website for all employees to read.
sentences.zh: 報告完整刊登在公司網站上，供所有員工閱讀。

sentences.en: The old building will not be torn down in its entirety, as the historic facade will be kept.
sentences.zh: 那棟老建築不會被全部拆除，因為歷史正面會被保留。

sentences.en: The new policy will be explained in its entirety at the staff meeting next Thursday.
sentences.zh: 新政策將在下週四的員工會議上完整說明。

words.note: 語塊：read in its entirety（全部讀完）、broadcast in its entirety（完整播出）、published in its entirety（完整刊登）、explained in its entirety（完整說明）。in its entirety 是「整個、全部」；completely、as a whole 意思接近。

sentences.en: The company hopes to reduce costs by moving its office to a smaller building outside the city.
sentences.zh: 公司希望把辦公室搬到城外一棟比較小的大樓來降低成本。

sentences.en: The restaurant has introduced several changes to reduce waste, such as using smaller plates and recycling food.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳推行了幾項減少浪費的改變，例如使用比較小的盤子。

sentences.en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease and help people live longer and healthier lives.
sentences.zh: 規律運動可以降低心臟病的風險，幫助人們活得更久。

sentences.en: The city plans to reduce traffic in the downtown area by building more bicycle lanes.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫增建自行車道來減少市中心的交通量。

sentences.en: Using energy-efficient lights can reduce the cost of electricity by about thirty percent each year.
sentences.zh: 使用節能燈每年可以減少大約三成的電費。

words.note: 語塊：reduce costs（降低成本）、reduce waste（減少浪費）、reduce the risk（降低風險）。reduce 是「減少」；reduction 是名詞；increase 是相反詞。

sentences.en: Each passenger may bring one piece of hand baggage on the plane, and it must fit under the seat.
sentences.zh: 每位乘客可以帶一件手提行李上飛機，而且必須放得進座位下方。

sentences.en: Please check the hand baggage allowance on your ticket before you pack for the trip.
sentences.zh: 打包行李前，請先確認機票上的手提行李限額。

sentences.en: Liquids in your hand baggage must be in small bottles and placed in a clear plastic bag.
sentences.zh: 手提行李中的液體必須裝在小瓶子裡，並放進透明塑膠袋。

sentences.en: Passengers who carry hand baggage only can go directly to the gate after they check in online.
sentences.zh: 只帶手提行李的乘客線上報到後就可以直接前往登機門。

sentences.en: Your laptop should be packed in your hand baggage rather than in the suitcase that you check in.
sentences.zh: 你的筆電應該放在手提行李裡，而不是託運的行李箱。

words.note: 語塊：carry hand baggage（攜帶手提行李）、hand baggage allowance（手提行李限額）、piece of hand baggage（一件手提行李）、in your hand baggage（在你的手提行李中）。hand baggage 是「隨身帶上飛機的行李」；carry-on luggage 是美式說法；checked baggage 是「託運行李」。

sentences.en: The hospital opened a new pediatric clinic for children who need special care after surgery.
sentences.zh: 醫院為手術後需要特別照護的孩子開設一間新的兒科診所。

sentences.en: Dr. Lee is a pediatric doctor who has worked with young patients for more than twenty years.
sentences.zh: 李醫師是一位照顧年幼病人二十多年的小兒科醫生。

sentences.en: The charity raises money to improve pediatric care in hospitals in rural areas of the country.
sentences.zh: 那個慈善團體募款改善國內鄉村地區醫院的兒童醫療。

sentences.en: Parents can bring their children to the pediatric clinic without an appointment on Saturday mornings.
sentences.zh: 週六早上家長不用預約就可以帶孩子去兒科診所。

sentences.en: The new pediatric ward has colorful walls and toys to help young patients feel more comfortable.
sentences.zh: 新的兒科病房有色彩繽紛的牆壁和玩具，讓年幼病人覺得更自在。

words.note: 語塊：pediatric doctor（小兒科醫生）、pediatric clinic（兒科診所）、pediatric care（兒童醫療）。pediatric 是「兒童醫療的」；pediatrician 是「小兒科醫生」；英式拼法 paediatric。

sentences.en: We would like to thank our customers for their continued support over the past twenty years.
sentences.zh: 我們要感謝顧客過去二十年來持續的支持。

sentences.en: The company expects continued growth in its online sales because more people are shopping from home.
sentences.zh: 公司預期網路銷售會持續成長，因為更多人在家購物。

sentences.en: We wish you continued success in your new position at the head office in New York.
sentences.zh: 祝你在紐約總公司的新職位上持續成功。

sentences.en: The continued rise in fuel prices has forced many airlines to increase the cost of their tickets.
sentences.zh: 油價持續上漲迫使很多航空公司調高機票價格。

sentences.en: Thanks to the continued efforts of our staff, the hotel received excellent reviews again this year.
sentences.zh: 多虧員工持續的努力，飯店今年又獲得了極佳的評價。

words.note: 語塊：continued support（持續的支持）、continued growth（持續成長）、continued success（持續成功）。continued 是「繼續下去的」；continuous 是「不間斷的」；continue 是動詞。

sentences.en: The company sells its products primarily online, although it also has a few stores in large cities.
sentences.zh: 公司主要在網路上販售產品，雖然在大城市也有幾家門市。

sentences.en: The meeting room is primarily used for training sessions, but it can also be booked for interviews.
sentences.zh: 那間會議室主要用來辦訓練課程，但也可以預約來面試。

sentences.en: Sales increased last year primarily because of the success of our new advertising campaign on social media.
sentences.zh: 去年銷售增加主要是因為新廣告活動很成功。

sentences.en: The program is aimed primarily at young people who want to start their own businesses.
sentences.zh: 這個計畫主要是針對想創業的年輕人。

sentences.en: The museum's collection consists primarily of paintings by artists who lived and worked in the region.
sentences.zh: 博物館的館藏主要是住在該地區的藝術家的畫作。

words.note: 語塊：primarily because（主要是因為）、primarily used for（主要用於）、primarily online（主要在網路上）、aimed primarily at（主要針對）、consists primarily of（主要由……組成）。primarily 是「主要」；mainly、mostly 意思接近；primary 是形容詞。

sentences.en: The pilot announced that the plane would land safely at the airport despite the strong winds.
sentences.zh: 機長宣布儘管風很大，飛機會安全降落在機場。

sentences.en: Please drive safely on the mountain roads, especially at night when it is raining or snowing.
sentences.zh: 在山路上請安全駕駛，尤其是下雨或下雪的時候。

sentences.en: All customer data is safely stored on secure servers that are protected by special software.
sentences.zh: 所有顧客資料都安全存放在受特殊軟體保護的伺服器上。

sentences.en: The package arrived safely, and none of the glass bottles inside were broken during the delivery.
sentences.zh: 包裹平安送達，裡面的玻璃瓶在運送過程中都沒有破。

sentences.en: Workers must be trained to use the machines safely before they start working on the production line.
sentences.zh: 工人在開始上生產線工作之前，必須受過安全使用機器的訓練。

words.note: 語塊：arrive safely（平安抵達）、drive safely（安全駕駛）、safely stored（安全存放）。safely 是副詞；safe 是形容詞「安全的」；safety 是名詞。

sentences.en: The new phone is popular with people in the age group between twenty and thirty-five.
sentences.zh: 新手機很受二十到三十五歲年齡層的人歡迎。

sentences.en: The survey asked people in each age group how often they shop online and what they usually buy.
sentences.zh: 調查詢問每個年齡層的人多常在網路上購物、通常買什麼。

sentences.en: Each age group at the summer camp has its own activities and its own teachers.
sentences.zh: 夏令營的每個年齡層都有自己的活動和老師。

sentences.en: The museum offers special tours for every age group, from young children to elderly visitors.
sentences.zh: 博物館為每個年齡層都提供特別導覽，從幼童到年長的訪客都有。

sentences.en: Sales of the new game were highest in the age group of teenagers and university students.
sentences.zh: 新遊戲在青少年和大學生的年齡層中銷量最高。

words.note: 語塊：in the age group（在……年齡層）、each age group（每個年齡層）。age group 是「某個年齡範圍的人」；generation 是「世代」。

sentences.en: The bank has hired more experts to fight cybercrime and protect its customers' personal information.
sentences.zh: 銀行增聘了更多專家打擊網路犯罪，保護顧客的個人資料。

sentences.en: Many small businesses do not know how to protect themselves from cybercrime, so the city offers free classes.
sentences.zh: 很多小企業不知道如何防範網路犯罪，所以市政府提供免費課程。

sentences.en: The police have created a special team that deals only with cybercrime and online fraud.
sentences.zh: 警方成立了一個專門處理網路犯罪和線上詐騙的特別小組。

sentences.en: Cybercrime has increased in recent years because more and more people shop and bank online.
sentences.zh: 近年來網路犯罪增加了，因為越來越多人在網路上購物和處理銀行業務。

sentences.en: Employees should never share their passwords, as this is one of the easiest ways for cybercrime to happen.
sentences.zh: 員工絕對不要分享密碼，因為這是網路犯罪最容易發生的方式之一。

words.note: 語塊：fight cybercrime（打擊網路犯罪）、protect ... from cybercrime（防範網路犯罪）、deals with cybercrime（處理網路犯罪）、cybercrime has increased（網路犯罪增加）。cybercrime 是「透過網路進行的犯罪」；cyber 是「網路的」；hacker 是「駭客」。

sentences.en: Drivers should use caution on the mountain roads because they can be very slippery after the rain.
sentences.zh: 駕駛在山路上應該小心，因為下雨後路面可能非常滑。

sentences.en: Please exercise caution when you open emails from people you do not know, as they may contain viruses.
sentences.zh: 打開陌生人寄來的郵件時請謹慎，因為可能含有病毒。
