sentences.en: The new medicine should be used with caution by elderly patients and people with heart problems.
sentences.zh: 長者和有心臟問題的人使用新藥時應該小心。

sentences.en: The sign near the entrance warns visitors to use caution because the floor is wet.
sentences.zh: 入口附近的標示提醒訪客要小心，因為地板是濕的。

sentences.en: Investors are advised to proceed with caution because the market has been unstable this year.
sentences.zh: 建議投資人謹慎行事，因為今年市場一直不穩定。

words.note: 語塊：with caution（小心地）、exercise caution（謹慎行事）、use caution（小心）。caution 是「小心」；cautious 是形容詞「謹慎的」；caution 也可以當動詞「警告」。

sentences.en: Please report any suspicious activity in the building to the security guard at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 大樓裡有任何可疑活動，請通報櫃台的保全。

sentences.en: The airport was closed for an hour after a suspicious package was found near one of the gates.
sentences.zh: 在一個登機門附近發現可疑包裹後，機場關閉了一小時。

sentences.en: The bank will call you if it notices suspicious activity on your credit card account.
sentences.zh: 如果銀行發現你的信用卡帳戶有可疑活動，會打電話給你。

sentences.en: Many customers are suspicious of emails that ask for their passwords or bank details by email.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客會懷疑要求提供密碼或銀行資料的電子郵件。

sentences.en: The manager became suspicious when the same invoice was sent to the accounting department twice.
sentences.zh: 同一張發票被寄到會計部兩次時，經理開始起疑。

words.note: 語塊：suspicious activity（可疑活動）、suspicious package（可疑包裹）、be suspicious of（懷疑……）。suspicious 可以是「可疑的（事物）」或「起疑心的（人）」；suspect 是動詞「懷疑」。

sentences.en: I am sorry if I called at an inconvenient time, so please let me know when it is better to talk.
sentences.zh: 如果我打來的時間不方便，很抱歉，請告訴我什麼時候比較適合談。

sentences.en: The new meeting time is inconvenient for employees who need to pick up their children from school.
sentences.zh: 新的會議時間對需要去學校接孩子的員工來說不方便。

sentences.en: The location of the new office is inconvenient because it is far from the subway station.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室的位置不方便，因為離捷運站很遠。

sentences.en: We understand that the construction work may be inconvenient for residents, and we apologize for the noise.
sentences.zh: 我們了解施工可能會造成居民的不便，並為噪音致歉。

sentences.en: If the delivery date is inconvenient for you, please call us and we will arrange another time.
sentences.zh: 如果送貨日期對你不方便，請打電話給我們，我們會安排其他時間。

words.note: 語塊：inconvenient time（不方便的時間）、inconvenient for（對……不方便）。inconvenient 是形容詞；inconvenience 是名詞「不便」；convenient 是「方便的」。

sentences.en: Electric cars are becoming increasingly popular as the price of fuel continues to rise around the world.
sentences.zh: 隨著油價持續上漲，電動車越來越受歡迎。

sentences.en: It is becoming increasingly difficult for young families to buy homes in the city center.
sentences.zh: 年輕家庭要在市中心買房變得越來越困難。

sentences.en: Online reviews are increasingly important for small restaurants that want to attract new customers online.
sentences.zh: 網路評論對想吸引新顧客的餐廳越來越重要。

sentences.en: Many workers are increasingly worried about their jobs as companies use more robots in factories.
sentences.zh: 隨著公司在工廠使用更多機器人，很多工人越來越擔心自己的工作。

sentences.en: The museum has become increasingly popular with tourists since it opened its new science exhibit.
sentences.zh: 博物館自從開了新的科學展後，越來越受觀光客歡迎。

words.note: 語塊：increasingly popular（越來越受歡迎）、increasingly difficult（越來越困難）、increasingly important（越來越重要）。increasingly 是「一直變得更……」；more and more 意思接近。

sentences.en: Please send all of your receipts to the finance department by the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 請在月底前把所有收據寄到財務部。

sentences.en: The book offers simple advice about personal finance, such as how to save money and avoid debt.
sentences.zh: 那本書提供簡單的個人理財建議，例如如何存錢和避免負債。

sentences.en: Ms. Park was promoted to finance director after working in the department for twelve years.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐在部門工作十二年後被升為財務總監。

sentences.en: Mr. Lee studied finance at university and now works as an analyst at a large bank.
sentences.zh: 李先生大學讀財務，現在在一家大銀行擔任分析師。

sentences.en: The finance department will review every expense report before employees are paid back for their costs.
sentences.zh: 財務部會在員工拿到報銷款之前審查每一份支出報告。

words.note: 語塊：finance department（財務部）、personal finance（個人理財）、finance director（財務總監）。finance 可以當名詞或動詞「提供資金」；financial 是形容詞。

sentences.en: The security system will stop any unauthorized access to the server room after business hours.
sentences.zh: 保全系統會阻止下班後任何未經授權進入機房的行為。

sentences.en: Unauthorized use of company cars is not allowed, and employees who break this rule may be punished.
sentences.zh: 不得擅自使用公司車輛，違反這項規定的員工可能會受罰。

sentences.en: The sign on the door says that unauthorized personnel are not allowed to enter the laboratory.
sentences.zh: 門上的標示寫著未經授權人員不得進入實驗室。

sentences.en: Please contact the bank immediately if you notice any unauthorized payments on your credit card.
sentences.zh: 如果你發現信用卡上有任何未經授權的付款，請立刻聯絡銀行。

sentences.en: The company installed new cameras to prevent unauthorized entry into the warehouse late at night.
sentences.zh: 公司裝了新的監視器，防止晚上有人未經授權進入倉庫。

words.note: 語塊：unauthorized access（未經授權的進入）、unauthorized use（擅自使用）、unauthorized personnel（未經授權人員）。unauthorized 是「沒有得到許可的」；authorized 是「經授權的」。

sentences.en: The company will issue a statement about the merger at a press conference on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 公司將在週一早上的記者會上就合併發表聲明。

sentences.en: Please check your bank statement every month to make sure that there are no mistakes.
sentences.zh: 請每個月檢查你的銀行對帳單，確認沒有錯誤。

sentences.en: The accountant prepared a financial statement that shows the company's income and expenses for the year.
sentences.zh: 會計師準備了一份財務報表，列出公司全年的收入和支出。

sentences.en: The airline issued a statement to apologize for the long delays that passengers experienced last weekend.
sentences.zh: 航空公司發表聲明，為乘客上週末遭遇的長時間延誤道歉。

sentences.en: You can download your monthly bank statement from the website or ask for a printed copy at a branch.
sentences.zh: 你可以從網站下載每月銀行對帳單，或到分行索取紙本。

words.note: 語塊：issue a statement（發表聲明）、bank statement（銀行對帳單）、financial statement（財務報表）。statement 可以是「聲明」或「對帳單、報表」；state 當動詞是「陳述」。

sentences.en: Before you buy a new laptop, it is a good idea to compare prices at several different stores.
sentences.zh: 買新筆電之前，最好先比較好幾家不同店的價格。

sentences.en: The report will compare sales this year with sales over the past five years in every region.
sentences.zh: 報告會把今年的銷售和過去五年每個地區的銷售做比較。

sentences.en: If you compare the new office with the old one, the new one is much brighter and closer to the station.
sentences.zh: 如果把新辦公室和舊的比較，新的明亮很多，也更靠近車站。

sentences.en: Customers can use the website to compare the features of each phone before they make a decision.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以用網站比較每支手機的功能，再做決定。

sentences.en: It is difficult to compare the two hotels because one is in the city and the other is near the beach.
sentences.zh: 很難比較這兩家飯店，因為一家在市區，另一家在海邊。

words.note: 語塊：compare A with B（把 A 和 B 比較）、compare the features（比較功能）、compare prices（比價）。compare with 和 compare to 常可互換；comparison 是名詞；comparable 是「可比較的」。

sentences.en: Five customers will be randomly selected to win a free vacation at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 月底將隨機選出五位顧客，贏得一次免費度假。

sentences.en: The survey was sent to one thousand randomly chosen people who live in the city.
sentences.zh: 那份調查寄給了一千位隨機挑選、住在城裡的人。

sentences.en: The inspectors will randomly check boxes from each shipment to make sure the products are not damaged.
sentences.zh: 檢查員會從每批貨中隨機抽查箱子，確認產品沒有損壞。

sentences.en: Seats on the bus are not reserved, so passengers may sit randomly wherever there is space.
sentences.zh: 巴士座位不對號，所以乘客可以隨意找空位坐。

sentences.en: The winners of the prize draw will be randomly selected by a computer program on Friday.
sentences.zh: 抽獎的得主將在週五由電腦程式隨機選出。

words.note: 語塊：randomly selected（隨機選出的）、randomly chosen（隨機挑選的）。randomly 是「沒有特定規則地」；random 是形容詞「隨機的」。

sentences.en: I need to reschedule the meeting because I have to visit a client on Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我需要把會議改期，因為週四下午得去拜訪客戶。

sentences.en: Please call the clinic at least one day in advance if you need to reschedule an appointment.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要改約時間，請至少提前一天打電話給診所。

sentences.en: The concert was rescheduled because of the storm, and the organizers will reschedule it for next Saturday.
sentences.zh: 演唱會因暴風雨延期，主辦單位會改到下週六舉行。

sentences.en: The airline will reschedule your flight at no extra cost if your original flight is canceled.
sentences.zh: 如果你原本的航班被取消，航空公司會免費幫你改期。

sentences.en: The manager asked whether we could reschedule the training session for a day when everyone is available.
sentences.zh: 經理問我們能不能把訓練課程改到大家都有空的一天。

words.note: 語塊：reschedule a meeting（會議改期）、reschedule an appointment（改約時間）、reschedule for（改到……）。reschedule 是「把約好的時間改到另一個時間」；postpone 是「延後」。

sentences.en: Please take care to lock all of the doors and windows before you leave the office at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上離開辦公室前，請留意把所有門窗鎖好。

sentences.en: Workers must take care to wear gloves when they handle the chemicals in the laboratory.
sentences.zh: 工作人員在實驗室處理化學品時，必須注意戴手套。

sentences.en: Take care to save your work often, as the old computers sometimes stop working without warning.
sentences.zh: 請留意經常存檔，因為舊電腦有時會毫無預警地當機。

sentences.en: The movers will take care to protect the furniture so that nothing is damaged during the move.
sentences.zh: 搬家人員會小心保護家具，讓搬家過程中沒有東西損壞。

sentences.en: Please take care to write your name and address clearly on the form so that we can contact you.
sentences.zh: 請留意在表格上清楚寫下姓名和地址，讓我們能聯絡你。

words.note: 語塊：take care to（注意要……）。take care to + 原形動詞 是「小心、留意去做」；take care of 是「照顧」。

sentences.en: Please do not throw away any documents that contain customer information without shredding them first.
sentences.zh: 含有顧客資訊的文件，請不要沒先用碎紙機銷毀就丟掉。

sentences.en: The restaurant tries not to throw away food by giving extra meals to a local charity.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳盡量不丟掉食物，把多的餐點送給當地慈善團體。

sentences.en: Before you throw away old electronics, please check whether they can be recycled at the store.
sentences.zh: 丟掉舊電子產品之前，請先確認店裡是否能回收。

sentences.en: Many people throw away clothes that are still in good condition, so the charity collects them.
sentences.zh: 很多人丟掉還很好的衣服，所以那個慈善團體會收集它們。

sentences.en: The office will throw away the old chairs next week, so please take one home if you want it.
sentences.zh: 辦公室下週會丟掉舊椅子，所以如果你想要可以帶一張回家。

words.note: 語塊：throw away any documents（丟掉任何文件）、throw away food（丟掉食物）、throw away old electronics（丟掉舊電子產品）、throw away clothes（丟掉衣服）、throw away the old chairs（丟掉舊椅子）。throw away 是「丟棄」；過去式 threw away；throw out 意思相同。

sentences.en: The property development company plans to build three hundred apartments near the new subway station.
sentences.zh: 那家房地產開發公司計畫在新捷運站附近蓋三百戶公寓。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim has worked in property development for twenty years and has built many offices in the city.
sentences.zh: 金先生從事房地產開發二十年，在城裡蓋了很多辦公大樓。

sentences.en: The property development project will include shops, restaurants, and a large park for the residents.
sentences.zh: 那個建案將包括商店、餐廳和一座給居民的大公園。

sentences.en: Many residents are worried that the new property development will make traffic in the area much worse.
sentences.zh: 很多居民擔心新的房地產開發會讓這一帶的交通變得更糟。

sentences.en: The city has strict rules for property development near the river in order to protect the environment.
sentences.zh: 市政府對河邊的房地產開發有嚴格的規定，以保護環境。

words.note: 語塊：property development company（房地產開發公司）、property development project（建案）、worked in property development（從事房地產開發）、the new property development（新的房地產開發）、rules for property development（房地產開發規定）。property development 是「買地蓋房再出售或出租」；developer 是「開發商」。

sentences.en: The city plans to transform the old factory into a modern art museum with shops and cafés.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫把舊工廠改造成有商店和咖啡館的現代美術館。

sentences.en: Smartphones have transformed the way people shop, and they will transform it even more in the future.
sentences.zh: 智慧型手機改變了人們購物的方式，未來還會改變得更多。

sentences.en: The new manager hopes to transform the small company into one of the leading firms in the industry.
sentences.zh: 新經理希望把那家小公司變成業界的領導企業之一。

sentences.en: The designer was able to transform the dark basement into a bright and comfortable meeting room.
sentences.zh: 設計師把昏暗的地下室改造成明亮舒適的會議室。

sentences.en: New technology can transform agriculture by helping farmers grow more food with much less water.
sentences.zh: 新科技能幫助農民用更少的水種出更多食物，徹底改變農業。

words.note: 語塊：transform A into B（把 A 變成 B）、transform the way（改變方式）。transform 是「徹底改變」；transformation 是名詞；change 是一般說法。

sentences.en: The company built its new factory in an industrial area on the edge of the city near the port.
sentences.zh: 公司把新工廠蓋在城市邊緣靠近港口的工業區。

sentences.en: The store sells industrial equipment such as large machines and tools to factories across the country.
sentences.zh: 那家店把大型機器和工具等工業設備賣給全國的工廠。

sentences.en: The government has introduced strict rules to stop factories from putting industrial waste into rivers.
sentences.zh: 政府推出嚴格規定，禁止工廠把工業廢棄物排進河川。

sentences.en: The old industrial area is being turned into apartments, offices, and parks for local residents.
sentences.zh: 舊工業區正在改建成給當地居民的公寓、辦公室和公園。

sentences.en: The new industrial park will create thousands of jobs for people who live in the surrounding towns.
sentences.zh: 新的工業園區將為周邊城鎮的居民創造數千個工作。

words.note: 語塊：industrial area（工業區）、industrial equipment（工業設備）、industrial waste（工業廢棄物）。industrial 是「和工業有關的」；industrious 是「勤勞的」，意思不同。

sentences.en: Trucks are not allowed to drive on residential streets after ten o'clock at night because of the noise.
sentences.zh: 因為噪音，卡車晚上十點後不准開進住宅區街道。

sentences.en: The new residential building near the park has two hundred apartments and a swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 公園附近的新住宅大樓有兩百戶公寓和一座游泳池。

sentences.en: Many families prefer to live in a quiet residential area that is close to good schools.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭比較喜歡住在靠近好學校的安靜住宅區。

sentences.en: The city will not allow factories to be built in residential areas, so the company must find another site.
sentences.zh: 市政府不允許在住宅區蓋工廠，所以公司必須另找地點。

sentences.en: Prices for homes in the residential area near the river have increased sharply over the past five years.
sentences.zh: 河邊住宅區的房價在過去五年大幅上漲。

words.note: 語塊：residential area（住宅區）、residential building（住宅大樓）、residential street（住宅區街道）。residential 是「供人居住的」；resident 是「居民」；residence 是「住所」。

sentences.en: Applicants must send a copy of their academic transcript along with their résumé and cover letter.
sentences.zh: 應徵者必須寄一份成績單影本，並附上履歷和求職信。

sentences.en: A transcript of the CEO's speech will be posted on the company's website later this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 執行長演講的逐字稿今天下午稍晚會貼在公司網站上。

sentences.en: Students can request an official transcript from the university office by filling out a simple form.
sentences.zh: 學生可以填寫一張簡單的表格，向大學辦公室申請正式成績單。

sentences.en: The reporter read the transcript of the interview carefully before writing the article for the magazine.
sentences.zh: 記者寫文章之前仔細讀了訪談的逐字稿。

sentences.en: Please attach your academic transcript to the scholarship application before the deadline on Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 請在週五截止日前，把成績單附在獎學金申請表上。

words.note: 語塊：academic transcript（成績單）、a transcript of（……的逐字稿）。transcript 可以是學校「成績單」或演講、會議的「逐字稿」；transcribe 是動詞。

sentences.en: Ms. Park asked her former manager to write a reference letter for her application to the bank.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐請前主管為她應徵銀行的申請寫一封推薦信。

sentences.en: All applicants must include at least one reference letter from a previous employer or teacher.
sentences.zh: 所有應徵者都必須附上至少一封前雇主或老師的推薦信。

sentences.en: The professor was happy to write a reference letter for the student, who had excellent grades.
sentences.zh: 教授很樂意為那位成績優秀的學生寫推薦信。

sentences.en: It is polite to ask for a reference letter at least two weeks before you need to send it.
sentences.zh: 至少在需要寄出的兩週前請人寫推薦信是有禮貌的。

sentences.en: The company received a strong reference letter from the candidate's previous employer in Tokyo last week.
sentences.zh: 公司收到那位候選人東京前雇主寫的一封很有力的推薦信。

words.note: 語塊：write a reference letter（寫推薦信）、ask for a reference letter（請求推薦信）。reference letter 是「前雇主或老師寫的推薦信」；letter of recommendation 意思相同。

sentences.en: Please send your résumé along with a short letter that explains why you want the job.
sentences.zh: 請寄出你的履歷，連同一封說明你為什麼想要這份工作的短信。

sentences.en: The hotel offers free breakfast along with free internet access to all guests who book online.
sentences.zh: 飯店為所有網路訂房的客人提供免費早餐和免費網路。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee, along with two other managers, will attend the conference in Singapore next month.
sentences.zh: 李小姐和另外兩位經理下個月會參加新加坡的研討會。

sentences.en: The package will be delivered along with a receipt and instructions for using the product.
sentences.zh: 包裹送達時會附上收據和產品使用說明。

sentences.en: The new phone comes with a charger along with a protective case and a pair of headphones.
sentences.zh: 新手機附有充電器，還有一個保護殼和一副耳機。

words.note: 語塊：along with（連同……）。along with 是「和……一起」；together with 意思相同；當主詞時動詞跟著前面的名詞。

sentences.en: Many customers choose this car because of its practicality, as it has plenty of space for families.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客選擇這款車是因為它的實用性，有足夠空間給家庭使用。

sentences.en: The engineers are testing the practicality of using solar panels on the roofs of all the factories.
sentences.zh: 工程師正在測試在所有工廠屋頂裝太陽能板的可行性。

sentences.en: The designer chose simple furniture for practicality, as it is easy to clean and move.
sentences.zh: 設計師為了實用選擇簡單的家具，因為容易清潔又方便搬動。

sentences.en: Some people question the practicality of the plan because it would be very expensive to build.
sentences.zh: 有些人質疑那個計畫的可行性，因為建造費用會非常高。

sentences.en: The new bag is popular because of its practicality, with many pockets for phones, keys, and wallets.
sentences.zh: 那款新包包因為實用而受歡迎，有很多放手機、鑰匙和錢包的口袋。

words.note: 語塊：the practicality of（……的實用性）、for practicality（為了實用）。practicality 是名詞；practical 是形容詞「實用的」；practice 是「練習；做法」。

sentences.en: The company is hiring an administrative assistant who can answer phones, organize meetings, and handle paperwork.
sentences.zh: 公司正在招聘一位能接電話和安排會議的行政助理。

sentences.en: Doctors often complain that they spend too much time on administrative work instead of seeing patients.
sentences.zh: 醫生常抱怨他們花太多時間在行政工作上，而不是看病人。

sentences.en: The new software will reduce administrative costs by allowing staff to complete forms online instead of on paper.
sentences.zh: 新軟體讓員工可以在線上填表，將降低行政費用。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz handles all of the administrative tasks for the sales team, including booking flights.
sentences.zh: Ruiz 小姐處理業務團隊的所有行政工作，包括訂機票。

sentences.en: The administrative office is on the second floor, next to the human resources department and the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 行政辦公室在二樓，就在人資部旁邊。

words.note: 語塊：administrative assistant（行政助理）、administrative work（行政工作）、administrative costs（行政費用）。administrative 是「行政上的」；administration 是名詞「行政；管理部門」。

sentences.en: All new employees must complete a probationary period of three months before they become permanent staff.
sentences.zh: 所有新員工都必須完成三個月的試用期，才能成為正式員工。

sentences.en: During the probationary period, managers will meet with new employees every two weeks to discuss their progress.
sentences.zh: 試用期間，經理每兩週會和新員工見面討論他們的進度。

sentences.en: A probationary employee does not receive the full benefits package until the end of the first three months.
sentences.zh: 試用期員工要到頭三個月結束後才能享有完整的福利方案。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee passed her probationary period and was offered a permanent position in the marketing department.
sentences.zh: 李小姐通過了試用期，獲得行銷部的正式職位。

sentences.en: The probationary period may be extended if the manager feels that the employee needs more training.
sentences.zh: 如果經理覺得員工需要更多訓練，試用期可能會延長。

words.note: 語塊：probationary period（試用期）、probationary employee（試用期員工）。probationary 是「試用中的」；probation 是名詞「試用期；緩刑」。

sentences.en: The meeting is expected to last for about two hours, so please plan your schedule accordingly.
sentences.zh: 會議預計持續大約兩小時，所以請據此安排你的行程。

sentences.en: The new phone has a battery that can last for two days without needing to be charged.
sentences.zh: 新手機的電池可以撐兩天不用充電。

sentences.en: The festival will last for three days and will include concerts, food stalls, and art exhibitions.
sentences.zh: 慶典將持續三天，有音樂會、美食攤位和藝術展覽。

sentences.en: Good furniture can last for many years if it is cleaned and cared for properly.
sentences.zh: 好的家具如果妥善清潔和保養，可以用很多年。

sentences.en: The sale will last until the end of the month, so customers still have time to buy winter clothing.
sentences.zh: 特賣會持續到月底，所以顧客還有時間買冬季服飾。

words.note: 語塊：last for（持續……）、last long（持久）。last 當動詞是「持續」；lasting 是形容詞「持久的」；last 也可當形容詞「最後的」。

sentences.en: The manager will assign a task to each member of the team at the meeting on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 經理會在週一早上的會議上分配任務給每位組員。

sentences.en: The company decided to assign Ms. Park to the new office in Singapore for two years.
sentences.zh: 公司決定指派朴小姐到新加坡的新辦公室兩年。

sentences.en: The manager will assign each new employee to a senior staff member who will help them during their first month.
sentences.zh: 經理會把每位新員工分配給一位資深員工，在第一個月幫助他們。

sentences.en: Please assign one person from each department to help organize the company's annual holiday party.
sentences.zh: 請每個部門指派一人幫忙籌辦公司的年度派對。

sentences.en: The hotel will assign rooms to guests when they check in at the front desk on the day of arrival.
sentences.zh: 飯店會在客人抵達當天於櫃台辦理入住時分配房間。

words.note: 語塊：assign a task（分配任務）、assign sb to（指派某人到……）、assign rooms（分配房間）。assign 是「分派工作或職位」；assignment 是名詞「任務」。

sentences.en: The company encourages employees to share their ideas, and we strongly encourage everyone to attend the meeting.
sentences.zh: 公司鼓勵員工分享想法，我們也強烈鼓勵每個人參加會議。

sentences.en: The city wants to encourage people to ride bicycles to work by building more bike lanes.
sentences.zh: 市政府想增建自行車道，鼓勵民眾騎腳踏車上班。

sentences.en: Teachers encourage students to read at least one book every month during the summer holiday.
sentences.zh: 老師鼓勵學生暑假期間每個月至少讀一本書。

sentences.en: The manager will encourage the team to take short breaks so that they do not feel too tired.
sentences.zh: 經理會鼓勵團隊稍作休息，以免太累。

sentences.en: We strongly encourage all guests to book their rooms early, as the hotel is usually full in summer.
sentences.zh: 我們強烈建議所有客人提早訂房，因為飯店夏天通常客滿。

words.note: 語塊：encourage sb to（鼓勵某人做……）、strongly encourage（強烈鼓勵）。encourage sb to + 原形動詞；encouragement 是名詞；discourage 是「使氣餒；勸阻」。

sentences.en: The key feature of the new phone is its camera, which takes clear pictures even at night.
sentences.zh: 新手機的主要特色是相機，即使晚上也能拍出清楚的照片。

sentences.en: The latest version of the app includes a new feature that allows users to pay bills online.
sentences.zh: App 的最新版本包含一個讓使用者在線上繳帳單的新功能。

sentences.en: Every car we sell has an important safety feature that stops the vehicle automatically in an emergency.
sentences.zh: 我們賣的每輛車都有一個在緊急時自動停車的重要安全功能。

sentences.en: The magazine's main feature this month is an interview with a famous chef from Paris.
sentences.zh: 這本雜誌本月的主要特輯是一篇對巴黎知名主廚的專訪。

sentences.en: One popular feature of the hotel is the rooftop garden, where guests can enjoy the view of the city.
sentences.zh: 飯店受歡迎的特色之一是頂樓花園，客人可以在那裡欣賞城市景色。

words.note: 語塊：key feature（主要特色）、new feature（新功能）、safety feature（安全功能）。feature 可以是「特色、功能」，也可以當動詞「以……為特色」（The film features a famous actor）。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee was promoted to head of the sales division after working at the company for ten years.
sentences.zh: 李小姐在公司工作十年後被升為業務部門主管。

sentences.en: The company's European division reported higher profits this year because of strong sales in Germany.
sentences.zh: 因為德國的銷售強勁，公司的歐洲分部今年公布了更高的獲利。

sentences.en: The new manager wants a clear division of responsibilities so that everyone knows what to do.
sentences.zh: 新經理想要清楚劃分責任，讓每個人都知道該做什麼。

sentences.en: Each division of the company must submit its budget for next year by the end of October.
sentences.zh: 公司的每個部門都必須在十月底前提交明年的預算。

sentences.en: The research division is working on a new battery that can be charged in only ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 研發部門正在開發一款只要十分鐘就能充飽的新電池。

words.note: 語塊：sales division（業務部門）、division of（……的劃分）。division 是公司裡的「事業部、部門」；department 意思接近；divide 是動詞「分」。

sentences.en: There has been a significant increase in the number of people who work from home since last year.
sentences.zh: 自從去年以來，在家工作的人數顯著增加。

sentences.en: The new factory will have a significant impact on the local economy by creating many new jobs.
sentences.zh: 新工廠將創造很多新工作，對地方經濟產生重大影響。

sentences.en: The company spent a significant amount of money on advertising before the product was launched.
sentences.zh: 公司在產品上市前花了相當大筆錢做廣告。

sentences.en: The report found no significant difference between the two products, so we chose the cheaper one.
sentences.zh: 報告發現兩項產品沒有顯著差異，所以我們選了比較便宜的。

sentences.en: Ms. Park made a significant contribution to the success of the project and received a special award.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐對專案的成功有重大貢獻，獲得了特別獎。

words.note: 語塊：significant increase（顯著增加）、significant impact（重大影響）、significant amount（相當大的量）。significant 是「重要的；數量明顯的」；significance 是名詞；insignificant 是「不重要的」。

sentences.en: The meeting was moved to Thursday at the request of the client, who will be traveling on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 應客戶的要求，會議改到週四，因為客戶週三要出差。

sentences.en: If you would like to make a request for extra towels, please call the front desk at any time.
sentences.zh: 如果你想要額外的毛巾，請隨時打電話給櫃台。

sentences.en: A list of ingredients for every dish on the menu is available upon request from the waiter.
sentences.zh: 菜單上每道菜的成分表如有需要可以向服務生索取。

sentences.en: The manager approved my request for two days off so that I can attend my sister's wedding.
sentences.zh: 經理核准了我請兩天假參加姐姐婚禮的請求。

sentences.en: We received your request for a refund and will send the money to your account within five days.
sentences.zh: 我們收到了您的退款申請，會在五天內把錢匯到您的帳戶。

words.note: 語塊：at the request of（應……的要求）、make a request（提出請求）、upon request（如有需要）。request 可以當名詞或動詞「要求」；request 當動詞時後面直接接受詞（request information），不加 for。

sentences.en: The new building has a bizarre design that looks like a giant shoe, but many tourists love it.
sentences.zh: 新大樓有一個看起來像巨大鞋子的怪異設計，但很多觀光客很喜歡。

sentences.en: It was a bizarre situation when two customers arrived at the same time with the same reservation.
sentences.zh: 兩位顧客帶著同一個訂位同時抵達，真是一個奇怪的情況。

sentences.en: The store received a bizarre request from a customer who wanted to buy every chair in the shop.
sentences.zh: 那家店收到一位顧客的奇特要求，他想買下店裡所有的椅子。

sentences.en: Some people found the movie bizarre, but critics praised it for its creative story and music.
sentences.zh: 有些人覺得那部電影很怪異，但評論家稱讚它故事和音樂很有創意。

sentences.en: The weather has been bizarre this year, with snow in April and very hot days in October.
sentences.zh: 今年天氣很怪，四月下雪，十月又非常熱。

words.note: 語塊：bizarre situation（奇怪的情況）、bizarre design（怪異的設計）、bizarre request（奇怪的要求）。bizarre 是「非常奇怪、不尋常的」；strange、weird 意思接近；bazaar（市集）發音一樣。

sentences.en: The furniture store will hold a clearance sale next weekend, with prices on sofas and tables up to seventy percent off.
sentences.zh: 家具店下週末將舉行清倉拍賣，沙發和桌子最多打三折。

sentences.en: Many customers waited in line for hours on Saturday morning for the end-of-season clearance sale at the department store.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客週六早上排隊好幾個小時，等百貨公司的季末清倉拍賣。

sentences.en: The store decided to hold a clearance sale that will continue until all of the winter clothing has been sold.
sentences.zh: 那家店決定舉行清倉拍賣，持續到所有冬季服飾賣完為止。

sentences.en: Items bought during the clearance sale cannot be returned or exchanged, so please choose carefully.
sentences.zh: 清倉拍賣期間買的商品不能退換，所以請仔細挑選。

sentences.en: The electronics store is having a clearance sale to make room for the newest models of televisions.
sentences.zh: 那家電器行正在舉行清倉拍賣，為最新型的電視騰出空間。

words.note: 語塊：hold a clearance sale（舉行清倉拍賣）、end-of-season clearance sale（季末清倉）。clearance sale 是「把存貨便宜賣掉的大拍賣」；clearance 是「清除；許可」。

sentences.en: The company spent an enormous amount of money on the new factory, but it has already paid off.
sentences.zh: 公司在新工廠上花了大筆錢，但已經回本了。

sentences.en: The concert was an enormous success, and tickets for the next show sold out on the website in less than one hour.
sentences.zh: 演唱會非常成功，下一場的門票在網站上不到一小時就賣光了。

sentences.en: Social media has had an enormous impact on the way companies advertise their products to young customers around the world.
sentences.zh: 社群媒體對公司向全世界年輕顧客廣告產品的方式產生了巨大的影響。

sentences.en: The new shopping center is enormous, with more than four hundred stores, twenty restaurants, and a large cinema.
sentences.zh: 新購物中心非常大，有四百多家店、二十家餐廳和一間大型電影院。

sentences.en: Organizing the international conference required an enormous amount of work from the whole team over six months.
sentences.zh: 籌辦國際研討會需要整個團隊花六個月投入大量的工作。

words.note: 語塊：enormous amount（大量的）、enormous success（巨大的成功）、enormous impact（巨大的影響）。enormous 是「非常大的」；huge、massive 意思接近。

sentences.en: Please share the information about the new schedule with everyone on your team by Friday.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前把新時程表的資訊分享給你團隊的每個人。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee and Mr. Kim share an office on the third floor, so they often work on projects together.
sentences.zh: 李小姐和金先生共用三樓的辦公室，所以常常一起做專案。

sentences.en: The two companies agreed to share the cost of building a new warehouse near the port.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司同意分攤在港口附近蓋新倉庫的費用。

sentences.en: Employees are encouraged to share their ideas for improving customer service with their managers at the weekly meeting on Monday.
sentences.zh: 公司鼓勵員工在週一的週會上和主管分享改善客服的點子。

sentences.en: We will never share your personal information with other companies or organizations without asking for your permission first.
sentences.zh: 沒有先徵求你的同意，我們絕不會把你的個人資料分享給其他公司或機構。

words.note: 語塊：share information（分享資訊）、share an office（共用辦公室）、share the cost（分攤費用）。share 可以當動詞或名詞「份；股份」；shareholder 是「股東」。

sentences.en: The author plans to publish a book about her experience of starting a business in another country.
sentences.zh: 那位作家打算出一本關於她在另一個國家創業經驗的書。

sentences.en: The magazine will publish an article about the new museum in its next issue in March.
sentences.zh: 那本雜誌將在三月的下一期發表一篇關於新博物館的文章。

sentences.en: The research team will publish the results of the study in a medical journal early next year.
sentences.zh: 研究團隊將在明年初於醫學期刊上公布研究結果。

sentences.en: The company will publish its annual report on its website at the end of the month so that investors can read it.
sentences.zh: 公司將在月底於網站上公布年報，讓投資人可以閱讀。

sentences.en: Many young writers now publish their stories online instead of sending them to traditional publishers and waiting for months.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕作家現在把故事發表在網路上，而不是寄給傳統出版社再等上好幾個月。

words.note: 語塊：publish a book（出書）、publish an article（發表文章）、publish the results（公布結果）。publish 是「出版、公開發表」；publisher 是「出版社」；publication 是「出版物」。

sentences.en: The manager wanted to emphasize the importance of safety rules before the workers started using the new machines.
sentences.zh: 經理想在工人開始使用新機器前強調安全規則的重要性。

sentences.en: In her speech, the CEO will emphasize that customer satisfaction is more important than short-term profits.
sentences.zh: 執行長在演講中會強調，顧客滿意度比短期獲利更重要。

sentences.en: The training video tries to emphasize the importance of washing hands often in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 訓練影片試著強調在廚房裡經常洗手的重要性。

sentences.en: Our advertisements emphasize the low price and high quality of the product to attract young families.
sentences.zh: 我們的廣告強調產品的低價和高品質，以吸引年輕家庭。

sentences.en: The report will emphasize that the company needs to reduce costs if it wants to stay competitive next year.
sentences.zh: 報告會強調公司如果明年想維持競爭力，就需要降低成本。

words.note: 語塊：emphasize the importance of（強調……的重要性）、emphasize that（強調……）。emphasize 後面直接接受詞，不加 on（emphasize the point）；名詞 emphasis 才說 put emphasis on。

words.meaning: 不太可能地；出乎意料地

sentences.en: The small bakery became improbably successful after a famous singer posted a photo of its cake online.
sentences.zh: 那家小麵包店在一位知名歌手把它的蛋糕照片放上網後，出乎意料地成功。

sentences.en: Sales of winter coats were improbably high in May because of the unusually cold weather this year.
sentences.zh: 因為今年異常寒冷，五月冬季外套的銷量高得出奇。

sentences.en: The old factory, improbably, became one of the most popular art museums in the whole country.
sentences.zh: 那座舊工廠出乎意料地成了全國最受歡迎的美術館之一。

sentences.en: The new product was improbably successful, even though the company spent very little money on advertising it.
sentences.zh: 雖然公司幾乎沒花錢打廣告，新產品卻出乎意料地成功。

sentences.en: Ticket prices for the final game were improbably high, so many fans decided to watch it at home on television.
sentences.zh: 決賽的票價高得出奇，所以很多球迷決定在家看電視轉播。

words.note: 語塊：improbably high（高得出奇）、improbably successful（出乎意料地成功）。improbably 是「照理說不太可能，但居然……」；improbable 是形容詞「不太可能的」；probably 是「大概」。

sentences.en: Most employees willingly accept the new working hours because they can leave earlier on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 大部分員工欣然接受新的上班時間，因為週五可以早點下班。

sentences.en: The supplier willingly agreed to lower its prices after we promised to place larger orders every month.
sentences.zh: 我們答應每個月下更大的訂單後，供應商欣然同意降價。

sentences.en: Our volunteers willingly help visitors find their way around the museum during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 在忙碌的假期期間，我們的志工樂意幫參觀者在博物館裡找路。

sentences.en: Mr. Tanaka willingly gave up his weekend to finish the presentation for the important client meeting.
sentences.zh: 田中先生自願放棄週末，為重要的客戶會議完成簡報。

sentences.en: The staff will willingly accept extra work during the busy season if they receive a bonus for it.
sentences.zh: 如果有獎金，員工在旺季會樂意接受額外的工作。

words.note: 語塊：willingly accept（欣然接受）、willingly agree（欣然同意）、willingly help（樂意幫忙）。willingly 是副詞；形容詞說 be willing to do（願意做……）；unwillingly 是「不情願地」。

sentences.en: We always keep in stock at least fifty boxes of printer paper so that the office never runs out.
sentences.zh: 我們總是保持至少五十箱影印紙的庫存，讓辦公室永遠不會用完。

sentences.en: The blue jacket you asked about is currently in stock, and we can send it to you tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 你問的那件藍色外套目前有貨，我們明天早上就能寄給你。

sentences.en: If the item is not in stock, our staff will order it for you and call you when it arrives at the store.
sentences.zh: 如果商品沒有現貨，我們的店員會幫你訂，到貨時再打電話給你。

sentences.en: The website shows whether each product is in stock or out of stock before customers place their orders.
sentences.zh: 網站會在顧客下單前顯示每項商品是有貨還是缺貨。

sentences.en: Please check that the parts are in stock before you promise the customer a delivery date for the repair.
sentences.zh: 在答應顧客維修的交貨日期前，請先確認零件有庫存。

words.note: 語塊：keep in stock（保持有庫存）、currently in stock（目前有貨）、out of stock（缺貨）。in stock 是「有現貨」，相反是 out of stock（缺貨）；stock 也是「股票」。

sentences.en: Customers can save as much as forty percent on furniture during the store's anniversary sale this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這週末店慶期間，顧客買家具最多可以省下四成。

sentences.en: Please try to finish as much as possible of the report before the meeting with the director on Monday.
sentences.zh: 請盡量在週一和主任開會前把報告完成大部分。

sentences.en: The new machine can produce as much as twice the amount of the old one in the same amount of time.
sentences.zh: 新機器在相同時間內的產量可以多達舊機器的兩倍。

sentences.en: Using energy-saving lights can help the company save as much as three thousand dollars a year.
sentences.zh: 使用省電燈泡可以幫公司一年省下多達三千元。

sentences.en: The hotel tries to use local food as much as possible, so most of its vegetables come from nearby farms.
sentences.zh: 飯店盡可能使用在地食材，所以大部分的蔬菜都來自附近的農場。

words.note: 語塊：save as much as（省下多達……）、as much as possible（盡可能多）。as much as 後面接不可數或金額（as much as 50%）；可數名詞要用 as many as。

sentences.en: The new library will officially open next Monday, and the mayor will give a short speech at the ceremony.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館下週一將正式開幕，市長會在典禮上簡短致詞。

sentences.en: The company will officially announce the name of its new president at the press conference tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 公司明天將在記者會上正式宣布新總裁的名字。

sentences.en: The smartphone was officially launched in Japan last week and will be available in Europe next month.
sentences.zh: 那支智慧型手機上週在日本正式推出，下個月在歐洲上市。

sentences.en: Although the project is not officially finished, most of the work has already been completed by the team.
sentences.zh: 雖然專案還沒正式結束，但團隊已經完成了大部分的工作。

sentences.en: Mr. Chen will officially start his new job as sales director on the first day of December.
sentences.zh: 陳先生將在十二月一日正式開始擔任業務總監的新工作。

words.note: 語塊：officially open（正式開幕）、officially announce（正式宣布）、officially launch（正式推出）。officially 是「正式、經官方確認地」；official 是形容詞「正式的」或名詞「官員」。

sentences.en: The company plans to relocate to a bigger building downtown because the current office is too crowded.
sentences.zh: 公司打算搬到市中心較大的大樓，因為目前的辦公室太擠了。

sentences.en: We will relocate the office during the holiday weekend so that the move does not affect our customers.
sentences.zh: 我們會在連假期間搬遷辦公室，以免搬家影響到顧客。

sentences.en: The firm offered to pay all moving costs for employees who agreed to relocate to the new branch in Osaka.
sentences.zh: 公司提議為同意調到大阪新分公司的員工支付所有搬家費用。

sentences.en: Many factories decided to relocate to areas where land is cheaper and workers are easier to find.
sentences.zh: 很多工廠決定遷到土地較便宜、也比較容易找到工人的地區。

sentences.en: The manager asked whether we would be willing to relocate employees from the main office to the new factory.
sentences.zh: 經理問我們是否願意把員工從總公司調派到新工廠。

words.note: 語塊：relocate to（搬遷到……）、relocate the office（搬遷辦公室）、relocate employees（調派員工）。relocate 多指公司、工廠或員工「遷到別的地方」；relocation 是名詞；move 是比較口語的說法。

sentences.en: The company cafeteria now offers a healthy diet with more vegetables, fish, and fruit for its employees.
sentences.zh: 公司餐廳現在為員工提供有更多蔬菜、魚和水果的健康飲食。

sentences.en: Doctors say that regular exercise and enough sleep are important parts of a healthy lifestyle for office workers.
sentences.zh: 醫生說，規律運動和充足睡眠是上班族健康生活方式的重要部分。

sentences.en: A healthy economy usually creates more jobs and gives people more money to spend on travel and shopping.
sentences.zh: 健全的經濟通常會創造更多工作，讓人們有更多錢花在旅遊和購物上。

sentences.en: The gym will hold free classes to help members keep a healthy lifestyle during the busy holiday season.
sentences.zh: 健身房會開免費課程，幫助會員在忙碌的假期期間維持健康的生活方式。

sentences.en: Our new menu includes several healthy options for customers who want to eat less sugar and salt.
sentences.zh: 我們的新菜單有好幾個健康的選擇，給想少吃糖和鹽的顧客。

words.note: 語塊：healthy diet（健康的飲食）、healthy lifestyle（健康的生活方式）、healthy economy（健全的經濟）。healthy 是「健康的；對健康有益的」；health 是名詞；healthful 意思接近但較少用。

sentences.en: The subway is the most popular means of transportation for people who work in the city center.
sentences.zh: 地鐵是在市中心上班的人最常用的交通工具。

sentences.en: Credit cards are the most common means of payment at our store, but we also accept cash.
sentences.zh: 信用卡是我們店裡最常見的付款方式，但我們也收現金。

sentences.en: The company communicates with its overseas offices by means of video calls every Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 公司每週二早上藉由視訊通話和海外辦公室聯絡。

sentences.en: The bike-sharing program offers a cheap and healthy means of transportation for students and office workers.
sentences.zh: 共享單車計畫為學生和上班族提供便宜又健康的交通工具。

sentences.en: Online banking has become an important means of payment for small businesses that sell their products online.
sentences.zh: 網路銀行已經成為在網路上賣東西的小公司重要的付款方式。

words.note: 語塊：means of transportation（交通工具）、means of payment（付款方式）、by means of（藉由……）。means 單複數同形（a means / many means）；mean 是動詞「意思是」，meaning 是「意思」。

sentences.en: The government started a new program to reduce childhood obesity by offering healthier lunches at schools.
sentences.zh: 政府開始一個新計畫，在學校提供更健康的午餐來減少兒童肥胖。

sentences.en: Experts say that the obesity rate has increased because many people spend most of the day sitting at desks.
sentences.zh: 專家說肥胖率上升，是因為很多人一天大部分時間都坐在桌前。

sentences.en: The health campaign aims to reduce obesity by encouraging people to walk at least thirty minutes every day.
sentences.zh: 這個健康宣導活動希望藉由鼓勵民眾每天至少走三十分鐘來減少肥胖。

sentences.en: Childhood obesity has become a serious problem in many countries where children eat a lot of fast food.
sentences.zh: 在很多孩子吃很多速食的國家，兒童肥胖已經變成嚴重的問題。

sentences.en: The report compared the obesity rate in different cities and found that people in large cities walk more.
sentences.zh: 報告比較了不同城市的肥胖率，發現大城市的人走比較多路。

words.note: 語塊：childhood obesity（兒童肥胖）、reduce obesity（減少肥胖）、obesity rate（肥胖率）。obesity 是名詞；形容詞是 obese（肥胖的）；overweight 是「過重」，程度比較輕。

sentences.en: According to company policy, all employees must wear their ID cards at all times while they are in the building.
sentences.zh: 依照公司規定，所有員工在大樓裡都必須隨時配戴識別證。

sentences.en: Our return policy allows customers to return any item within thirty days if they keep the receipt.
sentences.zh: 我們的退貨政策允許顧客在三十天內退回任何商品，只要保留收據。

sentences.en: Please read your insurance policy carefully before you sign it, especially the part about what is not covered.
sentences.zh: 簽名前請仔細閱讀你的保單，特別是不給付的部分。

sentences.en: The new policy on working from home will take effect at the beginning of next month for all departments.
sentences.zh: 新的在家工作規定將在下個月初對所有部門生效。

sentences.en: Customers complained that the store's return policy was too strict, so the manager decided to change it.
sentences.zh: 顧客抱怨那家店的退貨政策太嚴格，所以經理決定修改。

words.note: 語塊：company policy（公司規定）、return policy（退貨政策）、insurance policy（保單）。policy 是組織訂的「規定、方針」；politics 是「政治」；police 是「警察」。

sentences.en: Only trained workers are allowed to operate the machine, so new staff must complete the safety course first.
sentences.zh: 只有受過訓練的工人可以操作那台機器，所以新員工必須先完成安全課程。

sentences.en: Ms. Ortiz has been able to operate a successful business in the city for more than twenty years.
sentences.zh: 奧蒂茲女士在這個城市成功經營事業已經二十多年了。

sentences.en: The new software will help the warehouse operate smoothly even during the busiest months of the year.
sentences.zh: 新軟體會幫助倉庫在一年中最忙的幾個月也能順利運作。

sentences.en: The airline plans to operate ten more flights between Taipei and Tokyo starting next spring.
sentences.zh: 航空公司計畫從明年春天開始，在台北和東京之間多營運十個航班。

sentences.en: The factory will continue to operate during the holiday, although fewer workers will be on duty.
sentences.zh: 工廠在假期期間會繼續運作，不過值班的工人會比較少。

words.note: 語塊：operate a machine（操作機器）、operate a business（經營事業）、operate smoothly（順利運作）。operate 可以是「操作機器」也可以是「經營、營運」；operation 是名詞；operator 是「操作員」。

sentences.en: Workers who operate heavy machinery must wear helmets and safety boots at all times on the construction site.
sentences.zh: 操作重型機械的工人在工地必須隨時戴安全帽和穿安全靴。

sentences.en: The company sells farm machinery to customers in more than thirty countries around the world.
sentences.zh: 那家公司把農業機械賣給全世界三十多個國家的客戶。

sentences.en: Only certified staff are allowed to operate the machinery in the factory, so training is required.
sentences.zh: 只有持證員工可以操作工廠裡的機械，所以必須受訓。

sentences.en: The factory spent millions of dollars on new machinery to increase production and reduce costs.
sentences.zh: 工廠花了數百萬元買新機械，以提高產量並降低成本。

sentences.en: The heavy machinery will be moved to the new site by truck next week, so the road may be closed.
sentences.zh: 重型機械下週會用卡車運到新工地，所以道路可能會封閉。

words.note: 語塊：heavy machinery（重型機械）、farm machinery（農業機械）、operate machinery（操作機械）。machinery 是不可數名詞，指「機器的總稱」；單一台機器要說 a machine。

sentences.en: The supplier asked for a contract renegotiation because the price of raw materials has increased sharply.
sentences.zh: 供應商因為原料價格大漲而要求重新談判合約。

sentences.en: The union decided to call for renegotiation of the agreement after the company announced lower bonuses.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布降低獎金後，工會決定要求重新談判協議。

sentences.en: The contract renegotiation took three months, but both companies were satisfied with the final result.
sentences.zh: 合約重新談判花了三個月，但兩家公司對最後的結果都很滿意。

sentences.en: Our lawyers will handle the renegotiation of the lease with the building owner next month.
sentences.zh: 我們的律師下個月會處理跟大樓業主重新談判租約的事。

sentences.en: If sales continue to fall, the company may call for renegotiation of its agreements with several suppliers.
sentences.zh: 如果銷售持續下滑，公司可能會要求跟好幾家供應商重新談判協議。

words.note: 語塊：contract renegotiation（合約重新談判）、call for renegotiation（要求重新談判）。renegotiation 是名詞；動詞是 renegotiate；negotiation 是「談判」。

sentences.en: The team finally managed to succeed in finishing the project before the deadline despite many problems.
sentences.zh: 儘管問題很多，團隊最後還是成功在期限前完成了專案。

sentences.en: Ms. Wong will succeed Mr. Lee as president of the company when he retires at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 李先生年底退休後，王小姐將接替他擔任公司總裁。

sentences.en: Small businesses can succeed in a competitive market if they offer excellent service to their customers.
sentences.zh: 小公司只要提供顧客很好的服務，就能在競爭激烈的市場中成功。

sentences.en: The new manager hopes to succeed in reducing costs without cutting the salaries of any employees.
sentences.zh: 新經理希望在不減任何員工薪水的情況下成功降低成本。

sentences.en: Nobody knows who will succeed the current director as head of the research department next year.
sentences.zh: 沒有人知道明年誰會接替現任主任擔任研發部主管。

words.note: 語塊：succeed in（在……成功）、succeed sb as（接替某人擔任……）。succeed in + V-ing 是「成功做到」；succeed sb 是「接任某人」；success 是名詞，successful 是形容詞。

sentences.en: The supplier has a contractual obligation to deliver all materials to the factory by the end of each month.
sentences.zh: 供應商有合約義務在每個月底前把所有材料送到工廠。

sentences.en: Both companies signed a contractual agreement that explains how the profits will be shared between them.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司簽了一份合約協議，說明利潤要如何分配。

sentences.en: Please read the contractual terms carefully before you agree to work with the new advertising agency.
sentences.zh: 在同意和新廣告公司合作前，請仔細閱讀合約條款。

sentences.en: If the builder fails to meet its contractual obligations, the client may ask for compensation.
sentences.zh: 如果建商沒有履行合約義務，客戶可以要求賠償。

sentences.en: The lawyer explained the contractual details to the new employees during the first day of training.
sentences.zh: 律師在訓練第一天向新員工說明了合約細節。

words.note: 語塊：contractual obligation（合約義務）、contractual agreement（合約協議）、contractual terms（合約條款）。contractual 是 contract（合約）的形容詞；contractor 是「承包商」。

sentences.en: After two weeks of discussion, the two companies finally reached an agreement on the price of the land.
sentences.zh: 經過兩週的討論，兩家公司終於就土地價格達成協議。

sentences.en: The hotel and the travel agency will sign an agreement to offer special prices to tour groups.
sentences.zh: 飯店和旅行社將簽訂協議，為旅行團提供特別價格。

sentences.en: All of the board members were in agreement that the company should open a new branch in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 所有董事會成員都一致同意公司應該在新加坡開新分公司。

sentences.en: The new agreement allows employees to work from home two days a week if their managers approve.
sentences.zh: 新協議允許員工在主管同意下一週在家工作兩天。

sentences.en: The workers and the managers could not reach an agreement on salaries, so the talks will continue.
sentences.zh: 工人和管理階層在薪水上無法達成協議，所以談判會繼續。

words.note: 語塊：reach an agreement（達成協議）、sign an agreement（簽訂協議）、in agreement（意見一致）。agreement 是名詞；動詞是 agree（agree to + 事、agree with + 人）。

sentences.en: The contract must stipulate that the building must be completed before the end of next year.
sentences.zh: 合約規定大樓必須在明年底前完工。

sentences.en: The rules clearly stipulate that employees must not share customer information with anyone outside the company.
sentences.zh: 規則明確規定員工不得把顧客資料分享給公司外的任何人。

sentences.en: The agreement will stipulate that the supplier pays a fine if the materials arrive more than a week late.
sentences.zh: 協議會規定如果材料晚到超過一週，供應商要付罰款。

sentences.en: Most leases stipulate that tenants must give the owner at least one month's notice before they move out.
sentences.zh: 大部分租約都規定房客搬走前至少要提前一個月通知屋主。

sentences.en: The law will clearly stipulate that all restaurants must display the prices of their dishes on the menu.
sentences.zh: 法律將明確規定所有餐廳都必須在菜單上標示菜的價格。

words.note: 語塊：stipulate that（規定……）、clearly stipulate（明確規定）。stipulate 多用在合約、法律「明訂條件」；stipulation 是名詞；specify 意思接近。

sentences.en: Mr. Park decided to establish a company that makes eco-friendly packaging for restaurants and cafés.
sentences.zh: 朴先生決定創立一家為餐廳和咖啡廳製作環保包裝的公司。

sentences.en: It takes time to establish a relationship of trust with new clients, so please be patient and polite.
sentences.zh: 和新客戶建立信任關係需要時間，所以請耐心且有禮貌。

sentences.en: The firm is now well established in Europe and plans to establish its first office in Asia next year.
sentences.zh: 那家公司現在在歐洲根基穩固，打算明年在亞洲設立第一間辦公室。

sentences.en: The government will establish a new fund to help small businesses that were hurt by the storm.
sentences.zh: 政府將設立一個新基金，幫助受到暴風雨影響的小企業。

sentences.en: Our goal this year is to establish a relationship with at least three major hotel chains in Japan.
sentences.zh: 我們今年的目標是和日本至少三家大型連鎖飯店建立關係。

words.note: 語塊：establish a company（創立公司）、establish a relationship（建立關係）、well established（根基穩固的）。establish 是「創立、建立」；established 當形容詞是「已建立的、知名的」；establishment 是名詞。

sentences.en: Many young customers have shown great interest in the new electric bicycles that we started selling in May.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕顧客對我們五月開始賣的新電動自行車表現出很大的興趣。

sentences.en: The bank raised its interest rate on home loans, so many families are now waiting before buying a house.
sentences.zh: 銀行調高了房貸利率，所以很多家庭現在暫緩買房。

sentences.en: In the interest of safety, all visitors must wear a helmet when they enter the construction area.
sentences.zh: 為了安全起見，所有訪客進入工地區域時都必須戴安全帽。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen expressed interest in the marketing position and sent her résumé to the human resources department.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐對行銷職位表示有興趣，並把履歷寄給人資部門。

sentences.en: Customers who pay their bill late will be charged interest at a rate of two percent per month.
sentences.zh: 延遲付款的顧客會被收取每月百分之二的利息。

words.note: 語塊：interest in（對……的興趣）、interest rate（利率）、in the interest of（為了……的利益）。interest 有「興趣」和「利息」兩個常考意思；interested 是「感興趣的（人）」，interesting 是「有趣的（事物）」。

sentences.en: Ms. Yamada took the initiative to organize a training session for the new employees in her department.
sentences.zh: 山田小姐主動為她部門的新員工安排了一場訓練課程。

sentences.en: The company launched a new initiative to reduce plastic waste in all of its offices and factories.
sentences.zh: 公司推出一項新措施，要減少所有辦公室和工廠的塑膠廢棄物。

sentences.en: Mr. Lopez called the client on his own initiative and solved the problem before the manager even knew about it.
sentences.zh: 羅培茲先生主動打電話給客戶，在經理知道之前就解決了問題。

sentences.en: The city's new initiative encourages residents to grow vegetables in community gardens near their homes.
sentences.zh: 市政府的新措施鼓勵居民在家附近的社區菜園種菜。

sentences.en: Managers are looking for staff who can take the initiative and suggest better ways of working.
sentences.zh: 主管在找能主動提出更好工作方式的員工。

words.note: 語塊：take the initiative（主動）、new initiative（新措施）、on one's own initiative（主動地）。initiative 可以是公司推出的「新計畫、措施」，也可以是個人的「主動性」；initial 是「最初的」。

sentences.en: The sales team will meet several potential customers at the trade show in Singapore next month.
sentences.zh: 業務團隊下個月會在新加坡的展覽上和幾位潛在顧客見面。

sentences.en: Before we sign the contract, our lawyer will check the document for any potential problem.
sentences.zh: 簽約前，我們的律師會檢查文件裡有沒有可能的問題。

sentences.en: The report explains the potential risk of opening a new store in an area with very few residents.
sentences.zh: 報告說明在居民很少的地區開新店的潛在風險。

sentences.en: The company sends free samples to potential customers so that they can try the product before buying it.
sentences.zh: 公司寄免費樣品給潛在顧客，讓他們在購買前可以試用。

sentences.en: Engineers tested the bridge carefully to find any potential problem before it opened to the public.
sentences.zh: 工程師在橋開放給大眾前仔細測試，找出任何可能的問題。

words.note: 語塊：potential customer（潛在顧客）、potential problem（可能的問題）、potential risk（潛在風險）。potential 可以當形容詞「潛在的」或名詞「潛力」（have great potential）；potent 是「強效的」。

sentences.en: As a reward for their hard work, all employees will receive an extra day off at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 作為辛勤工作的獎勵，所有員工在年底都會多一天假。

sentences.en: Members of our reward program earn points every time they buy something at any of our stores.
sentences.zh: 我們獎勵方案的會員每次在任何一家分店消費都能賺點數。

sentences.en: Many people choose this job not only for the financial reward but also because they enjoy helping others.
sentences.zh: 很多人選這份工作不只是為了金錢報酬，也是因為喜歡幫助別人。

sentences.en: The manager gave the team a dinner at a nice restaurant as a reward for finishing the project early.
sentences.zh: 經理請團隊去好餐廳吃晚餐，作為提早完成專案的獎勵。

sentences.en: Customers who join the reward program before Friday will receive a free coffee on their next visit.
sentences.zh: 週五前加入獎勵方案的顧客下次光臨時可以得到一杯免費咖啡。

words.note: 語塊：as a reward for（作為……的獎勵）、reward program（獎勵方案）、financial reward（金錢報酬）。reward 可以當名詞或動詞（reward sb for sth）；award 是「頒發的獎項」，比較正式。

sentences.en: Last month, the company received a job application from more than three hundred people for the new marketing position.
sentences.zh: 公司上個月收到三百多人應徵新行銷職位的求職申請。

sentences.en: Please submit an application with your résumé and two reference letters by the end of this week.
sentences.zh: 請在本週末前提交申請，附上履歷和兩封推薦信。

sentences.en: All visitors must fill out an application form at the front desk before they receive a building pass.
sentences.zh: 所有訪客都必須先在櫃台填申請表，才能拿到大樓通行證。

sentences.en: Our new mobile application allows customers to check their account balance and pay bills at any time.
sentences.zh: 我們新的手機應用程式讓顧客隨時查詢帳戶餘額和繳帳單。

sentences.en: If you need help completing the application form, please call our customer service center between nine and five on weekdays.
sentences.zh: 如果你填寫申請表需要協助，請在平日九點到五點之間打電話給我們的客服中心。

words.note: 語塊：job application（求職申請）、submit an application（提交申請）、application form（申請表）。application 是「申請」或「應用程式（app）」；apply 是動詞（apply for a job）；applicant 是「申請人」。

sentences.en: We will send a technician to your office tomorrow morning to fix the air conditioner in the meeting room.
sentences.zh: 我們明天早上會派技術人員到你的辦公室修會議室的冷氣。

sentences.en: The repair technician said that the printer needs a new part, which will arrive on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 維修技術人員說印表機需要一個新零件，週四會到貨。

sentences.en: The hospital is hiring a lab technician who has at least three years of experience with medical tests.
sentences.zh: 醫院在招聘一位至少有三年醫學檢驗經驗的實驗室技術員。

sentences.en: A technician checks all of the machines in the factory every Monday to make sure they work properly.
sentences.zh: 每週一都有技術人員檢查工廠所有的機器，確保運作正常。

sentences.en: If the problem continues, please call us again and we will send a technician as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 如果問題持續，請再打給我們，我們會盡快派技術人員過去。

words.note: 語塊：repair technician（維修技術人員）、lab technician（實驗室技術員）、send a technician（派技術人員）。technician 是做實際技術工作的人；technique 是「技巧」；technology 是「科技」。

sentences.en: Please install the new software on your computer before the training session starts on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 請在週一早上訓練課程開始前把新軟體安裝到你的電腦上。

sentences.en: The workers will install new equipment in the kitchen next week, so the restaurant will close for two days.
sentences.zh: 工人下週會在廚房安裝新設備，所以餐廳會休息兩天。

sentences.en: We will have a technician install new security cameras at every entrance of the building because of the break-in last month.
sentences.zh: 因為上個月發生闖入事件，我們會請技術人員在大樓每個入口裝新的監視器。

sentences.en: The technician needed only an hour to install the new air conditioner in the conference room.
sentences.zh: 技術人員只花了一個小時就在會議室裝好新的冷氣。

sentences.en: It is not difficult to install the software yourself, but you can call our support team if you need help.
sentences.zh: 自己安裝軟體並不難，但如果需要協助可以打電話給我們的支援團隊。

words.note: 語塊：install software（安裝軟體）、install equipment（安裝設備）、have sth installed（請人安裝）。install 是「安裝」；installation 是名詞「安裝」；installment 是「分期付款」，很容易搞混。

sentences.en: Please click the link in the e-mail to activate your account before you log in for the first time.
sentences.zh: 第一次登入前，請點擊電子郵件裡的連結來啟用你的帳戶。

sentences.en: You must call the bank to activate your card before you can use it in stores or online.
sentences.zh: 你必須先打電話給銀行開卡，才能在店裡或網路上使用。

sentences.en: The last person to leave the office each evening must activate the alarm and lock the front door.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上最後離開辦公室的人必須啟動警報器並鎖上前門。

sentences.en: Customers can now activate their new phone online without visiting one of our stores or waiting in a long line.
sentences.zh: 顧客現在不用到我們的門市、也不用排長長的隊，就能在線上啟用新手機。

sentences.en: If you forget to activate the alarm, the security company will call you to remind you.
sentences.zh: 如果你忘了啟動警報器，保全公司會打電話提醒你。

words.note: 語塊：activate an account（啟用帳戶）、activate a card（開卡）、activate the alarm（啟動警報器）。activate 是「啟用、使開始運作」；active 是「活躍的」；activity 是「活動」。

sentences.en: The energy company will build a solar plant in the desert that can provide electricity for fifty thousand homes.
sentences.zh: 能源公司將在沙漠裡蓋一座能供應五萬戶用電的太陽能發電廠。

sentences.en: The solar plant project was delayed for six months because the company could not find enough land.
sentences.zh: 因為公司找不到足夠的土地，太陽能電廠專案延後了六個月。

sentences.en: Local residents supported the plan to build a solar plant because it will create jobs and clean energy.
sentences.zh: 當地居民支持蓋太陽能發電廠的計畫，因為它會創造工作和乾淨能源。

sentences.en: Engineers from Germany will visit the solar plant next week to check whether the panels are working properly.
sentences.zh: 德國的工程師下週會參觀太陽能發電廠，檢查太陽能板是否運作正常。

sentences.en: The solar plant project is expected to reduce the city's electricity costs by about twenty percent.
sentences.zh: 這個太陽能電廠專案預計能讓城市的電費降低約百分之二十。

words.note: 語塊：build a solar plant（建造太陽能發電廠）、solar plant project（太陽能電廠專案）。solar 是「太陽的」；solar panel 是「太陽能板」；plant 在這裡是「工廠、發電廠」。

sentences.en: The government plans to produce half of the country's electricity from renewable energy by the year 2040.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫在 2040 年前讓全國一半的電力來自再生能源。

sentences.en: Wind and sunlight are renewable resources, so many companies are investing in them to reduce pollution.
sentences.zh: 風和陽光是可再生資源，所以很多公司投資它們來減少污染。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim signed a one-year renewable contract, which she can extend if both sides are satisfied.
sentences.zh: 金小姐簽了一年可續約的合約，如果雙方都滿意就可以延長。

sentences.en: The company switched to renewable energy last year and has already reduced its electricity costs by ten percent.
sentences.zh: 公司去年改用再生能源，已經讓電費減少了一成。

sentences.en: The conference will focus on how cities can make better use of renewable resources such as wind and water.
sentences.zh: 研討會會聚焦在城市如何更善用風和水等可再生資源。

words.note: 語塊：renewable energy（再生能源）、renewable resources（可再生資源）、renewable contract（可續約的合約）。renewable 是「可再生的」或「可續期的」；renew 是動詞「續約；更新」；renewal 是名詞。

sentences.en: The new factory uses advanced technology that allows it to produce twice as many cars as the old one.
sentences.zh: 新工廠使用先進技術，產量是舊工廠的兩倍。

sentences.en: Employees who complete the advanced course in accounting will be eligible for a higher salary next year.
sentences.zh: 完成會計進階課程的員工明年有資格領更高的薪水。

sentences.en: Candidates with an advanced degree in engineering will be given priority for the research position.
sentences.zh: 擁有工程高等學位的應徵者會優先獲得研究職位。

sentences.en: The hospital bought several advanced machines that can find health problems much earlier and more accurately than before.
sentences.zh: 醫院買了幾台先進的機器，可以比以前更早、更準確地發現健康問題。

sentences.en: The language school offers an advanced course for students who want to improve their business writing skills.
sentences.zh: 語言學校為想加強商業寫作能力的學生開設進階課程。

words.note: 語塊：advanced technology（先進技術）、advanced course（進階課程）、advanced degree（高等學位）。advanced 是「先進的、程度高的」；advance 是動詞或名詞「前進；預先」（in advance 是「事先」）。

sentences.en: The jacket is made of a light synthetic material that keeps you dry even in heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 這件外套是用輕巧的合成材料做的，即使大雨也能讓你保持乾爽。

sentences.en: Many sports clothes are made from synthetic fiber because it dries much faster than cotton.
sentences.zh: 很多運動服是用合成纖維做的，因為它比棉乾得快很多。

sentences.en: The company is looking for a synthetic material that is cheaper than leather but looks just as good.
sentences.zh: 公司在找一種比皮革便宜、但看起來一樣好的合成材料。

sentences.en: Our new carpets contain no synthetic fiber, so they are safer for families with small children.
sentences.zh: 我們的新地毯不含合成纖維，所以對有小孩的家庭比較安全。

sentences.en: The factory produces synthetic rubber for car tires and sells most of it to companies in Europe.
sentences.zh: 那家工廠生產汽車輪胎用的合成橡膠，大部分賣給歐洲的公司。

words.note: 語塊：synthetic material（合成材料）、synthetic fiber（合成纖維）。synthetic 是「人工合成的」，相反是 natural（天然的）；artificial 意思接近。

words.meaning: 負擔得起的；價格實惠的

sentences.en: The new hotel offers comfortable rooms at an affordable price, so it is popular with young travelers.
sentences.zh: 新飯店以實惠的價格提供舒適的房間，所以很受年輕旅客歡迎。

sentences.en: The city plans to build more affordable housing for families who cannot pay the high rents downtown.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫為付不起市中心高房租的家庭蓋更多平價住宅。

sentences.en: Our goal is to make healthy food affordable for everyone, not only for people with high incomes.
sentences.zh: 我們的目標是讓每個人都買得起健康食物，不只是高收入的人。

sentences.en: The store became successful by selling good furniture at an affordable price to young couples.
sentences.zh: 那家店靠著用實惠的價格賣好家具給年輕夫妻而成功。

sentences.en: The government will spend more money next year on affordable housing near train stations for young workers and their families.
sentences.zh: 政府明年會花更多錢，在火車站附近為年輕上班族和家庭蓋平價住宅。

words.note: 語塊：affordable price（實惠的價格）、affordable housing（平價住宅）。affordable 是「買得起的」；afford 是動詞（can afford to do）；expensive 是「昂貴的」。

sentences.en: At the end of the meeting, Ms. Lee will summarize the main points so that everyone knows what to do next.
sentences.zh: 會議最後，李小姐會總結重點，讓每個人都知道下一步做什麼。

sentences.en: Please summarize the results of the customer survey in a short report for the director by Friday.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前把顧客調查的結果總結成一份簡短報告給主任。

sentences.en: Could you briefly summarize what was discussed at yesterday's meeting for those who could not attend?
sentences.zh: 你能為昨天沒能參加會議的人簡短總結一下討論了什麼嗎？

sentences.en: The first page of the report should summarize the main points in no more than two hundred words.
sentences.zh: 報告的第一頁應該用不超過兩百字總結重點。

sentences.en: The speaker will briefly summarize her research on consumer habits before answering questions from the audience at the conference.
sentences.zh: 在研討會上回答觀眾提問之前，講者會簡短總結她對消費習慣的研究。

words.note: 語塊：summarize the main points（總結重點）、summarize the results（總結結果）、briefly summarize（簡短總結）。summarize 是動詞；summary 是名詞（in summary 是「總之」）。

sentences.en: The two phones look different, but they are essentially the same, so you should buy the cheaper one.
sentences.zh: 這兩支手機看起來不一樣，但基本上一樣，所以你應該買比較便宜的。

sentences.en: The new plan is essentially different from the old one because it focuses on online sales.
sentences.zh: 新計畫和舊計畫本質上不同，因為它著重在網路銷售。

sentences.en: The job is essentially the same as your current one, but the salary is about twenty percent higher.
sentences.zh: 那份工作基本上和你目前的工作一樣，但薪水高大約兩成。

sentences.en: The two companies sell essentially the same products, so they compete mostly on price and service.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司賣的產品基本上一樣，所以主要在價格和服務上競爭。

sentences.en: The restaurant has changed its name, but the menu and the staff are essentially the same as before.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳改了名字，但菜單和員工基本上和以前一樣。

words.note: 語塊：essentially the same（基本上一樣）、essentially different（本質上不同）。essentially 是「基本上、實質上」；basically 意思接近；essential 是形容詞「必要的」。

words.meaning: 可取得性；有空；供應情況

sentences.en: Please check availability on our website before you visit, because some rooms may already be booked.
sentences.zh: 來之前請先在我們的網站上查詢空房，因為有些房間可能已經被訂走了。

sentences.en: Because of limited availability, each customer can buy only two tickets for the opening concert.
sentences.zh: 因為數量有限，每位顧客只能買兩張開幕演唱會的票。

sentences.en: The availability of cheap flights has made it easier for people to travel abroad for short holidays.
sentences.zh: 便宜機票的普及讓人們更容易出國度短假。

sentences.en: Please let me know your availability next week so that we can schedule the interview.
sentences.zh: 請告訴我你下週什麼時候有空，讓我們安排面試。

sentences.en: Our staff will check availability of the product in other stores if it is out of stock here.
sentences.zh: 如果這裡缺貨，我們的店員會查詢其他分店有沒有這項產品。

words.note: 語塊：check availability（查詢空位／庫存）、limited availability（數量有限）、availability of（……的供應）。availability 是 available（可取得的；有空的）的名詞。

sentences.en: Over forty years, the small family shop managed to evolve into one of the largest grocery chains in the country.
sentences.zh: 那家小家庭商店四十年來演變成全國最大的超市連鎖之一。

sentences.en: Customer needs evolve over time, so the company reviews its products and services every year.
sentences.zh: 顧客的需求會隨時間演變，所以公司每年都會檢討產品和服務。

sentences.en: Online shopping will continue to evolve as more people use their phones to buy everyday items.
sentences.zh: 隨著更多人用手機買日常用品，網路購物會持續發展。

sentences.en: The website started as a simple blog, but it will soon evolve into a popular news service.
sentences.zh: 那個網站一開始只是簡單的部落格，很快會演變成受歡迎的新聞服務。

sentences.en: Technology continues to evolve so quickly that workers must keep learning new skills throughout their careers.
sentences.zh: 科技持續快速發展，所以工作者整個職涯都必須一直學新技能。

words.note: 語塊：evolve into（演變成……）、evolve over time（隨時間演變）、continue to evolve（持續發展）。evolve 是「逐漸發展、演變」；evolution 是名詞；involve 是「涉及」。

sentences.en: Working from home is a viable option for employees who live far away from the office.
sentences.zh: 對住得離公司很遠的員工來說，在家工作是可行的選擇。

sentences.en: The engineers must prove that the new battery is commercially viable before the company invests more money.
sentences.zh: 在公司投入更多錢之前，工程師必須證明新電池在商業上可行。

sentences.en: Electric buses are now a viable alternative to diesel buses in many cities around the world.
sentences.zh: 在世界各地很多城市，電動公車現在是柴油公車的可行替代方案。

sentences.en: The consultant said that opening a second store downtown is not a viable option this year.
sentences.zh: 顧問說今年在市中心開第二家店不是可行的選擇。

sentences.en: Online classes have become a viable alternative for students who cannot attend school in person.
sentences.zh: 線上課程已經成為無法親自上學的學生可行的替代方案。

words.note: 語塊：viable option（可行的選擇）、commercially viable（商業上可行的）、viable alternative（可行的替代方案）。viable 是「行得通的」；feasible 意思接近；variable 是「可變的」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: Please note that the office will be closed on Monday because of the national holiday.
sentences.zh: 請注意，辦公室週一因國定假日休息。

sentences.en: The manager asked everyone to take note of the new safety rules posted near the elevator.
sentences.zh: 經理請大家留意貼在電梯旁邊的新安全規則。

sentences.en: Please make a note of the customer's phone number so that we can call her back this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 請記下那位顧客的電話號碼，讓我們今天下午可以回電給她。

sentences.en: The report will note that sales increased in every region except South America last year.
sentences.zh: 報告會指出去年除了南美洲以外，每個地區的銷售都增加了。

sentences.en: Visitors should take note of the emergency exits when they enter the theater for the first time.
sentences.zh: 訪客第一次進入劇院時應該留意緊急出口的位置。

words.note: 語塊：please note that（請注意……）、take note of（留意……）、make a note of（記下……）。note 可以是名詞「筆記；便條」或動詞「注意、指出」；notice 是「注意到；通知」。

sentences.en: Our sales team worked hard for six months to secure a contract with the largest hotel chain in Asia.
sentences.zh: 我們的業務團隊努力了六個月，拿下和亞洲最大連鎖飯店的合約。

sentences.en: The start-up needs to secure funding from investors before it can hire more engineers next year.
sentences.zh: 那家新創公司要先從投資人那裡取得資金，明年才能雇用更多工程師。

sentences.en: After two interviews, Ms. Kim was able to secure a position as a designer at a famous fashion company.
sentences.zh: 經過兩次面試，金小姐在一家知名時裝公司取得了設計師的職位。

sentences.en: Please secure all windows and doors before you leave the office, because a storm is expected tonight.
sentences.zh: 離開辦公室前請把所有門窗關緊，因為今晚預計會有暴風雨。

sentences.en: The museum hopes to secure funding from the city to repair its roof before the winter season.
sentences.zh: 博物館希望在冬天前從市政府取得資金修理屋頂。

words.note: 語塊：secure a contract（拿下合約）、secure funding（取得資金）、secure a position（取得職位）。secure 當動詞是「（費力）取得」或「使安全」；當形容詞是「安全的」；security 是名詞。

sentences.en: There was a clear divergence of opinion among the board members about whether to open a new factory.
sentences.zh: 董事會成員對於是否要開新工廠有明顯的意見分歧。

sentences.en: The report showed a large divergence between the sales forecast and the actual sales in the third quarter.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示第三季銷售預測和實際銷售之間有很大的差異。

sentences.en: The divergence of opinion between the two partners finally led them to start separate companies.
sentences.zh: 兩個合夥人之間的意見分歧最後讓他們各自創業。

sentences.en: Economists are studying the divergence between rising prices and slow wage growth in the region.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家正在研究該地區物價上漲和薪資成長緩慢之間的差異。

sentences.en: The manager tried to reduce the divergence of opinion within the team by holding a long discussion.
sentences.zh: 經理藉由一場長時間的討論，試著減少團隊內的意見分歧。

words.note: 語塊：divergence of opinion（意見分歧）、divergence between（……之間的差異）。divergence 是 diverge（分歧）的名詞；difference 意思接近但較口語；convergence 是相反詞「匯合」。

sentences.en: In his speech, the CEO will attribute the company's success to its hardworking employees and loyal customers.
sentences.zh: 執行長在演講中會把公司的成功歸功於努力的員工和忠實的顧客。

sentences.en: Many people attribute the increase in sales to the new advertising campaign that started in March.
sentences.zh: 很多人把銷售增加歸功於三月開始的新廣告活動。

sentences.en: Experts attribute the high number of accidents to poor lighting on the road at night.
sentences.zh: 專家把車禍數量高歸因於夜間道路照明不足。

sentences.en: The airline will attribute the delay to bad weather, which stopped all flights for almost two days.
sentences.zh: 航空公司會把延誤歸因於惡劣天氣，所有航班幾乎停飛了兩天。

sentences.en: Many analysts attribute the drop in profits to rising fuel prices and higher shipping costs.
sentences.zh: 很多分析師把獲利下滑歸因於燃料價格上漲和運費提高。

words.note: 語塊：attribute A to B（把 A 歸因於 B）、attribute success to（把成功歸功於）。attribute A to B 是「把 A 歸功／歸咎於 B」；當名詞時是「特質、屬性」；contribute 是「貢獻」。

sentences.en: The company will publish its annual report on its website at the end of March for all shareholders.
sentences.zh: 公司將在三月底於網站上公布年報給所有股東。

sentences.en: More than five hundred members are expected to attend the annual meeting in Singapore this year.
sentences.zh: 今年預計有五百多位會員參加在新加坡舉行的年會。

sentences.en: Each department must submit its annual budget to the finance team before the end of November.
sentences.zh: 每個部門都必須在十一月底前把年度預算交給財務團隊。

sentences.en: The annual festival attracts thousands of visitors from all over the country to the small town every summer.
sentences.zh: 這個一年一度的節慶每年夏天都吸引全國各地數千名遊客來到這個小鎮。

sentences.en: At the annual meeting, the CEO thanked all of the employees for their hard work during the difficult year.
sentences.zh: 在年會上，執行長感謝所有員工在艱難的一年裡辛勤工作。

words.note: 語塊：annual report（年報）、annual meeting（年會）、annual budget（年度預算）。annual 是「一年一次的」；annually 是副詞「每年」；anniversary 是「週年紀念」。

sentences.en: The new shopping precinct downtown has more than eighty stores and is closed to cars on weekends.
sentences.zh: 市中心新的購物徒步區有八十多家店，週末禁止車輛進入。

sentences.en: The police precinct near the train station will move to a larger building at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 火車站附近的警察分局年底會搬到較大的大樓。

sentences.en: Many visitors enjoy walking around the shopping precinct because there are cafés and street performers everywhere.
sentences.zh: 很多遊客喜歡在購物徒步區逛，因為到處都有咖啡廳和街頭藝人。

sentences.en: The city plans to turn the old market area into a shopping precinct with trees and benches.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫把舊市場區改造成有樹和長椅的購物徒步區。

sentences.en: Residents of the precinct were invited to a meeting to discuss the new parking rules for their neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 這一區的居民受邀參加會議，討論他們社區的新停車規定。

words.note: 語塊：shopping precinct（購物徒步區）、police precinct（警察轄區）。precinct 是城市裡劃分出來的「區」；shopping precinct 是英式說法，指禁止車輛進入的購物區。

sentences.en: Drivers must stop at every pedestrian crossing when someone is waiting to cross the street.
sentences.zh: 只要有人在等過馬路，駕駛就必須在每個行人穿越道停車。

sentences.en: The main street will become a pedestrian zone on weekends so that people can shop and walk safely.
sentences.zh: 主要街道週末會變成行人徒步區，讓大家可以安全地逛街散步。

sentences.en: A pedestrian was slightly injured when a bicycle hit him near the entrance of the shopping mall.
sentences.zh: 一名行人在購物中心入口附近被自行車撞到，受了輕傷。

sentences.en: The city installed new lights at the pedestrian crossing near the school to make it safer for children.
sentences.zh: 市政府在學校附近的行人穿越道裝了新燈，讓孩子更安全。

sentences.en: The new pedestrian zone has increased the number of customers visiting the small shops in the area.
sentences.zh: 新的行人徒步區增加了這一帶小店的來客數。

words.note: 語塊：pedestrian crossing（行人穿越道）、pedestrian zone（行人徒步區）。pedestrian 可以是名詞「行人」或形容詞「行人的」；passenger 是「乘客」。

sentences.en: Each passenger may bring one piece of carry-on luggage that weighs no more than seven kilograms.
sentences.zh: 每位乘客可以帶一件不超過七公斤的隨身行李。

sentences.en: Please check in your luggage at least one hour before your flight leaves for Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 請在飛往東京的班機起飛前至少一小時託運行李。

sentences.en: The luggage allowance for economy class is twenty-three kilograms on most international flights, but business class passengers can bring more.
sentences.zh: 大部分國際航班經濟艙的行李限額是二十三公斤，但商務艙乘客可以帶更多。

sentences.en: The hotel staff will keep your luggage at the front desk if you arrive before check-in time.
sentences.zh: 如果你在入住時間前抵達，飯店人員會把你的行李寄放在櫃台。

sentences.en: If you go over the luggage allowance, you will have to pay an extra fee at the check-in counter at the airport.
sentences.zh: 如果你超過行李限額，必須在機場報到櫃台付額外的費用。

words.note: 語塊：carry-on luggage（隨身行李）、check in luggage（託運行李）、luggage allowance（行李限額）。luggage 是不可數名詞，不能說 a luggage 或 luggages，要說 a piece of luggage；baggage 意思一樣。

sentences.en: The contract should clearly state that the supplier must deliver the goods within two weeks of the order.
sentences.zh: 合約應該清楚說明供應商必須在下單後兩週內交貨。

sentences.en: In the press release, the company will state that it has no plans to close any of its stores.
sentences.zh: 公司在新聞稿中會聲明沒有關閉任何分店的計畫。

sentences.en: The e-mail will state that the training session will begin at nine o'clock in Conference Room B.
sentences.zh: 電子郵件會說明訓練課程在九點於 B 會議室開始。

sentences.en: Please state your name and the reason for your visit when you arrive at the security desk.
sentences.zh: 到保全櫃台時，請說明你的姓名和來訪原因。

sentences.en: The manual should clearly state how often the machine needs to be cleaned and checked.
sentences.zh: 手冊應該清楚說明機器需要多久清潔和檢查一次。

words.note: 語塊：clearly state（清楚說明）、state that（聲明……）。state 當動詞是「正式說明」；當名詞是「狀態；州；國家」；statement 是「聲明」。

sentences.en: The company decided to hire a consultant to help reduce costs in its factories and warehouses.
sentences.zh: 公司決定聘請一位顧問，幫忙降低工廠和倉庫的成本。

sentences.en: Mr. Brown worked as a management consultant for ten years before he started his own business.
sentences.zh: 布朗先生在自己創業前當了十年的管理顧問。

sentences.en: A financial consultant can help you decide how much money to save for your retirement.
sentences.zh: 理財顧問可以幫你決定要為退休存多少錢。

sentences.en: The consultant suggested that the company should sell its products online instead of opening new stores.
sentences.zh: 顧問建議公司在網路上賣產品，而不是開新店。

sentences.en: We will hire a consultant from Germany to train our engineers on the new production system.
sentences.zh: 我們會聘請一位德國顧問來訓練我們的工程師使用新生產系統。

words.note: 語塊：hire a consultant（聘請顧問）、management consultant（管理顧問）、financial consultant（理財顧問）。consultant 是提供專業建議的人；consult 是動詞「諮詢」；consultation 是名詞「諮詢」。

sentences.en: The technician was able to retrieve all of the data from the broken computer before it was replaced.
sentences.zh: 技術人員在換掉壞掉的電腦之前，成功把所有資料救了回來。

sentences.en: Employees can retrieve information about their salaries and holidays from the company website at any time.
sentences.zh: 員工可以隨時從公司網站取得自己的薪資和休假資訊。

sentences.en: Passengers can retrieve their luggage from carousel number five after they pass through immigration at the international airport.
sentences.zh: 乘客在國際機場通過入境檢查後，可以在五號行李轉盤領取行李。

sentences.en: If you forget your password, you can retrieve it by answering the security question on the login page.
sentences.zh: 如果你忘了密碼，可以在登入頁面回答安全問題來找回。

sentences.en: The new software makes it easier to retrieve data about customer orders from the past five years.
sentences.zh: 新軟體讓取得過去五年顧客訂單的資料變得更容易。

words.note: 語塊：retrieve data（擷取資料）、retrieve information（取得資訊）、retrieve luggage（領取行李）。retrieve 是「找回、取回」；retrieval 是名詞；receive 是「收到」。

sentences.en: The company will carry out a feasibility study before it decides to build a new factory in Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 公司在決定是否在越南蓋新工廠之前，會先做可行性研究。

sentences.en: Engineers are checking the technical feasibility of using solar panels on the roof of the stadium.
sentences.zh: 工程師正在檢查在體育場屋頂使用太陽能板的技術可行性。

sentences.en: The consultant was hired to assess the feasibility of opening a second restaurant downtown near the new train station.
sentences.zh: 那位顧問受聘來評估在市中心新火車站附近開第二家餐廳的可行性。

sentences.en: According to the feasibility study, the new bridge would reduce traffic in the city center by thirty percent.
sentences.zh: 根據可行性研究，新橋會讓市中心的交通量減少三成。

sentences.en: The board will assess the feasibility of the plan carefully before it approves any money for the project.
sentences.zh: 董事會在核准任何專案經費之前，會仔細評估計畫的可行性。

words.note: 語塊：feasibility study（可行性研究）、technical feasibility（技術可行性）、assess the feasibility（評估可行性）。feasibility 是 feasible（可行的）的名詞；viability 意思接近。

sentences.en: The company now sells only environmentally friendly products, such as bags made from recycled paper.
sentences.zh: 公司現在只賣環保產品，例如用再生紙做的袋子。

sentences.en: Many customers are willing to pay more for food that comes in environmentally friendly packaging.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客願意多付錢買用環保包裝的食物。

sentences.en: Our new office building is environmentally friendly because it uses solar energy and collects rainwater.
sentences.zh: 我們的新辦公大樓很環保，因為它使用太陽能並收集雨水。

sentences.en: The hotel switched to environmentally friendly packaging for all of the soap and shampoo in its rooms.
sentences.zh: 飯店把房間裡所有的肥皂和洗髮精都改成環保包裝。

sentences.en: The store gives a small discount to customers who buy environmentally friendly products during Earth Week.
sentences.zh: 那家店在地球週期間給買環保產品的顧客一點折扣。

words.note: 語塊：environmentally friendly products（環保產品）、environmentally friendly packaging（環保包裝）。environmentally friendly 和 eco-friendly 意思一樣；environmental 是「環境的」。

sentences.en: The airline provides a special seat for passengers who are traveling with an infant on long flights.
sentences.zh: 航空公司為長途航班上帶嬰兒的乘客提供特別座位。

sentences.en: The company sells infant formula and baby food in more than forty countries around the world.
sentences.zh: 那家公司在全世界四十多個國家販售嬰兒配方奶和嬰兒食品。

sentences.en: The new shopping mall has a room for infant care where parents can feed and change their babies.
sentences.zh: 新購物中心有一間嬰兒照護室，讓父母可以餵奶和換尿布。

sentences.en: Parents must use an infant seat when they drive with a baby, according to the new traffic law.
sentences.zh: 依照新的交通法規，父母開車載嬰兒時必須使用嬰兒座椅。

sentences.en: The hospital offers free classes on infant care for new parents every Saturday morning in the community room on the first floor.
sentences.zh: 醫院每週六早上在一樓的社區教室為新手父母開設免費的嬰兒照護課程。

words.note: 語塊：infant care（嬰兒照護）、infant formula（嬰兒配方奶）、infant seat（嬰兒座椅）。infant 指還不會走路的「嬰兒」；baby 比較口語；infancy 是「嬰兒期；初期」。

sentences.en: The gym is looking for a fitness instructor who can teach yoga classes on weekday evenings.
sentences.zh: 健身房在找一位能在平日晚上教瑜伽課的健身教練。

sentences.en: My driving instructor was very patient and helped me pass the driving test on my first try.
sentences.zh: 我的駕訓教練很有耐心，幫我第一次就通過駕照考試。

sentences.en: The course instructor will send all of the training materials to the participants before the first class.
sentences.zh: 課程講師會在第一堂課前把所有訓練教材寄給學員。

sentences.en: Each instructor at the language school has at least five years of experience teaching business English.
sentences.zh: 那間語言學校的每位講師都有至少五年教商用英文的經驗。

sentences.en: Please ask the course instructor if you have any questions about the final exam or the homework.
sentences.zh: 如果你對期末考或作業有任何問題，請問課程講師。

words.note: 語塊：fitness instructor（健身教練）、driving instructor（駕訓教練）、course instructor（課程講師）。instructor 是「教課的人」；instruction 是「指示；教學」；instruct 是動詞「指導」。

sentences.en: The music store sells every kind of musical instrument, from cheap guitars to expensive pianos.
sentences.zh: 那家樂器行賣各種樂器，從便宜的吉他到昂貴的鋼琴都有。

sentences.en: Every measuring instrument in the laboratory must be checked carefully by the technician before each experiment begins.
sentences.zh: 實驗室裡的每一台測量儀器在每次實驗開始前都必須由技術人員仔細檢查。

sentences.en: The company makes a medical instrument that is used in hospitals all over Asia and Europe.
sentences.zh: 那家公司製造一種亞洲和歐洲各地醫院都在使用的醫療器材。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin learned to play a musical instrument when she was young, and she still plays the violin every weekend.
sentences.zh: 林小姐小時候學過樂器，現在每個週末還會拉小提琴。

sentences.en: The engineers used a special instrument to measure how much the bridge moves in strong winds.
sentences.zh: 工程師用一種特殊儀器來測量橋在強風中晃動多少。

words.note: 語塊：musical instrument（樂器）、measuring instrument（測量儀器）、medical instrument（醫療器材）。instrument 可以是「精密儀器」或「樂器」；tool 是一般「工具」；instrumental 是「有幫助的」。

sentences.en: All employees will receive an annual increment of three percent in their salary starting in January.
sentences.zh: 從一月開始，所有員工每年的薪水會調高百分之三。

sentences.en: Ms. Choi asked her manager about the salary increment that was promised in her contract.
sentences.zh: 崔小姐向經理詢問合約裡承諾的調薪。

sentences.en: The price of the service will rise by a small increment every year over the next three years.
sentences.zh: 這項服務的價格在未來三年每年會小幅調漲。

sentences.en: Workers who complete the advanced training course will receive a salary increment starting from next month.
sentences.zh: 完成進階訓練課程的員工從下個月開始會調薪。

sentences.en: The annual increment depends on each employee's performance and the company's profits for the year.
sentences.zh: 年度調薪取決於每位員工的表現和公司當年的獲利。
