words.note: 語塊：salary increment（調薪）、annual increment（年度調薪）、small increment（小幅增加）。increment 是「每次增加的量」，常用在薪水；increase 是一般的「增加」。

sentences.en: The new software update includes a product enhancement that makes the app faster and easier to use.
sentences.zh: 新的軟體更新包含一項產品改良，讓 App 更快也更好用。

sentences.en: The company invested heavily in quality enhancement after many customers complained about broken parts in its washing machines.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客抱怨洗衣機零件損壞後，公司大力投資在品質提升上。

sentences.en: The training program focuses on the enhancement of communication skills for managers and team leaders.
sentences.zh: 這個訓練計畫著重在提升經理和組長的溝通能力。

sentences.en: Our engineers are working on a product enhancement that will make the battery last twice as long.
sentences.zh: 我們的工程師正在做一項產品改良，讓電池續航力加倍。

sentences.en: The city spent two million dollars on the enhancement of public parks and playgrounds last year.
sentences.zh: 市政府去年花了兩百萬元提升公園和遊樂場。

words.note: 語塊：quality enhancement（品質提升）、product enhancement（產品改良）、enhancement of（……的提升）。enhancement 是 enhance（提升）的名詞；improvement 意思接近。

sentences.en: Customers who spend more than one hundred dollars will receive a gift voucher for their next visit.
sentences.zh: 消費超過一百元的顧客會得到一張下次光臨可用的禮券。

sentences.en: Please bring this discount voucher to the store before the end of the month to get twenty percent off.
sentences.zh: 請在月底前帶這張折價券到店裡，可以打八折。

sentences.en: The airline gave each passenger a meal voucher because the flight was delayed for more than three hours.
sentences.zh: 因為班機延誤超過三小時，航空公司給每位乘客一張餐券。

sentences.en: The hotel gave us a voucher for a free breakfast because our room was not ready when we arrived.
sentences.zh: 因為我們抵達時房間還沒準備好，飯店給了我們一張免費早餐券。

sentences.en: The discount voucher cannot be used together with other special offers or during the holiday sale.
sentences.zh: 這張折價券不能和其他優惠同時使用，假期特賣期間也不能用。

words.note: 語塊：gift voucher（禮券）、discount voucher（折價券）、meal voucher（餐券）。voucher 是可以換東西或抵錢的「券」；coupon 意思接近。

sentences.en: Many graduates prefer to work in the private sector because the salaries are usually higher.
sentences.zh: 很多畢業生比較想在民間企業工作，因為薪水通常比較高。

sentences.en: Teachers and nurses who work in the public sector will receive a pay raise starting next year.
sentences.zh: 在公部門工作的老師和護理師從明年開始會加薪。

sentences.en: The service sector, such as restaurants and hotels, employs more than half of the workers in the city.
sentences.zh: 服務業，像是餐廳和飯店，雇用了這個城市一半以上的工作者。

sentences.en: The technology sector grew quickly last year, and many companies are now looking for software engineers.
sentences.zh: 科技產業去年快速成長，很多公司現在都在找軟體工程師。

sentences.en: The government is working with the private sector to build more affordable housing in the area.
sentences.zh: 政府正與民間企業合作，在這一區蓋更多平價住宅。

words.note: 語塊：private sector（民間部門）、public sector（公部門）、service sector（服務業）。sector 指經濟中的「產業、領域」；section 是「部分；區塊」；department 是公司的「部門」。

sentences.en: The new factory will create a job opportunity for more than five hundred people in the local area.
sentences.zh: 新工廠將為當地五百多人創造工作機會。

sentences.en: I would like to take the opportunity to thank everyone who helped make this event a great success.
sentences.zh: 我想趁這個機會感謝每位幫忙讓這次活動圓滿成功的人。

sentences.en: Many companies see the growing number of older people as a big business opportunity for the next twenty years.
sentences.zh: 很多公司把老年人口增加視為未來二十年的一大商機。

sentences.en: Employees will have the opportunity to ask questions at the end of the presentation about the new benefits plan.
sentences.zh: 員工在新福利方案的簡報最後會有機會提問。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz decided to take the opportunity to study abroad when her company offered to pay for it.
sentences.zh: 公司提議出錢後，魯伊茲小姐決定把握機會出國進修。

words.note: 語塊：job opportunity（工作機會）、take the opportunity（把握機會）、business opportunity（商機）。opportunity 是「好機會」，比 chance 正式；take the opportunity to do 是「趁機做……」。

sentences.en: Please turn on the air conditioning in the meeting room before the clients arrive this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 請在客戶今天下午抵達前把會議室的冷氣打開。

sentences.en: The air conditioning system in the building will be repaired this weekend, so the office will be closed.
sentences.zh: 大樓的空調系統這個週末會維修，所以辦公室會關閉。

sentences.en: All of our hotel rooms have free Wi-Fi, a small refrigerator, a coffee machine, and air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 我們飯店所有房間都有免費無線網路、小冰箱、咖啡機和冷氣。

sentences.en: The company will replace the old air conditioning system with a new one that uses less electricity.
sentences.zh: 公司會把舊的空調系統換成比較省電的新系統。

sentences.en: Many people turn on the air conditioning all day in summer, so electricity bills are much higher.
sentences.zh: 很多人夏天整天開冷氣，所以電費高很多。

words.note: 語塊：turn on the air conditioning（開冷氣）、air conditioning system（空調系統）。air conditioning 是不可數的「空調系統」；air conditioner 是一台「冷氣機」。

sentences.en: The company spent a considerable amount of money on the new computer system for its offices.
sentences.zh: 公司在辦公室的新電腦系統上花了相當多的錢。

sentences.en: It took a considerable time to find a supplier that could deliver the materials so quickly.
sentences.zh: 花了相當長的時間才找到能這麼快交貨的供應商。

sentences.en: The team made a considerable effort to finish the project on time despite the lack of staff.
sentences.zh: 儘管人手不足，團隊還是付出相當大的努力準時完成專案。

sentences.en: The new policy has caused considerable confusion among employees, so the manager will explain it again.
sentences.zh: 新規定在員工之間造成相當大的混亂，所以經理會再解釋一次。

sentences.en: Building a new factory will require a considerable amount of time and money from the company.
sentences.zh: 蓋新工廠需要公司投入相當多的時間和金錢。

words.note: 語塊：considerable amount（相當多的量）、considerable time（相當長的時間）、considerable effort（相當大的努力）。considerable 是「數量或程度很大的」；considerate 是「體貼的」，很容易搞混。

sentences.en: The manager will take responsibility for the delay and explain the situation to the client.
sentences.zh: 經理會為延誤負責，並向客戶說明情況。

sentences.en: Her main responsibility is to answer customer questions and solve problems with orders and deliveries.
sentences.zh: 她的主要職責是回答顧客問題和處理訂單和送貨問題。

sentences.en: We are looking for someone with a strong sense of responsibility who can work without supervision.
sentences.zh: 我們在找一位有強烈責任感、可以獨立工作的人。

sentences.en: The new supervisor will take responsibility for training all staff in the warehouse next month.
sentences.zh: 新主管下個月會負責訓練倉庫所有員工。

sentences.en: Each team member has a different responsibility, so please check the list before the event begins.
sentences.zh: 每位組員都有不同的職責，所以活動開始前請看一下清單。

words.note: 語塊：take responsibility for（為……負責）、main responsibility（主要職責）、sense of responsibility（責任感）。responsibility 是名詞；形容詞 responsible 用 be responsible for；duty 意思接近。

sentences.en: The flight was delayed for two hours because of an equipment malfunction that was found before takeoff.
sentences.zh: 因為起飛前發現設備故障，班機延誤了兩個小時。

sentences.en: A system malfunction caused the bank's website to stop working for most of Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 系統故障讓銀行網站週一早上大部分時間都無法使用。

sentences.en: Please report any technical malfunction to the IT department as soon as you notice the problem.
sentences.zh: 一發現任何技術故障，請立刻通報資訊部門。

sentences.en: The factory had to stop production for a day after a serious malfunction in one of its machines.
sentences.zh: 工廠其中一台機器嚴重故障後，不得不停工一天。

sentences.en: The technician said the equipment malfunction was caused by dust inside the cooling fan, which had not been cleaned for months.
sentences.zh: 技術人員說設備故障是好幾個月沒清的冷卻風扇裡的灰塵造成的。

words.note: 語塊：equipment malfunction（設備故障）、system malfunction（系統故障）、technical malfunction（技術故障）。malfunction 可以當名詞或動詞（The machine malfunctioned）；breakdown 意思接近。

sentences.en: Please itemize the costs of the trip, including hotels, meals, and taxis, when you submit your expense report.
sentences.zh: 提交報帳單時，請逐項列出出差費用，包括住宿、餐費和計程車。

sentences.en: If you ask, the hotel will itemize every charge during your stay and send the bill to your company by e-mail.
sentences.zh: 如果你要求，飯店會逐項列出你住宿期間的每一筆費用，並把帳單用電子郵件寄到你的公司。

sentences.en: Our cashiers can itemize the receipt for customers who need to show their company exactly what they bought.
sentences.zh: 如果顧客需要讓公司看清楚買了什麼，我們的收銀員可以把收據逐項列出。

sentences.en: The accountant asked the department to itemize all expenses for the international conference in Seoul before Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 會計請部門在週五前逐項列出首爾國際研討會的所有費用。

sentences.en: The contractor will itemize the price of each material so that the client can understand the total cost.
sentences.zh: 承包商會逐項列出每種材料的價格，讓客戶了解總費用。

words.note: 語塊：itemize the costs（逐項列出費用）、itemize the receipt（列出收據明細）、itemize every charge（逐項列出每筆費用）。itemize 是「一項一項列出來」；item 是「項目」；itemized 是形容詞「列出明細的」。

sentences.en: We will send an invoice to your company after all of the products have been delivered.
sentences.zh: 所有產品送達後，我們會寄請款單到貴公司。

sentences.en: Please pay the invoice within thirty days, or a late fee of five percent will be added.
sentences.zh: 請在三十天內支付請款單，否則會加收百分之五的滯納金。

sentences.en: When you call our accounting office, please have your invoice number ready so that we can help you quickly.
sentences.zh: 打電話到我們的會計室時，請準備好發票號碼，讓我們能快速協助你。

sentences.en: The supplier sent the invoice to the wrong address, so we could not pay it on time.
sentences.zh: 供應商把請款單寄錯地址，所以我們沒辦法準時付款。

sentences.en: The accounting department checks every invoice carefully before any payment is made to suppliers at the end of each month.
sentences.zh: 會計部門在付款給供應商之前，會在每個月底付款給供應商之前，仔細檢查每一張請款單。

words.note: 語塊：send an invoice（寄發票）、pay an invoice（支付請款單）、invoice number（發票號碼）。invoice 是賣方寄給買方要求付款的「請款單」；receipt 是付錢後拿到的「收據」。

sentences.en: The product launch was a great success, and the company sold more than ten thousand units in a week.
sentences.zh: 產品發表會非常成功，公司一週內賣出一萬多台。

sentences.en: Good communication between departments is the key to success for any large project that involves many people and teams.
sentences.zh: 部門之間良好的溝通是任何牽涉很多人和團隊的大型專案成功的關鍵。

sentences.en: The success of the new restaurant is mainly due to its excellent food and friendly staff.
sentences.zh: 新餐廳的成功主要是因為食物很棒、員工很親切。

sentences.en: Ms. Park shared the secret of her success with young business owners at the conference.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐在研討會上和年輕的企業主分享她成功的祕訣。

sentences.en: The annual festival was a great success, attracting more visitors than in any previous year.
sentences.zh: 今年的年度節慶非常成功，吸引的遊客比以往任何一年都多。

words.note: 語塊：great success（巨大成功）、key to success（成功的關鍵）、success of（……的成功）。success 是名詞；succeed 是動詞；successful 是形容詞；successive 是「連續的」。

sentences.en: Customers who cancel their booking less than two days in advance will have to pay a penalty.
sentences.zh: 在不到兩天前取消訂位的顧客必須付罰款。

sentences.en: A late penalty of fifty dollars will be added if the rent is not paid by the fifth of the month.
sentences.zh: 如果房租沒有在每月五日前付清，會加收五十元的逾期罰款。

sentences.en: Companies that break the environmental law may face a heavy penalty from the government and lose their business licenses.
sentences.zh: 違反環保法的公司可能面臨政府的重罰，還會被吊銷營業執照。

sentences.en: The contract states that the builder will pay a penalty for every day the project is late.
sentences.zh: 合約規定專案每延遲一天，建商就要付罰款。

sentences.en: To avoid a late penalty, please make sure your tax forms are submitted before the end of May.
sentences.zh: 為了避免逾期罰款，請確保在五月底前提交報稅表。

words.note: 語塊：pay a penalty（付罰款）、late penalty（逾期罰款）、heavy penalty（重罰）。penalty 是違反規定的「處罰」；fine 是「罰金」，意思接近；penalize 是動詞。

sentences.en: Drivers who park in front of the hospital entrance will have to pay a fine of two hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 在醫院入口前停車的駕駛必須繳兩百元罰款。

sentences.en: Mr. Wilson got a parking fine because he left his car on the street for more than two hours.
sentences.zh: 威爾森先生把車停在路邊超過兩小時，所以被開了違規停車罰單。

sentences.en: The company had to pay a heavy fine after it was found that the factory had polluted the river.
sentences.zh: 被發現工廠污染河川後，公司必須繳高額罰款。

sentences.en: Library users who return books late must pay a small fine for each day the book is overdue.
sentences.zh: 逾期還書的圖書館讀者每逾期一天都要付一點罰款。

sentences.en: The city plans to raise the parking fine to reduce traffic problems in the downtown area.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫提高違規停車罰款，以減少市中心的交通問題。

words.note: 語塊：pay a fine（繳罰款）、parking fine（違規停車罰單）、heavy fine（高額罰款）。fine 當名詞是「罰金」；當動詞是「罰款」（be fined）；當形容詞是「好的；細的」。

sentences.en: Passengers must remain stationary in their seats until the train has completely stopped at the station.
sentences.zh: 乘客必須在座位上保持不動，直到列車在車站完全停下。

sentences.en: The bus hit a stationary vehicle that was parked on the side of the road, but nobody was hurt.
sentences.zh: 公車撞上一輛停在路邊的靜止車輛，但沒有人受傷。

sentences.en: The gym bought a new stationary bike for every room so that members can exercise while watching television.
sentences.zh: 健身房在每個房間都買了一台新的固定式健身車，讓會員可以邊看電視邊運動。

sentences.en: Prices have remained stationary for six months, but experts expect them to rise next year.
sentences.zh: 價格已經持平六個月了，但專家預期明年會上漲。

sentences.en: Please keep the machine stationary while the technician is checking the motor and other parts inside it.
sentences.zh: 技術人員在檢查機器內部馬達和其他零件時，請讓機器保持靜止。

words.note: 語塊：remain stationary（保持靜止）、stationary vehicle（靜止的車輛）、stationary bike（固定式健身車）。stationary（靜止的）和 stationery（文具）發音一樣、拼法只差一個字母，很容易考。

sentences.en: Many office workers take a dietary supplement because they do not have time to eat healthy meals.
sentences.zh: 很多上班族吃營養補充品，因為他們沒時間吃健康的餐點。

sentences.en: The report includes a supplement to the main document that explains the new safety rules.
sentences.zh: 報告附有一份主要文件的補充資料，說明新的安全規定。

sentences.en: The pharmacy is having a sale this week, and every vitamin supplement on the shelf is thirty percent off.
sentences.zh: 藥局這週特價，架上的每一種維他命補充品都打七折。

sentences.en: The newspaper publishes a special supplement about travel, food, and culture for its readers every Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 報紙每週日早上都會為讀者出一份關於旅遊、美食和文化的特別增刊。

sentences.en: Doctors say that a vitamin supplement cannot replace a healthy diet with fresh fruit and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 醫生說維他命補充品無法取代有新鮮蔬果的健康飲食。

words.note: 語塊：dietary supplement（營養補充品）、supplement to（……的補充）、vitamin supplement（維他命補充品）。supplement 可以當名詞或動詞「補充」；supply 是「供應」；complement 是「互補」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: The company is in no way responsible for items that are left in the lockers overnight.
sentences.zh: 公司對放在置物櫃過夜的物品不負任何責任。

sentences.en: The new policy will in no way affect the salaries or holidays of current employees.
sentences.zh: 新規定絕不會影響現有員工的薪水或假期。

sentences.en: The delay was in no way caused by our staff, but we still apologize to all of our customers.
sentences.zh: 延誤絕不是我們員工造成的，但我們還是向所有顧客道歉。

sentences.en: The hotel is in no way responsible for any loss or damage to cars in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 飯店對停車場內車輛的任何遺失或損壞一概不負責任。

sentences.en: The changes to the schedule will in no way affect the quality of the service we provide.
sentences.zh: 時程的變動絕不會影響我們提供的服務品質。

words.note: 語塊：in no way responsible（一點責任也沒有）、in no way affect（絕不影響）。in no way 是加強否定的說法；放在句首時要倒裝（In no way is this…）。

sentences.en: Employees are encouraged to take a walk at lunch to breathe fresh air and relax for a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 公司鼓勵員工午休散步，呼吸新鮮空氣，放鬆幾分鐘。

sentences.en: The new air system helps people breathe easily even when the office is full of people.
sentences.zh: 新的空調系統讓辦公室即使人很多，大家也能輕鬆呼吸。

sentences.en: The yoga instructor told the class to breathe in slowly and hold it for five seconds.
sentences.zh: 瑜伽老師請全班慢慢吸氣，憋住五秒。

sentences.en: Workers must wear masks in the factory so that they do not breathe in dust or chemicals.
sentences.zh: 工人在工廠必須戴口罩，以免吸入灰塵或化學物質。

sentences.en: After the contract was finally signed, the whole sales team could breathe easily again and enjoy their weekend.
sentences.zh: 合約終於簽下後，整個業務團隊才終於可以鬆一口氣，好好享受週末。

words.note: 語塊：breathe in（吸氣）、breathe fresh air（呼吸新鮮空氣）、breathe easily（輕鬆呼吸；放心）。breathe 是動詞（字尾有 e）；breath 是名詞「呼吸」，發音也不同。

sentences.en: The store installed a surveillance camera above every entrance after several items were stolen last month.
sentences.zh: 上個月好幾件商品被偷後，那家店在每個入口上方都裝了監視器。

sentences.en: The parking lot is under surveillance twenty-four hours a day, so customers can leave their cars safely.
sentences.zh: 停車場二十四小時都在監控之下，所以顧客可以放心停車。

sentences.en: The bank uses video surveillance in every branch to protect both its customers and its employees from crime.
sentences.zh: 銀行在每家分行都使用影像監控，保護顧客和員工免於犯罪。

sentences.en: Visitors should know that the whole building is under surveillance and that all recordings are kept for thirty days.
sentences.zh: 訪客應該知道整棟大樓都在監控之下，所有錄影會保存三十天。

sentences.en: The security team checks the surveillance camera footage every morning to make sure nothing unusual happened overnight.
sentences.zh: 保全團隊每天早上都會檢查監視器畫面，確認夜裡沒有發生異常的事。

words.note: 語塊：surveillance camera（監視器）、under surveillance（受到監控）、video surveillance（影像監控）。surveillance 是「（長時間）監看」；survey 是「調查」；supervision 是「監督」。

sentences.en: It is virtually impossible to find a parking space downtown on Saturday afternoon, so please take the subway.
sentences.zh: 週六下午在市中心幾乎不可能找到停車位，所以請搭地鐵。

sentences.en: Virtually all of the tickets for the concert were sold within the first hour after they went on sale online.
sentences.zh: 演唱會的票開賣後第一個小時內幾乎全部賣光。

sentences.en: Virtually every employee in the company attended the training session on the new computer system last week.
sentences.zh: 公司幾乎每位員工上週都參加了新電腦系統的訓練課程。

sentences.en: The new machine is so quiet that it is virtually impossible to hear it, even when you stand right next to it.
sentences.zh: 新機器非常安靜，即使站在旁邊也幾乎聽不到。

sentences.en: Our products are now available in virtually every supermarket in the country, from large cities to small towns.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品現在在全國幾乎每家超市都買得到，從大城市到小鎮都有。

words.note: 語塊：virtually impossible（幾乎不可能）、virtually all（幾乎全部）、virtually every（幾乎每個）。virtually 在多益常是「幾乎」（= almost）；virtual 是「虛擬的；實質上的」。

sentences.en: All visitors must show a photo ID to the security personnel at the front entrance before entering the building.
sentences.zh: 所有訪客進入大樓前，都必須向正門的保全人員出示有照片的證件。

sentences.en: The concert organizers will hire security personnel to make sure the event is safe for everyone who attends.
sentences.zh: 演唱會主辦單位會雇用保全人員，確保活動對每位參加者都很安全。

sentences.en: If you see a bag that has been left alone, please tell the security personnel at the information desk immediately.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到有人遺留的包包，請立刻告訴服務台的保全人員。

sentences.en: The bank decided to hire security personnel for every branch after a series of robberies in the area.
sentences.zh: 這一區發生一連串搶案後，銀行決定為每家分行雇用保全人員。

sentences.en: Security personnel will check every bag at the stadium entrance, so please arrive at least an hour early.
sentences.zh: 保全人員會在體育場入口檢查每一個包包，所以請至少提早一小時到。

words.note: 語塊：security personnel at（……的保全人員）、hire security personnel（雇用保全人員）。personnel 是「（全體）人員」，是複數概念；personal 是「個人的」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: The new rule will bar anyone who is not an employee from entering the factory without a visitor pass.
sentences.zh: 新規定將禁止任何不是員工的人在沒有訪客證的情況下進入工廠。

sentences.en: The city decided to bar large trucks from the downtown area during rush hour to reduce traffic jams.
sentences.zh: 市政府決定在尖峰時段禁止大卡車進入市中心，以減少塞車。

sentences.en: The league will bar players who break the rules more than twice from taking part in the next tournament.
sentences.zh: 聯盟將禁止違規超過兩次的選手參加下一場比賽。

sentences.en: The police had to bar entry to the street for several hours because of a gas leak in one of the buildings.
sentences.zh: 因為其中一棟大樓瓦斯外洩，警方必須封鎖那條街好幾個小時。

sentences.en: The club may bar members who do not pay their annual fee from using the swimming pool and the gym.
sentences.zh: 俱樂部可能會禁止沒繳年費的會員使用游泳池和健身房。

words.note: 語塊：bar from（禁止……進入／做）、bar entry（禁止進入）。bar 當動詞是「禁止、阻擋」（be barred from）；當名詞是「酒吧；棒；條」。

sentences.en: The start-up hopes to attract an investor from Silicon Valley who can help it expand into the American market.
sentences.zh: 那家新創公司希望吸引一位矽谷的投資人，幫助它擴展到美國市場。

sentences.en: Every foreign investor who buys land in the country must get permission from the government first.
sentences.zh: 每位在這個國家買地的外國投資人都必須先得到政府的許可。

sentences.en: Mr. Sato is a major investor in the new hotel, and he will attend the opening ceremony next month.
sentences.zh: 佐藤先生是新飯店的主要投資人，他下個月會參加開幕典禮。

sentences.en: The CEO will meet with each major investor this week to explain why profits fell in the third quarter.
sentences.zh: 執行長本週會和每位主要投資人見面，說明第三季獲利下滑的原因。

sentences.en: The company lowered its prices on new apartments to attract a foreign investor before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 公司降低了新公寓的價格，希望在年底前吸引外國投資人。

words.note: 語塊：attract investors（吸引投資人）、foreign investor（外國投資人）、major investor（主要投資人）。investor 是「投資的人」；invest 是動詞（invest in）；investment 是「投資（名詞）」。

sentences.en: Customers who purchase online before midnight on Friday will receive free shipping on all of their orders.
sentences.zh: 週五午夜前上網購買的顧客，所有訂單都享免運費。

sentences.en: Please keep your receipt after you make a purchase, because you will need it if you want to return the item later.
sentences.zh: 購買後請保留收據，因為之後如果想退貨會需要它。

sentences.en: Please send the purchase order to the supplier by Wednesday so that the materials arrive before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 請在週三前把採購單寄給供應商，讓材料在月底前送到。

sentences.en: The company plans to purchase three new delivery trucks to handle the increase in online orders.
sentences.zh: 公司計畫購買三台新貨車，以應付網路訂單的增加。

sentences.en: Members who make a purchase of more than fifty dollars will receive a free gift at the counter.
sentences.zh: 購買金額超過五十元的會員可以在櫃台領取一份免費禮物。

words.note: 語塊：purchase online（網購）、make a purchase（購買）、purchase order（採購單）。purchase 比 buy 正式，可以當動詞或名詞；proof of purchase 是「購買證明」。

sentences.en: Our analysts study the market trend every month so that we can change our products to meet customer needs.
sentences.zh: 我們的分析師每個月研究市場趨勢，讓我們能調整產品以符合顧客需求。

sentences.en: The current trend is for young people to rent apartments in the city instead of buying houses in the suburbs.
sentences.zh: 目前的趨勢是年輕人在城市租公寓，而不是在郊區買房子。

sentences.en: Many small clothing stores try to follow a trend quickly, but it is difficult to compete with large brands.
sentences.zh: 很多小服飾店試著快速跟上潮流，但很難和大品牌競爭。

sentences.en: The report shows a clear trend toward online shopping, especially among customers between twenty and forty years old.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示網路購物的明顯趨勢，特別是二十到四十歲的顧客。

sentences.en: If the current trend continues, electric cars will make up half of all new car sales within ten years.
sentences.zh: 如果目前的趨勢持續，電動車十年內將占新車銷量的一半。

words.note: 語塊：market trend（市場趨勢）、current trend（目前的趨勢）、follow a trend（跟隨潮流）。trend 是「趨勢、流行」；trendy 是形容詞「時髦的」。

sentences.en: The company will publish its financial report for the third quarter on its website next Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 公司下週二早上會在網站上公布第三季的財務報告。

sentences.en: The museum received financial support from several local businesses to repair its roof before the winter.
sentences.zh: 博物館獲得幾家當地企業的財務支援，在冬天前修理屋頂。

sentences.en: Many people talk to a financial advisor before they decide how to invest the money they have saved.
sentences.zh: 很多人在決定如何投資存下來的錢之前，會先找理財顧問談。

sentences.en: The new financial software makes it easier for small businesses to track their income and expenses every month.
sentences.zh: 新的財務軟體讓小公司更容易每個月追蹤收入和支出。

sentences.en: The government offers financial support to students who cannot afford to pay for their university education.
sentences.zh: 政府為付不起大學學費的學生提供財務支援。

words.note: 語塊：financial report（財務報告）、financial support（財務支援）、financial advisor（理財顧問）。financial 是 finance（財務）的形容詞；financially 是副詞。

sentences.en: The outdoor concert was canceled due to the weather, and all tickets will be refunded within two weeks.
sentences.zh: 戶外演唱會因為天氣取消，所有門票會在兩週內退款。

sentences.en: Due to a delay at the factory, your order will arrive three days later than we originally promised.
sentences.zh: 由於工廠延誤，您的訂單會比原先承諾的晚三天送到。

sentences.en: Due to high demand, the new phone is out of stock in most stores until the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 由於需求很高，新手機在大部分店家都缺貨到月底。

sentences.en: The meeting was moved to Friday due to the manager's business trip to Singapore this week.
sentences.zh: 因為經理這週要去新加坡出差，會議改到週五。

sentences.en: Prices of fresh vegetables have increased due to the weather, which has been unusually dry this summer.
sentences.zh: 由於今年夏天異常乾燥的天氣，新鮮蔬菜的價格上漲了。

words.note: 語塊：due to the weather（由於天氣）、due to a delay（由於延誤）、due to high demand（由於需求高）。due to 後面接名詞（due to the rain）；接句子要用 because；be due 也有「預定、到期」的意思。

sentences.en: We apologize for the unexpected delay and will do our best to deliver your order as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 我們為意外的延誤致歉，會盡力盡快送達您的訂單。

sentences.en: The engineers found an unexpected problem with the software just one day before it was supposed to launch.
sentences.zh: 工程師在軟體預定上線的前一天發現了意料之外的問題。

sentences.en: The survey produced an unexpected result, since most customers preferred the cheaper version of the product.
sentences.zh: 調查得到意外的結果，因為大部分顧客比較喜歡便宜版本的產品。

sentences.en: Because of an unexpected increase in orders, the factory had to ask workers to work on Saturdays.
sentences.zh: 因為訂單意外增加，工廠不得不請工人週六上班。

sentences.en: Please keep some money in the budget for any unexpected problem that may happen during the project.
sentences.zh: 請在預算裡保留一些錢，應付專案期間可能發生的任何意料之外的問題。

words.note: 語塊：unexpected delay（意外的延誤）、unexpected problem（意料之外的問題）、unexpected result（意外的結果）。unexpected 是「沒預料到的」；unexpectedly 是副詞；expected 是「預期的」。

sentences.en: Mr. Hall was absent from work for two weeks due to illness, so his assistant handled all of his meetings.
sentences.zh: 霍爾先生因病請假兩週，所以他的助理處理了他所有的會議。

sentences.en: The company's insurance plan covers the cost of treatment if an employee develops a serious illness.
sentences.zh: 如果員工罹患重病，公司的保險方案會負擔治療費用。

sentences.en: More companies now offer free counseling to help employees who are dealing with mental illness or stress.
sentences.zh: 現在有更多公司提供免費諮商，幫助正在面對心理疾病或壓力的員工。

sentences.en: Employees who miss more than three days of work due to illness must bring a note from their doctor.
sentences.zh: 因病缺勤超過三天的員工必須帶醫生證明。

sentences.en: The singer canceled the rest of her tour because of a serious illness, and fans received a full refund.
sentences.zh: 那位歌手因為重病取消剩下的巡演，歌迷都拿到全額退款。

words.note: 語塊：serious illness（重病）、due to illness（因病）、mental illness（心理疾病）。illness 是「生病的狀態或疾病」；disease 多指有名稱的具體疾病；ill 是形容詞「生病的」。

sentences.en: The heavy snow will force the airport to cancel most of its flights for the rest of the day.
sentences.zh: 大雪將迫使機場取消今天剩下的大部分航班。

sentences.en: If sales continue to drop, the owners may force the store to close two of its branches in the city center.
sentences.zh: 如果銷售持續下滑，老闆可能會迫使那家店關閉市中心的兩家分店。

sentences.en: Rising fuel prices may force airlines to raise ticket prices again before the summer holiday season.
sentences.zh: 燃料價格上漲可能迫使航空公司在暑假旺季前再次調漲票價。

sentences.en: A problem with the battery could force the company to delay the product launch until next spring.
sentences.zh: 電池的問題可能迫使公司把產品發表延到明年春天。

sentences.en: Nobody can force you to work overtime, but the company pays extra money to those who choose to do it.
sentences.zh: 沒有人能強迫你加班，但公司會給選擇加班的人額外的錢。

words.note: 語塊：force sb to（迫使某人……）、be forced to（被迫……）。force 當動詞是「強迫」；當名詞是「力量；武力」（in force 是「生效中」）。

sentences.en: The government plans to spend more money on the healthcare system to reduce waiting times at hospitals.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫在醫療體系上投入更多經費，縮短醫院的候診時間。

sentences.en: Every healthcare worker at the hospital received a bonus for working long hours during the busy winter months.
sentences.zh: 醫院的每位醫護人員都因為在忙碌的冬季長時間工作而獲得獎金。

sentences.en: Many families worry about rising healthcare costs, especially when they have older parents who need regular care.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭擔心醫療費用上漲，尤其是家裡有需要定期照顧的年長父母時。

sentences.en: The company offers good healthcare benefits, which is one reason why so many people want to work there.
sentences.zh: 公司提供很好的醫療福利，這是很多人想在那裡工作的原因之一。

sentences.en: The new app helps healthcare workers share patient information quickly and safely between different hospitals.
sentences.zh: 新的 App 幫助醫護人員在不同醫院之間快速又安全地分享病人資訊。

words.note: 語塊：healthcare system（醫療體系）、healthcare worker（醫護人員）、healthcare costs（醫療費用）。healthcare 是整體的「醫療照護服務」；health 是「健康」。

sentences.en: All full-time employees can join the company pension scheme after working here for six months.
sentences.zh: 所有正職員工在這裡工作滿六個月後，就可以加入公司的退休金方案。

sentences.en: The new bonus scheme rewards sales staff who bring in more than ten new customers every month.
sentences.zh: 新的獎金制度會獎勵每個月帶進十個以上新客戶的業務人員。

sentences.en: The government started a training scheme to help young people find jobs in the technology sector.
sentences.zh: 政府推出一項訓練計畫，幫助年輕人在科技產業找工作。

sentences.en: Workers said the new bonus scheme was unfair because it only rewarded people in the sales department.
sentences.zh: 員工說新的獎金制度不公平，因為只獎勵業務部的人。

sentences.en: The city's recycling scheme has reduced the amount of waste sent to landfills by almost forty percent.
sentences.zh: 市政府的回收計畫讓送到掩埋場的垃圾量減少了將近四成。

words.note: 語塊：pension scheme（退休金方案）、bonus scheme（獎金制度）、training scheme（訓練計畫）。scheme 在英式英文常指正式的「計畫、方案」；在美式英文有時帶「詭計」的負面意思。

sentences.en: The law firm offers a free consultation to new clients who want advice about starting a small business.
sentences.zh: 那家律師事務所為想諮詢開小公司的新客戶提供免費諮詢。

sentences.en: The new safety rules were written in consultation with the workers who use the machines every day.
sentences.zh: 新的安全規定是和每天使用機器的工人商議後制定的。

sentences.en: The consultation fee is one hundred dollars, but it will be returned if you decide to use our service.
sentences.zh: 諮詢費是一百元，但如果你決定使用我們的服務就會退還。

sentences.en: Please call our office to book a consultation with one of our financial advisors next week.
sentences.zh: 請打電話到我們辦公室，預約下週和我們的理財顧問諮詢。

sentences.en: The city will design the new park in consultation with local residents, who can share ideas online.
sentences.zh: 市政府會和當地居民商議設計新公園，居民可以在網路上分享想法。

words.note: 語塊：free consultation（免費諮詢）、in consultation with（與……商議）、consultation fee（諮詢費）。consultation 是 consult（諮詢）的名詞；consultant 是「顧問」。

sentences.en: Could you put together a report on last month's sales figures before the meeting on Thursday?
sentences.zh: 你能在週四開會前彙整一份上個月銷售數字的報告嗎？

sentences.en: The director asked Ms. Kim to put together a team of five people to plan the company's anniversary event.
sentences.zh: 主任請金小姐組成一個五人團隊，籌劃公司的週年活動。

sentences.en: Our consultants will put together a plan to help the company reduce its costs by ten percent next year.
sentences.zh: 我們的顧問會擬定一個計畫，幫助公司明年降低一成的成本。

sentences.en: It took the workers only two hours to put together all of the new desks in the office.
sentences.zh: 工人只花了兩個小時就把辦公室所有的新桌子組裝好了。

sentences.en: Before the trade show, please put together a list of all of the products that we will display at our booth.
sentences.zh: 展覽前，請整理出一份我們攤位要展示的所有產品清單。

words.note: 語塊：put together a report（彙整報告）、put together a team（組成團隊）、put together a plan（擬定計畫）。put together 是「把東西組合起來；整理出」；assemble 是比較正式的說法。

sentences.en: Applicants with previous experience in customer service will be given priority for the position at our new branch in Kaohsiung.
sentences.zh: 有客服相關經驗的應徵者應徵我們高雄新分店的職位時會優先錄取。

sentences.en: Sales this year were twenty percent higher than in the previous year, mainly because of the new product.
sentences.zh: 今年的銷售比前一年高兩成，主要是因為新產品。

sentences.en: The previous owner of the restaurant moved to Canada, but he still visits the restaurant every summer.
sentences.zh: 餐廳的前任老闆搬到加拿大了，但他每年夏天還是會回來看看。

sentences.en: Please read the minutes of the previous meeting before you come to the discussion on Monday.
sentences.zh: 週一來參加討論前，請先看上次會議的紀錄。

sentences.en: The new manager has no previous experience in the food industry, but she learns very quickly.
sentences.zh: 新經理沒有餐飲業的經驗，但她學得很快。

words.note: 語塊：previous experience（先前的經驗）、previous year（前一年）、previous owner（前任屋主）。previous 是「之前的」；previously 是副詞「先前」；precious 是「珍貴的」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: The price of the tour is inclusive of hotel rooms, all meals, and transportation between the cities.
sentences.zh: 這個行程的價格包含飯店住宿、所有餐點和城市之間的交通。

sentences.en: Many families choose an all-inclusive resort so that they do not have to worry about extra costs.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭選擇全包式度假村，這樣就不用擔心額外費用。

sentences.en: The company wants to build an inclusive workplace where employees from every background feel welcome.
sentences.zh: 公司想打造一個包容的職場，讓不同背景的員工都感到被接納。

sentences.en: All prices on the menu are inclusive of tax, but the service charge will be added to your bill.
sentences.zh: 菜單上所有價格都含稅，但服務費會另外加在帳單上。

sentences.en: Our new training program helps managers create a more inclusive workplace for people with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 我們的新訓練計畫幫助主管為身心障礙者打造更包容的職場。

words.note: 語塊：all-inclusive（全包的）、inclusive of（包含……）、inclusive workplace（包容的職場）。inclusive 是「包括在內的」；include 是動詞；exclusive 是相反詞「獨家的；不包括的」。

sentences.en: Money that you give to a registered charity can be used as a tax deduction at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 捐給登記有案的慈善機構的錢，年底可以拿來抵稅。

sentences.en: The monthly salary deduction for health insurance will increase slightly starting in January because of the new government rules.
sentences.zh: 健康保險每月的薪資扣款因為政府的新規定，從一月開始會稍微增加。

sentences.en: The company will make a deduction from your final payment if any office equipment is not returned.
sentences.zh: 如果沒有歸還任何辦公設備，公司會從你最後一筆薪水中扣除。

sentences.en: Please check your pay slip carefully and tell the accounting office if any deduction looks wrong.
sentences.zh: 請仔細檢查你的薪資單，如果任何扣款看起來有誤，請告訴會計室。

sentences.en: Small business owners can get a tax deduction for some of the money they spend on office supplies.
sentences.zh: 小企業主花在辦公用品上的部分費用可以拿來抵稅。

words.note: 語塊：tax deduction（減稅；稅額扣除）、salary deduction（薪資扣款）、make a deduction（扣除）。deduction 是 deduct（扣除）的名詞，也可以是「推論」（deduce 的名詞）；reduction 是「減少」。

words.meaning: 心事重重的；全神貫注於……的

sentences.en: The manager seemed preoccupied with the budget problems and did not hear my question during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 經理似乎一直在想預算的問題，會議中沒聽到我的問題。

sentences.en: Many employees are preoccupied with the merger and worry about whether they will keep their jobs.
sentences.zh: 很多員工滿腦子都是合併的事，擔心自己能不能保住工作。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin was so preoccupied with her presentation that she forgot to eat lunch on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 林小姐全神貫注在簡報上，週二連午餐都忘了吃。

sentences.en: Please do not let customers feel ignored, even if you are preoccupied with other tasks at the counter.
sentences.zh: 即使你在櫃台忙著其他事，也請不要讓顧客覺得被忽視。

sentences.en: The CEO was preoccupied with the new factory project, so she asked her assistant to handle the interviews.
sentences.zh: 執行長全心投入新工廠的專案，所以請助理處理面試。

words.note: 語塊：preoccupied with（全神貫注於……；被……佔據心思）。preoccupied 是「心裡一直想著某件事而分心」；occupied 是「忙碌的；有人使用的」。

sentences.en: Many customers are still hesitant to buy electric cars because there are not enough charging stations in the city.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客還是不太願意買電動車，因為市區的充電站不夠多。

sentences.en: The board was hesitant about opening a new store overseas until the market research was finished.
sentences.zh: 在市場調查完成之前，董事會對在海外開新店一直很猶豫。

sentences.en: New employees are often hesitant to ask questions, so managers should make them feel comfortable from the first day.
sentences.zh: 新員工常常不太敢發問，所以主管應該從第一天就讓他們感到自在。

sentences.en: Some investors were hesitant about the project because the company had never worked in that industry before.
sentences.zh: 有些投資人對這個專案很猶豫，因為公司以前從沒做過那個產業。

sentences.en: If you are hesitant to sign the contract, please ask our lawyer to explain any part that is not clear.
sentences.zh: 如果你對簽約還有疑慮，請讓我們的律師解釋任何不清楚的部分。

words.note: 語塊：hesitant to do（不太願意做……）、hesitant about（對……猶豫）。hesitant 是形容詞；hesitate 是動詞（Please don't hesitate to contact us）；hesitation 是名詞。

sentences.en: Every employee will have a performance evaluation with his or her manager at the end of December.
sentences.zh: 每位員工都會在十二月底和主管進行績效考核。

sentences.en: Please fill out the evaluation form after the training session so that we can improve the course next time.
sentences.zh: 訓練課程結束後請填寫評估表，讓我們下次能改進課程。

sentences.en: After careful evaluation of all of the proposals, the committee chose the design from a small local company.
sentences.zh: 仔細評估所有提案後，委員會選了一家當地小公司的設計。

sentences.en: Workers who receive a good performance evaluation are more likely to get a raise and a bonus next year.
sentences.zh: 績效考核好的員工明年比較有可能加薪和拿到獎金。

sentences.en: The evaluation form asks participants to rate the speaker, the materials, and the location of the seminar.
sentences.zh: 評估表請參加者為講者、教材和研討會場地評分。

words.note: 語塊：performance evaluation（績效考核）、evaluation form（評估表）、careful evaluation（仔細評估）。evaluation 是 evaluate（評估）的名詞；assessment 意思接近。

sentences.en: We expect to receive the new parts from our supplier by the end of next week at the latest.
sentences.zh: 我們預計最晚下週末會收到供應商的新零件。

sentences.en: We expect the new shopping mall to attract more than ten thousand visitors on its first weekend.
sentences.zh: 我們預計新購物中心在第一個週末會吸引一萬多名遊客。

sentences.en: As we expect, sales of air conditioners will increase sharply when the summer season begins next month.
sentences.zh: 如我們預期，下個月夏天一開始，冷氣的銷量就會大幅增加。

sentences.en: The company does not expect to hire any new employees until the economy improves next year.
sentences.zh: 公司預計在明年經濟好轉之前不會雇用新員工。

sentences.en: Passengers should expect delays on the highway this weekend because of the road construction near the airport.
sentences.zh: 因為機場附近在施工，旅客這個週末在高速公路上要有塞車的心理準備。

words.note: 語塊：expect to do（預計做……）、as expected（如預期）。expect 是「預期會發生」；wait for 是「等待」；expectation 是名詞「期望」。

sentences.en: I have called the customer service center multiple times, but nobody has solved the problem with my order.
sentences.zh: 我打了好幾次客服中心，但沒有人解決我的訂單問題。

sentences.en: The company has offices in multiple locations across Asia, including Tokyo, Seoul, Bangkok, and Singapore.
sentences.zh: 公司在亞洲多個地點設有辦公室，包括東京、首爾、曼谷和新加坡。

sentences.en: The test has forty multiple choice questions, and students have one hour to answer all of them.
sentences.zh: 考試有四十題選擇題，學生有一個小時作答。

sentences.en: The new software allows multiple users to work on the same document at the same time from different offices.
sentences.zh: 新軟體讓多位使用者可以在不同的辦公室同時編輯同一份文件。

sentences.en: Ms. Davis has visited the factory multiple times this year to check the quality of the products.
sentences.zh: 戴維斯小姐今年去了工廠好幾次，檢查產品品質。

words.note: 語塊：multiple times（好幾次）、multiple locations（多個地點）、multiple choice（選擇題）。multiple 是「很多個、不只一個」；multiply 是動詞「乘；增加」。

sentences.en: Every local resident is invited to a meeting at the library to discuss the plan for the new park.
sentences.zh: 每位當地居民都受邀到圖書館參加會議，討論新公園的計畫。

sentences.en: As a resident of the building, you can use the gym and the swimming pool on the roof for free.
sentences.zh: 身為大樓住戶，你可以免費使用頂樓的健身房和游泳池。

sentences.en: Mrs. Taylor has been a long-time resident of this neighborhood and knows almost everyone on the street.
sentences.zh: 泰勒太太是這個社區的長期住戶，幾乎認識街上的每個人。

sentences.en: The city will give each resident a free recycling bin to encourage people to sort their waste.
sentences.zh: 市政府會給每位居民一個免費的回收桶，鼓勵大家做垃圾分類。

sentences.en: A local resident complained that the noise from the construction site starts too early every morning.
sentences.zh: 一位當地居民抱怨工地的噪音每天早上都太早開始。

words.note: 語塊：local resident（當地居民）、resident of（……的居民）、long-time resident（長期住戶）。resident 是「住在某地的人」；residence 是「住所」；residential 是「住宅的」。

sentences.en: The company encourages energy conservation by turning off all lights and computers after seven in the evening.
sentences.zh: 公司鼓勵節約能源，晚上七點後關掉所有的燈和電腦。

sentences.en: During the dry season, the city asks every resident to practice water conservation at home.
sentences.zh: 乾季期間，市政府請每位居民在家節約用水。

sentences.en: The zoo donates part of its ticket sales to wildlife conservation programs in Africa and South America.
sentences.zh: 動物園把部分門票收入捐給非洲和南美洲的野生動物保育計畫。

sentences.en: The new building was designed with energy conservation in mind, so it uses forty percent less electricity.
sentences.zh: 新大樓在設計時就考慮了節約能源，所以用電量少了四成。

sentences.en: Students from the local university volunteer every summer to help with wildlife conservation in the national park.
sentences.zh: 當地大學的學生每年夏天都去國家公園當志工，協助野生動物保育。

words.note: 語塊：energy conservation（節約能源）、water conservation（節約用水）、wildlife conservation（野生動物保育）。conservation 是「保護、節約」；conversation 是「對話」，拼法很像；conserve 是動詞。

sentences.en: Many employees think that long meetings without a clear goal are a waste of time and money.
sentences.zh: 很多員工認為沒有明確目標的長時間會議既浪費時間又浪費錢。

sentences.en: The restaurant tries to reduce waste by giving leftover food to a local charity every evening.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳每天晚上把剩下的食物送給當地的慈善機構，以減少浪費。

sentences.en: Supermarkets are looking for new ways to cut food waste, such as selling fruit at lower prices before it goes bad.
sentences.zh: 超市在尋找減少廚餘的新方法，例如在水果壞掉前降價販售。

sentences.en: The factory reduced its waste by recycling plastic and paper and by using fewer materials in its packaging.
sentences.zh: 工廠藉由回收塑膠和紙類，以及減少包裝材料，降低了廢棄物。

sentences.en: Printing every e-mail is a waste of paper, so please read your messages on the screen whenever possible.
sentences.zh: 把每封電子郵件都印出來很浪費紙，所以請盡量在螢幕上閱讀。

words.note: 語塊：waste of time（浪費時間）、reduce waste（減少浪費）、food waste（廚餘）。waste 可以當名詞或動詞「浪費」；waist 是「腰」，發音一樣。

sentences.en: The online shopping market has grown rapidly over the past five years, especially among older customers.
sentences.zh: 網路購物市場在過去五年快速成長，特別是在年長顧客之間。

sentences.en: Technology changes so rapidly that our engineers must attend training courses every year to stay up to date.
sentences.zh: 科技變化得太快，所以我們的工程師每年都必須參加訓練課程以跟上最新發展。

sentences.en: The number of tourists visiting the island has increased rapidly since the new airport opened last year.
sentences.zh: 自從去年新機場啟用後，造訪那座島的遊客人數迅速增加。

sentences.en: The company is growing rapidly, and it plans to hire more than two hundred new workers next year.
sentences.zh: 公司正快速成長，計畫明年雇用兩百多名新員工。

sentences.en: Prices of fresh vegetables can change rapidly when there is a typhoon or a long period of heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 遇到颱風或長時間大雨時，新鮮蔬菜的價格可能會迅速變化。

words.note: 語塊：grow rapidly（快速成長）、change rapidly（快速變化）、increase rapidly（迅速增加）。rapidly 是 rapid（快速的）的副詞；quickly 意思接近。

sentences.en: The technician said we need to order a spare part from Germany before he can repair the machine.
sentences.zh: 技術人員說我們要先從德國訂一個備用零件，他才能修機器。

sentences.en: More than three hundred companies will take part in the international trade show in Shanghai next month.
sentences.zh: 下個月將有三百多家公司參加在上海舉行的國際展覽。

sentences.en: Customer service is an important part of our business, so all new staff receive two weeks of training.
sentences.zh: 客戶服務是我們事業很重要的一部分，所以所有新員工都要接受兩週的訓練。

sentences.en: All employees are encouraged to take part in the charity run that the company organizes every spring.
sentences.zh: 公司鼓勵所有員工參加每年春天舉辦的慈善路跑。

sentences.en: The warehouse keeps every spare part in stock so that broken machines can be repaired within one day.
sentences.zh: 倉庫備有每一種備用零件，讓壞掉的機器可以在一天內修好。

words.note: 語塊：spare part（備用零件）、take part in（參加）、part of（……的一部分）。part 可以是「部分」或機器的「零件」；take part in 等於 participate in（參加）。

sentences.en: The new phone will be available exclusively in our online store until the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 新手機到月底前只在我們的網路商店獨家販售。

sentences.en: The parking lot on the second floor is reserved exclusively for hotel guests and their visitors.
sentences.zh: 二樓的停車場只保留給飯店房客和他們的訪客。

sentences.en: This special menu was created exclusively for the anniversary event and will not be offered again.
sentences.zh: 這份特別菜單是專門為週年活動設計的，之後不會再提供。

sentences.en: The lounge is open exclusively for members of our reward program who travel in business class.
sentences.zh: 那間貴賓室只開放給搭乘商務艙的獎勵方案會員。

sentences.en: The designer's new collection is available exclusively at one department store in each major city.
sentences.zh: 那位設計師的新系列只在各大城市的一家百貨公司獨家販售。

words.note: 語塊：available exclusively（獨家販售）、exclusively for（專門給……）。exclusively 是「只、獨家」；exclusive 是形容詞「獨家的；高級的」；only 意思接近。

sentences.en: The building contractor promised that the new office would be finished before the end of September.
sentences.zh: 營造承包商保證新辦公室會在九月底前完工。

sentences.en: We plan to hire a contractor to repair the roof and paint the walls of the warehouse next month.
sentences.zh: 我們打算下個月雇用承包商修理屋頂並粉刷倉庫的牆壁。

sentences.en: Ms. Ford works as an independent contractor and designs websites for several small businesses in the city.
sentences.zh: 福特小姐是獨立承包人，為市內幾家小公司設計網站。

sentences.en: The city will hire a contractor from another region because no local company could do the job on time.
sentences.zh: 因為沒有本地公司能準時完成工作，市政府會雇用其他地區的承包商。

sentences.en: Before you hire a contractor, please ask for a written estimate and check reviews from previous customers.
sentences.zh: 雇用承包商之前，請先索取書面估價，並查看之前客戶的評價。

words.note: 語塊：building contractor（營造承包商）、hire a contractor（雇用承包商）、independent contractor（獨立承包人）。contractor 是接案或承包工程的人或公司；contract 是「合約」；contractual 是「合約上的」。

sentences.en: Every recent graduate who joins the sales team will receive six months of training before meeting any customers.
sentences.zh: 每位加入業務團隊的應屆畢業生在見客戶之前都會接受六個月的訓練。

sentences.en: Every university graduate who joins our company will work in three different departments during the first year.
sentences.zh: 每位加入公司的大學畢業生第一年都會在三個不同的部門工作。

sentences.en: Ms. Ito plans to graduate from business school next spring and hopes to work in the finance industry.
sentences.zh: 伊藤小姐打算明年春天從商學院畢業，希望在金融業工作。

sentences.en: This program helps each recent graduate find a job that matches his or her skills and interests.
sentences.zh: 這個計畫幫助每位應屆畢業生找到符合自己技能和興趣的工作。

sentences.en: The bank is looking for a university graduate with a degree in economics and strong computer skills.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行在找一位有經濟學學位、電腦能力強的大學畢業生。

words.note: 語塊：recent graduate（應屆畢業生）、university graduate（大學畢業生）、graduate from（從……畢業）。graduate 可以當名詞「畢業生」或動詞「畢業」（graduate from）；graduation 是「畢業」。

sentences.en: As a thank-you, the café gives every loyal customer a free cup of coffee after ten visits.
sentences.zh: 為了表示感謝，咖啡廳讓每位忠實顧客在消費十次後得到一杯免費咖啡。

sentences.en: The store sends a special discount to each loyal customer on his or her birthday every year.
sentences.zh: 那家店每年在每位忠實顧客生日時寄送特別折扣。

sentences.en: It is much cheaper to keep a loyal customer than to find a new one, so good service is very important.
sentences.zh: 留住一位忠實顧客比找一位新顧客便宜很多，所以好的服務非常重要。

sentences.en: The hotel wants to reward every loyal customer by offering a free room upgrade during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 飯店想在假期期間提供免費升等來回饋每位忠實顧客。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim has been a loyal customer of our bank for more than thirty years, so we invited him to our anniversary party.
sentences.zh: 金先生當我們銀行的忠實顧客三十多年了，所以我們邀請他參加週年派對。

words.note: 語塊：loyal customer of（……的忠實顧客）、reward a loyal customer（回饋忠實顧客）、keep a loyal customer（留住忠實顧客）。loyal 是「忠誠的」；loyalty 是名詞（loyalty program 是「會員回饋方案」）。

sentences.en: The company had to act swiftly to fix the problem after hundreds of customers complained on social media.
sentences.zh: 數百名顧客在社群媒體上抱怨後，公司必須迅速行動解決問題。

sentences.en: Our customer service team will respond swiftly to every e-mail, usually within two hours on weekdays.
sentences.zh: 我們的客服團隊會迅速回覆每封電子郵件，平日通常兩小時內就會回覆。

sentences.en: The two companies moved swiftly to complete the merger before the end of the financial year.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司快速推進，在會計年度結束前完成了合併。

sentences.en: The fire department responded swiftly, and nobody was hurt when the fire started in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 消防局迅速反應，廚房起火時沒有人受傷。

sentences.en: If the government does not act swiftly, the price of rice may continue to rise for several months.
sentences.zh: 如果政府不迅速行動，米價可能會持續上漲好幾個月。

words.note: 語塊：act swiftly（迅速行動）、respond swiftly（迅速回應）、move swiftly（快速推進）。swiftly 是 swift（迅速的）的副詞；quickly 意思一樣；shiftily 是「狡猾地」。

sentences.en: All customer information is stored securely on our servers and cannot be seen by anyone outside the company.
sentences.zh: 所有顧客資料都安全地存放在我們的伺服器上，公司以外的人無法看到。

sentences.en: Please make sure your seat belt is fastened securely before the plane takes off and during the whole flight.
sentences.zh: 飛機起飛前和整個飛行期間，請確認安全帶已牢牢繫緊。

sentences.en: The doors of the warehouse must be securely locked every night after the last delivery truck leaves.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上最後一台送貨卡車離開後，倉庫的門都必須牢牢鎖上。

sentences.en: Packages are wrapped securely in thick paper so that nothing inside is damaged during delivery.
sentences.zh: 包裹都用厚紙牢牢包好，讓裡面的東西在運送中不會損壞。

sentences.en: Employees can now pay their bills securely through the company's new mobile app without visiting the bank.
sentences.zh: 員工現在可以透過公司的新手機 App 安全地繳帳單，不用跑銀行。

words.note: 語塊：store securely（安全地保存）、fasten securely（牢牢繫緊）、securely locked（牢牢鎖上）。securely 是 secure（安全的；牢固的）的副詞；safely 意思接近。

sentences.en: All flights from the airport were canceled yesterday because of a severe blizzard that lasted for twelve hours.
sentences.zh: 因為一場持續十二小時的嚴重暴風雪，昨天機場所有航班都取消了。

sentences.en: The government issued a blizzard warning, so most schools and offices in the city will be closed tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 政府發布了暴風雪警報，所以市區大部分的學校和辦公室明天都會關閉。

sentences.en: The delivery company warned customers that packages might arrive late because of the blizzard in the north.
sentences.zh: 貨運公司提醒顧客，因為北部的暴風雪，包裹可能會晚到。

sentences.en: Several drivers were stuck on the highway for hours during the blizzard until rescue teams arrived.
sentences.zh: 暴風雪期間，好幾位駕駛被困在高速公路上好幾個小時，直到救援隊抵達。

sentences.en: Please stay indoors during the blizzard warning and do not drive unless it is an emergency.
sentences.zh: 暴風雪警報期間請待在室內，除非緊急情況否則不要開車。

words.note: 語塊：severe blizzard（嚴重的暴風雪）、blizzard warning（暴風雪警報）。blizzard 是強風加大雪的「暴風雪」；snowstorm 意思接近但較弱；hailstorm 是「冰雹」。

sentences.en: The flight was delayed because of poor visibility caused by thick fog over the airport.
sentences.zh: 班機因為機場上空濃霧造成的能見度差而延誤。

sentences.en: Drivers should slow down and turn on their lights when there is low visibility on the highway.
sentences.zh: 高速公路上能見度低時，駕駛應該減速並打開車燈。

sentences.en: Advertising on social media can increase visibility for small businesses that do not have a large budget.
sentences.zh: 在社群媒體打廣告可以為預算不多的小公司提高曝光度。

sentences.en: The marketing team hopes the sports event will increase visibility of our brand among young people.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊希望這場運動賽事能提高我們品牌在年輕人之間的曝光度。

sentences.en: Because of poor visibility, the ferry service between the two islands was stopped for the whole afternoon.
sentences.zh: 因為能見度差，兩座島之間的渡輪服務整個下午都停駛。

words.note: 語塊：poor visibility（能見度差）、low visibility（能見度低）、increase visibility（提高曝光度）。visibility 是 visible（看得見的）的名詞；可以指天氣的「能見度」或品牌的「曝光度」。

sentences.en: We sincerely apologize for the delay in your order and will give you a discount on your next purchase.
sentences.zh: 我們對您訂單的延誤誠心道歉，下次購物會給您折扣。

sentences.en: I sincerely hope that you will be able to attend our anniversary dinner at the hotel next Friday.
sentences.zh: 我衷心希望您能參加下週五在飯店舉行的週年晚宴。

sentences.en: The manager sincerely thanked the team for working late every night to finish the project on time.
sentences.zh: 經理真誠地感謝團隊每天晚上加班，準時完成專案。

sentences.en: The company would like to sincerely apologize to all passengers who were affected by the cancellation of the flight.
sentences.zh: 公司想向所有受到航班取消影響的乘客誠心道歉。

sentences.en: We sincerely hope that the new schedule will make it easier for employees to balance work and family life.
sentences.zh: 我們衷心希望新的班表能讓員工更容易兼顧工作和家庭生活。

words.note: 語塊：sincerely apologize（誠心道歉）、sincerely hope（衷心希望）、Yours sincerely（敬上）。sincerely 是 sincere（真誠的）的副詞；常用在信件結尾 Sincerely / Yours sincerely。

sentences.en: The package is still in transit, but it should arrive at your office by Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 包裹還在運送中，但應該會在週四下午前送到你的辦公室。

sentences.en: Many people in the city use public transit to get to work because parking downtown is very expensive.
sentences.zh: 市區很多人搭大眾運輸上班，因為市中心停車非常貴。

sentences.en: Each transit passenger must stay in the airport and show a boarding pass for the next flight.
sentences.zh: 每位轉機旅客都必須待在機場內，並出示下一班飛機的登機證。

sentences.en: Some of the glasses were broken in transit, so we will send you a new set at no extra cost.
sentences.zh: 有些玻璃杯在運送途中破了，所以我們會免費寄一組新的給您。

sentences.en: The government plans to improve public transit by adding more buses and extending the subway lines.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫增加公車班次、延長地鐵路線來改善大眾運輸。

words.note: 語塊：in transit（運送中）、public transit（大眾運輸）、transit passenger（轉機旅客）。transit 是「運送、通過」；transition 是「轉變」；transport 是「運輸」。

sentences.en: Sales of printed newspapers continue to decline sharply as more people read the news on their phones.
sentences.zh: 隨著更多人用手機看新聞，紙本報紙的銷量持續大幅下降。

sentences.en: Mr. Hughes decided to decline the offer from the bank because he wanted to stay closer to his family.
sentences.zh: 休斯先生決定婉拒那家銀行的工作邀請，因為他想離家人近一點。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, I must decline your invitation to the dinner because I will be on a business trip that week.
sentences.zh: 很遺憾，我必須婉拒您的晚餐邀請，因為那週我要出差。

sentences.en: The number of visitors to the museum began to decline after the new art center opened downtown.
sentences.zh: 市中心新的藝術中心開幕後，博物館的參觀人數開始下降。

sentences.en: The company may decline an offer to buy its factory if the price is lower than the value of the land.
sentences.zh: 如果價格低於土地價值，公司可能會婉拒收購工廠的提議。

words.note: 語塊：decline sharply（大幅下降）、decline an offer（婉拒提議）、decline an invitation（婉拒邀請）。decline 可以是「減少、下降」或「禮貌地拒絕」；當名詞是「下降」（a decline in sales）。

sentences.en: Please mention that you are a member of our reward program when you make a reservation by phone.
sentences.zh: 打電話訂位時，請提到你是我們獎勵方案的會員。

sentences.en: The manager did not mention the new policy during the meeting, so many employees were surprised by the e-mail.
sentences.zh: 經理在會議中沒有提到新規定，所以很多員工看到電子郵件時都很驚訝。

sentences.en: The hotel has a great view of the ocean, not to mention a beautiful pool and an excellent restaurant.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店有很棒的海景，更不用說還有漂亮的游泳池和很棒的餐廳。

sentences.en: In his speech, the CEO will mention that the company plans to open three new stores in Asia next year.
sentences.zh: 執行長會在演講中提到，公司明年打算在亞洲開三家新店。

sentences.en: Did the client mention whether she would like to meet on Tuesday or Wednesday next week?
sentences.zh: 客戶有提到她想在下週二還是週三見面嗎？

words.note: 語塊：mention that（提到……）、as mentioned（如前所述）、not to mention（更不用說）。mention 後面直接接受詞，不加 about（mention the problem）；當名詞是「提及」。

words.meaning: 令人滿意的；符合要求的

sentences.en: After three months of testing, the engineers finally achieved a satisfactory result with the new battery.
sentences.zh: 經過三個月的測試，工程師終於在新電池上得到令人滿意的結果。

sentences.en: Employees who show satisfactory performance during the probation period will be offered a permanent contract.
sentences.zh: 試用期間表現合格的員工會獲得正式合約。

sentences.en: The customer said that the service at the hotel was less than satisfactory and asked for a partial refund.
sentences.zh: 那位顧客說飯店的服務不太令人滿意，並要求部分退款。

sentences.en: If the quality of the products is not satisfactory, we will replace them or give you your money back.
sentences.zh: 如果產品品質不令人滿意，我們會更換或退款給您。

sentences.en: The report says the factory's safety standards are satisfactory, but there are still a few areas to improve.
sentences.zh: 報告說工廠的安全標準符合要求，但還是有幾個地方需要改進。

words.note: 語塊：satisfactory result（令人滿意的結果）、satisfactory performance（合格的表現）、less than satisfactory（不太令人滿意）。satisfactory 是「夠好、符合標準的」；satisfied 是「（人）感到滿意的」；satisfying 是「令人滿足的」。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the item you ordered is out of stock, but we can send it to you next week.
sentences.zh: 很遺憾，您訂購的商品缺貨，但我們下週可以寄給您。

sentences.en: The outdoor event was unfortunately canceled because of the heavy rain, so all tickets will be refunded.
sentences.zh: 戶外活動很遺憾地因大雨取消，所以所有門票都會退款。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, Ms. Brown will not be able to attend the meeting because her flight from London was delayed.
sentences.zh: 很遺憾，布朗小姐無法參加會議，因為她從倫敦出發的班機延誤了。

sentences.en: We received many excellent applications, but unfortunately we can only offer the position to one person.
sentences.zh: 我們收到很多很優秀的申請，但很遺憾，這個職位只能錄取一個人。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the restaurant is fully booked on Friday evening, so would you like a table on Saturday instead?
sentences.zh: 很遺憾，餐廳週五晚上已經訂滿了，您要改訂週六的位子嗎？

words.note: 語塊：unfortunately, …（很遺憾，……）。unfortunately 常放句首表示「很遺憾」；fortunately 是相反「幸好」；unfortunate 是形容詞。

sentences.en: If you have already paid your bill, please disregard this message and accept our thanks.
sentences.zh: 如果您已經繳費，請忽略這則訊息，並接受我們的感謝。

sentences.en: Workers who disregard the safety rules in the factory may be asked to leave their jobs.
sentences.zh: 在工廠裡無視安全規定的工人可能會被要求離職。

sentences.en: Some drivers disregard the warning signs and drive too fast on the narrow mountain road.
sentences.zh: 有些駕駛不理警告標誌，在狹窄的山路上開太快。

sentences.en: Please disregard the e-mail you received this morning, because it contained the wrong meeting time.
sentences.zh: 請忽略您今天早上收到的電子郵件，因為裡面的會議時間錯了。

sentences.en: Managers should never disregard complaints from customers, even if they seem small or unimportant at first.
sentences.zh: 主管絕對不應該忽視顧客的抱怨，即使一開始看起來很小或不重要。

words.note: 語塊：please disregard（請忽略）、disregard the rules（無視規定）、disregard the warning（不理警告）。disregard 是「不理會、不當一回事」；ignore 意思接近；regard 是「看待」。

sentences.en: Workers must wear gloves and masks when they handle hazardous materials in the laboratory or the storage room.
sentences.zh: 工人在實驗室或儲藏室處理有害物質時必須戴手套和口罩。

sentences.en: The factory pays a special company to remove its hazardous waste safely from the site every month.
sentences.zh: 工廠每個月付錢請專門的公司從廠區安全地清除有害廢棄物。

sentences.en: Because of hazardous conditions on the roads, the city asked residents to stay at home during the storm.
sentences.zh: 因為道路狀況危險，市政府請居民在暴風雨期間待在家裡。

sentences.en: Batteries are hazardous waste, so please do not throw them away with your normal garbage.
sentences.zh: 電池是有害廢棄物，所以請不要和一般垃圾一起丟掉。

sentences.en: All containers of hazardous materials must have clear labels that explain how to store them safely.
sentences.zh: 所有裝有害物質的容器都必須有清楚的標籤，說明如何安全存放。

words.note: 語塊：hazardous materials（有害物質）、hazardous waste（有害廢棄物）、hazardous conditions（危險的狀況）。hazardous 是 hazard（危險）的形容詞；dangerous 意思接近。

sentences.en: The company hired a seasoned professional with twenty years of experience to manage its overseas offices.
sentences.zh: 公司雇用了一位有二十年經驗的資深專業人士來管理海外辦公室。

sentences.en: As a seasoned traveler, Ms. Wong always packs light and never checks in any luggage.
sentences.zh: 身為旅行老手，王小姐總是輕裝出門，從不託運行李。

sentences.en: The chicken is seasoned with garlic, lemon, and fresh herbs before it is grilled over an open fire.
sentences.zh: 雞肉在明火燒烤前會先用大蒜、檸檬和新鮮香草調味。

sentences.en: The new project manager is a seasoned professional who has worked on many large construction projects.
sentences.zh: 新的專案經理是一位資深專業人士，參與過很多大型建設案。

sentences.en: Even a seasoned traveler can get lost in this city because the streets are narrow and the signs are confusing.
sentences.zh: 即使是旅行老手在這座城市也會迷路，因為街道很窄、路標也很混亂。

words.note: 語塊：seasoned professional（資深專業人士）、seasoned traveler（旅行老手）、seasoned with（用……調味）。seasoned 指人時是「老練的」（= experienced）；指食物時是「調味過的」；season 是「季節；調味」。

sentences.en: Working at the international hotel gave me invaluable experience in dealing with customers from many countries.
sentences.zh: 在國際飯店工作讓我獲得和各國顧客打交道的寶貴經驗。

sentences.en: Thank you for your invaluable advice, which helped us choose the right location for our new store.
sentences.zh: 謝謝您寶貴的建議，幫助我們為新店選對地點。

sentences.en: The new software will prove invaluable for managers who need to check sales figures quickly.
sentences.zh: 新軟體對需要快速查看銷售數字的主管會非常有用。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed has been an invaluable member of the team, and we will miss her when she retires next month.
sentences.zh: 阿哈邁德小姐一直是團隊非常寶貴的成員，她下個月退休時我們會很想念她。

sentences.en: The mentor program gives new employees invaluable advice from people who have worked here for many years.
sentences.zh: 導師計畫讓新員工得到在這裡工作多年的人的寶貴建議。

words.note: 語塊：invaluable experience（寶貴的經驗）、invaluable advice（寶貴的建議）、prove invaluable（證明非常有用）。invaluable 是「非常有價值的」，不是「沒價值」！沒價值是 valueless 或 worthless。

sentences.en: The manager had to put off the meeting until Friday because several team members were sick this week.
sentences.zh: 因為這週好幾位組員生病，經理不得不把會議延到週五。

sentences.en: The board decided to put off a decision about the new factory until the market research is finished.
sentences.zh: 董事會決定等市場調查完成後再做新工廠的決定。

sentences.en: Many people put off doing their taxes until the last week, so the tax office is always very busy in May.
sentences.zh: 很多人把報稅拖到最後一週，所以稅務局五月總是非常忙。

sentences.en: Please do not put off the repairs any longer, because the broken window could cause an accident.
sentences.zh: 請不要再延後修理了，因為破掉的窗戶可能會造成意外。

sentences.en: The company may put off the product launch until next year if the engineers cannot fix the problem in time.
sentences.zh: 如果工程師無法及時解決問題，公司可能會把產品發表延到明年。

words.note: 語塊：put off a meeting（延後會議）、put off a decision（延後決定）、put off doing（延後做……）。put off 後面接名詞或 V-ing（put off making a decision）；postpone 意思一樣，比較正式。

sentences.en: The price of the conference includes hotel accommodation for three nights and all meals during the event.
sentences.zh: 研討會的價格包含三晚的飯店住宿和活動期間的所有餐點。

sentences.en: Our travel department will arrange accommodation for all employees who are attending the training in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 我們的旅遊部門會為所有參加首爾訓練的員工安排住宿。

sentences.en: The company will pay all accommodation costs for staff who travel to other cities for work.
sentences.zh: 公司會支付因公到其他城市出差員工的所有住宿費。

sentences.en: Students who come from other countries can find cheap accommodation in the area near the university campus.
sentences.zh: 從其他國家來的學生可以在大學校園附近一帶找到便宜的住處。

sentences.en: Please send your receipts for accommodation costs to the accounting office within a week of your return.
sentences.zh: 請在回來後一週內把住宿費的收據交給會計室。

words.note: 語塊：hotel accommodation（飯店住宿）、arrange accommodation（安排住宿）、accommodation costs（住宿費）。accommodation 是「住宿」；英式常用不可數，美式常用複數 accommodations；accommodate 是動詞「容納」。

sentences.en: An outside accounting firm will conduct an audit of the company's records at the end of every year.
sentences.zh: 一家外部會計師事務所每年年底都會稽核公司的帳目。

sentences.en: The financial audit showed that the department had spent more money than its budget allowed.
sentences.zh: 財務稽核顯示那個部門花的錢超過了預算。

sentences.en: Small businesses should keep all of their receipts in case the government decides to do a tax audit.
sentences.zh: 小企業應該保留所有收據，以防政府決定進行稅務查核。

sentences.en: The hospital will conduct an audit of its safety procedures after two patients complained last month.
sentences.zh: 上個月兩位病人投訴後，醫院將稽核它的安全程序。

sentences.en: Please prepare all invoices from the past year, because the financial audit will begin next Monday.
sentences.zh: 請準備好過去一年的所有請款單，因為財務稽核下週一開始。

words.note: 語塊：financial audit（財務稽核）、conduct an audit（進行稽核）、tax audit（稅務查核）。audit 可以當名詞或動詞「查帳」；auditor 是「稽核員」；audition 是「試鏡」。

sentences.en: The restaurant decorates its desserts with edible flowers that are grown in its own garden.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳用自家花園種的可食用花朵裝飾甜點。

sentences.en: A small company in Seoul has developed edible packaging that can be eaten together with the food inside.
sentences.zh: 首爾一家小公司開發出可以和裡面的食物一起吃的可食用包裝。

sentences.en: Some of the mushrooms in the forest are edible, but others are very dangerous, so please do not pick them.
sentences.zh: 森林裡有些蘑菇可以吃，但有些非常危險，所以請不要摘。

sentences.en: The cake was so beautiful that many guests did not realize the decorations were edible.
sentences.zh: 那個蛋糕漂亮到很多客人都沒發現上面的裝飾是可以吃的。

sentences.en: Edible packaging could help reduce the amount of plastic waste that restaurants produce every day.
sentences.zh: 可食用包裝可以幫助減少餐廳每天產生的塑膠垃圾量。

words.note: 語塊：edible flowers（可食用的花）、edible packaging（可食用的包裝）。edible 是「可以吃的」；eatable 也有但較口語；inedible 是「不能吃的」。

sentences.en: Rising commodity prices, such as oil and wheat, have made it more expensive to produce and ship food.
sentences.zh: 像石油和小麥這類原物料價格上漲，讓食物的生產和運送成本變得更高。

sentences.en: Rice is a basic commodity in many Asian countries, so the government controls its price carefully.
sentences.zh: 米在很多亞洲國家是基本商品，所以政府會小心控制價格。

sentences.en: In a busy office, time is a valuable commodity, so meetings should be short and well organized.
sentences.zh: 在忙碌的辦公室裡，時間是寶貴的資源，所以會議應該簡短又有條理。

sentences.en: The company buys coffee and sugar directly from farmers to protect itself from changes in commodity prices.
sentences.zh: 公司直接向農民購買咖啡和糖，避免受到原物料價格波動的影響。

sentences.en: Water has become a valuable commodity in areas where it has not rained for several months.
sentences.zh: 在好幾個月沒下雨的地區，水已經成了寶貴的資源。

words.note: 語塊：commodity prices（原物料價格）、basic commodity（基本商品）、valuable commodity（寶貴的資源）。commodity 多指石油、小麥、咖啡這類「大宗商品」；product 是一般「產品」。

sentences.en: Many families prefer to dine out on Friday evenings, so restaurants are usually very busy at that time.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭喜歡週五晚上外出用餐，所以那個時段餐廳通常非常忙。

sentences.en: Customers who dine in will receive a free drink, while takeout orders will get a ten percent discount.
sentences.zh: 內用的顧客會得到一杯免費飲料，外帶訂單則享九折優惠。

sentences.en: The CEO will dine with several important clients at the hotel restaurant after the conference ends.
sentences.zh: 研討會結束後，執行長會和幾位重要客戶在飯店餐廳用餐。

sentences.en: Guests can dine on the rooftop terrace and enjoy a wonderful view of the city during the summer months.
sentences.zh: 夏季期間，客人可以在頂樓露台用餐，欣賞美麗的城市景色。

sentences.en: Fewer people dine out when the economy is weak, so many restaurants offer special lunch sets to attract customers.
sentences.zh: 經濟不好時外出用餐的人變少，所以很多餐廳推出特別午餐套餐吸引顧客。

words.note: 語塊：dine out（外出用餐）、dine in（內用）、dine with（和……用餐）。dine 比 eat 正式；diner 是「用餐的人；小餐館」；dining room 是「餐廳（房間）」。

sentences.en: The company's annual sports day will be held in the school gymnasium because of the rainy weather.
sentences.zh: 因為下雨，公司的年度運動會會在學校體育館舉行。

sentences.en: The new gymnasium has a basketball court, a running track, and a large room for yoga classes.
sentences.zh: 新的體育館有一座籃球場、一條跑道，還有一間做瑜伽的大教室。

sentences.en: Voters in the neighborhood can cast their ballots in the gymnasium of the local high school next Sunday.
sentences.zh: 這一區的選民下週日可以到當地高中的體育館投票。

sentences.en: The city plans to repair the roof of the old gymnasium before the start of the basketball season.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫在籃球季開始前修理舊體育館的屋頂。

sentences.en: More than five hundred people attended the job fair in the gymnasium of the community center on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 週六有五百多人參加在社區中心體育館舉行的就業博覽會。

words.note: 語塊：school gymnasium（學校體育館）、in the gymnasium（在體育館裡）。gymnasium 常簡稱 gym；stadium 是有觀眾席的「大型體育場」。

sentences.en: Every student must take a physical education class at least twice a week, according to the new school rules.
sentences.zh: 根據學校新規定，每位學生每週至少要上兩次體育課。

sentences.en: Mr. Garcia has worked as a physical education teacher at the elementary school for more than fifteen years.
sentences.zh: 賈西亞先生在那所小學當體育老師已經十五年多了。

sentences.en: The school will build a new field for physical education and after-school sports programs next year.
sentences.zh: 學校明年會蓋一座新操場，用於體育課和課後運動活動。

sentences.en: Physical education helps children stay healthy and teaches them how to work together as a team.
sentences.zh: 體育課幫助孩子保持健康，也教他們如何團隊合作。

sentences.en: Our company sells equipment for physical education classes, such as balls, mats, and jump ropes, to schools nationwide.
sentences.zh: 我們公司把體育課用品，像是球、墊子和跳繩，賣給全國的學校。

words.note: 語塊：physical education class（體育課）、physical education teacher（體育老師）。physical education 常縮寫成 PE；physical 是「身體的」；physics 是「物理學」。

sentences.en: The hotel lobby looked shabby, so the owners decided to replace the old carpet and paint the walls.
sentences.zh: 飯店大廳看起來很破舊，所以老闆決定換掉舊地毯並粉刷牆壁。

sentences.en: The office was full of shabby furniture, which made a bad impression on visitors and new clients.
sentences.zh: 辦公室裡都是破舊的家具，讓訪客和新客戶印象很差。

sentences.en: Employees should not wear shabby clothes when they meet clients at the office, even on casual Fridays.
sentences.zh: 即使是週五便服日，員工在公司見客戶時也不應該穿破舊的衣服。

sentences.en: The restaurant is a bit shabby inside, but the food is delicious and the prices are very reasonable.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳裡面有點破舊，但食物很好吃，價格也很合理。

sentences.en: After twenty years, the old train station started to look shabby, so the city plans to renovate it next year.
sentences.zh: 二十年後，舊火車站開始顯得破舊，所以市政府計畫明年整修。

words.note: 語塊：shabby clothes（破舊的衣服）、shabby furniture（破舊的家具）、look shabby（看起來很舊）。shabby 是「舊到看起來很寒酸」；worn-out 意思接近；chubby 是「圓胖的」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: Please read the job description carefully before you apply, because the position requires some travel abroad.
sentences.zh: 申請前請仔細閱讀職務說明，因為這個職位需要出國出差。

sentences.en: Every product description on our website includes the size, weight, and materials of the item.
sentences.zh: 我們網站上的每一則產品說明都包含商品的尺寸、重量和材料。

sentences.en: The police asked the witness to give a detailed description of the car that left the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 警方請目擊者詳細描述離開停車場的那輛車。

sentences.en: Customers complained that the product description was not accurate, because the color of the bag was different.
sentences.zh: 顧客抱怨產品說明不正確，因為包包的顏色不一樣。

sentences.en: The new job description explains the duties of the assistant manager and the skills that are required.
sentences.zh: 新的職務說明解釋了副理的職責和所需的技能。

words.note: 語塊：job description（職務說明）、product description（產品說明）、detailed description（詳細描述）。description 是 describe（描述）的名詞；descriptive 是「描述性的」；prescription 是「處方」。

sentences.en: All of our products are made in accordance with the law and meet the strictest safety standards.
sentences.zh: 我們所有的產品都依照法律製造，符合最嚴格的安全標準。

sentences.en: The supplier delivered the goods late, so we will charge a penalty in accordance with the contract.
sentences.zh: 供應商延遲交貨，所以我們會依照合約收取罰款。

sentences.en: In accordance with company policy, employees must take at least five days of vacation every year.
sentences.zh: 依照公司規定，員工每年至少必須休五天假。

sentences.en: The building was designed in accordance with the city's new rules for energy conservation and fire safety.
sentences.zh: 大樓是依照市政府新的節能和消防安全規定設計的。

sentences.en: Your personal information will be handled in accordance with the law and will never be shared without permission.
sentences.zh: 您的個人資料將依照法律處理，未經同意絕不會被分享。

words.note: 語塊：in accordance with the law（依照法律）、in accordance with the contract（依照合約）、in accordance with company policy（依照公司規定）。in accordance with 是正式的「依照」；according to 意思接近，但 according to 也可以是「根據（某人說）」。

sentences.en: Many office workers suffer from stress because they work long hours and rarely take a vacation.
sentences.zh: 很多上班族因為工時長、很少休假而受壓力所苦。

sentences.en: Mr. Kato could not attend the meeting because he started to suffer from a bad cold on Monday.
sentences.zh: 加藤先生無法參加會議，因為他週一開始得了重感冒。

sentences.en: Some hospitals in the region suffer from a shortage of nurses, so they are trying to hire staff from abroad.
sentences.zh: 這一區有些醫院面臨護理師短缺，所以正嘗試從國外招募人員。

sentences.en: Restaurants in tourist areas often suffer from a lack of customers during the rainy season.
sentences.zh: 觀光區的餐廳在雨季常常苦於缺少客人。

sentences.en: Employees who suffer from back pain can ask the company for a special chair at no extra cost.
sentences.zh: 有背痛問題的員工可以免費向公司申請特別的椅子。

words.note: 語塊：suffer from a cold（感冒）、suffer from stress（受壓力所苦）、suffer from a shortage（受短缺之苦）。suffer from 後面接疾病或問題；suffer 單獨用是「受苦；遭受（損失）」（suffer a loss）。

sentences.en: Employees who suffer from a chronic ailment can ask for flexible working hours to visit their doctor regularly.
sentences.zh: 患有慢性病的員工可以申請彈性工時，定期去看醫生。

sentences.en: The new clinic specializes in helping older patients treat a chronic ailment such as high blood pressure.
sentences.zh: 新診所專門幫助年長病人治療高血壓之類的慢性病。

sentences.en: The insurance plan covers medicine for any chronic ailment, so members do not have to pay much each month.
sentences.zh: 保險方案涵蓋任何慢性病的藥物，所以會員每個月不用付太多錢。

sentences.en: Living with a chronic ailment can be difficult, but regular exercise and a healthy diet can help a lot.
sentences.zh: 和慢性病一起生活可能不容易，但規律運動和健康飲食會很有幫助。

sentences.en: Doctors at the hospital will give a free talk on how to treat a chronic ailment at home next Saturday.
sentences.zh: 醫院的醫生下週六會舉辦免費講座，談如何在家照護慢性病。

words.note: 語塊：suffer from a chronic ailment（患有慢性病）、treat a chronic ailment（治療慢性病）。chronic 是「長期的、慢性的」；acute 是「急性的」；ailment 是比較輕的「病痛」。

sentences.en: Children who suffer from asthma should avoid playing outside on days when the air pollution is very high.
sentences.zh: 患有氣喘的兒童應該避免在空氣污染嚴重的日子到戶外玩。

sentences.en: The flight attendant helped a passenger who was having an asthma attack until the plane landed safely.
sentences.zh: 空服員協助一位氣喘發作的乘客，直到飛機安全降落。

sentences.en: Dust and smoke can cause an asthma attack, so the factory gives workers masks to wear at all times.
sentences.zh: 灰塵和煙霧可能引發氣喘，所以工廠發口罩給工人隨時配戴。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin has suffered from asthma since she was a child, so she always carries her medicine with her.
sentences.zh: 林小姐從小就有氣喘，所以她總是隨身帶著藥。

sentences.en: The new air cleaning system in the school has helped students with asthma breathe more easily in class.
sentences.zh: 學校的新空氣清淨系統幫助有氣喘的學生在課堂上呼吸更順暢。

words.note: 語塊：suffer from asthma（患有氣喘）、asthma attack（氣喘發作）。asthma 的 th 不發音，唸作 /ˈæzmə/；asthmatic 是「氣喘的；氣喘患者」。

sentences.en: The university received a research grant of two million dollars to study new ways of producing clean energy.
sentences.zh: 那所大學獲得兩百萬元的研究補助，研究生產乾淨能源的新方法。

sentences.en: Small farms can receive a grant from the government to buy machinery that saves water and energy.
sentences.zh: 小農場可以獲得政府補助，購買節水節能的機械。

sentences.en: The museum will use the government grant to repair the old building and open a new gallery.
sentences.zh: 博物館會用政府補助修繕舊建築，並開設一間新展廳。

sentences.en: Several start-ups applied for the research grant, but only three of them were chosen by the committee.
sentences.zh: 好幾家新創公司申請了研究補助，但委員會只選了其中三家。

sentences.en: If our company can receive a grant from the city, we will hire ten more young workers next year.
sentences.zh: 如果我們公司能獲得市政府的補助，明年會多雇用十位年輕員工。

words.note: 語塊：research grant（研究補助）、receive a grant（獲得補助）、government grant（政府補助）。grant 當名詞是「補助金」；當動詞是「准許；給予」（grant permission）；take sth for granted 是「視為理所當然」。

sentences.en: The new shopping center is a one-stop shop for families, with stores, restaurants, and a cinema in one building.
sentences.zh: 新購物中心對家庭來說是一站式商店，同一棟樓裡有商店、餐廳和電影院。

sentences.en: The bank now offers a one-stop service where customers can open an account and get a loan on the same day.
sentences.zh: 銀行現在提供一站式服務，顧客可以在同一天開戶並辦好貸款。

sentences.en: Our travel agency is a one-stop shop that books flights, hotels, and tours for business travelers.
sentences.zh: 我們的旅行社是一站式服務，為商務旅客預訂機票、飯店和行程。

sentences.en: The city opened a one-stop service center where residents can pay taxes and apply for permits.
sentences.zh: 市政府開設了一站式服務中心，居民可以在那裡繳稅和申請許可證。

sentences.en: Many customers like the one-stop service because they do not have to visit several different offices.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客喜歡一站式服務，因為他們不用跑好幾個不同的辦公室。

words.note: 語塊：one-stop shop（一站式商店）、one-stop service（一站式服務）。one-stop 是「在同一個地方就能處理所有事」，通常放在名詞前面。

sentences.en: Our store offers a wide range of kitchen products, from cheap plates to expensive coffee machines.
sentences.zh: 我們店提供各式各樣的廚房用品，從便宜的盤子到昂貴的咖啡機都有。

sentences.en: The hotel restaurant serves a wide variety of dishes from Asia, Europe, and South America.
sentences.zh: 飯店餐廳供應來自亞洲、歐洲和南美洲種類繁多的菜色。

sentences.en: The bookstore has a wide selection of business books, so it is popular with office workers in the area.
sentences.zh: 那家書店的商業書選擇眾多，所以很受這一帶上班族歡迎。

sentences.en: The new road is wide enough for large trucks, which will make deliveries to the factory much easier.
sentences.zh: 新道路寬到可以讓大卡車通過，這會讓送貨到工廠容易很多。

sentences.en: The conference will cover a wide range of topics, including marketing, finance, and new technology.
sentences.zh: 研討會將涵蓋廣泛的主題，包括行銷、財務和新科技。

words.note: 語塊：wide range of（各式各樣的）、wide variety of（種類繁多的）、wide selection（選擇眾多）。wide 是「寬、範圍大」；widely 是副詞「廣泛地」；width 是名詞「寬度」。

sentences.en: We left our dog at a boarding kennel near the airport while we were on vacation in Thailand.
sentences.zh: 我們在泰國度假時，把狗寄放在機場附近的寵物寄宿處。

sentences.en: The kennel fee is thirty dollars per night, which includes two meals and a daily walk for your dog.
sentences.zh: 寄宿費每晚三十元，包含兩餐和每天帶你的狗散步一次。

sentences.en: Many pet owners book a kennel months in advance because they are always full during the holidays.
sentences.zh: 很多飼主會提前幾個月預訂寵物寄宿處，因為假期總是客滿。

sentences.en: The new kennel has large rooms, a garden, and staff who check on the animals twenty-four hours a day.
sentences.zh: 新的寵物寄宿處有大房間、花園，還有二十四小時照看動物的工作人員。

sentences.en: Please bring your pet's medicine and favorite toy when you drop it off at the boarding kennel.
sentences.zh: 送寵物到寄宿處時，請帶上牠的藥和最喜歡的玩具。

words.note: 語塊：boarding kennel（寵物寄宿處）、kennel fee（寄宿費）。kennel 是寄放或飼養狗的地方；cage 是「籠子」；shelter 是「收容所」。

sentences.en: The machines in the factory are checked on a regular basis to make sure they are safe to use.
sentences.zh: 工廠的機器會定期檢查，確保使用安全。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim is a regular customer who comes to our café every morning before he goes to work.
sentences.zh: 金先生是常客，每天早上上班前都會來我們的咖啡廳。

sentences.en: The jacket is on sale for forty dollars, which is half of the regular price at the department store.
sentences.zh: 那件外套特價四十元，是百貨公司原價的一半。

sentences.en: Managers should meet with their team members on a regular basis to discuss problems and goals.
sentences.zh: 主管應該定期和組員開會，討論問題和目標。

sentences.en: Each regular customer receives a card that gives a ten percent discount on every purchase.
sentences.zh: 每位常客都會拿到一張卡，每次消費都打九折。

words.note: 語塊：regular basis（定期地）、regular customer（常客）、regular price（原價）。regular 是「規律的、平常的」；regularly 是副詞；irregular 是「不規律的」。

sentences.en: The new veterinary clinic near the park is open seven days a week and treats both dogs and cats.
sentences.zh: 公園附近的新動物醫院一週七天都營業，狗和貓都看。

sentences.en: Pet insurance can help owners pay for veterinary care if their animals become sick or get hurt.
sentences.zh: 寵物保險可以幫飼主在動物生病或受傷時支付獸醫照護費用。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee decided to study veterinary medicine because she has loved animals since she was a child.
sentences.zh: 李小姐決定念獸醫學，因為她從小就很喜歡動物。

sentences.en: The farm provides regular veterinary care for all of its cows to keep the milk safe and healthy.
sentences.zh: 農場為所有的乳牛提供定期的獸醫照護，確保牛奶安全健康。

sentences.en: The veterinary clinic will offer free health checks for pets during the first week of next month.
sentences.zh: 動物醫院下個月第一週會為寵物提供免費健康檢查。

words.note: 語塊：veterinary clinic（動物醫院）、veterinary care（獸醫照護）、veterinary medicine（獸醫學）。veterinary 是形容詞；獸醫本人是 veterinarian，常簡稱 vet；veteran 是「老兵；老手」。

sentences.en: The new covers will protect the outdoor furniture in the hotel garden from the elements during the rainy season.
sentences.zh: 雨季期間，新的防護罩會保護飯店花園裡的戶外家具免受風吹雨打。

sentences.en: Machines that are exposed to the elements for a long time can break down more often than those kept inside.
sentences.zh: 長時間暴露在風雨中的機器，比放在室內的更容易故障。

sentences.en: This jacket is designed for hikers who need protection from the elements in cold and wet weather.
sentences.zh: 這件外套是為需要在寒冷潮濕天氣中抵擋風雨的登山客設計的。

sentences.en: The old statue in the park has been exposed to the elements for a hundred years, so it needs to be repaired.
sentences.zh: 公園裡的老雕像已經暴露在風雨中一百年了，所以需要修復。

sentences.en: Please store the bicycles in the garage to protect them from the elements during the winter months.
sentences.zh: 冬季期間請把自行車放在車庫裡，保護它們免受風吹雨打。

words.note: 語塊：protect from the elements（保護免受風吹雨打）、exposed to the elements（暴露在風雨中）。the elements（複數、加 the）是指風、雨、雪等「惡劣天氣」；element 單數是「要素；元素」。

sentences.en: The new windows are designed to keep out the rain and the noise from the busy street outside.
sentences.zh: 新窗戶的設計可以擋住雨水和外面繁忙街道的噪音。

sentences.en: Visitors must keep out of the construction area, which is marked with yellow tape and warning signs.
sentences.zh: 訪客不得進入工地區域，那裡有黃色封鎖線和警告標誌標示。

sentences.en: This thick coat will keep out the cold even when the temperature drops below zero at night.
sentences.zh: 即使晚上氣溫降到零下，這件厚外套也能禦寒。

sentences.en: Please close the warehouse door after each delivery to keep out the rain and dust.
sentences.zh: 每次送貨後請把倉庫門關上，以擋住雨水和灰塵。

sentences.en: The sign on the door tells employees to keep out of the server room unless they work in the IT department.
sentences.zh: 門上的告示告訴員工，除非在資訊部門工作，否則不要進入機房。

words.note: 語塊：keep out the rain（擋雨）、keep out of（遠離；不進入）、keep out the cold（禦寒）。keep out 是「把……擋在外面」或「不要進入」；Keep Out 是告示牌上的「禁止進入」。

sentences.en: The company's patented technology allows the battery to charge fully in less than fifteen minutes.
sentences.zh: 公司的專利技術讓電池能在十五分鐘內充飽。

sentences.en: Our shoes have a patented design that reduces pressure on the feet during long walks or runs.
sentences.zh: 我們的鞋子有專利設計，可以在長時間走路或跑步時減輕腳的壓力。

sentences.en: Other companies cannot copy the patented technology without paying a fee to the inventor and getting written permission.
sentences.zh: 其他公司不付費給發明人並取得書面許可，就不能抄襲這項專利技術。
