sentences.en: The patented cleaning system uses less water than any other dishwasher on the market today.
sentences.zh: 這套專利清潔系統比市面上任何洗碗機都更省水。

sentences.en: The designer showed the patented design of the new chair to investors at the trade show in Milan.
sentences.zh: 設計師在米蘭的展覽上向投資人展示新椅子的專利設計。

words.note: 語塊：patented technology（專利技術）、patented design（專利設計）。patented 是「取得專利的」；patent 是名詞「專利」或動詞「取得專利」；patient 是「病人；有耐心的」。

sentences.en: Please store the paper in a dry place, because it can easily absorb moisture and become hard to print on.
sentences.zh: 請把紙存放在乾燥的地方，因為它很容易吸收濕氣，變得很難列印。

sentences.en: The new boxes protect electronic products from moisture during long trips by ship across the ocean.
sentences.zh: 新的箱子在橫渡大洋的長途海運時可以保護電子產品防潮。

sentences.en: Workers check the moisture level in the warehouse every morning to keep the wood from getting damaged.
sentences.zh: 工人每天早上檢查倉庫的濕度，以免木材受損。

sentences.en: This cream helps keep moisture in your skin, so it is popular with customers during the dry winter months.
sentences.zh: 這款乳霜幫助肌膚保濕，所以在乾燥的冬季很受顧客歡迎。

sentences.en: Too much moisture in the basement caused the walls to turn black, so the owner had to repair them.
sentences.zh: 地下室濕氣太重讓牆壁變黑，所以屋主必須修理。

words.note: 語塊：absorb moisture（吸收濕氣）、protect from moisture（防潮）、moisture level（濕度）。moisture 是不可數名詞；moist 是形容詞「微濕的」；humidity 是空氣中的「濕度」。

sentences.en: This water-resistant watch can be worn while swimming, but it should not be used for deep diving.
sentences.zh: 這款防水手錶可以戴著游泳，但不應該用於深潛。

sentences.en: The jacket is made of a light water-resistant material that is perfect for walking in the rain.
sentences.zh: 這件外套是用輕巧的防水材料做的，非常適合在雨中散步。

sentences.en: All of our new phones are water-resistant, so they will still work if you drop them in a puddle.
sentences.zh: 我們所有的新手機都防水，所以掉進水坑裡還是能用。

sentences.en: The company uses a water-resistant material for its backpacks to protect laptops and documents inside.
sentences.zh: 公司的背包使用防水材料，保護裡面的筆電和文件。

sentences.en: Please note that the watch is water-resistant only to thirty meters, as explained in the user manual.
sentences.zh: 請注意，如使用手冊所述，這款手錶只能防水到三十公尺。

words.note: 語塊：water-resistant watch（防水手錶）、water-resistant material（防水材料）。water-resistant 是「能抵擋一些水」；waterproof 是「完全防水」，程度更高。

sentences.en: Applicants for the position must have a bachelor's degree in accounting or a related field.
sentences.zh: 這個職位的應徵者必須有會計或相關科系的學士學位。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin is studying for a master's degree in business while she works full-time at the bank.
sentences.zh: 林小姐一邊在銀行全職工作，一邊攻讀企管碩士學位。

sentences.en: To some degree, the success of the product depends on how well we advertise it on social media.
sentences.zh: 在某種程度上，產品的成功取決於我們在社群媒體上的宣傳做得多好。

sentences.en: Even a change of one degree in the server room can cause the computers to stop working properly.
sentences.zh: 機房裡即使只變化一度，也可能讓電腦無法正常運作。

sentences.en: The company pays part of the cost for employees who want to earn a master's degree in the evening.
sentences.zh: 公司會為想在晚上攻讀碩士學位的員工負擔部分費用。

words.note: 語塊：bachelor's degree（學士學位）、master's degree（碩士學位）、to some degree（在某種程度上）。degree 可以是「學位」、「程度」或溫度的「度」；diploma 是「畢業證書」。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, your application does not meet the requirement for at least three years of experience in sales.
sentences.zh: 很遺憾，您的申請不符合至少三年業務經驗的要求。

sentences.en: A good level of English is the minimum requirement for all staff who work at the hotel's front desk.
sentences.zh: 良好的英文程度是所有飯店櫃台員工的最低要求。

sentences.en: The university raised its entry requirement this year, so fewer students were accepted into the program.
sentences.zh: 那所大學今年提高了入學條件，所以錄取這個學程的學生變少了。

sentences.en: Every new product must meet the safety requirement set by the government before it can be sold in stores.
sentences.zh: 每項新產品都必須符合政府訂的安全要求，才能在店裡販售。

sentences.en: The job has one important requirement: the person must be willing to travel abroad several times a year.
sentences.zh: 這份工作有一個重要的必要條件：這個人必須願意一年出國好幾次。

words.note: 語塊：meet the requirements（符合要求）、minimum requirement（最低要求）、entry requirement（入學條件）。requirement 是 require（需要）的名詞；常用複數 requirements。

sentences.en: The store will close early on Sunday so that the staff can take inventory of all of the products.
sentences.zh: 店週日會提早關門，讓員工盤點所有產品。

sentences.en: The new inventory control system tells managers exactly when they need to order more supplies.
sentences.zh: 新的庫存管理系統會告訴主管什麼時候需要再訂貨。

sentences.en: Many companies try to keep inventory low so that they do not waste money on products that do not sell.
sentences.zh: 很多公司盡量壓低庫存，以免把錢浪費在賣不出去的產品上。

sentences.en: We take inventory at the end of every month to check whether any items are missing or damaged.
sentences.zh: 我們每個月底盤點，檢查有沒有任何商品遺失或損壞。

sentences.en: The warehouse manager is responsible for inventory control and for training new staff in the department.
sentences.zh: 倉庫經理負責庫存管理，以及訓練部門的新員工。

words.note: 語塊：take inventory（盤點）、inventory control（庫存管理）、keep inventory low（壓低庫存）。inventory 是「庫存（的貨）」或「存貨清單」；stock 意思接近；invention 是「發明」。

sentences.en: If you take a long vacation, the work will pile up and you will be very busy when you return.
sentences.zh: 如果你休長假，工作會堆積如山，回來後會非常忙。

sentences.en: Many small businesses close because the bills pile up faster than the money they earn.
sentences.zh: 很多小公司倒閉，是因為帳單堆積的速度比賺錢的速度快。

sentences.en: Please do not let documents pile up on the desk, because important papers may get lost.
sentences.zh: 請不要讓文件堆在桌上，因為重要的文件可能會不見。

sentences.en: During the holiday season, orders pile up quickly, so the warehouse hires extra staff for December.
sentences.zh: 假期期間訂單會快速累積，所以倉庫十二月會雇用額外的人手。

sentences.en: The e-mails began to pile up while Mr. Ross was sick, so his assistant answered the most urgent ones.
sentences.zh: 羅斯先生生病期間電子郵件越積越多，所以他的助理回覆了最緊急的那些。

words.note: 語塊：work piles up（工作堆積）、bills pile up（帳單越積越多）、pile up on the desk（堆在桌上）。pile up 是「（東西、工作）越堆越多」；pile 當名詞是「一堆」（a pile of papers）。

sentences.en: Our designers pay attention to details, so every product looks good and works well for many years.
sentences.zh: 我們的設計師注重細節，所以每項產品都好看又耐用多年。

sentences.en: Please pay attention to the safety instructions before you start using the new machine in the factory.
sentences.zh: 在工廠開始使用新機器之前，請注意安全說明。

sentences.en: Investors always pay attention to the company's annual report to see whether profits are increasing.
sentences.zh: 投資人總是會注意公司的年報，看看獲利是否在增加。

sentences.en: Drivers must pay attention to the road signs, because the speed limit changes near the school.
sentences.zh: 駕駛必須注意路標，因為學校附近的速限會改變。

sentences.en: Managers should pay attention to how employees feel about the new working hours and the extra weekend shifts.
sentences.zh: 主管應該留意員工對新工作時間和額外週末班的感受。

words.note: 語塊：pay attention to details（注意細節）、pay attention to safety（注意安全）、pay attention to the road（注意路況）。pay attention to 後面接名詞或 V-ing；attention 是名詞「注意力」。

sentences.en: Sending the wrong products to the client was a costly mistake that the company will not make again.
sentences.zh: 把錯的產品寄給客戶是一個代價很高的錯誤，公司不會再犯了。

sentences.en: The old building needs costly repairs, so the owners have decided to sell it instead.
sentences.zh: 那棟舊大樓需要昂貴的修理費，所以業主決定把它賣掉。

sentences.en: It can be costly to replace all of the computers at once, so we will buy new ones over three years.
sentences.zh: 一次換掉所有電腦可能很貴，所以我們會分三年買新的。

sentences.en: A delay in the construction project would be very costly for both the builder and the city.
sentences.zh: 建設專案延誤對建商和市政府來說代價都很高。

sentences.en: Regular maintenance helps companies avoid costly repairs when their machines break down suddenly during busy periods.
sentences.zh: 定期保養幫助公司避免機器在忙碌時期突然故障時昂貴的修理費。

words.note: 語塊：costly mistake（代價高的錯誤）、costly repairs（昂貴的修理費）。costly 長得像副詞，其實是形容詞（= expensive）；cost 是名詞或動詞「花費」。

sentences.en: Please be careful not to spill coffee on the computer, because it could damage the keyboard.
sentences.zh: 請小心不要把咖啡灑在電腦上，因為可能會弄壞鍵盤。

sentences.en: If you spill water on the floor, please clean it up right away so that nobody slips and falls.
sentences.zh: 如果你把水灑在地上，請馬上擦乾，以免有人滑倒。

sentences.en: The government fined the company after a large oil spill polluted the beaches near the port.
sentences.zh: 大規模漏油污染了港口附近的海灘後，政府對那家公司開罰。

sentences.en: Waiters are trained to carry trays carefully so that they do not spill drinks on the customers.
sentences.zh: 服務生受過訓練要小心端托盤，以免把飲料灑在顧客身上。

sentences.en: Cleaning up an oil spill can take months and cost millions of dollars, so ships must follow strict rules.
sentences.zh: 清理漏油可能要花好幾個月和數百萬元，所以船隻必須遵守嚴格的規定。

words.note: 語塊：spill coffee（打翻咖啡）、spill water（灑出水）、oil spill（漏油）。spill 可以當動詞或名詞「灑出、溢出」；過去式是 spilled 或 spilt。

sentences.en: Employees who suggest ideas that save money will receive a monetary reward at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 提出省錢點子的員工年底會得到金錢獎勵。

sentences.en: The central bank changed its monetary policy to control rising prices and protect the value of the currency.
sentences.zh: 中央銀行調整了貨幣政策，以控制物價上漲並保護貨幣價值。

sentences.en: The old letters have no monetary value, but they are very important to the history of the company.
sentences.zh: 那些舊信件沒有金錢價值，但對公司的歷史非常重要。

sentences.en: Many volunteers help at the festival every year without any monetary reward because they love the town.
sentences.zh: 很多志工每年都在節慶幫忙、不拿任何金錢報酬，因為他們熱愛這個小鎮。

sentences.en: Experts expect the government to announce a new monetary policy after the meeting next week.
sentences.zh: 專家預期政府會在下週的會議後宣布新的貨幣政策。

words.note: 語塊：monetary reward（金錢獎勵）、monetary policy（貨幣政策）、monetary value（金錢價值）。monetary 是「和錢有關的」；financial 意思接近；monitor 是「監控」，拼法有點像。

sentences.en: The company will make a donation to the local children's hospital for every product sold this month.
sentences.zh: 這個月每賣出一件產品，公司就會捐款給當地的兒童醫院。

sentences.en: Thanks to a generous donation from a former student, the school was able to build a new library.
sentences.zh: 多虧一位校友的慷慨捐款，學校才得以蓋一座新圖書館。

sentences.en: Customers can make a donation at the counter, and all of the money will go to families affected by the flood.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以在櫃台捐款，所有的錢都會給受水災影響的家庭。

sentences.en: The museum received a generous donation of paintings from a famous collector who lived in the city.
sentences.zh: 博物館收到一位住在這座城市的知名收藏家慷慨捐贈的畫作。

sentences.en: Every donation to the charity, no matter how small, will help provide food for people in need.
sentences.zh: 每一筆捐給慈善機構的款項，不論多少，都會幫助提供食物給需要的人。

words.note: 語塊：make a donation（捐款）、generous donation（慷慨的捐款）、donation to（捐給……）。donation 是 donate（捐贈）的名詞；donor 是「捐贈者」。

sentences.en: The company has held a dominant position in the smartphone market for more than ten years.
sentences.zh: 那家公司在智慧型手機市場佔據主導地位十多年了。

sentences.en: After the merger, the new company will become the dominant player in the airline industry in Asia.
sentences.zh: 合併後，新公司將成為亞洲航空業的主要業者。

sentences.en: Social media now plays a dominant role in how young people choose which products to buy.
sentences.zh: 社群媒體現在在年輕人選購產品上扮演主導角色。

sentences.en: Small shops find it difficult to compete with a dominant player that can offer much lower prices.
sentences.zh: 小店很難和能提供低很多價格的主要業者競爭。

sentences.en: The government is worried that one dominant company may control the prices of electricity in the region.
sentences.zh: 政府擔心一家佔優勢的公司可能會控制這一區的電價。

words.note: 語塊：dominant position（主導地位）、dominant player（主要業者）、dominant role（主導角色）。dominant 是「最強、最主要的」；dominate 是動詞「主宰」；dormant 是「休眠的」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen will supervise the staff in the warehouse while the manager is on vacation next month.
sentences.zh: 下個月經理休假時，陳小姐會管理倉庫的員工。

sentences.en: Managers should closely supervise new employees during their first month and work with them every day.
sentences.zh: 主管應該在新員工第一個月密切監督他們，每天和他們一起工作。

sentences.en: Mr. Diaz was hired to supervise the project to build a new terminal at the airport.
sentences.zh: 迪亞茲先生受聘監督機場新航廈的建設專案。

sentences.en: Teachers supervise students carefully in the playground during lunch break to make sure that everyone stays safe.
sentences.zh: 午休時老師會在操場仔細看顧學生，確保每個人都安全。

sentences.en: An experienced engineer will supervise the installation of the new machines in the factory next week.
sentences.zh: 一位經驗豐富的工程師下週會監督工廠新機器的安裝。

words.note: 語塊：supervise staff（管理員工）、closely supervise（密切監督）、supervise a project（監督專案）。supervise 是「在旁邊看著並管理」；supervisor 是「主管」；supervision 是名詞。

sentences.en: Mr. Okada plans to retire from the company next spring after working here for almost forty years.
sentences.zh: 岡田先生在這裡工作將近四十年後，打算明年春天從公司退休。

sentences.en: More people want to retire early so that they can travel and spend more time with their families.
sentences.zh: 越來越多人想提早退休，好去旅行並多陪家人。

sentences.en: The manager, who is soon to retire, is training his successor to take over the department.
sentences.zh: 即將退休的經理正在訓練接班人接管部門。

sentences.en: Workers who retire from the factory receive a monthly pension and free health checks every year.
sentences.zh: 從工廠退休的員工每個月領退休金，每年也有免費健康檢查。

sentences.en: Ms. Rivera decided to retire early because she wanted to start a small bakery in her hometown.
sentences.zh: 里維拉小姐決定提早退休，因為她想在家鄉開一家小麵包店。

words.note: 語塊：retire from（從……退休）、retire early（提早退休）、soon to retire（即將退休）。retire 是動詞；retirement 是名詞；retiree 是「退休人員」；resign 是「辭職」。

sentences.en: Many employees will have a hand in the project, but Ms. Kim was the one who came up with the original idea.
sentences.zh: 很多員工都會參與這個專案，但想出最初點子的是金小姐。

sentences.en: Mr. Tan was proud to have a hand in the design of the new library, which won an international award.
sentences.zh: 譚先生很驕傲參與了新圖書館的設計，那座圖書館還得了國際獎。

sentences.en: Our customers will have a hand in choosing the new flavors, because we will ask them to vote online.
sentences.zh: 我們的顧客會參與選擇新口味，因為我們會請他們在網路上投票。

sentences.en: The famous chef did not have a hand in the restaurant's new menu, although his name is on the door.
sentences.zh: 雖然那位知名主廚的名字掛在門口，但他並沒有參與餐廳的新菜單。

sentences.en: Every member of the team will have a hand in the project, from planning the budget to meeting the clients.
sentences.zh: 每位組員都會參與這個專案，從規劃預算到和客戶見面。

words.note: 語塊：have a hand in the project（參與專案）、have a hand in the design（參與設計）、have a hand in choosing（參與挑選）。have a hand in 是「在某事中出了一份力」；take part in 意思接近。

sentences.en: The board will choose a successor to the current CEO, who plans to retire at the end of next year.
sentences.zh: 董事會將為明年底打算退休的現任執行長選出接班人。

sentences.en: Ms. Patel was named as the successor to Mr. Clark as head of the marketing department.
sentences.zh: 帕特爾小姐被任命為克拉克先生的繼任者，擔任行銷部主管。

sentences.en: Before he leaves the company, Mr. Wong will spend three months helping to train a successor.
sentences.zh: 王先生離開公司前，會花三個月幫忙培養接班人。

sentences.en: The founder has not yet decided who will be his successor, but many people think it will be his daughter.
sentences.zh: 創辦人還沒決定誰當接班人，但很多人認為會是他的女兒。

sentences.en: Choosing the right successor is one of the most important decisions that a company's leader can make.
sentences.zh: 選對接班人是公司領導人能做的最重要決定之一。

words.note: 語塊：choose a successor（選出接班人）、successor to（……的繼任者）、train a successor（培養接班人）。successor 是「接替職位的人」；predecessor 是「前任」；success 是「成功」。

sentences.en: Customers often blame the store for late deliveries, even when the problem is caused by the shipping company.
sentences.zh: 顧客常因為送貨延遲責怪店家，即使問題是貨運公司造成的。

sentences.en: The report found that nobody was to blame for the accident, which was caused by a sudden storm.
sentences.zh: 報告發現沒有人需要為事故負責，那是一場突如其來的暴風雨造成的。

sentences.en: The manager did not blame the team for the mistake and instead asked how they could prevent it next time.
sentences.zh: 經理沒有因為錯誤責怪團隊，而是問他們下次要怎麼避免。

sentences.en: Some experts blame the drop in sales on the rainy weather, while others say prices are simply too high.
sentences.zh: 有些專家把銷售下滑歸咎於多雨的天氣，其他人則說價格就是太高了。

sentences.en: It is easy to blame others when things go wrong, but good leaders take responsibility for their decisions.
sentences.zh: 出問題時責怪別人很容易，但好的領導者會為自己的決定負責。

words.note: 語塊：blame A for B（因 B 責怪 A）、be to blame（該負責）、blame A on B（把 A 歸咎於 B）。blame 可以當動詞或名詞；take the blame 是「承擔責任」。

sentences.en: Please read the contract carefully, because some phone companies add hidden costs to their monthly plans.
sentences.zh: 請仔細閱讀合約，因為有些電信公司會在月租方案裡加上隱藏費用。

sentences.en: Our bank has no hidden fees, so customers always know exactly how much they will pay each month.
sentences.zh: 我們銀行沒有隱藏收費，所以顧客總是清楚知道每個月要付多少。

sentences.en: During the office party, we discovered that our accountant has a hidden talent for singing.
sentences.zh: 在公司派對上，我們發現會計有唱歌的隱藏才能。

sentences.en: Many travelers complain about hidden fees, such as extra charges for bags and seat selection on flights.
sentences.zh: 很多旅客抱怨隱藏收費，例如航班上的行李和選位額外費用。

sentences.en: The hotel's website clearly shows the total price, so there are no hidden costs when you check out.
sentences.zh: 飯店網站清楚顯示總價，所以退房時不會有隱藏費用。

words.note: 語塊：hidden costs（隱藏費用）、hidden fees（隱藏收費）、hidden talent（隱藏的才能）。hidden 是 hide（隱藏）的過去分詞，當形容詞用；secret 意思接近。

words.meaning: 運輸業者；航空公司；電信業者

sentences.en: The national air carrier will start direct flights between Taipei and Seattle starting next summer.
sentences.zh: 國家航空公司明年夏天會開始台北和西雅圖之間的直飛航班。

sentences.en: We use a shipping carrier that can deliver packages to any city in the country within two days.
sentences.zh: 我們使用一家兩天內能把包裹送到全國任何城市的貨運業者。

sentences.en: Customers can choose their mobile carrier when they buy a new phone at our store.
sentences.zh: 顧客在我們店裡買新手機時，可以選擇電信業者。

sentences.en: The shipping carrier lost three of our packages last month, so we are looking for a new company.
sentences.zh: 那家貨運業者上個月弄丟了我們三個包裹，所以我們在找新的公司。

sentences.en: At least one low-cost air carrier now flies to the island, which has made it much more popular with tourists.
sentences.zh: 現在至少有一家低成本航空公司飛那座島，讓它更受觀光客歡迎。

words.note: 語塊：air carrier（航空公司）、shipping carrier（貨運業者）、mobile carrier（電信業者）。carrier 是「運送人或貨物的公司」；carry 是動詞「攜帶；運送」；career 是「職涯」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: The new bathroom has white ceramic tiles on the floor and walls, which are easy to clean.
sentences.zh: 新浴室的地板和牆壁都貼了白色磁磚，很好清理。

sentences.en: Every ceramic bowl in the shop is made by hand, so no two bowls look exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 店裡的每個陶碗都是手工製作的，所以沒有兩個碗完全一樣。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibition shows ceramic art from Japan, Korea, and China over the past five hundred years.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽展出日本、韓國和中國過去五百年的陶藝作品。

sentences.en: Please wrap each ceramic plate carefully in paper, because they break very easily during delivery to customers.
sentences.zh: 請用紙仔細包好每一個陶瓷盤子，因為送到顧客手上的途中很容易破。

sentences.en: The community center offers a ceramic art class every Saturday morning for adults and children.
sentences.zh: 社區中心每週六早上為大人和小孩開設陶藝課。

words.note: 語塊：ceramic tiles（磁磚）、ceramic bowl（陶碗）、ceramic art（陶藝）。ceramic 可以當形容詞或名詞「陶瓷製品」（ceramics 是「陶藝」）；pottery 是「陶器」。

sentences.en: A large bronze sculpture of a horse stands in front of the city hall and is popular with tourists.
sentences.zh: 市政府前面立著一座大型的馬匹銅雕，很受觀光客歡迎。

sentences.en: The park will display an outdoor sculpture by a famous artist from Spain for the next six months.
sentences.zh: 公園接下來六個月會展示一位西班牙知名藝術家的戶外雕塑。

sentences.en: More than ten thousand people visited the sculpture exhibition during its first week at the museum.
sentences.zh: 雕塑展在博物館的第一週就有一萬多人參觀。

sentences.en: The company paid an artist to create a sculpture for the lobby of its new headquarters.
sentences.zh: 公司付錢請一位藝術家為新總部的大廳創作一件雕塑。

sentences.en: Visitors are asked not to touch the sculpture, because the oil from their hands can damage the surface.
sentences.zh: 參觀者被要求不要觸摸雕塑，因為手上的油脂會損傷表面。

words.note: 語塊：bronze sculpture（銅雕）、outdoor sculpture（戶外雕塑）、sculpture exhibition（雕塑展）。sculpture 是「雕塑作品」；sculptor 是「雕刻家」；sculpt 是動詞「雕刻」。

sentences.en: Please dispose of all used batteries in the special box near the entrance instead of the regular trash.
sentences.zh: 請把所有用過的電池丟到入口附近的專用箱，而不是一般垃圾桶。

sentences.en: The factory must dispose of waste safely, or it will have to pay a heavy fine to the government.
sentences.zh: 工廠必須安全地處理廢棄物，否則要付給政府高額罰款。

sentences.en: Hospitals must properly dispose of needles and other medical waste to protect cleaning staff and the public.
sentences.zh: 醫院必須妥善處理針頭和其他醫療廢棄物，以保護清潔人員和民眾。

sentences.en: The company hired a special contractor to dispose of the old machines when the factory closed.
sentences.zh: 工廠關閉時，公司雇用了專門的承包商來處理舊機器。

sentences.en: Residents should dispose of large furniture by calling the city office and booking a collection date.
sentences.zh: 居民要丟大型家具，應該打電話給市公所預約收運日期。

words.note: 語塊：dispose of（處理掉……）、dispose of waste（處理廢棄物）、properly dispose of（妥善處理）。dispose 要加 of 才是「丟掉、處理掉」；disposal 是名詞；disposable 是「拋棄式的」。

sentences.en: Passengers may not bring any liquid larger than one hundred milliliters in their carry-on bags.
sentences.zh: 乘客不能在隨身行李中攜帶超過一百毫升的任何液體。

sentences.en: All restrooms in the building now have liquid soap instead of bars of soap to keep things clean.
sentences.zh: 大樓所有廁所現在都改用洗手乳取代肥皂，保持清潔。

sentences.en: The scientist poured a clear liquid into the glass and asked the students to watch the color change.
sentences.zh: 科學家把透明液體倒進玻璃杯，請學生觀察顏色變化。

sentences.en: Please clean up any liquid on the floor immediately to prevent customers from slipping and getting hurt in the store.
sentences.zh: 請立刻清理地上的任何液體，以免顧客在店裡滑倒受傷。

sentences.en: The company sells liquid soap in large bottles to hotels and restaurants at a special price.
sentences.zh: 那家公司以特價向飯店和餐廳販售大瓶裝的洗手乳。

words.note: 語塊：liquid soap（洗手乳）、clear liquid（透明液體）、liquids in carry-on bags（隨身行李中的液體）。liquid 可以當名詞或形容詞「液體的」；solid 是「固體」；gas 是「氣體」。

sentences.en: We regret to inform you that the concert has been canceled because the singer is sick.
sentences.zh: 我們很遺憾通知您，演唱會因歌手生病取消了。

sentences.en: The CEO wanted to express his regret to the customers who were affected by the problem with the website.
sentences.zh: 執行長想向受到網站問題影響的顧客表達遺憾。

sentences.en: Many people regret not saving more money when they were young, so they work longer before they retire.
sentences.zh: 很多人後悔年輕時沒有多存點錢，所以退休前工作得更久。

sentences.en: We regret to inform all passengers that the train to Busan will be delayed by about one hour.
sentences.zh: 我們很遺憾通知所有旅客，開往釜山的列車將延誤約一小時。

sentences.en: The company would like to express its regret for the delay and offer a full refund to every customer.
sentences.zh: 公司想對延誤表達遺憾，並為每位顧客提供全額退款。

words.note: 語塊：regret to inform（很遺憾通知）、express regret（表達遺憾）、regret doing（後悔做了……）。regret to do 是「很遺憾要做……」（regret to inform you）；regret doing 是「後悔做過……」。

sentences.en: The newspaper published an editorial that criticized the city's plan to build a new highway through the park.
sentences.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇社論，批評市政府要在公園裡蓋新高速公路的計畫。

sentences.en: The editorial team meets every morning to decide which stories will appear on the front page.
sentences.zh: 編輯團隊每天早上開會，決定哪些新聞會登上頭版。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant was asked to write an editorial about the importance of supporting local businesses.
sentences.zh: 格蘭特小姐受邀寫一篇關於支持在地商家重要性的社論。

sentences.en: Many readers sent letters to the newspaper after the editorial about rising housing prices in the capital.
sentences.zh: 那篇關於首都房價上漲的社論刊出後，很多讀者寫信給報社。

sentences.en: The magazine's editorial team is looking for a writer who has experience in travel and food.
sentences.zh: 雜誌的編輯團隊在找一位有旅遊和美食寫作經驗的作者。

words.note: 語塊：write an editorial（寫社論）、newspaper editorial（報紙社論）、editorial team（編輯團隊）。editorial 當名詞是「社論」，當形容詞是「編輯的」；editor 是「編輯」；edition 是「版本」。

sentences.en: The university offers a course in underwater archaeology for students who want to study old ships.
sentences.zh: 那所大學為想研究古船的學生開設水下考古學課程。

sentences.en: Dr. Lee decided to study archaeology after visiting the ancient temples in Cambodia as a child.
sentences.zh: 李博士小時候參觀過柬埔寨的古廟後，決定研究考古學。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibition shows objects found by experts in underwater archaeology near the coast.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽展出水下考古專家在海岸附近發現的物品。

sentences.en: Many students are interested in archaeology because it helps us understand how people lived long ago.
sentences.zh: 很多學生對考古學有興趣，因為它幫助我們了解很久以前人們如何生活。

sentences.en: The government gave a grant to the team to continue its work in underwater archaeology next year.
sentences.zh: 政府撥款給那個團隊，讓他們明年繼續進行水下考古工作。

words.note: 語塊：underwater archaeology（水下考古學）、study archaeology（研究考古學）。archaeology 是「考古學」；archaeologist 是「考古學家」；archaeological 是形容詞。

sentences.en: Please remit payment within thirty days of receiving the invoice to avoid a late fee.
sentences.zh: 請在收到請款單後三十天內匯款付清，以免產生滯納金。

sentences.en: Many workers who live abroad remit money to their families every month through mobile banking apps.
sentences.zh: 很多在國外工作的人每個月透過手機銀行 App 匯錢給家人。

sentences.en: Customers can remit payment by bank transfer or credit card, but we do not accept checks.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以用銀行轉帳或信用卡匯款付清，但我們不收支票。

sentences.en: The company will remit the money to your account as soon as the contract has been signed.
sentences.zh: 合約簽好後，公司會立刻把錢匯到你的帳戶。

sentences.en: If you are unable to remit payment by the due date, please contact our accounting office immediately.
sentences.zh: 如果您無法在到期日前匯款付清，請立刻聯絡我們的會計室。

words.note: 語塊：remit payment（匯款付清）、remit money（匯錢）、remit to（匯給……）。remit 是正式用語「匯款」；remittance 是名詞「匯款」；transfer 意思接近。

sentences.en: The client promised to wire money to our bank account by Friday so that we can start the project.
sentences.zh: 客戶答應週五前把錢電匯到我們的銀行帳戶，讓我們可以開始專案。

sentences.en: Please wire the deposit within three days, or we will not be able to hold the room for you.
sentences.zh: 請在三天內電匯訂金，否則我們無法為您保留房間。

sentences.en: The bank charges a fee of fifteen dollars for every wire transfer to another country.
sentences.zh: 銀行每筆國際電匯收取十五元手續費。

sentences.en: Electricians will wire the new office for internet and phones before the furniture arrives next week.
sentences.zh: 電工會在下週家具送到前，為新辦公室配好網路和電話線路。

sentences.en: Many customers prefer to wire money online because it is faster than going to the bank in person.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客比較喜歡在網路上電匯，因為比親自跑銀行快。

words.note: 語塊：wire money（電匯）、wire transfer（電匯）、be wired for（裝好……的線路）。wire 當動詞是「電匯；配電線」；當名詞是「電線」；wireless 是「無線的」。

sentences.en: The team will set a target date for the launch of the new website at the meeting on Monday.
sentences.zh: 團隊會在週一的會議上訂定新網站上線的目標日期。

sentences.en: The builder is working hard to meet the target date of March for the opening of the shopping mall.
sentences.zh: 建商正在努力趕上三月購物中心開幕的目標日期。

sentences.en: If we cannot meet the target date, we must tell the client as soon as possible and explain the reason.
sentences.zh: 如果我們無法在目標日期前完成，必須盡快告訴客戶並說明原因。

sentences.en: The target date for finishing the report is next Friday, but the final deadline is the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 完成報告的目標日期是下週五，但最後的截止期限是月底。

sentences.en: The manager asked each department to set a target date for reducing its paper use by half.
sentences.zh: 經理請每個部門訂定把用紙量減半的目標日期。

words.note: 語塊：set a target date（訂定目標日期）、meet the target date（達成目標日期）。target date 是預計完成某事的日期；deadline 是「截止期限」，語氣更強。

sentences.en: Mr. Ortiz will meet a client from Singapore at the hotel restaurant tomorrow to discuss the new contract.
sentences.zh: 奧蒂茲先生明天會在飯店餐廳和一位新加坡客戶見面，討論新合約。

sentences.en: The design company sent free samples to every potential client it met at the trade show last month.
sentences.zh: 那家設計公司寄免費樣品給上個月在展覽上認識的每位潛在客戶。

sentences.en: Our client list includes several large hotels, two airlines, and many small restaurants in the city.
sentences.zh: 我們的客戶名單包括好幾家大飯店、兩家航空公司和市內很多小餐廳。

sentences.en: The lawyer always calls each client personally to explain any changes in the case as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 那位律師總是親自打電話給每位委託人，盡快說明案件的任何變化。

sentences.en: Please treat every potential client politely, because even a small customer can become a big one later.
sentences.zh: 請禮貌對待每位潛在客戶，因為即使是小客戶之後也可能變成大客戶。

words.note: 語塊：meet a client（和客戶見面）、potential client（潛在客戶）、client list（客戶名單）。client 多指付費購買專業服務的「客戶」；customer 是一般商店的「顧客」。

sentences.en: The company is on course to reach its sales goal for the year, thanks to strong demand in December.
sentences.zh: 多虧十二月的強勁需求，公司有望達成年度銷售目標。

sentences.en: The construction of the new bridge is on course for completion by the end of next spring.
sentences.zh: 新橋的建設按計畫進行，預計明年春末完工。

sentences.en: The project manager holds weekly meetings to make sure the team stays on course with the schedule.
sentences.zh: 專案經理每週開會，確保團隊照時程進行。

sentences.en: Despite the bad weather, the delivery company says it is still on course to deliver all packages before the holiday.
sentences.zh: 儘管天氣不好，貨運公司說仍有望在假期前送達所有包裹。

sentences.en: If sales continue to grow at this rate, the store will be on course for its best year ever.
sentences.zh: 如果銷售繼續以這個速度成長，那家店有望迎來史上最好的一年。

words.note: 語塊：on course to（有望……）、on course for（朝……前進）、stay on course（保持進度）。on course 是「照原定方向前進」；off course 是「偏離方向」；of course 是「當然」，不要搞混。

sentences.en: If you need to take a day off, please send a request to your immediate supervisor at least one week in advance.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要請假，請至少提前一週向你的直屬主管提出申請。

sentences.en: All new employees report to their immediate supervisor on the first morning to receive their schedule.
sentences.zh: 所有新員工第一天早上都要向直屬主管報到，領取班表。

sentences.en: Please ask your immediate supervisor before you share any company documents with people outside the office.
sentences.zh: 把任何公司文件分享給外部人員之前，請先詢問你的直屬主管。

sentences.en: Ms. Chen's immediate supervisor recommended her for the promotion because of her excellent work this year.
sentences.zh: 陳小姐的直屬主管因為她今年表現優異而推薦她升職。

sentences.en: Any safety problems in the factory should be reported to your immediate supervisor right away.
sentences.zh: 工廠裡的任何安全問題都應該立刻向你的直屬主管報告。

words.note: 語塊：report to one's immediate supervisor（向直屬主管報告）、ask one's immediate supervisor（詢問直屬主管）。immediate 在這裡是「直接的」；supervisor 是「主管」；direct manager 意思一樣。

sentences.en: Ms. Romano has worked in the fashion industry for twenty years and now designs clothes for famous actors.
sentences.zh: 羅馬諾小姐在時尚產業工作二十年，現在為知名演員設計服裝。

sentences.en: The annual fashion show in Paris attracts designers, buyers, and reporters from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 巴黎一年一度的時裝秀吸引了來自世界各地的設計師、買家和記者。

sentences.en: Wide trousers are back in fashion this year, so many stores are selling them at the front of the shop.
sentences.zh: 寬褲今年又流行回來了，所以很多店都把它們擺在店面最前面賣。

sentences.en: The fashion industry produces a lot of waste, so some brands are now using recycled materials.
sentences.zh: 時尚產業產生大量廢棄物，所以有些品牌現在改用回收材料。

sentences.en: Tickets for the fashion show sold out in minutes, so the organizers decided to stream it online for free.
sentences.zh: 時裝秀的門票幾分鐘就賣光，所以主辦單位決定免費在網路上直播。

words.note: 語塊：fashion industry（時尚產業）、fashion show（時裝秀）、in fashion（流行中）。fashion 是「流行、時尚」；fashionable 是形容詞「時髦的」；old-fashioned 是「過時的」。

sentences.en: Please use this cleaning product only in a well-ventilated room, because the smell can be very strong.
sentences.zh: 請只在通風良好的房間使用這款清潔劑，因為味道可能很重。

sentences.en: The new office is bright and well-ventilated, with large windows that open onto a quiet garden.
sentences.zh: 新辦公室明亮又通風良好，大窗戶面向安靜的花園。

sentences.en: Paint should be stored in a cool and well-ventilated area, away from heat and direct sunlight.
sentences.zh: 油漆應存放在陰涼且通風良好的地方，遠離熱源和陽光直射。

sentences.en: Workers must stay in a well-ventilated area while they use strong chemicals in the factory or the laboratory.
sentences.zh: 工人在工廠或實驗室使用強效化學物質時必須待在通風良好的區域。

sentences.en: The hotel's rooms are all well-ventilated, so guests can sleep comfortably even without air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 飯店所有房間都通風良好，所以客人即使不開冷氣也能睡得舒服。

words.note: 語塊：well-ventilated room（通風良好的房間）、well-ventilated area（通風良好的區域）。ventilate 是「使通風」；ventilation 是「通風」；poorly ventilated 是「通風不良的」。

sentences.en: On misty mornings, flights from the small airport are often delayed until the weather clears.
sentences.zh: 在起霧的早晨，那座小機場的航班常常延誤到天氣轉好。

sentences.en: The mountain looks beautiful in misty weather, so many photographers visit it in early spring.
sentences.zh: 山在多霧的天氣裡看起來很美，所以很多攝影師會在早春去拍。

sentences.en: Drivers should turn on their lights and slow down on misty mornings when it is hard to see the road.
sentences.zh: 在看不清道路的起霧早晨，駕駛應該開燈並減速。

sentences.en: The tour company warned visitors that the view from the top may not be clear in misty weather.
sentences.zh: 旅行社提醒遊客，多霧的天氣時山頂的景色可能看不清楚。

sentences.en: It was a misty morning, so the ferry left the port thirty minutes later than usual.
sentences.zh: 那天早上起霧，所以渡輪比平常晚三十分鐘離港。

words.note: 語塊：misty morning（起霧的早晨）、misty weather（多霧的天氣）。misty 是「有薄霧的」；foggy 是「霧比較濃的」；mist 是名詞「薄霧」。

sentences.en: Customers who spend more than fifty dollars can enter a sweepstakes to win a trip to Hawaii.
sentences.zh: 消費超過五十元的顧客可以參加抽獎，有機會贏得夏威夷之旅。

sentences.en: Mr. Brown was surprised when he heard that he had won the sweepstakes and received a new car.
sentences.zh: 布朗先生聽到自己抽中大獎、得到一台新車時很驚訝。

sentences.en: The company's online sweepstakes attracted more than fifty thousand people from all over the country in its first week.
sentences.zh: 公司的線上抽獎活動第一週就吸引了全國各地五萬多人參加。

sentences.en: Employees of the store and their families are not allowed to enter the sweepstakes, according to the rules on the website.
sentences.zh: 依照網站上的規則，店家員工及其家人不得參加這項抽獎活動。

sentences.en: To enter the sweepstakes, please fill out the form on our website before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 要參加抽獎，請在月底前填寫我們網站上的表單。

words.note: 語塊：enter a sweepstakes（參加抽獎）、win a sweepstakes（抽中大獎）、online sweepstakes（線上抽獎）。sweepstakes 單複數同形；lottery 是「彩券」；raffle 是小型的「摸彩」。

sentences.en: The wedding shop offers a free consultation for every bride-to-be who books a dress before December.
sentences.zh: 婚紗店為每位在十二月前預訂禮服的準新娘提供免費諮詢。

sentences.en: The bride-to-be and her family visited three hotels before choosing the place for the wedding party.
sentences.zh: 準新娘和她的家人看了三家飯店才選定婚宴場地。

sentences.en: The magazine has a special section with advice for the bride-to-be on planning a wedding on a small budget.
sentences.zh: 雜誌有一個特別專欄，給準新娘用小預算籌辦婚禮的建議。

sentences.en: The bakery made a beautiful cake for the bride-to-be, decorated with edible flowers and gold leaves.
sentences.zh: 麵包店為準新娘做了一個漂亮的蛋糕，用可食用花朵和金箔裝飾。

sentences.en: Friends of the bride-to-be organized a surprise party for her at a small restaurant downtown.
sentences.zh: 準新娘的朋友在市中心一家小餐廳為她辦了一場驚喜派對。

words.note: 語塊：the bride-to-be and her family（準新娘和她的家人）、for the bride-to-be（給準新娘的）、friends of the bride-to-be（準新娘的朋友）。bride-to-be 是「即將結婚的女生」；groom-to-be 是「準新郎」；複數是 brides-to-be。

sentences.en: Customers who spend more than two hundred dollars qualify for free delivery anywhere in the city.
sentences.zh: 消費超過兩百元的顧客可以享市內免費送貨。

sentences.en: Ms. Ito studied for three years to qualify as a certified accountant before she joined the firm.
sentences.zh: 伊藤小姐在進那家事務所之前念了三年書，取得合格會計師資格。

sentences.en: Employees must work here for at least one year to qualify for the company's housing support program.
sentences.zh: 員工必須在這裡工作至少一年，才有資格申請公司的住房補助方案。

sentences.en: Students with high grades may qualify for a scholarship that pays for all of their university fees.
sentences.zh: 成績好的學生可能有資格獲得支付全部大學學費的獎學金。

sentences.en: Please check our website to see whether your old phone will qualify for the trade-in discount.
sentences.zh: 請上我們的網站看看你的舊手機是否符合以舊換新的折扣資格。

words.note: 語塊：qualify for（有資格獲得……）、qualify as（取得……資格）。qualify for + 名詞（qualify for a discount）；qualified 是形容詞「合格的」；qualification 是「資格」。

sentences.en: Taking the bus is an inexpensive option for tourists who want to see the city without renting a car.
sentences.zh: 對不想租車又想逛城市的觀光客來說，搭公車是便宜的選擇。

sentences.en: The restaurant serves delicious food that is relatively inexpensive, so it is always full at lunchtime.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的餐點好吃又相對便宜，所以午餐時間總是客滿。

sentences.en: Plastic chairs are inexpensive and light, but they are not as comfortable as wooden ones.
sentences.zh: 塑膠椅便宜又輕，但沒有木頭椅子舒服。

sentences.en: The hotel near the station is an inexpensive option for business travelers who only need a place to sleep.
sentences.zh: 車站附近的飯店對只需要地方睡覺的商務旅客來說是便宜的選擇。

sentences.en: Solar panels have become relatively inexpensive in recent years, so more families are installing them at home.
sentences.zh: 近年來太陽能板變得相對便宜，所以越來越多家庭在家裡裝。

words.note: 語塊：inexpensive option（便宜的選擇）、relatively inexpensive（相對便宜）。inexpensive 是比較委婉的「不貴」；cheap 有時帶「廉價、品質差」的意思；expensive 是「昂貴的」。

sentences.en: The new electric buses will help the city reduce carbon dioxide by about twenty percent each year.
sentences.zh: 新的電動公車每年會幫助城市減少約兩成的二氧化碳。

sentences.en: The factory installed special equipment to lower its carbon dioxide emissions and meet the new rules.
sentences.zh: 工廠安裝了特殊設備，以降低二氧化碳排放並符合新規定。

sentences.en: Trees absorb carbon dioxide from the air, so the company plants a tree for every product it sells.
sentences.zh: 樹木會吸收空氣中的二氧化碳，所以公司每賣出一件產品就種一棵樹。

sentences.en: Airlines are trying to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by using lighter planes and cleaner fuel.
sentences.zh: 航空公司正試著用更輕的飛機和更乾淨的燃料減少二氧化碳排放。

sentences.en: The report shows that carbon dioxide emissions from cars in the city have fallen for three years in a row.
sentences.zh: 報告顯示市區汽車的二氧化碳排放量已經連續三年下降。

words.note: 語塊：reduce carbon dioxide（減少二氧化碳）、carbon dioxide emissions（二氧化碳排放）。carbon dioxide 化學式是 CO2；carbon monoxide 是「一氧化碳」，有毒。

sentences.en: Whether the outdoor concert takes place will depend on the weather, so please check our website on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 戶外演唱會是否舉行要看天氣而定，所以請在週六查看我們的網站。

sentences.en: Many small towns depend on tourism, so a bad season can hurt local businesses very badly.
sentences.zh: 很多小鎮依賴觀光，所以淡季會嚴重衝擊當地商家。

sentences.en: The price of the trip will depend on the hotel you choose and the number of people in your group.
sentences.zh: 旅費會依你選的飯店和團體人數而定。

sentences.en: Our company does not want to depend on one supplier, so we buy materials from three different firms.
sentences.zh: 我們公司不想只依賴單一供應商，所以向三家不同的公司買材料。

sentences.en: The success of the new product will depend on how well the marketing team explains its benefits to customers.
sentences.zh: 新產品的成功取決於行銷團隊如何向顧客說明它的好處。

words.note: 語塊：depend on the weather（看天氣而定）、depend on tourism（依賴觀光）、depend on how（取決於如何……）。depend on 後面接名詞；dependent 是形容詞「依賴的」（be dependent on）。

sentences.en: Sending documents by e-mail is a cost-effective way to communicate with clients in other countries.
sentences.zh: 用電子郵件寄文件是和其他國家客戶聯絡的划算方法。

sentences.en: The consultant suggested a cost-effective solution that will save the company thousands of dollars a year.
sentences.zh: 顧問建議了一個有成本效益的方案，每年能幫公司省下數千元。

sentences.en: Online advertising is often more cost-effective than television ads for small businesses with limited budgets.
sentences.zh: 對預算有限的小公司來說，網路廣告通常比電視廣告更划算。

sentences.en: The city is looking for a cost-effective way to repair the old roads without closing them for months.
sentences.zh: 市政府在找一個划算的方法，不必封路好幾個月就能修好舊道路。

sentences.en: Solar energy has become a cost-effective solution for many factories that use a lot of electricity during the day.
sentences.zh: 太陽能已經成為很多白天大量用電的工廠有成本效益的方案。

words.note: 語塊：cost-effective way（划算的方法）、cost-effective solution（有成本效益的方案）。cost-effective 是「花的錢值得」；economical 意思接近；cost-efficient 也可以用。

sentences.en: The hotel provides airport transportation at no cost to guests who stay for more than three nights.
sentences.zh: 飯店為住宿超過三晚的客人提供免費機場接送。

sentences.en: If the product breaks within one year, we will repair it at no cost to the customer.
sentences.zh: 如果產品在一年內損壞，我們會免費替顧客修理。

sentences.en: Employees can attend the language classes at no cost, because the company pays for all of the fees.
sentences.zh: 員工可以免費上語言課，因為公司支付所有費用。

sentences.en: The museum offers guided tours for visitors at no cost every Saturday and Sunday afternoon in the main hall.
sentences.zh: 博物館每週六和週日下午在大廳為參觀者提供免費導覽。

sentences.en: We will replace the damaged items at no cost to you and send them by express mail tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我們會免費為您更換損壞的商品，明天用快遞寄出。

words.note: 語塊：at no cost to（不需……付費）、at no cost to you（您不用付費）。at no cost 等於 free of charge；at no extra cost 是「不另外收費」。

sentences.en: The outsourcing of customer service to another country helped the company reduce its costs by thirty percent.
sentences.zh: 把客服外包到另一個國家，幫助公司降低了三成的成本。

sentences.en: Many small companies hire an outsourcing company to handle their payroll and accounting work every month.
sentences.zh: 很多小公司每個月雇用外包公司處理薪資和會計工作。

sentences.en: Some employees worry that outsourcing will cause them to lose their jobs in the next few years.
sentences.zh: 有些員工擔心外包會讓他們在未來幾年失去工作。

sentences.en: The board will discuss the outsourcing of the IT department at its meeting next Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 董事會下週二的會議會討論資訊部門外包的事。

sentences.en: The outsourcing company we chose has offices in four countries and provides support twenty-four hours a day.
sentences.zh: 我們選的外包公司在四個國家設有辦公室，提供二十四小時支援。

words.note: 語塊：outsourcing company（外包公司）、outsourcing of（……的外包）。outsourcing 是把工作交給外部公司做；outsource 是動詞；in-house 是「公司內部自己做」。

sentences.en: The number of accidents on the highway will decrease by half if the new speed cameras work as planned.
sentences.zh: 如果新的測速照相機照計畫運作，高速公路上的事故數量會減少一半。

sentences.en: Sales of paper books did not decrease significantly last year, which surprised many experts in the industry.
sentences.zh: 去年紙本書的銷量並沒有顯著減少，讓很多業界專家很意外。

sentences.en: The price of the new phone will gradually decrease as more companies start selling similar models.
sentences.zh: 隨著更多公司開始販售類似機型，新手機的價格會逐漸下降。

sentences.en: The company hopes to decrease its use of plastic by forty percent within the next three years.
sentences.zh: 公司希望在未來三年內把塑膠用量減少四成。

sentences.en: Our electricity costs began to decrease significantly after we installed solar panels on the roof.
sentences.zh: 在屋頂裝了太陽能板後，我們的電費開始顯著減少。

words.note: 語塊：decrease by（減少了……）、decrease significantly（顯著減少）、gradually decrease（逐漸減少）。decrease 可以當動詞或名詞（a decrease in sales）；increase 是相反詞「增加」；reduce 是「（主動）減少」。

sentences.en: The restaurant was closed for a week after health inspectors found a rodent problem in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 衛生檢查員在廚房發現鼠患後，那家餐廳被勒令停業一週。

sentences.en: The warehouse hired a company that specializes in rodent control to protect the food stored there.
sentences.zh: 倉庫雇用了一家專門防治鼠害的公司，保護存放在那裡的食物。

sentences.en: Please keep all food in closed containers so that we do not have a rodent problem in the office.
sentences.zh: 請把所有食物放在密封容器裡，以免辦公室發生鼠患。

sentences.en: The city spends a lot of money on rodent control every year, especially in areas near the markets.
sentences.zh: 市政府每年在防治鼠害上花很多錢，特別是在市場附近的地區。

sentences.en: A small rodent was found in the storage room, so the manager called a pest control company immediately.
sentences.zh: 儲藏室裡發現一隻小老鼠，所以經理立刻打電話給除蟲公司。

words.note: 語塊：rodent problem（鼠患）、rodent control（防治鼠害）。rodent 是老鼠、松鼠這類「囓齒動物」的總稱；rat 是大老鼠，mouse 是小老鼠。

sentences.en: The company will hold a big party to mark the anniversary of its founding fifty years ago.
sentences.zh: 公司會舉辦盛大的派對，紀念五十年前的創立週年。

sentences.en: The opening of the new factory will mark the beginning of a new period of growth for the town.
sentences.zh: 新工廠的開幕將標誌這個小鎮新一波成長的開始。

sentences.en: Please mark each box with the name of your department so that the movers know where to take it.
sentences.zh: 請在每個箱子上標示你的部門名稱，讓搬家工人知道要搬去哪裡。

sentences.en: The city will plant a hundred trees in the park to mark the anniversary of the end of the war.
sentences.zh: 市政府會在公園種一百棵樹，紀念戰爭結束週年。

sentences.en: The sale will mark the beginning of the holiday season, so the store expects many customers this weekend.
sentences.zh: 這場特賣會標誌著假期購物季的開始，所以店家預期這週末會有很多顧客。

words.note: 語塊：mark the anniversary（紀念週年）、mark the beginning of（標誌……的開始）、be marked with（標有……）。mark 當動詞是「做記號；紀念」；當名詞是「記號；分數」；market 是「市場」。

sentences.en: Ms. Park left the bank to start her own management consultancy, which now has more than forty employees.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐離開銀行，創立了自己的管理顧問公司，現在有四十多名員工。

sentences.en: The consultancy fee for the project will be paid in three parts, at the beginning, middle, and end.
sentences.zh: 專案的顧問費會分三期支付，分別在開始、中期和結束時。

sentences.en: We hired a consultancy firm to help us decide whether to open new stores in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 我們雇用了一家顧問公司，幫我們決定是否要在東南亞開新店。

sentences.en: The management consultancy suggested that the company should reduce the number of meetings each week.
sentences.zh: 那家管理顧問公司建議公司減少每週的會議次數。

sentences.en: The consultancy firm specializes in helping hospitals improve their services and reduce waiting times for patients.
sentences.zh: 那家顧問公司專門協助醫院改善服務並縮短病人的候診時間。

words.note: 語塊：management consultancy（管理顧問公司）、consultancy fee（顧問費）、consultancy firm（顧問公司）。consultancy 是提供顧問服務的「公司」或「業務」；consultant 是「顧問（人）」。

sentences.en: If you have any problems with your order, please contact our customer care team by phone or e-mail.
sentences.zh: 如果您的訂單有任何問題，請透過電話或電子郵件聯絡我們的客服團隊。

sentences.en: The customer care center is open from eight in the morning until ten at night, seven days a week.
sentences.zh: 客服中心一週七天從早上八點開到晚上十點。

sentences.en: The hotel is famous for its excellent customer care, and many guests return every year.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店以優質的客戶服務聞名，很多客人每年都會再來。

sentences.en: All new staff in the customer care team receive two weeks of training before they answer calls.
sentences.zh: 客服團隊的所有新員工在接電話之前都要接受兩週的訓練。

sentences.en: Excellent customer care is the main reason why our customers choose us instead of our competitors.
sentences.zh: 優質的客戶服務是顧客選擇我們而不是競爭對手的主要原因。

words.note: 語塊：customer care team（客服團隊）、customer care center（客服中心）、excellent customer care（優質的客戶服務）。customer care 和 customer service 意思一樣，都是「客服」。

sentences.en: The government offers a tax deduction to people who buy an electric vehicle instead of a gas car.
sentences.zh: 政府為買電動車而不是汽油車的人提供稅金扣抵。

sentences.en: Only employees with special permission may drive a company vehicle outside of working hours or on weekends.
sentences.zh: 只有獲得特別許可的員工可以在上班時間以外或週末開公司車。

sentences.en: Please do not park a vehicle in front of the fire exit, or it will be removed at the owner's expense.
sentences.zh: 請勿把車停在逃生出口前，否則會被拖走，費用由車主負擔。

sentences.en: Every vehicle that enters the factory must stop at the gate so that security staff can check it.
sentences.zh: 每輛進入工廠的車輛都必須在大門停下，讓保全人員檢查。

sentences.en: The city plans to build more charging stations because the number of electric vehicle owners is growing quickly.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫增設更多充電站，因為電動車車主的人數快速成長。

words.note: 語塊：electric vehicle（電動車）、company vehicle（公司車）、park a vehicle（停車）。vehicle 是各種「車輛」的正式說法；h 不發音，唸作 /ˈviːɪkəl/。

sentences.en: Hotel prices on the island are almost twice as high during peak season, so many families travel in spring.
sentences.zh: 島上的飯店價格在旺季幾乎貴一倍，所以很多家庭選在春天旅遊。

sentences.en: The airline will add more flights to Tokyo during peak season to meet the high demand from tourists.
sentences.zh: 航空公司會在旺季增加飛東京的航班，以應付觀光客的高需求。

sentences.en: Peak season rates apply from July to August, so please book early if you want a lower price.
sentences.zh: 七月到八月適用旺季價格，所以如果想要便宜一點請提早預訂。

sentences.en: The restaurant hires twenty extra workers during peak season because the town is full of visitors.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳在旺季會多雇二十名員工，因為鎮上擠滿遊客。

sentences.en: Many shops in the beach town close for several months after the peak season ends in September.
sentences.zh: 九月旺季結束後，海邊小鎮很多店都會休息好幾個月。

words.note: 語塊：during peak season（旺季期間）、peak season rates（旺季價格）。peak season 是「生意最好的季節」；off-season 或 low season 是「淡季」；peak hours 是「尖峰時段」。

sentences.en: The company has a short window of opportunity to launch its product before competitors enter the market.
sentences.zh: 在競爭對手進入市場前，公司只有一段很短的時間可以推出產品。

sentences.en: Customers can choose a two-hour delivery window when they place their order on our website.
sentences.zh: 顧客在我們網站下單時可以選擇兩小時的配送時段。

sentences.en: The repair technician will arrive within a time window of nine to twelve in the morning.
sentences.zh: 維修技術人員會在早上九點到十二點的時間範圍內抵達。

sentences.en: Please buy your train tickets at the window near the main entrance of the station.
sentences.zh: 請在車站正門附近的窗口買火車票。

sentences.en: If you miss the delivery window, our driver will try to deliver the package again the next day.
sentences.zh: 如果你錯過配送時段，我們的司機隔天會再試著送一次包裹。

words.note: 語塊：window of opportunity（機會之窗）、delivery window（配送時段）、time window（時間範圍）。window 除了「窗戶」，也指一段可以做某事的「時間」；ticket window 是「售票窗口」。

sentences.en: Airport security staff will confiscate any liquids larger than one hundred milliliters in your carry-on bag.
sentences.zh: 機場安檢人員會沒收你隨身行李中超過一百毫升的任何液體。

sentences.en: Teachers may confiscate phones that students use during class and return them at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 老師可以沒收學生上課時使用的手機，放學時再歸還。

sentences.en: The police will confiscate fake products that are sold at the night market without permission.
sentences.zh: 警方會沒收在夜市未經許可販售的仿冒品。

sentences.en: Customs officers can confiscate items that are not allowed into the country, such as fresh fruit and meat.
sentences.zh: 海關人員可以沒收不准入境的物品，例如新鮮水果和肉類。

sentences.en: If you bring food into the concert hall, the staff will confiscate it at the entrance.
sentences.zh: 如果你帶食物進音樂廳，工作人員會在入口沒收。

words.note: 語塊：confiscate items（沒收物品）、be confiscated by（被……沒收）。confiscate 是官方或有權力的人「沒收」；seize 意思接近；concentrate 是「專心」，拼法有點像。

sentences.en: The artist will sculpt a statue of the town's founder, which will stand in front of the new library.
sentences.zh: 那位藝術家將雕刻小鎮創辦人的雕像，雕像會立在新圖書館前面。

sentences.en: Students in the art class learn how to sculpt in clay before they start working with stone.
sentences.zh: 美術課的學生在開始使用石材之前，先學如何用黏土塑造。

sentences.en: It took the artist almost a year to sculpt the large horse from a single piece of white marble.
sentences.zh: 那位藝術家花了將近一年，用一整塊白色大理石雕出那匹大馬。

sentences.en: Visitors to the festival can watch artists sculpt animals from ice in the town square.
sentences.zh: 參加節慶的遊客可以在小鎮廣場看藝術家用冰雕刻動物。

sentences.en: The museum invited a famous artist to sculpt a statue for its fiftieth anniversary celebration.
sentences.zh: 博物館邀請一位知名藝術家為五十週年慶雕刻一座雕像。

words.note: 語塊：sculpt a statue（雕刻雕像）、sculpt in clay（用黏土塑造）、sculpt from（用……雕刻）。sculpt 是動詞；sculpture 是「雕塑作品」；sculptor 是「雕刻家」。

sentences.en: The café sells cups and plates made by a local potter who has a small studio in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 那家咖啡廳販售一位在山上有小工作室的當地陶藝家做的杯盤。

sentences.en: A skilled potter with a good electric wheel can make more than fifty bowls in a single day.
sentences.zh: 一位技術好的陶藝家用好的電動拉坯機，一天可以做五十多個碗。

sentences.en: The workshop is taught by a skilled potter who has won several international awards for her work.
sentences.zh: 這個工作坊由一位作品得過好幾個國際獎的資深陶藝家授課。

sentences.en: Every summer, the town holds a market where each local potter can sell his or her work to tourists.
sentences.zh: 每年夏天小鎮都會舉辦市集，讓每位當地陶藝家向觀光客販售作品。

sentences.en: The local potter showed the students how to shape the clay and use the wheel safely in her studio.
sentences.zh: 那位當地陶藝家在她的工作室示範給學生看如何塑形黏土和安全地使用拉坯機。

words.note: 語塊：local potter（當地陶藝家）、skilled potter（技術好的陶藝家）。potter 是「做陶器的人」；pottery 是「陶器；陶藝」；pot 是「鍋；壺」。

sentences.en: The potter will apply a coat of glaze to the bowls before they go into the hot kiln.
sentences.zh: 陶藝家在碗放進高溫窯之前，會先塗上一層釉。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim plans to apply for the manager position that was advertised on the company website last week.
sentences.zh: 金小姐打算申請上週公司網站刊登的經理職位。

sentences.en: The new rules apply to all employees, including part-time workers and staff in overseas offices.
sentences.zh: 新規定適用於所有員工，包括兼職人員和海外辦公室的員工。

sentences.en: Please apply a coat of paint to the walls and wait at least four hours before adding the second one.
sentences.zh: 請在牆上塗一層油漆，等至少四小時再塗第二層。

sentences.en: Students who want to apply for the scholarship must submit their application before the end of March.
sentences.zh: 想申請獎學金的學生必須在三月底前提交申請。

words.note: 語塊：apply for（申請）、apply to（適用於；向……申請）、apply a coat of（塗一層……）。apply for 是「申請」；apply to 是「適用於」；apply 也可以是「塗抹」（apply glaze）。

sentences.en: After the bowls are dry, the potter will apply glaze to give them a shiny surface and bright colors.
sentences.zh: 碗乾了之後，陶藝家會上釉，讓它們有光亮的表面和鮮豔的顏色。

sentences.en: The cups are covered with a clear glaze, so you can still see the natural color of the clay.
sentences.zh: 杯子上了一層透明釉，所以還是看得到黏土的天然顏色。

sentences.en: Each glaze color looks different after firing, so the potter tests every new color on a small tile first.
sentences.zh: 每種釉色燒製後看起來都不一樣，所以陶藝家會先在小磁磚上測試每種新顏色。

sentences.en: The workshop teaches beginners how to apply glaze evenly so that the plates look professional.
sentences.zh: 工作坊教初學者如何均勻上釉，讓盤子看起來很專業。

sentences.en: Customers can choose their favorite glaze color when they order handmade plates from our studio.
sentences.zh: 顧客向我們工作室訂做手工盤子時，可以選擇自己最喜歡的釉色。

words.note: 語塊：apply glaze（上釉）、clear glaze（透明釉）、glaze color（釉色）。glaze 可以當名詞「釉」或動詞「上釉」；glass 是「玻璃」；graze 是「吃草」。

sentences.en: The bowls must be fired in a kiln at a very high temperature for about ten hours.
sentences.zh: 碗必須在窯裡以非常高的溫度燒大約十小時。

sentences.en: The studio bought a new electric kiln that uses less energy and is easier to control than the old one.
sentences.zh: 工作室買了一台新的電窯，比舊的更省電也更容易控制。

sentences.en: The potter checks the kiln temperature carefully, because the glaze can crack if it gets too hot.
sentences.zh: 陶藝家會仔細檢查窯溫，因為溫度太高釉可能會裂開。

sentences.en: Students are not allowed to open the electric kiln, because it stays very hot for several hours.
sentences.zh: 學生不准打開電窯，因為它好幾個小時都會很燙。

sentences.en: All of the cups are fired in a kiln twice, once before and once after the glaze is applied.
sentences.zh: 所有杯子都在窯裡燒兩次，上釉前一次、上釉後一次。

words.note: 語塊：electric kiln（電窯）、fire in a kiln（在窯裡燒製）、kiln temperature（窯溫）。kiln 是燒陶瓷或磚頭的「窯」；n 前面的 l 要發音，唸作 /kɪln/；oven 是一般「烤箱」。

sentences.en: Upon completion of the training course, each participant will receive a certificate from the company.
sentences.zh: 完成訓練課程後，每位參加者都會獲得公司頒發的證書。

sentences.en: The completion date of the new stadium has been moved to next June because of the bad weather.
sentences.zh: 因為天氣不好，新體育場的完工日期延到明年六月。

sentences.en: The new hospital is near completion and is expected to open to the public at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 新醫院接近完工，預計年底開放給民眾使用。

sentences.en: Payment will be made upon completion of the work, after the client has checked everything carefully.
sentences.zh: 款項會在工作完成、客戶仔細檢查所有東西之後支付。

sentences.en: The builder promised that the completion date would not change, even if more workers were needed.
sentences.zh: 建商保證即使需要更多工人，完工日期也不會改變。

words.note: 語塊：upon completion（完成時）、completion date（完工日期）、near completion（接近完成）。completion 是 complete（完成）的名詞；completely 是副詞「完全地」。

sentences.en: The gallery will exhibit works by young artists from all over Asia during the month of December.
sentences.zh: 畫廊十二月將展出來自亞洲各地年輕藝術家的作品。

sentences.en: More than three hundred companies will exhibit at the technology fair in Berlin next spring.
sentences.zh: 明年春天將有三百多家公司在柏林的科技展參展。

sentences.en: The museum plans to exhibit the ancient ceramic bowls that were found by the underwater archaeology team.
sentences.zh: 博物館打算展出水下考古團隊發現的古代陶碗。

sentences.en: Our company will exhibit its new electric bicycles at the trade show, so please visit our booth.
sentences.zh: 我們公司會在展覽上展出新的電動自行車，請來我們的攤位參觀。

sentences.en: The potter was invited to exhibit works at a famous gallery in Tokyo after winning an international award.
sentences.zh: 那位陶藝家贏得國際獎後，受邀在東京一家知名藝廊展出作品。

words.note: 語塊：exhibit works（展出作品）、exhibit at（在……展出）。exhibit 可以當動詞「展示」或名詞「展品；展覽」；exhibition 是「展覽（會）」。

sentences.en: The hotel will provide guests with free breakfast, parking, and airport transportation during their stay.
sentences.zh: 飯店會在住宿期間提供客人免費早餐、停車和機場接送。

sentences.en: The company will provide laptops for all new employees on their first day of work.
sentences.zh: 公司會在第一天上班時為所有新員工提供筆電。

sentences.en: We provide free delivery for customers who live within ten kilometers of the store or spend over fifty dollars.
sentences.zh: 我們為住在店家十公里內或消費超過五十元的顧客提供免費送貨。

sentences.en: The city plans to provide residents with more information about recycling through a new mobile app.
sentences.zh: 市政府打算透過新的手機 App 提供居民更多回收資訊。

sentences.en: The training program will provide workers with the skills they need to operate the new machinery safely.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫會提供工人安全操作新機械所需的技能。

words.note: 語塊：provide sb with（提供某人……）、provide sth for（為……提供）、provided that（只要……）。provide sb with sth 或 provide sth for/to sb；provider 是「提供者」；provided that 是「只要」。

sentences.en: Analysts project growth of about five percent in the tourism sector over the next two years.
sentences.zh: 分析師預估觀光業在未來兩年會成長約百分之五。

sentences.en: The finance team will project sales for next year based on the results of the last three years.
sentences.zh: 財務團隊會根據過去三年的結果預估明年的銷售。

sentences.en: Economists project that housing prices will continue to rise in the capital until at least next summer.
sentences.zh: 經濟學家預測首都房價至少會持續上漲到明年夏天。

sentences.en: The company did not project growth in the European market, so the strong sales there were a surprise.
sentences.zh: 公司沒有預估歐洲市場的成長，所以那裡的銷售強勁是個驚喜。

sentences.en: Experts project sales of electric cars to double in the region within the next five years.
sentences.zh: 專家預估這一區電動車的銷量在未來五年內會加倍。

words.note: 語塊：be projected to（預計會……）、project growth（預估成長）、project sales（預估銷售）。project 當動詞（重音在後）是「預估、投射」；當名詞（重音在前）是「專案」；projection 是「預測」。

sentences.en: The board will appoint a managing director for the new Asian division at its meeting next week.
sentences.zh: 董事會下週開會時會為新的亞洲事業部任命總經理。

sentences.en: Ms. Fischer has been the managing director of the company since it was founded fifteen years ago.
sentences.zh: 費雪小姐從公司十五年前創立以來一直擔任總經理。

sentences.en: The managing director will visit every branch this month to meet employees and listen to their ideas.
sentences.zh: 總經理這個月會走訪每家分公司，和員工見面並聽取他們的意見。

sentences.en: Mr. Choi was promoted to managing director after he helped the company double its profits in three years.
sentences.zh: 崔先生幫公司在三年內獲利加倍後，被升為總經理。

sentences.en: All requests for large purchases must be approved by the managing director before the order is placed.
sentences.zh: 所有大筆採購申請都必須在下單前由總經理核准。

words.note: 語塊：appoint a managing director（任命總經理）、managing director of（……的總經理）。managing director 常縮寫成 MD，英式公司裡常等於 CEO；manager 是一般「經理」。

sentences.en: The airline is a wholly owned subsidiary of a large company that also runs hotels and travel agencies.
sentences.zh: 那家航空公司是一家大企業的全資子公司，母公司也經營飯店和旅行社。

sentences.en: The company opened an overseas subsidiary in Vietnam to produce clothing at a lower cost.
sentences.zh: 公司在越南設立海外子公司，以較低成本生產服裝。

sentences.en: Ms. Ng was sent to manage the overseas subsidiary in Brazil for three years before she returned to the head office.
sentences.zh: 吳小姐被派去管理巴西的海外子公司三年，才回到總公司。

sentences.en: The software company became a subsidiary of a larger technology firm after the merger last year.
sentences.zh: 那家軟體公司在去年合併後成為一家較大科技公司的子公司。

sentences.en: Each subsidiary must send its financial report to the parent company at the end of every quarter.
sentences.zh: 每家子公司都必須在每季末把財務報告交給母公司。

words.note: 語塊：wholly owned subsidiary（全資子公司）、overseas subsidiary（海外子公司）、subsidiary of（……的子公司）。subsidiary 是被母公司控制的「子公司」；parent company 是「母公司」；subsidy 是「補助金」。

sentences.en: Buying a phone during the holiday sale is a good deal, because prices are usually thirty percent lower.
sentences.zh: 在假期特賣買手機很划算，因為價格通常便宜三成。

sentences.en: Our sales team worked for six months to close a deal with the largest supermarket chain in the country.
sentences.zh: 我們的業務團隊努力了六個月，跟全國最大的連鎖超市談成交易。

sentences.en: The customer service staff are trained to deal with complaints from customers quickly, politely, and professionally.
sentences.zh: 客服人員都受過訓練，要快速、有禮貌又專業地處理顧客的投訴。

sentences.en: The two companies finally reached a deal after several weeks of difficult negotiations about prices and delivery dates.
sentences.zh: 經過好幾週關於價格和交貨日期的艱難談判，兩家公司終於達成協議。

sentences.en: If you book your hotel and flight together on our website, you will get a better deal.
sentences.zh: 如果在我們網站上同時訂飯店和機票，可以拿到更划算的價格。

words.note: 語塊：good deal（划算的交易）、close a deal（談成交易）、deal with（處理）。deal 當名詞是「交易、優惠」；deal with 是片語「處理」；a great deal of 是「大量的」。

sentences.en: Our products are more expensive, but they are made with superior quality materials that last much longer.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品比較貴，但用的是優良品質的材料，可以用更久。

sentences.en: The new model is superior to the old one in speed, battery life, and design.
sentences.zh: 新機型在速度、電池續航力和設計上都優於舊機型。

sentences.en: The hotel is famous for its superior service, and many guests write positive reviews online.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店以優質服務聞名，很多客人在網路上寫好評。

sentences.en: Many customers believe that handmade furniture is superior to furniture produced in large factories overseas.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客認為手工家具優於海外大工廠生產的家具。

sentences.en: The company won the contract because it offered superior quality and service at a very reasonable price.
sentences.zh: 那家公司拿下合約，是因為它以非常合理的價格提供優良品質和服務。

words.note: 語塊：superior quality（優良品質）、superior to（優於……）、superior service（優質服務）。superior to 用 to，不用 than；inferior 是相反詞「較差的」；當名詞是「上司」。

sentences.en: The chef left the hotel to open an upscale restaurant in the city center, where dinner costs about a hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 那位主廚離開飯店，在市中心開了一家高檔餐廳，晚餐大約一百元。

sentences.en: Apartments in this upscale neighborhood are expensive, but they are close to parks, schools, and good shops.
sentences.zh: 這個高級住宅區的公寓很貴，但靠近公園、學校和好的商店。

sentences.en: The fashion brand wants to enter the upscale market by selling high-quality bags at higher prices.
sentences.zh: 那個時尚品牌想用較高的價格販售高品質包包，進入高端市場。

sentences.en: The new shopping mall is full of upscale stores that sell jewelry, watches, and designer clothes.
sentences.zh: 新購物中心滿是販售珠寶、手錶和名牌服飾的高檔商店。

sentences.en: Many young professionals are moving into the upscale neighborhood near the river because of the new subway line.
sentences.zh: 因為新的地鐵線，很多年輕專業人士搬進河邊的高級住宅區。

words.note: 語塊：upscale restaurant（高檔餐廳）、upscale neighborhood（高級住宅區）、upscale market（高端市場）。upscale 是美式說法「高檔的」；luxury 意思接近；downscale 是「低價位的」。

sentences.en: The dentist's office will send a reminder by text message one day before your appointment.
sentences.zh: 牙醫診所會在你預約的前一天傳簡訊提醒你。

sentences.en: This is a friendly reminder that the office will be closed on Monday for the national holiday.
sentences.zh: 友善提醒，辦公室週一因國定假日休息。

sentences.en: As a reminder, all employees must complete the online safety training by the end of this week.
sentences.zh: 提醒一下，所有員工都必須在本週末前完成線上安全訓練。

sentences.en: The library sends a reminder to every member whose books are due in three days.
sentences.zh: 圖書館會寄提醒給每位借的書三天後到期的會員。

sentences.en: Please send a reminder to the client about the payment, because the invoice is now two weeks late.
sentences.zh: 請寄一封付款提醒給客戶，因為請款單已經逾期兩週了。

words.note: 語塊：send a reminder（寄提醒）、friendly reminder（友善提醒）、as a reminder（提醒一下）。reminder 是 remind（提醒）的名詞；remind sb of / to do 是「提醒某人……」。

sentences.en: All meeting rooms in the hotel are equipped with modern audiovisual equipment, including projectors and speakers.
sentences.zh: 飯店所有會議室都配有現代化的視聽設備，包括投影機和喇叭。

sentences.en: Please contact the technician if you need help setting up the audiovisual equipment for your presentation.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要協助架設簡報用的視聽設備，請聯絡技術人員。

sentences.en: The language school uses audiovisual materials such as videos and songs to make lessons more interesting.
sentences.zh: 那間語言學校使用影片和歌曲等視聽教材，讓課程更有趣。

sentences.en: The conference center will replace all of its old audiovisual equipment before the international meeting in May.
sentences.zh: 會議中心會在五月的國際會議前更換所有舊的視聽設備。

sentences.en: Teachers can borrow audiovisual materials from the library for up to two weeks at no cost.
sentences.zh: 老師可以免費向圖書館借視聽教材，最多兩週。

words.note: 語塊：audiovisual equipment（視聽設備）、audiovisual materials（視聽教材）。audiovisual 常縮寫成 AV；audio 是「聲音的」，visual 是「視覺的」。

sentences.en: Please arrive ahead of time for the interview so that you can fill out the application form at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 面試請提早到，這樣你可以在櫃台填申請表。

sentences.en: Tickets for the museum are cheaper if you book ahead of time on the website instead of buying them at the door.
sentences.zh: 博物館門票在網站上事先預訂會比現場買便宜。

sentences.en: Good speakers always prepare ahead of time and practice their presentation at least three times.
sentences.zh: 好的講者總是事先準備，至少練習三次簡報。

sentences.en: The team finished the project two weeks ahead of time, so the manager gave everyone a day off.
sentences.zh: 團隊提前兩週完成專案，所以經理讓每個人放一天假。

sentences.en: If you need a special meal on the flight, please tell the airline ahead of time when you book your ticket.
sentences.zh: 如果你在飛機上需要特殊餐點，請在訂票時事先告訴航空公司。

words.note: 語塊：arrive ahead of time（提早到）、book ahead of time（事先預訂）、prepare ahead of time（事先準備）。ahead of time 等於 in advance；ahead of schedule 是「比預定時間早」。

sentences.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited in all areas of the hospital, including the parking lot and the garden.
sentences.zh: 醫院所有區域都嚴格禁止吸菸，包括停車場和花園。

sentences.en: The information in this report is strictly confidential and should not be shared with anyone outside the team.
sentences.zh: 這份報告的資訊極機密，不應該分享給團隊以外的任何人。

sentences.en: All workers must strictly follow the safety rules when they operate heavy machinery in the factory.
sentences.zh: 所有工人在工廠操作重型機械時都必須嚴格遵守安全規定。

sentences.en: Taking photos is strictly prohibited inside the gallery, because the light can damage the paintings.
sentences.zh: 畫廊內嚴格禁止拍照，因為光線會損傷畫作。

sentences.en: The new contract is strictly confidential until both companies officially announce the deal at the press conference next Monday.
sentences.zh: 在兩家公司下週一於記者會正式宣布交易之前，新合約都是極機密。

words.note: 語塊：strictly prohibited（嚴格禁止）、strictly confidential（極機密）、strictly follow（嚴格遵守）。strictly 是 strict（嚴格的）的副詞；strictly speaking 是「嚴格來說」。

sentences.en: The printer comes with one ink cartridge, but extra cartridges are sold separately at the counter.
sentences.zh: 印表機附一個墨水匣，但額外的墨水匣在櫃台另售。

sentences.en: Each guest can pay separately at the end of the meal, so there is no need to split the bill yourselves.
sentences.zh: 每位客人用餐後都可以分開付款，所以不用自己分帳。

sentences.en: The two teams will work separately on the project for a month and then share their results.
sentences.zh: 兩個團隊會分開做這個專案一個月，然後分享結果。

sentences.en: Please keep your receipts for the trip separately from your personal receipts so that accounting can check them easily.
sentences.zh: 請把出差收據和個人收據分開放，方便會計檢查。

sentences.en: The batteries are sold separately, so please remember to buy them if you want to use the toy right away.
sentences.zh: 電池另售，所以如果想馬上玩這個玩具，請記得買電池。

words.note: 語塊：sold separately（另售）、pay separately（分開付款）、separately from（與……分開）。separately 是 separate（分開的）的副詞；together 是相反詞「一起」。

sentences.en: All new employees must attend a training session on the computer system during their first week.
sentences.zh: 所有新員工第一週都必須參加電腦系統的訓練課程。

sentences.en: The speech will be followed by a question-and-answer session, so please prepare your questions in advance.
sentences.zh: 演講之後會有問答時間，所以請事先準備好問題。

sentences.en: The morning session of the conference will focus on marketing, and the afternoon will focus on finance.
sentences.zh: 研討會上午場會聚焦行銷，下午則聚焦財務。

sentences.en: If you cannot attend the training session on Monday, please sign up for the one on Thursday instead.
sentences.zh: 如果你無法參加週一的訓練課程，請改報名週四那場。

sentences.en: Each session at the gym lasts one hour and is led by an experienced fitness instructor.
sentences.zh: 健身房的每堂課都是一小時，由經驗豐富的健身教練帶領。

words.note: 語塊：training session（訓練課程）、question-and-answer session（問答時間）、morning session（上午場）。session 是「一段時間的活動」；section 是「部分；區域」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: Free tickets for the concert will be given out on a first-come, first-served basis at the city hall.
sentences.zh: 演唱會的免費門票會在市政府以先到先得的方式發放。

sentences.en: Parking spaces near the entrance are first-come, first-served, so please arrive early if you want one.
sentences.zh: 入口附近的停車位是先到先得，所以如果想要請早點到。

sentences.en: Seats at the seminar are available on a first-come, first-served basis, so we recommend registering soon.
sentences.zh: 研討會座位採先到先得，所以我們建議盡早報名。

sentences.en: The free gifts will be handed out on a first-come, first-served basis until all of them are gone.
sentences.zh: 免費禮物會以先到先得的方式發放，直到發完為止。

sentences.en: Rooms at the training center are assigned on a first-come, first-served basis, so please book early.
sentences.zh: 訓練中心的房間以先到先得的方式分配，所以請提早預訂。

words.note: 語塊：on a first-come, first-served basis（以先到先得的方式）。first-come, first-served 是「誰先來誰先拿到」，常和 basis 一起用。

sentences.en: Mr. Garcia is the sole proprietor of the bakery, so he makes all of the decisions about the business.
sentences.zh: 賈西亞先生是麵包店的獨資經營者，所以生意上的所有決定都由他做。

sentences.en: Many designers work as a sole proprietor because it is easy to start and does not require many employees.
sentences.zh: 很多設計師以獨資方式經營，因為容易起步，也不需要很多員工。

sentences.en: As the sole proprietor of the shop, Ms. Kim is responsible for paying all of its taxes and debts.
sentences.zh: 身為那家店的獨資經營者，金小姐要負責支付店裡所有的稅金和債務。

sentences.en: The bank asked every sole proprietor who applied for a loan to show tax records from the past three years.
sentences.zh: 銀行要求每位申請貸款的獨資經營者出示過去三年的稅務紀錄。

sentences.en: After working as a sole proprietor for ten years, Mr. Lee decided to form a company with two partners.
sentences.zh: 以獨資方式經營十年後，李先生決定和兩位合夥人成立公司。

words.note: 語塊：sole proprietor of（……的獨資經營者）、work as a sole proprietor（以獨資方式經營）。sole 是「唯一的」；proprietor 是「業主、老闆」；sole proprietorship 是「獨資企業」。

words.meaning: 一塵不染的；非常乾淨的

sentences.en: The hotel staff work hard to keep spotless every room, bathroom, and hallway in the building.
sentences.zh: 飯店員工很努力讓大樓裡的每間房間、浴室和走廊都保持一塵不染。

sentences.en: The kitchen in the restaurant was spotless, so the health inspector gave it the highest score.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的廚房一塵不染，所以衛生稽查員給了最高分。

sentences.en: Mr. Lopez has a spotless record as a driver and has never had an accident in thirty years.
sentences.zh: 羅培茲先生的駕駛紀錄完美，三十年來從沒出過事故。

sentences.en: The new office looked spotless when the employees arrived on Monday morning after the move.
sentences.zh: 搬家後員工週一早上抵達時，新辦公室看起來一塵不染。

sentences.en: Customers often say that our stores are spotless and that the staff are always friendly.
sentences.zh: 顧客常說我們的店非常乾淨，員工也總是很親切。

words.note: 語塊：keep spotless（保持一塵不染）、spotless record（完美紀錄）、spotless kitchen（一塵不染的廚房）、look spotless（看起來一塵不染）。spotless 是「一點污點都沒有」；spot 是「斑點；地點」；immaculate 意思接近。

sentences.en: The hotel replaced the old drapery in every room with new curtains that block out more light.
sentences.zh: 飯店把每間房間的舊窗簾換成能擋更多光的新窗簾。

sentences.en: The drapery store downtown sells beautiful fabric in more than two hundred colors and patterns.
sentences.zh: 市中心的窗簾店販售兩百多種顏色和花樣的布料。

sentences.en: Heavy drapery helps keep the meeting room quiet and warm during the cold winter months.
sentences.zh: 厚重的窗簾在寒冷的冬季幫助會議室保持安靜和溫暖。

sentences.en: The designer chose a light drapery fabric that matches the color of the sofa and the carpet.
sentences.zh: 設計師選了一種和沙發、地毯顏色相配的輕薄窗簾布料。

sentences.en: Please measure the windows in every room carefully before you order drapery from our online store.
sentences.zh: 從我們的網路商店訂購窗簾之前，請仔細量好每個房間的窗戶尺寸。

words.note: 語塊：drapery fabric（窗簾布料）、drapery store（窗簾店）、heavy drapery（厚重的窗簾）。drapery 多指厚重的「窗簾、布簾」；curtain 是一般「窗簾」；drape 是動詞「覆蓋」。

sentences.en: We will make a stopover in Singapore for two days on our way to Australia next month.
sentences.zh: 下個月去澳洲途中，我們會在新加坡中途停留兩天。

sentences.en: The airline offers a free hotel room for passengers who have an overnight stopover in Dubai.
sentences.zh: 航空公司為在杜拜過夜停留的乘客提供免費飯店房間。

sentences.en: The cheapest ticket includes a stopover in Hong Kong, which adds about five hours to the trip.
sentences.zh: 最便宜的機票包含在香港的中途停留，行程會多大約五小時。

sentences.en: Many travelers choose a stopover in Istanbul so that they can visit the city before flying to Europe.
sentences.zh: 很多旅客選擇在伊斯坦堡中途停留，在飛往歐洲之前參觀這座城市。

sentences.en: The tour includes an overnight stopover in Kyoto, where guests can enjoy a traditional dinner.
sentences.zh: 這個行程包含在京都過夜停留，客人可以享用傳統晚餐。

words.note: 語塊：make a stopover（中途停留）、overnight stopover（過夜停留）、stopover in（在……停留）。stopover 是長途旅行中途的短暫停留；layover 意思接近，多指轉機等待時間。

sentences.en: The two companies signed a letter of intent to work together on a new solar plant project.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司簽了意向書，要合作一個新的太陽能電廠專案。

sentences.en: The new rules were written with the intent of making the workplace safer for every employee.
sentences.zh: 新規定是為了讓職場對每位員工都更安全而制定的。

sentences.en: The firm announced its intent to buy a smaller competitor in the European market next year.
sentences.zh: 那家公司宣布有意在明年收購歐洲市場一家較小的競爭對手。

sentences.en: Please send us a letter of intent if you are interested in becoming a supplier for our stores.
sentences.zh: 如果您有興趣成為我們店的供應商，請寄一封意向書給我們。

sentences.en: The CEO said that it was never his intent to close the factory or reduce the number of workers.
sentences.zh: 執行長說他從來沒有要關閉工廠或裁員的意圖。

words.note: 語塊：letter of intent（意向書）、with the intent of（為了……）、intent to（意圖……）。intent 是較正式的「意圖」；intention 意思一樣，較常用；intend 是動詞「打算」。

sentences.en: The CEO will deliver a speech at the annual meeting about the company's plans for the next five years.
sentences.zh: 執行長將在年會上發表演說，談公司未來五年的計畫。

sentences.en: Ms. Ahmed was invited to deliver a speech on women in business at the international conference in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 阿哈邁德小姐受邀在首爾的國際研討會上就女性與商業發表演說。

sentences.en: Before you deliver a speech, it is a good idea to practice in front of a few colleagues.
sentences.zh: 發表演說之前，先在幾位同事面前練習是個好主意。

sentences.en: The mayor will deliver a speech at the opening ceremony of the new library next Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 市長下週六早上會在新圖書館的開幕典禮上發表演說。

sentences.en: Every graduate was nervous when the famous writer began to deliver a speech at the ceremony.
sentences.zh: 那位知名作家開始在典禮上發表演說時，每位畢業生都很緊張。

words.note: 語塊：deliver a speech at（在……發表演說）、deliver a speech on（就……發表演說）。deliver a speech 等於 give a speech / make a speech；deliver 也有「遞送」的意思。

sentences.en: The growth of commerce online has changed the way many people buy clothes, books, and food.
sentences.zh: 網路商業的成長改變了很多人買衣服、書和食物的方式。

sentences.en: The local chamber of commerce holds a monthly meeting where business owners can share ideas.
sentences.zh: 當地商會每個月都會開會，讓企業主分享想法。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin studied international commerce at university and now works for a large trading company.
sentences.zh: 林小姐大學念國際貿易，現在在一家大型貿易公司工作。

sentences.en: The city's chamber of commerce is organizing a job fair for young people next month.
sentences.zh: 市商會下個月要為年輕人舉辦就業博覽會。

sentences.en: Many small shops have started selling online because commerce is moving quickly from stores to the internet.
sentences.zh: 很多小店開始在網路上賣東西，因為商業正快速從實體店轉移到網路。

words.note: 語塊：e-commerce（電子商務）、chamber of commerce（商會）、international commerce（國際貿易）。commerce 是不可數名詞；commercial 是形容詞「商業的」或名詞「廣告」。

sentences.en: Customers can select from more than fifty colors when they order a new sofa from our website.
sentences.zh: 顧客在我們網站訂新沙發時，可以從五十多種顏色中挑選。

sentences.en: The chef will carefully select fresh vegetables from local farms every morning for the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 主廚每天早上會為餐廳從當地農場精心挑選新鮮蔬菜。

sentences.en: The committee will select three designs from the hundreds of entries it received for the competition.
sentences.zh: 委員會會從收到的數百件參賽作品中挑出三件設計。

sentences.en: Please select the size and color of the shirt before you click the button to place your order.
sentences.zh: 按下單按鈕之前，請先選擇襯衫的尺寸和顏色。

sentences.en: Only a few employees will be able to select from the new projects, so please submit your request early.
sentences.zh: 只有少數員工能挑選新專案，所以請盡早提出申請。

words.note: 語塊：select from（從……中挑選）、carefully select（精心挑選）、be selected for（被選為……）。select 比 choose 正式；selection 是名詞「選擇；精選」；selective 是「有選擇性的」。

sentences.en: The initial outlay for the new machines was high, but they will save the company money in the long term.
sentences.zh: 新機器的初期投入很高，但長期來說會幫公司省錢。

sentences.en: The board approved a capital outlay of two million dollars to build a new warehouse near the port.
sentences.zh: 董事會核准兩百萬元的資本支出，在港口附近蓋新倉庫。

sentences.en: The company's outlay on advertising increased by twenty percent this year because of the new product launch.
sentences.zh: 因為新產品上市，公司今年在廣告上的支出增加了兩成。

sentences.en: Opening a small café requires an initial outlay of about fifty thousand dollars for equipment and furniture.
sentences.zh: 開一家小咖啡廳需要約五萬元的初期投入，用來買設備和家具。

sentences.en: Solar panels need a large initial outlay, but they can reduce electricity bills for many years.
sentences.zh: 太陽能板需要很大的初期投入，但可以降低很多年的電費。

words.note: 語塊：initial outlay（初期投入）、capital outlay（資本支出）、outlay on（在……上的支出）。outlay 是「為某事花出去的錢」；expenditure 意思接近；outlet 是「暢貨中心；插座」。

sentences.en: The start-up received financial backing from several investors who strongly believe in its new battery technology.
sentences.zh: 那家新創公司獲得幾位非常看好其新電池技術的投資人提供資金支持。

sentences.en: Without financial backing from the city, the museum would not be able to stay open.
sentences.zh: 沒有市政府的財務支持，博物館就無法繼續營業。

sentences.en: The film was made with financial backing from a large company that wanted to promote tourism.
sentences.zh: 那部電影是在一家想推廣觀光的大公司資金後援下拍成的。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim is looking for financial backing to open a second restaurant in the city center next year.
sentences.zh: 金先生在尋找資金支持，打算明年在市中心開第二家餐廳。

sentences.en: The project will start as soon as we receive financial backing from the government and the bank.
sentences.zh: 一拿到政府和銀行的財務支持，專案就會開始。

words.note: 語塊：receive financial backing（獲得資金支持）、financial backing from（來自……的資金後援）。backing 是「支持」；financial support 意思接近；backer 是「贊助者」。

sentences.en: The new building has ramps and wide doors, so it is easy to use for every person with a disability.
sentences.zh: 新大樓有斜坡和寬門，讓每位身心障礙者都方便使用。

sentences.en: The company is committed to hiring people with a disability and providing the support they need.
sentences.zh: 公司致力於雇用身心障礙者，並提供他們需要的支援。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee has a physical disability, but she travels around the world for her job every month.
sentences.zh: 李小姐有肢體障礙，但她每個月都為工作環遊世界。

sentences.en: Workers who cannot do their job because of a disability may receive monthly support from the government.
sentences.zh: 因身心障礙而無法工作的人，可能每個月獲得政府的補助。

sentences.en: The theater offers special seats and free tickets for one companion of each guest with a disability.
sentences.zh: 劇院為每位身心障礙觀眾提供特別座位，並給一位陪同者免費門票。

words.note: 語塊：people with a disability（身心障礙者）、person with a disability（身心障礙人士）、physical disability（肢體障礙）、because of a disability（因身心障礙）。disability 是名詞；disabled 是形容詞；accessible 是「無障礙的」。

sentences.en: Please meet me at the main entrance of the building at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 請明天早上九點在大樓正門和我見面。

sentences.en: The entrance fee for the museum is ten dollars, but children under six can enter for free.
sentences.zh: 博物館的入場費是十元，但六歲以下兒童可以免費入場。

sentences.en: Students must pass an entrance exam in math and English before they can join the program.
sentences.zh: 學生必須通過數學和英文的入學考試，才能加入這個學程。

sentences.en: The main entrance will be closed for repairs next week, so please use the side door near the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 正門下週會因維修關閉，所以請使用停車場附近的側門。

sentences.en: The entrance fee includes a guided tour and a free drink at the café on the top floor.
sentences.zh: 入場費包含導覽和頂樓咖啡廳的一杯免費飲料。

words.note: 語塊：main entrance（正門）、entrance fee（入場費）、entrance exam（入學考試）。entrance 是「入口」或「進入」；entry 意思接近；exit 是「出口」。

sentences.en: The new software will enable employees to work from home as easily as they do in the office.
sentences.zh: 新軟體讓員工在家工作和在辦公室一樣方便。

sentences.en: The loan from the bank will enable the company to buy new machinery and hire more workers.
sentences.zh: 銀行的貸款讓公司能夠購買新機械並雇用更多員工。

sentences.en: Please enable access to your location so that the app can show you the nearest store.
sentences.zh: 請開放位置存取權限，讓 App 顯示離你最近的店。

sentences.en: The scholarship will enable students from poor families to study at the best universities in the country.
sentences.zh: 獎學金讓貧困家庭的學生能就讀全國最好的大學。

sentences.en: The new subway line will enable residents in the suburbs to reach downtown in under thirty minutes.
sentences.zh: 新地鐵線讓郊區居民能在三十分鐘內到達市中心。

words.note: 語塊：enable sb to do（使某人能夠……）、enable access（開放存取）。enable sb to do 一定接 to + 原形動詞；able 是形容詞「能夠的」；disable 是「使無法運作」。

sentences.en: Please send us a price quote for five hundred chairs, including the cost of delivery to our office.
sentences.zh: 請寄給我們五百張椅子的報價，包括送到我們辦公室的運費。

sentences.en: Before you choose a contractor, you should get a quote from at least three different companies.
sentences.zh: 選擇承包商之前，你應該至少向三家不同的公司取得報價。

sentences.en: The technician will look at the air conditioner and give a quote for the repair this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 技術人員今天下午會檢查冷氣，然後提供維修報價。
