sentences.en: The price quote is valid for thirty days, after which the cost of the materials may change.
sentences.zh: 報價有效期是三十天，之後材料成本可能會改變。

sentences.en: Customers can get a quote for car insurance online in less than five minutes on our website.
sentences.zh: 顧客在我們網站上不到五分鐘就能取得車險的報價。

words.note: 語塊：price quote（報價）、get a quote（取得報價）、give a quote（提供報價）。quote 可以當名詞「報價」或動詞「報價；引用」；quotation 是比較正式的「報價單；引文」。

sentences.en: The company will cover the cost of the training course for any employee who wants to learn English.
sentences.zh: 公司會為任何想學英文的員工支付訓練課程的費用。

sentences.en: Could you cover a shift for me on Saturday morning, because I need to attend my sister's wedding?
sentences.zh: 你週六早上可以幫我代班嗎？因為我要參加姐姐的婚禮。

sentences.en: The workshop will cover a topic that many small business owners find difficult: managing cash flow.
sentences.zh: 工作坊會涵蓋很多小企業主覺得困難的主題：現金流管理。

sentences.en: Our insurance plan will cover the cost of repairs if your phone is damaged within the first year.
sentences.zh: 如果你的手機在第一年內損壞，我們的保險方案會支付維修費用。

sentences.en: The reporter was sent to cover the opening of the new airport for the evening news program.
sentences.zh: 那位記者被派去報導新機場開幕，供晚間新聞播出。

words.note: 語塊：cover the cost（支付費用）、cover a shift（代班）、cover a topic（涵蓋主題）。cover 有很多意思：「蓋住」、「支付」、「涵蓋」、「代班」、「報導」；coverage 是名詞「涵蓋範圍；報導」。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim opened a savings account at the bank so that she could save money for a trip to Europe.
sentences.zh: 金小姐在銀行開了一個儲蓄帳戶，為歐洲之旅存錢。

sentences.en: The new machines will bring cost savings of about fifty thousand dollars a year for the factory.
sentences.zh: 新機器每年會為工廠節省約五萬元的成本。

sentences.en: Mr. Hall used his life savings to open a small hotel near the beach after he retired.
sentences.zh: 霍爾先生退休後用畢生積蓄在海邊開了一家小旅館。

sentences.en: Customers who open a savings account this month will receive a higher interest rate for one year.
sentences.zh: 這個月開儲蓄帳戶的顧客一年內可以享有較高的利率。

sentences.en: Switching to online meetings has created large cost savings because fewer employees need to travel.
sentences.zh: 改成線上會議帶來很大的成本節省，因為需要出差的員工變少了。

words.note: 語塊：savings account（儲蓄帳戶）、cost savings（成本節省）、life savings（畢生積蓄）。savings 常用複數；save 是動詞「節省；存錢」；saving 單數也可指「節省的部分」。

sentences.en: The store sells a matching set of plates, bowls, and cups that is perfect as a wedding gift.
sentences.zh: 那家店賣一套成套的盤子、碗和杯子，非常適合當結婚禮物。

sentences.en: The company will provide matching funds, so every dollar that employees donate will be doubled.
sentences.zh: 公司會提供配合款，所以員工每捐一元都會變成兩元。

sentences.en: The designer chose matching colors for the curtains and the sofa to make the room look larger.
sentences.zh: 設計師為窗簾和沙發選了相配的顏色，讓房間看起來更大。

sentences.en: Each member of the team received a matching jacket with the company's name printed on the back.
sentences.zh: 每位組員都拿到一件背後印有公司名稱的相同夾克。

sentences.en: For every donation to the hospital this month, a local bank will give matching funds up to one million dollars.
sentences.zh: 這個月每一筆捐給醫院的款項，一家當地銀行都會提供配合款，最高一百萬元。

words.note: 語塊：matching set（成套）、matching funds（配合款）、matching colors（相配的顏色）。matching 是「搭配、互相配合的」；match 是動詞「相配」或名詞「比賽；火柴」。

sentences.en: The tour will round out the day with a traditional dinner at a famous restaurant near the river.
sentences.zh: 行程會以河邊一家知名餐廳的傳統晚餐為一天畫下句點。

sentences.en: The company hired two new engineers to round out the team before the project begins next month.
sentences.zh: 公司雇用了兩位新工程師，在下個月專案開始前補齊團隊。

sentences.en: The chef added three vegetarian dishes to round out the menu for guests who do not eat meat.
sentences.zh: 主廚加了三道素食菜色，讓菜單對不吃肉的客人更完整。

sentences.en: A short question-and-answer session with all of the speakers will round out the conference on Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 週五下午和所有講者進行的簡短問答時間，會為研討會畫下句點。

sentences.en: Free coffee and dessert will round out the meal for every guest at the anniversary dinner.
sentences.zh: 免費的咖啡和甜點會為週年晚宴每位客人的餐點畫下完美句點。

words.note: 語塊：round out the day（為一天畫下句點）、round out the team（補齊團隊）、round out the menu（使菜單更完整）。round out 是「補上最後一部分，讓整體完整」；complete 意思接近。

sentences.en: The hotel restaurant serves dinner on fine china, which makes the meal feel very special.
sentences.zh: 飯店餐廳用精緻瓷器上晚餐，讓這頓飯感覺很特別。

sentences.en: My grandmother gave me a china set with blue flowers that she received at her own wedding.
sentences.zh: 祖母給了我一組藍花瓷器，那是她自己結婚時收到的。

sentences.en: Please wrap the china carefully in thick paper before you put it into the moving boxes.
sentences.zh: 把瓷器放進搬家箱之前，請用厚紙仔細包好。

sentences.en: The china cabinet in the dining room displays plates and cups that are more than a hundred years old.
sentences.zh: 餐廳的瓷器櫃展示著超過一百年的盤子和杯子。

sentences.en: The department store is having a sale on fine china, with prices up to forty percent off this weekend.
sentences.zh: 百貨公司這週末精緻瓷器特賣，最多打六折。

words.note: 語塊：fine china（精緻瓷器）、china set（瓷器組）、china cabinet（瓷器櫃）。china（小寫）是「瓷器」；China（大寫）是「中國」；porcelain 意思接近。

sentences.en: The market sells handmade bags, jewelry, and pottery made by local craftspeople from nearby villages.
sentences.zh: 市集販售附近村莊當地工匠手工製作的包包、首飾和陶器。

sentences.en: Skilled craftspeople spent two years repairing the old wooden doors and windows of the temple.
sentences.zh: 技術純熟的工匠花了兩年修復寺廟的舊木門和窗戶。

sentences.en: The festival gives local craftspeople a chance to show their work to thousands of tourists.
sentences.zh: 這個節慶讓當地工匠有機會向數千名遊客展示作品。

sentences.en: Our furniture is made by skilled craftspeople who use traditional methods and high-quality wood from local forests.
sentences.zh: 我們的家具是由技術純熟、使用傳統方法和當地森林高品質木材的工匠製作的。

sentences.en: The city offers grants to help young craftspeople open small shops and studios in the old town.
sentences.zh: 市政府提供補助，幫助年輕工匠在老城區開小店和工作室。

words.note: 語塊：local craftspeople（當地工匠）、skilled craftspeople（技術純熟的工匠）。craftspeople 是 craftsperson 的複數；craftsman 是「工匠（男性）」；craft 是「手藝」。

sentences.en: The grape vine in the garden produces enough fruit every summer for the restaurant to make its own jam.
sentences.zh: 花園裡的葡萄藤每年夏天結的果實夠餐廳自己做果醬。

sentences.en: A climbing vine covers the front of the old hotel, which makes it look beautiful in every season.
sentences.zh: 攀爬的藤蔓覆蓋著老飯店的正面，讓它每個季節都很漂亮。

sentences.en: Visitors to the farm can learn how to take care of a grape vine and pick fruit in the autumn.
sentences.zh: 參觀農場的遊客可以學習如何照顧葡萄藤，秋天還能採果。

sentences.en: The gardener cut the vine away from the windows so that more light could enter the office.
sentences.zh: 園丁把藤蔓從窗戶上剪開，讓更多光線進入辦公室。

sentences.en: Each vine on the farm is checked by hand every week to make sure the grapes are healthy.
sentences.zh: 農場的每株葡萄藤每週都會用手檢查，確保葡萄健康。

words.note: 語塊：grape vine（葡萄藤）、climbing vine（攀爬的藤蔓）。vine 是會攀爬的植物；vineyard 是「葡萄園」；wine 是「葡萄酒」，發音很像。

sentences.en: The hotel room has a magnificent view of the mountains and the lake, so guests often stay longer.
sentences.zh: 飯店房間有山和湖的壯麗景色，所以客人常常多住幾天。

sentences.en: The new concert hall is a magnificent building that has already become a symbol of the city.
sentences.zh: 新音樂廳是一棟宏偉的建築，已經成為這座城市的象徵。

sentences.en: The chef prepared a magnificent dinner for the guests at the company's fiftieth anniversary party.
sentences.zh: 主廚為公司五十週年派對的賓客準備了一頓極好的晚餐。

sentences.en: From the top of the tower, visitors can enjoy a magnificent view of the whole city at night.
sentences.zh: 從塔頂，遊客可以欣賞整座城市壯麗的夜景。

sentences.en: The old library is a magnificent building, and many tourists visit it just to take photos.
sentences.zh: 舊圖書館是一棟宏偉的建築，很多觀光客專程去拍照。

words.note: 語塊：magnificent view（壯麗的景色）、magnificent building（宏偉的建築）。magnificent 是「非常美麗、令人驚嘆的」；splendid 意思接近；significant 是「重大的」。

sentences.en: Our company will collaborate with a famous designer to create a new line of bags for next spring.
sentences.zh: 我們公司會和一位知名設計師合作，推出明年春天的新包款系列。

sentences.en: The two universities will collaborate on a research project about clean energy and climate change.
sentences.zh: 兩所大學將在一個關於乾淨能源和氣候變遷的研究專案上合作。

sentences.en: The marketing and sales teams must collaborate closely with each other to make sure the new product launch is successful.
sentences.zh: 行銷和業務團隊必須密切合作，確保新產品上市成功。

sentences.en: Local craftspeople will collaborate with the hotel to decorate every room with handmade art and furniture.
sentences.zh: 當地工匠將和飯店合作，用手工藝品和家具裝飾每間房間。

sentences.en: Engineers from both companies will collaborate on the design of the new electric vehicle for the Asian market.
sentences.zh: 兩家公司的工程師將在亞洲市場新電動車的設計上合作。

words.note: 語塊：collaborate with（與……合作）、collaborate on（在……上合作）、closely collaborate（密切合作）。collaborate 是「一起做某事」；collaboration 是名詞；cooperate 意思接近。

sentences.en: The city built a new bike path along the river so that people can ride safely to work.
sentences.zh: 市政府沿著河邊蓋了一條新的自行車道，讓民眾可以安全地騎車上班。

sentences.en: The training program helps employees plan their career path and develop the skills they need.
sentences.zh: 訓練計畫幫助員工規劃職涯發展路徑，培養所需的技能。

sentences.en: A walking path around the lake is popular with office workers who want to exercise during lunch.
sentences.zh: 環湖步道很受想在午休運動的上班族歡迎。

sentences.en: Please stay on the path when you walk through the park, because the grass was just planted.
sentences.zh: 走過公園時請走在步道上，因為草地剛種好。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee chose a career path in finance because she has always been good with numbers.
sentences.zh: 李小姐選擇了金融業的職涯路徑，因為她一直很擅長數字。

words.note: 語塊：bike path（自行車道）、career path（職涯發展路徑）、walking path（步道）。path 是「小路」，也可以比喻「發展途徑」；pass 是「通過」；bath 是「洗澡」。

sentences.en: There are no lifeguards on duty at the lake, so you will swim at your own risk during the summer.
sentences.zh: 湖邊沒有救生員值班，所以夏天在這裡游泳要風險自負。

sentences.en: The sign at the entrance says that you enter at your own risk if you leave the hiking path.
sentences.zh: 入口的告示寫著，離開登山步道的話進入風險自負。

sentences.en: If you park your car on the street overnight, you will be doing so at your own risk.
sentences.zh: 如果你把車停在路邊過夜，就要自己承擔風險。

sentences.en: The free software is provided as it is, so please download and use at your own risk.
sentences.zh: 這個免費軟體按現況提供，所以請自行承擔下載和使用的風險。

sentences.en: If you leave valuables in your room instead of the safe, you keep them there at your own risk.
sentences.zh: 如果你把貴重物品留在房間而不放保險箱，就要自己承擔風險。

words.note: 語塊：use at your own risk（使用風險自負）、enter at your own risk（進入風險自負）、swim at your own risk（游泳風險自負）。at your own risk 常見於告示：「風險自負」；at risk 是「處於危險中」。

sentences.en: On top of a higher salary, the new job offers four weeks of paid vacation every year.
sentences.zh: 除了更高的薪水，新工作每年還有四週的帶薪假。

sentences.en: The manager uses a shared calendar to stay on top of all of the team's deadlines and meetings.
sentences.zh: 經理用共用行事曆來掌握團隊所有的截止日期和會議。

sentences.en: The hotel is close to the beach, and on top of that, breakfast is included in the room price.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店離海灘很近，除此之外，房價還含早餐。

sentences.en: It is hard to stay on top of the latest technology because new products come out every month.
sentences.zh: 要跟上最新科技很難，因為每個月都有新產品推出。

sentences.en: On top of the delivery fee, customers who live on islands must pay an extra charge for shipping.
sentences.zh: 除了運費之外，住在離島的顧客還必須支付額外的運送費用。

words.note: 語塊：on top of that（除此之外）、stay on top of（掌握；跟上）。on top of 可以是「在……上面」或「除了……還有」；stay on top of 是「掌握狀況」。

sentences.en: The company decided to renew its contract with the cleaning service for another two years.
sentences.zh: 公司決定和清潔公司再續約兩年。

sentences.en: Please remember to renew your subscription before the end of the month so that you do not miss any issues.
sentences.zh: 請記得在月底前續訂，以免錯過任何一期。

sentences.en: You should renew your passport at least six months before it expires if you plan to travel abroad.
sentences.zh: 如果你打算出國，應該在護照到期前至少六個月更新。

sentences.en: The library sends an e-mail to remind members to renew their books before they are due.
sentences.zh: 圖書館會寄電子郵件提醒會員在書到期前續借。

sentences.en: If the landlord does not renew our lease, we will have to find a new office by next spring.
sentences.zh: 如果房東不跟我們續約，我們必須在明年春天前找新辦公室。

words.note: 語塊：renew a contract（續約）、renew a subscription（續訂）、renew a passport（更新護照）。renew 是「延長有效期」；renewal 是名詞；renewable 是「可再生的；可續約的」。

sentences.en: The company started a wellness program that offers free yoga classes and health checks for all staff.
sentences.zh: 公司推出一項健康促進計畫，為所有員工提供免費瑜伽課和健康檢查。

sentences.en: The hotel's new wellness center includes a spa, a swimming pool, and a quiet room for meditation.
sentences.zh: 飯店新的養生中心有水療、游泳池和一間冥想用的安靜房間。

sentences.en: Many managers now believe that employee wellness is important for keeping workers happy and productive.
sentences.zh: 很多主管現在相信，員工健康對讓員工開心又有效率很重要。

sentences.en: Employees who join the wellness program can receive a discount at the gym near the office.
sentences.zh: 參加健康促進計畫的員工可以在公司附近的健身房享有折扣。

sentences.en: The resort is famous for its wellness center, which offers massages and healthy meals made from local food.
sentences.zh: 那家度假村以養生中心聞名，提供按摩和用在地食材做的健康餐點。

words.note: 語塊：wellness program（健康促進計畫）、wellness center（養生中心）、employee wellness（員工健康）。wellness 是「整體身心健康」；health 是「健康」；fitness 是「體能」。

sentences.en: The period of validity for the gift card is one year from the date of purchase.
sentences.zh: 禮物卡的有效期限是購買日起一年。

sentences.en: Security staff will check the validity of each visitor's ID card before they enter the building.
sentences.zh: 保全人員會在訪客進入大樓前檢查每張身分證件的有效性。

sentences.en: Please check the validity of your visa carefully before you book your flight to the United States.
sentences.zh: 訂飛美國的機票之前，請仔細檢查你簽證的效期。

sentences.en: The contract has a period of validity of three years, after which both companies may decide to renew it.
sentences.zh: 合約的有效期限是三年，之後兩家公司可以決定是否續約。

sentences.en: The lawyer questioned the validity of the agreement because it was signed without the manager's approval.
sentences.zh: 律師質疑那份協議的有效性，因為它是在沒有經理批准的情況下簽的。

words.note: 語塊：period of validity（有效期限）、check the validity（檢查有效性）。validity 是 valid（有效的）的名詞；expiration 是「到期」。

sentences.en: Many young people are uninterested in buying cars, because they prefer to use public transit.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕人對買車沒興趣，因為他們比較喜歡搭大眾運輸。

sentences.en: The audience seemed uninterested during the long presentation, so the speaker decided to finish early.
sentences.zh: 冗長的簡報期間觀眾看起來沒興趣，所以講者決定提早結束。

sentences.en: The investor was uninterested in the project because it would take ten years to make a profit.
sentences.zh: 那位投資人對這個專案沒興趣，因為要十年才能獲利。

sentences.en: Customers who seem uninterested at first may change their minds after they try the product.
sentences.zh: 一開始看起來沒興趣的顧客，在試用產品後可能會改變主意。

sentences.en: The manager noticed that the staff were uninterested in the old training videos, so she made new ones.
sentences.zh: 經理注意到員工對舊的訓練影片不感興趣，所以她做了新的。

words.note: 語塊：uninterested in（對……不感興趣）、seem uninterested（看起來沒興趣）。uninterested 是「沒興趣的」；disinterested 是「公正無私的」，常被混用但意思不同。

sentences.en: The store will receive a shipment of new winter coats on Monday, so please prepare space in the stockroom.
sentences.zh: 店裡週一會收到一批新的冬季大衣，所以請在倉庫準備空間。

sentences.en: A shipment of computer parts arrived late because of the storm, so the factory stopped production for a day.
sentences.zh: 一批電腦零件因暴風雨晚到，所以工廠停工了一天。

sentences.en: The supplier had to delay the shipment because some of the products did not pass the quality check.
sentences.zh: 因為有些產品沒有通過品質檢查，供應商不得不延遲出貨。

sentences.en: Please check every box in the shipment carefully and report any damage to the delivery company.
sentences.zh: 請仔細檢查這批貨的每一個箱子，並把任何損壞通報貨運公司。

sentences.en: We will send you an e-mail with a tracking number as soon as your shipment leaves our warehouse.
sentences.zh: 您的貨物一離開我們的倉庫，我們就會寄給您附有追蹤號碼的電子郵件。

words.note: 語塊：receive a shipment（收到貨）、shipment of（一批……）、delay a shipment（延遲出貨）。shipment 是「一批運送的貨物」；ship 是動詞「運送」；shipping 是「運送；運費」。

sentences.en: The company has a zero tolerance policy for employees who are rude to customers or other staff.
sentences.zh: 公司對無禮對待顧客或其他員工的人採取零容忍政策。

sentences.en: Some customers have a low tolerance for long waiting times, so we try to answer calls within one minute.
sentences.zh: 有些顧客對長時間等待的容忍度很低，所以我們盡量在一分鐘內接電話。

sentences.en: These plants have a high tolerance of dry weather, so they are perfect for gardens in hot cities.
sentences.zh: 這些植物對乾燥天氣的耐受力很高，所以非常適合炎熱城市的花園。

sentences.en: The school has zero tolerance for bullying and will contact parents immediately if it happens.
sentences.zh: 學校對霸凌零容忍，一旦發生會立刻聯絡家長。

sentences.en: Workers with a low tolerance for noise should wear ear protection when they enter the factory floor.
sentences.zh: 對噪音耐受度低的工人進入工廠作業區時應該戴耳罩。

words.note: 語塊：zero tolerance（零容忍）、tolerance for（對……的容忍度）、tolerance of（對……的耐受力）。tolerance 是 tolerate（容忍）的名詞；tolerant 是形容詞「寬容的」。

sentences.en: The new machines will increase the production rate of the factory by about thirty percent.
sentences.zh: 新機器會讓工廠的生產速度提高約三成。

sentences.en: The production rate of the new phone has doubled since the second factory opened in Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 自從越南第二座工廠開工後，新手機的產量已經加倍。

sentences.en: To increase the production rate, the company added a night shift and hired fifty more workers.
sentences.zh: 為了提高生產速度，公司增加了夜班並多雇用五十名工人。

sentences.en: The manager checks the production rate every morning to make sure the factory will meet its target.
sentences.zh: 經理每天早上檢查生產速度，確保工廠能達成目標。

sentences.en: A higher production rate is important, but the quality of the products must not become worse.
sentences.zh: 提高產量很重要，但產品品質不能變差。

words.note: 語塊：increase the production rate（提高生產速度）、production rate of（……的產量）。production rate 是單位時間內的產量；output 是「產出量」；productivity 是「生產力」。

sentences.en: Mr. Wong took his suit to a skilled tailor to make the jacket fit better before the wedding.
sentences.zh: 王先生在婚禮前把西裝拿去給技術好的裁縫師修改，讓外套更合身。

sentences.en: The tailor shop near the station can finish a new shirt in only two days for a small extra fee.
sentences.zh: 車站附近的裁縫店只要加一點錢，兩天就能做好一件新襯衫。

sentences.en: A good tailor will measure you carefully and ask how you want the clothes to fit before starting.
sentences.zh: 好的裁縫師開始之前會仔細幫你量尺寸，並問你想要衣服怎麼合身。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a tailor service for guests who need their clothes repaired during their business trip.
sentences.zh: 飯店為出差期間需要修補衣服的客人提供裁縫服務。

sentences.en: The old tailor shop has been run by the same family for more than eighty years in the old town.
sentences.zh: 那家老城區的老裁縫店由同一個家族經營了八十多年。

words.note: 語塊：skilled tailor（技術好的裁縫師）、tailor shop（裁縫店）。tailor 也可以當動詞「量身訂做；調整」（tailor sth to sb's needs）；tailor-made 是「量身訂做的」。

sentences.en: Aside from the cost, the main problem with the plan is that it will take too long to complete.
sentences.zh: 除了費用之外，這個計畫的主要問題是要花太久才能完成。

sentences.en: The hotel was clean and comfortable, and aside from that, the staff were very friendly and helpful.
sentences.zh: 飯店乾淨又舒適，除此之外，員工也非常親切又樂於幫忙。

sentences.en: Aside from a few small problems with the software, the product launch went very smoothly.
sentences.zh: 除了軟體有幾個小問題之外，產品發表進行得非常順利。

sentences.en: Aside from the cost of the tickets, visitors should also budget for food and transportation in the city.
sentences.zh: 除了門票費用之外，遊客也應該為市內的餐飲和交通編列預算。

sentences.en: Everyone aside from Mr. Lee attended the meeting, because he was on a business trip in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 除了李先生之外，大家都參加了會議，因為他在新加坡出差。

words.note: 語塊：aside from that（除此之外）、aside from the cost（除了費用之外）。aside from 可以是「除了……以外（都）」或「除了……還有」；apart from 意思一樣。

sentences.en: The entire staff will attend the training session on the new safety rules next Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 全體員工下週五下午都會參加新安全規定的訓練課程。

sentences.en: The entire process of applying for a loan can now be completed online in less than one hour.
sentences.zh: 申請貸款的整個流程現在不到一小時就能在線上完成。

sentences.en: The power went out, so the factory had to stop production for the entire day on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 停電了，所以工廠週二一整天都必須停工。

sentences.en: The CEO thanked the entire staff for their hard work during the company's most successful year.
sentences.zh: 執行長感謝全體員工在公司最成功的一年裡辛勤工作。

sentences.en: The consultant will review the entire process of hiring new employees and suggest ways to make it faster.
sentences.zh: 顧問會檢視整個招募新員工的流程，並建議加快的方法。

words.note: 語塊：entire staff（全體員工）、entire process（整個流程）、the entire day（一整天）。entire 是「全部、完整的」；whole 意思接近；entirely 是副詞「完全地」。

sentences.en: All rooms in the hotel have free wireless internet, which guests can use with the password at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 飯店所有房間都有免費無線網路，客人可以用櫃台提供的密碼使用。

sentences.en: The store is having a sale on wireless headphones, with prices up to thirty percent off this week.
sentences.zh: 那家店本週無線耳機特價，最多打七折。

sentences.en: The new phone supports wireless charging, so you do not need a cable to charge the battery.
sentences.zh: 新手機支援無線充電，所以不需要充電線就能充電。

sentences.en: The café offers wireless internet to customers, but the connection can be slow during busy times.
sentences.zh: 咖啡廳提供顧客無線網路，但忙碌時段網速可能會變慢。

sentences.en: Many offices now use wireless charging pads on the meeting tables so that people can charge their phones easily.
sentences.zh: 很多辦公室現在在會議桌上使用無線充電板，讓大家方便幫手機充電。

words.note: 語塊：wireless internet（無線網路）、wireless headphones（無線耳機）、wireless charging（無線充電）。wireless 是「不用電線的」；wire 是「電線」；Wi-Fi 是無線網路的通稱。

sentences.en: After the company reorganization, the sales and marketing departments will be combined into one team.
sentences.zh: 公司重組後，業務部和行銷部會合併成一個團隊。

sentences.en: The bank will undergo a reorganization next year to reduce costs and improve customer service.
sentences.zh: 那家銀行明年將進行改組，以降低成本並改善客戶服務。

sentences.en: Several managers left the firm during the reorganization because they did not agree with the new plan.
sentences.zh: 改組期間好幾位經理離開了公司，因為他們不同意新的計畫。

sentences.en: The CEO explained the reasons for the company reorganization at a meeting with all employees.
sentences.zh: 執行長在全體員工會議上說明公司重組的原因。

sentences.en: The reorganization of the warehouse made it much faster for workers to find and pack orders.
sentences.zh: 倉庫重新規劃後，工人找貨和包裝訂單快了很多。

words.note: 語塊：company reorganization（公司重組）、undergo a reorganization（進行改組）。reorganization 是 reorganize（重新組織）的名詞；restructuring 意思接近。

sentences.en: Several residents raised a concern about the noise from the new factory at the town meeting.
sentences.zh: 好幾位居民在鎮民大會上提出對新工廠噪音的疑慮。

sentences.en: The doctor expressed concern about the patient's high blood pressure and asked him to come back next week.
sentences.zh: 醫生對病人的高血壓表示關切，請他下週回診。

sentences.en: Our main concern is the safety of our customers, so every product is tested many times before it is sold.
sentences.zh: 我們最主要的考量是顧客的安全，所以每項產品販售前都經過多次測試。

sentences.en: If you have any concern about your order, please contact our customer care team at any time.
sentences.zh: 如果您對訂單有任何疑慮，請隨時聯絡我們的客服團隊。

sentences.en: The main concern for many small businesses this year is the rising cost of rent in the city center.
sentences.zh: 今年很多小公司最主要的擔憂是市中心房租上漲。

words.note: 語塊：raise concerns（提出疑慮）、express concern（表達關切）、main concern（主要擔憂）。concern 可以當名詞「擔憂」或動詞「關係到；使擔心」；concerned 是「擔心的；相關的」。

sentences.en: Many people are choosing electric cars as an alternative to cars that use gas, especially in large cities.
sentences.zh: 很多人選擇電動車作為汽油車的替代品，特別是在大城市。

sentences.en: Because the bridge was closed, drivers had no alternative but to take the longer road around the lake.
sentences.zh: 因為橋封閉了，駕駛別無選擇，只能繞湖走比較遠的路。

sentences.en: Online meetings have become a viable alternative to business trips for many international companies with offices in different countries.
sentences.zh: 對很多在不同國家設有辦公室的跨國公司來說，線上會議已經成為出差的可行替代方案。

sentences.en: If the hotel is fully booked, our travel agent will suggest an alternative near the conference center.
sentences.zh: 如果飯店客滿，我們的旅行社會建議會議中心附近的替代方案。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers a vegetarian alternative to every meat dish on the menu for guests who do not eat meat.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳菜單上的每道肉類料理都有素食的替代選擇，給不吃肉的客人。

words.note: 語塊：alternative to（……的替代品）、have no alternative（別無選擇）、viable alternative（可行的替代方案）。alternative 可以當名詞或形容詞「替代的」；alternate 是「交替的；輪流的」。

sentences.en: Mr. Davis will undergo surgery on his knee next week, so he will work from home for a month.
sentences.zh: 戴維斯先生下週要接受膝蓋手術，所以會在家工作一個月。

sentences.en: The hospital is famous for heart surgery, and doctors from other countries come here to learn.
sentences.zh: 那家醫院以心臟手術聞名，其他國家的醫生會來這裡學習。

sentences.en: Patients usually need about two weeks to recover from surgery before they can return to work.
sentences.zh: 病人通常需要約兩週的術後恢復時間才能回去上班。

sentences.en: Ms. Park took three weeks off from work after her surgery, and her team covered her tasks.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐手術後請了三週假，由她的團隊分擔她的工作。

sentences.en: The new machine helps doctors perform surgery more quickly and with less pain for patients.
sentences.zh: 新機器幫助醫生更快地進行手術，病人也比較不痛。

words.note: 語塊：undergo surgery（接受手術）、heart surgery（心臟手術）、recover from surgery（術後恢復）。surgery 是「手術」；surgeon 是「外科醫生」；surgical 是形容詞「外科的」。

sentences.en: All visitors to the hospital must wear a surgical mask and wash their hands at the entrance.
sentences.zh: 所有醫院訪客都必須戴外科口罩，並在入口洗手。

sentences.en: The surgical team worked for eight hours to complete the difficult operation on Saturday night.
sentences.zh: 手術團隊週六晚上花了八小時完成那台困難的手術。

sentences.en: The new surgical procedure is less painful, so patients can go home on the same day.
sentences.zh: 新的外科手術比較不痛，所以病人當天就能回家。

sentences.en: The company produces surgical instruments that are used every day in hospitals across Europe and Asia.
sentences.zh: 那家公司生產歐洲和亞洲各地醫院每天使用的外科器械。

sentences.en: Each member of the surgical team must wash their hands carefully and wear clean gloves during the long operation.
sentences.zh: 手術團隊的每位成員在長時間手術期間都必須仔細洗手並戴乾淨的手套。

words.note: 語塊：surgical mask（外科口罩）、surgical team（手術團隊）、surgical procedure（外科手術）。surgical 是 surgery 的形容詞；medical 是「醫療的」。

sentences.en: The board will approve the plan to build a new factory if the cost is lower than five million dollars.
sentences.zh: 如果成本低於五百萬元，董事會就會批准蓋新工廠的計畫。

sentences.en: Many employees do not approve of the new policy because it reduces the number of holidays.
sentences.zh: 很多員工不贊成新規定，因為它減少了假期天數。

sentences.en: Your immediate supervisor must approve all travel expenses before you book the trip to the conference.
sentences.zh: 在預訂研討會行程之前，你的直屬主管必須核准所有差旅費用。

sentences.en: The city council will approve the budget for the new park at its meeting next Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 市議會將在下週二的會議上批准新公園的預算。

sentences.en: The manager will approve your request for time off as soon as she checks the team schedule.
sentences.zh: 經理一確認團隊班表就會批准你的請假申請。

words.note: 語塊：approve a plan（批准計畫）、approve of（贊成）、approve expenses（核准費用）。approve sth 是「核准」；approve of sth 是「贊成」；approval 是名詞。

sentences.en: Pre-registration is required for the cooking workshop on Saturday, because only thirty people can attend it.
sentences.zh: 週六的烹飪工作坊須事先報名，因為只能容納三十人。

sentences.en: The pre-registration fee for the conference is lower than the price you pay at the door.
sentences.zh: 研討會的預先報名費比現場報名便宜。

sentences.en: Online pre-registration for the marathon will open on the first of March and close two weeks later.
sentences.zh: 馬拉松的線上預先報名將在三月一日開放，兩週後截止。

sentences.en: Visitors who complete pre-registration can enter the trade show without waiting in the long line.
sentences.zh: 完成預先報名的訪客可以不用排長隊就進入展覽。

sentences.en: Please complete the online pre-registration form at least three days before the event begins next month.
sentences.zh: 請至少在下個月活動開始前三天完成線上預先報名表。

words.note: 語塊：pre-registration required（須事先報名）、pre-registration fee（預先報名費）、online pre-registration（線上預先報名）。pre- 是「事先」；registration 是「登記；報名」；register 是動詞。

sentences.en: The company will hold its annual party at a beachfront hotel with a large pool and a view of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 公司會在一家有大泳池和海景的海濱飯店舉辦年度派對。

sentences.en: Prices for beachfront property have risen sharply because many people want to own a holiday home.
sentences.zh: 海濱房產的價格大幅上漲，因為很多人想擁有度假屋。

sentences.en: The beachfront restaurant is famous for its fresh seafood, friendly staff, and beautiful sunset views.
sentences.zh: 那家海邊餐廳以新鮮海鮮、親切的員工和美麗的夕陽景色聞名。

sentences.en: All of the rooms in the beachfront hotel have a private balcony facing the sea.
sentences.zh: 那家海濱飯店所有房間都有面海的私人陽台。

sentences.en: Developers plan to build more beachfront property along the coast, but some residents are against it.
sentences.zh: 開發商計畫沿著海岸蓋更多海濱房產，但有些居民反對。

words.note: 語塊：beachfront hotel（海濱飯店）、beachfront property（海濱房產）、beachfront restaurant（海邊餐廳）。beachfront 是「緊鄰海灘的」；waterfront 是「濱水的」；seaside 是「海邊的」。

sentences.en: Free drinks will be served after the concert, courtesy of the local chamber of commerce.
sentences.zh: 演唱會後會提供免費飲料，由當地商會招待。

sentences.en: The photos in this brochure are courtesy of a famous photographer who lives in the town.
sentences.zh: 這本簡介裡的照片是由一位住在鎮上的知名攝影師提供的。

sentences.en: Every guest received a small gift bag at the dinner, courtesy of the hotel and its partners.
sentences.zh: 晚宴上每位客人都收到一個小禮物袋，由飯店和合作夥伴提供。

sentences.en: Transportation from the airport to the conference center will be provided courtesy of the organizers.
sentences.zh: 從機場到會議中心的交通由主辦單位免費提供。

sentences.en: The new computers in the library were provided courtesy of a technology company in the city.
sentences.zh: 圖書館的新電腦是由市內一家科技公司提供的。

words.note: 語塊：courtesy of the hotel（由飯店提供）、photos courtesy of（照片由……提供）、provided courtesy of（由……免費提供）、courtesy of the organizers（由主辦單位提供）。courtesy of 是「感謝某人或某單位免費提供」；courtesy 單獨是「禮貌」；courtesy bus 是「免費接駁車」。

sentences.en: If you have any problems with the new software, please do not hesitate to ask for help from the IT team.
sentences.zh: 如果你對新軟體有任何問題，請不要猶豫，向資訊團隊求助。

sentences.en: The customer decided to ask for a refund because the jacket arrived with a large hole in it.
sentences.zh: 那位顧客決定要求退款，因為外套送到時有一個大洞。

sentences.en: Many young managers ask for advice from senior colleagues when they face difficult decisions at work.
sentences.zh: 很多年輕主管在工作上遇到困難的決定時，會向資深同事徵求建議。

sentences.en: You can ask for a window seat when you check in at the airport, but it depends on availability.
sentences.zh: 你在機場報到時可以要求靠窗座位，但要看有沒有空位。

sentences.en: Please ask for a receipt whenever you pay for a taxi during your business trip.
sentences.zh: 出差期間每次付計程車錢時，請記得要收據。

words.note: 語塊：ask for help（求助）、ask for a refund（要求退款）、ask for advice（徵求建議）。ask for + 東西（ask for help）；ask sb to do 是「請某人做……」。

sentences.en: Members of the gym have unlimited access to all classes, including yoga, swimming, and dance.
sentences.zh: 健身房會員可以無限制參加所有課程，包括瑜伽、游泳和舞蹈。

sentences.en: The new phone plan offers unlimited data for only thirty dollars a month, so it is very popular.
sentences.zh: 新的手機方案每月只要三十元就有吃到飽數據，所以很受歡迎。

sentences.en: The café offers unlimited refills of coffee and tea for customers who buy a breakfast set.
sentences.zh: 咖啡廳為買早餐套餐的顧客提供咖啡和茶無限續杯。

sentences.en: Students will have unlimited access to the online library for as long as they study at the university.
sentences.zh: 學生在大學就讀期間可以無限制使用線上圖書館。

sentences.en: The hotel offers unlimited free coffee in the lobby for all guests from six in the morning until midnight.
sentences.zh: 飯店從早上六點到午夜在大廳為所有客人提供不限量的免費咖啡。

words.note: 語塊：unlimited access（無限制使用）、unlimited data（吃到飽數據）、unlimited refills（無限續杯）。unlimited 是「沒有限制的」；limited 是「有限的」；limitless 意思接近。

sentences.en: Passengers must tap their card at the turnstile before they can enter the subway platform.
sentences.zh: 乘客必須在閘門刷卡才能進入地鐵月台。

sentences.en: The stadium installed a new ticket turnstile at each gate so that fans can enter more quickly before the game.
sentences.zh: 體育場在每個入口都裝了新的驗票閘門，讓球迷在比賽前能更快入場。

sentences.en: Please pass through the turnstile one person at a time and keep your ticket until you leave.
sentences.zh: 請一次一人通過閘門，並保留票卷直到離開。

sentences.en: The turnstile at the main entrance was broken, so staff had to check tickets by hand.
sentences.zh: 正門的閘門故障了，所以工作人員只好人工驗票。

sentences.en: Each turnstile counts the number of visitors, which helps the museum know how busy it is every day.
sentences.zh: 每個閘門都會計算參觀人數，幫助博物館了解每天有多忙。

words.note: 語塊：pass through the turnstile（通過閘門）、ticket turnstile（驗票閘門）。turnstile 是車站、體育場入口一次只讓一人通過的閘門；gate 是一般「大門」。

sentences.en: Passengers who do not have a card can put money in the fare box next to the driver.
sentences.zh: 沒有卡的乘客可以把錢投進司機旁邊的收費箱。

sentences.en: The city replaced the old boxes on its buses with an electronic fare box that accepts cards and phones.
sentences.zh: 市政府把公車上的舊投幣箱換成可以刷卡和手機的電子收費箱。

sentences.en: Please have the exact amount ready, because the fare box on the bus does not give change.
sentences.zh: 請準備好剛好的金額，因為公車上的投幣箱不找零。

sentences.en: The driver checks the fare box at the end of each day and gives the money to the bus company.
sentences.zh: 司機每天收班時檢查投幣箱，把錢交給客運公司。

sentences.en: The new electric buses have a fare box that also shows how much money is left on your card.
sentences.zh: 新的電動公車有收費箱，還會顯示你卡片的餘額。

words.note: 語塊：put money in the fare box（把錢投進收費箱）、electronic fare box（電子收費箱）。fare 是車資；fare box 是公車上投錢的箱子；fair（公平的；博覽會）發音一樣，不要搞混。

words.meaning: 在（船、飛機、車）上；加入團隊

sentences.en: All passengers on board the plane must keep their seat belts fastened until the sign is turned off.
sentences.zh: 飛機上所有乘客都必須繫緊安全帶，直到燈號熄滅。

sentences.en: Welcome on board, Ms. Rivera! We are very happy that you have joined our marketing team.
sentences.zh: 歡迎加入，里維拉小姐！我們很高興你加入我們的行銷團隊。

sentences.en: The manager hopes that every department will get on board with the new plan to reduce paper use.
sentences.zh: 經理希望每個部門都支持新的減紙計畫。

sentences.en: There are more than three thousand passengers on board the cruise ship, which will arrive in Japan tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 郵輪上有三千多名乘客，明天會抵達日本。

sentences.en: Snacks and drinks are available on board the train, but passengers may also bring their own food.
sentences.zh: 火車上有販售點心和飲料，但乘客也可以自備食物。

words.note: 語塊：on board the plane（在飛機上）、welcome on board（歡迎加入）、get on board（贊同；加入）。on board 是「在交通工具上」，也可以比喻「加入、支持」；aboard 意思一樣。

sentences.en: In case of emergency, please leave the building by the stairs and do not use the elevators.
sentences.zh: 萬一發生緊急情況，請走樓梯離開大樓，不要搭電梯。

sentences.en: Please keep the emergency exit clear at all times, because boxes there could block people from leaving.
sentences.zh: 請隨時保持緊急出口暢通，因為放在那裡的箱子可能會擋住人離開。

sentences.en: Mr. Brown was taken to the emergency room after he hurt his arm at the construction site.
sentences.zh: 布朗先生在工地手臂受傷後被送到急診室。

sentences.en: Every employee should know the location of the nearest emergency exit on his or her floor.
sentences.zh: 每位員工都應該知道自己樓層最近的緊急出口在哪裡。

sentences.en: The phone number for the security office is printed on every door in case of emergency.
sentences.zh: 每扇門上都印有保全室的電話號碼，以防萬一發生緊急情況。

words.note: 語塊：in case of emergency（萬一發生緊急情況）、emergency exit（緊急出口）、emergency room（急診室）。emergency 是「緊急狀況」；urgent 是形容詞「緊急的」；emergence 是「出現」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: The meeting room was too small, so we held the meeting in the cafeteria instead.
sentences.zh: 會議室太小了，所以我們改在員工餐廳開會。

sentences.en: Instead of printing every document, please read your e-mails and reports on the computer screen.
sentences.zh: 與其把每份文件都印出來，請在電腦螢幕上閱讀電子郵件和報告。

sentences.en: The train was canceled because of the snow, so many passengers decided to take the bus instead.
sentences.zh: 火車因為下雪停駛，所以很多乘客決定改搭公車。

sentences.en: The company decided to repair the old machines instead of buying new ones, which saved a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 公司決定修理舊機器而不是買新的，省了很多錢。

sentences.en: If the blue shirt is out of stock, you can choose the white one instead at the same price.
sentences.zh: 如果藍色襯衫缺貨，你可以用同樣的價格改選白色的。

words.note: 語塊：instead of（而不是……）、use … instead（改用……）。instead 單獨用放句尾或句首（Let's take the bus instead）；instead of 後面接名詞或 V-ing。

sentences.en: The new library was built at a cost of five million dollars, which was paid by the city and local businesses.
sentences.zh: 新圖書館花了五百萬元建成，由市政府和當地企業出資。

sentences.en: The company will replace all of its delivery trucks at a cost of about two million dollars.
sentences.zh: 公司將花費約兩百萬元更換所有的送貨卡車。

sentences.en: The old bridge will be repaired at a cost of three hundred thousand dollars over the next six months.
sentences.zh: 舊橋將在未來六個月內花費三十萬元修繕。

sentences.en: The hotel added a new swimming pool and spa at a cost of more than one million dollars last year.
sentences.zh: 飯店去年花了一百多萬元增建新的游泳池和水療中心。

sentences.en: The museum bought the famous painting at a cost of ten million dollars, the highest price in its history.
sentences.zh: 博物館以一千萬元買下那幅名畫，是館史上最高的價格。

words.note: 語塊：at a cost of + 金額（花費……）、at the cost of（以……為代價）。at a cost of 後面接金額（at a cost of $2 million）；at the cost of 是「犧牲……」。

sentences.en: The hospital opened a new children's ward with colorful walls, toys, and a small library.
sentences.zh: 醫院開設了一間新的兒童病房，有彩色的牆壁、玩具和小圖書館。

sentences.en: Visitors to the hospital ward must wash their hands and speak quietly so that patients can rest.
sentences.zh: 醫院病房的訪客必須洗手並輕聲說話，讓病人休息。

sentences.en: The maternity ward is on the fifth floor, next to the waiting room for family members.
sentences.zh: 產房在五樓，就在家屬等候室旁邊。

sentences.en: Nurses in the ward check on every patient at least once an hour during the night.
sentences.zh: 病房的護理師夜間至少每小時查看每位病人一次。

sentences.en: The company donated new beds and televisions to the children's ward at the local hospital.
sentences.zh: 那家公司捐贈新病床和電視給當地醫院的兒童病房。

words.note: 語塊：hospital ward（醫院病房）、children's ward（兒童病房）、maternity ward（產房）。ward 在醫院是「病房」；在城市是「行政區」；room 是一般「房間」。

sentences.en: Workers who are injured on the job will receive medical treatment at no cost to them.
sentences.zh: 在工作中受傷的員工可以免費接受醫療。

sentences.en: Mr. Kim had to receive treatment for his back for several weeks after the accident.
sentences.zh: 金先生在事故後必須接受好幾週的背部治療。

sentences.en: All customers should be treated equally, and nobody should receive special treatment because of who they are.
sentences.zh: 所有顧客都應該被平等對待，沒有人應該因為身分而享有特別待遇。

sentences.en: The new hospital offers treatment for patients with heart problems from all over the region.
sentences.zh: 新醫院為整個地區有心臟問題的病人提供治療。

sentences.en: The insurance plan covers the cost of medical treatment for employees and their families, including children under eighteen.
sentences.zh: 保險方案涵蓋員工及其家人（包括十八歲以下的孩子）的醫療費用。

words.note: 語塊：medical treatment（醫療）、receive treatment（接受治療）、special treatment（特別待遇）。treatment 是 treat（治療；對待）的名詞；cure 是「治癒」。

sentences.en: Please enlarge the photo before you print it, because the faces are too small to see clearly.
sentences.zh: 列印前請先把照片放大，因為臉太小看不清楚。

sentences.en: The owners plan to enlarge the store next year by adding a café on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 老闆計畫明年在二樓加開咖啡廳，擴大店面。

sentences.en: The city will enlarge the parking lot near the train station because it is always full in the morning.
sentences.zh: 市政府會擴建火車站附近的停車場，因為早上總是停滿。

sentences.en: You can enlarge the text on the screen by clicking the button in the top right corner.
sentences.zh: 你可以點右上角的按鈕放大螢幕上的文字。

sentences.en: The museum decided to enlarge the gallery so that it can display more of its sculptures.
sentences.zh: 博物館決定擴大展廳，以展出更多雕塑。

words.note: 語塊：enlarge the photo（放大照片）、enlarge the store（擴建店面）、enlarge the parking lot（擴建停車場）、enlarge the gallery（擴大展廳）。enlarge 是「使變大」；expand 意思接近；enlargement 是名詞。

sentences.en: The salon accepts walk-in customers every day, but people with appointments will always be served first.
sentences.zh: 美髮沙龍每天都接受臨時上門的客人，但有預約的人一律優先服務。

sentences.en: The new walk-in clinic near the station is open every day from eight in the morning until ten at night.
sentences.zh: 車站附近新的免預約診所每天早上八點開到晚上十點。

sentences.en: The bedroom has a large walk-in closet, which was one reason why we decided to buy the apartment.
sentences.zh: 臥室有一個大的步入式衣櫥，這是我們決定買那間公寓的原因之一。

sentences.en: The restaurant keeps a few tables for walk-in customers who arrive without a reservation on weekends.
sentences.zh: 餐廳保留幾張桌子給週末沒有訂位直接上門的客人。

sentences.en: Patients can visit the walk-in clinic for minor problems such as colds and small cuts.
sentences.zh: 病人有感冒或小傷口之類的輕微問題時，可以去免預約診所。

words.note: 語塊：walk-in customers（臨時上門的客人）、walk-in clinic（免預約診所）、walk-in closet（步入式衣櫥）。walk-in 是「直接走進去、不用預約的」；appointment 是「預約」。

sentences.en: The company will pay for the meal if you take a client to dinner during the business trip.
sentences.zh: 如果你出差時帶客戶吃晚餐，公司會支付餐費。

sentences.en: The new solar panels will pay for themselves in about six years because of the lower electricity bills.
sentences.zh: 因為電費降低，新的太陽能板大約六年就能回本。

sentences.en: Visitors must pay for parking at the machine near the entrance before they return to their cars.
sentences.zh: 訪客回到車上前必須在入口附近的機器付停車費。

sentences.en: Many students work part-time in the evenings to pay for their university fees and books.
sentences.zh: 很多學生晚上打工來支付大學學費和書錢。

sentences.en: Guests can pay for their rooms by credit card, cash, or mobile payment at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 客人可以在櫃台用信用卡、現金或行動支付付房費。

words.note: 語塊：pay for the meal（付餐費）、pay for parking（付停車費）、pay for fees（支付費用）、pay for rooms（付房費）。pay for + 東西（pay for the tickets）；pay + 人或金額（pay the driver / pay $50）。

sentences.en: The new policy will allow employees to work from home two days a week if their managers agree.
sentences.zh: 新規定允許員工在主管同意下一週在家工作兩天。

sentences.en: The restaurant does not allow pets inside, but guests may bring them to the outdoor tables in the garden.
sentences.zh: 餐廳不允許寵物進入室內，但客人可以帶牠們到花園的戶外座位。

sentences.en: The software will allow customers to track their orders and change the delivery time online.
sentences.zh: 軟體讓顧客能在線上追蹤訂單和更改送貨時間。

sentences.en: Please allow at least three days for delivery, because we are very busy during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 請預留至少三天的送貨時間，因為我們在假期期間非常忙。

sentences.en: The museum does not allow visitors to take photos inside the gallery with the ancient paintings.
sentences.zh: 博物館不允許參觀者在有古畫的展廳裡拍照。

words.note: 語塊：allow sb to do（允許某人做……）、be allowed to（被允許……）、allow for（考慮到）。allow sb to do 一定接 to + 原形；permit 意思接近，比較正式；let sb do 不用 to。

sentences.en: The company will start mass production of the new electric bicycle in March next year.
sentences.zh: 公司明年三月將開始大量生產新的電動自行車。

sentences.en: Workers on the production line take a short break every two hours to prevent accidents.
sentences.zh: 生產線上的工人每兩小時休息一下，以防發生意外。

sentences.en: The factory plans to increase production by twenty percent to meet the growing demand from Asia.
sentences.zh: 工廠計畫增加兩成產量，以應付亞洲日益增加的需求。

sentences.en: The film's production took three years and involved more than five hundred people in four countries.
sentences.zh: 那部電影的製作花了三年，四個國家共有五百多人參與。

sentences.en: The new machines on the production line can work twenty-four hours a day without stopping.
sentences.zh: 生產線上的新機器可以一天二十四小時不停運作。

words.note: 語塊：mass production（大量生產）、production line（生產線）、increase production（增加產量）。production 是 produce（生產）的名詞；product 是「產品」；productivity 是「生產力」。

sentences.en: Please direct any questions about the new schedule to Ms. Lee in the human resources department.
sentences.zh: 關於新班表的任何問題，請洽人資部的李小姐。

sentences.en: Police officers will direct traffic near the stadium before and after the game on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 週六比賽前後，警察會在體育場附近指揮交通。

sentences.en: The famous actor will direct a film for the first time next year, and it will be shot in Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 那位知名演員明年將首次執導電影，會在台灣拍攝。

sentences.en: Staff at the information desk will direct visitors to the right room for each session.
sentences.zh: 服務台的工作人員會引導訪客到各場次的正確教室。

sentences.en: If you have a complaint, please direct it to our customer care team so that we can help you quickly.
sentences.zh: 如果您有任何投訴，請轉給我們的客服團隊，讓我們能快速協助您。

words.note: 語塊：direct questions to（把問題轉給……）、direct traffic（指揮交通）、direct a film（執導電影）。direct 當動詞是「指示、引導」；當形容詞是「直接的」；director 是「主任；導演」。

sentences.en: Applicants for the position must be fluent in English and Japanese, because they will work with clients from Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 應徵這個職位的人必須精通英文和日文，因為要和東京的客戶合作。

sentences.en: Ms. Park speaks fluent English because she studied at a university in Canada for five years.
sentences.zh: 朴小姐英文說得很流利，因為她在加拿大的大學讀了五年書。

sentences.en: The hotel is looking for front desk staff who are fluent in at least two languages.
sentences.zh: 飯店在找至少精通兩種語言的櫃台人員。

sentences.en: Mr. Chen became fluent in Spanish after working at a hotel in Mexico for three years.
sentences.zh: 陳先生在墨西哥的飯店工作三年後，西班牙文變得很流利。

sentences.en: Being fluent in a second language can help you get a better job in an international company.
sentences.zh: 精通第二外語可以幫你在跨國公司找到更好的工作。

words.note: 語塊：fluent in（精通……語言）、fluent English（流利的英文）。fluent 是「說得流利的」；fluently 是副詞；fluency 是名詞「流利度」。

sentences.en: Every employee must submit a headshot for the new company website by the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 每位員工都必須在本週末前提交一張大頭照放在公司新網站上。

sentences.en: The photographer will take a professional headshot of each speaker before the international conference begins.
sentences.zh: 攝影師會在國際研討會開始前為每位講者拍專業大頭照。

sentences.en: Actors usually send a headshot and a short résumé when they apply for a role in a film.
sentences.zh: 演員應徵電影角色時，通常會寄一張大頭照和簡短的履歷。

sentences.en: A professional headshot can make a good impression on employers who look at your online profile.
sentences.zh: 專業的大頭照能讓看你線上個人檔案的雇主留下好印象。

sentences.en: Please send a recent headshot to the marketing team so that they can add it to the brochure.
sentences.zh: 請把一張近照寄給行銷團隊，讓他們放進簡介冊裡。

words.note: 語塊：professional headshot（專業大頭照）、submit a headshot（提交大頭照）。headshot 是只拍頭和肩膀的照片，常用在履歷、名片或公司網站。

sentences.en: Our driver will meet you in the arrival area holding a sign with your name on it.
sentences.zh: 我們的司機會在入境大廳舉著寫有你名字的牌子接你。

sentences.en: There is a currency exchange counter in the arrival area, so you can change money as soon as you land.
sentences.zh: 入境大廳有換匯櫃台，所以你一落地就能換錢。

sentences.en: The arrival area of the airport was very crowded because several international flights landed at the same time.
sentences.zh: 機場入境大廳非常擁擠，因為好幾班國際航班同時降落。

sentences.en: Please wait for the tour guide in the arrival area after you collect your luggage.
sentences.zh: 領完行李後，請在入境大廳等導遊。

sentences.en: The new arrival area has more seats, free wireless internet, and several cafés for people who are waiting.
sentences.zh: 新的入境大廳有更多座位、免費無線網路，還有好幾家咖啡廳給等候的人。

words.note: 語塊：in the arrival area（在入境大廳）、meet sb in the arrival area（在入境大廳接人）。arrival 是「抵達」；departure area 是「出境大廳」；baggage claim 是「行李提領處」。

sentences.en: The trade association holds a conference every year where members can share news about the industry.
sentences.zh: 同業公會每年舉辦研討會，讓會員分享產業消息。

sentences.en: The festival is organized by the city in association with several local businesses and schools.
sentences.zh: 這個節慶是由市政府與幾家當地企業和學校合作舉辦的。

sentences.en: The study found a strong association between regular exercise and better performance at work among office employees.
sentences.zh: 研究發現上班族規律運動和工作表現較好之間有很強的關聯。

sentences.en: Ms. Grant was elected president of the restaurant association at its annual meeting last month.
sentences.zh: 格蘭特小姐在上個月的年會上被選為餐飲協會會長。

sentences.en: The new training course was developed in association with a famous business school at a university in London.
sentences.zh: 新的訓練課程是與倫敦一所大學的知名商學院合作開發的。

words.note: 語塊：trade association（同業公會）、in association with（與……合作）、association between（……之間的關聯）。association 是 associate（聯想；結交）的名詞；organization 是「組織」。

sentences.en: The mayor will give a speech at the opening ceremony of the new train station on Monday.
sentences.zh: 市長週一會在新火車站的開幕典禮上致詞。

sentences.en: The CEO's opening speech at the conference focused on the importance of protecting the environment.
sentences.zh: 執行長在研討會的開幕致詞聚焦在保護環境的重要性。

sentences.en: A famous scientist will give the keynote speech at the technology fair in Singapore next month.
sentences.zh: 一位知名科學家下個月將在新加坡的科技展發表主題演講。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin practiced her speech many times so that she would feel confident in front of the audience.
sentences.zh: 林小姐把演講練習了很多次，讓自己在觀眾面前有自信。

sentences.en: The keynote speech will begin at nine o'clock, so please arrive early to find a good seat.
sentences.zh: 主題演講九點開始，所以請提早到找好位子。

words.note: 語塊：give a speech（演講）、opening speech（開幕致詞）、keynote speech（主題演講）。speech 是名詞；speak 是動詞；speaker 是「講者」。

sentences.en: Each contestant in the cooking competition has one hour to prepare a dish using local vegetables.
sentences.zh: 烹飪比賽的每位參賽者有一小時，用在地蔬菜做出一道菜。

sentences.en: The winning contestant will receive five thousand dollars and a chance to work at a famous restaurant.
sentences.zh: 獲勝的參賽者將獲得五千元，以及到知名餐廳工作的機會。

sentences.en: Every contestant who signed up for the singing contest had to wait for hours, so the judges had a long day.
sentences.zh: 每位報名歌唱比賽的參賽者都要等好幾個小時，所以評審忙了一整天。

sentences.en: Every contestant must submit a short video before the deadline in order to take part in the final round.
sentences.zh: 每位參賽者都必須在截止日前提交一段短片，才能參加決賽。

sentences.en: The judges said the winning contestant had the most creative design they had seen in years.
sentences.zh: 評審說獲勝參賽者的設計是他們多年來看過最有創意的。

words.note: 語塊：each contestant（每位參賽者）、winning contestant（獲勝的參賽者）。contestant 是參加比賽的人；contest 是「比賽」；competitor 意思接近。

sentences.en: The hotel is only a five-minute walk from the nearest subway station, so it is easy to get around the city.
sentences.zh: 飯店離最近的地鐵站走路只要五分鐘，所以在城裡移動很方便。

sentences.en: Many new cafés and shops have opened near the subway station since the line was extended last year.
sentences.zh: 自從去年地鐵線延伸後，地鐵站附近開了很多新的咖啡廳和商店。

sentences.en: Please take exit three at the subway station and walk straight for about two hundred meters.
sentences.zh: 請在地鐵站三號出口出站，往前直走大約兩百公尺。

sentences.en: The nearest subway station to the stadium will be very crowded after the concert, so please be patient.
sentences.zh: 演唱會結束後，離體育場最近的地鐵站會非常擁擠，所以請耐心等候。

sentences.en: Apartments near the subway station are more expensive, but they save residents a lot of time every day.
sentences.zh: 地鐵站附近的公寓比較貴，但每天能幫住戶省下很多時間。

words.note: 語塊：nearest subway station（最近的地鐵站）、near the subway station（在地鐵站附近）。subway 是美式「地鐵」；英式說 underground 或 tube；metro 也很常用。

sentences.en: We guarantee that your order will arrive within two days, or we will refund the delivery fee.
sentences.zh: 我們保證您的訂單兩天內送達，否則退還運費。

sentences.en: All of our products come with a money-back guarantee, so you can return them within thirty days.
sentences.zh: 我們所有的產品都有退款保證，所以三十天內可以退貨。

sentences.en: The hotel cannot guarantee that a room with a sea view will be available on your arrival date.
sentences.zh: 飯店無法保證您抵達當天一定有海景房。

sentences.en: The new security system will guarantee that only employees can enter the building after eight o'clock.
sentences.zh: 新的保全系統會確保晚上八點以後只有員工能進入大樓。

sentences.en: Hard work does not always guarantee success, but it certainly improves your chances of reaching your goals.
sentences.zh: 努力不一定保證成功，但確實能提高你達成目標的機會。

words.note: 語塊：guarantee that（保證……）、money-back guarantee（退款保證）、be guaranteed to（保證會……）。guarantee 可以當動詞或名詞（a one-year guarantee）；warranty 是「保固」。

sentences.en: The new football stadium can hold more than sixty thousand fans and has a roof that opens and closes.
sentences.zh: 新的足球場可以容納六萬多名球迷，還有可開關的屋頂。

sentences.en: The concert will be held at an outdoor stadium, so please bring a raincoat in case of bad weather.
sentences.zh: 演唱會在戶外體育場舉行，所以請帶雨衣以防天氣不好。

sentences.en: Workers are replacing all of the stadium seats before the start of the new baseball season.
sentences.zh: 工人正在新棒球季開始前更換所有體育場座位。

sentences.en: Thousands of people walked from the subway station to the stadium before the final game.
sentences.zh: 決賽前，數千人從地鐵站走到體育場。

sentences.en: The city plans to build a new stadium near the river, which will also be used for concerts.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫在河邊蓋一座新體育場，也會用來辦演唱會。

words.note: 語塊：football stadium（足球場）、outdoor stadium（戶外體育場）、stadium seats（體育場座位）。stadium 是有觀眾席的大型場地；gymnasium 是室內「體育館」。

sentences.en: The manager agreed to push back the deadline by one week because the team needed more time.
sentences.zh: 經理同意把截止日延後一週，因為團隊需要更多時間。

sentences.en: We need to push back the meeting to Thursday, because the client's flight was delayed.
sentences.zh: 我們需要把會議延到週四，因為客戶的班機延誤了。

sentences.en: The company had to push back the opening of the new store because the building was not ready.
sentences.zh: 因為大樓還沒準備好，公司不得不延後新店開幕。

sentences.en: If we push back the deadline again, the client may decide to work with another company.
sentences.zh: 如果我們再次延後截止日，客戶可能會決定和別的公司合作。

sentences.en: Bad weather may push back the start of the construction project until the middle of next spring.
sentences.zh: 惡劣天氣可能會讓建設專案延到明年春天中旬才開始。

words.note: 語塊：push back the deadline（延後截止日）、push back the meeting（延後會議）。push back 是「把時間往後推」；put off、postpone 意思接近；bring forward 是「提前」。

sentences.en: Our staff will gladly help you find the right size if the shirt you ordered does not fit.
sentences.zh: 如果您訂的襯衫不合身，我們的員工很樂意幫您找到合適的尺寸。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz gladly accepted the job offer because it was exactly the position she had been hoping for.
sentences.zh: 魯伊茲小姐欣然接受了工作邀約，因為那正是她一直希望的職位。

sentences.en: I would gladly attend the conference, but I already have a business trip planned for that week.
sentences.zh: 我很樂意參加研討會，但那週我已經安排好出差了。

sentences.en: The hotel will gladly store your luggage after you check out if you want to explore the city.
sentences.zh: 如果您退房後想逛逛城市，飯店很樂意幫您寄放行李。

sentences.en: Many employees gladly volunteered to help at the charity event that the company organized on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 很多員工樂意自願到公司週六舉辦的慈善活動幫忙。

words.note: 語塊：gladly accept（欣然接受）、gladly help（樂意幫忙）。gladly 是 glad（高興的）的副詞；willingly 意思接近；I would gladly … 是很客氣的說法。

sentences.en: We have twenty minutes before the meeting, so let's grab a coffee at the café downstairs.
sentences.zh: 會議前還有二十分鐘，我們去樓下咖啡廳買杯咖啡吧。

sentences.en: Many office workers grab a bite at the food court because they only have thirty minutes for lunch.
sentences.zh: 很多上班族在美食街隨便吃點東西，因為午休只有三十分鐘。

sentences.en: The bright colors of the advertisement are designed to grab attention from people walking past the store.
sentences.zh: 廣告鮮豔的顏色是為了吸引經過店門口的人注意。

sentences.en: Please grab a copy of the schedule from the front desk before the training session begins.
sentences.zh: 訓練課程開始前，請到櫃台拿一份時程表。

sentences.en: The title of the article must grab attention, or readers will not click on it when they see it online.
sentences.zh: 文章標題必須吸引注意，否則讀者在網路上看到時不會點進去。

words.note: 語塊：grab a bite（隨便吃點東西）、grab a coffee（買杯咖啡）、grab attention（吸引注意）。grab 是口語「迅速拿、抓」；grab a bite 是「隨便吃點東西」。

sentences.en: The newspaper apologized to its readers for publishing inaccurate information about the company's profits last year.
sentences.zh: 那家報社向讀者道歉，因為刊登了有關公司去年獲利的錯誤資訊。

sentences.en: The map on the website is inaccurate, so some visitors could not find the entrance to the museum.
sentences.zh: 網站上的地圖不正確，所以有些遊客找不到博物館入口。

sentences.en: The manager returned the inaccurate report to the team and asked them to check the numbers again.
sentences.zh: 經理把不準確的報告退回給團隊，請他們再檢查一次數字。

sentences.en: Customers complained that the product description was inaccurate because the bag was much smaller than shown.
sentences.zh: 顧客抱怨產品說明不正確，因為包包比圖片上小很多。

sentences.en: If any of your personal information is inaccurate, please contact the human resources department as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 如果你的個人資料有任何錯誤，請盡快聯絡人資部門。

words.note: 語塊：inaccurate information（錯誤資訊）、inaccurate report（不準確的報告）。inaccurate 是「不精確、有錯的」；accurate 是相反詞；incorrect 意思接近。

sentences.en: The company signed a lease for a larger office downtown, and the move will take place next month.
sentences.zh: 公司在市中心簽了一間較大辦公室的租約，下個月搬家。

sentences.en: If we decide not to renew the lease, we must tell the landlord at least three months in advance.
sentences.zh: 如果我們決定不續租，必須至少提前三個月通知房東。

sentences.en: Please read the lease agreement carefully before you sign it, especially the part about repairs.
sentences.zh: 簽約前請仔細閱讀租賃合約，特別是維修的部分。

sentences.en: The restaurant's lease will end in December, so the owner is looking for a new location.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳的租約十二月到期，所以老闆在找新地點。

sentences.en: Many small businesses sign a lease for three years so that the rent does not increase too quickly.
sentences.zh: 很多小公司會簽三年的租約，讓租金不會漲得太快。

words.note: 語塊：sign a lease（簽租約）、renew a lease（續租）、lease agreement（租賃合約）。lease 可以當名詞或動詞「租賃」；rent 是一般的「租」；landlord 是「房東」，tenant 是「房客」。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibition is about the history of space exploration from the 1950s to today.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽是關於從 1950 年代到現在的太空探索歷史。

sentences.en: The government stopped oil exploration near the coast because of concerns about the environment and local fishing.
sentences.zh: 因為對環境和當地漁業的疑慮，政府停止了海岸附近的石油探勘。

sentences.en: The tour gives visitors time for exploration of the old town on their own after lunch.
sentences.zh: 這個行程讓遊客午餐後有時間自己探索老城區。

sentences.en: Companies that invest in space exploration hope to send tourists to the moon within twenty years.
sentences.zh: 投資太空探索的公司希望二十年內把觀光客送上月球。

sentences.en: The new app encourages exploration of the city by showing hidden cafés and small museums nearby.
sentences.zh: 新的 App 會顯示附近隱藏的咖啡廳和小博物館，鼓勵大家探索這座城市。

words.note: 語塊：space exploration（太空探索）、oil exploration（石油探勘）。exploration 是 explore（探索）的名詞；explorer 是「探險家」；explanation 是「解釋」。

sentences.en: I wonder if you could send me the report before the meeting, because I would like to read it first.
sentences.zh: 不知道你能不能在開會前把報告寄給我，因為我想先看一下。

sentences.en: Many customers wonder whether the new phone is worth the high price, so we offer a free trial.
sentences.zh: 很多顧客想知道新手機值不值得那麼貴的價格，所以我們提供免費試用。

sentences.en: The restaurant uses fresh local ingredients, so it is no wonder that it is always full on weekends.
sentences.zh: 那家餐廳用新鮮在地食材，難怪週末總是客滿。

sentences.en: We wonder if the store will be open on the national holiday, because we need to buy a gift.
sentences.zh: 我們想知道那家店國定假日有沒有開，因為我們需要買禮物。

sentences.en: The manager began to wonder whether the project could be finished on time without more staff.
sentences.zh: 經理開始懷疑沒有更多人手的話，專案能不能準時完成。

words.note: 語塊：wonder if（想知道是否……）、wonder whether（不知道是否……）、no wonder（難怪）。wonder if 常用來客氣地請求（I was wondering if you could…）；wander 是「閒逛」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: The writer spent two years working on the film script before a famous director agreed to make the movie.
sentences.zh: 那位作家花了兩年寫電影劇本，才有一位知名導演答應拍這部片。

sentences.en: Customer service staff follow a script when they answer the phone, but they can change it if needed.
sentences.zh: 客服人員接電話時會照講稿說，但需要時可以調整。

sentences.en: The marketing team hired a writer to write a script for the new television commercial.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊雇了一位作家為新的電視廣告寫腳本。

sentences.en: Please read the script carefully before the video recording, because we will only have the studio for two hours.
sentences.zh: 錄影前請仔細讀講稿，因為我們只有兩小時能用錄影室。

sentences.en: The actors received the film script one month before filming began in the mountains of northern Japan.
sentences.zh: 演員在日本北部山區開拍前一個月拿到電影劇本。

words.note: 語塊：write a script（寫劇本）、follow a script（照講稿說）、film script（電影劇本）。script 是演出或發言用的「稿子」；scripture 是「經文」；manuscript 是「手稿」。

sentences.en: The manager asked us to revise the plan after the client said the budget was too high.
sentences.zh: 客戶說預算太高後，經理請我們修改計畫。

sentences.en: The finance team will revise the budget for next year because the cost of materials has increased.
sentences.zh: 財務團隊會修訂明年的預算，因為材料成本上漲了。

sentences.en: Please revise the contract by Friday so that the lawyer can check it before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 請在週五前修改合約，讓律師在開會前檢查。

sentences.en: The company had to revise its sales forecast after the new product sold much better than expected.
sentences.zh: 新產品賣得比預期好很多，公司不得不修訂銷售預測。

sentences.en: Before you submit your report, please revise it carefully and check all of the numbers again.
sentences.zh: 提交報告前，請仔細修改並再檢查一次所有數字。

words.note: 語塊：revise the plan（修改計畫）、revise the budget（修訂預算）、revise the contract（修改合約）。revise 是「修改文件或計畫」；英式英文也有「複習」的意思；revision 是名詞。

sentences.en: You must get approval from your manager before you buy any equipment that costs more than five hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 購買任何超過五百元的設備前，你必須先取得主管批准。

sentences.en: Please send the final design to the client for approval before we start printing the brochures.
sentences.zh: 開始印製簡介之前，請先把最終設計寄給客戶審核。

sentences.en: The new medicine cannot be sold in stores until it receives approval from the government.
sentences.zh: 新藥在取得政府批准之前不能在店裡販售。

sentences.en: The plan for the new park received approval from the city council at its meeting last night.
sentences.zh: 新公園的計畫在昨晚的市議會會議上獲得批准。

sentences.en: All travel requests must be sent to the department head for approval at least two weeks in advance.
sentences.zh: 所有出差申請都必須至少提前兩週送交部門主管審核。

words.note: 語塊：get approval（取得批准）、for approval（供審核）、approval from（來自……的批准）。approval 是 approve（批准）的名詞；permission 是「許可」。

sentences.en: The company is looking for someone with experience in marketing to fill the vacant position.
sentences.zh: 公司在找有行銷經驗的人來填補這個職缺。

sentences.en: The hotel has only one vacant room left for Saturday night, so please book it quickly.
sentences.zh: 飯店週六晚上只剩一間空房，所以請盡快預訂。

sentences.en: The city plans to turn the vacant lot next to the school into a small park with trees and benches.
sentences.zh: 市政府計畫把學校旁邊的空地改成有樹和長椅的小公園。

sentences.en: Many stores on the main street have been vacant since the new shopping mall opened outside the town.
sentences.zh: 自從鎮外新購物中心開幕後，主要街道上很多店面都空著。

sentences.en: The vacant position will be advertised on the company website and in several newspapers next week.
sentences.zh: 這個職缺下週會刊登在公司網站和幾家報紙上。

words.note: 語塊：vacant position（職缺）、vacant room（空房）、vacant lot（空地）。vacant 是「沒有人使用的」；vacancy 是名詞「空缺；空房」；empty 意思接近。

sentences.en: The sales target for this month is unrealistic, because the store will be closed for five days.
sentences.zh: 這個月的業績目標不切實際，因為店要休息五天。

sentences.en: Some customers have unrealistic expectations about how fast their orders can be delivered during the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 有些顧客對假期期間訂單能多快送到有不切實際的期待。

sentences.en: Setting an unrealistic goal can make employees feel stressed and less motivated at work over time.
sentences.zh: 設定不切實際的目標久而久之會讓員工感到壓力、工作動力降低。

sentences.en: The consultant said that the plan to open ten new stores this year was unrealistic.
sentences.zh: 顧問說今年開十家新店的計畫不切實際。

sentences.en: It is unrealistic to expect a new employee to understand the entire system in the first week.
sentences.zh: 期待新員工第一週就了解整個系統是不切實際的。

words.note: 語塊：unrealistic goal（不切實際的目標）、unrealistic expectations（不切實際的期待）。unrealistic 是「做不到、不合現實的」；realistic 是相反詞「實際的」。

sentences.en: The new warehouse uses an automated system that can pack and ship orders without any workers.
sentences.zh: 新倉庫使用自動化系統，不需要工人就能包裝和出貨。

sentences.en: The factory is now fully automated, so only five engineers are needed to run the production line.
sentences.zh: 工廠現在全自動化，所以只需要五位工程師就能運作生產線。

sentences.en: Customers will receive an automated message by e-mail when their package leaves the warehouse in Busan.
sentences.zh: 顧客的包裹離開釜山倉庫時，他們會收到一則自動電子郵件訊息。

sentences.en: The bank's automated system will send you a reminder three days before your bill is due.
sentences.zh: 銀行的自動化系統會在帳單到期前三天寄提醒給您。

sentences.en: Some customers do not like automated phone services and prefer to speak to a real person.
sentences.zh: 有些顧客不喜歡自動語音服務，比較想跟真人說話。

words.note: 語塊：automated system（自動化系統）、fully automated（全自動的）、automated message（自動訊息）。automated 是「由機器自動執行的」；automatic 是「自動的」；automation 是名詞「自動化」。

sentences.en: At the beginning of the meeting, Ms. Chen will give a brief overview of the project and its goals.
sentences.zh: 會議一開始，陳小姐會簡要概述專案和目標。

sentences.en: The first chapter of the report provides an overview of the market and the main competitors.
sentences.zh: 報告的第一章提供市場和主要競爭對手的概要。

sentences.en: The training session will start with an overview of the company's history and its values.
sentences.zh: 訓練課程會先從公司歷史和價值觀的概述開始。

sentences.en: Please give an overview of your work experience in no more than two minutes during the interview.
sentences.zh: 面試時請在兩分鐘內概述你的工作經驗。

sentences.en: The website offers a brief overview of each tour, including the price, the length, and what is included.
sentences.zh: 網站提供每個行程的簡要說明，包括價格、時長和包含項目。

words.note: 語塊：brief overview（簡要概述）、give an overview（提供概要）、overview of（……的概要）。overview 是「整體的簡要說明」；summary 是「摘要」；review 是「檢討；評論」。

sentences.en: The new manager worked closely with the old one to make sure there was a smooth transition.
sentences.zh: 新經理和前任密切合作，確保交接順利。

sentences.en: During the transition period, employees can use both the old system and the new one.
sentences.zh: 過渡期間，員工可以同時使用舊系統和新系統。

sentences.en: The company's transition to electric delivery trucks will be completed by the end of next year.
sentences.zh: 公司改用電動送貨卡車的轉換會在明年底前完成。

sentences.en: Many workers needed extra training during the transition period after the factory was automated last spring.
sentences.zh: 工廠去年春天自動化後的過渡期，很多工人需要額外訓練。

sentences.en: The CEO thanked the team for helping to make the transition to the new office smooth and quick.
sentences.zh: 執行長感謝團隊幫忙讓搬到新辦公室的過程順利又快速。

words.note: 語塊：smooth transition（順利過渡）、transition period（過渡期）、transition to（轉換到……）。transition 是「從一個狀態變到另一個狀態」；transit 是「運輸；通過」；translation 是「翻譯」。

sentences.en: The sales team will give a demonstration of the new software to the client next Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 業務團隊下週二早上會向客戶示範新軟體。

sentences.en: Visitors to the trade show can watch a product demonstration at our booth every hour.
sentences.zh: 參觀展覽的訪客每小時都可以在我們的攤位看產品示範。

sentences.en: The famous chef will hold a cooking demonstration at the department store on Saturday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那位知名主廚週六下午會在百貨公司舉辦烹飪示範。

sentences.en: After the product demonstration, customers can try the new vacuum cleaner for themselves in the store.
sentences.zh: 產品示範結束後，顧客可以在店裡親自試用新的吸塵器。

sentences.en: The technician gave a demonstration of how to use the new machine safely before the workers started.
sentences.zh: 工人開始之前，技術人員示範了如何安全使用新機器。

words.note: 語塊：product demonstration（產品示範）、give a demonstration（做示範）、cooking demonstration（烹飪示範）。demonstration 是 demonstrate（示範；證明）的名詞；也可以指「示威遊行」。

sentences.en: The city experienced an economic boom after several large technology companies opened offices there in 2020.
sentences.zh: 2020 年好幾家大型科技公司在那裡設立辦公室後，這座城市經歷了一波經濟繁榮。

sentences.en: The housing boom has made it difficult for young families to buy apartments in the capital.
sentences.zh: 房市熱潮讓年輕家庭很難在首都買公寓。

sentences.en: There has been a boom in online shopping, especially among people over sixty years old.
sentences.zh: 網路購物大幅激增，特別是六十歲以上的人。

sentences.en: Many restaurants opened near the beach during the tourism boom of the last five years.
sentences.zh: 在過去五年的觀光熱潮中，海灘附近開了很多餐廳。

sentences.en: Experts say that the boom in electric car sales will continue for at least another ten years.
sentences.zh: 專家說電動車銷量的激增至少還會持續十年。

words.note: 語塊：economic boom（經濟繁榮）、housing boom（房市熱潮）、boom in（……的激增）。boom 是「突然快速成長」；bust 是相反「崩盤」；baby boom 是「嬰兒潮」。

sentences.en: Thanks to the support of our customers, the store has been open for more than fifty years.
sentences.zh: 多虧顧客的支持，那家店已經開了五十多年。

sentences.en: The project was finished early thanks to hard work from everyone on the design team.
sentences.zh: 多虧設計團隊每個人的努力，專案提早完成了。

sentences.en: Sales increased by twenty percent last year, thanks to the new advertising campaign on social media.
sentences.zh: 多虧社群媒體上的新廣告活動，去年銷售增加了兩成。

sentences.en: Thanks to the new subway line, it now takes only fifteen minutes to get from the airport to downtown.
sentences.zh: 多虧新地鐵線，現在從機場到市中心只要十五分鐘。

sentences.en: The museum was able to repair its roof thanks to the support of several local businesses.
sentences.zh: 多虧幾家當地企業的支持，博物館才得以修理屋頂。

words.note: 語塊：thanks to the support（多虧支持）、thanks to hard work（多虧努力）。thanks to 是「因為（通常是好的原因）」；due to 比較中性；thank you 是「謝謝你」。

sentences.en: The company will move to a new office near the subway station at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 公司月底會搬到地鐵站附近的新辦公室。

sentences.en: After the board approved the budget, we were finally able to move forward with the project.
sentences.zh: 董事會核准預算後，我們終於可以推進專案了。

sentences.en: We will move the meeting up to Monday, so please prepare your reports by Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們會把會議提前到週一，所以請在週五下午前準備好報告。

sentences.en: Ms. Lee will move to the Tokyo branch next spring to manage the new sales team there.
sentences.zh: 李小姐明年春天會調到東京分公司，管理那裡新的業務團隊。

sentences.en: If we want to move forward quickly, we need to hire two more engineers this month.
sentences.zh: 如果我們想快速推進，這個月需要再雇兩位工程師。

words.note: 語塊：move to（搬到……）、move forward（推進）、move up（提前；升遷）。move 有「搬家、移動、提前、感動」等意思；remove 是「移除」。

sentences.en: The campaign to reduce plastic waste has started to gain momentum, and many stores now offer paper bags.
sentences.zh: 減少塑膠垃圾的運動開始加速發展，很多商店現在都提供紙袋。

sentences.en: Sales of the new phone began to gain momentum after a famous singer used it in her music video.
sentences.zh: 一位知名歌手在音樂影片中使用新手機後，它的銷量開始衝高。

sentences.en: The idea of working from home continues to gain momentum, especially among young employees in large cities.
sentences.zh: 在家工作的想法持續升溫，特別是在大城市的年輕員工之間。

sentences.en: The project was slow at first, but it started to gain momentum after the new manager joined the team.
sentences.zh: 專案一開始很慢，但新經理加入團隊後開始加速。

sentences.en: Electric vehicles will continue to gain momentum as prices fall and more charging stations are built.
sentences.zh: 隨著價格下降和充電站增加，電動車會持續升溫。

words.note: 語塊：start to gain momentum（開始加速）、continue to gain momentum（持續升溫）。momentum 是「動能、氣勢」；gain 是「獲得」；lose momentum 是「失去動能」。

sentences.en: The hotel room has a stunning view of the ocean, so many guests take photos from the balcony.
sentences.zh: 飯店房間有絕美的海景，所以很多客人在陽台拍照。

sentences.en: The new museum has a stunning design that looks like a giant wave made of glass and steel.
sentences.zh: 新博物館有令人驚豔的設計，看起來像一道用玻璃和鋼鐵做成的巨浪。

sentences.en: The bride wore a stunning dress that was made by a famous designer in Paris.
sentences.zh: 新娘穿著一件由巴黎知名設計師製作的驚豔禮服。

sentences.en: From the top of the mountain, hikers can enjoy a stunning view of the whole valley.
sentences.zh: 從山頂，登山客可以欣賞整個山谷的絕美景色。

sentences.en: The car's stunning design won several awards at the international motor show in Geneva last year.
sentences.zh: 那輛車驚豔的設計去年在日內瓦國際車展上獲得好幾個獎項。

words.note: 語塊：stunning view（絕美景色）、stunning design（驚豔的設計）。stunning 是「美到讓人驚訝的」；magnificent、gorgeous 意思接近；stun 是動詞「使震驚」。

sentences.en: Fishing boats are not allowed in coastal waters near the island during the breeding season.
sentences.zh: 繁殖季期間，漁船不准進入島嶼附近的沿海水域。

sentences.en: The government passed a new law to protect coastal waters from pollution caused by factories.
sentences.zh: 政府通過一項新法律，保護沿海水域不受工廠污染。

sentences.en: Divers can see colorful fish and coral in the coastal waters near the beachfront hotel.
sentences.zh: 潛水客可以在海濱飯店附近的沿海水域看到五顏六色的魚和珊瑚。

sentences.en: The oil spill caused serious damage to the coastal waters, and the cleanup took several months.
sentences.zh: 漏油嚴重破壞了沿海水域，清理工作花了好幾個月。

sentences.en: Scientists are studying how rising temperatures affect the fish and plants that live in coastal waters.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在研究氣溫上升如何影響生活在沿海水域的魚類和植物。

words.note: 語塊：in coastal waters（在沿海水域）、protect coastal waters（保護沿海水域）。coastal 是 coast（海岸）的形容詞；coastline 是「海岸線」。

sentences.en: Please set up a projector in the meeting room before the clients arrive for the presentation.
sentences.zh: 請在客戶抵達聽簡報之前，在會議室架好投影機。

sentences.en: The projector in Conference Room B is broken, so we will use the large television screen instead.
sentences.zh: B 會議室的投影機壞了，所以我們會改用大電視螢幕。

sentences.en: The school bought a new projector for every classroom so that teachers can show videos to students.
sentences.zh: 學校為每間教室買了新的投影機，讓老師能播放影片給學生看。

sentences.en: Please turn off the projector after the meeting, because it gets very hot if it stays on too long.
sentences.zh: 會議結束後請關掉投影機，因為開太久會變得很燙。

sentences.en: The hotel can provide a projector and a screen at no extra cost for business guests.
sentences.zh: 飯店可以為商務客人免費提供投影機和投影幕。

words.note: 語塊：set up a projector（架設投影機）、projector screen（投影幕）。projector 是把影像投到牆上的機器；project 是「投射；專案」；projection 是「投影；預測」。

sentences.en: The product is excellent but too expensive, and therein lies the reason why sales have been slow.
sentences.zh: 產品很好但太貴，這就是銷售緩慢的原因。

sentences.en: The contract includes all of the terms therein, so please read every page before you sign it.
sentences.zh: 合約包含其中所有條款，所以簽名前請讀每一頁。

sentences.en: The city has many tourists but very few hotels, and therein lies a great business opportunity.
sentences.zh: 這座城市觀光客很多但飯店很少，這就是一個很好的商機。

sentences.en: Everyone wants the project to succeed, but nobody wants to pay for it, and therein lies the problem.
sentences.zh: 每個人都希望專案成功，但沒人想出錢，問題就出在這裡。

sentences.en: The report and the information contained therein must not be shared with anyone outside the company.
sentences.zh: 這份報告和其中所含的資訊不得分享給公司以外的任何人。

words.note: 語塊：therein lies（問題就在於……）。therein 是很正式的說法「在那之中」；therein lies the problem 是「問題就出在這裡」。

sentences.en: Employees who work more than forty hours a week will receive overtime pay at one and a half times their normal rate.
sentences.zh: 每週工作超過四十小時的員工可以領取正常時薪一點五倍的加班費。

sentences.en: Part-time workers are also eligible for overtime pay if they work on national holidays or weekends.
sentences.zh: 兼職人員如果在國定假日或週末上班，也有資格領加班費。

sentences.en: The union asked the company to increase overtime pay for workers on the night shift.
sentences.zh: 工會要求公司提高夜班工人的加班費。

sentences.en: Please record your working hours carefully so that you receive the correct overtime pay each month.
sentences.zh: 請仔細記錄工作時數，讓你每個月都能領到正確的加班費。

sentences.en: Many workers are happy to stay late during the busy season because they receive overtime pay.
sentences.zh: 很多工人在旺季樂意留晚一點，因為可以領加班費。

words.note: 語塊：receive overtime pay（領加班費）、be eligible for overtime pay（有資格領加班費）。overtime 是「加班（時間）」；work overtime 是「加班」；pay 是「薪資」。

sentences.en: The financial regulator fined the bank for failing to protect the personal information of thousands of its customers.
sentences.zh: 金融監管機構因為銀行沒有保護好數千位顧客的個資而對其開罰。

sentences.en: The energy regulator will decide next month whether the electricity company can raise its prices.
sentences.zh: 能源主管機關下個月會決定電力公司能否漲價。

sentences.en: The airline must get approval from the regulator before it can add new flights to Europe.
sentences.zh: 航空公司要先取得主管機關核准，才能增加飛往歐洲的新航班。

sentences.en: The regulator asked all phone companies to explain their prices and contracts more clearly to their customers.
sentences.zh: 主管機關要求所有電信公司向顧客更清楚地說明價格和合約。

sentences.en: After the accident, the regulator ordered the factory to stop production until it improved its safety rules.
sentences.zh: 事故後，主管機關命令工廠停產，直到改善安全規定為止。

words.note: 語塊：financial regulator（金融監管機構）、energy regulator（能源主管機關）、approval from the regulator（主管機關的核准）、the regulator asked（主管機關要求）、the regulator ordered（主管機關命令）。regulator 是負責監督規範的機構；regulate 是動詞「管理」；regulation 是「規定」。

sentences.en: Every apartment in the new building comes with a high-speed broadband connection at no extra cost.
sentences.zh: 新大樓的每間公寓都附有免費的高速寬頻連線。

sentences.en: The government plans to bring broadband service to all villages in the mountains within three years.
sentences.zh: 政府計畫在三年內把寬頻服務帶到山區所有村莊。

sentences.en: A fast broadband connection is important for employees who work from home and attend video meetings.
sentences.zh: 快速的寬頻連線對在家工作、參加視訊會議的員工很重要。

sentences.en: The phone company is offering a discount on high-speed broadband for new customers this month.
sentences.zh: 電信公司這個月為新顧客提供高速寬頻的折扣。

sentences.en: Many small towns still do not have good broadband service, which makes it hard for businesses to grow.
sentences.zh: 很多小鎮還沒有好的寬頻服務，讓企業很難發展。

words.note: 語塊：broadband connection（寬頻連線）、high-speed broadband（高速寬頻）、broadband service（寬頻服務）。broadband 是「高速網路連線」；Wi-Fi 是無線網路；bandwidth 是「頻寬」。

sentences.en: The employees were worried about their jobs after the company buyout was announced last week.
sentences.zh: 上週宣布公司收購後，員工都很擔心自己的工作。

sentences.en: The managers of the hotel completed a management buyout and now own the business themselves.
sentences.zh: 飯店的經理們完成了管理層收購，現在自己擁有這門生意。

sentences.en: The board rejected the buyout offer because it was much lower than the true value of the company.
sentences.zh: 董事會拒絕了收購提議，因為價格比公司的實際價值低很多。

sentences.en: After the buyout, the new owners plan to open twenty more stores across the country.
sentences.zh: 收購後，新老闆計畫在全國再開二十家店。

sentences.en: The buyout offer from the American firm surprised many investors, who did not expect such a high price.
sentences.zh: 那家美國公司的收購提議讓很多投資人很驚訝，他們沒想到價格這麼高。

words.note: 語塊：company buyout（公司收購）、management buyout（管理層收購）、buyout offer（收購提議）。buyout 是「買下公司的全部股份」；takeover 是「接管」；acquisition 是「併購」。

sentences.en: This ticket will entitle you to free entry to all of the museums in the city for three days.
sentences.zh: 這張票讓你三天內可以免費進入城市所有的博物館。

sentences.en: Membership will entitle you to a ten percent discount on every purchase at our stores.
sentences.zh: 成為會員後，在我們店每次購物都可以打九折。

sentences.en: Working at the company for five years will entitle employees to an extra week of vacation.
sentences.zh: 在公司工作滿五年的員工可以多一週假期。

sentences.en: The receipt will entitle the customer to a full refund if the product breaks within one month.
sentences.zh: 如果產品在一個月內損壞，憑收據可以全額退款。

sentences.en: Does this coupon entitle me to a free drink, or do I need to buy a meal first?
sentences.zh: 這張優惠券讓我可以拿免費飲料嗎？還是要先買餐？

words.note: 語塊：entitle sb to（使某人有權……）、be entitled to（有權利……）。entitle sb to sth 是「讓某人有資格得到某物」；entitlement 是名詞「權利」；title 是「標題；頭銜」。

sentences.en: A large portrait of the company's founder hangs in the main hall of the headquarters.
sentences.zh: 公司創辦人的大型肖像掛在總部大廳。

sentences.en: The artist was asked to paint a portrait of the retiring president for the university library.
sentences.zh: 那位藝術家受邀為大學圖書館畫退休校長的肖像。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibition includes a portrait of every king and queen from the last three centuries.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽包含過去三個世紀每位國王和王后的肖像。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin works as a portrait photographer and takes headshots for business people and actors.
sentences.zh: 林小姐是人像攝影師，幫商務人士和演員拍大頭照。

sentences.en: The hotel decorated its lobby with a portrait of every family member who has run the business.
sentences.zh: 飯店在大廳裝飾了每位經營過這門生意的家族成員的肖像。

words.note: 語塊：portrait of（……的肖像）、paint a portrait（畫肖像）、portrait photographer（人像攝影師）。portrait 是人物的「肖像畫或照片」；landscape 是「風景畫」；portray 是動詞「描繪」。

sentences.en: The government will fund a project to build new bike paths in every district of the city.
sentences.zh: 政府將資助一項在市內每個區蓋新自行車道的專案。

sentences.en: Donations from local residents and businesses will fund the new library, which opens next year.
sentences.zh: 當地居民和企業的捐款將資助明年開幕的新圖書館。

sentences.en: Several companies agreed to fund research on cleaner fuels for airplanes and ships over the next ten years.
sentences.zh: 好幾家公司同意在未來十年資助飛機和船舶更乾淨燃料的研究。

sentences.en: The school will use money from the city to fund a new computer lab for its students.
sentences.zh: 學校會用市政府的錢資助學生新的電腦教室。

sentences.en: If we cannot fund the project ourselves, we will need to find an investor before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 如果我們無法自己出資，就需要在年底前找到投資人。

words.note: 語塊：fund a project（資助專案）、fund the library（資助圖書館）、fund research（資助研究）。fund 可以當動詞「資助」或名詞「基金；資金」；funding 是「資金」。

sentences.en: The company donated food and blankets to every victim of the flood in the southern part of the country.
sentences.zh: 公司捐贈食物和毯子給南部每位水災災民。

sentences.en: Several shops became the victim of a computer attack that stole customers' credit card information.
sentences.zh: 好幾家商店成為電腦攻擊的受害者，顧客的信用卡資料被竊。

sentences.en: The charity collects money to help every victim of the earthquake rebuild their homes and businesses.
sentences.zh: 慈善機構募款幫助每位地震災民重建家園和事業。

sentences.en: The bank warned customers not to become a victim of fake e-mails that ask for passwords.
sentences.zh: 銀行提醒顧客不要成為索取密碼的假電子郵件的受害者。

sentences.en: The city opened a special center where each victim of the storm can get food, water, and medical help.
sentences.zh: 市政府開設特別中心，讓每位暴風雨災民都能取得食物、水和醫療協助。

words.note: 語塊：flood victims（水災災民）、victim of（……的受害者）。victim 是「受到傷害的人」；victor 是「勝利者」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: The elevator will be closed for routine maintenance on Saturday morning from eight to noon.
sentences.zh: 電梯週六早上八點到中午會因例行維修暫停使用。

sentences.en: Technicians perform routine maintenance on all of the machines in the factory every three months.
sentences.zh: 技術人員每三個月對工廠所有機器進行例行維修。

sentences.en: The website will be unavailable for two hours tonight because of routine maintenance on the main server.
sentences.zh: 網站今晚會因為主伺服器例行維修而有兩小時無法使用。

sentences.en: Routine maintenance can help companies avoid costly repairs when their machines break down suddenly during busy periods.
sentences.zh: 例行保養可以幫助公司避免機器在忙碌時期突然故障時昂貴的修理費。
