sentences.en: The swimming pool will be closed for routine maintenance during the first week of every month.
sentences.zh: 游泳池每個月第一週會因例行維修關閉。

words.note: 語塊：perform routine maintenance（進行例行維修）、closed for routine maintenance（因例行維修暫停）。routine 是「例行的」；maintenance 是「保養、維修」；maintain 是動詞「維持；保養」。

sentences.en: Please contact the administration office if you need a new ID card or a parking permit.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要新的識別證或停車證，請聯絡行政處。

sentences.en: Students who want to change their classes must visit the administration office before Friday at five o'clock.
sentences.zh: 想換課的學生必須在週五五點前到行政辦公室辦理。

sentences.en: Please visit the administration office on the second floor, which is next to the meeting rooms.
sentences.zh: 請到二樓的行政辦公室，就在會議室旁邊。

sentences.en: All forms for vacation requests are available at the administration office and on the company website.
sentences.zh: 所有請假申請表都可以在行政辦公室和公司網站取得。

sentences.en: The administration office will be closed on Monday afternoon because the staff are attending a training session.
sentences.zh: 行政辦公室週一下午會關閉，因為員工要參加訓練課程。

words.note: 語塊：contact the administration office（聯絡行政處）、visit the administration office（到行政辦公室）。administration 是「行政；管理」；administrative 是形容詞「行政的」；office 是「辦公室」。

sentences.en: Employees who drive to work must display a parking permit on the front window of their car.
sentences.zh: 開車上班的員工必須在前擋風玻璃放停車證。

sentences.en: Foreign workers need a work permit before they can start their jobs at the factory.
sentences.zh: 外籍員工在工廠開始工作前需要工作許可。

sentences.en: The company cannot start building the new warehouse until it receives a building permit from the city.
sentences.zh: 公司在取得市政府建築許可之前，不能開始蓋新倉庫。

sentences.en: Please apply for a parking permit at the administration office at least one week before you need it.
sentences.zh: 請至少提前一週到行政辦公室申請停車證。

sentences.en: The restaurant needs a special permit to put tables and chairs on the street in front of the shop.
sentences.zh: 餐廳需要特別許可，才能在店門口的街上擺桌椅。

words.note: 語塊：parking permit（停車證）、work permit（工作許可）、building permit（建築許可）。permit 當名詞（重音在前）是「許可證」；當動詞（重音在後）是「允許」；permission 是「許可」。

sentences.en: The city decided to designate the old train station as a historic building that cannot be torn down.
sentences.zh: 市政府決定把舊火車站指定為不能拆除的歷史建築。

sentences.en: The company will designate an area behind the building for smoking, so please do not smoke near the entrance.
sentences.zh: 公司會在大樓後方指定一個吸菸區，所以請不要在入口附近吸菸。

sentences.en: The manager will designate one person to answer customer questions while the team is at the conference.
sentences.zh: 團隊去研討會期間，經理會指派一人回答顧客問題。

sentences.en: The hotel will designate ten parking spaces for guests with electric cars starting next month.
sentences.zh: 飯店從下個月起會指定十個停車位給開電動車的客人。

sentences.en: The government will designate the coastal waters near the island as a protected area for marine life.
sentences.zh: 政府將把島嶼附近的沿海水域指定為海洋生物保護區。

words.note: 語塊：designate as（指定為……）、designate an area（指定區域）、designate sb to（指派某人……）、designate spaces（指定位置）。designate 是「正式指定」；designated 當形容詞是「指定的」；design 是「設計」。

sentences.en: There is a vending machine on every floor of the hospital where visitors can buy drinks and snacks.
sentences.zh: 醫院每層樓都有一台自動販賣機，訪客可以買飲料和點心。

sentences.en: The vending machine near the elevator is broken, so please use the one in the cafeteria instead.
sentences.zh: 電梯旁邊的自動販賣機壞了，所以請改用餐廳裡的那台。

sentences.en: The new vending machine accepts cards and phones, so you do not need to carry coins anymore.
sentences.zh: 新的自動販賣機可以刷卡和用手機付款，所以不用再帶硬幣了。

sentences.en: The company replaced the snacks in the vending machine with healthier options such as nuts and fruit.
sentences.zh: 公司把自動販賣機裡的零食換成堅果和水果等更健康的選擇。

sentences.en: Workers on the night shift often use the vending machine because the cafeteria closes at eight o'clock.
sentences.zh: 夜班工人常常使用自動販賣機，因為餐廳八點就關了。

words.note: 語塊：use the vending machine（使用自動販賣機）、vending machine on the floor（樓層的自動販賣機）。vending 是「販賣」；vendor 是「小販；供應商」。

sentences.en: The captain announced that the plane would land in Tokyo about twenty minutes earlier than expected.
sentences.zh: 機長宣布飛機會比預期早二十分鐘降落東京。

sentences.en: The ship captain has more than thirty years of experience sailing in the coastal waters of Asia.
sentences.zh: 那位船長在亞洲沿海水域航行超過三十年。

sentences.en: Ms. Ruiz was chosen as team captain of the company's football team because of her leadership skills.
sentences.zh: 魯伊茲小姐因為領導能力被選為公司足球隊的隊長。

sentences.en: The captain of the cruise ship welcomed all of the passengers at a special dinner on the first night.
sentences.zh: 郵輪船長在第一晚的特別晚宴上歡迎所有乘客。

sentences.en: Passengers must follow the instructions of the captain and the crew in case of emergency.
sentences.zh: 萬一發生緊急情況，乘客必須遵從機長和機組人員的指示。

words.note: 語塊：ship captain（船長）、team captain（隊長）、captain of（……的機長／船長）。captain 是負責一架飛機、一艘船或一支隊伍的人；pilot 是「飛行員」。

sentences.en: The retiring manager gave a touching speech that made many of her colleagues and friends cry.
sentences.zh: 即將退休的經理發表了一場動人的演講，讓很多同事和朋友都哭了。

sentences.en: The film tells a touching story about a small family restaurant that survives a difficult year.
sentences.zh: 那部電影講述一家小型家庭餐廳撐過艱難一年的感人故事。

sentences.en: Customers left many touching messages on our website after the bakery announced it would close.
sentences.zh: 麵包店宣布要結束營業後，顧客在我們網站上留下很多感人的留言。

sentences.en: The CEO's touching speech at the anniversary dinner thanked every employee and partner by name.
sentences.zh: 執行長在週年晚宴上的動人演講，一一點名感謝每位員工和合作夥伴。

sentences.en: The magazine published a touching story about a teacher who has helped students for forty years.
sentences.zh: 雜誌刊登了一篇關於一位幫助學生四十年的老師的感人故事。

words.note: 語塊：touching story（感人的故事）、touching speech（動人的演講）。touching 當形容詞是「令人感動的」；touch 是「觸摸」；moving 意思接近。

sentences.en: The speaker started the presentation with a light-hearted story about his first job that made the audience laugh.
sentences.zh: 講者用一個關於他第一份工作的輕鬆故事開場，讓觀眾笑了出來。

sentences.en: The company's new advertisements have a light-hearted tone that young customers on social media seem to enjoy.
sentences.zh: 公司的新廣告語氣輕鬆，社群媒體上的年輕顧客似乎很喜歡。

sentences.en: After a long week of work, many people prefer to watch a light-hearted film instead of a serious drama.
sentences.zh: 忙碌工作一週後，很多人比較喜歡看輕鬆的電影，而不是嚴肅的劇。

sentences.en: The meeting was light-hearted, but the team still made several important decisions about the project.
sentences.zh: 會議氣氛很輕鬆，但團隊還是對專案做了幾個重要決定。

sentences.en: The magazine's light-hearted tone makes it popular with readers who want to relax on weekends.
sentences.zh: 雜誌輕鬆的語氣讓它很受想在週末放鬆的讀者歡迎。

words.note: 語塊：light-hearted film（輕鬆的電影）、light-hearted tone（輕鬆的語氣）。light-hearted 是「心情輕鬆、不沉重的」；serious 是「嚴肅的」。

sentences.en: The small business continued to grow in the face of adversity, even when the economy was very weak.
sentences.zh: 即使經濟非常不景氣，那家小公司面對逆境仍持續成長。

sentences.en: The book tells the story of a woman who had to overcome adversity to become a successful chef.
sentences.zh: 那本書講述一位女性克服逆境成為成功主廚的故事。

sentences.en: Good leaders stay calm in the face of adversity and help their teams find solutions.
sentences.zh: 好的領導者在面對逆境時保持冷靜，幫助團隊找出解決辦法。

sentences.en: The award is given to an employee who has shown courage and the ability to overcome adversity.
sentences.zh: 這個獎頒給展現勇氣和克服逆境能力的員工。

sentences.en: The company learned many lessons from adversity during the difficult years after the storm destroyed its factory.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨摧毀工廠後艱難的那幾年，公司從逆境中學到很多教訓。

words.note: 語塊：in the face of adversity（面對逆境）、overcome adversity（克服逆境）。adversity 是「艱困的處境」；hardship 意思接近；adversary 是「對手」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: There was a sudden spike in orders after a famous actor wore our jacket in a popular television show.
sentences.zh: 一位知名演員在熱門電視節目中穿了我們的外套後，訂單突然暴增。

sentences.en: The hot weather caused a spike in electricity use, so the city asked residents to save energy.
sentences.zh: 炎熱天氣造成用電量激增，所以市政府呼籲居民節約能源。

sentences.en: The company saw a spike in website visits after it announced the holiday sale on social media.
sentences.zh: 公司在社群媒體宣布假期特賣後，網站造訪量激增。

sentences.en: Hospitals reported a sudden spike in patients with colds during the first week of winter.
sentences.zh: 冬天第一週，醫院通報感冒病人突然暴增。

sentences.en: A spike in fuel prices has made it more expensive for airlines to fly long distances.
sentences.zh: 燃料價格激增讓航空公司飛長途航線的成本更高。

words.note: 語塊：spike in（……的激增）、sudden spike（突然暴增）。spike 是「急劇上升的高點」；surge 意思接近；drop 是「下降」。

sentences.en: According to an unnamed source, the company plans to close three of its factories next year.
sentences.zh: 根據一位不具名消息來源，公司打算明年關閉三座工廠。

sentences.en: The painting was sold to an unnamed buyer for more than five million dollars at the auction.
sentences.zh: 那幅畫在拍賣會上以超過五百萬元賣給一位匿名買家。

sentences.en: An unnamed investor has offered to fund the new hospital, but the details have not been announced.
sentences.zh: 一位未具名的投資人提議資助新醫院，但細節尚未公布。

sentences.en: The newspaper reported the story based on information from an unnamed source inside the government.
sentences.zh: 報紙根據政府內部一位不具名消息來源的資訊報導了這則新聞。

sentences.en: The hotel was bought by an unnamed buyer who plans to turn it into luxury apartments.
sentences.zh: 那家飯店被一位匿名買家買下，他打算改建成豪華公寓。

words.note: 語塊：unnamed source（不具名消息來源）、unnamed buyer（匿名買家）。unnamed 是「沒有透露名字的」；anonymous 意思接近；named 是「被點名的」。

sentences.en: The meeting room has a large rectangular table that can seat up to twenty people.
sentences.zh: 會議室有一張大長方桌，最多可以坐二十人。

sentences.en: The new phone has a rectangular shape with rounded corners and a very thin screen.
sentences.zh: 新手機是有圓角的長方形，螢幕非常薄。

sentences.en: Please cut the paper into rectangular pieces that are about ten centimeters long and five centimeters wide.
sentences.zh: 請把紙剪成大約十公分長、五公分寬的長方形小片。

sentences.en: The garden has a rectangular pool in the middle, surrounded by colorful flowers and wooden benches.
sentences.zh: 花園中間有一個長方形水池，四周有繽紛的花和木頭長椅。

sentences.en: The designer chose a rectangular table for the dining room because it fits the long, narrow space.
sentences.zh: 設計師為飯廳選了一張長方桌，因為它適合狹長的空間。

words.note: 語塊：rectangular table（長方桌）、rectangular shape（長方形）。rectangular 是 rectangle（長方形）的形容詞；square 是「正方形」；circular 是「圓形的」。

sentences.en: Please check the technical specification of the printer before you buy ink or paper for it online.
sentences.zh: 在網路上幫印表機買墨水或紙之前，請先查看它的技術規格。

sentences.en: All parts made in the factory must meet the specification provided by the client in the contract.
sentences.zh: 工廠製造的所有零件都必須符合客戶在合約中提供的規格。

sentences.en: The product specification on our website includes the size, weight, and power use of each machine.
sentences.zh: 我們網站上的產品規格包含每台機器的尺寸、重量和耗電量。

sentences.en: The engineers rejected the shipment because the materials did not meet the specification in the contract.
sentences.zh: 工程師退回了那批貨，因為材料不符合合約中的規格。

sentences.en: Please send us the technical specification for the new laptop so that the IT team can review it.
sentences.zh: 請寄給我們新筆電的技術規格，讓資訊團隊審閱。

words.note: 語塊：technical specification（技術規格）、meet the specifications（符合規格）、product specification（產品規格）。specification 常縮寫成 spec，常用複數；specify 是動詞「明確指定」。

sentences.en: The hotel will be closed for refurbishment from January until the end of March next year.
sentences.zh: 飯店明年從一月到三月底會因整修暫停營業。

sentences.en: The old theater will undergo refurbishment next year, including new seats and a larger stage.
sentences.zh: 舊劇院明年將進行整修，包括新座位和更大的舞台。

sentences.en: After a complete refurbishment last summer, the office looks modern and has much better lighting.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天全面翻新後，辦公室看起來很現代，照明也好很多。

sentences.en: The museum raised money from local businesses to pay for the refurbishment of its main hall.
sentences.zh: 博物館向當地企業募款支付大廳的整修費用。

sentences.en: Several shops on the main street are closed for refurbishment, but they will reopen before the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 主要街道上有好幾家店因整修暫停營業，但會在假期購物季前重新開幕。

words.note: 語塊：undergo refurbishment（進行整修）、closed for refurbishment（整修暫停營業）、complete refurbishment（全面翻新）。refurbishment 是 refurbish（翻新）的名詞；renovation 意思接近。

sentences.en: Please take your car to an authorized dealer for repairs, or the warranty may not be valid.
sentences.zh: 請把車送到授權經銷商維修，否則保固可能會失效。

sentences.en: The car dealer offered us a good price on a new electric vehicle because it was the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 因為是月底，汽車經銷商給了我們一台新電動車很好的價格。

sentences.en: The painting was sold by a famous art dealer in London to a museum in New York.
sentences.zh: 那幅畫由倫敦一位知名藝術品商賣給紐約一家博物館。

sentences.en: Our products are available from any authorized dealer in the country, as well as on our website.
sentences.zh: 我們的產品可以在全國任何一家授權經銷商購買，也可以在我們網站上買。

sentences.en: The car dealer near the highway will hold a big sale this weekend with prices up to twenty percent off.
sentences.zh: 高速公路附近的汽車經銷商這週末會舉辦大特賣，最多打八折。

words.note: 語塊：car dealer（汽車經銷商）、authorized dealer（授權經銷商）、art dealer（藝術品商）。dealer 是「買賣某種商品的商人」；deal 是「交易」；distributor 是「批發商」。

sentences.en: The company moved its factory to another country because labor costs there are much lower.
sentences.zh: 公司把工廠搬到另一個國家，因為那裡的人力成本低很多。

sentences.en: Many farms are facing a labor shortage, so they are using machines to pick fruit and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 很多農場面臨勞力短缺，所以改用機器採收蔬果。

sentences.en: The labor union asked the company to increase wages and give workers more holidays every year.
sentences.zh: 工會要求公司調高工資，並每年給工人更多假期。

sentences.en: Rising labor costs have forced many restaurants in the city to raise their prices this year.
sentences.zh: 人力成本上升迫使市內很多餐廳今年漲價。

sentences.en: The government is working with business leaders to solve the labor shortage in the healthcare sector.
sentences.zh: 政府正與企業領袖合作，解決醫療產業的勞力短缺問題。

words.note: 語塊：labor costs（人力成本）、labor shortage（勞力短缺）、labor union（工會）。labor 是美式拼法，英式是 labour；laboratory 是「實驗室」。

sentences.en: Many companies are investing in emerging markets in Africa and Southeast Asia, where the economy is growing quickly.
sentences.zh: 很多公司投資非洲和東南亞的新興市場，那裡的經濟成長很快。

sentences.en: The conference will focus on emerging technology, such as artificial intelligence, robots, and electric aircraft.
sentences.zh: 研討會將聚焦人工智慧、機器人和電動飛機等新興科技。

sentences.en: The company hired a consultant to help it enter emerging markets where it has never done business before.
sentences.zh: 公司雇用顧問，幫助它進入以前從沒做過生意的新興市場。

sentences.en: Students who study emerging technology at university will have many job opportunities after they graduate.
sentences.zh: 在大學研究新興科技的學生畢業後會有很多工作機會。

sentences.en: Several emerging companies in the energy sector have received financial backing from large banks and investors.
sentences.zh: 能源產業好幾家新興公司已獲得大型銀行和投資人的資金支持。

words.note: 語塊：emerging market（新興市場）、emerging technology（新興科技）。emerging 是「剛開始出現、正在發展的」；emerge 是動詞「出現」；emergency 是「緊急情況」。

sentences.en: Many families rent out a room in their homes to tourists during the summer festival.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭在夏季節慶期間把家裡的房間出租給觀光客。

sentences.en: The restaurant will rent out the space on the second floor for private parties and business dinners.
sentences.zh: 餐廳會把二樓的空間出租給私人派對和商務晚宴使用。

sentences.en: If you rent out your apartment, you must tell the building manager and follow the rules.
sentences.zh: 如果你出租公寓，必須通知大樓管理員並遵守規定。

sentences.en: The company decided to rent out the empty floors of its building to small start-ups.
sentences.zh: 公司決定把大樓空著的樓層出租給小型新創公司。

sentences.en: The school will rent out its gymnasium to local sports clubs on weekends to earn extra money.
sentences.zh: 學校週末會把體育館出租給當地運動俱樂部，賺取額外收入。

words.note: 語塊：rent out a room（出租房間）、rent out the space（出租場地）、rent out the floors（出租樓層）、rent out an apartment（出租公寓）、rent out the gymnasium（出租體育館）。rent out 是「把自己的東西租給別人」；rent 單獨用可以是「租入」或「租出」。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a service where trained staff look after children while their parents go to dinner.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供讓受過訓練的員工在父母去吃晚餐時照顧孩子的服務。

sentences.en: Our sales staff are trained to look after customers carefully and answer all of their questions.
sentences.zh: 我們的銷售人員受過訓練，要細心招呼顧客並回答他們所有的問題。

sentences.en: Please look after the new employee during her first week and show her how the system works.
sentences.zh: 請在新員工第一週照顧她，並教她系統怎麼用。

sentences.en: Workers who stay late every night should remember to look after themselves and get enough sleep.
sentences.zh: 每晚都加班的員工應該記得照顧好自己、睡飽。

sentences.en: Ms. Kim asked her neighbor to look after her dog while she was on a business trip in Japan.
sentences.zh: 金小姐去日本出差時，請鄰居幫她照顧狗。

words.note: 語塊：look after children（照顧小孩）、look after customers（招呼顧客）、look after themselves（照顧自己）、look after the new employee（照顧新同事）、look after a dog（照顧狗）。look after 等於 take care of；look for 是「尋找」；look into 是「調查」。

sentences.en: The store announced a price reduction of thirty percent on all winter clothing this weekend.
sentences.zh: 那家店宣布這週末所有冬季服飾降價三成。

sentences.en: The new machines will lead to a cost reduction of about twenty percent in the factory.
sentences.zh: 新機器會讓工廠的成本降低約兩成。

sentences.en: There has been a reduction in the number of traffic accidents since the new speed limit was introduced.
sentences.zh: 自從實施新速限以來，交通事故數量減少了。

sentences.en: The company's cost reduction plan includes using less paper and turning off lights at night.
sentences.zh: 公司的成本降低計畫包括減少用紙和晚上關燈。

sentences.en: Customers who buy more than ten items will receive an extra price reduction at the counter.
sentences.zh: 購買超過十件商品的顧客在櫃台可以再享額外降價。

words.note: 語塊：price reduction（降價）、cost reduction（成本降低）、reduction in（……的減少）。reduction 是 reduce（減少）的名詞；deduction 是「扣除」，拼法很像。

sentences.en: Mr. Lee decided to turn down the job offer because he did not want to move to another city.
sentences.zh: 李先生決定拒絕那份工作邀約，因為他不想搬到另一個城市。

sentences.en: I am sorry, but I must turn down the invitation to dinner because I will be traveling that week.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，我必須婉拒晚餐邀請，因為那週我要出差。

sentences.en: Please turn down the volume of the music in the store, because customers cannot hear each other.
sentences.zh: 請把店裡的音樂音量調低，因為顧客聽不到彼此說話。

sentences.en: The board may turn down the offer if the buyer does not agree to keep all of the employees.
sentences.zh: 如果買方不同意留下所有員工，董事會可能會拒絕那個提議。

sentences.en: Please turn down the heating in the meeting room, because several people said it was too hot.
sentences.zh: 請把會議室的暖氣調低，因為好幾個人說太熱了。

words.note: 語塊：turn down an offer（拒絕提議）、turn down an invitation（婉拒邀請）、turn down the volume（調低音量）。turn down 是「拒絕」或「（音量、溫度）調低」；turn up 是相反「調高；出現」。

sentences.en: Customers can look up information about their orders and deliveries on our website at any time.
sentences.zh: 顧客可以隨時在我們網站上查詢訂單和送貨資訊。

sentences.en: If you do not know a word in the contract, please look up the meaning before you sign it.
sentences.zh: 如果合約裡有你不認識的字，簽名前請先查意思。

sentences.en: Employees can look up their remaining vacation days in the new app instead of asking the administration office.
sentences.zh: 員工可以在新 App 查詢剩下的假期天數，不用再問行政辦公室。

sentences.en: You can look up the opening hours of the museum on its website before you visit.
sentences.zh: 參觀前，你可以在博物館網站上查詢開放時間。

sentences.en: Please look up the client's phone number in the database and call her back this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 請在資料庫查一下客戶的電話號碼，今天下午回電給她。

words.note: 語塊：look up information（查詢資訊）、look up a word（查單字）、look up days（查詢天數）。look up 是「查」或「好轉」；look up to sb 是「尊敬某人」。

notes.note: 意思像 make（讓某人去做某事），但句型不同：prompt + 人 + to + 動詞（The rain prompted us to stay home.）；make + 人 + 動詞原形，不加 to（The rain made us stay home.）。make 較口語、帶「不得不」的感覺；prompt 較正式，指某件事成為原因、讓人決定去做。prompt 當形容詞是「迅速的」（a prompt reply）；放在名詞前通常是形容詞，後面接「人 + to + 動詞」就是動詞「促使」。

improve 和 enhance 意思很接近，都可以接 quality（品質）。improve＝把不好的變好、改善；enhance＝把本來就不錯的再提升、加強（例如 enhance the flavor 提升風味）。

語塊：outgoing／friendly personality（外向／親切的個性）、strong personality（個性很強）、personality traits（人格特質）。personality 也可以指「名人」（可數）：a TV personality（電視名人）、a well-known personality（知名人物）、a radio personality（電台主持人）。和 character 的差別：personality 偏外在個性，character 偏品格。別搞混 personnel（全體員工、人事）。
